title: Business Development Executive – IT Services
description:
**Indeed Job Title**  
Business Development Executive – IT Services

**Job Description**  
We are looking for a Business Development Executive – IT Services to identify potential clients, generate new business opportunities, build strategic client relationships, and drive revenue growth for IT services.

The role involves B2B prospecting, client acquisition, understanding business and technology requirements, presenting IT solutions, preparing proposals, and converting prospects into long-term clients. The candidate should have a good understanding of IT services such as website development, custom software development, web applications, mobile app development, e-commerce solutions, and other technology services.

Key responsibilities include:

* Identify and approach potential clients, including startups, SMEs, enterprises, and businesses requiring IT solutions
* Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and other prospecting channels
* Research target industries and companies to identify potential clients and relevant decision-makers such as Founders, CEOs, CTOs, Directors, and Business Owners
* Understand client business challenges, technical requirements, project objectives, timelines, and budget expectations
* Present relevant IT services and explain how technology solutions can improve business operations, customer experience, and overall efficiency
* Conduct discovery calls, client meetings, and online presentations to understand requirements and identify sales opportunities
* Prepare and share business proposals, quotations, project estimates, and service presentations in coordination with technical and project teams
* Explain project scope, deliverables, timelines, engagement models, and commercial terms to potential clients
* Follow up with prospects through calls, emails, LinkedIn, and meetings to move opportunities through the sales pipeline
* Coordinate with developers, designers, project managers, and technical teams to clarify client requirements and propose suitable solutions
* Negotiate pricing, project scope, and commercial terms within company guidelines
* Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, proposals, follow-ups, and sales opportunities in CRM, Excel, or Google Sheets
* Monitor sales pipeline progress and achieve assigned business development, client acquisition, and revenue targets
* Build long-term relationships with clients to generate repeat business, referrals, renewals, and additional project opportunities
* Research industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technology requirements to identify new business opportunities

**Experience**  
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in business development, B2B sales, IT services sales, or client acquisition preferred. Experience selling website development, custom software development, mobile applications, web applications, or other technology solutions will be an advantage.

**Who Can Apply**

* Candidates with experience in business development, B2B sales, IT sales, or client acquisition
* Candidates who understand IT services and can communicate the business value of technology solutions to potential clients
* Candidates comfortable with cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, and online or in-person client meetings
* Candidates who can identify decision-makers such as Founders, CEOs, CTOs, Directors, and Business Owners
* Candidates capable of understanding client requirements and coordinating with technical teams to prepare suitable proposals
* Candidates with strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
* Candidates comfortable managing sales pipelines, CRM systems, follow-ups, and monthly sales targets
* Experience in an IT company, software development company, web development agency, or technology services company will be preferred
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in IT sales and business development may also apply, depending on the company's requirements

**Skills**  
IT Services Sales · Business Development · B2B Sales · Lead Generation · Client Acquisition · Prospect Research · IT Solutions Sales · Website Development · Software Development · Web Applications · Mobile App Development · Cold Calling · Email Outreach · LinkedIn Prospecting · Client Requirement Analysis · Proposal Preparation · Negotiation · Sales Pipeline Management · CRM · Excel · Google Sheets · Communication Skills

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Anand Vihar, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:

**This role follows a rotational shift aligned with global client requirements.)**

The Role We are seeking an Analytics Consultant – Web & Mobile (Implementation) to deploy and optimise digital analytics solutions using platforms like Heap and Contentsquare. This role focuses on event tracking, implementation, and enabling clients to leverage behavioural data for product, marketing, and growth decisions. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong client-facing communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Technical & Domain Expertise ● Deploy and configure product analytics tools (Contentsquare, Heap) for event tagging, data capture, and KPI alignment ● Integrate analytics SDKs within mobile frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Xamarin) and align with tools like Firebase Analytics or Adjust ● Configure PII masking, API integrations, and data enrichment workflows ● Guide client technical teams in defining tracking requirements using HTML, CSS selectors, and JavaScript for web element mapping ● Implement and validate event tracking to ensure accurate and reliable data capture ● Conduct QA audits using console-based debugging to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness ● Develop detailed tracking plans and implementation documentation ● Analyse web and mobile behavioural data to uncover user patterns and recommend product and marketing optimisations ● Handshaking of data between MarTech tools — A/B testing, CRMs, transaction tools, tag managers, CDPs, marketing attribution tools, in-app guidance, etc. ● Design and implement UTM tracking frameworks and multi-touch attribution models for multi-channel campaigns ● Integrate marketing data sources with analytics platforms for ROI measurement across paid vs. organic acquisition 2. Mobile App Analytics ● Own end-to-end mobile analytics implementation across acquisition, engagement, retention, and user experience — a critical growth area for enterprise clients ● Instrument mobile-specific events (app installs, session start, in-app purchases, push interactions, deep links) and align with attribution SDKs like Adjust, AppsFlyer, or Firebase ● Measure mobile funnels, drop-offs, engagement metrics, retention curves, and cohort behaviour ● Advise clients on mobile metrics frameworks, data governance, and platform-specific nuances (iOS SKAdNetwork, Android privacy sandbox, consent management) ● Partner with client mobile engineering teams on A/B testing strategies and UX optimisation initiatives 3. Client Engagement & Delivery ● Translate business requirements into structured tracking and analytics implementation plans ● Manage end-to-end onboarding and implementation projects within agreed timelines ● Conduct workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations with client teams ● Provide ongoing advisory support to maximise analytics platform value realisation and build long-term client relationships

Requirements Essential ● Hands-on implementation experience with one or more analytics platforms: Heap, Contentsquare, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics, or Google Analytics (GA4/360). ● Experience configuring events, conversions, tracking plans, and data layers. ● Working knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, and basic JavaScript. ● Experience in instrumenting mobile analytics SDKs. ● Strong understanding of marketing analytics fundamentals (UTM parameters, attribution models, paid vs. organic analysis). ● Familiarity with ETL and BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Power BI, Tableau) for validation and reporting. ● Strong analytical reasoning and ability to translate insights into business recommendations. ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ● Ability to collaborate across developers, marketers, and product teams. ● Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments ● Exposure to AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for accelerating implementation, QA, and documentation Bonus Qualifications ● Experience with session replay and heatmapping tools. ● Familiarity with experimentation platforms (Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, or similar). ● SQL proficiency for advanced data analysis. ● Experience delivering analytics projects for US or European clients. ● Exposure to server-side tracking implementations. ● Knowledge of mobile acquisition and retention metric frameworks. What We’re Looking For Beyond technical capabilities, the ideal candidate demonstrates: ● Strong client empathy and the ability to simplify complex analytics concepts. ● A proactive, solution-oriented mindset. ● Close attention to detail in tracking, validation and documentation. ● Ownership mindset with strong follow-through. ● Curiosity and a continuous learning attitude toward emerging analytics tools and methodologies.

**You’ll Gain in This Role**
● Hands-on experience with leading analytics platforms like Heap and Contentsquare ● Exposure to global clients and complex digital ecosystems ● Opportunity to work across web, mobile, product, and marketing analytics ● Strong consulting + technical implementation skill development ● Fast learning curve in a high-growth analytics environment Why Join Us You will work at the intersection of technology, analytics, and business strategy, helping global clients unlock the value of behavioural data. Scaletrix.AI has helped various companies develop end-to-end solutions by bringing data engineering and data sciences together. Heap is trusted by enterprises like Microsoft, AMD, and Twilio. Scaletrix.AI is a strategic partner and India Center of Excellence for the platform.

Website: https://contentsquare.com/interactive/ https://www.heap.io/ You will work extensively on these platforms for real client problem-solving, gaining hands-on experience in digital experience and behavioural analytics.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
  
  
UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with very large distributed systems
* Knowledge of design process
* Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Credgenics is a technology-driven, SaaS-based debt collections and NPA resolution platform backed by investors including Accel Partners and Titan Capital. We work with banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and digital lending firms to improve collections efficiency through technology, automation, intelligence and digital workflows. Our platform helps financial institutions improve recovery outcomes, operational efficiency, reach and customer experience.

**The Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic Technology Interns who are eager to learn, build and solve real-world engineering problems in a fast-paced product environment. Depending on their skills and interests, interns may contribute to backend services and APIs, frontend web applications, or DevOps and cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to develop, test, deploy and maintain reliable software systems while learning industry-standard engineering practices.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Backend Development: Support the development and maintenance of backend services, REST APIs and database-driven applications.
* Frontend Development: Build and improve user-facing web features using JavaScript and React.js, with HTML and CSS.
* DevOps & Cloud: Assist with application deployments, cloud services, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation and monitoring.
* Write clean, readable and maintainable code, and participate in debugging, testing and code reviews.
* Work with databases and APIs to support reliable data flow between application components.
* Collaborate with backend, frontend, QA and DevOps engineers to deliver integrated product features.
* Help identify and troubleshoot performance, reliability and deployment issues.
* Document technical work and follow team practices for source control, testing, security and release management.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech/BE, MCA or a related technical degree.
* Strong fundamentals in programming, data structures, algorithms and problem-solving.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript or a similar language.
* For frontend work: familiarity with JavaScript, React.js, HTML5, CSS and responsive web design.
* For backend work: understanding of REST APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases and basic software design principles.
* For DevOps work: basic familiarity with Linux/Unix, AWS or another cloud platform, Git, Docker, scripting or CI/CD concepts.
* Familiarity with Git or another source-control tool; exposure to testing and debugging is an advantage.
* Curiosity to learn new technologies, attention to detail, good communication and a collaborative mindset.
* Ownership, adaptability and a willingness to work in a fast-paced, product-focused environment.

**Good to Have**

* Academic, personal or internship projects in web development, backend engineering, cloud or automation.
* Exposure to microservices, system design basics, CI/CD tools, Docker, AWS services, infrastructure as code or monitoring tools.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, unit testing and code reviews.

**Why Credgenics?**

Join a collaborative, fast-paced technology environment where you can work on real product challenges, learn from experienced engineers and contribute to technology that is transforming the financial services ecosystem.

**Internship Details**

Location: Noida

title: Senior Software Architect
description:

Copa Airlines is a leading Latin American airline recognized for its strong profitability and extensive route network, operating about 320 daily flights to 80 destinations in 32 countries across the Americas and the Caribbean. As a member of the Star Alliance and partner of United Airlines through code share agreements, Copa offers broad connectivity and global reach. **Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Senior Software Architect role is based in Bengaluru. The Senior Software Architect will define and maintain the overall software architecture for mission-critical airline and enterprise systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Responsibilities include collaborating with business and product stakeholders to translate requirements into architectural designs, guiding development teams with clear technical standards, and conducting architecture and code reviews. The Senior Software Architect will also mentor engineers, support continuous improvement of engineering practices, and work closely with operations teams to ensure robust deployment and monitoring strategies.

title: Principal Software Architect - Next Gen Informatics
description:
**Job Requirements**
Job Description
  
  
Principal Software Architect is responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end architecture of high performant, scalable, resilient next-generation laboratory informatics software platform, including instrument connectivity, laboratory workflows, quality control (QC), result management, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong software engineering and architectural expertise with demonstrated experience in
**AI-native software development**
- requiring the ability to transform conventional engineering workflows into AI-enabled development practices using coding agents, automated code analysis, agentic workflows, AI-assisted testing, and continuous verification while maintaining architectural integrity, security, and product quality.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Enterprise and Solution Architecture**
Own the end-to-end software architecture, including system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, deployment topology, and technology choices.
  
  
Define modular, extensible architectures supporting multiple instrument vendors, laboratory sites, product configurations, and deployment environments.
  
  
Establish architectural principles, design patterns, interface contracts, coding standards, and reference architectures.
  
  
Make informed build-versus-buy and architectural trade-off decisions considering reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and total cost of ownership.
  
  
Identify architectural risks, structural technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and opportunities for platform simplification.
  
  
Guide architecture evolution and modernization of legacy systems without compromising existing customer workflows or data integrity.
  
  
**AI-Native Software Architecture and Engineering**
Define the technical strategy for integrating AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, and maintenance.
  
  
Design AI-enabled engineering workflows using coding agents, agentic development environments, codebase intelligence, and automated verification.
  
  
Establish architectural context, repository-level instructions, machine-readable specifications, and guardrails that enable AI agents to work safely within complex software systems.
  
  
Evaluate AI agent architectures, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and code graph technologies where appropriate.
  
  
Establish repeatable evaluations for AI-generated code, including correctness, architectural conformance, test effectiveness, security, maintainability, and regression risk.
  
  
Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity without compromising software quality or release integrity.
  
  
**Instrument Connectivity and Interoperability Architecture**
Define a reusable connectivity architecture for integrating diagnostic instruments from multiple vendors.
  
  
Establish abstractions for protocol adapters, device drivers, message parsing, normalization, acknowledgements, retry, buffering, and recovery.
  
  
Guide implementation of TCP/IP and serial communication, vendor-specific protocols, and relevant standards such as CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.
  
  
Defining canonical data models and interface contracts for instrument messages, results, QC data, device status, and configuration.
  
  
Design for intermittent connectivity, duplicate or malformed messages, out-of-order events, service restarts, and safe recovery.
  
  
Establish simulator-based testing and conformance strategies that reduce the cost and complexity of onboarding new instruments.
  
  
**Laboratory Domain and Data Architecture**
Translate laboratory workflows and domain requirements into explicit, testable architectural models.
  
  
Define architectures for QC management, Levey–Jennings charts, Westgard rules, result review, QC closeout, alerting, and audit trails.
  
  
Establish data models and persistence strategies for historical results, QC observations, configuration versions, rule changes, and operator actions.
  
  
Ensure deterministic processing, traceability, historical reproducibility, and appropriate handling of concurrent updates.
  
  
**Key Technical Skills And Experience**
**Software Engineering**
15+ years in software engineering, including significant experience in software architecture and technical leadership
  
  
Strong proficiency in C#, .NET / .NET Core, object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and software design patterns.
  
  
Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant high-performance scalable applications.
  
  
Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or comparable frontend frameworks.
  
  
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, automated testing, CI/CD, debugging, security, and production issue resolution.
  
  
**Domain Experience - Mandatory**
Deep expertise in laboratory middleware systems, instrument drivers, message translation.
  
  
Clinical laboratory workflows, QC processes, result review, and instrument integration.
  
  
Laboratory instrument communication standards, including ASTM, CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.
  
  
Healthcare IT, LIS, laboratory middleware, diagnostic software, or IVD product development.
  
  
Applicable healthcare software lifecycle, quality-management, risk-management, and cybersecurity standards.
  
  
**AI-Native Development - Mandatory**
Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools in real software delivery projects.
  
  
Ability to design and implement AI-enabled engineering workflows spanning requirements analysis, codebase exploration, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and documentation.
  
  
Practical experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent agentic development environments.
  
  
Experience creating and maintaining repository-level AI instructions, reusable agent workflows, project context, and engineering guardrails.
  
  
Understanding of agent tool use, context windows, structured outputs, model limitations, and techniques for grounding AI-generated changes in actual code and specifications.
  
  
Experience integrating AI agents with source control, work items, build pipelines, test frameworks, and other engineering tools.
  
  
Ability to establish automated verification & human review mechanisms for AI-generated code.
  
  
Demonstrated understanding of AI failure modes, including hallucinated APIs, incorrect assumptions, insecure code, incomplete test coverage, and unintended architectural changes.
  
  
Practical knowledge of secure AI usage, confidential-data protection, access controls, auditability, and software licensing considerations.
  
  
Experience building custom coding agents, agentic workflows, or multi-agent engineering systems.
  
  
Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and codebase indexing.
  
  
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool integrations, or equivalent mechanisms for exposing engineering systems to AI agents.
  
  
Experience with code graphs, dependency analysis, semantic code search, and repository-scale reasoning.
  
  
**Qualifications And Experience**
Engineering degree in Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
15+ years of professional experience in SW product development
  
  
Sound knowledge of SDLC and agile practices.
  
  
Other Attributes
  
  
Excellent spoken & written communication skills
  
  
Detail oriented with strong problem solving and analytical skills
  
  
Team player with a proactive approach
  
  
Self-starter, quick learner, and passionate problem resolver

title: Principal Software Architect- High Performance Computing
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**Our Team**
Our team is developing a high-performance computing solution for low-latency and high throughput image processing and deep-learning workload that enables our Chip Manufacturing process control equipment to offer differentiated value to our customers.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**
As an architect, you will get the opportunity to grow in the field of high-performance computing, GPU compute infra, complex system design and low-level optimizations for better cost of ownership.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibility**

* As a Software Architect, you will be responsible for design and implementation of robust, scalable infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs).
* You will analyze and partition workloads to the most appropriate compute unit, ensuring tasks like AI inference and parallel processing runs on specialized accelerators, while serial tasks run on CPUs.
* You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Algo engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs.
* You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data.
* You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers in the HPC domain.
* You will be expected to profile entire cluster of nodes and each node with profilers to understand bottlenecks, optimize workflows and code and processes to improve cost of ownership.
* Conduct performance tuning and capacity planning, monitoring GPU metrics (e.g., using NVIDIA DCGM) for reliability
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements.
* Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems.
* Ensure that software systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.
* Your primary focus will be on ensuring that the software systems are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost effective.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
Someone who is passionate about and has deep understanding and experience in design and development of cutting edge HPC systems and heterogenous computing infrastructure. He should have very good hands-on experience in parallel programming (CUDA) and AI inference infrastructure. He should be able to multi-task and switch contexts based on business needs.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12 to 18 years of experience in implementing robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs)
* Working experience of GPU inference server like Nvidia Triton.
* Very good knowledge C/C++, Data structure and Algorithms and complexity analysis.
* Experience in developing Distributed High Performance Computing software using Parallel programming frameworks like MPI, UCX etc.
* Experience in GPU programming using CUDA, OpenMP, OpenACC, OpenCL etc.
* In depth experience in Multi-threading, Thread Synchronization, Inter process communication, and distributed computing fundamentals.
* Experience in Inter Process communication using Shared memory and Pipes.
* Experience in performance profiling at application and system level (e.g. vtune, Oprofiler, perf, Nividia Nsight etc.)
* Experience in low level code optimization techniques using Vectorization and Intrinsics, cache-aware programming, lock free data structures etc.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization technologies (docker/singularity) and low latency Message queues.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
* Ability to mentor and coach junior team members.
* Experience in Agile development methodologies.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Experience in HPC Job-Scheduling and Cluster Management Software (SLURM, Torque, LSF etc.)
* Good knowledge of Low-latency and high-throughput data transfer technologies (RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand)
* Good Knowledge of Parallel processing and DAG execution Frameworks like Intel TBB flowgraph, OpenCL/SYCL etc.

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 10% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes

description:

**About the Job:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java Technical Architect with strong expertise in Java development, deep understanding of Telecom protocols and systems You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable and intelligent software solutions that power next-generation telecom infrastructure and services.

**About NTR:**

NTR (Network Traffic Redirector) is Mobileum's flagship in-path roaming traffic steering solution, deployed across 600+ operator networks worldwide and engineered for five-nines availability. Built on Core Java, RAID (our no-code/low-code UI and ETL platform), Couchbase, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and Kubernetes/OpenShift, NTR steers roaming traffic in real time at carrier scale. We're now building agentic, GenAI-powered copilot capabilities on top of NTR, enabling autonomous configuration, natural-language operator assistance, and intelligent, self-healing traffic-steering decisions.

**Roles & Responsibility: -**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java-based applications for telecom platforms.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build end-to-end features, including backend logic, APIs, and system integrations.
* Work with telecom protocols such as MAP, CAP, Diameter, GTP, etc.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure best practices in software engineering, including CI/CD, test automation, and cloud deployment.

title: Senior Staff Engineer — Intuit Agent Ready Platform, PDX
description:
**Overview**
ARP assesses if Intuit internal platforms are "agentic-ready" for end-to-end AI agent development. Its Eval engine normalizes top use cases, spawns agents in virtualized environments, executes plans, auto-files issue for friction (e.g., missing docs/APIs), and re-runs checks on CI/CD deploys to prevent regressions. This role belongs to the Core Platform Framework team, which builds the Eval platform and requires research-minded engineers focused on agent orchestration and LLM tooling, distinct from the Operations/Adoption team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The selected responsibilities for the Senior Staff Engineer role encompass leading and driving key architecture initiatives for the Eval platform:
  
  

* Core Platform Architecture: Owning and evolving the virtualization/harness layer, the agent plan-then-execute engine, and the friction detection and auto-ticketing pipeline.
* Model Orchestration & Cost Efficiency: Transitioning from single static models to dynamic, step-level orchestration that routes tasks to cost-effective models (including open-source options and Claude) while monitoring cost and performance per step.
* Telemetry & Auditability: Designing scalable logging, cost, and telemetry systems to ensure full auditability and cost accountability for agent runs.
* Use-Case Normalization: Setting technical standards to normalize agent-readable use cases across differently-documented capability platforms.
* Cross-Team & Strategic Collaboration: Partnering with capability, operations, and adjacent platform teams on friction reporting, PRD-to-action pipelines, RAG-backed architecture context, and OPA policy validation.
* Roadmap Leadership & Governance: Guiding the roadmap from foundational tooling (plugins, RBAC, alerting) to automation (auto-fix agents, continuous re-runs) and governance visibility.
* Mentorship & Technical Standards: Mentoring engineers and elevating engineering standards through design reviews, architecture documentation, and hands-on contributions.

**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, focused on large-scale distributed systems or developer platforms.
* Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent systems (orchestration loops, tool use, plan-and-execute patterns).
* Strong systems programming background (Python, Java) with virtualization, sandboxing, or IaC experience.
* Proficiency in Python, Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, and React.
* Applied AI and prompt design skills for reliable, cost-aware LLM behavior.
* Proven Staff+ capability setting cross-team technical direction.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity in a research-driven, next-gen engineering environment.

**Preferred**

* Building or contributing to LLM or agent evaluation/benchmarking frameworks.
* Policy-as-code , RAG pipelines, or vector databases for enterprise agent grounding.
* Cost/token optimization and multi-model routing.
* Intuit experience or internal developer tools (CI/CD, Jira automation, developer portals).

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. title: Senior Principal Software Engineer JIRA Search
description:
**Overview**
**Jira Platform**
**Vision**
Jira Platform will enable Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale.
  
  
To Turn This Vision Into Reality, We Propose To Focus On The Three Forces We Believe Will Work Together To Create The Flywheel That Will Be Jira Platform, Helping Drive The Engine That Is Jira
  
  
AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent‑native system of record and control plane for human+AI teamwork.
  
  
ENTERPRISE READINESS Continue to invest in Enterprise features, and take advantage of the limited-time window due to Project Ascend to bring the world’s largest and most demanding enterprises into the Cloud
  
  
EFFICIENCY As the underlying platform serving Jira cloud customers, and a growing agentic workload, we need to provide a platform that has sound unit economics, accelerates developer productivity, and delivers world-class reliability.
  
  
**Your future team**
Jira Scalable Issue Search (JSIS) is a foundational investment in Jira platform, moving structured searches from a database-backed engine to OpenSearch. Operating at approximately 3 billion requests per day, JSIS is one of Atlassian’s largest services. Its multi-tenant, distributed architecture positions search to deliver the performance and scale customers expect as Jira grows.
  
  
More than 50 engineers across India and Europe, working alongside product managers, are driving this transformation. At JSIS’s scale, every release can affect customers across geographies, making reliability, performance, and customer impact central to the team’s decisions. This combination of technical depth and product focus gives the team the capacity to address adoption barriers while improving the search experience.
  
  
The long-term opportunity extends beyond search: JSIS will provide the foundation for federated search across Jira portfolios and, ultimately, a shared search capability across Atlassian products. Building for that future will position the platform to support new search experiences and the higher request volumes anticipated from agentic APIs—turning today’s architectural migration into a strategic advantage for the broader ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical evolution and long-term architecture of the team, shaping strategy for enterprise-scale data movement, governance, resiliency, and data health.
* Lead the largest architectural initiatives across Jira Platform, from strategy and milestones through delivery, adoption, and customer outcomes.
* Define and drive a 12–24 month roadmap for shared platform primitives, identify gaps, and make clear trade-offs on priorities.
* Raise standards for reliability, performance, observability, security, and operational excellence across systems handling critical enterprise data.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership via design reviews, deep investigations, incident reviews, and high-risk problem solving while mentoring Principal and senior engineers.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience developing large scale distributed systems.
* 4+ years of experience providing architectural oversight and technical leadership.
* SQL/No-SQL datastores - preferably Postgresql and Opensearch
* Data streaming (Kafka/Flink) and CDC eventing
* Soft skills - Driving complex step-change initiative across distributed cross-org setup with influence/buy-in from senior leadership

title: Principal Software Architect - Next Gen Informatics
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Job Description

Principal Software Architect is responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end architecture of high performant, scalable, resilient next-generation laboratory informatics software platform, including instrument connectivity, laboratory workflows, quality control (QC), result management, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong software engineering and architectural expertise with demonstrated experience in **AI-native software development** - requiring the ability to transform conventional engineering workflows into AI-enabled development practices using coding agents, automated code analysis, agentic workflows, AI-assisted testing, and continuous verification while maintaining architectural integrity, security, and product quality.

Key Responsibilities

**Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Own the end-to-end software architecture, including system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, deployment topology, and technology choices.

Define modular, extensible architectures supporting multiple instrument vendors, laboratory sites, product configurations, and deployment environments.

Establish architectural principles, design patterns, interface contracts, coding standards, and reference architectures.

Make informed build-versus-buy and architectural trade-off decisions considering reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and total cost of ownership.

Identify architectural risks, structural technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and opportunities for platform simplification.

Guide architecture evolution and modernization of legacy systems without compromising existing customer workflows or data integrity.

**AI-Native Software Architecture and Engineering**

Define the technical strategy for integrating AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, and maintenance.

Design AI-enabled engineering workflows using coding agents, agentic development environments, codebase intelligence, and automated verification.

Establish architectural context, repository-level instructions, machine-readable specifications, and guardrails that enable AI agents to work safely within complex software systems.

Evaluate AI agent architectures, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and code graph technologies where appropriate.

Establish repeatable evaluations for AI-generated code, including correctness, architectural conformance, test effectiveness, security, maintainability, and regression risk.

Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity without compromising software quality or release integrity.

**Instrument Connectivity and Interoperability Architecture**

Define a reusable connectivity architecture for integrating diagnostic instruments from multiple vendors.

Establish abstractions for protocol adapters, device drivers, message parsing, normalization, acknowledgements, retry, buffering, and recovery.

Guide implementation of TCP/IP and serial communication, vendor-specific protocols, and relevant standards such as CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.

Defining canonical data models and interface contracts for instrument messages, results, QC data, device status, and configuration.

Design for intermittent connectivity, duplicate or malformed messages, out-of-order events, service restarts, and safe recovery.

Establish simulator-based testing and conformance strategies that reduce the cost and complexity of onboarding new instruments.

**Laboratory Domain and Data Architecture**

Translate laboratory workflows and domain requirements into explicit, testable architectural models.

Define architectures for QC management, Levey–Jennings charts, Westgard rules, result review, QC closeout, alerting, and audit trails.

Establish data models and persistence strategies for historical results, QC observations, configuration versions, rule changes, and operator actions.

Ensure deterministic processing, traceability, historical reproducibility, and appropriate handling of concurrent updates.

Key Technical Skills and Experience

**Software Engineering**

15+ years in software engineering, including significant experience in software architecture and technical leadership

Strong proficiency in C#, .NET / .NET Core, object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and software design patterns.

Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant high-performance scalable applications.

Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or comparable frontend frameworks.

Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, automated testing, CI/CD, debugging, security, and production issue resolution.

**Domain Experience - Mandatory**

Deep expertise in laboratory middleware systems, instrument drivers, message translation.

Clinical laboratory workflows, QC processes, result review, and instrument integration.

Laboratory instrument communication standards, including ASTM, CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.

Healthcare IT, LIS, laboratory middleware, diagnostic software, or IVD product development.

Applicable healthcare software lifecycle, quality-management, risk-management, and cybersecurity standards.

**AI-Native Development - Mandatory**

Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools in real software delivery projects.

Ability to design and implement AI-enabled engineering workflows spanning requirements analysis, codebase exploration, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Practical experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent agentic development environments.

Experience creating and maintaining repository-level AI instructions, reusable agent workflows, project context, and engineering guardrails.

Understanding of agent tool use, context windows, structured outputs, model limitations, and techniques for grounding AI-generated changes in actual code and specifications.

Experience integrating AI agents with source control, work items, build pipelines, test frameworks, and other engineering tools.

Ability to establish automated verification & human review mechanisms for AI-generated code.

Demonstrated understanding of AI failure modes, including hallucinated APIs, incorrect assumptions, insecure code, incomplete test coverage, and unintended architectural changes.

Practical knowledge of secure AI usage, confidential-data protection, access controls, auditability, and software licensing considerations.

Experience building custom coding agents, agentic workflows, or multi-agent engineering systems.

Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and codebase indexing.

Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool integrations, or equivalent mechanisms for exposing engineering systems to AI agents.

Experience with code graphs, dependency analysis, semantic code search, and repository-scale reasoning.

Qualifications and experience

Engineering degree in Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

15+ years of professional experience in SW product development

Sound knowledge of SDLC and agile practices.

Other Attributes

Excellent spoken & written communication skills

Detail oriented with strong problem solving and analytical skills

Team player with a proactive approach

Self-starter, quick learner, and passionate problem resolver

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Photos
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

* Proven experience writing Test Plans and Test Strategies for complex projects
* Experience building automation frameworks from scratch (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, TestNG/JUnit, or similar)

* Strong API testing experience (REST Assured, Postman, or similar)
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)

AI & Soft Skills

* Prompt engineering skills for producing reliable code, test cases, and test data
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

ISTQB or AI certifications

description:

**The Role**

**Your Role**

The Mainframe Storage Support Specialist will provide expert-level support for enterprise mainframe storage environments, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance of mission-critical services. The role involves administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and implementation of storage solutions across complex z/OS environments.

  

**What you will do**

* Support IBM DFSMS components, including SMS, ACS routines, HSM, DFP, DSS, and RMM.
* Administer and support storage hardware and software platforms such as IBM DS8K, FlashSystem, and related storage technologies.
* Perform incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution for storage-related issues.
* Participate in change management activities, including implementation planning, risk assessment, testing, and execution.
* Monitor storage utilization, analyze trends, and perform capacity management activities to ensure future growth requirements are met.
Support

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

* Familiarity with storage monitoring/reporting tools and incident, problem, and change management processes.

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

* Demonstrated expertise developing GTM and pricing strategies for managed services, cloud services, software / SaaS, IT infrastructure, or hybrid technology offerings
