title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
**Job Description –Advanced Software Engineer**
-----------------------------------------------

As a Advanced Software Engineer here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for designing and developing the software solutions. You will collaborate with scrum teams, product owners and architects to drive solutions along with technical leadership.

You will report directly to our Sr. Software Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Bangalore, India location on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the organization by driving continuous improvement and innovation within the product development function, further solidifying Honeywell's position at the forefront of technological advancements.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Advanced Software Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering high-performance, scalable industrial software solutions. This role blends deep technical expertise in C++, C#, and Intel Fortran with DCS/PLC/OTS domain expertise and strong collaboration across product, architecture, and customer-facing teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain industrial operator training simulator software using C++, C#, and Intel Fortran.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into well-architected software components.
* Collaborate with Product Owners on roadmap, feature definition, and definition of done.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including stand-ups, grooming, estimation, and retrospectives.
* Ensure software quality through code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand industrial use cases and deliver effective solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation and communicate complex concepts clearly.

**You Must Have**
-----------------

* B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical/Electronics or instrumentation engineering or related discipline
* 8+ years of experience in product/software development
* Strong proficiency in C++ and C# with production-grade systems
* Working knowledge of Intel Fortran for numerical or high-performance computing
* 8+ years of experience in Industrial Automation (DCS, PLC, OTS)
* should pertain skills related to PLC, SCADA, DCS in honeywell, Siemens, Allen Bradely, DeltaV and Yokogawa systems
* Should have IEC 61131 programming skills like, Ladder Logics, Function Block diagrams, and Structure texts.
* Should be able to reverse engineering on the PLC/DCS block behaviours to derive the emulation logics for above mentioned brands.
* Should have good understanding on Client server architecture on the DCS/SCADA systems.
* Should have good understanding DCOM settings used for client server communication.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

**We Value**
------------

* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Engineering excellence, continuous learning, and quality mindset
* Team-oriented approach in a global, multi-functional environment

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Business Acceptance Analyst
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

#### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Bangalore (On-site)  
**Contract type:** Permanent
  
**Target start date:** January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time (40h/week), aligned with the GMT timezone (**starting** at **1:00 PM IST**)  
**Compensation:** INR 10,00,000 – 22,00,000 per year

#### **What You'll Architect**

As a **Business Acceptance Analyst / Digital Solution Validation**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making.

This role is both analytical and consultative, ideal for someone who can bridge business requirements and delivered digital solutions while ensuring production readiness. We are looking for professionals who can connect business needs with technology delivery, ensuring that solutions meet expectations before moving into production. Professionals who think like architects and act like builders.

You will support a global team responsible for the **processes, tools, and data governance associated with customer installed-base management**, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and digital delivery teams.

##### **Responsibilities**

* Review business and functional requirements to understand expected outcomes and acceptance conditions.
* Translate requirements and specifications into **structured validation scenarios and acceptance criteria**.
* Validate delivered functionality against agreed business requirements and solution specifications.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and deviations between requirements and delivered solutions.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and digital delivery teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain traceability between **requirements, acceptance criteria, validation outcomes, and production readiness**.
* Support business acceptance and pre-production validation activities.
* Provide clear evidence-based reporting of validation results and outstanding issues.
* Challenge unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria before solutions progress toward production.
* Apply **AI-enabled techniques** to improve validation efficiency, requirements analysis, documentation quality, scenario generation, and solution analysis.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI-assisted tools.
* Collaborate effectively with international colleagues while maintaining a strong on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges.
* You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action.
* You balance technical thinking with business understanding.
* You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments.
* You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.
* You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* You have strong attention to detail and enjoy validating whether solutions truly meet business expectations.
* You embrace innovation and are interested in leveraging AI to improve quality and efficiency.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in **business acceptance, solution validation, functional testing, QA analysis, UAT, or a similar role** within digital or technology delivery environments.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and software delivery teams.
* Experience operating within agile or iterative delivery environments.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Availability to work on-site in Bangalore.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Strong understanding of business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to transform functional requirements into effective validation scenarios and acceptance approaches.
* Experience validating delivered functionality against agreed business requirements.
* Proven ability to identify discrepancies between specifications and delivered solutions.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills.
* Experience with requirements traceability and acceptance management processes.
* Experience supporting production-readiness assessments and go-live decisions.
* AI-aware mindset with the ability to apply AI-assisted techniques to validation and analysis activities.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience validating **data-driven applications, platforms, or digital products**.
* Knowledge of **data quality, data governance, or master data management** concepts.
* Familiarity with validation management, defect tracking, or requirements management tools.
* Familiarity with CRM, enterprise applications, or Salesforce ecosystems and the business processes they support.
* Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot or other Generative AI tools to support business analysis, validation, documentation, or testing activities.
* Exposure to industrial, manufacturing, energy or service environments
* Experience in consulting or client-facing projects.
* Exposure to large-scale international transformation or digitalisation programmes.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Testing, Quality Assurance, Agile, Scrum, or related disciplines.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism.
* You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions.
* You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* You combine autonomy with collaboration.
* You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus India**

* **Hybrid work** model (3 days/week in office)
* **18 paid leaves** + 9 public holidays
* **₹5L** medical insurance + **₹10L** accident insurance
* Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
* International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
* Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Referral Bonus Scheme
* Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

️ **Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

#### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic..

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Verification
description:
LNT/SLE-V/1904146

* LTST-L&T Semiconductor Technologies Limited
* Bengaluru

* Posted On 23 Oct 2026
* End Date 21 Apr 2027
* Required Experience12 - 17 years

  

**Skills**
----------

#### **Knowledge & Posting Location**

UVM System Verilog - SV

#### **Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor of Technology (BTech)

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role**

L&T Semiconductor Technologies (LTSCT) is seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Senior Lead Engineer, Verification** to play a key technical leadership role in the development of next-generation semiconductor products.

This position provides an excellent opportunity to build a strong technical career while working on complex, state-of-the-art SoCs and IPs. As a Sr Lead Engineer, you will be responsible for driving verification strategy across **IP, Subsystem, and SoC** levels, leading verification architecture, mentoring engineers, and establishing reusable methodologies that improve quality and engineering productivity.

You will collaborate closely with System Architects, RTL Designers, Physical Design, Analog/Mixed-Signal, Post-Silicon Validation, Firmware, and Software teams throughout the product development lifecycle. You will actively participate in architecture reviews, influence design decisions from a verification perspective, and define scalable verification methodologies that enable first-silicon success.

Your responsibilities will include defining verification strategies, creating reusable SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification environments, developing comprehensive verification plans, selecting verification tools and methodologies, driving functional and code coverage closure, and ensuring timely project execution with the highest quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Sr Lead Engineer, you will independently lead complex verification activities or provide technical leadership to a team responsible for IP, Subsystem, and SoC verification.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership for verification projects from architecture definition through verification signoff.
* Operate with a strong product and system-level mindset, understanding complete data flows and system interactions.
* Drive verification strategy based on product requirements and architecture specifications.
* Define scalable and reusable Testbench (TB) architectures for multiple projects.
* Serve as the Lead Verification Architect for reusable verification environments across product lines.

* Participate in architecture, micro-architecture, design reviews, and technical decision-making.

**Verification Methodology**

* Develop reusable verification environments using **SystemVerilog and UVM** methodologies.
* Create comprehensive Verification Plans, Test Plans, Functional Coverage Plans, Assertions, and Verification Closure Metrics.
* Design and develop reusable Verification IPs (VIPs), Bus Functional Models (BFMs), scoreboards, checkers, monitors, and protocol-specific verification components.
* Integrate and validate internally developed VIPs with third-party commercial VIP solutions.
* Drive constrained-random verification, coverage-driven verification, assertion-based verification, and formal verification where applicable.

* Perform environment benchmarking, profiling, optimization, and performance tuning.

**Verification Execution**

* Plan and execute verification activities from block-level through full-chip verification.
* Develop and execute regression strategies for functional, performance, and corner-case validation.
* Analyze regression results, debug complex failures, identify root causes, and drive timely closure.
* Drive functional, code, assertion, toggle, and FSM coverage closure to meet verification signoff goals.

* Ensure compliance with project quality metrics and verification signoff criteria.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor verification engineers across multiple projects.
* Allocate work based on technical complexity, project priorities, and individual strengths.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, verification reviews, and technical audits.
* Guide engineers in debugging complex verification issues and adopting industry best practices.

* Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with RTL Design, System Architecture, Analog/Mixed-Signal Design, Physical Design, DFT, Firmware, Software, FPGA Prototyping, Emulation, and Post-Silicon Validation teams.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering teams across multiple geographic locations.

* Interface directly with customers to understand technical requirements, provide engineering solutions, and resolve critical issues with urgency.

**Methodology & Productivity Improvement**

* Drive continuous improvements in verification methodologies, engineering processes, and development flows.
* Evaluate, benchmark, and recommend EDA tools, simulators, emulators, formal verification tools, and verification technologies.
* Work closely with EDA vendors to establish efficient verification flows and deployment strategies.
* Develop automation frameworks, regression infrastructure, verification dashboards, and productivity-enhancing solutions.

* Build automation using scripting languages such as **Python, Perl, Shell, or Tcl** to improve verification efficiency.

**Documentation & Knowledge Sharing**

* Prepare verification architecture documents, user guides, methodology documentation, coding guidelines, and verification flow documentation.
* Maintain reusable verification assets and best-practice documentation.
* Conduct technical seminars, design reviews, methodology workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, and internal training programs.

Mentor junior engineers and support their technical and professional growth

title: Mainframe DB2 System Programmer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a Mainframe DB2 System Programmer at Kyndryl are project-based subject matter experts in all things infrastructure – good at providing analysis, documenting and diagraming work for hand-off, offering timely solutions, and generally “figuring it out.” This is a hands-on role where your feel for the interaction between a system and its environment will be invaluable to every one of your clients.

  

There are two halves to this role: First, contributing to current projects where you analyze problems and tech issues, offer solutions, and test, modify, automate, and integrate systems. And second, long-range strategic planning of IT infrastructure and operational execution. This role isn’t specific to any one platform, so you’ll need a good feel for all of them. And because of this, you’ll experience variety and growth at Kyndryl that you won’t find anywhere else.

  

Key Responsibilities :

  

* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade IBM DB2 for z/OS subsystems and related tools.
* Plan and execute DB2 version migrations, function-level activations, and subsystem upgrades
* Apply maintenance, PTFs, APARs, RSU updates, and security fixes using SMP/E.
* Administer and support Data Sharing, Sysplex, Group Buffer Pools, and Coupling Facility environments.
* Monitor and optimize DB2 system performance, storage utilization, and database availability.
Manage backup, recovery, cloning, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity activities.  

  

This is a project-based role where you’ll enjoy deep involvement throughout the lifespan of a project, as well as the chance to work closely with Architects, Technicians, and PMs. Whatever your current level of tech savvy or where you want your career to lead, you’ll find the right opportunities and a buddy to support your growth. Boredom? Trust us, that won’t be an issue.

  

Your future at Kyndryl

There are lots of opportunities to gain certification and qualifications on the job, and you’ll continuously grow as a Cloud Hyperscaler. Many of our Infrastructure Specialists are on a path toward becoming either an Architect or Distinguished Engineer, and there are opportunities at every skill level to grow in either of these directions.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Strong Experience in Mainframe DB2 System Programming.
* Experience and Expertise in Monoplex, SYSPLEX architecture and data sharing architecture.
* Experience in DB2 subsystem setup - both Stand-alone and data sharing.
* Experience in DB2 backup and recovery scenarios - traditional image copy, FLASH, mirroring etc., methodology.
* Experience in REXX/CLIST and ISPF programming skills.
* Good knowledge on transactional environment like CICS, IMS architecture and interface with DB2.
* DB2 Data sharing skills - Installation, customization, DB2 structures, CFRM policy, DB2 CF recovery, Data sharing locking mechanism etc.
* Experience and good exposure to SMP/E process.
* Experience and Expertise on software migration and maintenance procedures - Install, backout, re-migration process - DB2 V9, V10, and V11.
* Good Knowledge on DB2 Health check, DB2 security and Patch management.
* Good knowledge and experience on DB2 traces, SMF, RMF and WLM.
Good Knowledge on z/OS and DB2 system performance tuning methods.  

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* Experience in DB2 Connect and IBM Data Studio
* DB2 Cloning process - IBM DB2 Cloning Tool or any customized in-house Tools.
* Good knowledge on SYSPLEX, data sharing and distributed problem-solving skills.
Experience in problem debugging and Vendor specific PMR ticketing procedure.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Prompt engineering.
* Embeddings and semantic search.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Vector databases.
* Fine-tuning or adaptation of foundation models.
* AI agents and tool/function calling.
* LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Cloud & MLOps

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform

Knowledge of:

* Docker and containerization.
* CI/CD.
* Model deployment and monitoring.
* ML pipelines.
* MLOps practices.
* Kubernetes or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 5–10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on

experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.

* Proven experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions in real-world or

enterprise environments.

* Experience taking AI/ML models from experimentation/prototype stage through

production deployment is highly desirable.

* Candidates should demonstrate strong practical problem-solving ability rather than

purely academic or theoretical knowledge.

* Experience working in cross-functional or distributed technology teams is

preferred.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering,

Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

* Equivalent professional experience and strong technical expertise may also be

considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:

* Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
* Enterprise AI platforms.
* Azure AI / AWS AI / Google Cloud AI services.
* MLOps and production ML systems.
* NLP and conversational AI.
* Computer vision.
* AI-powered automation.
* Predictive analytics.
* Big Data technologies.
* API development and microservices.
* .NET/Java/Python-based enterprise application integration.
* Experience working with international clients or multinational organizations.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI

solutions.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multicultural team.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging AI technologies.
* Strong attention to quality, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Location & Mobility

**Work Location: Malaysia**

Candidate Source: India

Candidates currently based in India who are willing to relocate to Malaysia will be

considered.

International candidates with relevant experience and the ability to work from Malaysia

may also be considered based on project and employment requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working with multicultural and geographically

distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering capability.
* Experience solving complex real-world problems using AI/ML.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Good understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle.
* Practical experience with modern AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business

stakeholders.

Candidates with 5–10 years of experience who have progressed from hands-on AI/ML

development into senior-level technical ownership are especially encouraged to

apply.

Engagement Opportunity

The final role title, responsibilities, technology stack, and seniority will be aligned with the

candidate’s experience, technical specialization, and project requirements.

Potential positions may include:

* Senior AI/ML Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* AI Engineer
* Senior Data Scientist
* Applied AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* LLM Engineer
* AI/ML Technical Specialist
* AI/ML Architect

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Total years of experience.
* Relevant AI/ML experience.
* Current location in India.
* Current/expected compensation.
* Notice period/availability.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.
* Summary of key AI/ML projects handled.
* Details of relevant technical skills, frameworks, cloud platforms, and AI/ML

technologies.

* GitHub, portfolio, publications, or project links, where applicable.

Equal Opportunity

We encourage applications from qualified AI/ML professionals with diverse technical

backgrounds and industry experience. Selection will be based on relevant skills,

experience, technical capability, and suitability for the assigned project and role.

Pay: ₹409,194.83 - ₹1,694,864.16 per year

Work Location: Remote

title: Coupa – Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation
description:
**Coupa – Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation**

Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Senior Consultant, Coupa, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and support activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation and post-go-live activities across the solution lifecycle.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Consultant, Coupa on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting source-to-pay transformation initiatives across client environments.

* Lead discovery workshops, document business requirements, map current-state processes, identify process gaps, and design future-state workflows aligned to Coupa capabilities.
* Configure and support Coupa modules based on project scope, including Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, and Spend Analytics.
* Support integration design and execution between Coupa and enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, and Workday Financials, including connectors, flat-file integrations, and related data flows.
* Set up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, coding rules, supplier onboarding forms, and other components required for end-to-end source-to-pay operations.
* Support testing, defect triage, deployment, user training, hypercare, release updates, post-go-live optimization, and coordination with onsite and offshore teams across the implementation lifecycle.

**The team**

Enterprise Performance

Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.

The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.

**Location:** Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

**Shift Timings:** 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 5+ years of experience implementing or supporting Coupa across source-to-pay process areas, including requisitioning, sourcing, contracts, invoicing, supplier management, expenses, or payments
* Experience leading discovery workshops and documenting business requirements, process flows, and functional designs
* Experience configuring Coupa modules such as Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, or Spend Analytics
* Experience supporting integrations between Coupa and enterprise resource planning platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Workday Financials
* Experience setting up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, and related configuration components within Coupa
* Experience supporting system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, deployment, or hypercare activities
* Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Master of Technology (MTech), or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:

* Experience supporting procurement transformation, roadmap assessments, process re-engineering, or tool selection activities
* Experience with software-as-a-service procurement platforms such as Ivalua, SAP Ariba, or SAP Concur
* Experience supporting service-level agreement-based application support, ticket management, or root cause analysis
* Experience delivering training, user enablement materials, or software demonstrations for procurement platforms
* Experience supporting quarterly release management, upgrade planning, or post-go-live optimization
* Coupa or procurement platform certifications

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

title: AI Engineer - SAP S/4HANA
description:
**AI Engineer - SAP S/4HANA**

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

We are seeking an AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI and agentic architectures within the SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ecosystem. This role designs, builds, and deploys AI agents, Joule extensions, and LLM-driven solutions that make SAP business processes conversational, autonomous, and intelligently automated.

You will leverage foundation models (Claude, GPT, Gemini), SAP Joule, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol to create solutions that reason, plan, and act across SAP workflows — interoperating with external agent ecosystems while adhering to Clean Core principles and Responsible AI governance.

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design and build AI agents that autonomously orchestrate SAP S/4HANA business processes using multi-step reasoning, tool use via A2A and MCP protocols limiting human interaction to the bare minimum.
* Develop SAP Joule extensions using Joule Studio — creating custom skills, domain-specific agents, and conversational interfaces for natural language interaction with SAP data and transactions.
* Integrate and orchestrate foundation models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) via SAP Generative AI Hub — managing prompt engineering, model routing, guardrails, and agentic orchestration for production-grade deployments.
* Implement MCP-based tool-use patterns giving AI agents secure access to SAP systems — wrapping released APIs and OData services as MCP-consumable tools via the Integration Suite MCP Gateway.
* Build A2A-compliant multi-agent architectures enabling bidirectional communication between Joule, custom BTP agents, and external platforms.
* Establish prompt engineering standards, evaluation frameworks, and Responsible AI guardrails (hallucination mitigation, grounding validation, PII handling, audit trails).
* Explore and pilot emerging SAP AI capabilities (Joule Studio 2.0, SAP AI Agent Hub, ABAP AI agentic features) and provide adoption recommendations.
* Collaborate with SAP Lead Developers and Solution Architects to ensure AI solutions align with Clean Core architecture and the broader S/4HANA landscape.
* Mentor development teams on generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic design patterns, and AI-augmented workflows.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on Generative AI application development and/or agentic AI architectures.
* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) — including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, and multi-turn reasoning.
* Proven experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or SAP-native orchestration — with strong understanding of MCP and A2A protocols.
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP AI services — Generative AI Hub, AI Core, Joule Studio, SAP Build, and Integration Suite.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, data models, released APIs, and business processes in at least one functional domain (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Order-to-Cash).
* Strong understanding of AI safety and governance — hallucination mitigation, content moderation, agent access control, and observability.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate business processes into agentic workflows and demonstrate AI value to non-technical stakeholders.
* Growth mindset with passion for rapid prototyping and staying current with AI advancements and the SAP AI roadmap.

title: Senior Interior Designer
description:
Job description:

We are seeking a talented and experienced Interior Designer/Senior Interior Designer to join our dynamic team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for design, excellent technical skills, and the ability to create unique and functional spaces that reflect our clients' needs and aspirations.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Collaborate with clients to understand their design preferences, requirements, and budget constraints.

2. Develop design concepts and presentations that effectively communicate the vision and intent of the project.

3. Create detailed drawings, mood boards, and material boards to illustrate design concepts.

4. Select and source furniture, fixtures, finishes, and equipment (FF&E) that align with the project'sdesign concept, budget, and timeline.

5. Coordinate with architects, contractors, and vendors to ensure seamless execution of the design vision.

6. Oversee the implementation of design plans, including site visits and project management as needed.

7. Stay updated on industry trends, materials, and technologies to continuously innovate and enhance design solutions.

8. Maintain accurate project documentation and records, including budgets, schedules, and correspondence.

9. Provide exceptional customer service and support throughout the design process, addressing client feedback and concerns in a timely manner.

10. Contribute to business development efforts by participating in client meetings, presentations, and proposal preparations.

**Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or related field.

2. Proven experience in interior design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of projects.

3. Proficiency in SketchUp, Revit, or other design software.

4. Excellent creative and conceptual skills, with a keen eye for detail.

title: Sr IT Business Analyst Fraud Technology
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**1. Role Overview & Objective**
--------------------------------

The **Senior IT Business Analyst – Fraud Prevention** translates complex, high-level business and risk requirements into detailed, actionable technology deliverables. Serving as the primary bridge between Fraud Operations, Compliance, Risk Management, and Technology engineering teams, you will leverage modern analysis methodologies and enterprise AI capabilities to define, design, and implement advanced fraud detection and mitigation solutions. Your contributions will directly strengthen organizational resilience against emerging fraud threats while ensuring a frictionless customer journey.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

### **Requirements Engineering & Business Analysis**

* Leverage enterprise collaboration intelligence and AI-assisted elicitation tools to structure stakeholder workshops, extract business rules from discussions, and resolve requirement ambiguities and edge-case exceptions with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

* Elicit, analyze, and document comprehensive functional and non-functional requirements, producing industry-standard Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and technical specifications.

* Utilize advanced analytical tools for requirement pattern discovery and dependency mapping across distributed systems.

* Design and maintain robust process artifacts—including use case models, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, system context diagrams, and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN 2.0) workflows—covering standard operating paths, fraud-positive scenarios, false-positive handling, timeouts, vendor outages, and dual-control approvals.

* Define detailed technical and integration requirements for in-house detection engines, third-party vendor platforms, and core payment rails (e.g., Card Authorization, ACH, Wire, Real-Time Payments [RTP]).

* Decompose business initiatives into structured Jira Epics and INVEST-compliant User Stories featuring testable Gherkin syntax (Given-When-Then) acceptance criteria across diverse personas

* Establish and maintain end-to-end Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking regulatory/policy mandates to BRDs, FRDs, user stories, test cases, and compliance audit evidence.

* Facilitate backlog grooming and sprint planning in Jira, ensuring user stories meet the Definition of Ready (DoR) and align with engineering sprint capacity.

### **AI-Powered Fraud Solution Design**

* Translate evolving fraud typologies—such as Account Takeover (ATO), Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud, Synthetic Identity Theft, and mule account networks—into functional and technical specifications for machine learning models and real-time rule engines.
* Perform comprehensive impact assessments and root-cause analyses on fraud policy and rule updates, balancing fraud capture rate optimization against customer friction and False Positive Rates (FPR).

### **System Integration & Testing**

* Serve as the core technical liaison across core banking engines, fraud decisioning platforms, case management workflows, and identity verification/biometric APIs.
* Define data mapping specifications, schema definitions (JSON/XML), and API payloads for real-time transaction screening, event streaming (e.g., Kafka), and batch monitoring.
* Formulate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies, detailed test scripts, and defect triage workflows to validate fraud detection efficacy and system reliability prior to production releases.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Finance, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience as an IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Product Owner, with at least 2–3 years dedicated to fraud detection, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), or payment risk within financial services or FinTech environments.

### **Technical & Tool Competencies**

* **Methodologies:** Deep expertise in Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), hybrid delivery models, and the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* **Enterprise Fraud & Risk Platforms:** Practical experience with market-leading fraud detection and decisioning engines.
* **Analysis & Workflow Tools:** Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, diagramming tools ( Microsoft Visio, Enterprise Architect), and API testing/inspection utilities (Postman, Swagger).
* undefined

**Required skills and experience**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including several years in solution or application architecture roles.

* Track record of technical delivery of complex, multi-team programs to production.

title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication

to join our technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications.
  
  
As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence—actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions.
  
  
Experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations is expected for this role to help build intelligent, AI-enabled engineering solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture
* System Design: Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure full-stack applications, microservices, and APIs that align with enterprise standards.
* Technology Strategy: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends (including AI-assisted development) to continuously modernize our frontend and backend tech stack.
* Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices across frontend and backend systems.
* Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Hands-on Engineering
* Full-Stack Development: Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code across both frontend user interfaces and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, React or Angular, and Python.
* Backend Development: Design and implement scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
* ETL Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows using Spring Batch. This includes configuring components for complex data transformations and high-volume ingestion.
* API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability.
* Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle) and non-relational (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) databases.
* AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes.
* Team Mentorship & Collaboration
* Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline.
* Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
**Education & Experience**

* Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.

**Technical Skills**

* Backend Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services.
* Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Spring Boot and Spring Batch. Must understand job partitioning, multi-threaded steps, and fault-tolerance policies (skip/retry).
* Frontend Expertise: Strong front-end development experience using React or Angular to build responsive, user-focused web applications.
* Python Development: Solid Python development experience for automation, services, scripting, analytics workflows, or platform enablement.
* AI & Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features.
* Architecture & Design: Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns.
* Messaging & Streaming: Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and messaging-based integrations using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ for real-time data triggers.
* SQL Mastery: Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning across SQL and NoSQL technologies.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.
