title: Sr. Migration Modernization Architect, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
  
  
As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
  
  
On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
  
  
Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)
* Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud
* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

**Additional Desired Skills**

* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines
* Programming Skill with Java, .Net
* Container technologies
* Database migrations
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks
* Multi-cloud experience

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl
* 3+ years of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) experience
* Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience in software development
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with fully automated machine training (automatic re-training, automatic testing)
* Master's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or PhD or equivalent research experience and 9+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Manager, Application Engineering (Appian Platform)
description:
Leads a team thatprovides the most senior level IT technical lead services, including the direction, evaluation, selection, configuration, implementation, and integration of new and existing technologies and tools across a breadth of platforms. Provides direction across multiple teams.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role leads a team that provides the most senior level IT technical lead services across platforms, while overseeing secure API integration, aligning architecture with user and enterprise goals, and driving software documentation standards.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Provides the most senior level IT technical lead and architecture services and direction for critical software, middleware, or hardware projects on multiple platforms. Provides technical expertise and completes complex development, design, implementation, architecture design specification, and maintenance activities.
* Leads and ensures the viability of IT deliverables. Provides development and architectural options and approves the team's technical deliverables. Conducts testing, including functionality, technical limitations, and security. Provides production support for products.
* Identifies potential solutions and approves technical solutions proposed by team members. Elevates complex technical issues to IT experts. Resolves technical problems discovered by testers and internal clients. Responds to and resolves technical issues in a timely manner. Researches issues and performs root cause analysis. Anticipates technology problems and prevents them. Resolves potential technology problems implemented by less experience staff before they cause an issue.
* Communicates with key stakeholders on project issues and implications. Evaluates the impacts of change requests on technologies and effectively persuades and influences others on ideas.
* Maintains a current and working knowledge of IT development methodology, architecture design, and technical standards. Mentors IT staff and identifies training needs. As new standards are instituted, ensures their usage by team members. Learns, and applies new technology quickly, and is well versed on the latest technologies and tools supporting software development in the industry. Assists with the creation of strategic product roadmaps.
* Reviews and approves documentation and diagrams created by IT team members. Writes documentation, including technical standards and processes.
* Identifies opportunities for continuous quality improvement of technical standards, methodologies, and technologies.
* Develops code and test artifacts that reuse subroutines or objects, is well structured, backed by automated tests, includes sufficient comments and is easy to maintain. Writes programs, appropriate test artifacts, ad hoc queries, and reports. Employs contemporary software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that supports automation.
* Amplifies the productivity of entire team through collaboration, and the implementation of technology frameworks. Learns and applies new technology quickly, and is well versed on the latest technologies and tools supporting software development in the industry. Anticipates technology problems and prevents them. Resolves potential technology problems implemented by less experience staff before they cause an issue.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements. Works across organizational lines to improve both IT and Information Security policies and procedures.
* Maintains a broad understanding of the roles of front, middle and back office, and designs systems to enable efficient business processes while maintaining necessary controls. Maintains a broad understanding of the roles of external partners and designs systems to enable efficient business processes while maintaining necessary controls.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Oversee data flow integration between multiple APIs and systems for consistent, secure, and streamlined application performance.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across development, UX, and infrastructure teams, aligning systems architecture with end-user needs and enterprise objectives.
* Establish and govern software documentation standards to ensure clarity, maintainability, and ease of future upgrades.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial role with a strong focus on application engineering.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience delivering complex enterprise technology solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, and modern engineering practices.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and leading cross-functional teams.
* Strong expertise in Appian platform development, architecture, and implementation.
* Experience designing and delivering enterprise workflow and business process management solutions.
* Strong understanding of cloud technologies, preferably AWS
* Strong people leadership and team-building capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence technical and business decisions across organizations.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and strategic thinking skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and drive successful outcomes
* Appian certification(s) such as Lead Developer, Senior Developer, or Architect.
* AWS certification(s).
* Experience in Financial Services, Wealth Management, FinTech, or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to business process automation, workflow transformation, AI-enabled solutions, or digital transformation initiatives.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Lead – AI-Native Applications/ Lead FDE
description:
**About The Ksquare Group**

The Ksquare Group is a global technology consulting company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with over 14 years of experience delivering technology solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, AI, and network engineering for clients in Banking & Financial Services, Public Sector, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Logistics, Healthcare, and Enterprise Services. With a team of 350+ professionals across the US, Mexico, the Dominican Republic and India, we help organizations solve complex business challenges and achieve measurable outcomes through our collaborative POD-based delivery model. At The Ksquare Group, we foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth, empowering our teams to make a meaningful impact for clients worldwide.

**Role summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Fullstack Lead who builds AI-native applications end to end, from React or Vue.js front ends to agentic back ends. You will lead a small engineering pod, shape solutions with clients, and own delivery of production-grade conversational and agentic AI products. You bring deep knowledge of at least one business domain and turn its problems into well-designed software.
 

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead design and development of fullstack applications using React or Vue.js front ends with Node.js, Python, Java or .NET back ends.
* Build conversational AI and agentic AI features using LangChain (and LangGraph or similar), including tool calling, RAG, memory and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions, estimates and delivery plans; contribute to proposals and solution walkthroughs.
* Own application design: APIs, data models, front-end architecture, prompt and agent design, and integration with LLM providers.
* Deploy and run applications on cloud-native platforms (GCP, AWS or Azure) using containers, serverless, managed AI services and CI/CD.
* Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of 4–8 engineers; set coding standards and drive engineering best practices.
* Ensure quality, security, observability and cost-efficiency of AI applications, including LLM evaluation, guardrails and monitoring.
* Act as the main technical point of contact for client stakeholders; communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.
* Apply domain expertise to identify high-value AI use cases and shape product direction.

**Required skills and experience**

* 7+ years of professional software development, with solid fullstack delivery experience.
* Strong front-end expertise in React or Vue.js (component design, state management, TypeScript) and back-end expertise in at least one of Node.js (Express, NestJS), Python (FastAPI, Django), Java (Spring Boot) or .NET (ASP.NET Core).
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience building conversational AI and agentic AI applications using LangChain or equivalent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain4j, Semantic Kernel).
* Working knowledge of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini or similar), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and RAG patterns.
* Must have cloud-native experience on at least one of Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.
* Mandatory hands-on DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure automation, release management and production monitoring.
* Expertise in at least one business domain (e.g., BFSI, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, logistics, telecom).
* Proven track record of delivering projects on time and to quality, ideally in client-facing or consulting environments.
* Solutioning mindset: able to break down ambiguous problems and propose pragmatic, scalable solutions.
* Excellent design skills across system design, API design and UI/UX sensibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Exposure to LLMOps tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery and team leadership in distributed teams.

* Proven experience defining enterprise target-state architectures, transformation roadmaps, and architecture governance models.
* Strong experience conducting enterprise assessments and application portfolio rationalization initiatives.
* Solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, Zachman, or equivalent.

+ Experience designing systems for scalability, resilience, security, high availability, and performance.

title: Architect - Identity and Access Management - IAM SME
description:

We are seeking an experienced IAM Architect to lead the design, architecture, and implementation of enterprise Identity & Access Management solutions across workforce, customer, cloud, application, and non-human identities. * Design IAM solutions for Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
* Develop standards for cloud-native identity services and privileged access controls.

Planning, Scope Management, Risk Management, Design Reviews, Execution Oversight, Deployment Support, Change Management, Project Closure

* 10- 12 years of Identity & Access Management experience.
* 5+ years in IAM Architecture or Technical Lead roles.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale IAM transformation programs.

title: Adobe Enterprise Architect
description:

We are looking for an experienced
**Adobe Architect**
with strong hands-on experience across the Adobe ecosystem and the ability to translate complex Adobe capabilities into practical business solutions.

The role will work across Adobe Experience Cloud, with exposure to capabilities such as Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Real-Time CDP (RTCDP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Workfront and related Adobe technologies.

The ideal candidate is a strong Adobe practitioner and architect who can
**lead delivery, solve complex client problems, and clearly articulate how Adobe technologies can address business and customer-experience needs**
.

**strong depth in key Adobe capabilities, broad ecosystem understanding, and the ability to connect the pieces into effective solutions**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Adobe Architecture & Solution Design**

* Lead architecture and solution design for Adobe-based transformation and digital experience initiatives.

* Build and maintain strong relationships within the
  **Adobe ecosystem in India**
  , including Adobe teams, partners and relevant technology communities.
* Stay current with Adobe's evolving product roadmap, architecture patterns and emerging capabilities.
* Contribute to internal Adobe capability development through knowledge sharing, accelerators, frameworks and mentoring.

* **10+ years of experience**
  in technology, digital experience, MarTech, solution architecture or related areas.

  **Adobe technologies**
  , with deep expertise in at least one or more key Adobe platforms.

  **AEP, RTCDP, AJO, Workfront or other Adobe Experience Cloud technologies**
  .
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, integrations and digital experience solutions.
* Proven experience taking Adobe solutions from
  **architecture through implementation and delivery**
  .

  **Adobe ecosystem in India**

  who understands how Adobe capabilities fit together.

**credible Adobe technical leader for our clients**

The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques.

In this role, you will work on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications. As an important part of the role, you will solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the team. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. Furthermore, you will be expected to comprehend the technical requirements of diverse groups using AI, explore open-source tech options beneficial for us, and integrate the chosen tech within our teams to enhance efficiency and construct supportive systems. In addition to that, people and project management is going to be a key part of the job role. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job.

* Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualification:
  
  

* GAI academic qualifications/certifications
* Experience as a tech solution architect

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data**
Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy
**production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives**
**.**
We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building Teradata’s
**vector store and retrieval infrastructure**
, powering
**RAG, multimodal AI, agentic workflows, and semantic search**
at enterprise scale.
  
  
This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of
**LLMs, information retrieval, and distributed systems**
**,**
and wants to work on
**core platform capabilities**
, not just application demos.
  
  
You will:
  
  

* Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata’s vector store and retrieval stack.
* Define design patterns and best practices for RAG, semantic search, and agentic AI systems.
* Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions.
* Identify scalability, performance, and reliability risks and drive solutions proactively.
* Design agentic AI patterns, including tool calling, planning, memory, and orchestration.
* Design and implement core vector store capabilities, including indexing strategies, storage layouts, retrieval algorithms, and APIs.
* Build and maintain RAG evaluation frameworks, including relevance, faithfulness, accuracy, and cost metrics.
* Collaborate with product, research, and platform teams to translate customer use cases into scalable features.
* Benchmark Teradata’s vector store and RAG capabilities against industry alternatives (e. g. , cloud and open-source solutions).
* Contribute to technical design reviews, architecture decisions, and long-term AI platform strategy.

**Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best**
You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers, and domain experts
**at Silicon Valley**
, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems.
  
  
You’ll also work cross-functionally with:
  
  

* Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful.
* Domain specialists to ensure solutions align with real-world business problems in regulated industries.
* Infrastructure and platform teams responsible for training, evaluation, and scaling AI workloads.

This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company.
  
  
This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of complex systems.
* Deep expertise in vector search, information retrieval, or semantic search systems.
* Proven experience designing and deploying production-grade RAG platforms.
* Strong understanding of:
* Embeddings and similarity search
* Data chunking and context optimization
* Dense vs sparse vs hybrid retrieval
* Semantic search and relevance ranking
* Proficiency in Python (and/or Java); experience with production-grade systems.
* Experience working with large-scale data and performance-sensitive systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with multimodal embeddings and retrieval.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent).
* Experience implementing AI guardrails and evaluation frameworks.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with distributed systems or analytics platforms.
* Open-source contributions or published work in AI, IR, or GenAI.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Interior Designer
description:
An Interior Designer is responsible for planning, designing, and creating functional, attractive, and comfortable interior spaces for residential, commercial, and other projects. The role involves understanding client requirements, preparing design concepts and layouts, selecting materials and finishes, coordinating with vendors and contractors, and ensuring that projects are completed within the approved budget and timeline.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand client requirements, preferences, budget, and project objectives.
* Prepare interior design concepts, mood boards, space plans, and furniture layouts.
* Develop 2D drawings and 3D visualizations using software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, and 3ds Max.
* Select suitable materials, colors, lighting, furniture, fixtures, and finishes.
* Prepare working drawings, detailed drawings, and design specifications.
* Coordinate with architects, civil engineers, electrical engineers, carpenters, contractors, and vendors.
* Conduct site visits to monitor project progress and ensure design accuracy.
* Ensure efficient space utilization, functionality, aesthetics, and safety standards.
* Estimate project costs, prepare material lists, and assist with budget management.
* Monitor quality of workmanship and resolve design-related site issues.
* Track project schedules and ensure timely completion.
* Present design proposals to clients and incorporate feedback.
* Stay updated on interior design trends, materials, technologies, and industry standards.

Required Skills

* Creativity and strong design sense.
* Knowledge of space planning and interior design principles.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, or similar design software.
* Understanding of materials, furniture, lighting, and finishes.
* Knowledge of technical drawings and construction details.
* Communication, presentation, and client-handling skills.
* Vendor coordination and negotiation skills.
* Time management, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects.

Educational Qualifications

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or a related field.
* Relevant project experience or a portfolio of interior design work is preferred.
* Knowledge of site execution and project coordination is an advantage.

Experience

* Fresher: Basic design knowledge, software skills, creativity, and willingness to learn.
* 1–3 years: Design development, client coordination, working drawings, and site supervision.
* 3+ years: Independent project handling, budget management, vendor coordination, and team supervision.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of projects.
* Client satisfaction and design approval.
* Quality of drawings and execution.
* Budget adherence and material optimization.
* Effective coordination with vendors and site teams.
* Compliance with project specifications and safety standards.

Pay: Up to ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.
* Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.
* Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
* Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities.
* Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability.
* Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team.
* Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development.
* Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation.
* Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities.
* Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.
* Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality.
* Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities.
* Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Production Ownership**

* Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations.
* Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked.
* Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability.
* Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution.
* Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery.
* Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications.
* Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities.
* Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
* Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows.
* Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions.
* Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience leading engineering teams supporting Billing, Payments, Collections, or Commerce platforms.
* Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or in an architecture-focused role, bringing additional depth in technical design and engineering decision-making.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization, platform migration, or technical transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams or multiple engineering workstreams.
* Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted software development, or emerging agentic AI technologies.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16

title: Solutions Architect
description:
### **Description**

As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem.

You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organization's strategic objectives.

Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Programme Management, Operations and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.

  

### **What you'll be doing:**

* **Solution Architecture:** Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.

* **Architectural Evolution:** Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.

* **End-to-End Delivery:** Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges and ensuring successful outcomes.

* **Scalable Solution Design:** Design scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artefacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability and governance where AI capabilities are involved.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards and best practices.

* **Architecture Reviews:** Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.

* **Engineering Guidance:** Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance and decision-making for complex technical issues. Promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.

* **Technology Innovation:** Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, OTT best practices and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency and long-term architectural sustainability.

  

### **What you'll bring:**

  
6+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.  

Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.  
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using **Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably **AWS**.
Strong solution design expertise, including integration and management of third-party vendor solutions and in-house platforms.  
* **AI fluency:** Practical understanding of Generative AI, Machine Learning and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity and problem-solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.  
Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.  
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as **Node.js, Java, Python or Go**, and strong knowledge of database technologies.
Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity and drive effective technical outcomes.  
Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models and technology landscapes.  
Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, SoC Design Verification
description:
**About GlobalFoundries**

  

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com .

  
  

**Introduction**

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Senior Principal SoC Design Verification Engineer to serve as a senior technical authority for verification of custom System-on-Chip designs. The successful candidate will define strategy for the most complex verification initiatives, solve critical problems of exceptional complexity, drive innovation across programs, and influence cross-functional technical direction and execution.

  
  

This position is well suited to a highly accomplished verification leader with exceptional breadth and depth, a sustained record of leading high-impact initiatives, and the ability to convert ambiguous product, architecture, and organizational challenges into scalable verification strategies with measurable business impact.

Successful candidates are trusted senior technical authorities who combine hands-on technical depth, strategic judgment, innovation, influence across organizational boundaries, and sustained development of experienced technical leaders.

  
  

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Define verification strategy, architecture, and signoff criteria for the most complex SoC programs, multiple interdependent technical areas, or a portfolio of related designs.

* Lead high-impact technical initiatives that are critical to business and functional objectives, including strategy, planning, risk management, and execution alignment across organizations.

* Architect scalable verification platforms, methodologies, reference models, assertions, coverage solutions, and automation strategies for adoption across multiple programs.

* Establish verification readiness and quality frameworks, drive closure of critical risks, and provide evidence-based signoff recommendations to senior engineering and program leadership.

* Solve critical, novel, and nonrecurring problems of exceptional complexity and establish systematic approaches that prevent recurrence across products and teams.

* Lead cross-functional, cross-site, and multi-program resolution of critical issues with architecture, RTL design, firmware, DFT, emulation, physical design, and post-silicon teams.

* Initiate and drive transformative technical innovation and continuous-improvement initiatives with measurable quality, productivity, cost, schedule, or business impact.

* Coach and mentor senior engineers and technical leaders, shape technical direction, and serve as a key technical advisor to functional and program leadership.
  

**Other Responsibilities:**

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant industry experience; OR Bachelor's degree in a related field with 11+ years of relevant industry experience.

* Demonstrated exceptional mastery and breadth in SoC design verification and recognition as a senior technical authority across multiple programs or technical areas.

* Expert-level experience using SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained-random verification, functional coverage, and SystemVerilog assertions.

* Advanced scripting, automation, and data-analysis experience using Python, Tcl/Tk, Perl, Shell, or equivalent languages.

* Extensive experience with EDA verification, debug, and signoff tools in a UNIX design environment.

* Demonstrated success defining strategy and leading high-impact technical initiatives across complex programs and organizational boundaries.

* Demonstrated ability to solve critical problems of exceptional complexity through innovative, scalable, and sustainable approaches.

* Ability to influence senior cross-functional leadership, communicate complex tradeoffs, and drive alignment on technical direction and investment priorities.

* Demonstrated ability to coach senior engineers and technical leaders and elevate technical capability across teams and programs.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with power-aware verification using UPF, including isolation, retention, and power-state transitions.

* Experience with a CPU architecture such as RISC-V, Arm, or MIPS.

* Experience with common SoC protocols or interfaces such as AXI, AHB, APB, SPI, I²C, or UART.

* Experience with UVM RAL, SystemRDL, IP-XACT, or register-model generation flows.

* Experience with formal verification, gate-level simulation, emulation, FPGA prototyping, or hardware/software co-verification.

C or C++ experience related to embedded software, test development, or reference models.  

  

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

Information about our benefits you can find here: https://gf.com/about-us/careers/opportunities-asia

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: Principal, Cloud Engineer
description:

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”

* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

**Our Mission & Vision**

* Our Mission: To place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform.
* Our Vision: A world where the software ModMed builds increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
* Our Core Values: Create customer delight | Save time | Innovate boldly, then make things happen | Align passion with purpose | Think big | Have fun | Do good.

**The Role:** Technical Visionary for Reliability and Developer Velocity As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer at ModMed, you are a primary architect of our technical future. You don't just solve problems; you anticipate the needs of a global healthcare platform years in advance. You will think big to define the standards for reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and security that allow our doctors to provide world-class care without interruption. This is a high-impact technical leadership role where you will innovate boldly, then make things happen, acting as a vital bridge between engineering, product, and business goals. By aligning passion with purpose, you will build a resilient infrastructure that serves as the backbone for modern medicine and consistently creates customer delight.

**Primary Responsibilities**

Core Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

* Architectural Strategy & Technical Governance: Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for our global AWS cloud ecosystem. Design high-performance, fault-tolerant, and cost-optimized multi-region topologies capable of scaling elastically to meet massive transaction volumes while enforcing rigorous cloud hygiene (Save time).
* Systemic Observability Ecosystems: Institutionalize "Observability as a Culture" across the enterprise. Architect unified, global telemetry standards using Datadog and OpenTelemetry, transforming raw logs, metrics, and distributed traces into actionable, predictive insights that elevate system reliability across all product engineering groups.
* Developer Platform Evolution & CI/CD Engineering: Revolutionize the corporate CI/CD philosophy and internal developer platform (IDP) strategy. Engineer systemic, highly automated pipeline improvements using tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, ACK, CUE, and others to eliminate developer friction, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate the release velocity of hundreds of engineers.
* Enterprise Kubernetes Stewardship: Serve as the ultimate authority on container orchestration, microservices deployment, and service mesh architectures. Drive high-level initiatives to maximize Kubernetes cluster efficiency, auto-scaling dynamics, secure multi-tenancy, and immutable deployment patterns across the entire organization.
* Proactive Infrastructure Security & Compliance: Partner closely with SecOps to architect a zero-trust infrastructure fortress. Embed automated security guardrails and compliance controls into core Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines, ensuring seamless, continuous adherence to strict healthcare regulatory standards, including HIPAA and SOC 2 (Do good).
* Enterprise Triage & Resilience Engineering: Act as the premier technical escalation authority for critical, cross-system infrastructure failures. Spearhead complex, multi-layered root-cause analysis, lead deep-dive post-mortems, and champion engineering patterns that turn production incidents into systemic resilience upgrades.

**Technical Leadership & Culture Multiplication**

* Engineering Force Multiplier: Act as a strategic force multiplier across the engineering ecosystem. Direct high-impact cross-functional initiatives, define and publish enterprise-wide best practices, influence organizational technology roadmaps, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of technical excellence (Have fun. Do good.).

**Role Requirements & Qualifications Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with an IT focus.
* Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles.
* Engineering Tenure: 13–15+ years of distinguished experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Architecture, or DevOps Platform Engineering, with a definitive track record of scaling high-concurrency, enterprise cloud environments.
* AWS Architectural Authority: Deep, authoritative mastery of the AWS ecosystem (including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, and advanced networking features) with proven experience executing massive scalability strategies and sophisticated cloud spend optimization structures.
* Advanced Platform Stack: Professional-grade expertise architecting and managing production-scale Kubernetes environments, comprehensive Datadog telemetry architectures, and modular Infrastructure-as-Code platforms utilizing Terraform or Terragrunt at scale.
* Strategic Engineering & Tooling: Expert-level software engineering capability in Python, Go, or Bash to construct intelligent automation engines, internal CLI tools, and infrastructure platforms that systematically eliminate operational toil.
* Executive-Level Influence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, low-level technical trade-offs into clear strategic visions for executive leadership while remaining capable of conducting a rigorous, line-by-line code and architecture review.
* Mission Dedication: A strong desire to apply elite technical expertise toward modernizing healthcare infrastructure, protecting patient data integrity, and solving complex societal-scale challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's in Engineering or MCA.
* Industry Credentials: Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or relevant advanced Specialty certifications (Security, Advanced Networking).
* Distributed Systems Expertise: Direct experience managing high-throughput, event-driven streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis) or high-scale data warehouse solutions (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Snowflake).
* Community & Thought Leadership: A history of contributing to foundational open-source cloud-native projects, authoring technical white papers, or speaking at premier industry tech conferences (e.g., AWS re:Invent, KubeCon). ModMed Core Behavioral Competencies To thrive in this role, you should naturally embody our foundational competencies:
* Agility: Embraces change as a growth opportunity; learns from successes and failures and adapts to new challenges.
* Results Driven: Consistently achieves quality results, overcomes obstacles, and inspires others to do the same.
* Company Culture: Actively contributes to our culture to keep this company awesome, acts with a values-first mentality, embraces differences, and creates a sense of belonging for all.
* Customer Focus: Builds strong, positive relationships (internally and externally) and delivers customer-centric solutions.

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

* Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems
