About the Role

We are looking for a
**Lead Golang Platform Engineer**
to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone.

Key Responsibilities

* Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.
* Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency.
* Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using
  **Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis**
  .
* Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling.
* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.
* Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization.
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana.
* Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases.
* Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**ECM Senior 1-3– Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting digital, is looking out for experienced web content management expert, especially on Microsoft Office365. Resource will be part of Enterprise Content Management team delivering to clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for resources with expertise in O365 development, implementation and related technologies to join the group of our ECM Collaboration Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Produces high-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
* Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
* Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
* Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
* Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
* Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
* Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 4-7 years development in O365 implementation.
* Must have strong analytical and technical skills using SharePoint SPFx, Python, C#, ASP.Net with MVC, JavaScript, and a variety of tools to deliver client-side solutions within Office 365.
* Strong knowledge in SharePoint Architecture Design (Extranet & Intranet).
* Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions.
* Good experience in JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS, Fluent UI, Knockout JS, HTML5, CSS, Ajax, JSON, jQuery etc.
* Core Skills:

+ SharePoint: SPFx, PnP Framework, PowerShell
+ Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
+ Dataverse: Data modelling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
+ Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
+ PCF Controls: React, Python, TypeScript, PCF control framework

* Desirable Skills:

+ Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
+ Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
+ AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
+ Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
+ Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
+ Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
+ Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences.
+ Experience in consulting strongly preferred.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure.
+ Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers.
+ Interpersonal and communication skills.
+ Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration.
+ Work in collaborative and supportive manner.
+ Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information.
+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI.
* Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP.
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data Architect-AI and Data Solutions Engineer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 6-9 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Proficiency in cloud architecture design in any of the given areas – AWS/Azure/GCP Architecture.

**AWS Architect**

* Experience in provisioning and spinning up AWS EC2 instances - on-Demand, Spot, dedicated instances, and cost calculation.
* Experience with server less architecture (Lambda), API gateway and RESTful services/JSON etc.
* Experience with one or more relational databases on AWS RDS – Oracle/ SQL Server/ MySQL and/or cloud data warehouse databases such as AWS Redshift
* Exposure to Data migration facilities such as DMS, S3 COPY, streaming, Kinesis, Batch
* Experience in developing applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to DevOps tools, deployment and orchestration technologies such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline etc.
* Experience with monitoring resources and applications using CloudWatch metrics, alarms and logs and tracking user activity, API usage using CloudTrail
* Experience with cloud assessment and migration on-premise workloads onto AWS.
* Expertise in AWS Architecture, Automation Tools and understanding of the agile development process.
* Experience in Migration from on-prem to Cloud using AWS migration tools
* Experience with VPN connectivity between regions and subnets
* Experience with Business Continuity and Disaster Recover design, planning and implementation for cloud infrastructures
* Exposure to one or more - Python, Perl, Ruby or UNIX shell scripting.
* Experience working with AWS Command line utility (CLI) and SDKs.
* Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest & Motion)

**Azure Architect**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and a strong understanding of Azure capabilities and limitations with demonstrated experience in end-to-end deployment of MS Azure BI solution(s)
* Experience in migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.
* Experience in defining highly available, DR solutions in Azure
* Experience in assessing applications for cloud adoption and define Cloud strategy for enterprise
* Experience in using agile methodologies in implementing Azure solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Tools for system management, monitoring, automation, and agile development
* Design and develop robust, scalable solutions for collecting, analyzing large data sets, creating, and maintaining data pipelines, data structures and/or support of highly distributed applications
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory (ADF),Azure Databricks, Azure Data Flow, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics / erstwhile Azure Data Warehouse (SQLDW), Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, Data Lake Store, Data Lake Analytics, U-SQL, HDInsight, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Purview, Power Apps, Power BI and PowerShell Scripting
* Configure large database solutions in Azure using SQL Server / Azure SQL DWH / Synapse and optimize the existing or new solutions as and when needed for optimum performance.
* Build data lake from multiple data sources with ingestion, data governance and auditing capabilities
* Experience in any of Programming/Scripting languages - Bash, PySpark, Scala, Python, PowerShell, Ruby – would be preferred
* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.

**GCP Architect**

* Experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, and technical consulting with expertise in architecting and rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
* Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning and experience with data analytics and data visualization techniques and software.
* Experience in GCP Dataflow, BigQuery, Dataproc, Datalab, Dataprep, Pub/Sub and Genomics
* Experience with core Data Science techniques such as regression, classification or clustering, and experience with deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Torch, Caffe, Theano, etc).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements and environments (such as Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud computing includes virtualization, hosted services, multi-tenant cloud infrastructures, storage systems and content delivery networks.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in AWS Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing scripts in one or more languages such as Python, UNIX Scripting and/or similar.
* AWS/Azure/GCP Certified Associate or Professional

**Education**
:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc degree or equivalent from accredited university

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled
**AI/ML Expert**
to lead and innovate in the development of advanced machine learning solutions, with a focus on large language models (LLMs) and generative AI tools. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing AI models, leveraging cutting-edge frameworks and infrastructure. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable AI applications, enhance existing models, and explore new AI-driven solutions to meet business objectives.
  
  
**About You**
4+ years in professional ML engineering, with at least 1+ years focused strictly on LLMs and generative AI tools.
  
  
Languages: Expert-level Python.
  
  
AI Frameworks: Deep experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  
  
Agentic Frameworks: Proven hands-on production experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  
  
Data Infrastructure: Proficiency with vector databases like Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, or Chroma.
  
  
Deployment Tools: Experience with vLLM, Ollama, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  
  
You bring passion, energy, taste for exploration and adaptability. You seek the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop new skills.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Engineer, Public Markets Technology
description:
**Purpose. Performance. People.**
Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.
  
  
With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.
  
  
For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Software Engineer, you will participate in the design, build, test and support of value-add technology solutions and products. You will also work in close partnership with business and technology teams and will acquire sufficient understanding of business and technology to apply critical thought to business and technology requests.
  
  
**The Team**
**Core Accountabilities**

* Participate in the design, build, test and support of technology solutions or enhancements to enable business capabilities, in an Agile environment that includes business and T&D partner teams.
* Apply an understanding of engineering best practices and participate in continuous improvement across the team.
* Build an understanding of the technical landscape and the business capabilities it supports and apply critical thought to business requests
* Demonstrate agility and innovation by participating in experimentation and solicitation of early feedback ensuring responsiveness to evolving business needs.
* Participate with colleagues to help frame and think deeply about problems identifying options
* Contribute to root cause analysis of operational incidents impacting the products supported by the team
* Adhere to Agile SDLC and execute related duties as required.
* Maintain strong relationships with business partners, peer IT teams and vendor partners

**Core Qualifications (Education And Experience)**

* Undergraduate degree or college diploma in related field (e.g. Engineering, Computer Science).
* 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python, with experience in Pandas and API development

title: Leadership - System Engineering
description:
We are looking for an experienced systems engineering leader to head our Systems Engineering function for UAV/UAS platform development. In this senior leadership role, you will build and lead a high-performing team of systems engineers, owning end-to-end system architecture, requirements management, and verification & validation across our unmanned aerial platforms — including hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing systems. You will be the technical authority bridging mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload sub-disciplines, ensuring the platform is engineered as a coherent, certifiable, and mission-ready system, while partnering closely with program management, manufacturing, quality, and customers to deliver robust, field-proven products.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Establish, lead, and continuously mature the Systems Engineering function — defining processes, tools, and governance for requirements management, system architecture, interface control, and verification & validation (V&V) across the UAV product portfolio.2
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of systems engineers across requirements, architecture, integration, and test disciplines, fostering technical depth, accountability, and career growth.
* Own system-level architecture and trade studies for hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing UAV platforms — balancing payload, endurance, propulsion, structural, and mission performance requirements.
* Drive requirements engineering and traceability from customer/stakeholder needs (GSQR/SRS) through system, subsystem, and component-level specifications, ensuring full bidirectional traceability.
* Lead integration and verification & validation planning across propulsion, avionics, GNC/flight controls, EMI/EMC, structures, and payload subsystems, ensuring compliance to applicable standards (MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, ARP4754A, STANAG, DO-160 where applicable).
* Own technical risk management at the system level — identifying, assessing, and tracking design and integration risks, and driving mitigation through design reviews and test campaigns.
* Chair and govern technical design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) and serve as the senior technical interface with program management, quality, certification bodies (CEMILAC/DGQA), and customers.
* Partner with PMO, manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement to ensure system designs are manufacturable, testable, and aligned with program schedules and cost targets.
* Drive root-cause analysis and design improvements from flight test, field deployment, and reliability/endurance data, closing the loop into the engineering baseline.
* Lead make-vs-buy and vendor technical evaluations for critical subsystems (propulsion, avionics, payload, navigation) and manage technical relationships with external partners and consultants.
* Drive systems engineering tooling and infrastructure investments (requirements management, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), configuration management, simulation platforms).

description:

Experience: 7–8 Years

Industry: Banking / Financial Services preferred

Location: Mumbai(Thane /BKC) Work from Office

Role Type: Architecture, Engineering & Technology Leadership

1. About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Architect with 7–8 years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and cloud-native architectures.

The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions, with a focus on banking and financial services use cases. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, architectural decision-making, rapid prototyping, and collaboration with engineering, data, security, and business teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Solution Design

\* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.

\* Design scalable AI platforms integrating LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native infrastructure.

\* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and inference strategies.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, reference implementations, design principles, and engineering standards.

\* Design for high availability, scalability, low latency, cost optimisation, observability, and resilience.

Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineering

\* Architect and implement RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, retrieval, reranking, and contextual response generation.

\* Design intelligent AI agents capable of tool calling, multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, and controlled execution of enterprise business processes.

\* Develop multi-agent workflows where appropriate, with clear boundaries, state management, human approval, and failure-handling mechanisms.

\* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, model routing, context management, and conversation memory.

\* Apply guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, and unauthorised tool execution.

\* Build proof of concepts and convert successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Enterprise Integration & Banking Use Cases

\* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, REST APIs, event-driven systems, microservices, and secure data platforms.

\* Design AI solutions for banking use cases such as customer service automation, knowledge assistants, document intelligence, regulatory compliance, fraud investigation support, and developer productivity.

\* Ensure AI services integrate seamlessly with existing authentication, authorisation, audit, and monitoring frameworks.

\* Work with domain architects and business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into technical solutions.

MLOps, LLMOps & Production Engineering

\* Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices for AI applications and model-serving components.

\* Implement model evaluation, regression testing, prompt/version management, retrieval-quality assessment, and continuous monitoring.

\* Define evaluation frameworks covering factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, safety, and token consumption.

\* Monitor model performance, drift, failure rates, inference costs, and application reliability.

\* Optimise inference performance through caching, batching, model selection, quantisation, and other suitable techniques.

Security, Governance & Responsible AI

\* Design AI solutions with security and privacy by design, including encryption, role-based access control, secrets management, and data minimisation.

\* Implement responsible AI controls, explainability where appropriate, traceability, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

\* Address threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, and sensitive information leakage.

\* Collaborate with information security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to meet applicable regulatory and organisational requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

\* Provide hands-on technical leadership to developers and engineering teams throughout the solution lifecycle.

\* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and proof-of-concept evaluations.

\* Mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices, design patterns, and production-readiness standards.

\* Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation roadmaps to technical and business stakeholders.

title: AI Principle Architect
description: Our PurposeMastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.Title And SummaryAI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.

title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
description:
What do we do?
  
  
**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**
Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
  
  
By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
  
  
What your day will look like
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for two
**Cloud Application Modernisation & Agentic Architects (f/m/d)**
to own the end-to-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio — 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6–8 months.
  
  
This is not a design-and-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP & Network Agentic Architect — and turn them into modernised, cloud-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run.
  
  
**Time allocation (approximate):**
~50% hands-on application refactoring & migration | ~25% project management, planning & stakeholder coordination | ~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance & SRE | ~10% observability, testing & validation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Refactoring & Modernisation**

* Own the end-to-end refactoring of your assigned applications — from assessment and design through implementation and validation
* Apply 12-factor app principles, event-driven architecture patterns, and cloud-native design to legacy codebases
* Migrate workloads from on-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
* Design for scalability and on-demand resource consumption — cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
* Use LLM-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation

**Project Management & Delivery**

* Own the migration plan for your applications: timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
* Track and report progress with precision - this is a time-boxed programme (6–8 months); delays must be surfaced early
* Split application ownership with your paired architect: clear DRI per application, shared standards

**Resilience & Rollback**

* Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins - you have crisis experience and you use it
* Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
* Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
* Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
* Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post-migration
* Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog — you are one of its primary consumers

What you need to fulfill the role
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
You have migrated complex, production applications from on-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically:
  
  

* Proven on-prem to cloud migration experience — at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
* Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform — networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
* Deep hands-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
* Strong 12-factor app knowledge — you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
* Strong event-driven architecture experience — Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
* Crisis and rollback experience — you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post-mortems
* Proven focus on scalability and on-demand resource design — your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
* Proven hands-on agentic experience: must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity — 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
* FinOps awareness — cost attribution and rightsizing post-migration
* Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
* Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme

**Soft Skills**

* Extreme ownership — you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
* Strong project management discipline: you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
* Collaborative by default — you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
* Crisis-calm: you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
* Fact-driven communicator: you report progress with data, not narrative

**What Success Looks Like**

* Month 2: Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
* Month 4: First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major + 2 add-on) — observable, scalable, cost-attributed
* Month 6: 7–8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
* Month 8: All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application

Success is defined as: more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost — across all 10 applications.
  
  
**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
* You need a stable architecture foundation before you start — legacy migration means working with what exists
* You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
* You treat project management as someone else's job
* You have not handled a production rollback under pressure

What we offer
  
  

* Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
* Hybrid-first working
* Continuous learning & certification budget
* Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
* Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.
**Hybrid working | Work from abroad | Flexible working hours | Thinkproject Academy | Free English lessons | Unlimited learning | Headspace community access | Women's Network | Corporate volunteering | Social events**
We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.
  
  
**Your Contact**
Mehal Mehta
  
  
**How To Apply**
Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:
  
  

* Salary expectations
* Potential start date
* A short write-up (max 300 words) on the most complex on-prem to cloud migration you have delivered - what went wrong, how you handled it, and what the outcome was, this is the most important part of your application

Working at thinkproject.com -
**think career. think ahead.**

description:
Job Description

We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced SQL Server Database Architect to lead the architecture, governance, modernization, and operational excellence of enterprise SQL Server platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, database security, and operational resilience.

  

* **Role: SQL Server Database Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 12 to 17 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architecture for SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and decision frameworks for SQL Server platforms.
* Establish standards for clustering, Always On Availability Groups, backup, recovery, monitoring, encryption, and privileged access management.
* Develop lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernization, consolidation, and database migration roadmaps.
* Act as the technical design authority for enterprise database solutions.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, resilience, data governance, and service management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform modernization initiatives.
* Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions aligned to business requirements.
* Lead recovery planning, failover testing, restore validation, and resilience assessments.
* Define standards for indexing strategies, query optimization, workload management, and database performance tuning.
* Establish performance baselines, capacity models, and forecasting processes.
* Lead technical response during critical incidents and major platform outages.
* Drive root-cause analysis and implement long-term engineering improvements.
* Define database security architectures and governance standards.
* Implement controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, patching, hardening, secrets management, and service accounts.
* Partner with cybersecurity, audit, risk, and compliance teams to address control requirements and audit findings.
* Ensure database platforms comply with relevant regulatory and operational resilience requirements.
* Support data protection, retention, governance, and compliance initiatives across the organization.
* Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to database administrators and engineering teams.
* Review and approve complex implementation plans and solution designs.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools.
* Evaluate database technologies, vendor solutions, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to manage technical dependencies.
* Maintain architecture repositories, service maps, support models, standards, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to strategic technology planning and database platform governance.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 12-17 years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Architecture roles.
* Extensive experience with SQL Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 in large enterprise production environments.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).
* Deep understanding of High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, Restore, and Business Continuity strategies.
* Strong experience supporting mission-critical business applications under formal change, incident, problem, and release management frameworks.
* Expertise in database modernization, upgrade, consolidation, and cloud migration programs.
* Advanced T-SQL development, execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Windows Server administration and supporting infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos Authentication, storage systems, networking, virtualization, and monitoring platforms.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server security architecture, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with automation using PowerShell and scripting technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture frameworks and technical governance processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies

title: Solution Architect
description:
Location : Pune

###### **About Wai**

Wai Technologies is a cutting-edge firm that pioneers innovative solutions in the tech industry. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, the company seamlessly blends state-of-the-art technologies with visionary strategies to empower businesses worldwide. With a commitment to excellence and a focus on transformative digital experiences, Wai Technologies stands as a beacon of technological advancement, driving growth and fostering innovation in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, we excel in Cloud services, App Modernization, Data/AI, specializing in industries such as Healthcare, Fintech, Construction, and more.

###### **About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to design and govern the architecture of banking-grade fintech platforms — digital wallets, money market/deposit accounts, payments, and value-added services (VAS). Think systems comparable to Shoprite Money Market, retail banking wallets, or similar high-volume consumer financial platforms.

You will own end-to-end solution design, define integration and data architecture, and ensure every system we build satisfies financial regulation from day one. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and engineering teams who build to your designs.

###### **Key Responsibilities**

Solution Architecture

* Design end-to-end architectures for banking and payments products: wallets, money market/transactional accounts, remittances, bill payments, airtime/VAS.
* Define integration patterns with core banking systems, payment switches, card schemes, and third parties (ISO 8583 / ISO 20022, EFT, RTC, DebiCheck, Rapid Payments, card issuing/acquiring).
* Design ledger, reconciliation, settlement, and clearing flows with strong guarantees around transaction integrity and idempotency.
* Own non-functional architecture: high availability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and performance at retail scale.
* Lead build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection (core banking, KYC, fraud, ledger platforms).
* Produce and maintain architecture artefacts: solution designs, sequence and data-flow diagrams, API contracts, and threat models.
* Establish and chair architecture governance (design reviews, standards, reference architectures).

Compliance & Security by Design

Architect systems compliant with South African financial regulation:

* SARB requirements and the National Payment System Act
* FICA — KYC/AML/CFT controls, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, FIC reporting
* GDPR — data privacy, residency, consent, retention
* PASA / payments industry rules and clearing/settlement participation
* Design for PCI DSS compliance in card data environments.
* Embed security architecture: encryption, key management (HSMs), secure SDLC, fraud controls, and complete audit trails.
* Support audits, penetration tests, and regulator or sponsor-bank due diligence.

Stakeholder Engagement

* Partner with product, compliance, legal, and operations to balance speed-to-market with regulatory obligations.
* Engage sponsor banks, card schemes (Visa/Mastercard), and fintech partners on integration and certification.
* Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to executives and external stakeholders.

###### **Minimum Requirements**

* 8+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years in solution or enterprise architecture roles.
* Proven track record architecting banking or fintech systems in production — digital wallets, money market/deposit products, payment platforms, or mobile money.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, settlement, and clearing in the South African payments landscape.
* Strong working knowledge of FICA, GDPR, PCI DSS, SARB/NPS requirements and how they translate into system design.
* Expertise in distributed systems: microservices, event-driven architecture, messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), API design, and financial-grade data modelling.
* Cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in regulated environments.

###### **Advantages**

* Core banking platform experience or proprietary ledger design.
* Card scheme certification experience (Visa/Mastercard issuing or acquiring).
* TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, CISSP/CISM, or PCI ISA certification.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

###### **Personal Attributes**

* Systems thinker who can zoom from regulatory obligation down to API contract.
* Clear communicator with executives, regulators, and engineers alike.
* Pragmatic — balances architectural purity with commercial delivery pressure.

###### **In addition to your standard CV**

Please ensure your application specifically addresses the following:

* Name the specific platform(s) you've worked on (e.g., Money Market, a mobile money platform, or equivalent) and describe your specific role and scope on each — not just "banking/fintech experience" as a listed skill.
* Confirm direct sponsor-bank / BaaS interfacing experience — describe a specific instance where you sat in technical integration discussions with a sponsor or partner bank's engineering or compliance team, and what that involved.
* Confirm payments and credit-regulation exposure — good to have exposure: PayShap, and NCR/NCA familiarity (in addition to FICA/POPIA/PCI DSS already listed), micro-lending etc.
* Provide at least one reference who can speak directly to your fintech delivery work (not a generic HR/manager reference) — we will be verifying this as part of the process.

Working Conditions:

* Complete work from office

###### **Benefits**

* We offer opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects with global clients, giving you exposure and helping you grow your skills.
* Learning and development are part of our culture, and we provide a platform to advance your career.
* Day shift from 9:30 am to 7:00 pm & fixed weekly off on Saturday and Sunday.
* Opportunities for skill development and training
* Training and mentorship programs offered.
* Performance-based annual bonuses.
* Health Insurance: Coverage for employees and dependents.
* Paid holidays & maternity benefits
* Gratuity and Employee Recognition Programs.

**Key Competencies**

\* MES solution design and architecture

\* Opcenter configuration and development

\* Manufacturing process analysis

\* System integration

\* Database and API development

\* Problem solving and root-cause analysis

\* Stakeholder management

\* Technical documentation

\* Agile project delivery

**Scope of Work**

1. Business Requirements Gathering

\* Engage with business stakeholders, production teams, quality, maintenance, warehouse, and IT teams to understand current manufacturing processes.

\* Conduct workshops, interviews, and site visits to gather functional and non-functional requirements.

\* Document business requirements and obtain stakeholder approval.

2. Process Analysis and Documentation

\* Analyze existing ("As-Is") manufacturing processes and identify pain points and improvement opportunities.

\* Design future-state ("To-Be") processes aligned with MES capabilities and business objectives.

\* Develop process maps, workflow diagrams, and business process documentation.

3. Requirements Management

\* Create and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS), user stories, and acceptance criteria.

\* Prioritize requirements based on business value, regulatory compliance, and project scope.

\* Manage requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

4. Gap Analysis

\* Compare current business processes with standard MES functionality.

\* Identify functional gaps and recommend process changes, system configuration, or customizations where necessary.

\* Evaluate impacts on manufacturing operations and business processes.

5. Stakeholder Management

\* Act as the primary liaison between business users, implementation partners, solution architects, developers, and project management.

\* Facilitate discussions to resolve business and functional issues.

\* Ensure stakeholder expectations are aligned throughout the implementation.

6. Functional Solution Design

\* Collaborate with solution architects to translate business requirements into functional solutions.

\* Review system configurations to ensure alignment with approved business requirements.

\* Support the definition of workflows, business rules, and exception handling.

7. Integration Requirements

\* Define business requirements for integrations between MES and enterprise systems such as ERP, SCADA, PLCs, LIMS, WMS, and quality systems.

\* Work with integration teams to validate end-to-end business processes.

\* Ensure data consistency and process continuity across integrated systems.

8. Master Data Management

\* Identify manufacturing master data requirements, including products, materials, equipment, routing, work centers, recipes, and resources.

\* Support data mapping, validation, and migration activities.

\* Ensure data quality and governance standards are followed.

9. Testing Support

\* Develop test scenarios and business test cases.

\* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production validation.

\* Coordinate defect triage with business users and technical teams.

\* Validate that implemented functionality meets business requirements.

10. Change Management and Training

\* Assess business impacts resulting from new MES processes.

\* Prepare training materials, user guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

\* Conduct user training sessions and support organizational change management initiatives.

11. Deployment and Go-Live Support

\* Assist in deployment planning and production readiness assessments.

\* Support cutover activities and business validation during go-live.

\* Monitor user adoption and provide functional support during hypercare.

12. Risk and Issue Management

\* Identify business risks associated with MES implementation.

\* Escalate issues affecting project scope, timeline, or operational readiness.

\* Recommend mitigation strategies and participate in issue resolution.

13. Compliance and Quality Assurance

\* Ensure MES processes comply with industry regulations, company standards, and quality requirements.

\* Support audit readiness by maintaining complete and accurate business documentation.

\* Verify that electronic records and manufacturing workflows meet applicable compliance requirements.

14. Continuous Improvement

\* Collect user feedback after implementation.

\* Identify opportunities for process optimization and system enhancements.

\* Support future MES releases, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Deliverables**

\* Business Requirements Document (MD50)

\* Technical Requirements Specification (MD70)

\* As-Is and To-Be Process Maps

\* Gap Analysis Report

\* Data Mapping Documents

\* Test Scenarios and UAT Scripts

title: Senior Engineer, AI Security
description:
The **AI Security Engineer** is responsible for building and running the security controls that find and govern the use of artificial intelligence across Danaher, including chat tools, AI platforms, and autonomous agents. The engineer configures and tunes policies and detections in CrowdStrike Falcon and AI gateways, and builds the automation that lets Danaher adopt AI safely.

This position reports to the **Senior Manager, AI Security & Governance** and is part of the **DIS Corporate Cybersecurity - AI Security** team located in **Bangalore or Pune India** and will be an on-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Configure, tune, and maintain security policies for the AI control plane in CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) and Falcon Shield, including access rules, prompt rules, and report, transform, or block actions.
* Manage policy and configuration for AI gateways that cover gaps the CrowdStrike tools cannot reach.
* Build alerts and detections for unapproved AI use, risky agent behavior, and policy violations, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.
* Build the automation yourself: prove a task by hand in the platform, then automate it with Python, PowerShell, and platform APIs.
* Contribute to AI security design with the AI Security Architect, and coordinate with the Security Operations Center and the CrowdStrike engineering team.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 9+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on work on endpoint, software-as-a-service, or cloud security platforms.
* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or customizing CrowdStrike Falcon, such as policy authoring, integrations, detection logic, or console administration.
* Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
* Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.
* AI gateways or AI security platforms (such as JetStream, LiteLLM, or Prisma AIRS), or security for Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Securing autonomous AI agents or Model Context Protocol servers.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.
