title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
PeopleSoft Developer
  
About the Role#JLLTechAmbitions
  
JLL, an international real estate management company, is looking for PeopleSoft Developers to join our JLL Technology Engineering organization. You will work on mission-critical financial systems, combining hands-on PeopleSoft development with analysis of business needs, root-cause work on production issues, and delivery of enhancements through the full change lifecycle.
  
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, changing environment, enjoys solving business problems through creative thinking, and brings a “Get it done” attitude with a “Think ahead” mentality. You should be comfortable working independently and with a distributed team, and able to lead by example.
  
**ResponsibilitiesDevelop and enhance:** design, code, and unit test customizations and enhancements to JLL’s PeopleSoft Financials modules using PeopleCode, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, SQR, and SQL.
  
**Resolve production issues:** analyze incidents and batch failures, determine root cause, deliver fixes, and move solutions through the change lifecycle. Document recurring failures as SOPs and known-error articles.
  
**Translate requirements:** work with finance users and functional analysts to turn business needs into functional and technical specifications, and articulate requirements in enough detail for thorough testing.
  
**Build and support integrations:** develop and maintain interfaces with upstream and downstream systems using Integration Broker, file layouts, and Component Interfaces, and monitor interface and batch process flows.
  
**Reporting:** build and maintain BI Publisher reports, PS Queries, and SQRs for finance, audit, and operational needs.
  
**Upgrades and infrastructure:** take part in PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) and PeopleTools upgrades, including keep/drop analysis, compare-report review, and retrofit of customizations, and support PeopleSoft environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  
**Testing and quality:** prepare test cases, run unit and system integration testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and track defects to closure.
  
**Improve and optimize:** identify performance improvements and automation opportunities, evaluate user interface enhancements, and drive change that reduces manual effort.
  
**Document and enable:** maintain technical documentation, training material, and job aids, and consult with the business on correct use and interpretation of PeopleSoft functionality.
  
**Collaborate and mentor:** participate in global and regional enhancement and implementation projects, and share knowledge with and guide junior team members.
  
Experience & EducationAt least 5 years of IT experience, with 8+ years of hands-on PeopleSoft development preferred. A computer science or related engineering degree is preferred.
  
Proven experience supporting and enhancing PeopleSoft Financials (FSCM 9.2) in a production environment.
  
Experience with PeopleSoft upgrades (PUM image and PeopleTools), including object compare and retrofit.
  
Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to resolve issues under SLA pressure.
  
Experience with API testing and familiarity with HTTP, REST, and JSON protocols.
  
Reliable, self-motivated, and self-disciplined, able to plan and run multiple tasks at once.
  
Effective written and verbal communication, and strong analytical and organizational skills.
  
Technical Skills & CompetenciesPeopleSoft development (required): PeopleCode, Application Designer, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, File Layouts, Data Mover, Approval Workflow Engine (AWE), and PS Query, on PeopleTools 8.5x and later.
  
**Reporting (required):** BI/XML Publisher and SQR.
  
**Integrations (required):** PeopleSoft Integration Broker, plus experience with file-based and web-service interfaces.
  
**Database (required):** Strong Oracle SQL; ability to write, tune, and troubleshoot SQL scripts.
  
**Financial modules:** hands-on experience in several of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Billing, Contracts, Purchasing/Requisitions, Asset Management, Project Costing, and Travel & Expenses. Exposure to a multi-currency, multi-book instance is a plus, including document sequencing, VAT, sales and use tax processing, payment predictor, and bank interfaces.
  
**SDLC and tooling:** full software development lifecycle (analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment), Agile delivery, and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow and Jira.
  
Basic knowledge of financial accounting.
  
Preferred (Nice to Have)PeopleSoft Fluid user interface development.
  
Experience with PeopleSoft on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or a cloud migration.
  
PeopleSoft Test Framework or other test automation tools.
  
UNIX shell scripting and job scheduling tools (for example Autosys).
  
PeopleSoft security administration (user profiles, roles, workflow setup).
  
Integration experience with external platforms such as Workday or ServiceNow.
  
Oracle PeopleSoft or Oracle Cloud certifications.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Experience Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you eager to shape the future of video entertainment, from movies and TV shows to live sports events? Do you enjoy tackling complex challenges within large-scale systems? If so, we invite you to help build the future of entertainment with us at Prime Video!  
  
Since its launch in 2007, Prime Video has been transforming the traditional television and movie industry. With a rapidly expanding library of high-quality content and availability in over 240 countries and territories, Prime Video is now a key strategic priority for Amazon. We invest heavily in acquiring, producing, and programming a diverse range of TV shows, movies, and live events. Our exclusive titles include "The Lord of the Rings," "The Boys," "The Wheel of Time," and "The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel," among others. Beyond our extensive On-Demand catalog, Prime Video offers a wide selection of Linear Channels and Live Sports, featuring major events like Thursday Night Football, the English Premier League, NBA, MLB, ATP tennis, French Open, and the UEFA Champions League. If this sparks your interest, read on!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable systems that power Prime Video’s streaming services.
* Define the architecture for our software, utilizing a broad range of technologies, programming languages, and systems.
* Implement and operate APIs that manage billions of playback start requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency content delivery.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence the overall technical strategy and contribute to the team’s long-term roadmap.
* Communicate effectively across teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with technical goals and project timelines.
* Apply creative problem-solving skills to address complex challenges.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and new technologies, integrating them where appropriate. Fluency in GenAI based developer efficiency tools is a plus.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, contributing to the overall growth and success of the engineering team.

  
A day in the life  
As a software engineer on the Prime Video team, my day starts with diving into hands-on coding and technical problem-solving. I’m not just writing code—I’m helping to shape the architecture of complex systems that millions of people rely on every day. One of the most rewarding aspects of my role is seeing my work come to life when friends and family use Prime Video to watch their favorite shows and live sports.  
  
My primary focus is on designing and maintaining the APIs that power every title on Prime Video. This involves creating highly reliable and low-latency systems that ensure users can start streaming their content with just a click. The challenges are unique, especially when it comes to managing the sheer scale of requests we handle daily. To tackle these, I leverage AWS technologies like EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, and CloudFront.  
  
Collaboration is a significant aspect of my role. I collaborate with a cross-functional team to align our technical strategies and define our long-term roadmap. It’s exhilarating to influence decisions that will shape the future of Prime Video. Throughout the day, I alternate between deep focus on coding and brainstorming sessions with my teammates to tackle novel challenges.  
  
Beyond the technical work, I also play a key role in mentoring junior engineers. Sharing my knowledge and seeing others grow is incredibly fulfilling. I’m always encouraged to push the boundaries of what’s possible, and I have the freedom to explore new ideas that can elevate our service to the next level.  
  
At the end of the day, I know that the work I do directly contributes to a world-class viewing experience for millions of Prime Video users, and that’s a great feeling.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility.

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world’s most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale.

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale.

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

* Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of secure, reliable, robust, and interoperable payment acceptance products.
* Provide engineering leadership to ensure solutions align with platform principles, architecture standards, and Visa-grade availability, resiliency, and operational excellence expectations.
* Remain actively hands-on with architecture, design reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concepts, performance analysis, debugging, technical troubleshooting, production-readiness, and critical delivery decisions on a day-to-day basis.
* Apply AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent engineering practices to improve software delivery, search relevance, analytics capabilities, operational insight, developer productivity, and business outcomes.
* Define and execute the technical strategy for payment processing and acceptance platforms in alignment with product vision, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution.
* Drive delivery of fit-for-purpose products and platform capabilities that improve time-to-market while maintaining security, quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases.
* Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users.
* Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives.
* Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering best practices for application development, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness, strengthening reliability, performance, maintainability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Search and Analytics capabilities.
* Partner with application, data, platform, product, regional, business, client-facing, security, privacy, risk, governance, compliance, and operations teams to translate requirements into high-quality solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements (security, latency, availability, compliance, maintainability) and applicable policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.
* Communicate and present technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, delivery progress, and recommendations clearly, adapting to audiences that include executive leaders, business partners, product partners, architecture forums, and engineering teams.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, senior engineers, technical leads, and engineering leaders through regular feedback, design reviews, architecture discussions, hands-on problem solving, technical deep dives, brown bag sessions, tech talks, production troubleshooting, and career development conversations.
* Build and lead high-performing teams by promoting collaboration, constructive debate, accountability, inclusion, and execution excellence consistent with Visa Leadership Principles.
* Bring forward new ideas, engineering improvements, and technology recommendations that increase team effectiveness, improve developer productivity, and advance platform capabilities.
* Influence technical strategy across teams without relying on formal reporting authority, using strong engineering judgment, collaboration, credibility, and hands-on technical depth.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
* Demonstrated success leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and geographically distributed software engineering teams, including people management, coaching, performance development, delivery accountability, and hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.
* Deep experience designing, building, and operating globally distributed, mission-critical systems that require high availability, scalability, resiliency, and security, and that support very high transaction volumes with strict availability, latency, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to solve complex technical and organizational problems across multiple domains, systems, and teams.
* Experience setting technical direction, influencing architecture and delivery strategy, and aligning engineering execution with product and business objectives.
* Strong proficiency in modern software engineering practices, programming languages, API design, system design, testing, deployment, and operational excellence, with a strong hands-on background in API-first software product development using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Vert.x, REST, Kafka, Hazelcast, Git, Maven, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Recent hands-on experience with architecture, design, coding practices, code reviews, debugging, production support, and technical decision-making in complex software systems.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview:

### **Working at Atlassian India**

Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear.

Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere.

### **Your future team: KubePlat Team**

The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products.

What we own:

* **Kubernetes infrastructure:** hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments.
* **Fleet management:** automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts.
* **Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service:** an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices.
* **Cloud resource management:** self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on.
* **Secure sandboxed compute:** strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads.
* **Software delivery:** artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day.
* **AI/ML infrastructure:** the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features.

We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale.

Responsibilities:

As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch.

### **What you'll do**

* Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters.
* Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - SRE
description:
Introduction:

**Job title: Senior Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Experience: 5-10 years**

**The opportunity**

You will work on world-class retail supply chain solutions, deploying and running enterprise applications, including GPU-powered AI/ML products, on Azure and Oracle Cloud. These applications run 24/7 and are business-critical: warehouses and stores depend on them for daily operations. In this cloud and SRE role, you will own their reliability: defining and meeting SLOs, responding fast to incidents, troubleshooting end to end, and engineering out recurring problems through automation.

  
Job Description:

**Key responsibilities**

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing team. In this role, you will:

* Own the reliability of business-critical retail supply chain applications on Azure and Oracle Cloud, used 24/7 by warehouses and stores.
* Define and track SLIs and SLOs with product and application teams, using error budgets to balance reliability and release speed.
* Build observability (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts) using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Zabbix.
* Provide 24/7 L2/L3 support, act as incident commander on major incidents, and lead root cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Troubleshoot end to end across Cloudflare, HAProxy, network, Linux, Docker, Apache TomEE/Java, APIs, and Oracle Database, and quickly isolate the failing layer.
* Diagnose Java application issues using thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs, and APM traces.
* Perform first-level Oracle Database triage and escalate to the DBA team with clear diagnostics.
* Build and deploy cloud infrastructure (networks, VMs, containers, VPN, ExpressRoute, FastConnect) using Terraform and Ansible.
* Automate away toil, such as deployments, health checks, failover, and routine maintenance, with Python and Bash.
* Plan capacity, tune performance, and test high availability and disaster recovery through regular failover drills.
* Plan and execute production changes with minimal downtime and tested rollback, and maintain runbooks.

**Key criteria**

**Must-have**

* 5-10 years in SRE, cloud infrastructure, or production operations, including at least 3 years running production workloads on Azure or OCI.
* Strong cloud expertise (Azure or OCI) across networking (VNet/VCN, VPN, ExpressRoute/FastConnect), compute, storage, and IAM.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu) and hands-on Docker experience.
* Hands-on Terraform, Ansible, and Python/Bash automation in production environments.
* Practical SRE experience: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, 24/7 incident management, and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Experience with observability and APM tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, ELK, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or New Relic).
* End-to-end troubleshooting across networking (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS), HAProxy or similar load balancers, Java on TomEE/Tomcat, REST APIs, and Oracle Database at triage level.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift and on-call model.

**Good-to-have**

* Cloud certifications (Azure, OCI, or AWS).
* Experience with Cloudflare (DNS, WAF, CDN, caching rules).
* CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) with canary or blue-green releases.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
* Chaos engineering or game-day exercises to test resilience.
* GPU-based compute supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Retail or supply chain domain exposure, ITIL familiarity, and strong written and verbal communication.

**Growth opportunities**

* Learning opportunities with multi-cloud environments.
* Scope to deepen expertise in Oracle Cloud (OCI) and Azure in large production environments.
* Opportunity for cross-skilling (retail products, multi-cloud, DevOps, orchestration tools, scripting, and company AI trainings) and enhancing skills to stay competitive in the future.

title: Junior GPU Software Engineer
description:
**Junior GPU Software Engineer**

**Hyderabad, Telangana | On-site**

**Experience: 1–4 Years**

**About OXMIQ**

OXMIQ provides complete hardware and software GPU IP, so our customers can build their own AI silicon. Our OxCore architecture combines scalar, tensor and SIMT engines on one platform. It delivers CUDA compatibility alongside a flexible, fully programmable architecture. OxPython, our software stack, runs on top of it and lets CUDA-optimized models run unmodified on Oxmiq’s GPU IP, giving day-zero support for new AI models. We have an established software team and a working stack. We’re now moving from development to production delivery, hardening the platform and scaling it to meet real customer demands.

You’ll join the OXMIQ software team as an early-career engineer working on the GPU software stack. You’ll work closely with senior engineers and architects to build, test and optimize the kernels, runtime and enablement layers that bring high performance to our customers’ AI workloads.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, test and optimize GPU software within OxPython, the OXMIQ software stack, across the kernel, runtime and framework integration layers.
* Write and tune GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton-based and custom ops) for AI workloads such as GEMM, attention, convolution and memory-bound operators.
* Profile and benchmark workloads, identify performance bottlenecks and help close the gap to peak hardware utilization.
* Learn and apply SIMT and parallel compute concepts, including thread/warp scheduling, divergence, occupancy and efficient use of the memory hierarchy.
* Help enable new models, operators and customer workloads on Oxmiq GPU IP, including bring-up on pre-silicon and emulation platforms.
* Work with compiler engineers on how kernels are lowered and mapped onto Oxmiq hardware through MLIR/LLVM.
* Support software/hardware validation through test development, debugging and issue triage.
* Carry out root cause analysis for functional and performance issues in kernels and runtime code.
* Contribute to tooling, automation and documentation that make the stack easier to develop, test and ship.
* Take part in design and code reviews, and learn from senior engineers across the kernels, runtime and frameworks teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in GPU, systems or performance-focused software, including internships, research or graduate project work.
* Strong fundamentals in C/C++ and systems programming.
* Hands-on experience with GPU programming, including CUDA, from coursework, research, internships or projects.
* Understanding of SIMT and parallel compute fundamentals: threads/warps, divergence, synchronization, occupancy and memory hierarchies.
* Interest in performance work, plus basic experience with profiling and optimizing code.
* Familiarity with computer architecture and operating systems concepts.
* Exposure to ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and how deep learning workloads run on GPUs.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, eagerness to learn, and a bias toward shipping. You prototype, measure and iterate quickly.

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience writing or optimizing GPU kernels such as GEMM, convolution, reductions or attention.
* Exposure to Triton or similar high-level GPU kernel frameworks.
* Familiarity with compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
* Exposure to GPU profiling tools such as Nsight or similar.
* Experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development workflows.
* Coursework, research or projects in parallel computing, GPU architecture, compilers or high-performance computing.
* Background in AI workloads and software stacks: LLM inference and training, attention and KV-cache optimization, distributed and multi-GPU execution, or serving frameworks such as vLLM and SGLang.
* Contributions to open-source GPU, compiler, runtime or ML-framework projects such as LLVM, MLIR, Triton or PyTorch.

**Education**

B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/MS/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

**Why OXMIQ**

You’ll join a fast-growing company with an established team and a proven stack, as we scale it into a production platform in customers’ hands. You’ll work directly with the people designing the hardware it runs on. This role suits an early-career engineer who wants to build deep GPU software skills, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and work across an entire SIMT compute platform rather than just one layer of it.

**Compensation & Benefits**

OXMIQ offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, equity participation, comprehensive medical coverage, and the opportunity to contribute to foundational silicon and software technology.

***OXMIQ is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.***

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Lead software architecture and modernization**

Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.

* **Stay deeply hands-on in code**

Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.

* **Design strong domain models and APIs**

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.

* **Modernize application foundations**

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.

* **Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability**

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

* **Improve data access and integration design**

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

* **Raise the bar for code quality and testing**

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.

* **Create reusable engineering patterns**

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.

* **Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution**

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.

**WHAT THIS IS NOT**

* This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
* This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering**

You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.

* **Credible hands-on implementation depth**

You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.

* **Service transformation and architecture judgment**

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.

* **Production reliability and performance expertise**

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.

* **Software design and refactoring depth**

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.

* **Data and integration depth**

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

* **Strong testing and code-quality discipline**

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

* **Principal-level technical leadership**

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

* **An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**

You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

**BONUS POINTS**

* Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
* Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
* Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
* Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
* Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **Modernization advances without destabilizing the business**

Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.

* **Critical software becomes easier to change**

Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.

* **Architecture decisions become executable**

Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.

* **Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle**

Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.

* **AI expands engineering leverage**

AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.

**WHY THIS MATTERS**

ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.

This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  
A day in the life  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.  
  
About the team  
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Engineering Manager-Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week** 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for a production web application environment built around .NET / C#, APIs, React / Redux, current Azure services, and modern CI/CD practices, while leading the team's cloud migration to AWS.
* Help define the next-generation direction for the Insights application, including modernization, architecture, AWS target-state design, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity with AI-assisted tooling such as Cursor.
* Own delivery execution across roadmap work, technical debt, operational improvements, incident response, release readiness, and production support.
* Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and business stakeholders to translate priorities into clear technical plans, backlog decisions, acceptance criteria, and delivery outcomes.
* Improve engineering practices across code quality, review discipline, automated testing, observability, release management, incident learning, service-level objectives, and responsible use of AI coding tools including Cursor.
* Support transition and long-term ownership of complex or partner-built application components into full-time team accountability.
* Strengthen application reliability across multi-tenant architecture, customer access models, background processing, messaging, integrations, and data platform dependencies.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

* Recent hands-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people-only management role.
* Strong technical background in .NET / C#, API development, React or comparable SPA frameworks, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience leading engineering teams through delivery planning, technical decision-making, production support, and release execution.
* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.
* Hands-on AWS experience with production application workloads (for example EC2 / ECS / EKS / Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS / SNS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and AWS-aligned CI/CD), including cloud migration or platform cutover experience.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted software development, including Cursor (or a closely comparable AI coding assistant / IDE), and the ability to apply it to design, coding, code review, testing, documentation, and incident analysis while keeping humans accountable for production quality.
* Experience with CI/CD, release engineering, environment management, and migration or improvement of build and deployment workflows.
* Ability to operate in a production environment, including incident management, root-cause analysis, observability, service health, and reliability improvement.
* Strong collaboration with Product or Product Owner functions, including backlog shaping, acceptance criteria, tradeoff decisions, and roadmap execution.
Ability to coach engineers at all experience levels, create accountability, and balance hands-on technical guidance with people leadership.  

**IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**
-----------------------

* Experience with Power BI, embedded analytics, or other BI / reporting platforms.
* Deeper AWS architecture experience (landing zones, networking, identity, cost management, or large-scale Azure-to-AWS application migration).
* Experience establishing team standards for AI-assisted development with Cursor, including prompt/review practices, security guardrails, and measuring productivity impact.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture and hierarchical customer access models.
* Experience modernizing a large, long-lived frontend application, including framework and build-toolchain upgrades.
* Familiarity with warehousing, ETL, data engineering partnerships, or data platform adjacency.
* Experience with payments, billing integrations, SSO, identity federation, SOC 2, vertical SaaS, fitness, wellness, or multi-product platform environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* Clear ownership, stable delivery rhythms, and strong accountability across application development and production support.
* The current application is better understood, better documented, more reliable, and easier for the team to operate and enhance.
* A practical next-generation application direction is defined, with clear modernization priorities, an Azure-to-AWS migration sequence, and team adoption of AI-assisted engineering (including Cursor).
* Releases are more predictable, incidents are managed with discipline, and quality validation improves across environments.
* Engineers on the team receive strong technical guidance, coaching, prioritization, and support for growth.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

### **AI & Innovation Leadership**

* Lead adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices to improve development productivity, delivery velocity, quality, and operational efficiency.

* Promote responsible use of AI technologies, ensuring compliance, security, governance, and risk management standards.

### **Engineering Productivity, Metrics & Outcomes**

* Establish and drive engineering productivity and operational excellence metrics across teams.
* Utilize Developer Experience (DX) and Engineering Excellence frameworks to improve developer effectiveness, system reliability, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Leverage engineering insights and platform metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve value stream flow, and increase team efficiency.
* Drive adoption of data-driven decision making using engineering, delivery, quality, and operational KPIs.

* Promote automation-first approaches to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and accelerate time-to-market.

### **People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent across multiple teams.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
* Build high-performing, inclusive teams focused on collaboration, innovation, and customer outcomes.
* Support hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, and talent acquisition activities.

### **Performance & Talent Management**

* Own performance management processes including goal setting, development planning, talent assessments, and appraisal cycles.
* Conduct regular coaching and career development discussions with team members.
* Identify growth opportunities and create development plans aligned with organizational needs.
* Recognize and reward performance while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

### **Stakeholder & Business Partnership**

* Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Business Leaders, Operations, and Enterprise stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights, technical expertise, and business acumen.
* Align engineering initiatives with business objectives and customer outcomes.

### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Serve as a key BOS leadership representative within the Hyderabad location.
* Support Hyderabad location strategy, workforce growth, employee engagement, leadership visibility, and organizational development.
* Partner with local and global leaders to strengthen BOS presence and leadership effectiveness within the Hyderabad engineering organization.
* Drive local leadership forums, employee connect initiatives, and organizational health activities.

  
Qualifications:

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10-14 years of technology industry experience with progressive responsibilities in software engineering, technology delivery, or engineering management.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience leading engineering teams.
* Experience leading multiple Agile delivery teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Proven experience managing performance reviews, talent development, goal setting, and employee mentoring.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple locations.
* Experience assisting with location strategy, workforce planning, and organizational growth initiatives.
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams and portfolio governance forums.
* Experience managing large-scale transformation or organizational change programs.
* Solid grasp of Agile, Lean, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Developer Experience (DX) principles.

Additional Information:

**What Makes You a Standout Candidate**
---------------------------------------

* Thinks like an Engineering Leader and Technology Strategist, not a traditional project manager.

* Drives measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, reliability, and business value.
* Makes data-driven decisions using engineering metrics, delivery benchmarks, and business outcomes.
* Balances technology strategy, engineering excellence, people leadership, and business priorities.
* Builds a culture of innovation, continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.
