We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

**Red Team / Adversarial Simulation Engineer**

**The Opportunity**

We’re hiring a Red Team / Adversarial Simulation Engineer to help strengthen our offensive security capabilities. You’ll support adversary simulation exercises and targeted testing mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, working alongside team members to identify risk and help improve defenses.

You’ll work closely with senior Red Team operators and security engineering partners to execute scoped exercises, produce clear evidence of exploitable paths, and translate offensive findings into practical risk reduction.

**What You’ll Do**

* Support operations: Assist in planning and execution of approved adversary simulation exercises across endpoints, identity, applications, cloud, and third-party integrations, with guidance from senior operators.
* Execute adversary tradecraft: Operate across initial access simulation, internal discovery, credential access testing, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command-and-control simulation, and objective-based actions within approved scope.
* Map procedures and findings to MITRE ATT&CK to keep tradecraft, reporting, and scenario design consistent across exercises.
* Track operational outcomes: Collect command output, screenshots, logs, timelines, access paths, affected assets, and constraints so findings are defensible and reproducible.
* Build technical depth: Help maintain lab environments, test infrastructure, and approved tooling while following established safety and OPSEC practices.
* Learn and share tradecraft: Contribute to team standards, document lessons learned, and participate in peer reviews of techniques, findings, and reports.
* Apply and assess LLMs: Use LLMs to support authorized offensive security operations, including research, scripting, analysis, tooling, and workflow automation, and evaluate LLM-enabled systems for weaknesses that could contribute to an attack path.
* Follow safety and compliance practices: Operate within defined scope, approvals, deconfliction steps, and engagement rules for all activities.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 1 to 3 years in offensive security, penetration testing, Red Team operations, adversary simulation, or hands-on security engineering with offensive testing exposure.
* Technical foundation: Solid working knowledge of Windows and Linux internals, cloud security, AI/LLM, common enterprise attack paths, and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Framework fluency: Practical familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, including the ability to map and demonstrate Red Team procedures against tactics, techniques, objectives, and enterprise risk.
* Scripting and tooling: Practical experience writing or modifying scripts in PowerShell, Python, Go, Rust, or C#, with enough depth to automate operator tasks, adapt approved tooling, handle output, and troubleshoot execution issues.
* Operator mindset: Ability to think through attack paths, adjust safely when assumptions fail, maintain discipline under scope constraints, and document what worked, what failed, and why.
* Communication: Clear technical writing, disciplined evidence handling, and the ability to explain attack paths, impact, and remediation context to technical audiences without overstating findings.
* Automated security testing: Experience planning and managing test execution across a range of automated security testing tools, validating results, tracking coverage, and delivering clear, actionable reports.

*Certifications (nice to have): OSCP, CRTO/CRTP, or similar hands-on security certifications.*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)

description:
GeForce NOW is NVIDIA's Cloud Gaming service, streaming games at the highest quality to any and every user, regardless of their device type and capabilities - low-end PCs, Macs, TV or mobile devices. title: Lead Engineer II – Senior Engineer, Authentication and Authorization IRC302231
description:
**Description**
We’re building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You’ll own the common auth stack — making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface.
  
  
**Requirements**
You should have
  
  
– 5+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments.
  
  
– Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well-tested service code in either.
  
  
– Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — not just using libraries but understanding what’s happening underneath.
  
  
– Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
  
  
– Familiarity with multi-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
  
  
– Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).
  
  
Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
– Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2.0 flows, API key management, and service-to-service identity.
  
  
– Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar).
  
  
– Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane — clean APIs, well-documented contracts, and minimal coupling.
  
  
– Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers.
  
  
– Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
  
  
– Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one-off implementations.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  
  
Overview  
The Mastercard Payment Networks team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Follow established coding standards, testing practices, and quality gates.
* Debug issues and contribute to defect resolution and system stability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support smooth project delivery.
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and meet sprint commitments.
* Contribute to Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and learning initiatives when required.
* Seek feedback, continuously learn, and adopt modern development and cloud practices.

  
All About You  

* 6 months to 1 year of overall career experience into Software Engineering in Java Full Stack
* Passion for software engineering with foundational Full Stack or Backend development skills.
* Good understanding of Java and Spring Boot fundamentals.
* Basic awareness of microservices and event-driven architecture concepts.
* Exposure to real-time or online systems development is an advantage.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and version control tools.
* Knowledge of databases (RDBMS and/or NoSQL such as Cassandra).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., PCF) and digital-native architectures is desirable.
* Strong learning ability with a mindset to quickly grasp and apply new technologies.
* Effective communication and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Positive attitude towards continuous learning and improvement.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description: Senior Software Engineer / Staff Software EngineerAbout the Role

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Senior Software Engineer / Staff Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance SaaS applications. The role involves leading backend development, designing distributed systems, making architecture decisions, and solving complex engineering challenges to improve product reliability and scalability.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in backend engineering, system design, microservices, and cloud infrastructure. This role also requires technical leadership, mentoring engineers, establishing engineering best practices, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Software Architecture and Design:** Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures that support business requirements and long-term product growth.
* **Backend Development:** Lead the development of robust backend services and applications using Java, Python, Go, or other suitable programming languages.
* **Distributed Systems:** Design, build, and maintain distributed systems and microservices to support high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.
* **System Design:** Develop architectural solutions, evaluate technical trade-offs, and establish design patterns for complex software systems.
* **API Development:** Design and implement efficient, secure, and scalable APIs to support seamless communication between services and applications.
* **Database Optimization:** Work with SQL and NoSQL databases, caching mechanisms, and data storage systems to improve query performance and application efficiency.
* **Performance Optimization:** Identify performance bottlenecks, conduct root cause analysis, and implement improvements to reduce latency and increase system throughput.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** Develop and maintain cloud-based infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and scalable application environments.
* **CI/CD and Automation:** Improve continuous integration and continuous deployment processes to enable reliable releases and efficient engineering workflows.
* **System Reliability and Observability:** Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting solutions to improve system visibility, availability, and incident response.
* **Code Quality and Reviews:** Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews, and promote testing practices and maintainable software development.
* **Technical Mentoring:** Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and support team members in solving complex engineering problems.
* **Technical Decision-Making:** Lead architecture discussions, evaluate technologies, and make informed engineering decisions aligned with product and business goals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with product management, security, infrastructure, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable software solutions.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve development processes, system architecture, engineering productivity, and overall product quality.

Qualifications and Experience

* **Educational Qualification:** Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience:** 7–12 years of relevant software engineering experience.
* **Programming Expertise:** Strong proficiency in Java, Python, Go, or similar backend programming languages.
* **Backend Engineering:** Extensive experience developing production-grade backend applications, services, and APIs.
* **System Design:** Demonstrated expertise in designing scalable architectures, distributed systems, and microservices.
* **Database Knowledge:** Strong understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, caching strategies, data modeling, and performance optimization.
* **Cloud and DevOps:** Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and production operations.
* **Observability:** Familiarity with monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, and system performance analysis.
* **Engineering Best Practices:** Experience with code reviews, automated testing, design reviews, and software quality standards.
* **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to mentor engineers, guide technical decisions, and deliver complex engineering projects.
* **Problem-Solving Skills:** Strong analytical thinking and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with engineering and cross-functional teams.

Required Technical Skills

Java, Python, Go, Backend Development, Distributed Systems, Microservices, System Design, API Architecture, REST APIs, SQL, NoSQL Databases, Caching, Performance Optimization, Cloud Infrastructure, CI/CD, Observability, Monitoring, Logging, Automated Testing, Code Reviews, Technical Mentoring, and Engineering Best Practices.

Preferred Candidate Profile

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

**Job Description:**

**Who we are**
--------------

  
  

**About bp/team**
=================

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.

  
  

**Role Purpose**
================

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.

  
  

Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Scope & Scale**
=================

**Platform focus**

Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.

**Testing coverage**

Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.

**Non-functional quality**

Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.

**Delivery lifecycle**

Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.

**Quality engineering**

Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis**
--------------------------------------

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.

* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.

* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.

* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.

* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

**Manual & Exploratory Testing**
--------------------------------

* Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services.

* Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios.

* Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards.

* Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes.

* Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases.

**Test Automation & Continuous Testing**
----------------------------------------

* Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios.

* Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback.

* Select appropriate candidates for automation, balancing business value, stability, maintenance effort and execution speed.

* Monitor automation reliability, investigate failures and continuously improve coverage, execution time and maintainability.

**Defect Management & Quality Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Log clear, reproducible defects with evidence, business impact, severity and appropriate diagnostic information.

* Work with engineers and suppliers to triage defects, investigate root causes, validate fixes and prevent recurrence.

* Maintain transparent defect status, highlight release risks and escalate unresolved quality concerns with options.

* Analyse defect patterns, escaped defects, automation results and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.

* Contribute to retrospectives and root-cause reviews, turning lessons into stronger requirements, engineering and test practices.

**Collaboration & Quality Culture**
-----------------------------------

* Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery.

* Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions.

* Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing.

* Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets.

* Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams.

  
  

**Skills & Experience**
=======================

* Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches.

* Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability.

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent.

* Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control.

* Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.

* Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing.

* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers.

* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations.

  
  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Clear test coverage and traceability across requirements, business journeys, risks and acceptance criteria.

* Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues.

* Reliable and maintainable automated regression coverage integrated into delivery pipelines.

* Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions.

* Improved platform quality across functionality, accessibility, usability, performance, security and operability.

* Effective defect resolution and measurable reduction in repeated or escaped defects.

Strong collaboration and shared quality ownership across business, product, engineering and supplier

  
  

**About bp**
------------

  
  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. title: Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
***Job Title:*** *Azure Cloud Platform Engineer* ***Company****: Toro Technology Center India*

  
  

**Who Are We?**

The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career.

**What Will You Do?**

In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:

* Collaborate with technical leadership, architecture, security, application, data, and AI teams to design and deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective Azure platform solutions.
* Engineer and support enterprise Azure Landing Zones, management groups, subscriptions, resource organization, tagging, policy, logging, and governance patterns.
* Design and implement Azure networking and connectivity patterns, including VNets, DNS, firewalls, private endpoints, routing, and secure hybrid or enterprise connectivity.
* Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform as a core engineering tool; use Bicep and Azure Verified Modules where they provide a strong Azure-native fit.
* Develop versioned, tested, reusable IaC modules and platform patterns that standardize cloud provisioning and reduce manual deployment effort.
* Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps, including reusable workflows, environment promotion, approvals, testing, and deployment traceability.
* Implement secure cloud identity patterns using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and workload identity or OIDC-based authentication.
* Embed security and governance into engineering workflows using least privilege, Azure Policy, secure defaults, vulnerability and secret scanning, and documented exception handling.
* Build observability and operational readiness using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, dashboards, actionable alerting, runbooks, and service ownership practices.
* Own platform capabilities across their lifecycle - design, build, deployment, operations, incident response, root-cause analysis, resilience improvement, and retirement.
* Apply cloud FinOps practices including cost allocation, tagging, budgeting, forecasting, rightsizing, utilization analysis, anomaly identification, and optimization recommendations.
* Automate recurring operational and provisioning activities using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent scripting and automation techniques.
* Partner with application, data, analytics, and AI engineering teams to provide secure cloud foundations, connectivity, compute, storage, and deployment patterns for modern workloads.
* Create clear technical documentation, reference architectures, reusable examples, and knowledge-transfer material that supports consistent adoption across global teams.

**What Do You Need?**

To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps, or Platform Engineering, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, versioning, environment separation, and production deployment patterns.
* Strong experience with Azure platform services, networking, identity, security, governance, and automation.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Enterprise, including CI/CD pipelines or GitHub Actions and source-control-based engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, Azure Policy, Key Vault, private endpoints, and enterprise networking concepts.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, incident response, operational support, and reliability practices for production cloud services.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Understanding of cloud cost management and FinOps principles, including tagging, cost ownership, budgeting, rightsizing, and optimization.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Azure Well-Architected Framework, Azure Landing Zone design principles, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), SLOs, or resilience testing.
* Experience supporting cloud foundations for data, analytics, or AI workloads, including secure connectivity, compute, storage, identity, and deployment automation.
* Exposure to multi-cloud engineering patterns or AWS/GCP is beneficial; Azure remains the primary focus of this role.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), or HashiCorp Terraform Associate are preferred, but equivalent practical experience is valued.
* Experience creating reusable platform services, self-service or 'golden path' capabilities, internal developer platforms, or cloud service catalogs.

**What Can We Give You?**

At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical insurance plan many other great benefits - The Toro company offers employees , a variety of perks, including:

***Dress for your day*** - We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment.

***Location*** – Conveniently located **Baner, Pune** we are centrally located for most commuters!

***Food*** - Take advantage of our café, which serves both breakfast and lunch. You can grab a snack and a coffee at any time during your day.

***Wellness*** - The Toro Company offers complimentary use of our onsite fitness facility to employees. In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health and financial health resources to all employees.

***Volunteerism*** - The Toro Company is proud to provide employees 20 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community.

***Flexible Work Arrangements*** – This team is currently implementing a hybrid work schedule. The opportunity to collaborate in the office and work from home part-time, has promoted team-building and flexibility.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – OpenStack / Ceph / KVM
description:
**XLoud | Delhi , India | 4–8 years**

**About XLoud**

XLoud builds sovereign private cloud infrastructure on open technologies: OpenStack, KVM, Ceph and Kubernetes. We design, deploy and run production clouds for enterprises and government customers, and help them move off VMware onto open, KVM-based platforms using our own migration tooling (XMS). The engineers here own real infrastructure, from bare metal to tenant workloads.

**What you will do**

* Deploy, operate and scale production OpenStack clouds (Kolla-Ansible), including Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Octavia and Magnum.
* Handle day-2 cloud administration: availability zones, host aggregates, flavors, quotas, project/tenant management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot OpenStack services and the infrastructure underneath them: compute, networking, storage and control plane.
* Run Ceph clusters in production: OSD add/remove/recreate, flag management, PG and recovery tuning, capacity planning, and RBD/CephFS/RGW operations.
* Manage KVM/QEMU and libvirt, including CPU pinning, NUMA, huge pages, and GPU/SR-IOV passthrough for high-performance workloads.
* Execute VMware-to-KVM migrations for customers using XMS, from discovery and planning through cutover.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack (Magnum / Cluster API) for containerised and microservices workloads.
* Build automation with Bash, Python, Ansible and Terraform for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operations.
* Configure and debug networking: TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, OVS/OVN, bridging, routing, iptables, DNS and DHCP.
* Manage physical servers through iDRAC, iLO and IPMI/BMC: provisioning, firmware and hardware fault handling.
* Monitor platform health with Prometheus, Grafana and ELK/OpenSearch, and act on alerts before customers notice them.
* Apply security hardening and access controls aligned with ISO 27001 and customer compliance requirements.
* Meet SLAs and follow ITSM processes for incidents, changes and problem management.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in private cloud infrastructure, with hands-on OpenStack administration in production.
* Strong Linux administration on RHEL/Rocky and Ubuntu: installation, kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, performance analysis and upgrades.
* Hands-on Ceph operations experience.
* Solid networking fundamentals and comfort debugging at the packet level.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform).
* Ability to work directly with customer teams and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

**Good to have**

* RHCSA / RHCE, Red Hat OpenStack, or CKA certifications.
* Experience with SDN/NFV, OVN, or DPDK.
* VMware vSphere background, especially migrations off it.
* GPU infrastructure (vGPU, MIG, passthrough) for AI workloads.

title: DevOps Engineer Kafka & PostgreSQL
description:
**Company Description**

**About Mirantis**

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open-source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment — on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers.

As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to own the deployment, release, and reliability backbone of the k0rdent-ai platform — our multi-tenant control plane for enterprise GPU infrastructure. The platform’s core services — identity (Keycloak), API gateway (Kong), workflow engine (Temporal), a suite of Go APIs, and the PostgreSQL databases behind them — run on every control-plane and regional cluster we operate, and must be upgraded safely, observed continuously, and recovered quickly.

You will run this platform across both cloud Kubernetes (AWS) and bare-metal clusters in our data centers, delivering it through Helm charts and k0rdent ServiceTemplates and MultiClusterServices. Beyond day-to-day operations, a substantial focus of this role is engineering the foundations that stateful services depend on: snapshot-capable storage (CSI drivers, StorageClasses, volume snapshots), CloudNativePG backups and point-in-time recovery, and the CI/CD and bare-metal end-to-end pipelines that validate every change before it reaches customers.

Because this platform holds the record of every tenant, user, and cluster action, this role also owns its operational readiness — runbooks, restore drills, and the upgrade and rollback paths that keep a failed release from turning into data loss.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Multi-Environment Kubernetes Operations: Deploy, upgrade, and operate k0s / k0rdent-managed Kubernetes clusters on AWS and on bare-metal hardware, across a global control plane and multiple regions — cluster lifecycle, node maintenance, capacity planning, and version upgrades.
* Helm & Service Delivery: Author and maintain Helm charts and k0rdent ServiceTemplates and MultiClusterServices for core services (Keycloak, Kong, Temporal, CloudNativePG, and in-house Go APIs), including dependency ordering, health gating, versioning, and zero-downtime upgrade paths.
* Storage & Snapshot Engineering: Design and run Kubernetes storage for each environment — AWS EBS CSI in the cloud; OpenEBS LocalPV, Longhorn, or Ceph on bare metal — including StorageClasses, reclaim policies, the CSI snapshot controller, and VolumeSnapshotClasses, so stateful services can be snapshotted and restored reliably.
* Database Backup & Recovery: Operate CloudNativePG backup and recovery end to end — scheduled volume snapshots, continuous WAL archiving to object storage, point-in-time recovery, and replica clusters — with defined RPO/RTO targets and regular restore drills.
* CI/CD & End-to-End Testing: Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for linting, chart unit tests, artifact packaging and publishing to OCI registries, and on-demand bare-metal end-to-end environments; keep them fast, reliable, and easy to debug.
* GitOps & Infrastructure as Code: Maintain a strictly declarative infrastructure-as-code (IaC) culture using Terraform and Argo CD (or Flux), keeping every environment — from developer labs to production — reproducible and reviewable through code.
* Observability & Incident Response: Build monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for service health, database replication and backup status, and capacity; join the on-call rotation, lead troubleshooting, and drive post-incident improvements.
* Security & Air-Gapped Delivery: Manage TLS and certificate lifecycle (cert-manager), secrets, network policies, and least-privilege RBAC, and support private-registry and air-gapped installations for sovereign customers.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

**Must Have**

* Platform Experience: 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 3+ years operating production Kubernetes for business-critical services.
* Kubernetes Depth: Strong grasp of Kubernetes primitives — workloads and StatefulSets, operators and CRDs, persistent volumes and CSI storage, RBAC, and network policies — with hands-on experience upgrading and troubleshooting clusters in production.
* Helm & Release Engineering: Hands-on authoring of non-trivial Helm charts — templating, values design, chart dependencies, and testing with helm-unittest or chart-testing. Experience with k0rdent, Cluster API, or a multi-cluster delivery tool (Argo CD ApplicationSets, Fleet, Sveltos) is preferred, but what matters is depth with Helm, not the specific delivery tool.
* Kubernetes Storage: Practical experience with CSI drivers, StorageClasses, and volume snapshots — AWS EBS CSI preferred, but equivalent experience with Longhorn, Ceph (Rook), OpenEBS, or another cloud CSI driver is acceptable. What matters is understanding how storage behaves when pods, nodes, and clusters fail.
* PostgreSQL on Kubernetes: Hands-on experience running PostgreSQL through a Kubernetes operator — CloudNativePG (CNPG) preferred, but Zalando’s postgres-operator, Crunchy PGO, or a comparable operator is acceptable — including backups, restores, and point-in-time recovery.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Production experience in AWS (EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, S3; EKS a plus); equivalent GCP or Azure experience also counts.
* CI/CD & Automation: Designing and maintaining GitHub Actions (or GitLab CI) pipelines, with solid scripting in Bash plus Python or Go (Golang).
* Collaboration: Clear written and spoken English and comfort working across time zones, with regular overlap with US and European teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with bare-metal provisioning (Metal3, Ironic, PXE) and GPU or AI infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Kong Gateway or the Kubernetes Gateway API, and Keycloak / OIDC identity integration.
* Experience operating Temporal or other workflow engines in production.
* Experience delivering software into air-gapped or sovereign environments using private registries and mirrored artifacts.
* Experience designing cross-region disaster recovery for stateful services, including RPO/RTO trade-off decisions.
* Certifications such as CKA / CKS or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional — a plus.
* Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects (Helm charts, Kubernetes operators, CNCF projects) — a huge plus.

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science & Engineering (or a related field), or 8+ years of equivalent related experience.

 **Additional Information**

**We offer:**

* Operate some of the most advanced AI infrastructure environments in production today.
* Work with the latest NVIDIA GPU technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and high-performance networking environments.
* Help define operational standards and reliability practices for next-generation AI infrastructure services.
* Influence the adoption of AI-powered operational capabilities through k0rdent AI.
* Work alongside highly skilled engineers solving complex infrastructure and platform challenges at scale.
* Join a growing organisation investing heavily in AI infrastructure, platform services, and operational innovation.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description: DescriptionAmazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.Key job responsibilitiesAs an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.

Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.

Key Responsibilities

**Platform Engineering & Reliability:** Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.

**CI/CD & Release Engineering:** Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: AI Data Engineer
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform, the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media & entertainment company. We stream 650+ Bengali movies, 185+ originals, and 3000+ hours of content to an audience of ~250 million Bengalis worldwide. We're part of the wider SVF ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.

We are scaling our AI ambitions through a company-wide push to embed AI into how all we operate, anchored by a dedicated AI brain.

**What you'll do :**

hoichoi already runs a comprehensive data setup for consumer and content data. As AI at hoichoi expands, that same architecture needs to extend to cover it too — including turning unstructured content into knowledge that in-house AI agents and applications can actually use.

You'll own the day-to-day health of that data: schemas, availability, and fixing what breaks, working in close, daily contact with our engineering team and in direct support of the AI team.

* Process data requests from other teams — building views and data-set bundles for analytics use.
* Own day-to-day data hygiene: schema health, data availability, and fixing breakages as they occur.
* Work in close, daily contact with the engineering team; this is a high-involvement, high-contact role by design.
* Support the AI team with AI-ready data — including embeddings/vector pipelines, chunking, and handling unstructured content (video metadata, subtitles, synopses, thumbnails) — alongside your core data engineering work.
* Help extend hoichoi's existing data architecture to adopt new methodologies around transforming structured and unstructured data into knowledge consumed by in-house AI agents and applications as it grows.
* Build and maintain orchestration/transformation pipelines and streaming or event-ingestion pipelines (clickstream, CDC) that keep data flowing reliably.
* Own data governance and PII handling for consumer data, in line with DPDP Act compliance.

**Must have qualifications :**

* 2–6 years of experience in data engineering, with hands-on schema and pipeline work.
* Strong SQL fluency.
* Comfortable owning data hygiene end-to-end — not just building pipelines, but fixing what breaks in them.
* Experience with modern analytics/data technologies — ClickHouse, MongoDB, Postgres, or similar modern RDBMS/NoSQL databases.
* Experience with orchestration/transformation tooling (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or equivalent) and streaming/event-ingestion pipelines (Kafka, CDC, clickstream).
* AI-first by default — you actively use AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) in your own work rather than defaulting to hand-coding everything, with at least one end-to-end example where AI generated significant code you debugged or overrode. This matters more to us than raw years of experience.
* Awareness of data governance, PII handling, and DPDP Act compliance — this role touches consumer data directly.
* Should stay on top of the latest Data & AI technology trends, and work closely with the AI and technology teams to bring relevant ones in.

**Good to have :**

* Experience in a media, streaming, or content platform environment.
* Exposure to preparing or structuring data specifically for AI/ML use cases.
* Excellent knowledge of modern data concepts — self-healing data pipelines, Knowledge Graphs, Ontologies.
* Data-quality/observability tooling experience (tests, monitoring, schema-drift alerting).
* Any relevant AI certifications (e.g., Anthropic Claude certifications) or data engineering/AI certifications from major hyperscalers.

**Culture & How We Work**

At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

+ Error handling
+ Retry mechanisms
+ Reprocessing
+ Alerting
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation
+ Audit trail mechanisms

* Participate in technical design reviews and ensure interfaces meet enterprise integration architecture standards.
* Prepare and maintain technical/interface specification documents covering end-to-end integration from source system through middleware to target system.

+ Source and target systems
+ Interface direction
+ Business triggers
+ Data structures and mappings
+ Transformation rules
+ Frequency and volumes
+ Authentication/security
+ Error handling
+ Reprocessing
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation
+ Dependencies
+ Batch scheduling

* Participate in interface migration and deployment activities across SAP development, quality, validation, and production environments.
* Support cutover planning, interface activation/deactivation, data synchronization, and post-go-live stabilization.

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP interface/integration development.

* Strong knowledge of IDoc/ALE, RFC, BAPI, OData, REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, and API technologies.

* Knowledge of SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF) is desirable.
* Experience with integration monitoring and error-handling frameworks.
* Understanding of certificate management, OAuth, Basic Authentication, SAML, API keys, encryption, and secure communication protocols.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP and API Management is preferred.
* Understanding of event-driven integration, Event Mesh, or similar technologies is an advantage.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles and API-first integration architecture is preferred.

* Minimum 8+ years of overall SAP technical/integration experience.
* Significant hands-on experience in SAP interface design, development, testing, and production support.
* Experience working in SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, transformation, or support programs.
* Greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation experience is preferred.
* Experience integrating SAP with multiple enterprise and third-party applications.
* Experience working with geographically distributed functional, technical, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
* Pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical device, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Associate – Integration Developer / SAP Integration Suite certification.
* SAP BTP-related certification.

* Other relevant SAP technical/integration certifications.

**Key Success Measures**

* Delivery of stable, secure, scalable, and maintainable SAP interfaces.

* Compliance with SAP Clean Core and enterprise architecture principles.
* Successful completion of required testing and validation activities.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Saleshandy)
description:
**Experience:** 5-7 years

**About Saleshandy**
--------------------

Saleshandy is how thousands of sales teams around the world find their next customer and reach them. A lead database of **850+ million contacts**. Email sequences and mailbox warmup running continuously across tens of thousands of inboxes. Analytics that has to be correct the moment someone looks at it.

Every one of those is a systems problem before it's a product problem, and that's where the interesting work is. Searching hundreds of millions of records in under a second. Processing event streams that can't lose or double-count a message. Building interfaces that stay fast when the dataset behind them only ever grows.

We're hiring a Tech Lead to own a significant part of that surface, and the engineers who build it.

**What's the Role About**
-------------------------

You'll lead a team of engineers working across the stack, and you'll still be one of the **strongest engineers** on it. You take the hardest problem of the quarter yourself, you're in the design reviews catching what everyone else missed, and you own the architectural direction for everything your team touches.

You'll also own something less visible and worth more: that there is **one right way** to do the things that have to be correct. One approach to retries and failure recovery. One source of truth for the numbers customers see. Defined once and inherited, instead of five engineers each arriving at a slightly different, slightly wrong version of it.

Three things matter more than the title you held before:

* **Technical direction.** You can hold the whole system in your head and say where it's going. You make the call between queue and stream, between a new service and a boundary in an existing one, and you can defend it on trade-offs rather than preference.
* **Force multiplication.** Your result isn't what you shipped, it's what the team shipped and how much better they got doing it. You know where every engineer stands, you deal with a performance problem when you see it rather than when the calendar says to, and you're the reason the strong ones stay and people grows.
* **High agency.** You act when the spec is unclear instead of waiting for someone to decide for you. Work doesn't stall on your side waiting on another team, you go and unblock it. You stay on the hook for what you ship until it actually works in production, not until it's merged.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the architectural direction across your surfaces, and the trade-offs behind every call
* Design and ship the hardest work yourself, you stay a builder
* Run design reviews that catch races, partial failures, and everything that only breaks at volume
* Define the shared patterns your team inherits, and consolidate the ones that got built twice
* Own operability: what you ship is observable, alerted, and runnable by more than one person
* Grow the engineers on your team, and give leadership an honest, evidence-backed read on each of them
* Run interview loops and make the call on who joins
* Own a customer-facing metric, and cut the work that isn't moving it
* Use AI coding agents as a core part of the workflow, and own the quality bar that keeps their output honest

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **Distributed systems experience that's real.** Services that stay correct when they fail halfway and get retried. Event pipelines that don't lose or duplicate work. You can defend your choice of queue, stream, or store instead of reaching for whichever is fashionable.
* **Data at volume.** MySQL that holds up under genuine load, schema, indexing, and finding the query that's quietly costing you. Search and analytics at scale with OpenSearch or ClickHouse. Caching as a deliberate decision, not a reflex.
* **Credibility across the stack.** You review a data-heavy React surface's state architecture as seriously as you review a service boundary. You don't need to out-build your specialists; you do need to recognise the design that will hurt in six months.
* **You can run what you ship.** Containerised deploys, CI/CD, and production observability. When something is intermittently timing out, you find it in traces and metrics rather than guessing.
* **AI fluency with judgment.** You use coding agents daily, and you've thought about what breaks when an entire team does and put something in place for it.
* **A track record with people.** Engineers you've led who got measurably better, and who you can talk about specifically.

**Our stack****:** Node.js, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, OpenSearch, React, Docker, AWS, Grafana/Tempo/Loki.

**Nice to have, not required:** ClickHouse, MongoDB, Terraform. You'll pick these up here if you haven't used them.  
https://stackshare.io/saleshandy/saleshandy

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* **Purpose:** You'll own a core part of a product used every working day by thousands of sales teams, at a scale, 850 million records, continuous delivery infrastructure, real-time analytics, you can't get at most companies.
* **Growth:** This is the seat that leads to Staff Engineer or Engineering Manager here, depending on which half of it you find you love. You'll find out which one you are.
* **Leverage:** We're serious about AI-first engineering. You'll set how an entire team works with coding agents, not just how you do.
* **Ownership:** Architectural direction, a customer metric, and the team. Not a ticket-routing role with a senior title.

**Culture Fit, Are You One of Us**
----------------------------------

* You still write code :)
* You use AI as a multiplier.
* You don't wait for permission on the calls you can reverse, you make them, write down why, and keep moving.
* You get genuine satisfaction out of someone else levelling up.
* You'll tell someone their design is wrong, or that they aren't growing, in a way they can actually hear.
* You raise a "yellow" early, and you thank the people who do the same.
* You debug with traces, logs, and metrics, never with guesswork.
* You'd rather define the right pattern once than personally fix the same bug five times.

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

Techjays is an AI engineering and technology consulting firm headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with delivery teams in Coimbatore and Chennai, India.

We are setting up a managed operations team in India to support a US-based B2B SaaS CRM platform. The platform runs on physical servers in a colocation data center rather than on a public cloud such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

The data center provider handles hardware break-fix support, while our team owns day-to-day operations, including infrastructure and platform administration, security and releases, and SQL Server databases.

As Senior Database Engineer, you will own the SQL Server environment behind the platform. You will keep databases available, backed up, and performing efficiently; troubleshoot performance issues; and plan upgrades and high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) changes. You will also review and deploy database changes associated with application releases.

You will work closely with the Infrastructure and Platform Operations Manager, the Infrastructure Security and Release Operations Lead, and the client's engineering team on schema and query changes.

**Key Responsibilities**

·   Administer production and non-production SQL Server instances, including installation, configuration, patching, and version upgrades.

·   Run and test backups and restores, ensuring recovery point and recovery time objectives are met.

·   Manage high availability and disaster recovery using Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, or log shipping, and conduct failover tests.

·   Monitor database health, identify slow queries, blocking, and deadlocks, and tune queries and indexes.

·   Plan and perform index maintenance, statistics updates, and database integrity checks (DBCC) while minimizing customer impact.

·   Review and deploy schema changes and data scripts as part of releases, with rollback steps prepared in advance.

·   Manage logins, roles, permissions, encryption, and auditing in line with security and compliance requirements.

·   Track storage growth and plan capacity as data volumes grow across tenants.

·   Respond to database incidents as part of the on-call rotation and document root causes and corrective actions.

·   Maintain database runbooks, configuration records, and disaster recovery procedures.

**Must-Have Requirements**

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI for CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models are used alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so quality is judged by clinical performance and reliability, not benchmark scores.

As a Junior AI Engineer, you will own scoped model workstreams (data, training, evaluation and error analysis) under the guidance of senior AI engineers, and support the move of validated models into production. Medical-imaging experience is welcome but not required; serious hands-on deep-learning work is.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

● Model development. Train, fine-tune and evaluate CNN- and transformer-based models for classification, detection and segmentation, starting from strong baselines and running disciplined, reproducible experiments.

● Scoped ownership. Own a defined model workstream under senior review, from dataset preparation through training, validation, documentation and hand-off.

● Data pipelines. Build and maintain DICOM pipelines for ingestion, de-identification, series selection, pre-processing, augmentation, annotation handling and dataset versioning.

● Evaluation and error analysis. Report clinical metrics (sensitivity, specificity, PPV/NPV, ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, per-case and per-lesion), analyse false positives and negatives by subgroup, and explain why the model fails.

● Radiologist collaboration. Work with radiologists (US, Indian certified) to define labels, review difficult cases and turn clinical feedback into measurable model improvements.

● Production support. Contribute to packaging validated models as tested inference services (Python, Docker, FastAPI), including unit and regression tests that confirm changes do not alter clinical outputs. Senior engineers lead serving architecture, optimisation and deployment.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

● Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

● Experience. 2-4 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering or research experience, including deep-learning work beyond coursework, tutorials, notebooks or API wrappers.

● Proof of building. At least one substantial computer-vision system or research contribution that you personally drove into a reproducible pipeline, service or real downstream use, and can defend in technical depth.

● Programming. Strong Python and NumPy, and deep hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras. Able to debug data loaders, leakage, incorrect metrics and unstable training.

● Fundamentals. Solid grounding in deep learning and computer vision (CNNs, vision transformers, detection, segmentation, transfer learning) and in statistics and experimental design (ROC/PR analysis, thresholds, calibration).

● Engineering basics. Linux, Git, clean modular Python, Docker, pytest and basic CI/CD.

Good-to-have:

● Medical imaging. Experience with DICOM/NIfTI, MONAI or nnU-Net.

● Production exposure. Model serving with FastAPI, ONNX/TensorRT, and experiment tracking with MLflow or Weights & Biases.

● LLMs and cloud. Exposure to LLMs, embeddings or RAG, and to one of AWS, Azure or GCP. These add to, but do not replace, core deep-learning skills.

**Key Skills:**

Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow / Keras | NumPy | OpenCV | scikit-learn | CNNs | Vision Transformers | Detection | Segmentation | DICOM / NIfTI | Clinical Metrics | Error Analysis | Git | Linux | Docker | FastAPI | pytest | MLflow / Weights & Biases

**Why Join Daignostix:**

● Real clinical AI. Build models for real medical-imaging workflows and see how they affect radiologists and patients.

● Direct access to radiologists. Work closely with subspecialist radiologists (US, Indian certified) on ground truth, difficult cases and failure analysis.

● Mentorship with ownership. Senior technical review, dedicated on-premise GPU infrastructure, and visibility across development, deployment, clinical validation and regulatory pathways.
