title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**Job Description**
6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and creating an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to.
  
  
You'll work across the full journey from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions—including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security.
  
  
6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B. Agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Agents and Orchestration
  
  

* Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human-in-the-loop steps.
* Choose among routing, orchestrator-worker, plan-and-execute, reflection, and multi-agent handoff patterns based on the problem.
* Run agents headless—API- and MCP-first—across in-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from one shared core.
* Maintain reusable components for state, memory, tool-calling, and agent-to-agent delegation with scoped permissions.

APIs, Tools, and MCP
  
  

* Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to read 6sense data and take action, for both human and LLM callers.
* Tune tool design for agent success, including names, descriptions, schemas, response shapes, error messages, and token-efficient outputs.
* Redesign and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, and graceful degradation, while maintaining backward compatibility and adopting new specification capabilities as they mature.
* Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Write integration guides and reference clients, and define how 6sense consumes third-party MCP servers, including trust boundaries.
* Harden execution with idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, and spend controls. Maintain standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery.

Context and Evaluation
  
  

* Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context to agents through MCP, APIs, and tools, ensuring one context layer serves every surface. Establish contracts defining what each call returns, how fresh the information is, where it comes from, and how it is scoped to the tenant and user.
* Improve permission-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, and citations. Optimize context assembly and memory within token and latency limits.
* Extend evaluation using golden datasets, tool-selection and tool-call accuracy, end-to-end task success, regression suites, and release gates, including context-quality measures.
* Expand tracing and usage analytics, and report on task success rate, tool-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost per successful outcome.

Security, Privacy, and Trust
  
  

* Make security a first consideration in every tool, API, agent, and MCP change, and review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities.
* Enforce tenant isolation and user-level authorization on every call so agents never access data beyond the caller's permissions. Maintain short-lived, scoped credentials.
* Defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agency, and data leakage through tool outputs, traces, and logs. Set runtime limits on steps, tokens, time, and cost.

Customers and Engineering Craft
  
  

* Triage and debug customer-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems, identify root causes, and deliver fixes.
* Participate in customer and partner technical calls, and support enablement teams with guidance, demos, and documentation.
* Write design documents that clearly explain assumptions and trade-offs, review code and designs, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and participate in on-call rotations and incident response.
* Track developments in MCP, agent frameworks, and model capabilities. Prototype promising technologies and provide short, evidence-backed recommendations.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience building and running production software, with strong distributed-systems fundamentals, including idempotency, fault tolerance, backpressure, and failure recovery.
* 2+ years of experience building production LLM-based systems, including agents used by real customers.
* Strong Python skills and production experience with LangGraph or an equivalent orchestration framework.
* Experience designing APIs and tool interfaces for LLM callers, including schemas, descriptions, error handling, and tool-selection behavior. Direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience scaling an API or platform used by external customers or partners, including authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Production experience with retrieval and grounding, as well as writing and running LLM evaluations.
* Experience with multi-tenant, security-sensitive cloud systems, preferably AWS, including authorization boundaries and data-leakage prevention.
* Experience debugging production issues across services and supporting customers directly or through support and solutions teams.
* A track record of owning multi-month, cross-team projects independently and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building or operating MCP servers in production, or contributing to MCP open-source projects.
* Experience serving context to agents from signals, entity data, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience integrating with external agent platforms or AI assistants as a partner, or working with agent interoperability protocols.
* Experience with B2B go-to-market, RevTech, CRM, or intent-data platforms.
* Experience with model routing, caching, and cost/latency optimization.
* Experience with Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or Spark.

What This Role Is Not
  
  

* Not an architect role: You'll set direction through working code and design documents.
* Not MCP-only: MCP sits alongside APIs, tools, and orchestration.
* Not a greenfield build: These systems are live, with real customers depending on them.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

title: Sr AI Agent Engineer
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building 
****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. Our work spans alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data. We build AI systems intended for real-world deployment, where transparency, auditability, and robustness are first-class constraints.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

****The Role****

We are building a 
****high-autonomy AI Engineering Agent****

 that can execute end-to-end AI engineering workflows on top of the Lexsi backend. The system is designed to reason over complex objectives, plan multi-step actions, interact with tools and data systems, evaluate outcomes, and iterate over long horizons while remaining interpretable and aligned.

As a 
****Sr AI Agent Engineer****

, you will be responsible for defining and building the core agent architecture. You will make foundational decisions about how the agent reasons, plans and executes actions, maintains memory and state, and has its decisions inspected and explained. This role requires deep hands-on engineering and the ability to operate in ambiguous environments with ownership from day one.

****What You’ll Build****

* ****End-to-end AI Engineering Agents****

   that can autonomously perform tasks such as experiment design, evaluation, analysis, and reporting, rather than merely assisting a human in these workflows.
* ****Harness Engineering:****

   Able to design and maintain complex harness components that support agents' scale exponentially for complex tasks.
* ****Agent architectures that combine reasoning, planning, tool orchestration, and memory****

  , with explicit handling of long-horizon execution, partial failures, and self-correction.
* ****Deep integrations with the Lexsi backend****

  , including internal evaluation systems, data pipelines, and alignment tooling, as well as enterprise APIs and proprietary data sources.
* ****Agents designed for enterprise and regulated environments****

  , where every action, decision, and output must be inspectable, explainable, and defensible.

****Responsibilities****

* ****Own the architecture and implementation of the AI Engineering Agent****

  , making early design decisions around planners, reasoning loops, memory models, and execution control that will shape the system long-term.
* ****Build robust tool orchestration and execution layers****

  , ensuring the agent can interact reliably with internal services, external APIs, and data systems, and recover gracefully from failures.
* ****Design and implement memory and state management****

  , enabling agents to operate across long-running tasks, retain relevant context, and reason over past actions and outcomes.
* ****Embed alignment, safety, and interpretability into the system design****

  , working closely with research teams to ensure that agent behavior is auditable and controllable by construction.
* ****Stress-test agent behavior in real-world conditions****

  , identifying edge cases, failure modes, and distribution shifts, and iterating on the system to improve reliability and correctness.
* ****Set a high engineering bar****

  , contributing to design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision-making with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

****Requirements****

* ****Significant experience building and shipping complex AI or ML-heavy systems****

  , where you have owned architecture and seen systems evolve in production, not just prototypes.
* ****Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and frameworks****

  , such as ReAct-style agents, AutoGPT-like systems, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar, with a clear understanding of their limitations and failure modes.
* ****Strong backend engineering fundamentals****

  , including advanced Python proficiency, experience building APIs and services, and familiarity with databases, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
* ****A systems-thinking mindset****

  , with the ability to reason about performance, reliability, cost, safety, and interpretability as interconnected design constraints.
* ****Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments****

  , where problems are loosely specified and ownership is expected rather than assigned.

****Strong Bonus Signals****

* Experience building 
  ****long-horizon or stateful agent systems****

   that must reason over time rather than single-turn interactions.
* Prior exposure to 
  ****AI alignment, interpretability, or safety tooling****

  , especially in production or enterprise settings.
* Experience working in 
  ****regulated or high-stakes domains****

  , where system behavior must be explained and audited after deployment.
* A track record of debugging and improving systems that behaved unpredictably in the real world.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

title: Applied AI ML Senior Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Join a world-class data science team at JPMorgan Chase and help shape the future of our Chief Administrative Office.
  
  
As a Data Scientist Senior Associate in the Chief Data & Analytics Office, you will lead the development and deployment of innovative AI and machine learning solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to address complex business challenges, drive adoption of modern ML practices, and ensure responsible AI governance. You will have the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art technologies and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the hands-on design, development, and deployment of advanced AI, GenAI, and large language model solutions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on a wide range of machine learning techniques and optimizations.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, production-ready AI systems.
* Conduct experiments using the latest ML technologies, analyze results, and tune models for optimal performance.
* Own end-to-end code development in Python for both proof-of-concept and production-ready solutions.
* Integrate generative AI within the ML platform using state-of-the-art techniques.
* Drive adoption of modern ML infrastructure, tools, and best practices.
* Optimize system accuracy and performance by identifying and resolving inefficiencies.
* Communicate technical concepts and results to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ensure responsible AI practices, model governance, and compliance with regulatory standards.
* Mentor and guide other AI engineers and scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, including generative AI, large language models, or foundation models.
* Experience programming in Python; experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Proven experience designing, training, and deploying large-scale ML/AI models in production environments.
* Deep understanding of prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and distributed systems (Kubernetes, Ray, Slurm).
* Solid grasp of MLOps tools and practices (MLflow, model monitoring, CI/CD for ML).
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated leadership in working effectively with engineers, product managers, and other ML practitioners.
* Experience applying data science and ML techniques to solve business problems and passion for detail, follow-through, and technical excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Experience with high-performance computing and GPU infrastructure (e.g., NVIDIA DCGM, Triton Inference).
* Familiarity with big data processing tools and cloud data services.
* Advanced knowledge in reinforcement learning, meta learning, or related advanced ML areas.
* Experience with search/ranking, recommender systems, or graph techniques.
* Background in financial services or regulated industries.
* Experience with building and deploying ML models on cloud platforms such as AWS Sagemaker, EKS, etc.
* Published research or contributions to open-source GenAI/LLM projects.

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Job Description - Sr. Gen AI Engineer / Lead Gen AI Engineer

Location - Bengaluru/Gurgaon/Hyderabad/Chennai/Noida/Pune/Mumbai

Work Mode- Hybrid

About Us

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance.

The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM’s 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world’s leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025 Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on Sr. Gen AI Engineer / Lead Gen AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade Generative AI applications. In this dual-impact role, you will act as a primary individual contributor architecting core AI engines while simultaneously leading engineers through task allocation, code reviews, and technical mentorship. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between state-of-the-art AI research (LLMs, Agentic frameworks, Advanced RAG, OCR) and production-grade full-stack engineering (Python, FastAPI, React).

Key Responsibilities

* **Generative AI & Agentic Systems:**
  Architect, build, and optimize LLM-powered applications, multi-agent workflows (e.g., CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph), and autonomous AI agents.
* **RAG & Document Intelligence:**
  Design and deploy advanced RAG architectures and document processing pipelines utilizing OCR techniques (e.g., LayoutLM, PaddleOCR, Tesseract, Azure Document Intelligence) and Vision LLMs to extract structured data.
* **Backend Microservices:**
  Build robust, asynchronous, high-throughput microservices and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
* **Frontend Integration:**
  Collaborate on or build modern web interfaces using React (e.g., Control Towers, operations dashboards, interactive chat interfaces).
* **MLOps & Infrastructure:**
  Oversee model deployment, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, vector database integration (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, PGVector), and cloud infrastructure setup (Azure/AWS).
* **Technical Oversight:**
  Lead a team of AI, backend, and full-stack engineers; allocate tasks, establish sprint priorities, and ensure timely delivery.
* **Conduct rigorous code reviews:**
  To maintain high engineering standards, security, performance, and scalability across AI and full-stack codebases.

Required Experience and Qualifications

* **Overall Experience:**
  6 to 9 years of professional software engineering experience.
* **AI/ML Domain Experience:**
  3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML, OCR, and Generative AI solutions in production.
* **Core Technical Stack:**
* **Generative AI & LLMs:**
  Extensive experience with commercial and open-source LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama), Agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI), and LLM evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, TruLens, RAGAS).
* **RAG & Unstructured Data:**
  Strong knowledge of hybrid search, re-ranking, chunking strategies, vector databases, and document intelligence workflows.
* **OCR & Vision Techniques:**
  Hands-on experience with OCR engines (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, Azure Document Intelligence) and Multi-Modal/Vision LLMs.
* **Backend:**
  Deep expertise in Python and asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI, AsyncIO).
* **Frontend:**
  Working proficiency in React (TypeScript/JavaScript) for building interactive web UI components.
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure / AWS), Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

Recognition & Achievements

* We have been recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest’s North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM’s Pema Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025.
* In Nov 2023, Straive acquired Gramener, an award-winning, design-led data science company, enhancing our data, analytics, and AI capabilities. In June 2025, we acquired SG Analytics, a leading provider of AI-powered insights and contextual analytics services.

For more information, please visit our Website
https://www.straive.com/

Join Us Today

**Ready to make an impact? Join Straive and redefine the future of business and technology, where you can thrive and lead.**

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status."*

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Photos
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Detection Engineer – Early Career**
=====================================

  
  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

description:

* Experience developing automated tests using Python, PyTest, GoogleTest, or similar frameworks.

* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.

* Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto-based systems.
* Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level automated testing.
* Familiarity with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, and Bash.
* Experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with optical measurement systems, instrumentation products, or related industrial devices.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong ownership mindset with a passion for product quality and customer satisfaction.
* Curious, hands-on, and eager to learn new technologies and domains.
* Structured and detail-oriented approach to testing and problem solving.
* Collaborative team player with strong communication and influencing skills.

* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human sized organization where you’ll have contact beyond the R&D department.

title: AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

#### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Bangalore, India (**On-site**)  
**Contract type:** Employee  
**Target start date:** Early January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time  
**Compensation:** Between ₹22–34 LPA

#### **What You'll Architect**

As an **AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining **business analysis, data, AI-enabled ways of working, and human decision-making**.

Working closely with **business stakeholders and digital delivery teams**, you will help identify the real problem behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively and **translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.** You will also bring a practical **AI-first approach** to your work, exploring how **AI and Generative AI can accelerate analysis, improve processes and help teams** validate solutions more effectively.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the **intersection of business, data and technology**, and who is curious about better ways to turn ideas into outcomes.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand **processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes**.
* Translate business needs into **clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria** for digital delivery teams.
* Challenge requirements constructively to ensure teams solve the **right business problem**, rather than simply implementing requested features.
* Act as the bridge between **business stakeholders and technical delivery teams**, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply an **AI-first mindset** to identify opportunities where **AI and GenAI can accelerate analysis, improve requirements quality, support prototyping, or optimise business processes**.
* Leverage AI tools as part of your daily work to increase speed, quality, and effectiveness in analysis and documentation.
* Help teams rapidly explore and validate alternative approaches rather than defaulting to traditional solutions.
* Understand and consider **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance implications** when shaping requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with distributed teams across **France, Spain, India, and the Philippines**.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders through an active on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are naturally curious and constantly looking for better ways to solve business problems.
* You do not see AI as a separate capability. Instead, you instinctively think **AI-first**, using AI tools to improve analysis, accelerate delivery, and challenge traditional ways of working.
* You enjoy understanding business processes, questioning assumptions, and uncovering the underlying problems that need to be solved.
* You are comfortable working between **business** and **technical teams,** helping both sides reach clarity and alignment.
* You are a**nalytical and structured**, but also p**ragmatic and focused** on outcomes.
* You are **confident challenging stakeholders constructively** when requirements, assumptions, or proposed solutions can be improved.
* You **thrive in collaborative and international environments** and enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and functions.
* You are **self-directed, take ownership of your work, and are comfortable operating autonomously** within a global organisation.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with both business users and technical teams.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

##### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Business Analyst experience with **strong data / CRM / Salesforce exposure**.
* Experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.
* Experience producing high-quality **user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria**.
* Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including business stakeholders, developers, product teams, and data specialists.
* Experience operating within international or distributed organisations.
* Professional proficiency in **English**.
* Able to work **on-site in Bangalore.**

##### **Technical & Professional Skills**

* Excellent **requirements engineering and business analysis capabilities**.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business challenges into clear and actionable delivery requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working closely with technical delivery teams and understanding technology constraints and opportunities.
* Practical experience using **AI and GenAI tools** to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, requirements engineering, or delivery effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of the value AI can bring to business analysis, process optimisation, and solution design.
* Ability to challenge both business and technical stakeholders constructively.
* Understanding of **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance principles**.
* Comfortable working autonomously while managing multiple stakeholder relationships.

##### **Particularly Valuable Experience**

* Experience using tools such as **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot for Microsoft 365, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar LLM-based assistants** to improve analysis, documentation, problem-solving, and delivery workflows.
* Ability to demonstrate how AI meaningfully changes and improves your approach to business analysis rather than simply using AI occasionally.

##### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with **data-intensive applications**, analytics platforms, or data transformation programmes.
* Understanding of **data governance, data lifecycle management, and data quality frameworks**.
* Experience in a **Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar hybrid role**.
* Exposure to **industrial, manufacturing, energy, or services environments**.
* Experience working in **Agile product delivery environments**.
* Familiarity with using AI to support **requirements engineering, business analysis, solution exploration, documentation, or rapid prototyping**.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on **understanding the business problem** before defining the solution.
* You use **AI naturally as part of your workflow**, enabling faster analysis, better requirements, and more informed decision-making.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and help stakeholders explore alternatives that may create greater value.
* You balance business needs, technical realities, and delivery constraints to arrive at practical solutions.
* You can move **comfortably** between **strategic conversations** anddetailed **requirements definition**.
* You **build trust with stakeholders** through clear communication, curiosity, and consistent delivery.
* You understand that requirements are rarely perfect on day one and are comfortable working through ambiguity to create clarity.
* You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, accelerate delivery, and **enhance outcomes through AI-enabled approaches.**
* You contribute to collective intelligence by **sharing knowledge,** **encouraging better ways of working**, and **helping teams become more effective.**
* You combine the mindset of a **Business Analyst, Product Analyst, and AI practitioner**, using technology not as an end goal, but as a way to solve meaningful business challenges.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus India**

* **Hybrid work** model (3 days/week in office)
* **18 paid leaves** + 9 public holidays
* **₹5L** medical insurance + **₹10L** accident insurance
* Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
* International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
* Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Referral Bonus Scheme
* Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

️ **Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

#### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic..

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Gov.
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 5-7 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.
* Extensive Travel:The role is based out of Bangalore and requires extensive travel across various states in India, depending on project and business requirements.

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (5-7) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Good data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Passion to write code and build solutions.
* Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a senior, hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Senior Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: Design and implement secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: Architect and integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Technical leadership: Define standards, review code and designs, mentor engineers and work closely with architects, vendors and business stakeholders.

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 7+ years (recommended) in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform – Expert level: Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Expert level: Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - Advanced: REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - Advanced: MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - Advanced: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - Advanced: IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Senior, hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: Strong background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with a strong back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Advanced Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Solid data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, data modelling, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Hands-on technical leader who still writes code and builds solutions.
* Strong architectural thinking, balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Drives large initiatives with ownership, structure and focus on outcomes.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Mentors and raises the technical level of the team.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Senior Test Engineer, IMS & AI Communication Products
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Test Engineer with 5-6 years of experience in testing IMS-based telecom products and next-generation AI-powered communication applications, including Voice Translation, Speech Processing, Conversational AI, and Real-Time Media platforms

**Key Responsibilities**

**IMS & Telecom Testing**

* Perform functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing of IMS-based products.
* Validate end-to-end call flows across IMS network elements.
* Analyze and troubleshoot telecom signaling and media issues.
* Execute interoperability testing with various IMS components and network elements.
* Perform capacity, load, scalability, failover, resiliency, and soak testing.

**AI Product Testing**

* Test AI-powered communication products such as:
  + Voice Translation
  + Speech-to-Text (STT)
  + Text-to-Speech (TTS)
  + Conversational AI / Voice Bots

**Automation & Cloud-Native Testing**

* Develop test scripts for validating APIs, SIP call flows, and media scenarios.
* Execute testing in Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.

**Protocol & Media Validation**

* Analyze SIP traces using Wireshark, HOMER, or equivalent tools.
* Validate RTP, SRTP, RTCP media flows.

Review logs, packet captures, and KPIs to identify product defects

* **IMS Network Elements:** SBC, TAS/Application Server, MRF, IMS Core Components

Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.

title: Support Engineer
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Full-time

**About the job**
-----------------

**About Signeasy**

**Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.**

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

  

**Your role**

As our Support Engineer, you'll be part of the Customer Support team and the technical voice of Signeasy for our customers. You'll resolve the issues that need more than a help article: API errors, integration failures, SSO setups, mobile app, and tricky account problems. You'll handle tickets end to end and get on calls with our enterprise and API customers when a conversation works better than an email thread.

You'll be the bridge between customers and our engineering team. When something is broken, you'll reproduce it, find the root cause where you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-documented ticket. When something is confusing, you'll fix it at the source with better docs, macros, and product feedback.

If you enjoy digging into logs, love the moment a stubborn issue finally clicks, and care about leaving every customer better off than you found them, you'll find a lot to love here.

  

**What you'll do**

**Ticket resolution**

* Own tickets across email, chat, and phone, from first response to resolution, within our support SLAs
* Take escalations from the frontline team and resolve complex issues across our web app, iOS and Android apps, eSign API, and Intelligent Contract Management
* Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools our customers rely on
* Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates, and manage expectations on timelines and workarounds

**Enterprise and API customers**

* Join calls with enterprise and API customers to debug live issues, walk through setups, and answer technical questions
* Help developers integrate our eSign API: review their requests, read error responses, and point them to best practices
* Support admins with account configuration, SSO/SAML, user management, and compliance-related questions

**Debugging and escalation to engineering**

* Reproduce issues across platforms, and investigate using logs, HAR files, browser dev tools, API tools such as Postman, and SQL queries
* Separate configuration issues from real bugs, and file well-documented Jira tickets with steps to reproduce, impact, and customer context
* Follow escalations through to closure and close the loop with the customer

**Knowledge and product feedback**

* Write and update help center articles, internal runbooks, and Zendesk macros so the next customer or teammate solves it faster
* Spot recurring issues and trends, and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product
* Respond to app store reviews that need a technical answer

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools to investigate issues, draft responses, and summarize ticket trends
* Build simple scripts, automations, and templates that cut repetitive work for the support team
  

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone technical, curious, and customer-first: a problem solver who takes ownership and doesn't let an issue go cold.

* 3 to 4 years of experience in technical or product support for a B2B SaaS product
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON, with hands-on experience using Postman or similar tools
* Comfort reading logs, analyzing HAR files, and using browser developer tools
* Experience troubleshooting web and mobile apps
* Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar helpdesk) and Jira
* Confidence leading customer calls, including with technical and enterprise stakeholders
* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, empathetic, and crisp communication style
* Self-driven, organized, and calm under pressure, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities
  

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with SSO/SAML, OAuth, and webhooks
* Exposure to integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365
* Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
* Experience with iOS or Android debugging tools
  

**Why you'll love this role**

This role sits at the center of everything we ship. You'll work with customers of every size, from individual professionals to enterprise and API teams, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to make Signeasy better every week.

Your work will directly shape how customers experience Signeasy: how quickly their problems are solved, how much they trust us, and how the product improves based on what they tell us.

It's a high-ownership role with clear room to grow, into senior support, support operations, solutions engineering, or product, depending on where your interests take you.

  

**Why work with Signeasy**

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.

  

**We'd love to hear from you**

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

* Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
* Meet Signeasy's leadership team
* Read our origin story
* Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
* Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Apply for this position
