title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**Principal DevOps / Software Engineer (Cloud Orchestration & Platform Engineering)**

The Software Engineering team delivers next-generation application enhancements and new products for a changing world. Working at the cutting edge, we design and develop software for platforms, peripherals, applications and diagnostics — all with the most advanced technologies, tools, software engineering methodologies and the collaboration of internal and external partners.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Software Principal Engineer on our Software Engineering Team in **Bangalore, India**.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal DevOps / Software Engineer, you will architect, build, and evolve the cloud automation, orchestration, and platform capabilities that power our global development ecosystem. You will work deeply within our VMware‑based infrastructure stack, spanning Aria Automation, Aria Operations, VCF, ESXi, and vCenter, while driving modernization toward next‑generation VCF Operations and AI‑enabled orchestration frameworks.

You will partner closely with our software engineering Scrum teams to deliver resilient, intelligent, and scalable automation services that enhance developer productivity, streamline reservation and deployment workflows, and maintain the reliability of critical DevOps tool chains. Your leadership will influence both technology strategy and hands‑on implementation across complex hybrid‑cloud environments.

**You will:**

* Design, implement, and evolve cloud automation and orchestration workflows for VMware‑based platforms, including Aria Automation/Operations and emerging VCF Operations
* Architect and maintain integrations with ServiceNow, reservation systems, deployment services, and asset management platforms supporting global engineering teams
* Develop, enhance, and maintain automation pipelines and services supporting virtual and physical asset provisioning
* Lead modernization initiatives as Aria is modernized, transitioning orchestration capabilities into new VCF‑based platforms and intelligent automation ecosystems
* Create automation frameworks, APIs, and services enabling self‑service provisioning, developer tooling, and global platform operations
* Collaborate closely within Agile/SCRUM teams to design high‑quality automation, observability, and platform capabilities aligned with product engineering needs
* Drive architectural discussions, document solutions, and mentor engineering peers in DevOps engineering, platform automation, and VMware‑centered cloud technologies
* Champion secure-by-design engineering practices, reliable CI/CD methodologies, and scalable operational patterns across the stack

  

**Take the first step towards your dream career**  
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* **8–12 years of professional experience** in DevOps engineering, cloud automation, or software engineering, with senior‑level ownership of infrastructure orchestration and developer‑focused services
* Expert-level proficiency with **VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vCenter, ESXi**, and enterprise‑scale virtualization management
* Extensive hands-on experience with **VMware Aria Automation (vRA/vRealize), Aria Operations, and orchestration tooling**, including lifecycle management, blueprints, policies, and extensibility
* Demonstrated experience architecting and developing **complex automation pipelines**, including API-driven workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and multi‑platform integrations
* Strong programming or scripting expertise (Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or equivalent) for automation, platform integration, and orchestration logic
* Experience integrating DevOps automation with **ServiceNow**, including CMDB synchronization, workflow automation, and custom orchestration triggers
* Deep understanding of **cloud automation frameworks**, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and enterprise DevOps practices
* Strong knowledge of **platform observability**, operational analytics, and distributed system diagnostics
* Ability to lead architectural initiatives, produce clear technical documentation, and mentor cross-functional engineering teams
* Experience operating within Agile/SCRUM teams, influencing strategy across multiple software and infrastructure groups
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with global engineering, operations, and platform teams

  

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with **ServiceNow development**, including scripting, custom integrations, API development, and platform configuration
* Exposure to **IPAM solutions** or network services automation (e.g., Infoblox or equivalent)
* Strong familiarity with **Agile/SCRUM methodologies** and enterprise SDLC practices
* Experience with **GitOps** and container‑oriented tooling such as Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, or related platforms
* Exposure to **Agentic AI / GenAI** as applied to workflow automation, intelligent orchestration, or advanced developer tooling
* Experience developing automation for hybrid cloud or multi‑cloud environments
* Understanding of infrastructure security, RBAC models, and enterprise compliance frameworks

  

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.  
Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.  
  
**Application closing date: 30th Oct 2026**  
  
Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**Informa** is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis** is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Quality Engineer with strong expertise in automation and modern Quality Engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience on creating automated data validation scripts to test ETL data pipelines and report bugs or glitches. This position requires hands-on experience in ETL Testing and Automated Test Development. You will also be responsible for UI, API, backend, and performance testing, with a passion for engineering scalable automation solutions, driving quality throughout the SDLC, and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve software quality and delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and manage the data quality framework across production data pipelines.
* Build reusable data quality checks using tools such as Great Expectations or equivalent frameworks.
* Working with large and complex data sets (SQL and No-SQL), data lakes (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Test Automation - Build automated data validation scripts to test the quality of data in data lake (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Define checks for schema, null values, uniqueness, referential integrity, data volume, freshness, late-arriving data, and business rules.
* Integrate data quality checks at ingestion, transformation, and pre-publish stages.
* Participate in requirements analysis, test strategy, test planning, risk assessment, test estimation, and release validation activities.
* Validate REST APIs, backend services, databases, and microservices through automated and manual testing.
* Perform performance and load testing using JMeter or BlazeMeter, analyse bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for performance improvements.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring quality gates, automated reporting, and continuous feedback.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality software delivery.
* Perform defect analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and support production issue investigations.
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate test design, automation development, defect analysis, and framework maintenance.
* Continuously improve automation coverage, framework stability, execution efficiency, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor junior Quality Engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Experience:**

* 3–4 years of experience in Quality Engineering, with strong expertise in Data Engineering, Data Quality, or Data Reliability Engineering.
* Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, dbt Tests, Deequ, or equivalent tools.
* Strong SQL skills, including window functions, complex joins, and queries on large partitioned datasets.
* Minimum 2 year of hands-on coding experience in Python.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in ETL testing of Data Pipelines and Data Warehouse.
* Experience with cloud data lake technologies, including S3, Glue, Athena, Spark on EMR, and Apache Iceberg.
* Experience in API automation (REST APIs, Postman, API testing frameworks).
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and modern Quality Engineering practices.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with test strategy, risk-based testing, test planning, and quality metrics.
* Experience in defect management, root cause analysis, and release quality validation.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience using AI-assisted testing tools to improve test design, automation development, execution, and maintenance (Claude Code preferred).

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Mastery of specialized data quality tools (e.g., Great Expectations, Informatica DQ).
* Proficiency with cloud platforms and data warehouses (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).
* Knowledge of global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and best practices for data governance.
* Experience testing microservices-based and distributed architectures.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools.
* Experience working on enterprise SaaS or publishing/content management platforms.

**Nice to Have**

* ISTQB Certification.
* Data Quality tool certified eg Informatica, Right Data etc
* AWS or Azure Fundamentals Certification.
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and the nuances of experimentation
* Experience with AI-driven Quality Engineering practices.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong ownership mindset with a quality-first approach.
* Strong ownership of data quality and reliability.
* Ability to identify and resolve the root cause of data quality issues.
* Good judgement on when a quality check should block, quarantine, or generate an alert.
* Ability to identify risks early and drive preventive quality practices.
* Quick learner with enthusiasm for adopting emerging technologies and AI-powered engineering solutions.
* Ability to mentor and coach team members while fostering a culture of quality.
* Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.
* Self-driven, proactive, and capable of working in a fast-paced Agile environment.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

  
**Additional Information**

You must have the right to work and live in India.

**Location:** The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our Bengaluru office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

**What we offer in return:**

* A competitive salary + bonus
* 24 days annual leave
* 4 volunteering days annually
* Day off for your birthday
* Pension contributions
* Medical insurance for self and dependants; life cover and personal accident cover for self
* Seasonal social and charitable events
* Training and development
* Tools and equipment for remote working

We want all our candidates to shine in our recruitment process. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you are able to show us your best self. This could include having the application form in a different format, more time for questions, or anything else – please ask us, we are happy to be flexible! Please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk

**Being Yourself at Taylor & Francis:**

If you’re excited about working with Taylor & Francis to foster human progress through knowledge, we invite you to apply even if your existing skills and experience don’t fit every item listed above. At Taylor & Francis, we are at our best and most successful when colleagues can be themselves and make a contribution regardless of their identity or background. As a colleague, you will have the opportunity to further innovate and develop in areas that you are passionate about. Our goal is to empower you with the resources, incentives, and flexibility you need to enjoy success at work and to live a healthy, balanced life.

Taylor & Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

Lead the E-Commerce Engineering capability across Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/Demandware) and Shopify, owning technical execution, full-stack delivery, and operational reliability across all brand websites while building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

* Own platform technical execution and codebase governance across SFCC (Demandware) multi-brand realms and Shopify Plus applications.
* Oversee end-to-end frontend and backend code delivery using Node.js, ISML, SFRA (Storefront Reference Architecture), and modern JavaScript frameworks across all brand websites.
* Drive migration from monolithic SFCC setups toward composable, decoupled frontend microservices and API-first integrations.
* Enforce secure coding standards, peer code reviews, automated unit and integration testing, and DevSecOps practices across e-commerce squads.
* Lead multi-squad engineering delivery within two-week agile sprints and 8-week Program Increment (PI) planning cycles. Engineering Reports to Director of Engineering Bengaluru.
* Ensure peak site availability, fast page-load speeds, and zero-downtime checkouts during high-volume retail trading events.
* Oversee technical interfaces connecting e-commerce applications with middleware (MuleSoft), Order Management (Fluent OMS), POS (Oracle XStore), and payment gateways, and track DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes,Defect Escape Rate, MTTR).
* Manage production code deployments and implementations releases, constantly improving the process to reach a goal of multi releases per day.
* Own SFCC and Shopify platform from maintenance perspective making sure that everything is operationally working as expected without any disruptions.
* Direct, mentor a high-performing team of full-stack e-commerce engineers and tech leads, run performance reviews, career development paths, and adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code).
* Partner with the Architecture, Omnichannel, Product, and QA on workforce and capacity planning.
* Own end-to-end e-commerce engineering delivery across SFCC and Shopify, including integrations, release readiness, and production stability.
* Remain hands-on: contribute to complex implementation and plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing across integrated SFCC and Shopify systems for assigned scope.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Minimum 10 years of total software engineering experience, including 5 years hands-on e-commerce full-stack development and 3 years directly managing engineering teams of 15+ people.
* Experience leading complex e-commerce platforms across SFCC and Shopify Plus in multi-brand retail environments, with strong ownership of integrations, performance, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in SFCC (Business Manager, SFRA, Controllers, Pipelines, Job Frameworks) and Shopify Plus, with mastery of ISML, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), and React.
* Strong command of Node.js, RESTful API design, GraphQL, headless architecture, and microservices integration.
* Experience with e-commerce search engines (Algolia, Constructor.io), CDN/caching (Fastly/Cloudflare), catalog indexing, GitLab CI/CD, Git workflows, and automated build and release pipelines.
* Practical experience with observability and APM tools (Datadog, Splunk) for site health, error logging, and incident response, and SAFe/Agile delivery (Jira/Confluence); familiarity with Claude Code for AI-assisted engineering.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Agentic Shopping Experience
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About the Team  
The IES Agentic Shopping team is defining the future of shopping for emerging markets by building AI-powered shopping experiences. We bring contextual intelligence, hyper-personalization, and multi-modal, vernacular experiences to the customer's everyday shopping journey — making it delightful and effortless.
  
  
About the Role  
We are hiring a Principal Technical Product Manager to define and deliver an AI-powered experience that transforms how customers discover, evaluate, and purchase. You will leverage AI to generate and surface rich, multi-modal content, build personalized and immersive experiences, and seamlessly integrated multi-lingual text and voice interactions.  
  
As the senior product leader for this charter, you will own product strategy, roadmap, and requirements; align stakeholders across the globe; and drive rapid experimentation to continuously raise the bar on delight, relevance, and conversion. You will develop deep expertise in LLM-based automation and agentic system architectures to make informed technical decisions and set a durable product vision.  
  
This is a high-ambiguity, high-impact role at the frontier of applied AI in retail — ideal for a builder who thrives in a fast-moving, dynamic landscape.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for AI-powered agentic shopping experiences in emerging markets.  
  
Translate strategy into clear requirements, driving execution across global engineering and science teams.  
  
Develop deep knowledge of LLM-based automation and agentic system architectures to inform product and technical decisions.  
  
Drive a culture of rapid experimentation (A/B testing, prototyping) to continuously improve delight, relevance, and conversion.  
  
Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, science, design, and business leadership; balancing competing priorities across multiple workstreams.  
  
Represent the voice of emerging-market customers, grounding the roadmap in real customer behavior and needs.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will:  
  

* Drive and execute product strategy and roadmap working backwards from customer requirements in collaboration with engineering technical leadership
* Assess technical implications of product architecture and optimization decisions
* Drive technical alignment across dependencies
* Work directly with software engineering teams to define and execute on new features
* Produce clear and concise documents such as PRFAQ and PRD documents
* Write user stories, and validate features meet developer needs
* Drive feature discussions with customers, engineering, and other stakeholders
* Anticipate bottlenecks, manage risk and escalations, balancing technical constraints
* Find opportunities to innovate on behalf of our customers, design features related to these opportunities, and always push to improve our product developer experience
* Build ecosystem partnerships and stay connected with industry trends

  
  
  
About the team  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We operate with startup like velocity, prioritizing talent acquisition, hands on leadership, and flexible organization. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
  
It is in our nature to learn and be curious. We foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.  
  
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge sharing, mentorship and other career advancing resources here to help you develop into a better rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 10+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**

* 3+ years of experience in developing and managing large-scale data infrastructure and AI applications
* Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable, fault-tolerant data infrastructure on AWS using services such as AWS Redshift, RDS, Glue, EMR, and other related tools
* Advanced skills in Python, PySpark, and SQL for efficient data manipulation and processing along with experience with data modelling and database design (SQL and NoSQL)
* Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Hadoop) and real-time data processing solutions
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and security best practices
* Knowledge of data streaming technologies such as Kafka, AWS Kinesis, or equivalent
* Ability to work directly with data scientists, analysts, and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
* Master’s degree in a related field, contributing added knowledge will be preferred
* AWS-related certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics) or equivalent cloud platform credentials are highly desirable.

**Responsibilities**

As a Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining reliable data infrastructure, including pipelines and workflows that support business functions and advanced analytics. This role is crucial in ensuring the seamless integration and operation of our AI and data infrastructure.

* Design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant ETL/ELT processes leveraging AWS services (e.g., Redshift, RDS, Glue, EMR)
* Develop and optimize data workflows using Python, PySpark, and SQL, ensuring top performance
* Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to gather data requirements while delivering effective solutions
* Ensure adherence to best practices related to data governance, quality, and security across all data pipelines
* Automate and optimize data processing tasks to improve reliability and reduce manual intervention
* Drive adoption of emerging big data technologies, cloud engineering, and automation practices
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to junior team members as required
* Foster a culture of teamwork, openness, and innovation within and across teams

**About The Team**

Moody’s Ratings’ AI Analytics group develops advanced machine learning (ML) and generative AI solutions for high-profile data science initiatives. The successful candidate will guide teams in building robust, scalable, and secure solutions on AWS. The successful candidate will strive to meet Moody’s values: openness, diversity, inclusivity, respect, and a willingness to learn.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Information Systems Engineer
description:
**Overview**  
**About Business Unit:**  
At the core of all that Epsilon does is a team that sets the foundation of our IT infrastructure. The team drives innovation and efficiency through pioneering technology across Epsilon's platforms and business verticals. From being the first point of contact for infrastructure needs to final deployment, the team provides end-to-end solutions for our client-facing platforms. ETS supports all aspects of revenue-generating platforms for Epsilon and sets the architectural direction for our enterprise deployments. By adopting the newest technologies, such as Cloud, Automation, and Artificial Intelligence, the team is at the front of redefining our digital business and capturing new opportunities.
  
  
**Summary:**  
As an integral member of the Infrastructure Transition Team within our enterprise IT organization, you will provide comprehensive support and deliver end-to-end infrastructure services across cloud environments, operating systems, network, virtualization, and operational integrations.
  
  
You will actively engage in project activities including feasibility analysis, scoping, scheduling, and task management. The role will contribute to the end-to-end infrastructure lifecycle, including server provisioning, onboarding, configuration, integration, migration, operational readiness, and secure decommissioning. A key focus will be eliminating repetitive manual activities through scripting, Infrastructure as Code, orchestration, and reusable automation solutions.
  
  
This position requires close collaboration with Architecture, Operations, Security, IAM, Network, Cloud, Application, Project Management and Client teams to ensure that infrastructure solutions are technically sound, operationally ready, and aligned with measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments, with strong expertise in automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps practices, and operational excellence.
  
  
Clear and timely communication with users and management regarding the status of ongoing activities is vital to maintain transparency and ensure project success.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Provide engineering support for Windows and Linux platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure operations.
* Lead server lifecycle management, including onboarding, integration, migration, and decommissioning, using automation to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
* Drive infrastructure automation and DevOps adoption through reusable solutions, scripting, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted engineering tools (Microsoft Copilot, Cursor).
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Ansible, Python, Terraform, AWX, CloudFormation, and other tools across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Design and support hybrid-cloud solutions, enabling seamless modernization of legacy workloads and adoption of cloud-native services.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and platform issues, optimizing performance, resilience, and service availability.
* Communicate effectively with partners, providing insight into project status, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to enhance system scalability, security, and cost-effectiveness.
* Identify, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities while maintaining security and compliance standards.
* Manage and optimize multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure using automation, configuration management, and security standards.
* Define and enforce infrastructure management policies, procedures, and guidelines for both modern and legacy environments.
* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and technical documentation in Confluence to support knowledge sharing and operational consistency.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 2-5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering and technical delivery
* Strong hands-on experience supporting enterprise Windows and Linux environments.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, AWX) and scripting using Python (preferred), PowerShell, or Bash.
* Solid experience with AWS and Azure cloud platforms; exposure to Google Cloud is desirable.
* Experience managing server lifecycle operations, including provisioning, onboarding, migration, and decommissioning.
* Understanding of operating system fundamentals including user and kernel space, memory management, shared libraries, file and network IO, Windows registry, software distribution, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies to improve automation, code development, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Awareness of emerging infrastructure, cloud, automation, and AI technologies, with a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
* Experience with the project lifecycle of network integrations, infrastructure build, data center builds, and/or network hardware refresh.
* Good communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in Agile and multi-functional environments.
* Self-motivated team player with a continuous learning approach and passion for automation and innovation.

  
**Additional Information**  
Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  
  
Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.  
  
Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.  

* **People centricity:** We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* **Collaboration:** We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* **Growth:** There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  
Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

  
These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.  
  
**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
  
Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

You will join as a **senior AI expert**, operating across IT Consulting, Solution Architecture, Technical Leadership and Principal Engineering responsibilities depending on the product need. The role combines deep AI and DevSecOps expertise with **hands-on engineering and coaching**.

*#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #PPSolutions #AgenticAI #DevSecOps #Copilot*

**Grow together**

As a **Senior IT Consultant for AI Acceleration**, you will work with P&P product teams to identify, design and implement responsible AI capabilities across the software delivery lifecycle. You will translate customer needs, product priorities, pain points and feature ideas into clearly defined AI-assisted delivery outcomes.

Your work will span requirements engineering, solution options and blueprints, architecture, code generation, testing, documentation, knowledge management, application support and operations. You will use Copilot, AI agents and approved AI tooling to accelerate delivery while maintaining human control over prioritization, decisions, quality and accountability.

**The** **SQUAD** combines senior AI expertise with P&P product and software expertise. AI experts inject capabilities, reusable assets, coaching and hands-on support. Product teams continue to own business value, backlog priorities, delivery commitments, acceptance, quality and compliance. **What you do**

* Implement reusable AI assets tailored to P&P Solutions needs while using and fulfilling DHL and Agent Friday standards.
* Coach and complement product teams through hands-on AI implementation, from exploration and co-design through engineering and handover.
* Integrate AI into DevSecOps practices for requirements, architecture, engineering, code, testing, documentation, knowledge and operations.
* Create solution options and blueprints that consider security, performance, compliance, maintainability and operational readiness.
* Apply Copilot, AI agents and other approved AI tools using effective prompting, engineering patterns and repeatable playbooks.
* Partners with architects, technical leads, developers, testers, product owners and domain experts in a co-creation model.
* Maximize AI efficiency and demonstrate outcomes through transparent measures such as delivery acceleration, quality improvement, reuse and reduced manual effort.
* Identify and address AI risks, limitations and quality concerns, keeping human review and accountability embedded in the delivery process.
* Enable knowledge transfer so product teams can sustainably operate, extend and reuse the implemented capabilities.
* Support priority P&P products and domains, including End Customer Solutions, Billing Solutions, Mobile Solutions and other customer-facing or operational solutions.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**

* Substantial experience in AI-assisted software engineering, generative AI or agentic AI, with strong hands-on delivery experience.
* Profound knowledge of integrating AI into software engineering and DevSecOps workflows.
* Experience with AI/LLM application development, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, AI agents, model evaluation and integration of AI services into enterprise applications.
* Practical expertise with GitHub Copilot or comparable coding assistants, AI agents, prompt engineering, reusable patterns and playbooks.
* Strong software engineering foundation, including architecture, clean code, APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development and production operations.
* Ability to create solution options and translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical designs, prototypes and production-ready approaches.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, model limitations, evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Hands-on coaching mindset with the ability to transfer knowledge and raise the AI capability of multidisciplinary product teams.
* Experience working in complex enterprise environments with distributed, cross-regional teams.
* Excellent spoken and written English, strong stakeholder communication and the ability to explain AI opportunities and constraints without hype.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively and organize work under time and workload pressure.

**Experience that will help you stand out**

* Experience in logistics, postal, parcel, retail, billing, customer-facing digital channels or mobile application domains.
* Familiarity with P&P concepts such as customer journeys, touchpoints, Packstation/Poststation, billing and finance, mobile apps, pension services, production, transport or BI solutions.

title: Director, Engineering
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead the Chennai engineering organization for 2 scrum teams, shared platform resources (Architect, ML Engineer, SDET), and a team of ~20 engineers across backend, frontend, AI, and QA disciplines. You will own delivery accountability, team health, technical quality, and the cross-team coordination that keeps two scrum teams moving in the same direction. You will be the primary technical counterpart to the US-based Product leadership, the direct interface to platform teams, and the person who sets the engineering culture for the entire team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the full Chennai engineering organization (~20 engineers): two Scrum teams, two Engineering Managers, Staff/Senior engineers, Applied ML, and Staff SDET.

* Own delivery accountability: sprint cadence, cross-team dependency management, risk tracking, and executive reporting on engineering progress.

* Set and enforce technical standards: hexagonal architecture discipline, AI-native integration patterns, code quality gates, and observability standards across both teams.

* Act as the primary technical counterpart to US-based Product leadership — translate business requirements into engineering execution plans, surface trade-offs early, and maintain shared understanding of what is being built and why.

* Own the cross-team coordination interface to platform teams (Agentic Engine, Core Platform, ARC backend, Design) — ensuring product dependencies are tracked, escalated, and resolved on schedule.

* Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent: own the full hiring pipeline, define career ladders, conduct performance reviews, and make compensation decisions.

* Drive the technical roadmap for Phase 2 in partnership with the ML Architect, Applied Scientist, and Product leadership — shaping the next wave of AI capabilities.

* Maintain technical depth: actively participate in architecture reviews, challenge design decisions, and unblock engineers on complex distributed systems and AI integration challenges.

* Build and sustain a high-trust, high-accountability engineering culture where engineers feel ownership, psychological safety, and pride in their craft.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership — managing managers and leading teams of 15+ engineers.

* Deep technical background in Java backend systems, distributed microservices, and event-driven architecture — able to engage credibly in architecture reviews and design decisions.

* Proven track record building and operating SaaS platforms on AWS with multi-database stacks (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis/Aerospike).

* Demonstrated experience with hexagonal architecture at scale — enforcing domain isolation as teams and services grow.

* Strong cross-functional leadership: experience working closely with Product Management, Design, and executive stakeholders across geographies (US-India distributed teams).

* Track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent — building teams from the ground up in competitive markets.

* Experience delivering in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with evolving platform dependencies and shifting priorities.

Good to Have

* Experience leading engineering teams building AI-native products (LLM integration, agentic systems, scoring pipelines, MCP tool design).

* Background in martech, customer data platforms, or dealer/automotive technology.

* Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines within the same org.

Exposure Temporal for durable workflow orchestration at the team level.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options.

* Medical insurance coverage.

* Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies.

title: Software Development Engineer, FinTech - TFAW
description:
**Description**
Do you want to build machine learning and agentic-AI systems that analyze billions of dollars in transactions every day, and measure your impact in millions of dollars saved?
  
  
In Amazon's Finance Technology group, we build the detection systems (machine learning, and increasingly agentic AI) that defend Amazon against theft, fraud, abuse, and waste across the supply chain, retail catalog, and corporate procurement. We turn terabytes of transaction, vendor, and operational data into real-time risk decisions: scoring payments as they happen, surfacing anomalous behavior, and uncovering collusion networks that span thousands of entities.
  
  
We're now building the next generation of that platform around generative and agentic AI: multi-agent systems that discover fraud patterns directly from the raw data flowing through Amazon's businesses, working alongside domain experts to turn what they find into production detection logic. The result is a platform where new detection coverage comes not only from engineers, but from agents and the experts who know the fraud best, shipping in days instead of sprints.
  
  
You'll build the agent tools, ML pipelines, services, and data infrastructure behind all of this, working with generative AI, large language models, and agent frameworks alongside the anomaly-detection, classification, and graph-modeling techniques they build on. You'll partner directly with applied scientists, fellow engineers, and finance operations teams, and you'll see your ideas reach production in weeks.
  
  
If you want to apply advanced ML and agentic AI at Amazon scale, on systems with a direct, measurable financial impact, we'd love to talk.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You Will Participate In The Full Software Development Lifecycle, From Collaborating With Customers And Scientists On Design, To Building Scalable, Extensible Systems That Run In Production. You Will
  
  
Design and build ML pipelines that process terabytes of data and score billions of dollars in transactions.
  
  
Build agentic AI applications: LLM-powered agents that discover risk patterns and generate detection logic, operating through well-defined tool interfaces with human-in-the-loop review.
  
  
Build the knowledge and memory systems agents depend on: vector stores, knowledge graphs, the entity-risk layer for cross-entity collusion detection, and in-session and shared memory.
  
  
Develop how we evaluate agent effectiveness in fraud detection, and turn analysts' ad-hoc investigation patterns into repeatable, templated workflows.
  
  
Build the platform and tooling (governed data access, model deployment, and self-service rule authoring) that lets agents and non-engineers ship detection logic safely and fast.
  
  
Take models and agents from prototype to reliable, real-time production systems, and work directly with internal customers to turn feedback into shipped improvements.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You'll partner with applied scientists, software engineers, and finance operations teams across Amazon. You'll harden an agent pipeline for production, extend the entity graph that powers a new detector, or design a tool interface that lets an agent query data safely, then review it with the customer who'll use it. Because our team and our customers are comfortable trying new ideas, you'll get your work in front of real data quickly and iterate on what you learn.
  
  
**About The Team**
We own the machine learning and agentic-AI systems that prevent, recover, and avoid internal and external theft, fraud, abuse, and waste across Amazon Finance Operations. Our platform makes real-time risk decisions on transactions from many of Amazon's largest businesses. We're actively building toward entity-level risk profiles updated in real time, and agentic systems that compress fraud discovery and investigation from weeks to days, with engineers building the leverage layer that multiplies what every analyst and agent can do.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience in processing data with a massively parallel technology (such as Redshift, Teradata, Netezza, Spark or Hadoop based big data solution)

title: Sr. AI-Native Application Engineer / Sr.Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description:
**About The Ksquare Group**

The Ksquare Group is a global technology consulting company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with over 14 years of experience delivering technology solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, AI, and network engineering for clients in Banking & Financial Services, Public Sector, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Logistics, Healthcare, and Enterprise Services. With a team of 350+ professionals across the US, Mexico, the Dominican Republic and India, we help organizations solve complex business challenges and achieve measurable outcomes through our collaborative POD-based delivery model. At The Ksquare Group, we foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth, empowering our teams to make a meaningful impact for clients worldwide.

**Role summary**

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Application Engineer who works as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE): embedded with our clients, close to their users, data and systems. You will build and ship conversational and agentic AI applications end to end, from React or Vue.js front ends to Node.js, Python, Java or .NET back ends, and turn real customer problems into working software in production. You move fast, own outcomes, and feed what you learn in the field back into our platforms and accelerators.
 

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and ship fullstack AI-native applications using React or Vue.js front ends with Node.js, Python, Java or .NET back ends.
* Develop conversational AI and agentic AI features using LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, including tool calling, RAG, memory and multi-step workflows.
* Integrate LLMs and managed AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) with client systems, APIs and data sources.
* Deploy and operate applications on GCP, AWS or Azure using containers, serverless and CI/CD, and own them through to production.
* Write clean, tested and well-documented code; take an active part in design and code reviews.
* Embed with client teams, on-site or remote; work directly with business users, SMEs and engineers to understand workflows, pain points and success criteria.
* Run discovery sessions and map client processes to identify high-value AI use cases; turn them into scoped, buildable solutions.
* Rapidly prototype and demo working solutions (POCs and MVPs), iterate on user feedback, and harden them for production.
* Work within the client’s environment: connect to their data, legacy systems, identity and security controls, and meet their compliance and governance requirements.
* Define and track success metrics with the client (accuracy, adoption, time saved, cost) and run LLM evaluations against real-world data.
* Own production support in the client environment; troubleshoot issues across the stack, prompts, agents and integrations.
* Drive adoption: train client users and teams, write runbooks and hand-over documentation, and enable client engineers to own the solution.
* Act as the voice of the customer: feed field learnings, recurring patterns and feature requests back to product, platform and practice teams, and turn them into reusable components and accelerators.
* Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to client stakeholders and internal leads.

**Required skills and experience**

* 4–6 years of professional software development, with solid fullstack delivery experience.
* Strong front-end skills in React or Vue.js (component design, state management, TypeScript).
* Strong back-end skills in at least one of Node.js (Express, NestJS), Python (FastAPI, Django), Java (Spring Boot) or .NET (ASP.NET Core).
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience building conversational AI and agentic AI applications using LangChain or equivalent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain4j, Semantic Kernel).
* Working knowledge of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini or similar), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and RAG patterns.
* Must have cloud-native experience on at least one of Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.
* Mandatory hands-on DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and production deployments.
* Experience in client-facing or customer-embedded roles; comfortable working directly with business users and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership and problem-solving: able to work through ambiguity, make pragmatic trade-offs and deliver independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel and work on-site at client locations as needed.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to LLMOps tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Exposure to one or more business domains (e.g., BFSI, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, logistics).
* Prior experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, startup or consulting role.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**
:
  
  
Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.
  
  
We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.
  
  
**About the opportunity:**
As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.
  
  
You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
  
  
You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.
* Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

**Your technical toolkit:**
**Languages and software engineering**
Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.
  
  
**Models and AI ecosystem**
Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.
  
  
**Agentic AI engineering**
Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.
  
  
**Retrieval and search**
Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.
  
  
**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**
End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.
  
  
**Frameworks**
Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.
  
  
**MLOps and LLMOps**
CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.
  
  
**Data and ML foundations**
Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.
  
  
**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.
