title: Senior Data Scientist – Perturbation Biology & AI
description: What You Will DoLet’s do this. Let’s change the world. We are seeking a highly qualified and motivated Senior Data Scientist with a strong background in computational biology to join the Bioinformatics Technologies team within Amgen’s Automation, Research Data Systems, Informatics, and AI (ARIA) organization. ARIA is a multidisciplinary group embedded within Amgen’s discovery engine, leveraging advancements in digital technologies for disease modeling and digital modality engineering to accelerate the pipeline from target inception through drug development. Within ARIA, Bioinformatics Technologies serves as an innovation hub for developing, deploying, and applying emerging digital technologies in computational biology to drive the next generation of therapeutic discovery.Perturbation screening is an essential approach for understanding how genetic and non-genetic changes impact cellular systems. By systematically probing gene function and network dependencies, these studies reveal disease mechanisms, identify novel therapeutic targets, and uncover biomarkers that can guide preclinical and translational research. This capability enables more confident target validation and accelerates the path from discovery to therapeutic hypothesis generation. In this role, you will develop and apply advanced computational and AI/ML methods to analyze perturbation screening data, strengthen data interpretability, and collaborate with experimental teams to ensure computational predictions translate into actionable insights for target and therapeutic discovery. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical aptitude, have a high degree of technical competency in computational sciences with a deep theoretical understanding of AI/ML and causal learning paired with an excellent understanding of molecular biology proven by a track record of innovative and collaborative research.RESPONSIBILITIES:Develop and apply advanced methodologies at the intersection of functional genomics and AI/ML analytics to identify and validate novel therapeutic targets, elucidate mechanisms of action, and discover preclinical biomarkers.Provide computational and data science support for high-throughput single-cell perturbation and phenotypic screening experiments (e.g., Perturb-seq) to map gene–phenotype relationships, uncover disease drivers, and prioritize hits for validation.Drive digital innovation by identifying gaps in analytical workflows and developing robust, reproducible, and FAIR solutions that improve data interpretability, strengthen readout confidence, and accelerate therapeutic hypothesis generation.Build and apply machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI approaches to simulate cellular responses to single or combinatorial genetic and non-genetic perturbations, delivering fit-for-purpose predictions that reduce experimental burden and accelerate therapeutic hypothesis generation.Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and translational teams to ensure computational predictions align with experimental design and biological context, enabling testable target and biomarker hypotheses; contribute to the design of perturbation experiments so that computational and experimental approaches inform and strengthen each other.What We Expect Of YouWe are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a senior data scientist with these qualifications.Basic Qualifications:Any degree and 8-13 years of directly related experiencePreferred Qualifications:Demonstrated expertise in method development for functional genomics and perturbation screens, ideally with experience in single-cell omics technologies.Strong background in machine learning and AI, including deep learning, generative modeling, and transformer-based architectures; experience with pre-training, fine-tuning, and few-/zero-shot learning, ideally with experience in in silico modeling of cellular responses to drug or genetic perturbations.Proven track record of applying computational methods to drive biological insights, target validation, biomarker discovery, or therapeutic hypothesis generation.Proficiency in scientific programming languages and tool development using Python, R, or similar, with familiarity in relevant libraries and frameworks.Experience with large-scale data processing using cloud computing, workflow development, and software best practices (e.g., version control, continuous integration, test-driven development).Familiarity with agentic AI, digital innovation approaches, and FAIR data principles for building robust and scalable analytical workflows.Familiarity with molecular and disease biology, with the ability to contextualize computational findings in therapeutic discovery.Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to extract and clearly present insights from complex data to diverse audiences with rigor and accuracy.Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills with demonstrated ability to thrive in cross-functional teams and effectively present results to diverse audiences.Creative, open-minded, and passionate about research, with a proven record of innovative algorithm and model development demonstrated through impactful publications, patents, or widely adopted tools.

The intern will gain hands-on experience in day-to-day cloud operations, monitoring and incident triage, infrastructure automation and CI/CD, cloud cost management (FinOps), security and compliance, and AI-assisted operations while collaborating with experienced cloud engineers, and application development teams.  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the platform end to end, connect application and business needs to reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud operations, evaluate state-of-the-art automation approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and agentic operations solutions.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the platform architecture (mainly AWS, with some Azure), the multi-account setup across production and non-production environments, service dependencies, deployment workflows, and the main reliability, security, and cost risks.
* Assist with day-to-day cloud operations, including environment health checks, configuration reviews, access requests, backups, and resource inventory, starting in non-production environments under guidance.
* Build and maintain monitoring for cloud services, including CloudWatch metrics, log-based metric filters, alarms, and dashboards, and help tune thresholds to reduce alert noise.
* Participate in incident investigation and log triage; query logs and metrics with tools such as CloudWatch Logs Insights, reproduce issues, support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and turn findings into runbooks and triage playbooks.

* Support Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure; analyze pipeline results, build logs, and agent failures, and help keep controllers and agents healthy and current.

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. title: AI Test Engineer
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. We are looking for an AI Test Engineer who combines strong software quality assurance and test automation experience with hands-on expertise in AI-assisted testing. The role involves using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and Figma designs to generate test scenarios and executable automated tests using AI tools.

The ideal candidate can effectively provide the right context to AI tools, validate AI-generated outputs, and continuously improve test development workflows to accelerate automation while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, traceability, and maintainability.

* Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to provide AI tools with requirements, application context, coding standards, existing automation frameworks, and relevant design information so that generated tests are accurate and maintainable.
* Review, validate, debug, and refine AI-generated test scenarios and automation code rather than accepting generated output without verification.
* Identify opportunities to automate the test-development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, test generation, test-data creation, regression maintenance, failure analysis, and coverage expansion.

* 5–8 years of experience in software QA
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding or engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for software testing and test automation.

* Experience creating or configuring AI-assisted workflows that can transform requirements into executable automation, rather than using AI only for ad-hoc code completion or general-purpose prompting.
* Ability to provide application-specific context to AI tools, including existing automation code, framework conventions, requirements, design information, and test data, to improve generated test quality.
* Practical understanding of validating AI-generated tests for correctness, coverage, maintainability, traceability to requirements, and potential hallucinations or incorrect assumptions.

***Personal competencies***

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and a risk-based approach to quality assurance.
* Curiosity and a proactive mindset when exploring complex workflows and edge cases.
* Willingness to adopt AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and test coverage.

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.
* Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.
* Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
* Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities.
* Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability.
* Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team.
* Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development.
* Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation.
* Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities.
* Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.
* Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality.
* Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities.
* Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Production Ownership**

* Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations.
* Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked.
* Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability.
* Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution.
* Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery.
* Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications.
* Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities.
* Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
* Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows.
* Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions.
* Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities.

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Lead software architecture and modernization**

Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.

* **Stay deeply hands-on in code**

Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.

* **Design strong domain models and APIs**

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.

* **Modernize application foundations**

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.

* **Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability**

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

* **Improve data access and integration design**

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

* **Raise the bar for code quality and testing**

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.

* **Create reusable engineering patterns**

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.

* **Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution**

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.

**WHAT THIS IS NOT**

* This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
* This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering**

You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.

* **Credible hands-on implementation depth**

You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.

* **Service transformation and architecture judgment**

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.

* **Production reliability and performance expertise**

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.

* **Software design and refactoring depth**

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.

* **Data and integration depth**

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

* **Strong testing and code-quality discipline**

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

* **Principal-level technical leadership**

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

* **An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:

Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:

  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits

title: IT Technical Intern

* Use scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to improve repetitive IT processes and operational efficiency.
* Investigate recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, workflows, and user experience.
* Contribute to IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, deployments, infrastructure improvements, asset refreshes, and technology evaluations.
* Explore the responsible use of AI tools, automation, and intelligent assistants for IT support, documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and knowledge management.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, reliability, and alignment with organizational policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, user guides, network diagrams, and troubleshooting references.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users and provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support.

  
Qualifications:

* Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networking concepts, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management principles.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals and design algorithms.
* Working knowledge of at least one operating system, such as Windows, Linux, or macOS.
* Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, user accounts, access permissions, and common enterprise IT services.
* Basic familiarity with productivity applications, collaboration tools, cloud services, endpoint devices, and software installation or configuration.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically, research solutions, follow procedures, document work accurately, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Understanding of basic cybersecurity, data privacy, password security, phishing risks, and responsible handling of confidential information.

Nice to have Skills :

* Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise platforms.

title: 26-223: Senior Data Engineer
description:
### **Senior Data Engineer** **Job ID#: 26-2233** **Location: Hyderabad/Vijaywada India.** **Who We Are:** **Since our inception back in 2006, Navitas has grown to be an industry leader in the digital transformation space, and we’ve served as trusted advisors supporting our client base within the commercial, federal, and state and local markets.** **What We Do:** **At our very core, we’re a group of problem solvers providing our award-winning technology solutions to drive digital acceleration for our customers! With proven solutions, award-winning technologies, and a team of expert problem solvers, Navitas has consistently empowered customers to use technology as a competitive advantage and deliver cutting-edge transformative solutions.**

**Overview:**  
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Amazon Redshift, SQL development, ETL/ELT pipelines, and production data engineering support.  
  
The primary responsibility of this role is to develop, maintain, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize our existing Amazon redshift data warehouse and associated data integration workflows. The engineer will ensure the reliability performance accuracy and timely execution of scheduled data pipelines supporting enterprise analytics and reporting.  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience with complex SQL development, ETL process design, job scheduling, production monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with tableau and its underlying data dependencies is important.  
  
As part of a broader data and AI platform modernization strategy the engineer will also participate in the phased migration of existing redshift workloads to Databricks. The successful candidates must demonstrate a willingness and ability to learn Databricks, Delta Lake, and modern data engineering practices.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Production Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Support**

* Monitor scheduled ETL jobs, Redshift workloads, data pipelines, and production data processing activities.
* Proactively identify and resolve job failures, performance bottlenecks, data discrepancies, and scheduling issues
* Rapidly diagnose, debug, and resolve production issues involving SQL, ETL workflows, and scheduled automation.
* Perform root-cause analysis of recurring production incidents and implement permanent corrective solutions.
* Monitor data pipeline execution, processing times, failures, and system performance to ensure operational reliability.
* Develop and maintain monitoring scripts, automated alerts, and operational dashboards for production workflows.
* Participate in rotational on-call production support to troubleshoot and resolve critical data processing issues.
* Maintain operational documentation, incident resolution procedures, and production support runbooks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, analytics, and other IT teams to resolve production issues and maintain data availability.

**Redshift and ETL/ELT Pipeline Design, Development, and Automation**

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain data warehouse solutions using Amazon Redshift.
* Perform SQL performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting to improve data processing efficiency
* Analyze existing data models, schemas, tables, and transformation logic to identify performance and reliability improvements.
* Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT solutions supporting enterprise data integration and analytics.
* Work with Amazon S3, Python, and other AWS data services to support data processing and integration requirements.
* Develop and maintain Python scripts and SQL-based data transformation solutions.
* Maintain scheduled data processing jobs, including job dependencies, execution sequences, and automated recovery mechanisms.
* Improve existing ETL solutions through SQL optimization, automation, and reusable engineering practices.
* Implement error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, and alerts to improve pipeline reliability.
* Work with enterprise source systems, including PeopleSoft, D2L, Salesforce, and other structured data sources as required.

**Data Quality, Validation, and Analytics Support**

* Develop data validation checks, reconciliation processes, and automated quality controls to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Investigate data discrepancies and resolve issues between source systems, Redshift transformations, and downstream reporting.
* Work with analytics teams to understand business logic, data requirements, and reporting dependencies.
* Support Tableau reporting and analytics workloads by ensuring the accuracy, availability, and performance of underlying Redshift data.
* Troubleshoot SQL queries, data models, and pipeline failures impacting Tableau dashboards and scheduled reporting.
* Assist with data model enhancements, reporting performance optimization, and resolution of data-related incidents.
* Validate that data transformations and business rules are correctly implemented.

**Redshift to Databricks Migration and Modernization**

* Support the organization’s phased transition from Amazon Redshift to Databricks.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
About Meeru AI

Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.

We deploy on customer terms — **SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises** — across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.

The Role

We are looking for a **Staff Data Engineer** to build and own the major subsystems of the data foundation — the pipelines, connectors, and curated models that feed the platform's analytics and AI layers. You take the data architecture and standards set by the data lead and turn them into robust, production-grade systems that don't break and don't lie about the numbers.

You own significant pieces of the platform end to end complex transformations over the warehouse, source integrations for new customer systems, and the reconciliation and lineage that prove the curated model ties back to source. This is a hands-on, high-ownership engineering role with a clear path toward Senior Staff.

 **Requirements**  

* **7+ years in data engineering.** You've owned complex, production pipelines end to end, including how they perform, how reliable they are and what they cost to run.
* **Expert SQL and data modeling.** You write complex, set-based transformations over a cloud warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL or similar) and design models other teams build on.
* **dbt in production.** You've built and maintained real dbt projects, including incremental models that refresh efficiently instead of rebuilding everything.
* **Production orchestration with Airflow or Dagster.** You design DAGs that are safe to rerun and backfill.
* **Warehouse internals and performance tuning.** You know why a query is slow or expensive on large datasets and how to fix it.
* **A bias toward correctness.** You treat data tests, reconciliation against source and lineage as core to the job, and you build pipelines that are idempotent and reproducible.
* **Solid Python.** Enough to write pipeline code, tests and tooling that others can maintain.
* **Comfort with messy source systems.** You've integrated real-world sources with inconsistent data and changing schemas, and kept downstream models stable.
* **Collaboration and mentorship.** You agree data contracts with backend and AI teams, review peers' work and mentor senior and mid-level engineers.

**Nice to have**

* **ERP and financial data.** Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or Workday, or with finance data such as general ledger, accounts payable, payroll and HRIS.
* **CDC and managed ingestion.** Change-data-capture pipelines or tools like Fivetran.
* **Multi-cloud and customer-hosted deployments.** Work across AWS, Azure and GCP, ideally where pipelines run inside customer environments with strict tenant isolation and no data leaving.
* **A wider warehouse range.** Oracle ADW, Apache Pinot or MySQL alongside the main warehouses.
* **FinTech or financial-services exposure.** You understand why finance teams need numbers that tie out to the cent.
* **Reusable integration frameworks.** You've built connectors or mappings as configuration on a shared framework, so the next source is faster to onboard.
* **Test and synthetic data.** You've built golden or synthetic datasets for regression testing.
* **Interest in architectural ownership.** This role has a clear path toward Senior Staff.

**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: AI Architect(Gen AI & Agentic AI) 7 to 8yrs
description:
Job Description: AI Architect – Generative AI & Agentic AI

Experience: 7–8 Years

Industry: Banking / Financial Services preferred

Location: Mumbai(Thane /BKC) Work from Office

Role Type: Architecture, Engineering & Technology Leadership

1. About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Architect with 7–8 years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and cloud-native architectures.

The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions, with a focus on banking and financial services use cases. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, architectural decision-making, rapid prototyping, and collaboration with engineering, data, security, and business teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Solution Design

\* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.

\* Design scalable AI platforms integrating LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native infrastructure.

\* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and inference strategies.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, reference implementations, design principles, and engineering standards.

\* Design for high availability, scalability, low latency, cost optimisation, observability, and resilience.

Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineering

\* Architect and implement RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, retrieval, reranking, and contextual response generation.

\* Design intelligent AI agents capable of tool calling, multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, and controlled execution of enterprise business processes.

\* Develop multi-agent workflows where appropriate, with clear boundaries, state management, human approval, and failure-handling mechanisms.

\* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, model routing, context management, and conversation memory.

\* Apply guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, and unauthorised tool execution.

\* Build proof of concepts and convert successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Enterprise Integration & Banking Use Cases

\* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, REST APIs, event-driven systems, microservices, and secure data platforms.

\* Design AI solutions for banking use cases such as customer service automation, knowledge assistants, document intelligence, regulatory compliance, fraud investigation support, and developer productivity.

\* Ensure AI services integrate seamlessly with existing authentication, authorisation, audit, and monitoring frameworks.

\* Work with domain architects and business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into technical solutions.

MLOps, LLMOps & Production Engineering

\* Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices for AI applications and model-serving components.

\* Implement model evaluation, regression testing, prompt/version management, retrieval-quality assessment, and continuous monitoring.

\* Define evaluation frameworks covering factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, safety, and token consumption.

\* Monitor model performance, drift, failure rates, inference costs, and application reliability.

\* Optimise inference performance through caching, batching, model selection, quantisation, and other suitable techniques.

Security, Governance & Responsible AI

\* Design AI solutions with security and privacy by design, including encryption, role-based access control, secrets management, and data minimisation.

\* Implement responsible AI controls, explainability where appropriate, traceability, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

\* Address threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, and sensitive information leakage.

\* Collaborate with information security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to meet applicable regulatory and organisational requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

\* Provide hands-on technical leadership to developers and engineering teams throughout the solution lifecycle.

\* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and proof-of-concept evaluations.

\* Mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices, design patterns, and production-readiness standards.

\* Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation roadmaps to technical and business stakeholders.

3. Required Technical Skills

Generative AI & LLMs

\* Strong understanding of LLMs, transformer-based models, embeddings, tokenisation, context windows, and inference.

\* Hands-on experience with commercial and/or open-source models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or equivalent.

\* Expertise in RAG, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt engineering, and structured generation.

\* Practical experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Programming & Backend Engineering

\* Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-grade AI applications.

\* Solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, API security, and distributed systems.

\* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent backend frameworks.

\* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot and microservices is an advantage.

Data & Search Technologies

\* Experience with vector databases or vector search technologies such as pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.

\* Strong understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases, document processing, data pipelines, and data quality.

\* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, hybrid search, and enterprise data integration is desirable.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

\* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

\* Experience deploying AI workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based architectures.

\* Familiarity with API gateways, event-driven architecture, secrets management, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

\* Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, or equivalent.

AI Quality, Evaluation & Operations

\* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks, automated testing, tracing, and observability tools.

\* Understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, model safety, and retrieval-quality optimisation.

\* Knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

4. Qualifications & Experience

\* 7–8 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or related technology roles.

\* Demonstrable hands-on experience delivering AI or GenAI solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage.

\* Strong architectural problem-solving skills and ability to make informed build-versus-buy and model-selection decisions.

\* Experience working with enterprise-scale applications, sensitive data, and production deployment constraints.

\* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

\* Banking, financial services, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience is highly desirable.

5. Preferred Experience

\* Experience building agentic AI systems that invoke enterprise tools and APIs under controlled permissions.

\* Knowledge of AI security testing, red teaming, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.

\* Experience with multimodal AI, document intelligence, speech, or vision-based solutions.

\* Familiarity with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms and integration with microservices.

\* Experience designing AI solutions for high-volume, low-latency, business-critical environments.

6. Success Criteria

The AI Architect will be measured on the ability to:

\* Deliver secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions aligned with business outcomes.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns that accelerate delivery across engineering teams.

\* Improve answer quality, retrieval accuracy, reliability, and user adoption.

\* Optimise inference cost, response latency, and infrastructure utilisation.

\* Demonstrate measurable business value through automation, productivity improvements, and reduced manual effort.

\* Ensure AI solutions meet defined security, governance, auditability, and operational-readiness requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A hands-on AI architect who can move from business problem definition to solution architecture, working code, production deployment, and measurable business impact—not just develop GenAI proofs of concept.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Agentic AI & gen AI: 5 years (Required)

We are looking for a proactive, quick learner who can build practical AI solutions, take ownership of assigned tasks, and contribute to developing reliable AI-driven automation systems.

Interested and eligible candidates can share their updated resume along with details of their relevant n8n, RAG, and Prompt Engineering projects.

title: Computer Vision Research Engineer
company: Blue Ocean Systems Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Senior Computer Vision Research Engineer – Deep Learning & 3D Vision

**Experience:** 5+ years

Role Overview

We are looking for a **Senior Computer Vision Research Engineer** with strong fundamentals in computer vision and deep learning, and extensive hands-on experience building, modifying, training, and optimizing computer vision models from scratch.

The ideal candidate should understand neural networks at the **layer and architecture level**, be able to modify existing architectures or design custom models, and have strong experience in high-accuracy **pixel-level segmentation, transformers, 3D vision, depth data, and large-scale model training**.

Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and train computer vision models from scratch for segmentation, detection, feature extraction, and related vision tasks.

· Understand and modify neural network architectures at the layer/block level, including convolution, normalization, activation, attention, skip connections, encoders, and decoders.

· Work extensively with segmentation architectures such as **U-Net, U-Net++, SegFormer, Swin Transformer**, and similar CNN/Transformer-based architectures.

· Develop highly accurate pixel-level segmentation solutions where prediction accuracy may directly affect millimeter- or centimeter-level measurements.

· Work with **3D vision, depth maps, point clouds, RGB-D/stereo data, camera calibration, and geometric computer vision**.

· Build and maintain robust model training pipelines, including preprocessing, augmentation, loss functions, optimizers, learning-rate scheduling, hyperparameter tuning, validation, and error analysis.

· Work with **large-scale datasets**, including dataset cleaning, annotation quality analysis, class imbalance, sampling strategies, and data validation.

· Optimize models for inference speed, GPU memory, latency, and accuracy using techniques such as mixed precision, quantization, pruning, ONNX, and TensorRT.

· Develop and optimize inference pipelines for GPU, edge, and production environments.

· Maintain clear documentation of model architectures, datasets, training configurations, experiments, metrics, and model versions.

· Perform systematic model evaluation and failure analysis using appropriate metrics such as IoU, Dice, precision, recall, F1, mAP, and application-specific accuracy metrics.

· Research, evaluate, and implement new computer vision and deep learning approaches where they provide practical improvements.

Required Skills

· 5+ years of hands-on experience in Computer Vision / Deep Learning.

· Strong experience with **PyTorch** or similar deep learning frameworks.

· Proven experience **building and modifying computer vision models from scratch**, rather than only fine-tuning pretrained models.

· Strong understanding of CNN architectures, individual layers, feature maps, receptive fields, and encoder-decoder architectures.

· Strong experience with **semantic/pixel-level segmentation**.

· Hands-on experience with **U-Net, U-Net++, SegFormer, Swin Transformer, Vision Transformers**, or similar architectures.

· Good understanding of transformers, attention mechanisms, and modern vision architectures.

· Experience with **3D data, depth maps, point clouds, stereo/RGB-D data**, or related spatial vision problems.

· Strong understanding of optimizers, loss functions, hyperparameter tuning, training strategies, and model convergence.

· Experience working with **large datasets and production-scale training pipelines**.

· Experience with model optimization and high-performance inference.

· Strong understanding of core computer vision concepts, image processing, camera geometry, and model evaluation.

Good to Have

1. Exposure to **MLOps practices**, including:

1. Model and dataset versioning

2. DVC or equivalent tools

3. Experiment tracking

4. Model parameter and configuration tracking

5. Training metric tracking

6. Model artifact management

7. Reproducible training pipelines

2. Experience with experiment tracking and model lifecycle tools such as **MLflow, ClearML, Weights & Biases**, or similar platforms.

3. Experience with high-precision visual measurement systems.

4. Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, NVIDIA Jetson, or edge deployment.

5. Experience reproducing research papers or developing custom architectures/loss functions.

Education

B.Tech / M.Tech / MS / PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics, IT, AI/ML, or a related engineering discipline from a reputed institute.
