description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Early-career Full Stack Engineer with a focus on AI Engineering to help build next-generation intelligent applications powered by large language models (LLMs). This role sits at the intersection of application development, data engineering, and applied AI—developing scalable systems that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM evaluation frameworks, and agent-based architectures.
  
  
You will work closely with platform, data, and product teams to build AI-powered experiences using Azure, Databricks, Postgres, and modern AI/agent frameworks.
  
  
**Major Duties**
AI & Application Development
  
  

* Build end-to-end AI-powered applications (UI + backend services + model orchestration)
* Design and implement RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval and grounding
* Develop and deploy LLM-based workflows and agents (multi-step reasoning, tool use, orchestration)
* Integrate models via APIs and hosted platforms (Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, etc.)

LLM Evaluation & Quality
  
  

* Develop LLM evaluation frameworks (accuracy, hallucination detection, relevance, safety)
* Implement automated testing and benchmarking for prompt chains and agents
* Define and monitor LLM performance metrics (precision, recall, grounding fidelity)
* Support experimentation (prompt engineering, model comparisons, fine-tuning readiness)

Data & Backend Engineering
  
  

* Build and optimize data pipelines leveraging Databricks (Spark, Delta)
* Design and query structured and semi-structured datasets using Postgres
* Enable efficient retrieval layers (vector search, embeddings, indexing strategies)
* Support data modeling for AI use cases (knowledge bases, feature stores)

Platform & Agent Development
  
  

* Develop AI agents within Databricks and Azure ecosystems
* Integrate orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
* Build reusable services/APIs for agent capabilities (search, summarization, reasoning)

Full Stack Development
  
  

* Contribute to lightweight front-end interfaces for AI applications (React or similar)
* Build backend APIs/services (Python-based frameworks)
* Ensure production readiness (logging, monitoring, scalability, security)

**Experience & Qualification**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering, building AI applications, LLM, Python.
* B.E/B.Tech or above degree requried.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: AI Engineer (Autonomous Agents, Voice and MCP)
description:
Company description

SWAB Technologies Private Limited is a Pune-based technology company. We are building an autonomous AI agent that takes voice commands and carries out real business work on its own, such as making calls and running ads.

Role description

We need an experienced AI engineer. This is not a role for freshers or for someone learning on the job. You will build this agent from the ground up. The founder defines what it must do. You decide how to build it, you build it end to end, and you own it for the long term.

* Build an autonomous AI agent that understands voice commands and takes action on its own
* Design and build MCP servers and tool integrations so the agent can operate real business tools
* Enable the agent to act: place and handle phone calls, create and run ad campaigns, and carry out other everyday business tasks
* Build realtime voice pipelines (speech-to-text, LLM, text-to-speech) with low latency, supporting Indian accents and languages
* Build the agent core: planning, tool calling, background task execution, retries, and memory
* Add guardrails so the agent asks for confirmation before irreversible actions such as spending ad budget, payments, or calls, and defend against prompt injection
* Build evaluations, monitoring, and cost and latency controls, so quality is measured and not assumed
* Turn the founder's requirements into working software without needing detailed specifications
* Own the system long term: architecture, reliability, security, and documentation

Qualifications

* Experienced engineer required: significant hands-on experience building and shipping production software, including at least one LLM-based agent or voice product used by real users
* Able to build alone, end to end: backend, APIs, integrations, and deployment, without a large team or detailed specs
* Experience with tool calling, structured outputs, asynchronous jobs, and MCP or similar tool-integration protocols
* Strong in Python or Node.js/TypeScript
* Experience with realtime voice or telephony, or a working project that shows you can learn it quickly
* Understands security for connected business accounts: OAuth, token storage, and least-privilege access
* Based in Pune, or ready to relocate to Pune for this on-site role
* Can show a live product, repository, or demo you built and explain every major decision

Nice to have:

* Experience with advertising platform APIs such as Meta or Google Ads
* Telephony or SIP integration experience
* Indian-language speech recognition or text-to-speech
* Early-stage startup experience as one of the first engineers

What we value:

* Ownership: treats the product as theirs, not as a ticket queue
* Self-driven: takes a clear goal and delivers without being managed step by step
* Long-term commitment: this is a multi-year build, and we want someone who plans to stay
* Direct and honest: tells the founder when an idea will not work, with reasons
* Pragmatic: ships a working version, then improves it with real usage

title: Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer
description:
**# Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer**

* Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
* Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office (WFO)(890)
* Experience:\*\* 8–11 Years
* Salary Budget:\*\* ₹8,00,000–₹18,00,000 per annum (₹8–18 LPA)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 45 Days
* Preferred Candidates:\*\* Local candidates based in Pune

**## Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
  
  
This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality.
  
  
**## Key Responsibilities**
### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration
  
  

* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies.
* Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.
* Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations.
* Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation.
* Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles.
* Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs.

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing
  
  

* Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications.
* Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
* Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
* Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

### 4. Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.
* Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
* Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations
  
  

* Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows.
* Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.
* Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses.
* Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations.

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control
  
  

* Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab.
* Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks.
* Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues.

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability
  
  

* Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms.
* Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements.
* Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security
  
  

* Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads.
* Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep.
* Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls.

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate technical issues, evaluation outcomes, incident updates, and resolutions clearly.
* Participate in technical discussions and troubleshooting sessions.
* Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams.

**## Mandatory Skills / Must-Haves**
**The Following Skills Are Explicitly Mandatory For This Position**

* Python
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* OpenAI
* Azure Databricks

Candidates must also demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities appropriate for a client-facing engineering role.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
AI Principle Architect
  
  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
**FinOps Engineer**

**Company:** Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product:** Fonazo – AI-Powered Voice Agent & Subscription Platform  
**Job Title:** FinOps Engineer  
**Experience:** 4+ Years  
**Qualification:** Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field  
**Location:** Pune  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred  
**Salary:** As per experience and industry standards

**Job Summary**

Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **FinOps Engineer with a strong background in Finance, FinTech, subscription billing, and payment gateway management** to manage the financial operations of our clients using **Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform**.

The ideal candidate will have at least 4 years of hands-on experience managing subscription-based revenue models, recurring billing, payment processing, financial reconciliation, transaction settlements, refunds, chargebacks, and payment gateway integrations. The candidate should be familiar with payment service providers such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, Amazon Pay, and similar platforms.

The role involves overseeing end-to-end financial operations for multiple clients, ensuring accurate subscription revenue tracking, monitoring payment performance, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining financial transparency across the Fonazo platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Subscription Billing & Revenue Management**

* Manage end-to-end subscription billing operations for Fonazo clients, including recurring payments, subscription plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and plan changes.
* Monitor subscription revenue, billing cycles, failed payments, pending invoices, and outstanding receivables to ensure accurate and timely revenue collection.
* Establish and maintain processes for tracking Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), customer lifetime value (CLV), churn, and subscription growth.
* Ensure accurate calculation of subscription charges, prorated billing, discounts, promotional offers, taxes, and other applicable fees.
* Identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, investigate root causes, and implement corrective measures.
* Coordinate with the product and development teams to improve billing workflows and automate subscription-related financial processes.

**2. Payment Gateway Management & Integration**

* Manage financial operations across payment gateways and subscription payment platforms, including Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay (FIS Global), 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, Amazon Pay, and other relevant providers.
* Configure and monitor payment gateway settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods, and recurring billing arrangements.
* Track payment success rates, declined transactions, gateway fees, transaction costs, refunds, and settlement discrepancies across providers.
* Coordinate with technical teams to troubleshoot payment gateway integration issues, API-related billing errors, webhook failures, and transaction status mismatches.
* Evaluate payment gateway performance, pricing structures, supported currencies, geographical coverage, and settlement timelines to recommend suitable solutions for clients.
* Ensure proper reconciliation between gateway transaction records, Fonazo subscription records, invoices, and bank settlements.

**3. Financial Reconciliation & Settlement Management**

* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of payment gateway transactions, subscription invoices, customer payments, refunds, and bank settlements.
* Verify gross transaction values, processing fees, commissions, taxes, net settlements, and pending or disputed transactions.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies between payment gateways, internal billing systems, accounting records, and bank statements.
* Monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions, payment reversals, and unaccounted financial entries.
* Maintain accurate financial ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports, and supporting documentation for audit and accounting purposes.
* Coordinate with the Accounts and Finance team to ensure proper recording of revenue, receivables, gateway charges, and settlement entries.

**4. Client Financial Operations & Account Management**

* Manage subscription-related financial operations for multiple Fonazo clients, ensuring accurate billing, payment collection, revenue reporting, and account-level financial records.
* Monitor each client's subscription plans, active subscriptions, transaction history, invoices, outstanding balances, refunds, and payment status.
* Prepare client-wise financial statements and reports covering subscription revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges, and net settlements.
* Coordinate with clients to resolve billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies, refund requests, and settlement-related queries.
* Maintain clear records of client transactions, payment histories, subscription changes, and financial adjustments.
* Ensure timely communication with clients regarding failed payments, pending dues, billing changes, and other subscription-related financial matters.

**5. Refunds, Chargebacks & Dispute Management**

* Manage refund requests, chargebacks, payment reversals, and disputed transactions in accordance with company policies and payment gateway requirements.
* Investigate transaction disputes, collect supporting evidence, and coordinate with payment service providers to facilitate timely resolution.
* Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends, fraudulent transaction indicators, and recurring payment failures.
* Establish procedures for refund approvals, transaction verification, dispute escalation, and financial adjustment entries.
* Work with customer support and technical teams to identify the causes of payment disputes and prevent recurring issues.
* Maintain complete documentation of refunds, chargebacks, disputes, and their final outcomes.

**6. Financial Reporting, MIS & Analytics**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering subscription revenue, payment collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds, and gateway settlements.
* Develop dashboards to track MRR, ARR, churn rate, renewal rates, payment success rates, outstanding receivables, and revenue leakage.
* Analyze payment gateway fees, subscription performance, client profitability, transaction costs, and revenue trends to support management decisions.
* Prepare client-wise and gateway-wise financial performance reports for internal management and business reviews.
* Identify financial irregularities, recurring billing issues, and operational inefficiencies through data analysis.
* Use Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar reporting tools to automate financial reports and improve data accuracy.

**7. Financial Controls, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Establish internal controls for subscription billing, refunds, payment settlements, revenue recognition, and financial adjustments.
* Ensure that financial operations follow applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, payment provider policies, and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction records, audit trails, approval workflows, and supporting documents for financial reviews and audits.
* Coordinate with internal finance, compliance, and technical teams to support applicable PCI DSS requirements and secure payment-handling practices.
* Monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorized refunds, and potential payment fraud indicators.
* Support compliance with applicable data protection, customer billing, and payment-related requirements across relevant markets.

**8. Product & Technical Team Coordination**

* Work closely with product managers, backend developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to improve Fonazo's subscription billing and payment management modules.
* Translate financial requirements into clear functional specifications for subscription plans, billing logic, invoices, payment retries, refunds, and settlement workflows.
* Validate payment gateway integrations, subscription lifecycle events, billing calculations, and transaction reconciliation during product releases.
* Coordinate testing of payment APIs, webhook events, recurring billing scenarios, failed payment recovery, and refund workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual reconciliation, improve financial accuracy, and streamline client onboarding.
* Contribute to the development of scalable financial workflows that support increasing subscription volumes and multiple client accounts.

**9. Subscription Performance & Payment Optimization**

* Analyze failed and declined transactions to identify the reasons for payment failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Implement and monitor dunning processes, automated payment retries, renewal reminders, and failed-payment recovery workflows.
* Evaluate payment gateway performance to improve transaction approval rates and reduce unnecessary processing costs.
* Monitor subscription cancellations, involuntary churn, payment-related customer drop-offs, and recurring billing issues.
* Recommend improvements to subscription pricing, billing frequency, payment methods, and collection workflows based on financial data.
* Work with product and customer success teams to improve renewal rates, customer payment experience, and subscription revenue retention.

**10. Accounting, Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Support subscription revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, payment collection projections, and financial budgeting for Fonazo operations.
* Maintain accurate records of accounts receivable, deferred revenue where applicable, payment gateway fees, refunds, and other subscription-related financial entries.
* Coordinate with the accounting team on monthly closing, revenue reconciliation, financial statements, and audit requirements.
* Analyze client-wise revenue, platform operating costs, payment processing charges, and contribution margins.
* Support the preparation of financial forecasts and management reports for business planning and operational decision-making.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen financial controls, reduce operating costs, and improve cash flow visibility.

**Required Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing, revenue reconciliation, and financial operations.
* Hands-on experience with one or more payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout, Square, Payoneer, or Amazon Pay.
* Knowledge of subscription lifecycle management, recurring billing, invoicing, payment retries, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement reconciliation.
* Understanding of financial reporting, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, payment gateway fees, and cash flow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, and financial reporting.
* Experience with financial dashboards, MIS reporting, and analytical tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Working knowledge of SQL and financial data analysis is preferred.
* Understanding of payment gateway APIs, webhooks, transaction statuses, and reconciliation workflows is an advantage.
* Familiarity with accounting or ERP systems and automated billing platforms is preferred.
* Knowledge of international payments, multi-currency transactions, cross-border settlements, and applicable tax treatment is an advantage.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline is required.
* A Master's degree in Finance, FinTech, Accounting, or Business Administration is preferred.
* Certifications in FinTech, payment systems, financial analysis, accounting, or relevant financial operations are an added advantage.

**5. Experience Requirements**

* Minimum **4+ years of relevant professional experience** in FinOps, subscription finance, payment operations, billing and reconciliation, or FinTech financial operations.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with payment gateways and recurring subscription payment systems.
* Experience managing financial operations for multiple clients, accounts, or subscription-based products.
* Proven ability to handle transaction reconciliation, failed payments, refunds, chargebacks, settlement reports, and revenue tracking.
* Experience working with SaaS platforms, AI products, voice-agent platforms, or other recurring-revenue business models is highly desirable.
* Experience collaborating with finance, product, engineering, and customer support teams to resolve complex financial and payment issues.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and timeliness of subscription billing and financial reconciliation.
* Reduction in unresolved settlement discrepancies and unaccounted transactions.
* Payment success rate and effectiveness of failed-payment recovery.
* Timeliness of client collections, refund processing, and dispute resolution.
* Accuracy and timely submission of financial MIS reports and dashboards.
* Reduction in payment gateway costs and preventable revenue leakage.
* Accuracy of client-wise subscription revenue and financial records.
* Effectiveness of billing automation and improvements in financial processes.
* Compliance with internal financial controls and audit requirements.
* Quality of coordination with clients, finance teams, and technical teams.

description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Job Summary:**  
Early-career Full Stack Engineer with a focus on AI Engineering to help build next-generation intelligent applications powered by large language models (LLMs). This role sits at the intersection of application development, data engineering, and applied AI—developing scalable systems that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM evaluation frameworks, and agent-based architectures.

You will work closely with platform, data, and product teams to build AI-powered experiences using Azure, Databricks, Postgres, and modern AI/agent frameworks.  
  
**Major Duties:**  
AI & Application Development

* Build end-to-end AI-powered applications (UI + backend services + model orchestration)
* Design and implement RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval and grounding
* Develop and deploy LLM-based workflows and agents (multi-step reasoning, tool use, orchestration)
* Integrate models via APIs and hosted platforms (Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, etc.)

LLM Evaluation & Quality

* Develop LLM evaluation frameworks (accuracy, hallucination detection, relevance, safety)
* Implement automated testing and benchmarking for prompt chains and agents
* Define and monitor LLM performance metrics (precision, recall, grounding fidelity)
* Support experimentation (prompt engineering, model comparisons, fine-tuning readiness)

Data & Backend Engineering

* Build and optimize data pipelines leveraging Databricks (Spark, Delta)
* Design and query structured and semi-structured datasets using Postgres
* Enable efficient retrieval layers (vector search, embeddings, indexing strategies)
* Support data modeling for AI use cases (knowledge bases, feature stores)

Platform & Agent Development

* Develop AI agents within Databricks and Azure ecosystems
* Integrate orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
* Build reusable services/APIs for agent capabilities (search, summarization, reasoning)

Full Stack Development

* Contribute to lightweight front-end interfaces for AI applications (React or similar)
* Build backend APIs/services (Python-based frameworks)
* Ensure production readiness (logging, monitoring, scalability, security)

**Experience & Qualification:**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering, building AI applications, LLM, Python.
* B.E/B.Tech or above degree requried.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer** to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.

This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.

The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. All AI-assisted output must be appropriately reviewed, validated, secured, and tested prior to implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable Java-based enterprise integration solutions using REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.
* The successful candidate is expected to incorporate approved AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day engineering activities, including:
* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for assigned solutions throughout the development and support lifecycle.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and development practices, including responsible use of AI-assisted capabilities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering efficiency.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI Data AI Engineering is a central team responsible for building and managing a broad suite of data-centric applications and capabilities that support all MSCI business verticals.

A core part of our mission is ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across MSCI’s products. The team designs and implements robust AI-driven data quality enhancements to guarantee that downstream analytics, models, and client-facing solutions are built on trusted data.

As a member of this team, you will work alongside highly motivated professionals who challenge one another to produce best-in-class products and technology. We stay at the forefront of advancements in LLMs, GenAI, NLP, ML, and modern data science — and lead the planning and deployment of advanced AI and data quality solutions across MSCI’s application landscape.

Your Key Responsibilities:

* Develop data science applications and contribute to MSCI’s ongoing AI adoption journey.
* Implement ML/NLP/GenAI/Agentic AI, and advanced anomaly detection methodologies (including statistical, ML-based, and AI-driven approaches) within data science tools to deliver new functionality for both the internal production platform and the client delivery platform.
* Support teams across data and technology in implementing AI solutions and integrating their services with MSCI’s data science products and platforms.
* Engage with content expert teams across technology and build a deep understanding of MSCI APIs and data delivery platforms.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Data Operations, and IT Infrastructure throughout all stages of the development lifecycle, ensuring reliable, high-quality, and scalable solutions.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

* At least a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience in finding patterns in data, creating statistical models, data exploration, data visualization, and data mining.
* Experience in developing AI and ML solutions and delivering them to production.
* Strong hands-on experience in Python & NLP
* Expertise in anomaly detection methodologies, including statistical techniques, ML-based approaches, and AI-driven detection systems for identifying irregularities, data drift, and quality issues.
* Prior experience or projects involving LLMs and Agentic AI is a strong plus.
* Understanding of good software development practices: Test-Driven Development (TDD), refactoring, pair-programming, and solid design principles.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and demonstrating a strong drive toward delivery.
* Experience with cloud-based solutions, especially Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior AI EngineerMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions.
* Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs.
* Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations.
* Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions.
* Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale.
* Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production.
* Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models.
* Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists.
* Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards.
* Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability.
* Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably.
* Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
* A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome).
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value.
* Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents.
* Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock.
* Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About TVARIT:**

TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving

advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).

With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most

innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.

We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team

The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on

quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement:**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence:**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* **10+ years of professional experience,** including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* **Mandatory manufacturing exposure:** direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* **Software delivery leadership:** must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* **Mandatory AI modeling experience:** strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* **Proven customer-facing leadership**, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* **Proven delivery track record:** leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

**Strong Haves**

* **Data science and AI:** Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* **Metals process understanding:** Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.

Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
* Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.
* AI gateways or AI security platforms (such as JetStream, LiteLLM, or Prisma AIRS), or security for Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Securing autonomous AI agents or Model Context Protocol servers.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Senior Data Science Engineer
description:

title: Client Project Manager
description:
### **Life at TCG Digital**

At TCG Digital, we’re more than technologists—we’re visionaries shaping the future of business with AI-driven solutions that transform speed into measurable value. Our global team is a dynamic blend of engineers, designers, and strategists spanning six countries and over 15 languages, all working together to create innovative solutions for complex challenges. From mathematicians and ethical hackers to musicians and comedians, our team thrives on diversity. Each unique background contributes fresh perspectives and creativity, powering the innovative solutions that define our success.

Join us to make an impact, not just on technology but on the world of business itself.

  

**Role**

Client Project Manager, Industrial AI & Process Optimization

  

**No. of positions**

1

  

**Location**

Delhi

  

**Experience**

10-15 Years

  

**Education**

B.E./B.Tech./MCA; PMP, PRINCE2 or SAFe certification preferred.

  

**Role summary**
----------------

  

We are hiring a Client Project Manager (CPM) to lead delivery of AI-driven process optimization programs for large refinery and petrochemical clients. The solutions combine first-principles process models with AI/ML on our industrial analytics platform. They are deployed at plant sites, first as advisory (open loop) and then writing targets to advanced process control (closed loop).

  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

The CPM owns delivery, client governance and project commercials from kick-off to handover.

  

* **Sales-Delivery Collaboration**
  + Receive formal handover from the pre-Sales team covering SOW, pricing model, delivery estimated with assumptions, risk register, and client relationship notes.
  + Validate that delivery commitments are achievable;
  + Flag gaps or risks before baseline is set.
  + Help establish the scope baseline prior to kick-off.
  + Provide contract, Pricing Sheet, P-o-S Factory estimates, stakeholder map and risks/issues/dependencies/assumptions to Delivery for triggering Project initiation into Delivery
  + Conduct external kick-off with customer, working with Pod team to develop and finalize kick-off content
* **Commercial Accountability**
  + Ensure invoices are raised on time per contractual milestones or periodic billing schedules.
  + Track billing triggers — milestone completions, delivery acceptances, T&M cycles.
  + Coordinate with Finance and client-side teams for invoice approval and payment.
  + Monitor accounts receivable and escalate overdue invoices within defined thresholds.
  + Maintain commercial hygiene — no revenue leakage through missed billing cycles or unclaimed change requests.
  + Ensure client approval of invoices is obtained in time.
  + Drive resolution of dependencies that affect invoicing and commercial closure.
* **Scoping & Change Management**
  + Maintain the agreed project scope baseline and identify scope creep early.
  + Communicate change implications clearly to both client and delivery team before work proceeds.
* **Client Governance & Reporting**
  + Establish the value note – baseline “as-is” state of the defined value parameters and the “to-be” state of the value parameters as success criteria for the Project
  + Collaborate with the Project Lead to ensure deliverables serve the client’s strategic intent, not just SOW compliance.
  + Conduct formal value realization reviews with the client at key intervals.

  

**Qualifications and experience**
---------------------------------

  

**Must have**

* B.E./B.Tech./MCA; PMP, PRINCE2 or SAFe certification preferred.
* Work experience in process industries (refining, petrochemicals, chemicals).
* A total of 10-15 years of experience in software delivery, with last 3-5 years as Project Manager for software, data or AI projects.
* Full SDLC experience (requirements, design, development, testing, release, support) in agile (Scrum/Kanban) and hybrid models.
* Customer Engagement, Stakeholder Management.
* Project management discipline: scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and change control; estimation with WBS and story points.
* Jira and Confluence: backlogs, sprint boards, dashboards and workflows; MS Project or equivalent.
* Fixed-price delivery: change requests, milestone billing and margin management.
* Strong client communication and stakeholder management with senior customer teams.

**Good to have**

* Degree in Chemical, Instrumentation or Process Engineering.
* Delivery of advanced process control, real-time optimization or plant analytics projects, including site commissioning and acceptance tests.
* Knowledge of first-principles process simulation and hybrid (physics plus ML) models.
* Industrial data integration: DCS and historian data over OPC, OT/IT network segregation, IEC 62443.

description:

Along the way, you will get to:

* Embed Responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance into delivery while mentoring engineering teams and building applied AI capability.

* Health Benefits
