title: Sr. Delivery Consultant-AI/ML, ProServe
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Excited by using massive amounts of data to develop Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) models? Want to help the largest global enterprises derive business value through the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI)? Eager to learn from many different enterprise’s use cases of AWS ML and DL? Thrilled to be key part of Amazon, who has been investing in Machine Learning for decades, pioneering and shaping the world’s AI technology?
  
  
At AWS ProServe India LLP (“ProServe India”), we are helping large enterprises build ML and DL models on the AWS Cloud. We are applying predictive technology to large volumes of data and against a wide spectrum of problems. Our Professional Services organization works together with our internal customers to address business needs of AWS customers using AI.
  
  
AWS Professional Services is a unique consulting team in ProServe India. We pride ourselves on being customer obsessed and highly focused on the AI enablement of our customers. If you have experience with AI, including building ML or DL models, we’d like to have you join our team. You will get to work with an innovative company, with great teammates, and have a lot of fun helping our customers.
  
  
If you do not live in a market where we have an open Data Scientist position, please feel free to apply. Our Data Scientists can live in any location where we have a Professional Service office.
  
  
A successful candidate will be a person who enjoys diving deep into data, doing analysis, discovering root causes, and designing long-term solutions. It will be a person who likes to have fun, loves to learn, and wants to innovate in the world of AI.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand the internal customer’s business need and guide them to a solution using our AWS AI Services, AWS AI Platforms, AWS AI Frameworks, and AWS AI EC2 Instances .
* Assist internal customers by being able to deliver a ML / DL project from beginning to end, including understanding the business need, aggregating data, exploring data, building & validating predictive models, and deploying completed models to deliver business impact to the organization.
* Use Deep Learning frameworks like MXNet, Caffe 2, Tensorflow, Theano, CNTK, and Keras to help our internal customers build DL models.
* Use SparkML and Amazon Machine Learning (AML) to help our internal customers build ML models.
* Work with our Professional Services Big Data consultants to analyze, extract, normalize, and label relevant data.
* Work with our Professional Services DevOps consultants to help our internal customers operationalize models after they are built.
* Assist internal customers with identifying model drift and retraining models.
* Research and implement novel ML and DL approaches, including using FPGA.

This role is open for Mumbai/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Gurugram
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Experience with popular deep learning frameworks such as MxNet and Tensor Flow
* Experience driving collaborative projects from conception to delivery, or experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations
* Experience with AI/ML technologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience
* Experience in consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions
* Experience as technical specialist in design and architecture
* Experience in cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience in external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as ML Operations Engineer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first-class support to our clients with expertise and care.
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
To design, implement, and maintain robust MLOps frameworks that streamline the deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models, ensuring efficient and reliable production operations on AWS.
  
  
**Responsibilities Of The Role**

* Build and optimize scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS-based infrastructure for ML/GenAI workloads
* Develop automated workflows for data ingestion, model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring using tools like AWS SageMaker, Step Functions, and Lambda
* Implement data quality checks, lineage tracking, and compliance standards for curated datasets
* Integrate ML pipelines with DevOps practices, ensuring seamless collaboration between data science and engineering teams
* Deploy monitoring solutions for model performance, drift detection, and system health using AWS CloudWatch and custom dashboards
* Ensure adherence to security best practices and governance requirements for AI deployments
* Work closely with Data Scientists to operationalize models and optimize deployment strategies

**Technical Skills Required For This Role Include**

* Experience in Programming & Automation: Python, Bash, SQL.
* Worked in MLOps Tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker Pipelines.
* Cloud Platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
* DevOps: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Docker, Kubernetes
* Data Management: Data curation, governance, and ETL processes.

The ML Ops Engineer role focuses on building and managing automated pipelines, AWS-based architectures, and monitoring frameworks to enable efficient deployment and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models in production environments.
  
  
This role requires a flexible working approach, ensuring availability during select hours that overlap with US-based partners and stakeholders.
  
  
You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Noida.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To implement data quality process and procedures, ensuring that data is reliable and trustworthy, then extract actionable insights from it to help the organisation improve its operation, and optimise resources.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification.
* Execution of data cleansing and transformation tasks to prepare data for analysis.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Development and application of advanced analytical techniques, including machine learning and AI, to solve complex business problems.
* Documentation of data quality findings and recommendations for improvement.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Vice President, Engineering
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner.

**Quick Take -**

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals.
* Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well.
* Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders.

**The Work -**

***Engineering for the customer journeys***

* **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery.
* **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each.
* **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product.

***Partnership with Data & Intelligence***

* **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations.
* **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models.
* **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards.

***Delivery and engineering excellence***

* **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions.
* **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root.
* **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development.
* **Production ownership.** Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations.
* **Architecture and standards.** Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately.

***Leadership and management***

* **Organization.** Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them.
* **Global teams.** Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices.
* **Talent.** Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer.
* **Budget and reporting.** Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run.

**First-Year Priorities**

* Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them.
* Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios.
* Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards.
* Assign a lead team for each supplier–buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow.
* Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it.
* Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations.
* Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track.

**Required Skills**

* 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS.
* A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems.
* Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale.
* Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery.
* Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development.
* Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures.
* A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers.
* Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones.
* Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001).
* Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

**Preferred Skills**

* Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech.
* Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: FIELD OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – FIELD OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE (CIVIL SURVEY & DGPS OPERATIONS)**

**Company:** BetterDrones (Knifedge Lab Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)  
**Location:** Noida, Sector 62, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirement:** Extensive travel across India, including remote and difficult terrain

**About BetterDrones**

BetterDrones is a drone intelligence and geospatial technology company specializing in drone inspections, GIS, LiDAR, mapping, surveying, and AI-powered infrastructure inspection solutions.

We work with power utilities, renewable energy companies, EPC contractors, railways, and government organizations to inspect, map, and manage critical infrastructure using advanced drone and geospatial technologies.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on **Field Operations Executive with a Civil Engineering or Surveying background** to manage and execute field survey and infrastructure inspection projects across India.

The role involves managing Surveyor and DGPS (Differential Global Positioning System) teams, coordinating field activities, monitoring survey quality, handling client communication, and ensuring timely project execution.

**This is a demanding, field-intensive position — not a desk-based operations or coordination job.** Project locations may include difficult terrain, uneven ground, remote areas, long walking routes, and sites with limited accessibility. Candidates must be prepared to work in challenging field conditions and stay at project locations for extended periods.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked as Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, or Civil Site Engineers and are ready to take ownership of teams, clients, and end-to-end field execution.

Key Responsibilities1. Field Survey & Project Execution

* Plan, coordinate, and execute field surveying, DGPS, mapping, and infrastructure inspection projects.
* Understand project requirements, survey methodology, site conditions, manpower needs, and equipment requirements before deployment.
* Monitor field progress and ensure survey activities are completed as per project specifications and timelines.
* Visit project sites and actively supervise field execution whenever required.
* Ensure teams are prepared to work in challenging terrain, remote locations, and physically demanding field conditions.

2. Surveyor & DGPS Team Management

* Lead and manage Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, field engineers, and other deployed personnel.
* Allocate work, plan daily routes, monitor productivity, and ensure adequate field coverage.
* Verify that teams understand survey instructions, coordinates, benchmarks, data collection requirements, and project deliverables.
* Resolve field-level challenges related to manpower, equipment, access, productivity, and survey execution.
* Maintain team discipline, accountability, attendance, and adherence to company policies.

3. Client Coordination & Site Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during field execution.
* Coordinate site access, survey requirements, permissions, daily progress, and project schedules.
* Communicate technical and operational issues clearly and professionally.
* Handle client queries, field-level escalations, and execution-related concerns.
* Provide regular progress updates and ensure client expectations are aligned with actual site conditions and project timelines.

4. Survey Quality & Technical Coordination

* Review survey records, field measurements, DGPS observations, coordinates, and daily field reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, survey procedures, and required accuracy standards.
* Coordinate with GIS, data processing, and project teams for data transfer, validation, and final deliverables.
* Identify gaps, errors, and incomplete field data and arrange corrective action.
* Maintain proper documentation and ensure data completeness before project closure.

5. Planning, Logistics & Equipment Management

* Plan manpower deployment, travel, accommodation, local transportation, and field logistics.
* Coordinate the movement and availability of DGPS equipment, GNSS receivers, survey instruments, drones, batteries, and accessories as applicable.
* Ensure equipment is maintained, handled, and used correctly.
* Anticipate operational risks and arrange resources to minimize downtime and project delays.

6. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

* Prepare daily progress reports, project trackers, manpower reports, and field status updates.
* Monitor project timelines, team productivity, survey coverage, data quality, and pending activities.
* Escalate resource shortages, technical issues, and schedule risks promptly.
* Coordinate with management and internal departments to ensure timely project completion.

Required Experience & QualificationsEssential Requirements

* 3–6 years of experience in civil surveying, DGPS/GNSS surveying, land surveying, infrastructure projects, or field operations.
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Surveying, Geomatics, or a related technical discipline.
* Practical understanding of field survey execution, survey instruments, site measurements, and survey documentation.
* Experience managing or coordinating field teams, preferably Surveyor and DGPS teams.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage client interactions professionally.
* Ability to plan field activities, resolve on-site problems, and manage project deadlines.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, reporting, and project documentation.
* Willingness and physical readiness to work in demanding field conditions and travel extensively across India.

Preferred Experience

* Power transmission line and distribution network surveys.
* Transmission line route surveys and corridor mapping.
* DGPS, GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or similar surveying workflows.
* Railway, highway, solar, industrial, and other infrastructure surveys.
* LiDAR surveys, drone mapping, and geospatial data collection.
* Experience coordinating with government departments, power utilities, EPC contractors, and infrastructure clients.
* Hands-on experience as a Surveyor or Survey Engineer with subsequent team-management responsibilities.

Field Conditions — Please Read Before Applying

Candidates must understand the practical demands of this role:

* Projects may be located in remote, hilly, uneven, forested, rural, or otherwise difficult-to-access areas, depending on the assignment.
* Fieldwork may involve extensive walking, long outdoor working hours, changing weather, and physically demanding site conditions.
* Some projects require extended stays away from Noida, with travel schedules determined by operational requirements.
* The role requires active supervision of Surveyor and DGPS teams, not merely assigning tasks from the office.
* Candidates must be comfortable handling field personnel, resolving site-level issues, and communicating with clients under pressure.
* Work conditions vary by project, and candidates should be prepared for both relatively accessible sites and challenging terrain.

**Please apply only if you are genuinely comfortable with the field requirements and nationwide travel.**

Why Join BetterDrones?

* Work on large-scale power and infrastructure surveying and inspection projects.
* Gain exposure to DGPS, GIS, LiDAR, drone mapping, and advanced geospatial technologies.
* Work with experienced professionals and enterprise infrastructure clients.
* Develop leadership experience in field operations and project execution.
* Build a career in the growing drone and geospatial technology industry.

Who Should Apply?

Civil Engineers, Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, and field professionals who combine **practical surveying knowledge, team-management ability, strong client communication, and a willingness to work in challenging field conditions**.

Candidates with only office-based coordination experience and no relevant field or surveying exposure may not be suitable for this position.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have in Civil Surveying, DGPS/GNSS Surveying, Land Surveying, or Infrastructure Field Operations? Briefly describe your experience.
* Which surveying instruments have you personally operated or used in field projects? Mention your practical experience with DGPS/GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or other survey equipment.
* Describe your experience managing Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, or field survey teams. How many people have you managed, and what were your responsibilities?
* This role involves extensive walking, uneven terrain, remote locations, long outdoor working hours, and physically demanding field conditions. Are you comfortable performing these duties as required? Please explain any relevant field experience.
* Are you willing to travel extensively across India and stay at remote project locations for extended periods according to project requirements? Please confirm clearly.
* Describe a situation where you directly coordinated with a client or site representative during a survey or infrastructure project. What issue arose, and how did you resolve it?
* Our budget for this position is ₹3 LPA to ₹4.2 LPA, depending on experience and suitability. Are you comfortable with this salary range? Please mention your current CTC and expected CTC.
* We are looking for immediate joiners. If selected, how soon can you join? Please mention your current notice period and the earliest confirmed joining date.

title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
Gurugram · Full-time · Senior

#### **About The Position**

**About Coralogix**

Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.

We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.

**The Role**

Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.

Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.

A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.

  
  

**What You Will Build**

**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade
  

  

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets
  

  

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data
  

  

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

#### **Requirements**

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  

  

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones
  

  

**Cultural Fit**

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O
description:
**Position Title:**DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O

**Position Type:** Regular - Full-Time

**Requisition ID:** 45078

Role Overview

The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline.

Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil.

Key Responsibilities

**Platform Engineering & Reliability:** Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services.

**CI/CD & Release Engineering:** Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability.

**DevSecOps Adoption:** Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance.

**Security by Design:** Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

**Infrastructure as Code:** Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling.

**GitOps & Kubernetes:** Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman.

**Toolchain Availability:** Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows.

**Automated Governance:** Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines.

**Observability & Self-Healing:** Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience.

**Performance & Operations:** Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure.

**Cross-Functional Architecture:** Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards.

**AI-Assisted Engineering:** Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability.

**Documentation & Enablement:** Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices.

**Automation Culture:** Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation.

Required Skills and Experience

Core Experience

**10+ years of relevant experience** in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps.

**Hands-on engineering experience** designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks.

**Strong programming and scripting capability** using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages.

**Proven operational discipline** across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation.

**Strong communication and collaboration skills** with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams.

Technical Capabilities Required

**DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, or CNCF certification** is preferred.

**Experience with Agile and DevOps delivery methods** and with planning, estimation, and delivery in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

**Demonstrated learning agility** with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies responsibly.

Preferred Attributes

* Systems thinker who balances developer experience, security, reliability, governance, and cost.
* Self-starter who can operate with appropriate autonomy while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment.
* Pragmatic engineer who favors standards, reusable products, automation, and measurable outcomes over one-off solutions.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect - Source.AI
description:
Job ID: 113274

* Gurugram

Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.**

**YOUR IMPACT**

You will lead the engineering function for Source.AI, McKinsey's GenAI-powered, agentic category-management and sourcing platform.

You will set and drive the end-to-end technical vision across data engineering, data science, and full-stack software development, ensuring the platform is designed, built, and scaled to meet the needs of enterprise procurement clients globally.

You will own technical direction for a multi-surface product stack: AWS based, a NestJS and Next.js monorepo (Nx, pnpm), Python FastAPI microservices, per-client Snowflake data tenants, and an agentic AI layer spanning spend intelligence, market radar, category strategy, negotiation coaching, and tail-spend repricing. You will lead a team of data engineers, data scientists, and full-stack developers, partnering with product leadership and delivery leads to ship the roadmap while maintaining delivery SLAs on live client deployments.

You will architect and operationalize GenAI capabilities at production scale, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), NL2SQL, prompt engineering, vector search, and multi-agent orchestration, all routed through McKinsey's enterprise AI Gateway with Responsible-AI guardrails. You will establish engineering best practices, AI-assisted SDLC workflows, and observability standards so the team ships secure, reliable, and governable AI-driven features on a continuous cadence.

You will play a critical role in scaling Source.AI from a proven PoC portfolio to an enterprise-grade SaaS platform, driving transformative impact by enabling intelligent, scalable, and secure agent-based technologies that unlock measurable savings, productivity, and risk visibility for procurement teams worldwide.

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering or platform architecture, including 3+ years in technical leadership or people management roles leading cross-functional engineering teams
* Proven track record building and scaling GenAI products in production, with ownership of architecture, delivery, post-launch iteration, reliability, and performance
* Experience leading teams across data engineering, data science, and full-stack development, with the ability to set technical direction, mentor senior ICs, and drive accountability across workstreams

* Knowledge of AI governance, security, compliance, and observability, including guardrails for safety and reliability, prompt tracing, cost tracking, and failure analysis

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. title: Physical AI Software
description:
**Job Description**
*Business Unit: Mobile Robotics| Function: NPD |Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India*
**Role Overview**
Novus Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz is looking for a Physical AI Software to own the software architecture and technical leadership for autonomous mobile robot (AMR) platforms within the Mobile Robotics business. This role sits at the intersection of classical autonomy stacks (perception, localization, navigation, control) and emerging Physical AI capabilities such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and Vision-Language Models (VLM), and is directly responsible for taking systems from prototype to reliable, field-deployed fleets. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on robotics software expertise with the leadership skills to mentor a team, drive architecture decisions, and resolve real-world deployment challenges in customer environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Systems Integration**

* Lead end-to-end software architecture for mobile robotics platforms — perception, localization/SLAM, navigation, motion control, and safety systems.
* Own design decisions around ROS/ROS 2 middleware, sensor fusion pipelines, and modular hardware abstraction layers.
* Act as technical lead for fleet-level coordination and communication interfaces (REST, MQTT, CAN).
* Set technical direction and coding/architecture standards for the team; review designs and code from other engineers.

**Physical AI, VLA/VLM & Perception**

* Drive integration of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and Vision-Language Model (VLM) capabilities into the autonomy stack for tasks such as semantic scene understanding, instruction-conditioned navigation, and object/task-level reasoning.
* Own the Visual SLAM pipeline (e.g., ORB-SLAM, VINS, RTAB-Map or equivalent) for robust localization and mapping across dynamic, GPS-denied, and visually repetitive warehouse/industrial environments.
* Evaluate, fine-tune, and productionize foundation-model-based perception and reasoning components, balancing on-robot compute constraints with model accuracy and latency.
* Integrate and validate AI/ML models in production for localization, obstacle detection, and object/pallet identification.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4-6 years of experience in mobile robotics / autonomous systems software, with demonstrated ownership of production AMR deployments.
* Strong hands-on experience with ROS / ROS 2, including middleware architecture and sensor fusion.
* Proven experience with Visual SLAM techniques and libraries, and a solid grasp of localization and mapping in real-world, GPS-denied environments.
* Working knowledge of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and/or Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches, and how to integrate foundation-model-based perception into constrained, real-time robotic systems.
* Practical experience with controllers such as PID, Stanley, or Model Predictive Control (MPC) for motion/velocity control.
* Demonstrated track record of diagnosing and resolving field/deployment issues in live customer or warehouse environments (not simulation-only experience).
* Proficiency in Python and C++ for robotics software development; familiarity with OpenCV, NumPy/SciPy, and standard ROS toolchains.
* Experience with fleet-level communication protocols (REST, MQTT, CAN) and hardware-in-the-loop or simulation-based testing frameworks.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a small technical team, or clear readiness to step into a team-lead capacity.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Engineering (Robotics, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline) required

**About Novus Hi-tech Robotic Systemz**
Novus Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz Pvt. Ltd. builds autonomous systems across ADAS, ADAS Aftermarket, Mobile Robotics, and Defence Robotics. The Mobile Robotics business unit focuses on autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for warehouse, industrial, and logistics environments, combining perception, navigation, and AI to deliver reliable, field-ready autonomy at scale.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Head of Delivery
description:
- Description

  The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

  You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

  **Portfolio and P&L**

  * Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.
  * Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.
  * Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.
  * Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

  **Delivery operating model**

  * Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.
  * Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.
  * Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.
  * Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

  **Client delivery governance**

  * Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.
  * Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.
  * Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

  **Pre-sales support**

  * Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.
  * Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

  **People and leadership**

  * Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.
  * Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.
  * Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

  **Quality and compliance**

  * Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.
  * Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

  Required Skills

  * 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.
  * Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.\
  * Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.
  * Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.
  * Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.
  * Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.
  * Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.
  * Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.
  * Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

  **Nice to have**

  * Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.
  * Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.
  * Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.
  * PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.
  * Has built a PMO or delivery excellence function from scratch.

This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.

* Assist in developing process mining use cases, KPIs and dashboards by leveraging transactional and master data from enterprise systems.
* Lead a team of Senior Consultants and independently drive client discussions and communications.
* Groom junior resources and participate in business development activities.
* Provide timely and constructive feedback to junior staff and manage team/individual KPIs and other performance metrices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Hands-on experience with:
* Process Mining & Analytics

+ Experience with Celonis, Signavio, ARIS Process Mining or similar platforms preferred.
+ Candidates with strong SQL, ETL, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience and willingness to learn Process Mining are encouraged to apply.
+ Understanding of business process analysis, workflow optimization and operational excellence concepts.

+ Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
+ Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.
+ Experience working with large transactional datasets from ERP and enterprise applications.
+ Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.

+ Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
+ Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.

+ Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.

* Enterprise Platforms

+ SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in computer science, data science or a related field.
* 8 to 10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

+ Process Mining
+ Data Analytics
+ Data Engineering
+ Business Intelligence
+ Process Improvement

* Experience working with Big4 is a strong advantage.
* A valid passport for travel.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience creating event logs and process datasets from SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365 or other ERP platforms.
* Exposure to process mining concepts such as event logs, case IDs, process variants, conformance checking and root cause analysis.
* Knowledge of process mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio or ARIS is desirable but not mandatory.
* Experience with data integration, data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms.
* Understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), HR or similar business processes.

Data AI/ML combines advanced statistical modeling, computational power, and data engineering to build intelligent systems that can learn, adapt, and automate decisions.
  
  

* Independently design and implement scalable machine learning solutions and data systems, ensuring end to end workflows, large scale analytics and reliability
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into data engineering solutions, evaluate user journeys and challenge business requirements to ensure seamless, value driven delivery and integration of solutions
* Implement and refine feature engineering, monitoring, ML pipelines, deploy models in production, and address challenges in data pipelines
* Apply innovative problem-solving techniques, leveraging advanced methodologies to find unique approaches to complex problems and improve outcomes
* Investigate and resolve complex challenges in data models and deployment to ensure reliable solutions that meet performance benchmarks

description:
