title: Business Analytics Analyst- Generative AI
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**About CITI**

Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have 200 years of experience helping our clients meet the world's toughest challenges and embrace its greatest opportunities.

  
  

**Citi Analytics and Information Management (AIM)**

Citi AIM was established in 2003 and is located across multiple cities in India - Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram and Pune. It is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. It identifies fact-based opportunities for revenue growth in partnership with the businesses. The function balances customer needs, business strategy, and profit objectives using best in class and relevant analytic methodologies.

  
  

**What we do?**

The US Consumer Cards (USCC) – Digital Product Analytics Team is a specialized function dedicated to understanding, measuring, and improving the servicing and marketing experience across all digital platforms. We are a dynamic and data-driven team focused on accelerating digital growth, enhancing customer engagement, and driving operational efficiency. By leveraging cutting-edge analytics and Gen-AI, we identify and act on opportunities to improve the customer lifecycle, increase digital revenue, and reduce service costs. We foster a culture of continuous learning and rapid experimentation to deliver impactful digital experiences that resonate with our customers. Our mission is to leverage data and insights to make our digital platforms the preferred channels for our customers, ultimately driving revenue and efficiency.

  
  

**Role Description:**

  
  

The Business Analytics Analyst (C10) is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

**Few notables among the multiple areas that we work in:**

* **Drive Digital Marketing, Product Sales & Engagement:**
  + Develop and execute sophisticated digital marketing strategies to significantly grow digital product sales and increase customer footfall and stickiness on our platforms.
  + Analyze user behavior and campaign performance to identify new opportunities for engagement and revenue generation.
* **Optimizing Digital Servicing Channels (Website & Mobile App):**
  + Conduct deep-dive analyses of our website and mobile app to identify and eliminate points of friction in the customer service journey, making them more intuitive, efficient, and user-friendly.
  + Analyze customer interaction data to find opportunities to streamline the digital experience, reducing the need for customers to resort to calls or chats.
* **Leverage Advanced Analytics and AI:**
  + Apply Gen-AI powered analysis to enhance customer interactions, particularly in areas like Chatbot performance and personalized user experiences.
  + Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI solutions using techniques such as prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI models with frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.
  + Use analytical intelligence to uncover deep insights that inform strategies for reducing our cost-to-serve and improving overall efficiency across the customer lifecycle.
* **Fostering a Culture of Experimentation:**
  + Lead the industrialization and enhancement of our "Test & Learn" capability, enabling the rapid design, execution, and measurement of experiments for new digital features and marketing campaigns.
  + Utilize A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other experimentation techniques to generate actionable insights and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Interpret complex data sets to identify significant trends, patterns, and anomalies, translating these into clear, concise, and impactful insights that support informed decision-making for business partners and senior leadership.
* Identifies and compiles data sets using a variety of tools (e.g. SQL, Python, PySpark) to help predict, improve, and measure the success of key business to business outcomes.
* Utilize statistical methods and analytical tools to extract meaningful insights from large and complex datasets.
* Responsible for documenting data requirements, data collection / processing / cleaning, and exploratory data analysis, which may include utilizing statistical models / algorithms and data visualization techniques.
* Incumbents in this role may often be referred to as Data Scientists.

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands-on Experience in Python, SQL & Machine Learning (ML) is a must. Experience with PySpark is preferred.
* Proficiency in GenAI technologies including prompt engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, and the development of Agentic AI.
* Familiarity with GenAI governance principles and best practices to ensure responsible and compliant AI development.
* Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code according to design specifications and coding standards.
* Knowledge of digital marketing and Credit Card business, and industry best practices is highly beneficial.
* Experience working and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to guide and mentor the junior team members. Ability to build partnerships with cross-functional teams.
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with at least 3 years of working experience OR Master's Degree with 2 years of working experience.
* Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the management in a structured and simpler form.
* Hands-on experience working with large, complex, unstructured dataset, data warehouses and ability to pull data using relevant programs and coding.
* Experience in working on Investment Analytics, Retail Analytics, Credit Cards, Services, Banking & Markets Financial Services be nice to have.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be organized, detail oriented, flexible, and adaptive to matrix work environment.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in Python, PySpark, Hive, Impala, SQL programing will be preferred.
* Credit card Business and P&L experience would be preferred.
* Knowledge on Adobe, Test & Learn and other web analytics tool.

Role: Observability (O11y) Engineer (Enterprise Observability Platform)

Location: Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad (In-person)

We are building a next-generation Enterprise Observability Platform using Splunk Enterprise, ITSI, and Splunk Observability Cloud (O11y) for our clients. We are seeking a Splunk O11Y- Observability Engineer to lead the design, deployment, and enablement of observability capabilities across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

This role focuses on instrumentation, telemetry pipeline engineering, service modeling, APM rollout, and onboarding new teams into the observability ecosystem. The engineer will work closely with application owners, SRE, DevOps, and platform engineering teams to deliver full-stack visibility and accelerate observability adoption.

  

Key Responsibilities

Observability Architecture & Implementation

* Design and implement observability solutions using Splunk Observability Cloud (APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, RUM, Log Observer).

* Build and optimize OpenTelemetry (OTel) collector pipelines for metrics, traces, and logs.

* Define instrumentation strategies for applications (auto-instrumentation, SDKs, agents).

* Develop service maps, dependency graphs, and distributed tracing configurations.

Application & Service Onboarding

* Partner with application teams to onboard services into O11y and ITSI.

* Define SLIs/SLOs, KPIs, and service health indicators.

* Build dashboards, detectors, alerts, and anomaly detection rules tailored to each service.

* Ensure consistent tagging, metadata, and observability standards across teams.

ITSI & Splunk Core Integration

* Implement ITSI service models, KPIs, correlation searches, and glass tables.

* Integrate O11y telemetry with Splunk Enterprise and ITSI for unified service health.

* Collaborate with Splunk Core SMEs to align ingestion, retention, and data modeling.

Telemetry Pipeline Engineering

* Deploy and configure OTel collectors across VMs, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services.

* Implement processors, exporters, and routing logic for efficient telemetry flow.

* Optimize pipelines for performance, cost, and reliability.

Enablement & Best Practices

* Develop onboarding guides, instrumentation patterns, and observability standards.

* Conduct workshops, demos, and training sessions for engineering teams.

* Provide architectural guidance on observability adoption across the enterprise.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work with SRE, DevOps, Cloud, and Application teams to embed observability into CI/CD and deployment workflows.

* Support modernization initiatives such as microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud migrations.

* Influence platform roadmap and observability strategy.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

* Hands-on experience implementing Splunk Observability Cloud (APM, Infra Monitoring, RUM, Log Observer).

* Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry (collectors, processors, exporters, instrumentation).

* Experience with distributed tracing, span analysis, and service dependency mapping.

* Familiarity with Splunk Enterprise and ITSI for integrated observability use cases.

* Strong Linux/Unix skills and scripting (Python, Bash).

* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, and Azure).

Implementation & Architecture Skills

* Experience designing observability solutions for microservices, APIs, and distributed systems.

* Ability to guide teams through instrumentation and telemetry onboarding.

* Strong understanding of SLIs/SLOs, service health scoring, and reliability engineering.

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-facing skills.

* Ability to lead workshops and influence engineering teams.

* Strong documentation and architectural thinking.

Preferred Qualifications

* Splunk Observability or OTel certifications.

* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tools.

* Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, or CI/CD pipelines.

* Experience in large enterprise, utilities, financial, or public sector environments.

  
Mandatory Skills: Splunk AIOPS .  
Experience: 5-8 Years .  
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-23

  

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Good data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Passion to write code and build solutions.
* Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Gov.
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 5-7 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

title: Data Scientist
description:
The Data Scientist executes end-to-end Data Science and Machine Learning workflows under guidance to deliver measurable value in industrial operations. You will focus on data acquisition/cleaning, feature engineering, exploratory analysis, model development/validation, and contribute to deployment and monitoring in collaboration with data/platform engineering. Primary use cases include time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance, with Generative AI (GenAI) as an added advantage. Exposure to operations in Oil & Gas, Fossil Power, or Renewable Power is a plus.

**Job Description**
===================

Roles and Responsibilities

* Execute DS/ML tasks across the model lifecycle: data acquisition, quality assessment/cleansing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis on industrial datasets (sensor/telemetry, logs, emissions, maintenance) with reproducible workflows.
* Train, tune, and validate models (regression, classification, and time-series methods such as ARIMA/Prophet; anomaly detection; ensembles). Document experiments and results clearly.
* Collaborate with data/platform engineering to contribute to data pipelines and model serving; support deployment activities and basic monitoring/drift checks under supervision.
* Produce clean, well-structured Python/SQL code; follow coding standards, version control, and experiment tracking practices.
* Create visual analyses and concise summaries to communicate findings and recommendations to teammates and stakeholders; incorporate feedback to iterate.
* Assist in measuring outcomes against success metrics (e.g., reliability, availability, efficiency, emissions, cost) and maintain project artifacts (reports, annotated code).
* Learn industrial context, data sources, and domain constraints; proactively identify data quality issues and propose fixes within established procedures.
* Participate in POCs/pilots, including GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics workflows (analytics automation, documentation) as an added advantage.
  

  

Education Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with minimum 3 years of experience in Data Science/Machine Learning or closely related roles.

  
  

Desired Characteristics

Technical Expertise:

* Proficient in Python and SQL; hands-on with Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; basic exposure to TensorFlow/PyTorch is a plus.
* Applied experience with feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, and performance measurement for time-series and classification/regression problems.
* Solid foundations in data management: ETL basics, data quality checks/cleansing, and working with large datasets.
* Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI) and MLOps concepts (experiment tracking, model registry, monitoring) is a plus.
* Competent in visual analytics for EDA and communicating insights; experience with dashboards or notebooks preferred.
* Familiarity with big data/streaming technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka) and real-time analytics considerations is a plus.

Domain Knowledge:

* Exposure to industrial operations (Oil & Gas, Fossil Power, Renewable Power) is a plus; ability to learn failure modes, maintenance strategies, and process constraints and translate them into features and validation criteria.
* Basic understanding of business drivers and operational KPIs (availability, MTBF/MTTR, throughput, energy yield, emissions, cost) with the ability to connect analytical results to business value.
  

  

Personal Attributes:

* Curiosity and continuous learning mindset; connects ideas and incorporates feedback quickly.
* Comfort in ambiguity at project/task level; states assumptions clearly and adapts based on new information.
* Clear communicator; explains technical information to teammates and stakeholders and asks clarifying questions to ensure shared understanding.

title: IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager
description:
**IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager**
===========================================

**Location:** Bengaluru, India | On-site

**Company:** Ayar Labs

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Great engineering depends on a workplace that works: laptops ready on day one, reliable connectivity, an organized lab, and someone nearby who can figure out what’s wrong and get it fixed.

At Ayar Labs, we’re building optical I/O technology for high-performance computing. We’re looking for a resourceful, hands-on IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager to support our India office and help our engineers do their best work. You’ll be the local person people turn to for technical help and practical solutions, working closely with the office manager and our global IT and lab teams.

This is an on-site role with plenty of variety. One morning, you might help a colleague get connected, set up a new workstation, or troubleshoot hardware with a remote IT teammate. Later, you might organize a lab bench, check a portable clean dry air (CDA) system, or coordinate a repair with a service provider. You’ll manage day-to-day operations through direct, hands-on work, with room to improve how the site runs as it grows.

**What You’ll Achieve**
-----------------------

  

* **An engineering team that can stay focused.** Provide friendly, responsive helpdesk support for computers, software, accounts, connectivity, and meeting-room technology. Help new colleagues get started, keep users informed, and follow issues through to resolution. Work with global IT on access, device setup, updates, and security practices.
  
* **Reliable cloud support for the EDA team.** Support engineering teams in an AWS environment. Partner with global IT and EDA to help provision and maintain Linux compute environments, manage user access, and troubleshoot connectivity, storage, and tool-license access issues so engineers can keep design and simulation workloads running.
  
* **Local hands for a global team.** Be the on-site eyes and hands for remote IT and engineering colleagues. Help install and connect equipment, inspect hardware, trace and label cables, replace approved components, and carry out guided troubleshooting. Capture useful details so specialists can resolve issues quickly.
  
* **Labs and workspaces that are ready to use.** Keep benches, equipment, tools, spares, and supplies organized and easy to find. Maintain practical inventory and maintenance records, support equipment setup and moves, and coordinate service or calibration with lab owners and vendors. Follow lab safety and equipment-handling procedures, including electrostatic discharge (ESD) precautions where applicable.
  
* **Small facilities problems are handled before they become disruptions.** Partner with the office manager on everyday upkeep, minor repairs, and simple installations. Support routine checks and basic upkeep of portable CDA systems and other supporting equipment within your training and approved procedures. Coordinate with building management and qualified service providers when work needs specialist attention, and follow through until it’s complete.
  
* **Better ways of working.** Turn recurring problems into practical improvements. Keep clear support notes, useful checklists, and straightforward how-to guides. Help plan equipment and supply needs, flag risks early, and coordinate priorities with the office manager, IT, and engineering.

**Skills You’ll Need to Bring**
-------------------------------

  

* **5+ years of IT experience**, with hands-on helpdesk, desktop support, systems administration, or similar work supporting employees directly.
  
* A practical troubleshooting foundation across computer hardware, operating systems, business applications, user access, and basic networking. You can work through an unfamiliar problem and recognize when to bring in a specialist.
  
* Comfort with light facilities work: using basic tools, fixing small problems, helping set up workspaces, and learning the routine care of equipment such as portable CDA systems.
  
* Strong organization skills and a habit of leaving labs, workspaces, equipment records, and shared supplies easier for others to use.
  
* Clear communication, patience with users, and dependable follow-through. You can work independently on-site while coordinating effectively with remote colleagues and local vendors.
  

Experience in a semiconductor, electronics, or photonics lab is a plus. Familiarity with Linux, Windows, lab equipment handling, ESD practices, asset tracking, or small-office facilities support will also help. You don’t need to have done every part of this role already; we’re looking for a solid IT foundation, practical judgment, and an interest in learning the rest.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

You’ll see the impact of your work every day: a new hire ready to contribute, a lab setup back in service, or an engineer able to keep working because you spotted and solved a problem. You’ll work close to the engineering team, build experience across IT and lab operations, and help shape a workplace people can rely on.

If you enjoy helping people, working with your hands, and making things run better, we’d like to hear from you.

**NOTE TO RECRUITERS:** Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. Remuneration for recruiting activities is only applicable subject to a signed and executed agreement between the parties. Please don’t send candidates to Ayar Labs, and do not contact our managers.

**About Ayar Labs**
-------------------

At Ayar Labs we’re about to revolutionize computing by moving data with light. We’re unleashing processing power for artificial intelligence, high performance computing, cloud and telecommunications by removing the bottlenecks created by today’s electrical I/O - making it possible to continue scaling computing system performance. Ayar Labs is the first to deliver an optical I/O solution that combines in-package optical I/O chiplets and multi-wavelength remote light sources to replace traditional electrical I/O. This silicon photonics-based I/O solution enables chips to communicate with each other from millimeters to kilometers, to deliver orders of magnitude improvements in latency, bandwidth density, and power consumption.

With our strong collaborations with industry leaders and government, our deep ties to MIT and UC Berkeley, and our commitment to hiring the best engineers in photonics and electronics, joining our team gives you the opportunity to collaborate with renowned experts on challenging, paradigm-shifting work.

We are passionate about delivering in-package optical I/O at scale, leveraging the strength of our patent portfolio and our team of leading interdisciplinary experts. We believe that deep cross-collaboration between teams facilitated by honest, open debate is the best way to drive innovation and achieve big wins. Join our team and experience the possibilities.

title: IT Support Manager
description:
**Company Description**

BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.

BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance.

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers.

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India.

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, 401K, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.

Learn more at betsol.com

 **Job Description**

The IT Support Manager leads the IT support operations and owns major incident management end to end. This person keeps day to day support running well, acts as the senior escalation point, and takes command when an incident impacts a client or our agents. They own the incident management process we recently launched and mature it from a new process into a dependable practice. This is a working manager role: you lead people and process, and you go deep in the technical detail when an incident demands it.

**Why this role exists:** Support and incident work currently escalates to a single point. This role takes ownership of that work, matures the incident process, and gives the team an escalation path and a leader of its own.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**IT Support Operations**

* Own IT support operations end to end: queue health, escalation, and service quality against SLA and CSAT targets.
* Own IT asset and device lifecycle: procurement, provisioning, tracking, and retirement of endpoints and support hardware.
* Own support tooling and vendor spend, including the budget line for support tools and partners, and surface spend decisions to IT leadership.
* Deliver a regular SLA, CSAT, and incident reporting cadence to IT leadership, with trends and improvement actions.

**Major Incident Management**

* Own incident command, coordination, stakeholder communication, and resolution for Sev1 and Sev2 events across our environment.
* Own the incident process: Jira intake, severity definitions, on-call and paging criteria, and enforcement.
* Run post incident reviews for every major incident, with actions tracked to closure, and recurring issues identified and solved through problem management.

**Incident Command**

This is the part of the role that separates a strong hire from a queue manager. When an impacting outage occurs, you are the person who:

* Declares the incident and takes the incident commander seat, or assigns it clearly.
* Runs the bridge and drives the technical response without doing all the hands on work yourself.
* Owns clear, timely stakeholder and client communication, kept separate from the person doing the fix.
* Makes the call on severity, mitigation risk, maintenance windows, and resolution.
* Runs post incident review with actions and named owners.

**People Leadership**

* Lead the support team: coaching, one on ones, growth, and performance.
* Manage our managed support partner as an extension of the team.

**Coordination and Documentation**

* Coordinate with Cybersecurity and Rapid7 MDR during security incidents.
* Coordinate with Professional Services, who own the contact center tooling, during incidents that involve it.
* Own documentation and self service in Confluence so the team resolves more without escalating, and knowledge does not live in one head.

**SYSTEMS AND SERVICES**

You do not need deep hands on expertise in every tool below. You do need enough fluency to command an incident that involves any of them and to know who owns what. The security tooling is owned by our security team and the contact center tooling by our professional services team; you coordinate with those teams during incidents rather than administering their tools.

**Domain Systems and services**

**Identity & access** Okta and SCIM, Microsoft Entra ID

**Endpoint & device** Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender suite, SentinelOne, Secure Remote Worker

**Collaboration & email** Google Workspace, Microsoft Exchange Online, Zoom, Slack

**Contact center & voice** Five9, Nextiva, NICE

**Cloud & infrastructure** AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, GitHub

**ITSM & people ops** Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rippling

**Security operations** Rapid7 InsightIDR and InsightConnect, Rapid7 MDR (24/7), KnowBe4

**Automation & AI** Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, OpenAI

**Category and % Allocation**

**Run** 60%

* Support queue health, triage, and escalation against SLA and CSAT
* Incident command and response for Sev1 and Sev2 events
* Endpoint and support hardware provisioning and lifecycle
* SLA, CSAT, and incident reporting to leadership

**Grow** 30%

* Maturing and enforcing the incident management process
* Managed support partner oversight
* Post incident reviews and problem management to cut recurrence
* Coaching and developing the support team
* Self service and documentation in Confluence

**Transform** 10%

* Automating support and incident workflows
* Scaling support coverage and on-call maturity as the business grows
* Deepening coordination with Cybersecurity and Professional Services

 **Qualifications**

**Required**

* Five to eight years in IT support, service desk, or technical operations, with the senior end preferred given the incident command scope.
* Proven experience running major incidents as incident commander, not just logging or reporting on them.
* Experience managing an IT support or service desk function, with real ownership of SLA and CSAT outcomes.
* People management experience, including coaching and performance.
* Working fluency across identity, endpoint, collaboration, and cloud in a multi cloud (AWS and Azure) environment.
* Experience running or maturing an incident process, ideally in Jira.
* Strong written and verbal communication, especially under pressure and with non technical and client stakeholders.
* Experience with compliance frameworks such as HITRUST or SOC 2 and the incident evidence they require.

**Preferred**

* Background in a CX or a contact center environment, and familiarity with platforms like Five9, Nextiva, NICE.
* Hands on with Okta, Entra ID, Intune, or Microsoft Defender.
* ITIL certification, or demonstrated experience running ITIL aligned incident and problem management.
* Experience managing a managed service partner such as BETSOL.
* Familiarity with ThinScale SRW (BYOD endpoint management).

  
**Additional Information**

Working Hours would be 4PM to 1AM IST

This role will be part of the on-call pager escalation path, but will not be the primary on-call support

Number of people reporting to this position - 4 to 5 (Help Desk and Sys Admins)

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Prompt engineering.
* Embeddings and semantic search.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Vector databases.
* Fine-tuning or adaptation of foundation models.
* AI agents and tool/function calling.
* LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Cloud & MLOps

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform

Knowledge of:

* Docker and containerization.
* CI/CD.
* Model deployment and monitoring.
* ML pipelines.
* MLOps practices.
* Kubernetes or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 5–10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on

experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.

* Proven experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions in real-world or

enterprise environments.

* Experience taking AI/ML models from experimentation/prototype stage through

production deployment is highly desirable.

* Candidates should demonstrate strong practical problem-solving ability rather than

purely academic or theoretical knowledge.

* Experience working in cross-functional or distributed technology teams is

preferred.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering,

Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

* Equivalent professional experience and strong technical expertise may also be

considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:

* Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
* Enterprise AI platforms.
* Azure AI / AWS AI / Google Cloud AI services.
* MLOps and production ML systems.
* NLP and conversational AI.
* Computer vision.
* AI-powered automation.
* Predictive analytics.
* Big Data technologies.
* API development and microservices.
* .NET/Java/Python-based enterprise application integration.
* Experience working with international clients or multinational organizations.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI

solutions.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multicultural team.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging AI technologies.
* Strong attention to quality, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Location & Mobility

**Work Location: Malaysia**

Candidate Source: India

Candidates currently based in India who are willing to relocate to Malaysia will be

considered.

International candidates with relevant experience and the ability to work from Malaysia

may also be considered based on project and employment requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working with multicultural and geographically

distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering capability.
* Experience solving complex real-world problems using AI/ML.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Good understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle.
* Practical experience with modern AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business

stakeholders.

Candidates with 5–10 years of experience who have progressed from hands-on AI/ML

development into senior-level technical ownership are especially encouraged to

apply.

Engagement Opportunity

The final role title, responsibilities, technology stack, and seniority will be aligned with the

candidate’s experience, technical specialization, and project requirements.

Potential positions may include:

* Senior AI/ML Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* AI Engineer
* Senior Data Scientist
* Applied AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* LLM Engineer
* AI/ML Technical Specialist
* AI/ML Architect

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Total years of experience.
* Relevant AI/ML experience.
* Current location in India.
* Current/expected compensation.
* Notice period/availability.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.
* Summary of key AI/ML projects handled.
* Details of relevant technical skills, frameworks, cloud platforms, and AI/ML

technologies.

* GitHub, portfolio, publications, or project links, where applicable.

Equal Opportunity

We encourage applications from qualified AI/ML professionals with diverse technical

backgrounds and industry experience. Selection will be based on relevant skills,

experience, technical capability, and suitability for the assigned project and role.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Professional Services experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  
  
AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.  
  
AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.  
  
Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
* Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
* Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
* Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
* Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
* Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
* Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
* Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
* Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
* Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

  
A day in the life  
As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
* 5+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
* 5+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
* 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
* Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
* Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
* Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. As the Technical Program Manager for AI Platform, you'll turn our internal AI components and platform foundations into golden paths for the Product & Tech teams shipping AI experiences to customers. ### **You Will**

* **Own the shared-foundations program.** Maintain the view of components that multiple feature teams need (agent handoff, identity, context, memory, governance, and more). Drive a single accountable owner, clear roles, and decision dates for each, overlaying team roadmaps without replacing them.
* **Drive cross-team decisions to closure.** Frame the decisions that unblock architecture, sequence product, UX, and engineering inputs, and run working sessions with named owners and dated action items.
* **Scale an innersource model.** Partner with engineering to establish a contribution-based approach for shared AI components: versioned templates, reference implementations, and docs that anyone can improve through review, with clear guidelines, release processes, and safe staged rollout.
* **Report on platform scorecard.** Define metrics that capture ecosystem leverage, adoption, quality, and team velocity. Set baselines and targets, secure instrumentation, and bring the results into leadership and stakeholder reporting.
* **Reduce duplication.** Identify capabilities built in multiple places and drive consolidation/unification, tracking those migration plans across teams.
* **Partner on governance.** Work with security, identity, audit, and legal teams to continually iterate and track responsible AI requirements within the platform.
* **Communicate clearly.** Write decision-first updates tailored to leaders and project stakeholders.

### **You Have**

* 2-4 years of technical program management on platform, infrastructure, or developer-experience programs spanning many teams and timezones.
* Fluency in LLM & agent systems: orchestration, tool use, MCP, memory, context, evals.
* Experience defining platform or developer metrics: baselines, targets, instrumentation, and adoption measures. You've made invisible infrastructure work visible to leadership.
* Experience enabling shared components through SDK-style or innersource models, including versioning and release management.
* Proven ability to lead without authority across engineering, product, UX, and security.
* Strong planning discipline: dependency mapping, risk tracking, capacity awareness.
* Excellent written communication, especially decision memos and executive reporting.
* Legally eligible and available to work a hybrid schedule in BLR office.

* Familiarity with agent interoperability protocols and data platform governance tooling.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: AI / ML internship in degradation modelling for Li-ion batteries
description:
**We’re hiring: AI/ML Engineering Intern at Bridgegreen Upcycle, Chennai 🔋**

Predicting how a second-life battery will age is a hard problem. Getting it right decides whether a repurposed pack is a reliable product or a warranty liability.

At Bridgegreen Upcycle, we’re building the data and modelling foundation to answer that question for real batteries in the field. We're looking for an intern who wants to work where machine learning, physics, electrochemistry and engineering insights meet.

**What you’ll do**

* Clean, validate, and analyse real-world battery datasets
* Improve our ML models through structured experiments, benchmarking, and cross-validation
* Build feature engineering and numerical modelling pipelines
* Read battery and electrochemistry literature and turn it into better models
* Keep your experiments reproducible, with clean code, Git, and clear write-ups

**Who you are**

* A final-year or current Master’s student in CS, AI, Data Science, Physics, Applied Maths, or EE/ME/ChemE
* Strong in Python, with solid ML fundamentals and comfortable with numerical methods
* You’ve built at least one project in PyTorch using CUDA/GPU, whether personal, academic, or hobby
* Curious about how batteries actually degrade, and happy to work on open-ended R&D problems

**What you’ll get**

Hands-on work with real battery data, exposure to scientific ML and physics-informed modelling, and close mentorship on problems that go straight into products.

📍 On-site at our Recharge Center, Marai Malai Nagar, Chennai

⏳ 3 months | Starts immediately

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a GitHub link or project write-up to info@bridgegreenupcycle.com. Please include JDI-014 in the subject line.

description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Data Engineers with strong PySpark and data engineering expertise to deliver AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s enterprise customers.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize scalable data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will collaborate with customer technical teams, solution architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems for generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; support platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply Oracle product capabilities in customer deployments.
  
  

* 5–8 years of experience designing, building, and delivering scalable data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Software Engineer, AI Engineer, Consulting Engineer, or similar technical role.
* Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms like Databricks.
* Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, and modern data ecosystems; experience with Scala, Java, or Kafka is a plus.
* Exposure to building AI agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Strong understanding of Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance optimization, and tuning.
* Experience modernizing analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Working understanding of networking concepts to support data connectivity, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Strong communication, customer collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Design and deliver Oracle AI Data Platform solutions, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Build scalable, governed, AI-ready data pipelines, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
****The Role****
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Applied AI team. This is a hands-on, generalist role working across Arcadia’s core ML and AI workstreams: utility data extraction, consumption forecasting, and agent-powered production workflows. You will work directly with senior data scientists and engineering to build, evaluate, and ship models that drive meaningful impact on central business operations.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to applied ML—from building classifiers and forecasting models to tuning prompts and supporting evaluation frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and extend production ML models for utility bill data extraction, including classifier and routing logic, LLM extraction prompts, and template confidence and accuracy analysis
* Build and iterate on forecasting models for operational use cases: predicting bill availability, estimating utility spend, and surfacing prioritization signals
* Contribute to audit and anomaly detection work—analyzing flagged bills, quantifying error rates, and helping tune tolerance thresholds
* Participate in offline experimentation and champion/challenger evaluations; document results clearly and compellingly to guide business decisions
* Work with data teams and subject matter experts to source, understand, and validate data; surface data quality issues proactively
* Write clean, well-documented Python code; contribute to shared notebooks and model development pipelines
* Collaborate with engineering to support model integration and monitoring; contribute to design docs and relevant code reviews

**What We're Not Looking For**
This is not a research role, a pure NLP or LLM engineering role, or a data analytics/BI role. Candidates whose experience is primarily in dashboarding, reporting, or model-free data work are not a fit. Candidates who have only worked in academic or research settings without production deployment experience should be screened carefully.
  
  
**What Will Help You Succeed**

* 1–3 years of experience building and evaluating ML models in a professional or research setting
* Solid foundation in statistics, supervised learning, classification, regression, and evaluation methodology (precision/recall, cross-validation, holdout testing)
* Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and SQL
* Experience with time series data or forecasting is a plus
* Exposure to generative AI tools and LLM-based workflows
* Ability to work iteratively and independently—formulate assumptions, document them, and advance projects without constant direction
* Clear communicator: able to explain what a model does and what its results mean to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience
