title: Senior Specialist - Embedded Testing
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Responsible for Handling an Embedded Testing Team across Protection & Controls product lines and responsible for planning, designing, developing, and executing comprehensive test strategies to ensure the delivery of high‑quality products. This role involves close collaboration with development, product, and engineering teams to test/validate embedded products and Will lead testing strategies, identify issues early, automate test processes, and drive continuous quality improvements, develop automation frameworks.

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

* Conduct comprehensive functionality testing across protection and control products to ensure reliable operation under normal and fault conditions.
* Validate correct operation of protection schemes by simulating fault conditions and verifying product response.
* Expert in validating and testing industrial communication protocols like IEC 61850, IEC 60870, Modbus, DNP3
* Design and develop advanced test automation frameworks and scripts to enhance testing efficiency, accuracy, and coverage for embedded systems and communication protocols.
* Design, develop, and operate advanced Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Firmware-in-the-Loop (FIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test environments to simulate real-world grid conditions and validate embedded firmware performance.
* Extensive hands-on experience in testing and validating embedded communication interfaces and tools, including Serial Port Monitor, Tera Term, and Wireshark, along with modules such as Wi-Fi, BLE, USB, and Ethernet, ensuring reliable connectivity, data integrity, and protocol compliance.
* Conduct R&D for power system domain applications.
* Perform deep-dive debugging of embedded firmware and hardware interactions during system failures, utilizing oscilloscopes and logic analysers for detailed signal and timing analysis.
* Develop and interpret wiring diagrams to ensure accurate system understanding and effective fault isolation.
* Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and design documents.
* Define and implement overall testing strategies including functional, regression, performance, security, and automation testing.
* Knowledge in understanding Product Requirements, Marketing Requirements and deriving System Integration test cases.
* Contribute to risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
* Should be highly creative in coming up with out-of-box scenarios for testing and bugs
* Identify, analyse, and document defects using tracking tools
* Track defects through resolution and verify fixes
* Provide clear test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to ensure testability and quality in every stage of development.
* Participate in design and code reviews with a quality-first perspective.
* Advocate for quality engineering practices and continuous improvement.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers.
* Lead test initiatives for large features or project modules.
* Perform end-to-end system analysis and design of complex systems (hardware, software, communications).
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Help establish and refine QA standards, processes, and documentation.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in electrical/Electronics/Software Engineering (or) Equivalent
* Minimum 10 to 15 years related Experiences in Protective Relaying & Substation Communication Solutions and Lateral Protection (Medium/High Voltage Products).
* Should have programming knowledge on Python, java, java script, Bash,Golang.
* Hands-on experience with IEC 61850 testing tools (e.g., Omicron IED Scout, Triangle Microworks test harness).
* Experience developing products in an Agile environment and understanding of SDLC, STLC
* Knowledge of secure communication protocols, authentication mechanisms, and data encryption techniques
* Experience with version control systems (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments (Azure/AWS/GCP)
* Added advantageof having Certified ISTQB Foundation level
* Experience on working with the test kit like Omicron CMC356,500, CPC100 and various make secondary/primary injection test kit
* Should have experience in Designing, Developing, and Testing real time embedded products.
* Should have knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical and Embedded Parameters
* Must Demonstrate consistent and sustainable application of problem solving and analytical skills.
* Competent working with Microsoft Office & related software operating on a Windows platform.

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

title: Software Development Engineer, FinTech - TFAW
description:
**Description**
Do you want to build machine learning and agentic-AI systems that analyze billions of dollars in transactions every day, and measure your impact in millions of dollars saved?
  
  
In Amazon's Finance Technology group, we build the detection systems (machine learning, and increasingly agentic AI) that defend Amazon against theft, fraud, abuse, and waste across the supply chain, retail catalog, and corporate procurement. We turn terabytes of transaction, vendor, and operational data into real-time risk decisions: scoring payments as they happen, surfacing anomalous behavior, and uncovering collusion networks that span thousands of entities.
  
  
We're now building the next generation of that platform around generative and agentic AI: multi-agent systems that discover fraud patterns directly from the raw data flowing through Amazon's businesses, working alongside domain experts to turn what they find into production detection logic. The result is a platform where new detection coverage comes not only from engineers, but from agents and the experts who know the fraud best, shipping in days instead of sprints.
  
  
You'll build the agent tools, ML pipelines, services, and data infrastructure behind all of this, working with generative AI, large language models, and agent frameworks alongside the anomaly-detection, classification, and graph-modeling techniques they build on. You'll partner directly with applied scientists, fellow engineers, and finance operations teams, and you'll see your ideas reach production in weeks.
  
  
If you want to apply advanced ML and agentic AI at Amazon scale, on systems with a direct, measurable financial impact, we'd love to talk.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You Will Participate In The Full Software Development Lifecycle, From Collaborating With Customers And Scientists On Design, To Building Scalable, Extensible Systems That Run In Production. You Will
  
  
Design and build ML pipelines that process terabytes of data and score billions of dollars in transactions.
  
  
Build agentic AI applications: LLM-powered agents that discover risk patterns and generate detection logic, operating through well-defined tool interfaces with human-in-the-loop review.
  
  
Build the knowledge and memory systems agents depend on: vector stores, knowledge graphs, the entity-risk layer for cross-entity collusion detection, and in-session and shared memory.
  
  
Develop how we evaluate agent effectiveness in fraud detection, and turn analysts' ad-hoc investigation patterns into repeatable, templated workflows.
  
  
Build the platform and tooling (governed data access, model deployment, and self-service rule authoring) that lets agents and non-engineers ship detection logic safely and fast.
  
  
Take models and agents from prototype to reliable, real-time production systems, and work directly with internal customers to turn feedback into shipped improvements.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You'll partner with applied scientists, software engineers, and finance operations teams across Amazon. You'll harden an agent pipeline for production, extend the entity graph that powers a new detector, or design a tool interface that lets an agent query data safely, then review it with the customer who'll use it. Because our team and our customers are comfortable trying new ideas, you'll get your work in front of real data quickly and iterate on what you learn.
  
  
**About The Team**
We own the machine learning and agentic-AI systems that prevent, recover, and avoid internal and external theft, fraud, abuse, and waste across Amazon Finance Operations. Our platform makes real-time risk decisions on transactions from many of Amazon's largest businesses. We're actively building toward entity-level risk profiles updated in real time, and agentic systems that compress fraud discovery and investigation from weeks to days, with engineers building the leverage layer that multiplies what every analyst and agent can do.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience in processing data with a massively parallel technology (such as Redshift, Teradata, Netezza, Spark or Hadoop based big data solution)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. High (for L08) — requires balancing quality/latency, integrating multiple enterprise tools, and ensuring reproducible evaluation under evolving requirements.

Yes — frequent interactions with platform, product/domain, security, SRE/observability, and enterprise app owners.

**Key Skills/Experience Required Minimum Qualifications:**

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**
:
  
  
Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.
  
  
We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.
  
  
**About the opportunity:**
As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.
  
  
You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
  
  
You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.
* Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

**Your technical toolkit:**
**Languages and software engineering**
Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.
  
  
**Models and AI ecosystem**
Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.
  
  
**Agentic AI engineering**
Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.
  
  
**Retrieval and search**
Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.
  
  
**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**
End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.
  
  
**Frameworks**
Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.
  
  
**MLOps and LLMOps**
CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.
  
  
**Data and ML foundations**
Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.
  
  
**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: The Core Engineering - KYC Model Eng - Vice President - Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
**About Compliance Engineering**
The Core Engineering is a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm.
  
  
Our engineers have access to the latest technology and massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, leveraging modern frameworks to build responsive, intuitive front-end and Big Data applications. The firm is making a significant investment to uplift and rebuild the Compliance application portfolio.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on
**Vice President (VP), Full-Stack Engineer**
to join our technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications.
  
  
As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence—actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions.
  
  
Experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations is expected for this role to help build intelligent, AI-enabled engineering solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture
* System Design: Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure full-stack applications, microservices, and APIs that align with enterprise standards.
* Technology Strategy: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends (including AI-assisted development) to continuously modernize our frontend and backend tech stack.
* Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices across frontend and backend systems.
* Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Hands-on Engineering
* Full-Stack Development: Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code across both frontend user interfaces and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, React or Angular, and Python.
* Backend Development: Design and implement scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
* ETL Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows using Spring Batch. This includes configuring components for complex data transformations and high-volume ingestion.
* API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability.
* Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle) and non-relational (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) databases.
* AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes.
* Team Mentorship & Collaboration
* Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline.
* Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
**Education & Experience**

* Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.

**Technical Skills**

* Backend Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services.
* Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Spring Boot and Spring Batch. Must understand job partitioning, multi-threaded steps, and fault-tolerance policies (skip/retry).
* Frontend Expertise: Strong front-end development experience using React or Angular to build responsive, user-focused web applications.
* Python Development: Solid Python development experience for automation, services, scripting, analytics workflows, or platform enablement.
* AI & Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features.
* Architecture & Design: Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns.
* Messaging & Streaming: Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and messaging-based integrations using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ for real-time data triggers.
* SQL Mastery: Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning across SQL and NoSQL technologies.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit to our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. title: Lead – AI-Native Applications/ Lead FDE
description:
**About The Ksquare Group**

The Ksquare Group is a global technology consulting company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with over 14 years of experience delivering technology solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, AI, and network engineering for clients in Banking & Financial Services, Public Sector, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Logistics, Healthcare, and Enterprise Services. With a team of 350+ professionals across the US, Mexico, the Dominican Republic and India, we help organizations solve complex business challenges and achieve measurable outcomes through our collaborative POD-based delivery model. At The Ksquare Group, we foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth, empowering our teams to make a meaningful impact for clients worldwide.

**Role summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Fullstack Lead who builds AI-native applications end to end, from React or Vue.js front ends to agentic back ends. You will lead a small engineering pod, shape solutions with clients, and own delivery of production-grade conversational and agentic AI products. You bring deep knowledge of at least one business domain and turn its problems into well-designed software.
 

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead design and development of fullstack applications using React or Vue.js front ends with Node.js, Python, Java or .NET back ends.
* Build conversational AI and agentic AI features using LangChain (and LangGraph or similar), including tool calling, RAG, memory and multi-step workflows.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions, estimates and delivery plans; contribute to proposals and solution walkthroughs.
* Own application design: APIs, data models, front-end architecture, prompt and agent design, and integration with LLM providers.
* Deploy and run applications on cloud-native platforms (GCP, AWS or Azure) using containers, serverless, managed AI services and CI/CD.
* Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of 4–8 engineers; set coding standards and drive engineering best practices.
* Ensure quality, security, observability and cost-efficiency of AI applications, including LLM evaluation, guardrails and monitoring.
* Act as the main technical point of contact for client stakeholders; communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.
* Apply domain expertise to identify high-value AI use cases and shape product direction.

**Required skills and experience**

* 7+ years of professional software development, with solid fullstack delivery experience.
* Strong front-end expertise in React or Vue.js (component design, state management, TypeScript) and back-end expertise in at least one of Node.js (Express, NestJS), Python (FastAPI, Django), Java (Spring Boot) or .NET (ASP.NET Core).
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience building conversational AI and agentic AI applications using LangChain or equivalent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain4j, Semantic Kernel).
* Working knowledge of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini or similar), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and RAG patterns.
* Must have cloud-native experience on at least one of Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.
* Mandatory hands-on DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure automation, release management and production monitoring.
* Expertise in at least one business domain (e.g., BFSI, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, logistics, telecom).
* Proven track record of delivering projects on time and to quality, ideally in client-facing or consulting environments.
* Solutioning mindset: able to break down ambiguous problems and propose pragmatic, scalable solutions.
* Excellent design skills across system design, API design and UI/UX sensibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Exposure to LLMOps tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery and team leadership in distributed teams.

title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication

title: Product Data Scientist - AI & Analytics
description:
**About Quin**
Quin builds intelligent safety systems that combine hardware, software and real-time data to detect critical events and connect people to help when it matters most. Our products sit at the intersection of IoT, edge computing, and real-world human behaviour, generating rich datasets that power smarter decisions, better user experiences, and ultimately save lives.
  
  
**The role**
We're hiring a Data Scientist to drive how Quin measures its products, and turn that data into AI our customers and team rely on every day.
  
  
Building on our existing data foundation, you’ll lead execution on analytics across our core products. That covers everything from Amplitude instrumentation to the metrics, dashboards, and predictive modelling that drive product and marketing decisions.
  
  
From there, you’ll help take data further with AI. You’ll bring intelligent features into our products and explore how agents can build on your work: surfacing insights faster, scaling analysis across products, and opening up new ways for the team to use data. You’ll decide where AI adds the most value, then design and ship it to run reliably in production.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Your work splits into three areas:
  
  

* Instrumentation and metrics
* Own the tracking plan and event taxonomy across our core products.
* Implement Amplitude instrumentation client-side and server-side with engineering.
* Build pipelines from Amplitude and other sources into our warehouse, with data-quality checks.
* Define one documented metrics layer for activation, engagement, retention, conversion and LTV.
* Analytics and dashboards
* Build real-time dashboards for product, marketing and leadership, each tied to a decision.
* Run the analysis behind product and marketing decisions: funnels, cohorts, retention and feature adoption.
* Collaborate with Marketing to design and read out A/B tests.
* Build predictive models for churn, segmentation, and conversion that feed product and lifecycle decisions.
* AI on top of the metrics layer
* Bring AI features into our customer-facing products, working with engineering from prototype to production
* Build agents that run securely in isolated, containerised environments, with tightly scoped access to data and tools.

**What We're Looking For**
**Analytics and data**

* 4+ years in product analytics, data science or analytics engineering, ideally in a product-led company.
* You've owned product instrumentation end to end in Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar: tracking plans, event design, implementation and governance.
* Expert SQL and strong Python.
* Experience modelling data in a cloud warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift or Postgres)
* Strong experimentation and statistics: A/B test design, power analysis, funnel and cohort analysis.
* You've built dashboards that teams use to make decisions.

**AI (hands-on Experience Required)**

* You've built and shipped at least one LLM-powered feature, agent or automation that real users rely on.
* Hands-on with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar), including tool use or function calling, and retrieval (RAG).
* Experience building agents that connect to real data and tools, using frameworks and protocols such as MCP, LangGraph, or the Claude Agent SDK.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with a semantic layer tool such as dbt Semantic Layer or Cube.
* Experience in wearables or IoT products

**Why join Quin**

* Work on a mission-driven product with real world impact.
* Shape Quin's data and AI foundations from the ground up, with real ownership.
* Ship AI features that customers use in production.
* Work across product, engineering, marketing and leadership, not in a silo.
* Join a fast-moving team building at the edge of hardware and AI.

title: Manager I, Data Scientist
description:
Kroll is hiring a Data Science Manager to lead and grow our data science function within the Enterprise Data Group. This role sits at the intersection of technical leadership and strategic delivery — you will shape how data science is practised across the team, own the roadmap for ML and AI initiatives, and develop the talent responsible for bringing those initiatives to life.
  
  
Our program spans fintech product development, digital transformation, process automation with machine learning, business intelligence, data governance, and generative AI. You will lead a team of data scientists who partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders — including professionals from the world's largest financial institutions, law enforcement agencies, and government bodies.
  
  
At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients' most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of junior, intermediate, and senior data scientists — setting technical direction, enabling individual development, and cultivating a high-performance team culture
* Own the end-to-end data science roadmap: prioritise initiatives, manage delivery, and communicate progress and impact to senior leadership and clients
* Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to define problems, scope ML solutions, and translate data science capabilities into measurable business outcomes
* Provide technical oversight across the full ML lifecycle — from problem framing and data validation through model design, experimentation, production deployment, and monitoring
* Establish and uphold team standards around code quality, experimentation rigour, model governance, and responsible AI practices
* Drive adoption and evolution of ML infrastructure on Databricks and Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AKS), including MLOps practices such as CI/CD, model versioning, and drift detection
* Champion LLM and generative AI initiatives — including RAG architecture, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and agentic frameworks — ensuring they are evaluated rigorously and deployed responsibly
* Recruit and retain top data science talent; lead hiring, onboarding, and performance management processes
* Represent data science internally and externally, communicating technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

**Requirements**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field
* 7+ years of applied data science or machine learning experience, including at least 2 years in a people management or technical lead capacity
* Proven track record of delivering ML solutions to production and driving measurable business impact
* Strong Python skills and fluency with the modern ML stack (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, pandas)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks (notebooks, jobs, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and Spark/PySpark
* Production experience on Azure — ideally including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Data Lake
* Breadth across ML domains: traditional/statistical ML, deep learning, NLP, and LLM/GenAI applications, including hands-on experience with prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and agentic workflows
* Experience establishing MLOps practices including CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection, and model versioning
* Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex technical work into clear business narrative for senior leadership and clients
* Strong judgment in prioritisation, tradeoffs, and managing competing stakeholder demands

**Preferred**

* Experience in financial services, risk, compliance, or regulatory domains
* Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), LLM evaluation tooling, and production deployment of GenAI applications
* Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including fairness, explainability, and data privacy
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions

title: Specialist Assistant Manager- Omnichannel Marketing Strategy
description:
**L40 Specialist Assistant Manager- Omnichannel Marketing Strategy**

**Who You Are**

Are you passionate about digital marketing and advertising? Are you driven to understand all the technical details while also able to see the big picture? Are you able to direct and guide teams through the next steps to pull off what may, at first, seem insurmountable? Are you experienced in building consensus among a wide range of stakeholders?

If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with the Demand Gen team within the office of Innovation, Technology and Performance. You’ll join a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo. We are insatiably curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

**What You’ll Do**

As the Omnichannel Marketing Strategist and product owner of journey orchestration, you will be central to connecting the team-building experiences across all marketing channels to deliver user journeys from top-to-bottom of the marketing funnel. You’ll seek out business use cases from varying Deloitte service and industry areas in the B2B space. As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will dive deep into the MarTech stack to understand all facets of the systems we leverage, the processes we employ, and the data we use to tailor personalized experiences with the Deloitte brand.

Working alongside our other product owners, you’ll assist those teams in building, implementing, and scaling architectural designs to provide a complete view of our customers―from anonymous prospects to known customers and beyond. This strategic role will also represent life cycle management objectives across our digital production teams, ensuring we use best practices across all owned/paid channels for privacy, segmentation, and personalization.

The Omnichannel Marketing Strategist must be able to develop relationships with the technical team by speaking their language and understanding their needs. Additionally, this lead will build rapport with key leadership stakeholders by presenting highly technical concepts in simple terms.

**Additional Responsibilities**:

* Facilitate strategic conversations with Deloitte business leaders to define and document business use cases for user journeys
* Document use cases and prioritize based on level-of-effort, needs, and value
* Assess and define technical requirements and integration points as they relate to solution development
* Work with cross-functional teams to clearly link functional scopes back to business value
* Maintain working knowledge of end-to-end solutions, with the ability to identify risks and issues throughout the project timeline
* Own the functional testing of the implemented solutions
* Interface with specific SMEs across Marketing Excellence, including CRM, MarTech, AdTech, Brand, Demand Gen, Sales, and Digital Production to usher in an elevated customer experience and novel marketing data solutions

**Required Qualifications**:

* 8+ years of experience in managing and/or developing digital marketing and advertising solutions
* Robust knowledge of all the various owned and paid digital channels―website and form management, email, SMS, SEM, social media, streaming media, etc.
* Extensive experience with CRMs, CDPs, data integration, data normalization and hygiene, tracking, analytics, data analysis, etc.
* Ability to develop processes in digital marketing that lead to best-in-class results
* Solid footing in marketing strategy―personas, segmentation, journey orchestration, awareness to engagement to conversion objectives, dynamic messaging, etc.
* Background working in a consulting or agency model
* Experience leading enterprise-level integrations and implementations using both first- and third-party solutions
* Proven experience managing end-to-end marketing technology projects; preferably related to marketing databases or marketing campaign tools
* Exceptional ability to translate requests from non-technical stakeholders into operational steps and successful outcomes―and vice-versa
* Experience applying and setting best practices for form conversion with a keen eye on metrics that may suggest abandonment
* Skilled in testing user experiences to increase performance outcomes
* Experience with customer data leveraged for marketing purposes
* Excellent people and presentation skills with a high degree of initiative and dependability
* Strengths in negotiation and conflict resolution
* BS/BA Degree or equivalent experience

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* Experience working with/in regulated industries (ex: health care, financial utilities, government, utilities, utilities, etc.)
* Experience with marketing automation products like Eloqua
* Experience with CRM such as Salesforce
* Experience working in the Adobe Experience Cloud suite of products and real-time CDP
* Familiarity with public cloud offerings and other solutions built around these technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and similar)
* Understanding of Agile Project Management methods

* Lead omnichannel journey orchestration across the full B2B marketing funnel, connecting teams across owned and paid channels to deliver personalized customer experiences from anonymous prospect to known customer and beyond.
* Partner with Deloitte business leaders and cross-functional SMEs to define, document, and prioritize marketing use cases based on business value, effort, and customer impact.
* Translate business needs into technical requirements, integration points, and scalable solution designs across CRM, CDP, MarTech, AdTech, digital production, and customer data platforms.
* Oversee end-to-end marketing technology initiatives, including solution implementation, functional testing, lifecycle management, risk identification, and alignment to privacy, segmentation, and personalization best practices.
* Serve as a strategic SME and product owner who can communicate complex technical concepts to leadership while collaborating effectively with technical teams, stakeholders, and delivery partners.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in digital marketing channels and platforms, including websites, forms, email, SMS, SEM, social, streaming media, CRM, CDP, analytics, and marketing automation tools such as Eloqua and Salesforce.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, customer data, data normalization/hygiene, tracking, analytics, and personalization technologies, including Adobe Experience Cloud and real-time CDP environments.
* Familiarity with cloud and delivery ecosystems, including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Agile methods, and testing/optimization practices to improve marketing performance and conversion outcomes.

**Education Required**

* BS/BA degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of experience in digital marketing, advertising solutions, or enterprise marketing technology delivery is required.

**Work Location:**

**Hyderabad - Shift: 2:00 pm to 11:00 pm OR 11:00 am - 4:00 pm & 7:00 pm - 11:00 pm**

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: IT Technical Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious IT Technical Intern to join our Information Technology team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in IT support, systems administration, troubleshooting, networking, cybersecurity, hardware and software management, documentation, and technology operations while collaborating with IT professionals and business users.  
Our intent is to develop an IT professional who can understand the organization’s technology environment end to end, translate user and business requirements into practical technical solutions, resolve issues efficiently, support reliable IT operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and security practices.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the organization’s IT infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, devices, users, technical requirements, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Assist in providing first-level technical support to employees and users through ticketing systems, email, chat, phone, or in-person support.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, network, connectivity, access, printing, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* Assist with user account provisioning, access management, password resets, permissions, onboarding, offboarding, and identity-related tasks.
* Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and other productivity platforms, as applicable.
* Monitor IT systems, services, devices, and alerts and escalate incidents or risks according to established procedures.
* Assist with network troubleshooting involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, routers, and related infrastructure.
* Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, licenses, warranties, configurations, users, and IT assets.
* Use IT service management and ticketing tools to document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Assist with software deployment, patching, updates, endpoint configuration, backups, and routine maintenance activities.
* Support cybersecurity practices such as endpoint protection, access control, phishing awareness, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, and incident reporting.
* Follow established IT policies, procedures, change management practices, security controls, and data protection requirements.
* Assist with system administration tasks across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, virtual machines, or other environments, as applicable to the assigned team.
* Use scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to improve repetitive IT processes and operational efficiency.
* Investigate recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, workflows, and user experience.
* Contribute to IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, deployments, infrastructure improvements, asset refreshes, and technology evaluations.
* Explore the responsible use of AI tools, automation, and intelligent assistants for IT support, documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and knowledge management.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, reliability, and alignment with organizational policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, user guides, network diagrams, and troubleshooting references.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users and provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support.

  
Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networking concepts, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management principles.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals and design algorithms.
* Working knowledge of at least one operating system, such as Windows, Linux, or macOS.
* Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, user accounts, access permissions, and common enterprise IT services.
* Basic familiarity with productivity applications, collaboration tools, cloud services, endpoint devices, and software installation or configuration.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically, research solutions, follow procedures, document work accurately, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Understanding of basic cybersecurity, data privacy, password security, phishing risks, and responsible handling of confidential information.

Nice to have Skills :

* Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to IT service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with networking tools, command-line utilities, remote support tools, monitoring platforms, or diagnostic utilities.
* Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, batch scripting, or other automation and scripting technologies.
* Exposure to endpoint management, mobile device management, patch management, software deployment, or configuration management tools.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and practices, including endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, identity and access management, security monitoring, and incident response.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with virtualization, containers, backup systems, storage, servers, or infrastructure monitoring.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base articles, process guides, diagrams, or user training materials.
* Exposure to AI assistants, automation tools, prompt engineering, or AI-enabled IT support and knowledge management workflows.

**WHO WE ARE**

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and **Amplify Your Impact.** Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

title: AI Test Engineer
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

We are looking for an AI Test Engineer who combines strong software quality assurance and test automation experience with hands-on expertise in AI-assisted testing. The role involves using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and Figma designs to generate test scenarios and executable automated tests using AI tools.

The ideal candidate can effectively provide the right context to AI tools, validate AI-generated outputs, and continuously improve test development workflows to accelerate automation while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, traceability, and maintainability.

#### **What you will do**

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions to translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX specifications such as Figma designs into test scenarios and executable automated tests.
* Build and improve AI-assisted testing workflows where requirements and design artifacts can be provided as context and used to generate, update, and expand automated tests with minimal manual scripting.
* Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to provide AI tools with requirements, application context, coding standards, existing automation frameworks, and relevant design information so that generated tests are accurate and maintainable.
* Review, validate, debug, and refine AI-generated test scenarios and automation code rather than accepting generated output without verification.
* Identify opportunities to automate the test-development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, test generation, test-data creation, regression maintenance, failure analysis, and coverage expansion.

#### **What you bring**

*Experience*

* 5–8 years of experience in software QA
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding or engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for software testing and test automation.
* Experience using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX designs as context for AI-assisted generation of test scenarios and automated tests.
* Experience creating or configuring AI-assisted workflows that can transform requirements into executable automation, rather than using AI only for ad-hoc code completion or general-purpose prompting.
* Ability to provide application-specific context to AI tools, including existing automation code, framework conventions, requirements, design information, and test data, to improve generated test quality.
* Practical understanding of validating AI-generated tests for correctness, coverage, maintainability, traceability to requirements, and potential hallucinations or incorrect assumptions.

***Personal competencies***

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and a risk-based approach to quality assurance.
* Curiosity and a proactive mindset when exploring complex workflows and edge cases.
* Willingness to adopt AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and test coverage.
* Effective communication and collaboration across technical and clinical teams.
* Ownership of testing outcomes, defect resolution, and release quality.

#### **Who we are**

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.

* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.

Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
