title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.

We are applying predictive technology to large volumes of data and against a wide spectrum of problems. Our Professional Services organization works together with our internal customers to address business needs of AWS customers using AI.

If you have experience with AI, including building ML or DL models, we’d like to have you join our team. If you do not live in a market where we have an open Data Scientist position, please feel free to apply. Our Data Scientists can live in any location where we have a Professional Service office.

* Work with our Professional Services Big Data consultants to analyze, extract, normalize, and label relevant data.

description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

* 5+ years of experience in building and deploying enterprise-grade machine learning infra, SaaS software, data analytics solutions, or online platforms
* 2+ years of experience in building LLM infra or high-volume AI inference components.
* Academic degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong background in Python programming, Distributed computing, Engineering, big data processing, and cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-premises)

* Data Engineering - expert in MongoDB and strong fundamentals in data lakes, data storage, ETL pipelines, and building real-time data pipelines.
* Strong material skills, excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to lead teams, mentor juniors, and work with other teams.

* Experience in scaling AI/ML production systems using classic ML models, LLMs, and Deep Learning models on traditional hardware and high-performance computing.

As Sr Engineering Manager, you'll be the main SPOC for all the engineering efforts behind the AryaXAI platform, serving customers in SaaS and on-premise modes and scaling multiple AI models in startups, SMEs, and highly regulated industries.

* One of the best health care plans that covers not only you but also your family, and offers the best Life insurance plans.

* Career development and leadership opportunities

title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, AIA Activation to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI & Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.

* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant team.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption

* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

* Minimum years of related experience required: 2+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.

requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to

managing risks throughout the project.

realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with
  
  
customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud
  
  
computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which
  
  
help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also
  
  
deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of
  
  
solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to

customer needs
  
  

* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project

delivery
  
  

* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective

migration strategies

technologies

reusable artifacts

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Plexitech Solutions LLP is a technology company focused on mobility, infrastructure, industrial automation, and operational intelligence solutions for enterprises and government organizations. For over 26 years, the company has supported more than 500 enterprise clients worldwide across sectors such as transportation, logistics, aviation, energy, utilities, manufacturing, public infrastructure, and emergency services. Plexitech’s platforms integrate connected devices and field assets to enable real-time monitoring, management, and optimization of complex, distributed operations. Its portfolio includes fleet and mobility platforms, IoT and telematics solutions, SCADA systems, enterprise software, and AI-powered analytics that enhance safety, productivity, and decision-making. With deep domain expertise and global implementation experience, Plexitech helps organizations build smarter, safer, and more efficient operations in an increasingly connected world.
  
**Role Description**
The Data Engineer will design, build, and maintain data pipelines and infrastructure supporting Plexitech’s operational intelligence and analytics platforms. This full-time, on-site role is based in Thane and involves collaborating with software engineers, data analysts, and product teams to ensure data is reliable, scalable, and accessible for business use. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing ETL processes, modeling data for analytics and reporting, optimizing data storage and retrieval, and ensuring data quality and integrity across multiple sources. The Data Engineer will work with large, complex datasets from IoT devices, industrial systems, and enterprise applications, and will contribute to performance tuning, documentation, and continuous improvement of the data ecosystem. The role also involves supporting deployments, troubleshooting data-related issues, and adhering to security and compliance standards.

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Engineering and Data Warehousing for building and maintaining scalable data platforms.
* Candidates should possess solid experience in Data Modeling and Data Analytics to support reporting, dashboards, and advanced insights.

* Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (such as Python or Scala).
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, and familiarity with modern data platforms or cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) is beneficial.
* Understanding of data pipeline orchestration tools, version control, and best practices for data quality, governance, and security.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical concepts clearly, and solve problems in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and cloud-native architectures.

The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions, with a focus on banking and financial services use cases. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, architectural decision-making, rapid prototyping, and collaboration with engineering, data, security, and business teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Solution Design

\* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.

\* Design scalable AI platforms integrating LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native infrastructure.

\* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and inference strategies.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, reference implementations, design principles, and engineering standards.

\* Design for high availability, scalability, low latency, cost optimisation, observability, and resilience.

Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineering

\* Architect and implement RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, retrieval, reranking, and contextual response generation.

\* Design intelligent AI agents capable of tool calling, multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, and controlled execution of enterprise business processes.

\* Develop multi-agent workflows where appropriate, with clear boundaries, state management, human approval, and failure-handling mechanisms.

\* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, model routing, context management, and conversation memory.

\* Apply guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, and unauthorised tool execution.

\* Build proof of concepts and convert successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Enterprise Integration & Banking Use Cases

\* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, REST APIs, event-driven systems, microservices, and secure data platforms.

\* Design AI solutions for banking use cases such as customer service automation, knowledge assistants, document intelligence, regulatory compliance, fraud investigation support, and developer productivity.

\* Ensure AI services integrate seamlessly with existing authentication, authorisation, audit, and monitoring frameworks.

\* Work with domain architects and business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into technical solutions.

MLOps, LLMOps & Production Engineering

\* Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices for AI applications and model-serving components.

\* Implement model evaluation, regression testing, prompt/version management, retrieval-quality assessment, and continuous monitoring.

\* Define evaluation frameworks covering factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, safety, and token consumption.

\* Monitor model performance, drift, failure rates, inference costs, and application reliability.

\* Optimise inference performance through caching, batching, model selection, quantisation, and other suitable techniques.

Security, Governance & Responsible AI

\* Design AI solutions with security and privacy by design, including encryption, role-based access control, secrets management, and data minimisation.

\* Implement responsible AI controls, explainability where appropriate, traceability, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

\* Address threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, and sensitive information leakage.

\* Collaborate with information security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to meet applicable regulatory and organisational requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

\* Provide hands-on technical leadership to developers and engineering teams throughout the solution lifecycle.

\* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and proof-of-concept evaluations.

\* Mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices, design patterns, and production-readiness standards.

\* Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation roadmaps to technical and business stakeholders.

3. Required Technical Skills

Generative AI & LLMs

\* Strong understanding of LLMs, transformer-based models, embeddings, tokenisation, context windows, and inference.

\* Hands-on experience with commercial and/or open-source models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or equivalent.

\* Expertise in RAG, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt engineering, and structured generation.

\* Practical experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Programming & Backend Engineering

\* Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-grade AI applications.

\* Solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, API security, and distributed systems.

\* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent backend frameworks.

\* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot and microservices is an advantage.

Data & Search Technologies

\* Experience with vector databases or vector search technologies such as pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.

\* Strong understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases, document processing, data pipelines, and data quality.

\* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, hybrid search, and enterprise data integration is desirable.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

\* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

\* Experience deploying AI workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based architectures.

\* Familiarity with API gateways, event-driven architecture, secrets management, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

\* Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, or equivalent.

AI Quality, Evaluation & Operations

\* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks, automated testing, tracing, and observability tools.

\* Understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, model safety, and retrieval-quality optimisation.

\* Knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

4. Qualifications & Experience

\* 7–8 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or related technology roles.

\* Demonstrable hands-on experience delivering AI or GenAI solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage.

\* Strong architectural problem-solving skills and ability to make informed build-versus-buy and model-selection decisions.

\* Experience working with enterprise-scale applications, sensitive data, and production deployment constraints.

\* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

\* Banking, financial services, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience is highly desirable.

5. Preferred Experience

\* Experience building agentic AI systems that invoke enterprise tools and APIs under controlled permissions.

\* Knowledge of AI security testing, red teaming, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.

\* Experience with multimodal AI, document intelligence, speech, or vision-based solutions.

\* Familiarity with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms and integration with microservices.

\* Experience designing AI solutions for high-volume, low-latency, business-critical environments.

6. Success Criteria

The AI Architect will be measured on the ability to:

\* Deliver secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions aligned with business outcomes.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns that accelerate delivery across engineering teams.

\* Improve answer quality, retrieval accuracy, reliability, and user adoption.

\* Optimise inference cost, response latency, and infrastructure utilisation.

\* Demonstrate measurable business value through automation, productivity improvements, and reduced manual effort.

\* Ensure AI solutions meet defined security, governance, auditability, and operational-readiness requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A hands-on AI architect who can move from business problem definition to solution architecture, working code, production deployment, and measurable business impact—not just develop GenAI proofs of concept.

title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About TVARIT:**

TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving

advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).

With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most

innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.

We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team

The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on

quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement:**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence:**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* **10+ years of professional experience,** including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* **Mandatory manufacturing exposure:** direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* **Software delivery leadership:** must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* **Mandatory AI modeling experience:** strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* **Proven customer-facing leadership**, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* **Proven delivery track record:** leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

**Strong Haves**

* **Data science and AI:** Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* **Metals process understanding:** Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.
* **Software development lifecycle:** Working understanding of how industrial software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported, including agile practices, CI/CD, code quality, and testing, sufficient to lead engineering teams and make sound delivery trade-offs. Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.
* **Solution architecture and productization:** Translating business and operational requirements into functional specifications, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps; reusable components, configurable solutions, model generalization, and validation across plants.

Familiarity Needed

* **Industrial data and integration:** Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, sensors, lab and quality data, and manufacturing data platforms, including data quality, contextualization, and OT/IT integration
* **Deployment and MLOps:** Cloud, edge, and on-premises deployment, MLOps, model monitoring and retraining, security, and reliability. Familiarity with Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
* **Emerging AI:** Awareness of generative AI, LLMs, and industrial copilots, including their practical applications and limitations in manufacturing

title: AI/ML Engineering Lead
description:
***Job Title:*** AI/ML Engineering Lead ***Company****: Toro Technology Center India*

**Who Are We?**

The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career.

**What Will You Do?**

In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:

AI/ML Engineer, EIT

* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, and other business use cases.
* Validate, optimize, and continuously improve models through feature engineering, experimentation, performance analysis, tuning, and evaluation to support production readiness and business outcomes.
* Build Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including conversational assistants, ML models, intelligent search, and multi-step intelligent workflows.
* Develop and optimize models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and AI architecture based on accuracy, quality, latency, cost, security, explainability, scalability, and business value.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable AI services, APIs, data and feature pipelines, and enterprise application integrations using strong software engineering practices, including source control, code review, automated testing, and technical documentation.
* Implement MLOps and GenAIOps practices, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated deployment, rollback, and lifecycle management.
* Establish production monitoring and evaluation to track model performance, data and prediction drift, groundedness, bias, data quality, reliability, safety, usage, cost, and operational health, with appropriate alerting and retraining or remediation workflows.
* Implement Responsible AI, security, and governance controls, including risk assessments, human-in-the-loop oversight, access controls, data protection, traceability, and safeguards against hallucination, prompt injection, and data leakage.
* Troubleshoot production AI solutions, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve reliability, scalability, performance, and operational supportability.
* Translate business opportunities into well-defined AI problem statements, success measures, solution designs, and delivery plans, collaborating with Business, Data Science and Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal, Compliance, and Governance teams to deliver production-ready solutions aligned with enterprise standards.

**What Do You Need?**

To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative or technical discipline.
* 6+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, AI Engineering, and/or advanced analytics.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, evaluation, optimization, and production monitoring.
* Experience building Generative AI or agentic AI applications using technologies and patterns such as RAG, vector search, embeddings, tool calling, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Proficiency in one or more programming and analytical technologies such as Python, R, Spark, Scala, and SQL.
* Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques, including neural networks, XGBoost, support vector machines, gradient boosting, random forests, and related algorithms.
* Experience working with both structured and unstructured data, including feature engineering, information retrieval, dimensionality reduction, and feature extraction.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical techniques, and data visualization.
* Advanced proficiency with Python/R, Spark, SQL, MLOps, GenAIOps, and agentic AI workflows.
* Experience designing and operating production Generative AI solutions utilizing RAG, embeddings, vector and semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agents SDK, Databricks, or comparable AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Azure DevOps, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience with MLflow or comparable experiment tracking and model registry capabilities, containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, privacy, data governance, model risk management, security, and Responsible AI controls.
* Experience operating production AI/ML solutions with model observability, service-level monitoring, cost controls, incident management, usage telemetry, and continuous performance improvement.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Engineer, AI Security
description:
The **AI Security Engineer** is responsible for building and running the security controls that find and govern the use of artificial intelligence across Danaher, including chat tools, AI platforms, and autonomous agents. The engineer configures and tunes policies and detections in CrowdStrike Falcon and AI gateways, and builds the automation that lets Danaher adopt AI safely.

This position reports to the **Senior Manager, AI Security & Governance** and is part of the **DIS Corporate Cybersecurity - AI Security** team located in **Bangalore or Pune India** and will be an on-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Configure, tune, and maintain security policies for the AI control plane in CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) and Falcon Shield, including access rules, prompt rules, and report, transform, or block actions.
* Manage policy and configuration for AI gateways that cover gaps the CrowdStrike tools cannot reach.
* Build alerts and detections for unapproved AI use, risky agent behavior, and policy violations, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.
* Build the automation yourself: prove a task by hand in the platform, then automate it with Python, PowerShell, and platform APIs.
* Contribute to AI security design with the AI Security Architect, and coordinate with the Security Operations Center and the CrowdStrike engineering team.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 9+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on work on endpoint, software-as-a-service, or cloud security platforms.
* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or customizing CrowdStrike Falcon, such as policy authoring, integrations, detection logic, or console administration.
* Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
* Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.
* AI gateways or AI security platforms (such as JetStream, LiteLLM, or Prisma AIRS), or security for Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Securing autonomous AI agents or Model Context Protocol servers.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**Overview**

The Identity and Access Management Engineer (Junior) will supports the secure and reliable operation of identity services across the organisation. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role assists with user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication, single sign-on, privileged access and identity governance activities.

The position contributes to project delivery and operational support by following approved standards, documenting work, resolving routine issues and escalating risks or complex technical matters appropriately.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Support the secure and reliable operation of identity and access management services across the organisation.
* Contribute to IAM, PAM and identity governance initiatives through project delivery and operational support activities.
* Assist in implementing identity standards, controls and automation aligned with the organisation’s security strategy.
* Support continuous improvement of identity lifecycle, authentication and privileged access capabilities.

Operational Management

* Manage approved joiner, mover and leaver activities, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes and routine IAM troubleshooting.
* Provision, modify and remove user, service and privileged accounts across supported on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Apply approved access models, including role-based and attribute-based access controls, group membership and entitlements.
* Support periodic access reviews and follow up outstanding certifications, exceptions and remediation actions.
* Assist with the administration, configuration, testing and support of hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
* Support application onboarding for single sign-on, multifactor authentication and automated provisioning using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Contribute to PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other scripts or workflows that automate repeatable IAM activities, with peer review before production use.
* Assist with identity services hosted across Azure and AWS and their supporting Windows, Linux and virtualised infrastructure.
* Maintain daily IAM platform stability and compliance through service monitoring, BAU engineering, incident troubleshooting, fulfilment of service requests and controlled changes.
* Troubleshoot access, authentication, federation, directory and provisioning issues using documented procedures, system logs and structured diagnostic techniques.
* Support Active Directory Domain Services and related technologies such as LDAP, Group Policy, DNS, certificate services, forest trusts and remote access services under appropriate guidance.
* Maintain accurate tickets, work notes, configuration records, operational procedures and handover information.

People Leadership

* Build effective working relationships with application owners, Service Desk, infrastructure, cloud, security and project teams.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Identity Architects to deliver IAM and PAM enhancements.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
* Share knowledge and contribute to team capability through structured learning and practical assignments.

Governance & Risk

* Support the discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
* Assist with implementation and uplift of privileged-access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, least privilege, account discovery and automated password rotation.
* Follow least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, privacy and privileged-access requirements when administering identity services.
* Support audit and assurance activities by maintaining complete access records, approvals, evidence and operational documentation.
* Identify control gaps, recurring incidents and opportunities for automation or service improvement and escalate recommendations through the appropriate process.
* Escalate risks, exceptions and complex technical matters through appropriate governance processes.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

Experience

* Degree, diploma or equivalent practical training in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in IAM, directory services, systems administration, IT support or cybersecurity; graduates with relevant practical exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Foundational understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, conditional access, multifactor authentication, RBAC and ABAC.
* Practical exposure to Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in a hybrid environment; familiarity with Microsoft Identity Manager or Entra ID Connect is advantageous.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, federation and API concepts.
* Basic to intermediate PowerShell and scripting capability; exposure to Microsoft Graph is desirable.
* Awareness of Windows Server and Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, certificate services and forest trusts.
* Foundational cloud knowledge across Azure or AWS and basic familiarity with virtualisation; Linux exposure is desirable.
* Exposure to PAM or IGA platforms such as CyberArk and SailPoint is advantageous.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, IAM or security certifications are desirable but not essential.

Personal Attributes
  

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and seek guidance for complex or high-risk matters.
* Balanced interest in operational support, incident resolution, debugging and engineering delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to approvals, testing, evidence and record keeping.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build constructive relationships with technical teams and business partners.
* Able to prioritise assigned work, meet agreed deadlines, raise blockers early and contribute effectively in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Cybersecurity Consultant
description:
**Location** - New Delhi **Experience** - 8-10Years+

###### **Vacancies - 1**

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a skilled Cybersecurity Consultant to assess, review, and strengthen the security posture of Government IT systems, cloud infrastructure, web applications, and enterprise platforms. The candidate will be responsible for conducting security audits, reviewing Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) findings, tracking remediation activities, establishing cloud security baselines, assessing access controls, and ensuring incident response readiness. The role will also involve evaluating security risks and providing formal security recommendations and sign-off before production go-live.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Security Audit & Compliance**

* Define security audit scope, objectives, assessment methodology, and audit checklists for IT applications and infrastructure.
* Conduct security assessments of web applications, APIs, databases, servers, networks, and cloud environments.
* Review security configurations, access permissions, system architecture, and operational controls.
* Identify security gaps, vulnerabilities, compliance issues, and potential risks.
* Prepare security audit reports with findings, severity classifications, recommendations, and corrective actions.
* Verify alignment with applicable government security guidelines, organizational policies, and relevant industry standards.
* Maintain audit evidence, risk registers, compliance records, and security review documentation.

### **2. VAPT Findings & Remediation Tracking**

* Review Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) reports for applications, APIs, networks, and infrastructure.
* Assess vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business impact, and associated security risks.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to prioritize remediation activities.
* Maintain vulnerability registers, remediation trackers, target closure dates, and escalation records.
* Validate remediation evidence and coordinate retesting to confirm that identified vulnerabilities have been resolved.
* Track unresolved critical and high-risk findings and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Provide recommendations for secure coding, configuration hardening, patch management, and vulnerability prevention.

### **3. Cloud Security Baseline & Access Control**

* Define and review cloud security baselines for platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Assess cloud configurations, network security, storage permissions, encryption, logging, and monitoring controls.
* Review Identity and Access Management (IAM), role-based access control, privileged accounts, and least-privilege access.
* Validate multi-factor authentication, access provisioning, account lifecycle management, and periodic access reviews.
* Assess security controls for cloud-hosted applications, databases, APIs, virtual machines, and containerized workloads.
* Review backup protection, disaster recovery arrangements, security logging, and alerting mechanisms.
* Recommend corrective actions to address cloud misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and security control gaps.

### **4. Incident Response & Security Readiness**

* Assess incident response procedures, escalation matrices, communication protocols, and incident management workflows.
* Review preparedness for cybersecurity incidents, including unauthorized access, malware, data breaches, and service disruptions.
* Evaluate security monitoring, log management, alerting, evidence preservation, and incident reporting mechanisms.
* Support the development and review of incident response plans, playbooks, and recovery procedures.
* Coordinate incident response exercises, security awareness activities, and lessons-learned reviews.
* Recommend measures to improve incident detection, containment, recovery, and business continuity.
* Ensure security incidents and corrective actions are documented and tracked appropriately.

### **5. Application & Infrastructure Security Review**

* Review application architecture, APIs, authentication mechanisms, session management, and data protection controls.
* Assess security risks associated with application integrations, databases, third-party services, and external interfaces.
* Evaluate security configurations for servers, operating systems, firewalls, networks, and cloud infrastructure.
* Review secure development practices and recommend controls to reduce application-level vulnerabilities.
* Assess encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and sensitive data handling practices.
* Coordinate with solution architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and QA teams to address identified security risks.

### **6. Go-Live Security Assessment & Sign-Off**

* Conduct security readiness assessments before production deployment of applications and IT systems.
* Review security audit results, VAPT findings, remediation evidence, access controls, and cloud security configurations.
* Verify closure of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities or ensure that formally approved risk exceptions are documented.
* Assess incident response readiness, monitoring arrangements, backup controls, and security escalation procedures.
* Document residual risks, outstanding actions, recommendations, and deployment conditions.
* Provide formal security recommendations and sign-off based on the approved go-live security criteria.

**Key Deliverables**
--------------------

* Security audit scope, assessment methodology, and security audit checklist.
* Application, infrastructure, API, and cloud security assessment reports.
* VAPT findings register and vulnerability remediation tracker.
* Remediation validation and retesting reports.
* Cloud security baseline and access control review documentation.
* Incident response readiness assessment and recommendations.
* Security risk register, compliance evidence, and corrective action reports.
* **A Go-Live Security Sign-Off Note for each engagement**, documenting the assessment scope, security findings, remediation status, residual risks, approved exceptions, and final security readiness recommendation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional experience in cybersecurity consulting, information security, security auditing, or IT risk assessment.
* Strong understanding of information security principles, risk management, vulnerability assessment, and security controls.
* Experience reviewing VAPT reports, tracking remediation activities, and validating security fixes.
* Knowledge of cloud security, IAM, access control, encryption, network security, and infrastructure hardening.
* Understanding of incident response processes, security monitoring, logging, and disaster recovery.
* Experience preparing security audit reports, checklists, risk registers, and compliance documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**
-------------------------------------

* Experience in Government IT, public sector, e-Governance, or large-scale enterprise technology projects.

* Familiarity with security assessment tools and vulnerability management platforms.

* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, Security+, or cloud security certifications will be an added advantage.

**Qualification - B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.Tech. or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Management or a related discipline.**

We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring

**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1

Who You'll Work With

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team

description:
