myNachiketa is the world’s only D2C brand with products that bring the knowledge of the Gita & Vedas to children. We design innovative products in the form of books, games, videos, workshops, learning programs and more.

Our products are based on deep scholarship, with a special focus on ease of use and customer delight. We reach families through our books, digital platforms and programs in India and internationally.

Our products have consistently received 4.6+ star ratings on Amazon and have featured as Bestsellers. We have reached over 500K families and have a growing community of parents, children and supporters.

myNachiketa is founded by Varun Aggarwal, co-founder of Aspiring Minds, which had a $100M exit. We work with a small, high-performance team with the ambition to take Indian philosophical knowledge to children across the world.

Website: www.mynachiketa.com

**The Role**

We are looking for a **Creative Associate – AI & Visual Content** to create engaging visual content across advertising, brand communication and storytelling.

You will create **ad images, video ads, carousels, social-media creatives and longer-form storytelling content**, using tools such as Canva and the latest AI image and video platforms.

A large part of the role is about **creative judgment**: understanding the audience, choosing the right visual style, finding the right hook, and turning an idea into something people want to stop and look at.

A creative designed for a parent buying a book may need to look very different from a story video for a child. We want someone who enjoys figuring out that difference.

**Responsibilities include:**

**Advertising Creatives**

* Create **static ads, video ads, carousels and other performance-marketing creatives**.
* Develop multiple visual ideas, hooks and creative directions for the same product or campaign.
* Work with the marketing team to understand what is performing and build better creative variations.
* Rapidly test different formats, layouts, styles and messages.

**Brand & Social Creatives**

* Design posts, carousels, campaign creatives, book-related visuals and other brand content.
* Maintain a high bar on **visual quality, consistency and attention to detail**.
* Adapt content to different audiences, formats and platforms.
* Stay aware of current visual and content trends and use them intelligently.

**AI Video & Storytelling**

* Create **AI-assisted videos**, from short promotional content to longer-form storytelling.
* Convert scripts and stories into visual concepts, scenes and sequences.
* Help decide the right **characters, visual world, mood, composition and style** for a story.
* Experiment with AI image and video tools to develop engaging and consistent visual narratives.
* Work on longer-form content where storytelling, pacing and visual continuity matter.

**Experience**

**Freshers are welcome.**

We would especially like to hear from candidates who have already created designs or videos through:

* College clubs, festivals or societies
* College publications or social-media pages
* Personal projects
* YouTube or Instagram pages
* Internships or freelance work
* Posters, carousels, reels or videos made as a hobby
* AI image or video experiments
* Storytelling or creative projects done independently

A **portfolio or examples of creative work are required**.

We care much more about **creative ability, taste, attention to detail and curiosity** than formal work experience or degree.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong **creativity and visual taste**.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good working knowledge of **Canva** and other design tools
* Comfort with AI tools for image and video creation, or a strong willingness to learn them quickly.
* Awareness of current trends in advertising, social content, video and visual storytelling.
* Ability to understand an audience and choose the **right creative style and format** for them.
* Ability to take a rough brief or idea and turn it into a finished creative.
* Willingness to experiment, iterate and create multiple versions rather than stopping at the first idea.
* Curiosity about design, storytelling, advertising and new creative technology.

Formal design training is **not required**

**What is in it for you**

* Work across a wide range of creative formats: **ads, carousels, video, storytelling and AI content**.
* See your work used in real campaigns, products and storytelling projects.
* Learn how creative decisions affect both audience engagement and business performance.
* Get significant creative ownership early in your career.
* Work in a small team where good ideas can quickly turn into real projects.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect - Source.AI
description:

* Gurugram

Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.**

**YOUR IMPACT**
---------------

You will lead the engineering function for Source.AI, McKinsey's GenAI-powered, agentic category-management and sourcing platform.

You will set and drive the end-to-end technical vision across data engineering, data science, and full-stack software development, ensuring the platform is designed, built, and scaled to meet the needs of enterprise procurement clients globally.

You will own technical direction for a multi-surface product stack: AWS based, a NestJS and Next.js monorepo (Nx, pnpm), Python FastAPI microservices, per-client Snowflake data tenants, and an agentic AI layer spanning spend intelligence, market radar, category strategy, negotiation coaching, and tail-spend repricing. You will lead a team of data engineers, data scientists, and full-stack developers, partnering with product leadership and delivery leads to ship the roadmap while maintaining delivery SLAs on live client deployments.

You will architect and operationalize GenAI capabilities at production scale, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), NL2SQL, prompt engineering, vector search, and multi-agent orchestration, all routed through McKinsey's enterprise AI Gateway with Responsible-AI guardrails. You will establish engineering best practices, AI-assisted SDLC workflows, and observability standards so the team ships secure, reliable, and governable AI-driven features on a continuous cadence.

You will play a critical role in scaling Source.AI from a proven PoC portfolio to an enterprise-grade SaaS platform, driving transformative impact by enabling intelligent, scalable, and secure agent-based technologies that unlock measurable savings, productivity, and risk visibility for procurement teams worldwide.

**YOUR GROWTH**
---------------

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

* **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* **Global community:** With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* **World-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**
----------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering or platform architecture, including 3+ years in technical leadership or people management roles leading cross-functional engineering teams
* Proven track record building and scaling GenAI products in production, with ownership of architecture, delivery, post-launch iteration, reliability, and performance
* Experience leading teams across data engineering, data science, and full-stack development, with the ability to set technical direction, mentor senior ICs, and drive accountability across workstreams
* Strong expertise in GenAI systems, including LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG pipelines, NL2SQL, vector databases, embeddings, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel
* Proficiency with AI-assisted software development methodologies and tools, including Cursor, Claude Code, and comparable agentic coding environments; comfortable driving an AI-native SDLC across teams
* Strong cloud engineering experience, preferably on AWS, with working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, distributed or event-driven systems, message queues, and real-time data flows
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake data modeling, multi-tenant data isolation, and ETL/ELT pipelines for enterprise-scale data onboarding
* Familiarity with modern full-stack development, including TypeScript/Node.js, NestJS, React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, and monorepo tooling such as Nx and pnpm
* Knowledge of AI governance, security, compliance, and observability, including guardrails for safety and reliability, prompt tracing, cost tracking, and failure analysis
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align product leaders, partners, delivery teams, and cross-functional stakeholders around technical and business priorities

Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues.

Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

title: Technical Mentor & Technical Operations Lead
description:
Job Description: Technical Mentor & Technical Operations Lead

**Company:** MINDSEEKERS Technologies Private Limited  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Department:** Technical Training & Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Mindseekers

MINDSEEKERS Technologies is looking for a technically strong, passionate, and responsible professional with excellent Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) knowledge. The candidate will be responsible for mentoring students, delivering technical training, managing technical operations, and representing the company at webinars, workshops, and college events.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Technical Training & Student Mentorship**

* Conduct live classes and mentor students in various CSE domains.
* Explain complex technical concepts through practical examples and hands-on projects.
* Prepare course materials, assignments, projects, and technical assessments.
* Monitor student progress and resolve technical doubts.
* Maintain the quality and consistency of training sessions.

**2. Technical Knowledge & Development**

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), programming, and core Computer Science subjects.
* Teach and guide students in Python, Java, C++, Web Development, and other relevant technical domains.
* Have working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, and emerging technologies.
* Support technical projects, internal tools, learning platforms, and other company technology requirements.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and recommend practical solutions.

**3. Technical Operations & Management**

* Manage and coordinate the technical training activities of the organisation.
* Support the development and maintenance of technical systems, websites, dashboards, and learning platforms.
* Coordinate with trainers, team leaders, interns, and other departments for smooth technical operations.
* Maintain technical documentation, course updates, and training schedules.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements in technical delivery.

**4. Webinars, Workshops & College Engagement**

* Conduct technical webinars, workshops, seminars, and guest lectures at colleges whenever required.
* Represent Mindseekers professionally during academic and industry interactions.
* Develop engaging presentations on current and emerging technical topics.
* Participate in college visits, technical events, and student engagement activities.
* Help build technical collaborations and strengthen the company's academic presence.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical expertise may also be considered.
* Strong fundamentals in programming, DSA, OOP, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and Software Engineering.
* Proficiency in at least two programming languages, preferably Python, Java, or C++.
* Practical project experience and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Excellent communication, presentation, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently conduct classes, webinars, and technical workshops.
* Strong ownership, leadership, coordination, and time-management abilities.
* Willingness to travel to colleges for technical sessions when required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience as a Technical Trainer, Software Developer, Teaching Assistant, Technical Lead, or Mentor.
* Experience delivering technical workshops or college webinars.
* Knowledge of AI/ML, Data Science, Web Development, Cybersecurity, or Cloud Computing.
* Experience managing a technical team or coordinating multiple training programs.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can **teach technology, apply technology, and manage technology**. The ideal candidate should be confident enough to handle a classroom, solve practical technical problems, coordinate technical operations, and represent the organisation in front of college students and faculty.

Interested candidates should share their resume, relevant projects, technical expertise, and any previous teaching or presentation experience.

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

* LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen or equivalent frameworks.

title: Sr. Applied Scientist, WWOS Tech
description:
**Description**
Have you ever wanted to solve a mystery or be part of solving a case? Are you fascinated by detective stories or crime shows on TV? Do you love to catch bad actors, build ML models and solve complex problems. If so, working on the WWOS Tech team as an Applied Scientist is the place for you!
  
  
We detect theft, fraud and organized crime happening across our global supply chain and operations for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the cost savings of Amazon's inventory losses.
  
  
The primary role of an Applied Scientist within Amazon is to address business challenges through building a compelling case, and using data to influence change across the organization. This individual will be given responsibility on their first day to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Decisions and tools made in this role will have significant impact to the customer experience, as it will have a major impact on all the fraud investigations happening across Amazon operations.
  
  
Ideal candidates will be a high potential, strategic and analytic graduate with a PhD in ( Research, Statistics, Engineering, and Supply Chain) ready for challenging opportunities in the core of our world class operations space. Great candidates have a history of building fraud detections, detecting organized crime and the ability to use data and research to make changes. This individual will need to be able to work with a team, but also be comfortable making decisions independently, in what is often times an ambiguous environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own KPIs that measure theft/fraud management performance and efficiencies.
* Detect and automate theft, fraud MOs
* Detect organized crime rings and bad actor clusters
* Perform end to end evaluation of operational defects, system gaps, and scaling challenges (both system and operational).
* Contribute to the overall fraud management and product development strategies.
* Present key learnings and vision to stakeholders and leadership.
* Integrate ML detection models via software applications

**About The Team**
We believe that building a culture that is welcoming and inclusive is integral to people doing their best work and is essential to what we can achieve as a company. We actively recruit people from diverse backgrounds to build a supportive and inclusive workplace. Our team puts a high value on work-live balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **Description**
We are looking for Applied Scientists to advance how Minerva detects and responds to risk across KDP and Kindle Unlimited, building new models and raising the bar on the ones in production. You will own a problem end to end, from framing and modeling through evaluation and production launch, working with scientists and engineers in Bengaluru and the US.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor production risk models and push their quality higher: track performance and drift, improve how performance is measured, and lead the deep-dive science that turns model behavior into better detection.
* Design, train, and evaluate improved detection models, and take them to production with engineering partners.
* Build datasets, labels, evaluation sets, and metrics, and strengthen them as abuse patterns change.
* Write clear readouts with recommendations for scientists, engineers, and policy partners.

**About The Team**
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) has empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Minerva is the science and analytics organization for Amazon's Books business. We build systems for content understanding, author marketing and discovery, fraud and abuse prevention, and content risk, and we optimize manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality for Print On Demand (POD). We have mature areas and green-field opportunities, with engineering, business intelligence, and data engineering support across our areas. We are now building science teams in Bengaluru that work closely with our scientists in the US. Risk Science, a team within Minerva, keeps fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content out of the Books catalog and programs such as Kindle Unlimited, using text, image, and behavioral data.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field research
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience with fraud detection, abuse prevention, trust and safety, or content moderation
* Experience with model monitoring, data drift detection, or calibration
* Experience with graph-based ML, behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection
* Experience with large-scale data processing (for example Spark or SQL on large datasets)

description:

**Senior Applied Scientist – Process Discovery & Agentic AI**
**About The Role**
Before an AI agent can reliably operate software on a user's behalf, it needs to understand the underlying business process, including its steps, decision points, dependencies, variations, and edge cases. This knowledge is often scattered across event logs, unstructured documents, screen recordings, UI interaction traces, and domain expertise.
  
  
As a
**Senior Applied Scientist**
, you will provide technical leadership in developing scalable, process-agnostic learning systems that uncover the underlying structure, decision logic, and dynamics of complex workflows from sparse, noisy, and diverse observations.
  
  
You will own major research and technical areas, transforming heterogeneous data such as action logs, screen traces, semi-structured documents, and complex workflows into structured representations that support reliable AI agent execution. You will shape system architecture and define evaluation standards to ensure these representations are accurate, transparent, compact, and auditable.
  
  
You will also contribute to the development of computer-use models that enable AI agents to interact reliably with enterprise software.
  
  
This role involves solving open-ended research problems, developing new algorithms, designing rigorous experiments, making architecture decisions, and mentoring scientists and engineers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Process Discovery and Representation**

* Lead the development of pipelines that discover and formalize end-to-end business processes from event logs, UI interaction traces, screen recordings, and unstructured documents.
* Develop algorithms for process variant detection, noise removal, and trace consolidation.
* Design core representations and architectures that preserve essential process information while eliminating irrelevant variations.
* Establish principles for balancing abstraction and fidelity in process representations.
* Build retrieval and grounding systems using standard operating procedures, documents, and domain knowledge.
* Define technical direction, review experimental results, and mentor scientists and engineers.

**Evaluation and Reliability**

* Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for process discovery, including LLM-as-Judge pipelines, conformance checking, and regression testing.
* Create evaluation methods for processes without a single canonical ground truth.
* Test conditional branches, exception paths, loops, rare variants, and other complex scenarios.
* Make algorithmic and architectural trade-offs to support millions of execution traces and thousands of process variants.
* Diagnose production failures and translate recurring issues into research initiatives and system improvements.

**Collaboration and Technical Leadership**

* Collaborate with computer-use AI teams to ensure process representations support reliable autonomous execution.
* Work with research, engineering, and product teams to transition research prototypes into production systems.
* Mentor scientists and engineers in problem formulation, experimental design, technical reviews, and productionization.
* Contribute to technical documentation, research publications, and communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong Problem-Solving and Algorithmic Thinking: Ability to break down ambiguous problems, reason through edge cases, and design efficient algorithms using graph structures, data structures, approximation, indexing, and complexity analysis.
* Machine Learning Expertise: Deep knowledge of representation learning, sequence modeling, clustering, structured prediction, information retrieval, generative modeling, and foundation-model adaptation.
* Research and Technical Judgment: Ability to identify research opportunities, design meaningful experiments, evaluate competing approaches, and guide technical direction.
* Applied Foundation Model Experience: Hands-on experience building reliable production systems using modern language or multimodal models, including retrieval, structured generation, evaluation, grounding, and model adaptation.
* LLM Evaluation and Reliability: Experience with LLM-as-Judge systems, evaluation rubrics, synthetic data, fine-tuning, model post-training, confidence calibration, faithfulness verification, and production monitoring.
* Python Proficiency: Strong Python engineering skills, experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, and the ability to build scalable, tested, production-quality research systems.
* Cross-Domain Research: Ability to apply and adapt research from AI, computer vision, language modeling, process mining, program synthesis, graph learning, and knowledge representation.
* Communication and Mentorship: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, document architectural decisions, and improve the work of other scientists and engineers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strong research track record, including publications in leading ML, AI, NLP, computer vision, reinforcement learning, or data mining conferences.
* Experience taking research concepts from publication through production deployment.
* Experience defining technical strategy, mentoring researchers or engineers, and influencing architecture across teams.
* Knowledge of process mining, event log analysis, process discovery, conformance checking, or process variant analysis.
* Experience extracting structured information from documents, including named entity recognition, relation extraction, and table extraction.
* Experience processing multimodal data such as screen recordings, UI screenshots, interaction traces, and text.
* Experience with foundation-model adaptation techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, synthetic data, distillation, and reinforcement-learning-based post-training.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
You enjoy uncovering hidden structures in complex data and building systems that can infer how unfamiliar processes work without predefined rules.
  
  
You are comfortable moving between algorithms, machine learning, graph structures, retrieval systems, and foundation models to solve difficult research problems. You take ownership of technical decisions, value rigorous experimentation, and care about building reliable systems that work at scale.
  
  
You are motivated by working with an ambitious team where research, engineering, and practical execution come together to build next-generation AI systems.

description:
**About CITI**
Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have 200 years of experience helping our clients meet the world's toughest challenges and embrace its greatest opportunities.
  
  
**Citi Analytics and Information Management (AIM)**
Citi AIM was established in 2003 and is located across multiple cities in India - Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram and Pune. It is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. It identifies fact-based opportunities for revenue growth in partnership with the businesses. The function balances customer needs, business strategy, and profit objectives using best in class and relevant analytic methodologies.
  
  
**What we do?**
The US Consumer Cards (USCC) – Digital Product Analytics Team is a specialized function dedicated to understanding, measuring, and improving the servicing and marketing experience across all digital platforms. We are a dynamic and data-driven team focused on accelerating digital growth, enhancing customer engagement, and driving operational efficiency. By leveraging cutting-edge analytics and Gen-AI, we identify and act on opportunities to improve the customer lifecycle, increase digital revenue, and reduce service costs. We foster a culture of continuous learning and rapid experimentation to deliver impactful digital experiences that resonate with our customers. Our mission is to leverage data and insights to make our digital platforms the preferred channels for our customers, ultimately driving revenue and efficiency.
  
  
**Role Description:**
The Business Analytics Analyst (C10) is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.
  
  
**Few notables among the multiple areas that we work in:**

* Drive Digital Marketing, Product Sales & Engagement:

+ Develop and execute sophisticated digital marketing strategies to significantly grow digital product sales and increase customer footfall and stickiness on our platforms.
+ Analyze user behavior and campaign performance to identify new opportunities for engagement and revenue generation.

* Optimizing Digital Servicing Channels (Website & Mobile App):

+ Conduct deep-dive analyses of our website and mobile app to identify and eliminate points of friction in the customer service journey, making them more intuitive, efficient, and user-friendly.
+ Analyze customer interaction data to find opportunities to streamline the digital experience, reducing the need for customers to resort to calls or chats.

* Leverage Advanced Analytics and AI:

+ Apply Gen-AI powered analysis to enhance customer interactions, particularly in areas like Chatbot performance and personalized user experiences.
+ Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI solutions using techniques such as prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI models with frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.
+ Use analytical intelligence to uncover deep insights that inform strategies for reducing our cost-to-serve and improving overall efficiency across the customer lifecycle.

* Fostering a Culture of Experimentation:

+ Lead the industrialization and enhancement of our "Test & Learn" capability, enabling the rapid design, execution, and measurement of experiments for new digital features and marketing campaigns.
+ Utilize A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other experimentation techniques to generate actionable insights and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

+ Interpret complex data sets to identify significant trends, patterns, and anomalies, translating these into clear, concise, and impactful insights that support informed decision-making for business partners and senior leadership.
+ Identifies and compiles data sets using a variety of tools (e.g. SQL, Python, PySpark) to help predict, improve, and measure the success of key business to business outcomes.
+ Utilize statistical methods and analytical tools to extract meaningful insights from large and complex datasets.
+ Responsible for documenting data requirements, data collection / processing / cleaning, and exploratory data analysis, which may include utilizing statistical models / algorithms and data visualization techniques.
+ Incumbents in this role may often be referred to as Data Scientists.

**Technical Skills:**

+ Hands-on Experience in Python, SQL & Machine Learning (ML) is a must. Experience with PySpark is preferred.
+ Proficiency in GenAI technologies including prompt engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, and the development of Agentic AI.
+ Familiarity with GenAI governance principles and best practices to ensure responsible and compliant AI development.
+ Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code according to design specifications and coding standards.
+ Knowledge of digital marketing and Credit Card business, and industry best practices is highly beneficial.
+ Experience working and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
+ Ability to guide and mentor the junior team members. Ability to build partnerships with cross-functional teams.

**Qualifications:**

+ Bachelor's Degree with at least 3 years of working experience OR Master's Degree with 2 years of working experience.
+ Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the management in a structured and simpler form.
+ Hands-on experience working with large, complex, unstructured dataset, data warehouses and ability to pull data using relevant programs and coding.
+ Experience in working on Investment Analytics, Retail Analytics, Credit Cards, Services, Banking & Markets Financial Services be nice to have.
+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be organized, detail oriented, flexible, and adaptive to matrix work environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

+ Experience in Python, PySpark, Hive, Impala, SQL programing will be preferred.
+ Credit card Business and P&L experience would be preferred.
+ Knowledge on Adobe, Test & Learn and other web analytics tool.

title: Senior Specialist - Market Risk
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Senior Specialist - Market Risk Operations will support the Gas & Power trading business by providing independent market risk measurement, exposure monitoring, P&L analysis, risk reporting, and control framework oversight. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex risk metrics into meaningful business insights for senior management.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Analyse and explain daily P&L movements and key portfolio risk drivers.
* Perform risk analysis using Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, sensitivity analysis, and other market risk methodologies.
* Monitor trading exposures and limits in accordance with the Trading Control Framework and Manual of Authorities (MOA).
* Provide insightful risk commentary on commodity trading portfolios, particularly Gas and Power.
* Conduct ad hoc data analysis and reporting using trading risk databases and reporting tools.
* Partner with traders, business stakeholders, and technology teams to investigate and resolve risk reporting and application issues.
* Develop and maintain reporting solutions, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Lead business improvement initiatives and risk-related projects with tight delivery timelines.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, SOX controls, Shell Control Framework, and internal policies.

**What You Bring**

* Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of market risk concepts including VaR, stress testing, sensitivity analysis, basis risk, volume risk, and currency risk.
* Knowledge of commodity markets, preferably LNG, Natural Gas, and Power trading.
* Experience working with risk management platforms such as Endur and Nucleus.
* Strong technical and analytical skills with hands-on experience in:

+ SQL and Oracle
+ Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar data visualization tools

* Ability to analyse large datasets and communicate findings effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project leadership capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* FRM or CFA certification.
* Experience supporting trading and risk management functions within commodity markets.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Pyspark Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**PySpark / Big Data Engineer**
to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Pipeline Design & Development**

* Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and Python to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage).
* Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
* Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing.

**Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization**

* Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection.
* Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks).

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads.
* Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro).

**Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps**

* Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines.
* Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest).

**Governance, Security & Quality**

* Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

**Required Technical Qualifications & Skills**

* Core Technologies - Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x
* Database & Querying - Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions
* Data Lake & Lakehouse - Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC
* Workflow & Orchestration - Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows
* Cloud Platforms - AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS)
* Streaming Technologies - Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Event Hubs, or Kinesis

**Key Competencies & Experience**

* Distributed Computing Fundamentals: In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies).
* Production Experience: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale.
* Problem Solving: Proven track record in debugging memory bottlenecks, Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors, and resolving data skew issues.
* Data Engineering Best Practices: Experience implementing modular code architectures, logging, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch), and alerting.
* Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks platform (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon engine, MLflow).
* Familiarity with Scala/Java in addition to Python.
* Knowledge of DataOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience with modern analytical data warehouses (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift).
* Relevant certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional AWS Certified Data Engineer / Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)CCA Spark and Hadoop Developer (or equivalent)
* Educational Requirements
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

Secondary : Bigdata, Abinitio, Unix, Oracle

You will help shape our strategy and standards, strengthen governance, and build a thriving BPM community of practice that delivers consistent, high-quality models ready for automation and insight. title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualification**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Manufacturing Experienced Professional - Production Planning & Scheduling
description:
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
**Role Purpose**
The Role will support the Global Drilling Services S&OP organization by transforming complex materials and operational data into scalable, automated, and actionable planning solutions.
  
  
The role will have a particular focus on repairable materials, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory, connecting data across operations, AMO, Manufacturing and regional organizations.
  
  
Rather than relying on manual analysis and individual material reviews, the role will develop automated data models, dashboards and analytics capable of identifying planning gaps, determining inventory requirements and supporting proactive materials decisions at global scale.
  
  
SQL, Power BI and automation will be key enablers of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop scalable analytical models and automated solutions supporting global S&OP and materials planning processes, with particular focus on repairables, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory.
* Connect and analyze data from SAP and other enterprise data sources, including material consumption, scrap, repair activity, circulation hours, installed/available asset population and inventory.
* Develop models to determine appropriate material and sub-assembly requirements based on asset population, historical consumption, utilization, repair behavior and operational demand.
* Build and maintain end-to-end Power BI solutions, including data extraction, transformation, data modeling, business logic, DAX and dashboard development.
* Use SQL to create scalable datasets and analytical models, reducing dependency on manual Excel-based analysis and repetitive data preparation.
* Develop automated planning alerts and exception-management mechanisms to identify material shortages, excess inventory, abnormal consumption, planning gaps and other conditions requiring action.
* Develop and progressively enhance predictive analytics supporting materials requirements and repairable inventory decisions.
* Maintain and improve analytical methodologies such as sub-assembly-to-asset ratios, ensuring planning parameters evolve with changes in fleet size, utilization and operational behavior.
* Improve visibility and control of capitalized inventory, supporting appropriate inventory positioning and utilization.
* Partner directly with Regional S&OP/Planning teams, AMO and Manufacturing to understand operational problems, validate assumptions and translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
* Work independently from an initially defined business problem to investigate data, identify root causes, develop potential solutions and implement sustainable tools with appropriate stakeholder guidance.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate existing manual processes across regions rather than developing isolated local solutions.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to S&OP and operational stakeholders based on the analytical models developed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including the ability to extract, combine, transform and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong Power BI capabilities, with demonstrated experience developing solutions end-to-end, including Power Query/data transformation, data modeling, DAX and visualization.
* Experience developing automated and scalable analytical solutions, replacing repetitive manual processes with sustainable data-driven workflows.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous business problem into a structured analytical approach and independently drive the solution with limited guidance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect operational behavior with materials and inventory requirements.
* Ability to work effectively across a global, cross-functional organization, interacting with regional teams, Manufacturing, AMO, S&OP and other functions.
* Fluent English and strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP data and materials-related processes. Deep SAP expertise is not required, but familiarity with SAP environments would be advantageous.
* Minimum 2 years' experience.
* Experience within Drilling Services, Oilfield Services or another asset-intensive industrial environment.
* Understanding of drilling tools, AMO/repair operations, manufacturing processes, repairable and sub-assemblies.
* Understanding of S&OP, materials planning, inventory management, MRP and/or supply-demand planning concepts.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Power Automate, SAP automation or similar workflow/automation platforms.
* Exposure to predictive analytics, statistical modeling or advanced demand/material requirement modeling.

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.

* Translate regulatory mandates and market surveillance policies into reliable, deterministic control algorithms and automated surveillance components.
* Collaborate with trading desks, risk managers, and compliance stakeholders to support the modeling of trade lifecycles, order workflows and multi-asset risk analytics.
* Perform application profiling, database tuning, and SQL query optimization to reduce bottlenecks, minimize latency and improve throughput.

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with solid hands-on experience building backend applications and data pipelines in Python.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, relational database design, query optimization, indexing strategies and database performance profiling.
* Working knowledge of Investment Banking and Capital Markets, including a good understanding of trade and transaction lifecycles, order management, execution workflows and market risk analytics.
* Demonstrated experience developing and supporting scalable systems handling sizable data volumes.
* Experience working within Agile frameworks, using Jira and GitHub for version control, branching strategies and collaborative development.

* A hybrid working model combining focused remote productivity with in-office collaboration in Pune.
