title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**Title: Analytics Consultant – Web & Mobile (Implementation)**

**Experience: 4+ years in Product Analytics Office**

**Timings: 2 PM to 12 AM IST**

**This role follows a rotational shift aligned with global client requirements.)**

The Role We are seeking an Analytics Consultant – Web & Mobile (Implementation) to deploy and optimise digital analytics solutions using platforms like Heap and Contentsquare. This role focuses on event tracking, implementation, and enabling clients to leverage behavioural data for product, marketing, and growth decisions. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong client-facing communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Technical & Domain Expertise ● Deploy and configure product analytics tools (Contentsquare, Heap) for event tagging, data capture, and KPI alignment ● Integrate analytics SDKs within mobile frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Xamarin) and align with tools like Firebase Analytics or Adjust ● Configure PII masking, API integrations, and data enrichment workflows ● Guide client technical teams in defining tracking requirements using HTML, CSS selectors, and JavaScript for web element mapping ● Implement and validate event tracking to ensure accurate and reliable data capture ● Conduct QA audits using console-based debugging to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness ● Develop detailed tracking plans and implementation documentation ● Analyse web and mobile behavioural data to uncover user patterns and recommend product and marketing optimisations ● Handshaking of data between MarTech tools — A/B testing, CRMs, transaction tools, tag managers, CDPs, marketing attribution tools, in-app guidance, etc. ● Design and implement UTM tracking frameworks and multi-touch attribution models for multi-channel campaigns ● Integrate marketing data sources with analytics platforms for ROI measurement across paid vs. organic acquisition 2. Mobile App Analytics ● Own end-to-end mobile analytics implementation across acquisition, engagement, retention, and user experience — a critical growth area for enterprise clients ● Instrument mobile-specific events (app installs, session start, in-app purchases, push interactions, deep links) and align with attribution SDKs like Adjust, AppsFlyer, or Firebase ● Measure mobile funnels, drop-offs, engagement metrics, retention curves, and cohort behaviour ● Advise clients on mobile metrics frameworks, data governance, and platform-specific nuances (iOS SKAdNetwork, Android privacy sandbox, consent management) ● Partner with client mobile engineering teams on A/B testing strategies and UX optimisation initiatives 3. Client Engagement & Delivery ● Translate business requirements into structured tracking and analytics implementation plans ● Manage end-to-end onboarding and implementation projects within agreed timelines ● Conduct workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations with client teams ● Provide ongoing advisory support to maximise analytics platform value realisation and build long-term client relationships

title: Associate Manager, Scripting
description:
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
We have Scripting Team in India, based in Gurgaon. This hub is part of our global Operations team, reporting into Operations Director based in the UK office. This team will focus on programming of ad hoc, tracking and syndicated quantitative studies, ensuring that survey instruments are tailored for precision and compliance with industry standards. The team will script and maintain online questionnaires enabling seamless data capture from healthcare professionals, patients, and key stakeholders. By integrating complex logic, customized routing, and validation checks, the team will ensure high-quality, error-free data. Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Scripting Team lead role will report into The Scripting Senior Manager position. The role will involve help with setting up the scripting function, working with Research and Project Management stakeholders to define the best practice and establish processes for scripting and data processing within the business, as well as managing actual scripting. This will include:
  
  

* Initial set up of the scripting and data processing function, working with a variety of senior stakeholders to understand requirements and suggest improvements.
* Implementation of new processes and policies, including preparing “the best practice” manuals and guides for Research and Project Management staff globally.
* Supporting a transition from an outsourced model to a blended in-house approach.
* Line management of Scripting Executives, including training, mentoring and involvement in recruitment and selection.
* Scripting and programming medium complexity online surveys using the Confirmit platform, incorporating logic, custom routing, and question validation to ensure seamless user experience and data accuracy
* Conducting rigorous testing of surveys before launch, identifying and resolving any programming or logic errors to ensure data integrity and smooth respondent experience
* Cleansing and validating data in the relevant software (SPSS or similar) and process survey data for tabulation
* Managing workloads of the team and delivery across projects
* Liaising with internal clients, advising on best practice, and assisting with problem solving

**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**

* More than 6 years of experience in a scripting role within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)
* Proficiency in using Confirmit’s scripting platform, including authoring, logic implementation, and deployment
* Solid understanding of scripting languages such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for customizing survey functionality and layout
* Experience working with survey data formats (e.g., XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management.
* Understanding of quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices.
* Demonstrable experience of working with senior and junior team members
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills
* Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**About Inizio Ignte:**
Inzio Ignite a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.

If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Quant Research Intern
description:
H TO H Partners LLP is a proprietary trading firm that trades its own capital in Indian index and commodity futures. We are building a systematic trading desk and are looking for a sharp Quant Research Intern to research, design and backtest trading strategies.

What you'll do

• Research and develop systematic strategies for Nifty/BankNifty and MCX futures (long and short)

• Build robust backtests with realistic costs, slippage and position sizing

• Run out-of-sample and walk-forward tests, and avoid overfitting, look-ahead and survivorship bias

• Track strategies in paper trading and present results to the trading team

What we're looking for

• Students or recent graduates in Maths, Statistics, Economics, CS or Engineering

• Strong Python (pandas, numpy); backtrader or vectorbt is a plus

• Solid statistics and time-series fundamentals

• Genuine interest in markets; knowledge of futures is a plus

• Kaggle, WorldQuant BRAIN or similar competition experience is a strong plus

Details

• Duration: 3 months

• Location: Remote

• Stipend: ₹10,000/month

• Strong performers may be offered an extension or a full-time role

How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn, or send your CV and GitHub/Kaggle profile to harshit23019@gmail.com with the subject "Quant Research Intern". Shortlisted candidates will get a take-home research assignment.

title: Global Digital Marketing Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The Global Digital Marketing Analytics Senior Analyst is a hands-on analytical practitioner who serves as the dedicated analytics resource across BCG's digital marketing channel teams — including email, paid media, web, content, and beyond. This person is embedded in the day-to-day rhythm of channel execution and campaign delivery, providing the analytical support, performance interpretation, and data-driven guidance that helps channel teams make smarter decisions about how they plan, optimize, and evolve their activations.
  
  
This is not a reporting role. The Senior Specialist goes beyond pulling numbers to actively interpreting what channel data means, identifying what is and is not working across the channel mix, and translating those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that channel strategists and campaign managers can act on in real time. This person is a trusted analytical partner to multiple channel teams simultaneously — organized enough to manage a broad portfolio of analytical support needs, and sharp enough to add genuine strategic value to each one.
  
  
**Channel Performance Analysis & Insight**

* Serve as the primary analytics partner across digital marketing channel teams — including email, paid media, web, social, and content — providing hands-on analytical support that helps each team understand and act on their performance data
* Analyze channel performance data on an ongoing basis, going beyond surface metrics to identify trends, anomalies, and patterns that reveal what is driving or limiting channel effectiveness across campaigns and activations
* Translate channel data findings into clear, actionable insight narratives that channel teams can use to make immediate optimization decisions — explaining not just what the numbers show but what they mean and what should change as a result
* Develop a working understanding of how each channel's data behaves — its quirks, its limitations, its attribution challenges, and its most meaningful performance signals — so that analytical conclusions are always grounded in an accurate picture of what the data can and cannot tell you
* Proactively surface channel performance insights to channel leads and campaign managers without waiting to be asked, identifying inflection points, underperformance signals, and optimization opportunities as they emerge

**Campaign & Activation Analytics Support**

* Support the analytics needs of active marketing campaigns across the channel mix — providing pre-campaign audience and benchmarking analysis, in-flight performance monitoring, and post-campaign measurement and insight synthesis
* Build and maintain campaign performance trackers and channel scorecards that give channel and campaign teams clear, current visibility into how activations are performing against goals across all relevant metrics
* Conduct cross-channel campaign analyses that connect the dots between how audiences are engaging across email, paid, web, and other digital touchpoints — identifying patterns in cross-channel behavior that inform how campaigns should be sequenced, optimized, or adjusted mid-flight
* Contribute to post-campaign retrospectives by preparing well-structured performance summaries and insight outputs that capture what worked, what did not, and what the data recommends for future activations

**Channel Strategy Insight & Optimization**

* Partner with channel leads and CX strategists to bring analytical perspective into channel strategy conversations to inform how channels are planned, invested in, and evolved over time
* Conduct deeper analytical investigations when channel performance raises strategic questions
* Identify recurring performance patterns across channels and campaigns that point to systemic optimization opportunities — bringing these findings forward with clear recommendations rather than simply observing them
* Support channel investment and prioritization conversations with data — preparing analytical inputs that help marketing leadership understand where channel spend and effort are generating the strongest return

**Data Pulling, Validation & Reporting**

* Extract, validate, and prepare channel performance data from across BCG's digital marketing technology stack — including Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, SEMRush, Demandbase, ad network platforms, CRM, and other relevant sources — ensuring accuracy and consistency before any analysis or output is produced
* Write SQL queries against the marketing master dataset in Snowflake to access audience and engagement data that supplements platform-level reporting, expanding the analytical picture available for channel insight work
* Build and maintain recurring channel reporting outputs — dashboards, scorecards, and performance summaries — that keep channel teams consistently informed without requiring manual analytical effort for every update
* Apply rigorous data validation habits to all analytical work — checking figures, interrogating unexpected results, and never presenting numbers to stakeholders without confidence in their accuracy

**Enablement & Analytical Standards**

* Develop and maintain channel-specific metric glossaries, reporting templates, and analytical reference guides that help channel teams interpret their own data more independently and consistently
* Contribute to the development of shared analytical standards across the marketing analytics function — ensuring that metrics, definitions, and performance benchmarks are applied consistently across channels and campaigns
* Support the onboarding of channel team members onto analytics tools and reporting outputs, helping new colleagues understand how to read and use the data available to them

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in a digital marketing analytics, channel analytics, or marketing data role, with hands-on experience analyzing performance data across at least two or more digital marketing channels — email, paid media, web, social, or equivalent
* Solid working knowledge of the digital marketing channel landscape — how each channel works, what its key performance metrics are, how attribution and measurement differ across channels, and how audience behavior connects across touchpoints
* Hands-on experience working with marketing analytics platforms including at least several of the following: Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, SEMRush, Demandbase, Google Analytics, paid media ad network reporting platforms, or equivalent
* Solid SQL skills at a querying and analysis level, with the ability to independently access and interrogate marketing datasets in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse environment
* Proficiency in Tableau or a comparable data visualization platform for building and maintaining channel performance dashboards and analytical outputs
* Strong data validation instincts and attention to detail — you check your own work, interrogate unexpected results, and take accuracy seriously before anything goes to a stakeholder
* Clear, confident communication skills with the ability to present channel performance findings and recommendations to channel leads, campaign managers, and senior marketing stakeholders in a way that is accessible, structured, and actionable
* Experience working in a fast-moving, campaign-driven marketing environment where analytical support needs shift quickly and responsiveness matters
* Familiarity with A/B testing methodology and the ability to interpret test results accurately and communicate findings clearly
* Experience working in an Agile or sprint-based environment preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With
  
  
This role sits within BCG's Global Marketing analytics function and operates as a shared analytical resource across the digital marketing channel teams. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the channel leads, managers, and leads across email, paid media, web, events, and content — the people whose campaign and activation shapes your analytical work is designed to sharpen and inform. You will be present in their planning conversations, their optimization reviews, and their campaign retrospectives, bringing data to the table at the moments when it matters most.
  
  
Within the analytics function, you will work closely with the Senior Manager and Director of Marketing Analytics, contributing channel-level analytical output that feeds into the broader audience and performance insight picture the function produces for senior marketing leadership. You will also collaborate with dashboard and data engineering colleagues when channel reporting needs require new data pipelines or expanded Snowflake access, and with CRM data operations colleagues when audience and contact data underpins channel targeting or segmentation analysis.
  
  
This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys the variety and pace of working across multiple channels simultaneously — who finds satisfaction in being the person a channel team turns to when the data raises a question they cannot answer on their own, and who takes pride in giving them an answer that actually changes what they do next.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Getting into the data quickly and knowing what you are looking for — you have strong analytical instincts developed across enough channel experience that you notice when something looks off, when a trend is significant, and when a number needs to be investigated before it gets presented
* Working across multiple channels and analytical workstreams simultaneously without losing quality or momentum — you are organized, prioritize well, and deliver reliably across a busy and varied portfolio of analytical support needs
* Translating channel performance data into plain language that channel managers and campaign teams can act on — you don't hide behind technical terminology or data caveats, you give people the insight they need to make a decision
* Being a genuine partner to channel teams rather than a report factory — you show up to conversations with a perspective, ask clarifying questions that sharpen the analytical brief, and add value beyond the specific output that was requested
* Moving fluidly across the digital channel landscape — you are comfortable switching from an email performance analysis to a paid media attribution question to a web engagement funnel in the same day, and you bring enough channel-specific knowledge to each that your analysis is grounded and credible
* Knowing the difference between a data issue and a performance issue — you have the technical discipline to validate your data before drawing conclusions, and the intellectual honesty to say when the data is not clean enough to support the insight being requested

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
#MarTech
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect - Source.AI
description:
Job ID: 113274

* Gurugram

Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.**

**YOUR IMPACT**
---------------

You will lead the engineering function for Source.AI, McKinsey's GenAI-powered, agentic category-management and sourcing platform.

You will set and drive the end-to-end technical vision across data engineering, data science, and full-stack software development, ensuring the platform is designed, built, and scaled to meet the needs of enterprise procurement clients globally.

You will own technical direction for a multi-surface product stack: AWS based, a NestJS and Next.js monorepo (Nx, pnpm), Python FastAPI microservices, per-client Snowflake data tenants, and an agentic AI layer spanning spend intelligence, market radar, category strategy, negotiation coaching, and tail-spend repricing. You will lead a team of data engineers, data scientists, and full-stack developers, partnering with product leadership and delivery leads to ship the roadmap while maintaining delivery SLAs on live client deployments.

You will architect and operationalize GenAI capabilities at production scale, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), NL2SQL, prompt engineering, vector search, and multi-agent orchestration, all routed through McKinsey's enterprise AI Gateway with Responsible-AI guardrails. You will establish engineering best practices, AI-assisted SDLC workflows, and observability standards so the team ships secure, reliable, and governable AI-driven features on a continuous cadence.

You will play a critical role in scaling Source.AI from a proven PoC portfolio to an enterprise-grade SaaS platform, driving transformative impact by enabling intelligent, scalable, and secure agent-based technologies that unlock measurable savings, productivity, and risk visibility for procurement teams worldwide.

**YOUR GROWTH**
---------------

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

* **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* **Global community:** With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* **World-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**
----------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering or platform architecture, including 3+ years in technical leadership or people management roles leading cross-functional engineering teams
* Proven track record building and scaling GenAI products in production, with ownership of architecture, delivery, post-launch iteration, reliability, and performance
* Experience leading teams across data engineering, data science, and full-stack development, with the ability to set technical direction, mentor senior ICs, and drive accountability across workstreams
* Strong expertise in GenAI systems, including LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG pipelines, NL2SQL, vector databases, embeddings, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel
* Proficiency with AI-assisted software development methodologies and tools, including Cursor, Claude Code, and comparable agentic coding environments; comfortable driving an AI-native SDLC across teams
* Strong cloud engineering experience, preferably on AWS, with working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, distributed or event-driven systems, message queues, and real-time data flows
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake data modeling, multi-tenant data isolation, and ETL/ELT pipelines for enterprise-scale data onboarding
* Familiarity with modern full-stack development, including TypeScript/Node.js, NestJS, React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, and monorepo tooling such as Nx and pnpm
* Knowledge of AI governance, security, compliance, and observability, including guardrails for safety and reliability, prompt tracing, cost tracking, and failure analysis
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align product leaders, partners, delivery teams, and cross-functional stakeholders around technical and business priorities

Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues.

Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Ability to translate complex or ambiguous requirements into scalable technical solutions.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description: Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.About SarvamSarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.What this role promises youYou will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.What you'll doBuild and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail. Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents. Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from. Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily. Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time. Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves. Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer. Write design docs and keep decisions documented. Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.Who you areWe are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke. You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day. You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL. You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover. You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back. You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't. You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it. Bonus pointsExperience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction. Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications. Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction. Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems. Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production. On-prem or air-gapped deployments. Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: Sr. Alteryx Developer with PySpark 5+yrs (Hyderabad & Bangalore)
description:
**Senior Alteryx Developer 5+yrs**

**Preferably Bangalore & Hyderabad location.**

**Full time permanent position with Vivid Edge Corp.**

We are seeking a Senior Alteryx Developer with deep specialization in Data Preparation and Wrangling to architect, clean, standardise, and enrich high-volume datasets across our enterprise data ecosystem. In this role, you will be the core technical authority responsible for turning messy, fragmented, and unstructured raw data into clean, highly structured, and business-ready data assets.

You will design production-grade data preparation workflows using Alteryx Designer, leverage In-Database techniques for massive scale, enforce data quality and governance standards, and feed pristine datasets downstream to BI platforms, machine learning models, and executive reporting systems.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Data Preparation & Cleansing

Design, build, and optimize enterprise-level Alteryx workflows dedicated to heavy data profiling, cleansing, deduplication, blending, and schema normalization from disparate, messy sources.

Standardize data inputs across structured (SQL, Snowflake), semi-structured (JSON, XML), and unstructured formats (PDFs, log files, multi-tab Excel sheets, web scrapes).

Implement advanced string manipulation, regex patterns, fuzzy matching, and parsing logic to resolve data discrepancies and unify identity records across platforms.

Architect automated data quality auditing frameworks within workflows to detect, isolate, and log missing values, schema drifts, outliers, and corrupted records before downstream consumption.

Enterprise Pipeline Development & Scalability

Build high-performance ETL/ELT data preparation pipelines utilizing Alteryx In-Database (In-Db) processing and SQL pushdown execution to process multi-terabyte datasets efficiently.

Develop reusable Batch, Iterative, and Standard Macros to standardize recurring data prep tasks (e.g., date standardization, currency conversion, schema mapping, dynamic multi-file ingestion).

Build robust error-handling, automated alerts, and logging protocols to ensure zero data loss and seamless pipeline recovery during failure events.

Manage workflow deployment, scheduling, credentials, and data connection pooling on Alteryx Server (Gallery).

Required Technical Skills

Alteryx Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience using Alteryx Designer with a primary focus on data preparation (Parsing, Preparation, Transform, Developer, and In-Db tool categories).

Advanced Data Wrangling: Deep mastery of data manipulation techniques—including Regex, Parse, Fuzzy Matching, Spatial Data Prep, Cross-Tab, Transpose, and Join/Union strategies.

SQL & Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL proficiency (joins, window functions, CTEs, complex data type conversions) and direct experience wrangling data within cloud warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift).

Server Administration & Scheduling: 2+ years of experience publishing, scheduling, and optimizing memory usage for data-prep workloads on Alteryx Server.

Certifications: Alteryx Designer Advanced or Expert Certification required.

title: Data Analytics Engineer III
description:
Position Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help define and scale analytics across Experity.
  
  
This role will own analytical domains and build semantic models, trusted metrics, reusable datasets, and AI-ready data products. The Senior Analytics Engineer will work across analytics, data engineering, architecture, product, and AI teams to translate ambiguous business needs into scalable analytical solutions.
  
  
This is not primarily a dashboard development or traditional reporting role. The focus is creating trusted analytical foundations that can be reused across products, teams, applications, and AI experiences.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution with analytical judgment. They can independently work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, make sound modeling decisions, and improve how analytics is delivered.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own assigned analytical domains from requirements clarification through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
* Design and maintain semantic models representing Experity’s products, business processes, and core business entities.
* Define reusable analytical datasets, governed metrics, and centralized business logic.
* Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable data products rather than one-off analytical solutions.
* Determine appropriate data grain, facts, dimensions, conformed entities, and relationships.
* Make informed decisions about whether business logic belongs in the transformation layer, semantic layer, or consuming application.
* Develop production-quality transformations using SQL, Python, Snowflake, and dbt.
* Establish automated testing, documentation, monitoring, and data-quality controls for owned models.
* Design semantic models, metadata, metric definitions, descriptions, and verified query patterns that enable AI tools and natural-language interfaces to reliably interpret analytical data.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering speed, quality, and consistency.
* Partner directly with U.S.-based analytics, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify tradeoffs.
* Proactively raise unclear requirements, data quality concerns, architectural risks, and design decisions.
* Collaborate with data engineers and architects to establish reliable and scalable analytical patterns.
* Lead analytics-engineering onboarding for new products and business domains.
* Identify duplicated logic, inconsistent metric definitions, architectural gaps, and opportunities for automation or reuse.
* Create reusable patterns that can be adopted across domains rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.
* Review analytical designs and code produced by other engineers and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex production, performance, and data-quality issues.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Assigned analytical domains can move from business requirements to production with limited supervision.
* Metrics are trusted and consistent across BI tools, applications, products, and AI experiences.
* Priority domains have reusable, well-documented semantic models.
* Business logic is centralized, testable, version-controlled, and appropriately governed.
* Architectural and data-quality issues are identified before they become downstream reporting problems.
* Analysts spend less time rebuilding foundational logic or reconciling competing metric definitions.
* New products and domains follow reusable patterns rather than starting from scratch.
* Patterns established in one domain are successfully reused across additional domains.
* Junior and mid-level engineers benefit from technical guidance, reviews, and established engineering practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, advanced data analytics, or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, analytical, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced SQL skills and strong understanding of query performance and maintainability.
* Working proficiency with Python for data processing, automation, testing, or analytics engineering workflows.
* Strong experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.
* Strong experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data grain, facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions, business entities, and reusable analytical design.
* Demonstrated experience designing production-quality analytical models rather than only consuming existing datasets.
* Experience with Git, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, and production software development practices.
* Ability to independently turn ambiguous requirements into clear analytical solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and explain modeling decisions to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, ownership, and communication skills.
* Experience working effectively with distributed or cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer

Our platform supports the full lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. We are seeking a hands-on Principal Software Development Engineer to provide technical leadership for this greenfield platform. You will define architecture and engineering strategy for highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. You will solve ambiguous, cross-organizational problems; establish durable technical patterns; and raise the engineering bar while remaining deeply engaged in design, implementation, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.

This role combines broad autonomy with the opportunity to integrate with existing OCI systems through well-established contracts. You will influence the direction of a foundational platform at cloud scale and help shape how OCI continues to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a hands-on cloud engineer and technical leader with a record of delivering high-scale, high-impact distributed systems.
* You turn ambiguous business and infrastructure problems into clear technical strategy, phased execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
* You care deeply about customers and consistently make sound trade-offs among reliability, security, velocity, simplicity, and cost.
* You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product leaders, and partner teams.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience designing, shipping, and operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.

* Strong proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; proficiency with scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Deep experience with distributed-systems fundamentals, microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication, data consistency, fault tolerance, and highly available service design.

* Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and programming paradigms.

* Experience with the physical asset lifecycle in cloud-scale data centers, including planning, delivery, inventory, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems, capacity-planning tools, or physical infrastructure workflows.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.

* Experience diagnosing and resolving complex performance, scaling, and reliability issues in large distributed environments.
* Track record of establishing technical standards, reusable platform capabilities, or engineering practices adopted across teams.

Responsibilities

* Own and evolve the technical architecture for services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Lead the design and delivery of resilient, scalable, secure, and operable services for the end-to-end physical asset lifecycle.
* Translate long-term business and infrastructure goals into technical strategy, architecture roadmaps, and sequenced execution plans.
* Remain hands-on: prototype critical paths, review code and designs, solve difficult technical problems, and guide implementation of high-risk components.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, operations, security, and partner organizations; establish clear interfaces and durable integration contracts.
* Define and champion operational-excellence standards, including observability, service health, incident learning, capacity planning, and reliability goals.
* Identify systemic risks, technical debt, and scaling bottlenecks; prioritize improvements using customer impact and data-driven analysis.
* Raise the technical bar through architectural reviews, engineering standards, technical mentorship, and constructive feedback.
* Influence major decisions for new and existing products, build consensus around trade-offs, and communicate decisions clearly to stakeholders.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components

* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Detection Engineer – Early Career**
=====================================

  
  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-23

  

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Good data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Passion to write code and build solutions.
* Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to design, develop, and optimize scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines. The candidate will work across batch and real-time data processing, object storage, analytical data layers, and reusable data transformation frameworks. The role requires strong hands-on engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, configurable, and maintainable data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**  
· Design, develop, and maintain batch and real-time data ingestion pipelines.

· Build data processing workflows using Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and PySpark.

· Implement streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, including buffering, replay, and failure recovery.

· Develop layered data architectures covering raw, cleansed, transformed, and curated datasets.

· Build reusable components for data cleansing, joins, aggregations, validation, and transformations.

· Integrate object storage with analytical table formats and processing engines.

· Implement schema discovery, schema evolution, data quality checks, and metadata management.

· Work with structured and semi-structured formats, including Parquet, CSV, and JSON.

· Develop data decoding and transformation workflows based on provided data dictionaries, format specifications, scaling rules, and engineering units.

· Optimize Spark jobs, data partitioning, incremental processing, and analytical workloads.

· Implement logging, monitoring, error handling, and recovery mechanisms for data pipelines.

· Collaborate with backend and frontend engineers to integrate data services with application APIs and user interfaces.

· Containerize services using Docker and support development and deployment in Linux-based, on-premises environments.

· Write test cases, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and maintain technical documentation.

Required Skills

· 5–6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering and pipeline development.

· Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and PySpark.

· Practical experience with Apache Kafka and real-time or near-real-time data processing.

· Experience designing batch and streaming pipelines, including retries, checkpointing, replay, and fault handling.

· Hands-on experience with object storage such as SeaweedFS, MinIO, or S3-compatible storage.

· Experience with Apache Iceberg or comparable lakehouse table formats, including schema evolution, partitioning, and metadata management.

· Strong understanding of Parquet, CSV, JSON, schema management, and data validation.

· Experience building layered data architectures and reusable transformation frameworks.

· Experience implementing joins, aggregations, incremental processing, and data quality rules.

· Experience optimizing Spark jobs and handling large datasets efficiently.

· Familiarity with PostgreSQL or equivalent relational databases.

· Experience with REST APIs, Docker, Linux, Git, and software debugging.

· Ability to develop configurable pipelines that can be extended to new datasets and processing requirements.

Pay: ₹1,010,000.00 - ₹1,880,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

description:

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. **Take the first step towards your dream career**  
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* Expert-level proficiency with **VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vCenter, ESXi**, and enterprise‑scale virtualization management
* Extensive hands-on experience with **VMware Aria Automation (vRA/vRealize), Aria Operations, and orchestration tooling**, including lifecycle management, blueprints, policies, and extensibility
* Demonstrated experience architecting and developing **complex automation pipelines**, including API-driven workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and multi‑platform integrations
* Strong programming or scripting expertise (Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or equivalent) for automation, platform integration, and orchestration logic
* Experience integrating DevOps automation with **ServiceNow**, including CMDB synchronization, workflow automation, and custom orchestration triggers
* Deep understanding of **cloud automation frameworks**, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and enterprise DevOps practices
* Strong knowledge of **platform observability**, operational analytics, and distributed system diagnostics
* Ability to lead architectural initiatives, produce clear technical documentation, and mentor cross-functional engineering teams
* Experience operating within Agile/SCRUM teams, influencing strategy across multiple software and infrastructure groups
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with global engineering, operations, and platform teams

  

**Desirable Requirements**

* Strong familiarity with **Agile/SCRUM methodologies** and enterprise SDLC practices

**Who we are**

Enablement & Best Practices
