And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**Quality Assurance Engineer**

Security Implementation & Integration Quality Assurance | Enterprise Security Program

**Experience**

* 5 – 9 yrs experience
  

**Employment type**

Full-time

  

**Working model**

Global collaboration; flexible hours as needed

  

**Role overview**
=================

We are looking for a proactive and quality-focused QA Engineer to support information security implementation and integration projects. The ideal candidate brings strong IT fundamentals, a disciplined approach to delivery, and a genuine commitment to learning. Direct QA or security-testing experience is valuable, but transferable experience from any IT domain is welcome when supported by the right mindset, ownership, and attention to detail.

  

**What matters most: ownership, reliability, learning agility, collaboration, and consistent follow-through.**
==============================================================================================================

**Key responsibilities**
========================

* **Quality planning and delivery:** Understand project requirements, risks, and acceptance criteria; translate them into practical test strategies, plans, scenarios, cases, and data.
* **Test execution:** Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing across project releases; maintain clear traceability to requirements.
* **Defect management:** Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through closure; provide concise evidence and work constructively with delivery teams on resolution.
* **Security-focused validation:** Support testing of security-related solutions and integrations, including negative scenarios, access controls, data handling, and agreed security requirements.
* **Automation and efficiency:** Contribute to reusable automated tests, test-data management, and integration of suitable tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* **Quality governance:** Follow agreed QA standards, maintain audit-ready evidence, and contribute to quality metrics, status reporting, and release-readiness decisions.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with product, engineering, operations, information security, and vendor teams across locations and time zones.
* **Continuous improvement:** Actively identify gaps, suggest pragmatic improvements, share knowledge, and strengthen team practices.

  

**Mindset and behaviours**

* + **Ownership and accountability:** Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through on commitments, and raises risks early.
  + **Commitment and reliability:** Demonstrates consistent effort, discipline, and dependability, especially during critical delivery periods.
  + **Learning agility:** Quickly understands unfamiliar technologies, business processes, and security concepts; actively seeks and applies feedback.
  + **Quality mindset:** Looks beyond happy-path validation, asks thoughtful questions, and focuses on preventing defects rather than only detecting them.
  + **Collaboration and respect:** Communicates clearly, works well with diverse stakeholders, and contributes to a supportive, high-performing team environment.
  + **Pragmatic problem solving:** Uses evidence and sound judgement to balance risk, speed, and quality.

**Required qualifications and capabilities**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 5 years of professional experience. Experience may come from software development, application support, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business analysis, operations, testing, or a comparable technology role.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand requirements, identify risk, and communicate findings clearly.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to organize work, manage priorities, meet commitments, and operate effectively with appropriate guidance.
* High attention to detail and a demonstrable commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes.

  

**Preferred experience**

* Hands-on experience in software testing, test management, defect management, or quality engineering.
* Exposure to Agile or Scrum delivery and collaboration in cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with APIs, databases, web applications, integrations, or cloud-based solutions.
* Exposure to test automation frameworks, scripting, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Awareness of information security principles, security testing approaches, vulnerability management, or secure development practices.
* Experience working with distributed teams, vendor partners, or global stakeholders.

* Test strategy or test approach aligned to project risk and scope.
* Test plans, scenarios, cases, scripts, test data, and requirement traceability.
* Clear defect records with reproducible steps and supporting evidence.
* Test execution results, quality metrics, risk summaries, and release-readiness input.
* Automation assets and reusable QA documentation, where applicable.

  

**How success will be measured**

* Consistent delivery against agreed commitments and quality standards.
* Clear, accurate, and timely reporting of progress, defects, dependencies, and risks.
* Effective collaboration and constructive challenge within cross-functional teams.
* Growth in domain knowledge, QA capability, and ability to work with increasing independence.
* Meaningful improvement in test coverage, repeatability, and team efficiency.

**Why join this team**
======================

This role offers the opportunity to build deeper quality-engineering and information-security expertise while contributing to business-critical initiatives. You will work with global stakeholders, learn across technologies and platforms, and help shape practical QA practices in a team that values accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**Informa** is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis** is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Quality Engineer with strong expertise in automation and modern Quality Engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience on creating automated data validation scripts to test ETL data pipelines and report bugs or glitches. This position requires hands-on experience in ETL Testing and Automated Test Development. You will also be responsible for UI, API, backend, and performance testing, with a passion for engineering scalable automation solutions, driving quality throughout the SDLC, and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve software quality and delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and manage the data quality framework across production data pipelines.
* Build reusable data quality checks using tools such as Great Expectations or equivalent frameworks.
* Working with large and complex data sets (SQL and No-SQL), data lakes (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Test Automation - Build automated data validation scripts to test the quality of data in data lake (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Define checks for schema, null values, uniqueness, referential integrity, data volume, freshness, late-arriving data, and business rules.
* Integrate data quality checks at ingestion, transformation, and pre-publish stages.
* Participate in requirements analysis, test strategy, test planning, risk assessment, test estimation, and release validation activities.
* Validate REST APIs, backend services, databases, and microservices through automated and manual testing.
* Perform performance and load testing using JMeter or BlazeMeter, analyse bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for performance improvements.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring quality gates, automated reporting, and continuous feedback.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality software delivery.
* Perform defect analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and support production issue investigations.
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate test design, automation development, defect analysis, and framework maintenance.
* Continuously improve automation coverage, framework stability, execution efficiency, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor junior Quality Engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Experience:**

* 3–4 years of experience in Quality Engineering, with strong expertise in Data Engineering, Data Quality, or Data Reliability Engineering.
* Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, dbt Tests, Deequ, or equivalent tools.
* Strong SQL skills, including window functions, complex joins, and queries on large partitioned datasets.
* Minimum 2 year of hands-on coding experience in Python.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in ETL testing of Data Pipelines and Data Warehouse.
* Experience with cloud data lake technologies, including S3, Glue, Athena, Spark on EMR, and Apache Iceberg.
* Experience in API automation (REST APIs, Postman, API testing frameworks).
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and modern Quality Engineering practices.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with test strategy, risk-based testing, test planning, and quality metrics.
* Experience in defect management, root cause analysis, and release quality validation.

**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 5-7 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.
* Extensive Travel:The role is based out of Bangalore and requires extensive travel across various states in India, depending on project and business requirements.

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (5-7) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Security Operations & Threat Hunter with exceptional troubleshooting abilities and a deep understanding of both endpoint and cloud threats. The ideal candidate will be a key player in our Security Operations Center (SOC), proactively hunting for threats, analyzing security incidents, and ensuring the protection of our infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments.

This role offers a distinct growth trajectory: beyond day-to-day triage and incident response, you will dedicate meaningful time to high-impact engineering projects, AI-driven security automation, and direct collaboration with senior engineering leadership.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Analyze security alerts from security tools to identify potential threats.
* Conduct forensic investigations and deep-dive analysis of security events to identify trends, attack techniques, and areas for improvement.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, and cloud environments to identify sophisticated cyber threats.
* Analyze security logs, behavioral patterns, and anomalies to detect indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Investigate security incidents, perform forensic analysis, and provide actionable recommendations for mitigation and remediation.
* Develop and refine threat hunting methodologies, leveraging frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
* Automate threat detection and analysis using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Continuously monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack trends to improve detection and response strategies.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of experience in security operations, threat hunting, or a similar cybersecurity role.
* Experience working with log data for detection and response across Cloud, EDR, Network, and related telemetry.
* Experience developing and deploying effective detection rules (e.g., YARA, Sigma, SQL-based rules, Network signatures).
* Strong understanding of network security monitoring, packet analysis, and log correlation.
* Deep understanding of advanced threat detection methodologies and threat intelligence.
* Proficiency in analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) based on frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation for security operations (Python, PowerShell, or Bash).
* Solid understanding of endpoint security, identity management, cloud security, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response, and threat intelligence.
* Strong communication skills, an inquisitive mindset, and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and collaborate across teams.

**Working Model & Schedule**
----------------------------

* **Global Exposure & Quarterly Rotations:** To foster close alignment with our distributed engineering teams and US leadership, this role follows a structured quarterly time-zone rotation (rotating through San Francisco/PST, New York/EST, and local daytime business hours). This cadence provides direct access to senior leadership, high-visibility global projects, and cross-functional teams across the organization.
* **Rotational On-Call Coverage:** Shared participation in rotational weekend on-call pager duty to triage critical incidents alongside team members and leadership.
* **Location & Hybrid Flexibility:** Based in Bangalore. During local daytime business cycles, work on-site from our Bangalore office to build strong peer relationships and cross-functional connections; flexible remote arrangements apply during global and US-aligned cycles.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: Security Consultant
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 23, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752299

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Security Consultant**

**Job Summary:**

As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.

  

The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.

  

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity:**

The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.

The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**

This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

  

**Skills and attributes for success:**

The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.

  

A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.
* Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

  

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

  

**What working at EY offers:**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

title: Data Architect
description:
**We’re Hiring: Databricks Data Architect**

Are you passionate about building state-of-the-art data platforms and leading modern enterprise transformations? We are looking for an experienced
**Databricks Data Architect**
to lead the architecture, design, and optimization of our enterprise Databricks Lakehouse platform.

In this role, you will define target-state architectures, modernize legacy platforms, and build high-performance, secure, and governed data products at scale.

**📍 Key Responsibilities**

* **Lakehouse Architecture:**
  Design & implement enterprise-scale Databricks Lakehouse solutions leveraging Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and Databricks SQL.
* **Modernization & Migration:**
  Lead migration and refactoring of legacy Synapse, SQL Server, Hadoop, and T-SQL workloads into PySpark, Databricks SQL, and Delta-based architectures.
* **Data Modeling & Performance:**
  Architect Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) models and implement Liquid Clustering, Z-Ordering, partitioning, and cost optimization strategies.
* **Real-time Ingestion:**
  Build robust streaming and batch ingestion frameworks using Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, and Delta Change Data Feed (CDF).
* **Governance & Security:**
  Integrate enterprise security, data quality, lineage, and compliance via Unity Catalog.
* **Automation & DataOps:**
  Establish CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), and Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB).

**💡 Key Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  12+ years in Data Engineering/Architecture, with
  **5+ years specifically in Databricks architecture**
  .
* **Core Tech Stack:**
  Databricks Lakehouse, PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, DLT, and MLflow.
* **Cloud Platform:**
  Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (ADLS Gen2, ADF, Azure Entra ID, Event Hubs).
* **Automation:**
  Hands-on experience with Git, Terraform, Azure DevOps, and DABs.
* **Domain:**

* **Concepts:**

title: Customer Support Agent (Trading Platform)
description:
**About GoCharting**

GoCharting is one of the most advanced platforms for seeing and trading the markets. Traders use it to read price and volume through professional orderflow tools - footprint charts, volume profile, cumulative delta, DOM - to analyse the market and to place orders through their broker, all in the browser.

Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world: from people learning to read orderflow to professionals who trade every session. 3M+ registered traders, PE-backed since 2025, profitable, with a mandate to scale 10x over four years.

**The role**

You'll be the person traders talk to when they need help with GoCharting - and the person who actually solves it.

The questions are rarely simple. A footprint chart looks different from what a trader expects. Data for a symbol is delayed. A broker connection drops just before the market opens. An order didn't go through. A subscription didn't renew. Behind each message is a trader who is in the middle of a session and is losing time or money while they wait.

Your job is to understand the product deeply enough to find the real cause, give a complete answer, and - when it's a bug - give our engineers everything they need to fix it. Over time, you become one of the people in the company who knows the product best and knows what traders struggle with.

**What you'll do**

* Solve product questions end to end. Charts and indicators, orderflow tools, market data, broker connections and order execution, account and billing. Reproduce the problem in the platform yourself, check the obvious causes, and come back with an answer that closes the question.
* Write answers that close the question. One complete, professional reply instead of several chat bubbles. You'll work to our Communication Standards - a short guide on tone, structure and what a complete answer looks like.
* Explain the product to traders. Help people set up and read footprint charts, volume profile, DOM and other tools - clearly, in their terms, without a script.
* Troubleshoot technical issues. Check what the trader sees, look at the browser console, compare accounts and settings, narrow it down before escalating.
* Escalate bugs with evidence. Write bug reports an engineer can act on without asking a follow-up question: what the trader did, what happened, what was expected, environment, screenshots, whether it reproduces.
* React fast during incidents. When data or the platform has a problem during market hours, flag it immediately and keep traders informed.
* Turn repeated questions into knowledge. Write and improve help articles and saved replies, so the next trader with the same question gets the answer faster.
* Be the trader's voice inside the company. Tag conversations properly and bring patterns to the team: what confuses traders, what breaks, what they keep asking for.

  

**How we think about the work**

Every action in the inbox has consequences down the line. A wrong tag hides a problem from the people who could fix it. A premature close brings the trader back angrier. A vague escalation costs an engineer an hour. We look for people who think about what happens next - to the trader, to the colleague who picks up after them, and to the team that receives the escalation.

**You're probably a fit if**

* You write excellent English - clear, calm and complete. This is the core of the job.
* You have 2+ years of customer-facing support for a technical product, ideally B2C SaaS or fintech, working a real inbox (chat, email, messaging).
* You like figuring out how things work. You can follow a UI, read an error, reproduce a problem and use browser DevTools at a basic level.
* You take ownership of a conversation until it's solved, not until it's handed off.
* Strong plus: you trade, or you've supported a trading, brokerage or market-data product. You know what a chart, an order book, a session and a broker connection are - and ideally you've used orderflow tools yourself.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with a modern helpdesk (Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar); writing help articles; Hindi and / or Tamil.

  

**Probably not a fit if**

* You prefer ready-made scripts to understanding the product and the actual question.
* You see escalation as "passing the ticket on".

  

**Working hours**

We support traders across Indian and US market hours, so the team works in shifts, including evening and night shifts (remote), with weekend and public holiday shifts on a rotation. Shift, weekend and holiday work come with allowances.

**Logistics**  
Location: Chennai, India.

Employment type: Full-time, Onsite/Hybrid.

Reports to: Customer Support lead.

*If you've read this far, please start your answer to the first question with the word "Orderflow" - so we know you've read the whole description.*

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.
* Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models.
* Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability.
* Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

title: Senior Specialist - Embedded Testing
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Responsible for Handling an Embedded Testing Team across Protection & Controls product lines and responsible for planning, designing, developing, and executing comprehensive test strategies to ensure the delivery of high‑quality products. This role involves close collaboration with development, product, and engineering teams to test/validate embedded products and Will lead testing strategies, identify issues early, automate test processes, and drive continuous quality improvements, develop automation frameworks.

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

* Conduct comprehensive functionality testing across protection and control products to ensure reliable operation under normal and fault conditions.
* Validate correct operation of protection schemes by simulating fault conditions and verifying product response.
* Expert in validating and testing industrial communication protocols like IEC 61850, IEC 60870, Modbus, DNP3
* Design and develop advanced test automation frameworks and scripts to enhance testing efficiency, accuracy, and coverage for embedded systems and communication protocols.
* Design, develop, and operate advanced Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Firmware-in-the-Loop (FIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test environments to simulate real-world grid conditions and validate embedded firmware performance.
* Extensive hands-on experience in testing and validating embedded communication interfaces and tools, including Serial Port Monitor, Tera Term, and Wireshark, along with modules such as Wi-Fi, BLE, USB, and Ethernet, ensuring reliable connectivity, data integrity, and protocol compliance.
* Conduct R&D for power system domain applications.
* Perform deep-dive debugging of embedded firmware and hardware interactions during system failures, utilizing oscilloscopes and logic analysers for detailed signal and timing analysis.
* Develop and interpret wiring diagrams to ensure accurate system understanding and effective fault isolation.
* Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and design documents.
* Define and implement overall testing strategies including functional, regression, performance, security, and automation testing.
* Knowledge in understanding Product Requirements, Marketing Requirements and deriving System Integration test cases.
* Contribute to risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
* Should be highly creative in coming up with out-of-box scenarios for testing and bugs
* Identify, analyse, and document defects using tracking tools
* Track defects through resolution and verify fixes
* Provide clear test reports, metrics, and dashboards to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to ensure testability and quality in every stage of development.
* Participate in design and code reviews with a quality-first perspective.
* Advocate for quality engineering practices and continuous improvement.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers.
* Lead test initiatives for large features or project modules.
* Perform end-to-end system analysis and design of complex systems (hardware, software, communications).
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Help establish and refine QA standards, processes, and documentation.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in electrical/Electronics/Software Engineering (or) Equivalent
* Minimum 10 to 15 years related Experiences in Protective Relaying & Substation Communication Solutions and Lateral Protection (Medium/High Voltage Products).
* Should have programming knowledge on Python, java, java script, Bash,Golang.
* Hands-on experience with IEC 61850 testing tools (e.g., Omicron IED Scout, Triangle Microworks test harness).
* Experience developing products in an Agile environment and understanding of SDLC, STLC
* Knowledge of secure communication protocols, authentication mechanisms, and data encryption techniques
* Experience with version control systems (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments (Azure/AWS/GCP)
* Added advantageof having Certified ISTQB Foundation level
* Experience on working with the test kit like Omicron CMC356,500, CPC100 and various make secondary/primary injection test kit
* Should have experience in Designing, Developing, and Testing real time embedded products.
* Should have knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical and Embedded Parameters
* Must Demonstrate consistent and sustainable application of problem solving and analytical skills.
* Competent working with Microsoft Office & related software operating on a Windows platform.

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification

* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

title: Software Development Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious Software Development Intern to join our Software Engineering team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in software design, development, debugging, integration, continuous integration and delivery, and AI-assisted software engineering while collaborating with developers and experienced engineering professionals.  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the product and project end to end, translate customer and system requirements into reliable software solutions, evaluate modern development approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and AI-assisted engineering solutions.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the product architecture, application workflows, customer use cases, technical requirements, dependencies, and engineering challenges across the complete software development lifecycle.
* Assist in designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining software applications and components based on business and technical requirements.
* Write clean, readable, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code following established coding standards and software engineering best practices.
* Develop and integrate application features across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and supporting services, as applicable to the assigned project.
* Participate in requirements analysis, technical discussions, solution design, code reviews, debugging, and implementation activities.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and work with databases, data models, queries, and application integrations.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and unexpected application behavior.
* Develop unit tests and integration tests to validate software functionality, reliability, and maintainability.
* Use Git-based version control workflows to manage code changes, collaborate with team members, and contribute to shared repositories.
* Work with Jenkins or other CI/CD tools to understand build processes, automated checks, deployment workflows, and software delivery practices.
* Explore modern development tools, frameworks, libraries, and architectural approaches to improve development efficiency and software quality.
* Prototype AI-assisted software development solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as code generation, code review, documentation, debugging, refactoring, and test creation.
* Contribute to AI-enabled engineering workflows where software agents can analyze requirements, use development tools, generate or modify code, and validate outcomes with appropriate human review.
* Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and adherence to established engineering standards.
* Apply secure coding practices, investigate technical challenges, and recommend improvements to application performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, APIs, and development workflows to support knowledge sharing and long-term product maintenance.

  
Qualifications:

**Required Skills :**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of software development principles, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, debugging, and software development lifecycle (SDLC) concepts.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Foundational understanding of application development, REST APIs, databases, SQL, source control, and software integration concepts.
* Essential exposure to and conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI, including their practical applications in software engineering.
* Ability to understand a system end to end, learn unfamiliar technologies, analyze problems logically, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment, learn, and accept feedback.

**Preferred/Nice to have Skills :**

* Hands-on exposure to frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with backend development using Python, Java, Node.js, Spring Boot, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar systems.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, API integration, authentication, and application security fundamentals.
* Exposure to Git-based workflows and development platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Jenkins or another CI/CD platform, including build pipelines, automated checks, and deployment processes.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, or development tools such as AWS, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Experience with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, AI-agent frameworks, or model evaluation techniques.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, hallucination risks, code validation, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.
* Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.
* Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
* Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities.
* Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability.
* Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team.
* Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development.
* Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation.
* Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities.
* Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.
* Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality.
* Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities.
* Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Production Ownership**

* Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations.
* Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked.
* Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability.
* Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution.
* Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery.
* Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications.
* Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities.
* Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
* Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows.
* Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions.
* Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience leading engineering teams supporting Billing, Payments, Collections, or Commerce platforms.
* Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or in an architecture-focused role, bringing additional depth in technical design and engineering decision-making.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization, platform migration, or technical transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams or multiple engineering workstreams.
* Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted software development, or emerging agentic AI technologies.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**
