description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

We are looking for an AI Test Engineer who combines strong software quality assurance and test automation experience with hands-on expertise in AI-assisted testing. The role involves using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and Figma designs to generate test scenarios and executable automated tests using AI tools.

The ideal candidate can effectively provide the right context to AI tools, validate AI-generated outputs, and continuously improve test development workflows to accelerate automation while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, traceability, and maintainability.

#### **What you will do**

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions to translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX specifications such as Figma designs into test scenarios and executable automated tests.
* Build and improve AI-assisted testing workflows where requirements and design artifacts can be provided as context and used to generate, update, and expand automated tests with minimal manual scripting.
* Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to provide AI tools with requirements, application context, coding standards, existing automation frameworks, and relevant design information so that generated tests are accurate and maintainable.
* Review, validate, debug, and refine AI-generated test scenarios and automation code rather than accepting generated output without verification.
* Identify opportunities to automate the test-development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, test generation, test-data creation, regression maintenance, failure analysis, and coverage expansion.

#### **What you bring**

*Experience*

* 5–8 years of experience in software QA
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding or engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for software testing and test automation.
* Experience using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX designs as context for AI-assisted generation of test scenarios and automated tests.
* Experience creating or configuring AI-assisted workflows that can transform requirements into executable automation, rather than using AI only for ad-hoc code completion or general-purpose prompting.
* Ability to provide application-specific context to AI tools, including existing automation code, framework conventions, requirements, design information, and test data, to improve generated test quality.
* Practical understanding of validating AI-generated tests for correctness, coverage, maintainability, traceability to requirements, and potential hallucinations or incorrect assumptions.

***Personal competencies***

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and a risk-based approach to quality assurance.
* Curiosity and a proactive mindset when exploring complex workflows and edge cases.
* Willingness to adopt AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and test coverage.
* Effective communication and collaboration across technical and clinical teams.
* Ownership of testing outcomes, defect resolution, and release quality.

#### **Who we are**

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

title: Manager of Software Engineering - .Net, C#, Python
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

This is your chance to change the path of your career and guide multiple teams to success at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

As a Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Corporate and Investment Bank - Securities Services Technology team, you lead multiple teams and manage day-to-day implementation activities by identifying and escalating issues and ensuring your team's work adheres to compliance standards, business requirements, and tactical best practices.

**Job responsibilities**

* Designs, develops, and maintains enterprise applications using C# and .NET ecosystem, build scalable solutions with both .NET Framework and modern .NET (6/7/8+), develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems and implement clean code principles and industry-standard design patterns
* Works with various database technologies including SQL and NoSQL solutions, design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data access patterns, implement data persistence layers using Entity Framework.
* Leads team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices and SDLC/TLM automation to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes, while setting expectations for human validation, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and consistent use of reusable patterns across teams.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives.
* Provides guidance to immediate team of software engineers on daily tasks and activities
* Sets the overall guidance and expectations for team output, practices, and collaboration
* Anticipates dependencies with other teams to deliver products and applications in line with business requirements
* Manages stakeholder relationships and the team's work in accordance with compliance standards, service level agreements, and business requirements

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience. In addition, demonstrated coaching and mentoring experience
* Proficient in coding in one or more languages specifically C#, .Net Core/.Net 6+, Python and SQL.
* Experience in developing responsive front end UI using React/Angular/Typescript along with understanding of object-oriented programming principles
* Experience leading responsible adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and delivery tools across engineering teams, including defining ways of working (review/validation expectations), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of data.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and governance expectations; ability to coach engineers on compliant and effective usage.
* Database Knowledge (Any of the following): SQL Databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle). Understanding of database design principles and query optimization and experience with ORM frameworks (Entity Framework, Dapper).
* Knowledge of Frontend Integration (Any of the following): React (Hooks, components, state management, modern React patterns), Angular (Components, services, TypeScript, RxJS). Understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals and experience with REST API consumption and integration.
* Experience leading technology projects and managing technologists
* Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle including automation and continuous delivery methods
* Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience working at code level

title: Software Engineering Manager-Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week** 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for a production web application environment built around .NET / C#, APIs, React / Redux, current Azure services, and modern CI/CD practices, while leading the team's cloud migration to AWS.
* Help define the next-generation direction for the Insights application, including modernization, architecture, AWS target-state design, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity with AI-assisted tooling such as Cursor.
* Own delivery execution across roadmap work, technical debt, operational improvements, incident response, release readiness, and production support.

* Support transition and long-term ownership of complex or partner-built application components into full-time team accountability.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

* Recent hands-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people-only management role.

* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.

* Experience with CI/CD, release engineering, environment management, and migration or improvement of build and deployment workflows.
* Ability to operate in a production environment, including incident management, root-cause analysis, observability, service health, and reliability improvement.
* Strong collaboration with Product or Product Owner functions, including backlog shaping, acceptance criteria, tradeoff decisions, and roadmap execution.
Ability to coach engineers at all experience levels, create accountability, and balance hands-on technical guidance with people leadership.  

**IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**
-----------------------

* Experience with Power BI, embedded analytics, or other BI / reporting platforms.
* Deeper AWS architecture experience (landing zones, networking, identity, cost management, or large-scale Azure-to-AWS application migration).
* Experience establishing team standards for AI-assisted development with Cursor, including prompt/review practices, security guardrails, and measuring productivity impact.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture and hierarchical customer access models.
* Experience modernizing a large, long-lived frontend application, including framework and build-toolchain upgrades.
* Familiarity with warehousing, ETL, data engineering partnerships, or data platform adjacency.
* Experience with payments, billing integrations, SSO, identity federation, SOC 2, vertical SaaS, fitness, wellness, or multi-product platform environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* Clear ownership, stable delivery rhythms, and strong accountability across application development and production support.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: Software Development Manager, Payables Tech
description:

title: Senior Security Delivery Expert
description:
**Overview**

**Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.**

Microsoft Defender Experts Team is looking for an experienced professional to join our detection and response team. No matter how sophisticated attacker behaviors become, Microsoft 365 Defender will help enterprises detect, investigate, and respond to advanced attacks and data breaches on their networks. Our team uses deep knowledge of the attacker landscape and rich telemetry from our sensors to perform root-cause analysis and generate custom alerts, ensuring that Microsoft 365 Defender customers are well equipped to quickly respond to human adversaries identified in their unique environments. Ensuring that no human adversary can operate silently begins with experts harnessing the powerful optics provided by Microsoft 365 Defender, across the attacker kill-chain, coupled with world-class detections. We are looking for someone who is passionate about this work to help us harness the power of Microsoft’s trillions of security signals to quickly identify and report the latest human adversary behaviors, drive critical context-rich alerts, build new tools and automations in support of hunting objectives, and drive innovations for detecting advanced attacker tradecraft.

 **Responsibilities**

* Partner with your team of Microsoft Threat Experts providing deep research and analysis of threats impacting our customers.

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Lead software architecture and modernization**

Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.

* **Stay deeply hands-on in code**

Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.

* **Design strong domain models and APIs**

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.

* **Modernize application foundations**

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.

* **Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability**

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

* **Improve data access and integration design**

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

* **Raise the bar for code quality and testing**

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.

* **Create reusable engineering patterns**

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.

* **Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution**

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.

**WHAT THIS IS NOT**

* This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
* This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering**

You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.

* **Credible hands-on implementation depth**

You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.

* **Service transformation and architecture judgment**

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.

* **Production reliability and performance expertise**

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.

* **Software design and refactoring depth**

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.

* **Data and integration depth**

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

* **Strong testing and code-quality discipline**

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

* **Principal-level technical leadership**

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

* **An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering**

You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

**BONUS POINTS**

* Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
* Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
* Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
* Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
* Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **Modernization advances without destabilizing the business**

Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.

* **Critical software becomes easier to change**

Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.

* **Architecture decisions become executable**

Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.

* **Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle**

Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.

* **AI expands engineering leverage**

AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.

**WHY THIS MATTERS**

ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.

This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  
A day in the life  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.  
  
About the team  
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

About RTX

At RTX, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 people come together with a shared purpose: to solve the world’s most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference. Through our three industry-leading businesses, advanced engineering capabilities, and significant investments in research and development, we are pushing the boundaries of science and technology to connect and protect our world.

**Join Collins Aerospace and help shape the future of flight.**

Collins Aerospace delivers technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of aerospace technologies, we help customers navigate the evolving demands of global aviation.

Be part of a team that is advancing aviation safety, reliability, and innovation through world-class engineering.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Avionics Software Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer / Technical Lead** to drive the verification, testing, debugging, and certification of safety-critical avionics software.

In this role, you will work on requirement-based testing, structural coverage analysis, host- and target-based verification, and compliance with DO-178B/C certification objectives. You will collaborate with global engineering teams, contribute to certification reviews and audits, and help develop innovative tools and processes that improve software quality and engineering efficiency.

This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with technical leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement while contributing to avionics systems that support safe and reliable flight operations.

**What You’ll Do**

Avionics Software Verification & Certification

* Design, develop, review, and execute requirement-based test cases, test procedures, and unit tests for safety-critical avionics software.
* Perform software verification and validation across host and target environments, including unit, integration, and system-level testing.
* Conduct Structural Coverage Analysis (SCA) and support the achievement of applicable software coverage objectives.
* Ensure compliance with DO-178B/C processes and objectives for applicable software assurance levels, including Levels A, B, and C.
* Support certification activities, including Stages of Involvement (SOI), technical reviews, compliance submissions, and internal and external audits.
* Maintain adherence to established software development, verification, quality, and documentation standards.

**Technical Problem-Solving & Tool Development**

* Debug and troubleshoot software issues across host and target platforms, including software-software and hardware-software integration environments.
* Analyze system capabilities, software behavior, and reported issues to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Develop and maintain Python-based automation and common engineering tools to improve development and verification efficiency.
* Apply engineering principles to design, develop, and implement technologies, components, subsystems, and systems that meet defined requirements and specifications.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in test automation, verification methodologies, and engineering workflows.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams to deliver project milestones and engineering commitments.
* Lead or coordinate moderately sized engineering teams, as applicable, ensuring quality, timely execution, and alignment with project objectives.
* Coach and mentor junior engineers, review technical deliverables, and promote engineering best practices.
* Lead or contribute to innovation initiatives, quality improvement activities, and CORE workshops to deliver measurable product and process improvements.
* Identify novel technical solutions and ensure innovations are appropriately captured and protected through applicable intellectual property processes.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* Understanding of avionics systems and software architecture, particularly in areas such as Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), and cockpit displays.
* Strong proficiency in Python for scripting, test automation, and engineering tool development.
* Sound knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and DO-178B/C processes for safety-critical avionics software.
* Hands-on experience in software Verification & Validation, Structural Coverage Analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and requirement-based testing.
* Experience in unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and software verification activities.
* Experience with software-software and hardware-software integration and debugging.
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
* Working knowledge of version control and project tracking tools such as Git or Subversion and Jira.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **6-9 years of avionics engineering experience**, particularly in safety-critical software verification and certification.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as PyATE, Rapita, Coverity, and Jama.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and tools or environments such as Docker, Visual Studio Code, and Artifactory.
* Sound programming knowledge of C/C++.
* Knowledge of avionics data link applications and protocols, including: Controller–Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC).Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Contract (ADS-C).ATN Context Management (CM).FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN).Airline Operational Control (AOC) and Flight Management System (FMS) flight-planning applications.
* Familiarity with data link industry standards such as DO-258A, ED-110B, and DO-351.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and engineering review experience.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in Lean principles, innovation, and engineering excellence.

**Why Join Collins Aerospace?**

* **Make a real-world impact:** Contribute to safety-critical avionics software that supports the future of aviation.
* **Solve complex engineering challenges:** Work with advanced technologies, rigorous certification processes, and sophisticated verification environments.
* **Collaborate globally:** Partner with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams across international locations.
* **Grow your technical leadership:** Mentor engineers, influence engineering practices, and contribute to innovation.
* **Drive engineering excellence:** Help improve product quality, verification efficiency, and software reliability.

The recruiting team will provide further details regarding the role type and current site arrangements during the hiring process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned location is the employee’s responsibility.

Education & Experience Guidelines

This position typically requires a university degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and relevant professional experience. Equivalent experience or an advanced degree may be considered in accordance with the role’s requirements and applicable local regulations.

The level of responsibility and experience required will depend on the final position scope and assigned engineering responsibilities.

**Ready to advance the future of avionics?**

Bring your expertise in safety-critical software, verification, and certification to Collins Aerospace, where engineering excellence and innovation help shape the next generation of aerospace technology.

*RTX adheres to the principles of equal employment. All qualified applications will be given careful consideration without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition.
* Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation.
* Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting.

* Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams.
* Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
* GCP certification
* Background in Mathematics or Statistics

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:

At AryaXAI, everyone contributes hands-on to our mission in a flat organizational structure that values curiosity, initiative, and exceptional performance.

****Qualifications:****

We are now looking for highly experienced Senior Engineering Managers who can lead the platform scale and components, and make it the industry best in the relevant components. Ideal candidates should have at least 5+ years of experience working with products that require heavy engineering and scaling requirements. Preference is from a product background with strong discipline around the stack and PR quality. 

* 5+ years of experience in building and deploying enterprise-grade machine learning infra, SaaS software, data analytics solutions, or online platforms
* 2+ years of experience in building LLM infra or high-volume AI inference components.
* Academic degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong background in Python programming, Distributed computing, Engineering, big data processing, and cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-premises)

* Programming skills - expert in Python and solid coding practices

* Experience in scaling AI/ML production systems using classic ML models, LLMs, and Deep Learning models on traditional hardware and high-performance computing.

As Sr Engineering Manager, you'll be the main SPOC for all the engineering efforts behind the AryaXAI platform, serving customers in SaaS and on-premise modes and scaling multiple AI models in startups, SMEs, and highly regulated industries.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems
