title: Senior Manager, Digital Insights & Analytics – Client Data & Experience
description:
Senior Manager, & Digital Insights & Analytics, Client Data & Experience
  
  
Mumbai, India ( 23 Oct 2026) JD
  
  
Apply now
  
  
**About Amicorp**
Amicorp Group is an independent global provider of corporate management, fiduciary, fund administration and financial markets services. Since 1992, we have helped entrepreneurs, families, investment managers, corporations and financial institutions simplify operations, stay compliant and protect and grow their assets. With offices across multiple jurisdictions worldwide, we combine local expertise with global reach.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Amicorp’s markets are changing fast. New financial hubs are rising, clients and intermediaries expect digital service, and new opportunities are emerging in areas such as tokenization, fintech alliances and data centers. To capture them, Amicorp needs to know which clients, segments, services and markets offer the most growth, and to act on that insight quickly.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Digital Insights & Analytics will provide that insight. You will align Amicorp’s client data with market opportunities to show where to focus, which services to offer to whom, and how to grow, retain and serve clients better. To do this, you will connect the CRM, Zoho applications and other client platforms into a single, trusted view of each client. You will lead Amicorp’s client analytics, from data integration and quality to dashboards, predictive models and client experience measurement, and make data the basis for growth decisions across marketing, the sales offices and client service.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
What You’ll Work On
  
  
Market Opportunity Insight
  
  

* Combine client data with market and competitor insight from the Market Intelligence Lead to size opportunities by client segment, service line and jurisdiction.
* Identify where Amicorp is under-represented, which clients and intermediaries are most likely to need new services (such as tokenization or data center structuring), and where to invest.
* Support the Head of Digital Business Development, the Special Projects Lead and the sales offices with data-backed opportunity analysis and business cases.

Client Data Strategy & Single Client View
  
  

* Define and own Amicorp’s client data strategy, including the data model, key definitions (client, prospect, intermediary, account, service line) and how data flows between platforms.
* Build and maintain a single client view that brings together data from the CRM, Zoho applications, client portals, WhatsApp, marketing automation, the websites, events and finance systems.
* Set up the matching and de-duplication rules that link the same client, contact or intermediary across systems.
* Create a roadmap for client data and analytics capabilities, agreed with the Head of Digital Business Development and IT.

Platform Integration: CRM, Zoho & Client Platforms
  
  

* Map every client-facing platform, the data it holds and how it connects to the others.
* Design and oversee integrations between the CRM, Zoho applications (such as Zoho CRM, Desk, Campaigns, Forms or Analytics, depending on what Amicorp uses) and other platforms, working with IT and vendors on APIs, connectors and data pipelines.
* Make sure key events, such as enquiries, event registrations, WhatsApp conversations, portal activity, onboarding steps and invoices, reach the right systems and the client record.
* Work with the Sales Operations & Office Liaison Lead, who administers the CRM and prospecting tools, so integrations support how the sales offices work.
* Work with the Web Development & MarTech Lead on website, tracking and marketing automation data.
* Evaluate and recommend data and integration tools, such as a data warehouse, integration platform or customer data platform, with a clear business case.

Data Quality & Governance
  
  

* Set and enforce data quality standards for completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness across all client platforms.
* Run regular data quality checks and dashboards, and lead clean-up programs with the offices and system owners.
* Define data ownership, access rights and naming conventions for client data.
* Keep documentation of data sources, definitions and integrations up to date, so others can rely on and reuse them.

Analytics, Reporting & Dashboards
  
  

* Build the enterprise dashboards that show the full client journey: marketing reach, leads, pipeline, conversion, onboarding, service, revenue and retention.
* Measure marketing and sales performance end to end, including campaign and channel contribution to pipeline and revenue, working with the Senior Marketing Specialist, Digital and the Sales Operations & Office Liaison Lead.
* Provide analysis by client segment, service line, jurisdiction, intermediary and office.
* Answer ad-hoc questions from executives, business line leaders and the sales offices with clear, reliable data.
* Make dashboards self-service where possible, and train users to read and use them.

Advanced Analytics & AI
  
  

* Develop models that predict client attrition risk, cross-sell and upsell opportunities, lead quality and client lifetime value.
* Segment clients and intermediaries by behavior, value and needs to support targeting and personalization.
* Use AI to analyze unstructured data, such as WhatsApp conversations, emails, survey comments and service requests, to identify themes and sentiment.
* Apply AI responsibly, with human review, clear documentation and compliance with Amicorp policies.

Client Experience Measurement
  
  

* Own the enterprise Client Experience Index (CEI) and the Voice of the Client program, including NPS, CSAT and Customer Effort Score.
* Link client experience scores to the single client view, so feedback can be analyzed by client, service, office and journey stage.
* Connect client experience to business outcomes such as retention, share of wallet, referrals from intermediaries and cost to serve.
* Map key client journeys, such as entity formation, fund launch, trust set-up, onboarding and KYC, and identify friction points using data.

Data Protection & Compliance
  
  

* Make sure client data is collected, integrated, stored and used in line with data protection, confidentiality and regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction, including GDPR and AML/KYC rules.
* Work with Compliance, Legal and Information Security on consent, data retention, data residency and access controls.
* Apply privacy-by-design to every integration and analytics project.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Build and lead a small analytics capability over time, using internal staff, vendors and partners as needed.
* Promote a data-driven culture across marketing, sales offices and client service.
* Report regularly to the Head of Digital Business Development and executive leadership on insights, priorities and the value delivered.

How This Role Fits the Team
  
  

* Head of Digital Business Development is this role’s line manager and uses its insights to set digital growth priorities and targets.
* Sales Operations & Office Liaison Lead administers the CRM and prospecting tools and supports the sales offices. This role owns how client data connects across platforms, and the analytics built on it.
* Web Development & MarTech Lead owns the websites, marketing automation, tracking and consent tools. This role uses their data and designs how it links to the client record.
* Senior Marketing Specialist, Digital owns campaign and channel reporting. This role connects that reporting to pipeline, revenue and client outcomes.
* Client Messaging & WhatsApp Lead runs the WhatsApp channel. This role integrates conversation and consent data and analyzes it for insight.
* Market Intelligence Lead covers the external market and competitors. This role covers Amicorp’s own client data. Together they size and prioritize market opportunities.
* Integrated Content Strategist and the Head of Group Marketing use this role’s segments and insights to shape audiences and messaging.
* Global Events Lead shares event data, which this role links to clients and pipeline.
* IT, Compliance and Information Security are key partners for integrations, security and data protection.

**Qualifications, Skills, And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Information Systems or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in client service operations, CRM, digital communications or conversational messaging, including at least 2 years running a messaging channel such as WhatsApp Business at scale.
* Hands-on experience with the WhatsApp Business Platform (API), including template management, opt-in rules and automation.
* Experience setting up service operating models, such as routing, response-time targets and escalation processes.
* Experience in financial services, banking, wealth management, fund administration or another regulated industry strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating teams across offices or leading a small team.

Skills & Tools
  
  

* Experience with messaging and service platforms such as Twilio, Infobip, 360dialog, Respond.io, Zendesk, Sprinklr or Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or HubSpot) and their integration with messaging tools.
* Experience designing chatbot and automated conversation flows.
* Solid understanding of data protection, consent and record-keeping requirements for client communications.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to write short, clear and professional messages.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, and the ability to stay calm and responsive in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in complex, multi-jurisdictional organizations; additional languages are a plus.

Additional Information
  
  

* This is an onsite role based in Mumbai, India; it is not a remote opportunity.
* Occasional travel to regional offices may be required.

For queries, please contact: Jobs@amicorp.com
  
  
Ready to apply?
  
  
Fill up few details, and we’ll be in touch soon. For queries, please contact: Jobs@amicorp.com

title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

About Us

Resollect is a Mumbai-based startup fixing how debt recovery works in India. We work with banks, asset reconstruction companies (ARCs) and NBFCs, and the industry has been stuck with clunky, manual processes for far too long. We're changing that by combining legal processes (SARFAESI, Sec 13(2), Sec 14, DRT) with smart automation, clean design, and AI that actually does something useful. We're a small, founder-led team with deep domain expertise, and we move fast.

The Role

Resollect sits on a lot of recovery data: loan accounts, notices, legal stages, hearings and recoveries across our bank, NBFC and ARC clients. Most of it arrives messy. Your job is to make it clean, trustworthy and useful, both for our clients and for how we run the company.

We're big on AI here. We don't want someone who does repetitive work by hand. We want someone who reaches for AI first, builds their own small tools, writes their own prompts, and automates the boring stuff out of existence.

What You'll Do

Build and own dashboards for clients and internal teams: portfolio recovery, case-stage tracking (Sec 13(2) → 13(4) → Sec 14 → DRT), turnaround times and collections.

Tame messy client data. Clean loan-book dumps and inconsistent Excel files, and build pipelines so the same cleanup never has to be done twice.

Write SQL and own data quality across our internal systems.

Find what drives recovery. Which accounts, actions and geographies recover best, and turn that into clear recommendations.

Automate recurring client MIS and reporting.

Use AI / LLMs to extract structured data from documents such as notices and court orders, and to speed up analysis.

Work with tech and operations on data models, tracking and new product features.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years as an analyst (strong freshers with real projects are welcome).

Strong SQL and Excel. Python (pandas) is a big plus.

Dashboarding experience in Power BI, Looker, Metabase or similar.

Structured thinking. You start from the business question, not the chart.

Clear communication. You can explain a finding to a bank's head of collections in two minutes.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Experience with lending, collections or BFSI data

Experience using LLMs to extract or classify data from documents

A grounding in statistics, or side projects that show you go beyond the obvious

Why This Might Be Worth Your Time

Real data, real money: your analysis directly changes how loans get recovered.

You'll work directly with the founder and build the data function from the ground up.

You'll get very good at using AI for real analytical work.

If you get a kick out of turning a messy spreadsheet into a decision someone acts on, we'd like to meet you.

title: AI Architect(Gen AI & Agentic AI) 7 to 8yrs
description:
Job Description: AI Architect – Generative AI & Agentic AI

Experience: 7–8 Years

Industry: Banking / Financial Services preferred

Location: Mumbai(Thane /BKC) Work from Office

Role Type: Architecture, Engineering & Technology Leadership

1. About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Architect with 7–8 years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and cloud-native architectures.

The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions, with a focus on banking and financial services use cases. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, architectural decision-making, rapid prototyping, and collaboration with engineering, data, security, and business teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Solution Design

\* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.

\* Design scalable AI platforms integrating LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native infrastructure.

\* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and inference strategies.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, reference implementations, design principles, and engineering standards.

\* Design for high availability, scalability, low latency, cost optimisation, observability, and resilience.

Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineering

\* Architect and implement RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, retrieval, reranking, and contextual response generation.

\* Design intelligent AI agents capable of tool calling, multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, and controlled execution of enterprise business processes.

\* Develop multi-agent workflows where appropriate, with clear boundaries, state management, human approval, and failure-handling mechanisms.

\* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, model routing, context management, and conversation memory.

\* Apply guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, and unauthorised tool execution.

\* Build proof of concepts and convert successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Enterprise Integration & Banking Use Cases

\* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, REST APIs, event-driven systems, microservices, and secure data platforms.

\* Design AI solutions for banking use cases such as customer service automation, knowledge assistants, document intelligence, regulatory compliance, fraud investigation support, and developer productivity.

\* Ensure AI services integrate seamlessly with existing authentication, authorisation, audit, and monitoring frameworks.

\* Work with domain architects and business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into technical solutions.

MLOps, LLMOps & Production Engineering

\* Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices for AI applications and model-serving components.

\* Implement model evaluation, regression testing, prompt/version management, retrieval-quality assessment, and continuous monitoring.

\* Define evaluation frameworks covering factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, safety, and token consumption.

\* Monitor model performance, drift, failure rates, inference costs, and application reliability.

\* Optimise inference performance through caching, batching, model selection, quantisation, and other suitable techniques.

Security, Governance & Responsible AI

\* Design AI solutions with security and privacy by design, including encryption, role-based access control, secrets management, and data minimisation.

\* Implement responsible AI controls, explainability where appropriate, traceability, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

\* Address threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, and sensitive information leakage.

\* Collaborate with information security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to meet applicable regulatory and organisational requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

\* Provide hands-on technical leadership to developers and engineering teams throughout the solution lifecycle.

\* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and proof-of-concept evaluations.

\* Mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices, design patterns, and production-readiness standards.

\* Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation roadmaps to technical and business stakeholders.

3. Required Technical Skills

Generative AI & LLMs

\* Strong understanding of LLMs, transformer-based models, embeddings, tokenisation, context windows, and inference.

\* Hands-on experience with commercial and/or open-source models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or equivalent.

\* Expertise in RAG, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt engineering, and structured generation.

\* Practical experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Programming & Backend Engineering

\* Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-grade AI applications.

\* Solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, API security, and distributed systems.

\* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent backend frameworks.

\* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot and microservices is an advantage.

Data & Search Technologies

\* Experience with vector databases or vector search technologies such as pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.

\* Strong understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases, document processing, data pipelines, and data quality.

\* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, hybrid search, and enterprise data integration is desirable.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

\* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

\* Experience deploying AI workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based architectures.

\* Familiarity with API gateways, event-driven architecture, secrets management, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

\* Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, or equivalent.

AI Quality, Evaluation & Operations

\* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks, automated testing, tracing, and observability tools.

\* Understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, model safety, and retrieval-quality optimisation.

\* Knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

4. Qualifications & Experience

\* 7–8 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or related technology roles.

\* Demonstrable hands-on experience delivering AI or GenAI solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage.

\* Strong architectural problem-solving skills and ability to make informed build-versus-buy and model-selection decisions.

\* Experience working with enterprise-scale applications, sensitive data, and production deployment constraints.

\* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

\* Banking, financial services, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience is highly desirable.

5. Preferred Experience

\* Experience building agentic AI systems that invoke enterprise tools and APIs under controlled permissions.

\* Knowledge of AI security testing, red teaming, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.

\* Experience with multimodal AI, document intelligence, speech, or vision-based solutions.

\* Familiarity with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms and integration with microservices.

\* Experience designing AI solutions for high-volume, low-latency, business-critical environments.

6. Success Criteria

The AI Architect will be measured on the ability to:

\* Deliver secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions aligned with business outcomes.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns that accelerate delivery across engineering teams.

\* Improve answer quality, retrieval accuracy, reliability, and user adoption.

\* Optimise inference cost, response latency, and infrastructure utilisation.

\* Demonstrate measurable business value through automation, productivity improvements, and reduced manual effort.

\* Ensure AI solutions meet defined security, governance, auditability, and operational-readiness requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A hands-on AI architect who can move from business problem definition to solution architecture, working code, production deployment, and measurable business impact—not just develop GenAI proofs of concept.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Experience:

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
The IT Services & Support (ITSD) team keeps Comscore's global workforce productive by owning identity, endpoint, and service-desk operations across our Reston, Portland, New York, Amsterdam, Warsaw, Santiago, and Pune offices. The team runs Comscore's Okta tenant, JIRA Service Management portal, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID directory, and endpoint management platforms (Jamf Pro, Quest KACE, Automox, Intune), and is the first-line owner for every access, hardware, software, and productivity request across the company.

Comscore is hiring IT Support Engineers to join the growing Pune arm of this team. This is a hands-on, ticket-driven role that owns a defined slice of the JIRA Service Management (IESD) queue end-to-end during APAC and EMEA business hours. This role works directly with the Pune Team Lead and existing Pune specialists on daily service-desk operations, access provisioning, and endpoint recovery for employees in the US, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.

We are open to candidates with varying years of experience. If you have strong fundamentals in identity, access, and end-user support, and the attitude to treat each ticket as a problem to understand rather than a form to fill, we will train you on our stack.

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Pick up tickets from the IT Service Desk queue in JIRA Service Management, resolve them end-to-end using documented runbooks, and apply the appropriateness-check discipline that governs access grants at Comscore.
* Add and remove users from Okta groups, Active Directory security groups, and Microsoft 365 security groups to grant application access across roughly 270 Okta-managed applications, including Claude Code / Apps Gateway, Microsoft Copilot, Adobe Creative Cloud, and the long tail of business tooling.
* Manage distribution lists, mail aliases, shared mailboxes, and robotic mailboxes in Microsoft 365 admin center and Active Directory.
* Process contractor account creations, 90-day extensions, and offboarding in Active Directory and Okta.
* Perform BitLocker recovery-key retrieval, Quest KACE and Automox agent re-enrollment, and CrowdStrike Falcon user-facing endpoint recovery.
* Reset MFA factors, unlock accounts, and support user password resets across Okta and Active Directory, including scripted bulk operations on Panel Activation accounts.
* Support the Pune office with hardware setup, Windows and macOS laptop imaging, dual-monitor configuration, and new-hire onboarding, shared with the existing Pune team members.
* Document the workflows you own as reusable runbooks in Confluence and keep them current as the stack evolves.
* Escalate judgment calls (tight-license applications, admin-level access requests, policy exceptions) to the Pune Team Lead or the US senior engineers.
* Participate in the follow-the-sun support model with a defined overlap window each week for US and EMEA collaboration, closing tickets before the US team's working day begins.
* Communicate incident status, change notifications, and ticket updates in clear written English to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the IT service catalog and the quality of request-type templates in the JIRA Service Management portal.
  

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and a visible interest in IT support operations are welcome to apply.
* Zero to five years of experience in IT Service Desk, IT Support, Desktop Support, or a related operations role.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one of: Okta, Microsoft 365 admin center, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID. Working familiarity with JIRA Service Management is a plus.
* Comfortable with ticket-driven work, SLA discipline, and queue-based prioritization.
* Clear written and spoken English, sufficient for daily interaction with US and EMEA engineers, managers, and end users.
* Attention to detail and the ability to follow, refine, and author operational procedures.
* Analytical mindset — you treat a ticket as a problem to understand, not a form to fill.
* Ownership attitude and willingness to pick up unfamiliar workflows with a runbook and a bit of coaching.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate. The role is hybrid, with Pune-office presence expected two to three days a week.
* Ability to work a schedule that provides at least two hours of overlap with US Eastern time each week for cross-region collaboration and handoff.
  

**Preferred:**

* Exposure to Jamf Pro, Quest KACE, Automox, or Microsoft Intune on the endpoint-management side.
* Working knowledge of CrowdStrike Falcon or any enterprise EDR console.
* Scripting familiarity in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automating repetitive administrative tasks.
* Any identity or Microsoft 365 certification (Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator SC-300, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals MS-900).
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Prior experience in a follow-the-sun IT support operating model with US, EMEA, and APAC handoffs.
* Familiarity with Slack, Zoom, and Adobe Creative Cloud administration.
* Experience with Confluence page authoring and knowledge-base contribution.
* Prior experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, or MRC audit evidence collection cycles.
  

**Working Hours**

This role also supports Comscore offices in the United States and Europe during their local business hours, Monday through Friday. There is no weekend coverage; you will be assigned to one of the three fixed shift windows.

**About Comscore:**

  

At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.

Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.

Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

title: Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer** to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.

This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.

The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. All AI-assisted output must be appropriately reviewed, validated, secured, and tested prior to implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable Java-based enterprise integration solutions using REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.
* The successful candidate is expected to incorporate approved AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day engineering activities, including:
* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for assigned solutions throughout the development and support lifecycle.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and development practices, including responsible use of AI-assisted capabilities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering efficiency.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.

**About the role**

The **Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations** will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies. **12 to 16 years** of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.

Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise

The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In this role, you will:**

### **1. Service Ownership and Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.

### **2. Architecture and Design Governance**

* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.

### **3. Technology and Engineering Leadership**

Maintain sufficient technical depth to guide engineering teams, challenge vendor recommendations, approve designs and support critical escalations across the following domains:

**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging

4. Operations, Delivery and Problem Management

* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**

### **Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About TVARIT:**

TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving

advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).

With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most

innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.

We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team

The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on

quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement:**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence:**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* **10+ years of professional experience,** including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* **Mandatory manufacturing exposure:** direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* **Software delivery leadership:** must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* **Mandatory AI modeling experience:** strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* **Proven customer-facing leadership**, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* **Proven delivery track record:** leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

**Strong Haves**

* **Data science and AI:** Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* **Metals process understanding:** Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.
* **Software development lifecycle:** Working understanding of how industrial software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported, including agile practices, CI/CD, code quality, and testing, sufficient to lead engineering teams and make sound delivery trade-offs. Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.
* **Solution architecture and productization:** Translating business and operational requirements into functional specifications, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps; reusable components, configurable solutions, model generalization, and validation across plants.

Familiarity Needed

* **Industrial data and integration:** Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, sensors, lab and quality data, and manufacturing data platforms, including data quality, contextualization, and OT/IT integration
* **Deployment and MLOps:** Cloud, edge, and on-premises deployment, MLOps, model monitoring and retraining, security, and reliability. Familiarity with Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
* **Emerging AI:** Awareness of generative AI, LLMs, and industrial copilots, including their practical applications and limitations in manufacturing

AI/ML Engineer, EIT

Preferred Qualifications

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

Research & Technology Group  

**Job Description:**

**Who we are**
--------------

  
  

**About bp/team**
=================

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.

  
  

**Role Purpose**
================

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.

  
  

Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Scope & Scale**
=================

**Platform focus**

Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.

**Testing coverage**

Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.

**Non-functional quality**

Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.

**Delivery lifecycle**

Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.

**Quality engineering**

Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis**
--------------------------------------

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.

* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.

* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.

* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.

* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

**Manual & Exploratory Testing**
--------------------------------

* Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services.

* Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios.

* Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards.

* Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes.

* Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases.

**Test Automation & Continuous Testing**
----------------------------------------

* Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios.

* Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback.

* Select appropriate candidates for automation, balancing business value, stability, maintenance effort and execution speed.

* Monitor automation reliability, investigate failures and continuously improve coverage, execution time and maintainability.

**Defect Management & Quality Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Log clear, reproducible defects with evidence, business impact, severity and appropriate diagnostic information.

* Work with engineers and suppliers to triage defects, investigate root causes, validate fixes and prevent recurrence.

* Maintain transparent defect status, highlight release risks and escalate unresolved quality concerns with options.

* Analyse defect patterns, escaped defects, automation results and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.

* Contribute to retrospectives and root-cause reviews, turning lessons into stronger requirements, engineering and test practices.

**Collaboration & Quality Culture**
-----------------------------------

* Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery.

* Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions.

* Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing.

* Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets.

* Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams.

  
  

**Skills & Experience**
=======================

* Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches.

* Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability.

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent.

* Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control.

* Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.

* Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing.

* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers.

* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations.

  
  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Clear test coverage and traceability across requirements, business journeys, risks and acceptance criteria.

* Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues.

* Reliable and maintainable automated regression coverage integrated into delivery pipelines.

* Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions.

* Improved platform quality across functionality, accessibility, usability, performance, security and operability.

* Effective defect resolution and measurable reduction in repeated or escaped defects.

Strong collaboration and shared quality ownership across business, product, engineering and supplier

  
  

**About bp**
------------

  
  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**Overview**

The Identity and Access Management Engineer (Junior) will supports the secure and reliable operation of identity services across the organisation. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role assists with user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication, single sign-on, privileged access and identity governance activities.

The position contributes to project delivery and operational support by following approved standards, documenting work, resolving routine issues and escalating risks or complex technical matters appropriately.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Support the secure and reliable operation of identity and access management services across the organisation.
* Contribute to IAM, PAM and identity governance initiatives through project delivery and operational support activities.
* Assist in implementing identity standards, controls and automation aligned with the organisation’s security strategy.
* Support continuous improvement of identity lifecycle, authentication and privileged access capabilities.

Operational Management

* Manage approved joiner, mover and leaver activities, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes and routine IAM troubleshooting.
* Provision, modify and remove user, service and privileged accounts across supported on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Apply approved access models, including role-based and attribute-based access controls, group membership and entitlements.
* Support periodic access reviews and follow up outstanding certifications, exceptions and remediation actions.
* Assist with the administration, configuration, testing and support of hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
* Support application onboarding for single sign-on, multifactor authentication and automated provisioning using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Contribute to PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other scripts or workflows that automate repeatable IAM activities, with peer review before production use.
* Assist with identity services hosted across Azure and AWS and their supporting Windows, Linux and virtualised infrastructure.
* Maintain daily IAM platform stability and compliance through service monitoring, BAU engineering, incident troubleshooting, fulfilment of service requests and controlled changes.
* Troubleshoot access, authentication, federation, directory and provisioning issues using documented procedures, system logs and structured diagnostic techniques.
* Support Active Directory Domain Services and related technologies such as LDAP, Group Policy, DNS, certificate services, forest trusts and remote access services under appropriate guidance.
* Maintain accurate tickets, work notes, configuration records, operational procedures and handover information.

People Leadership

* Build effective working relationships with application owners, Service Desk, infrastructure, cloud, security and project teams.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Identity Architects to deliver IAM and PAM enhancements.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
* Share knowledge and contribute to team capability through structured learning and practical assignments.

Governance & Risk

* Support the discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
* Assist with implementation and uplift of privileged-access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, least privilege, account discovery and automated password rotation.
* Follow least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, privacy and privileged-access requirements when administering identity services.
* Support audit and assurance activities by maintaining complete access records, approvals, evidence and operational documentation.
* Identify control gaps, recurring incidents and opportunities for automation or service improvement and escalate recommendations through the appropriate process.
* Escalate risks, exceptions and complex technical matters through appropriate governance processes.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

Experience

* Degree, diploma or equivalent practical training in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in IAM, directory services, systems administration, IT support or cybersecurity; graduates with relevant practical exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Foundational understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, conditional access, multifactor authentication, RBAC and ABAC.
* Practical exposure to Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in a hybrid environment; familiarity with Microsoft Identity Manager or Entra ID Connect is advantageous.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, federation and API concepts.
* Basic to intermediate PowerShell and scripting capability; exposure to Microsoft Graph is desirable.
* Awareness of Windows Server and Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, certificate services and forest trusts.
* Foundational cloud knowledge across Azure or AWS and basic familiarity with virtualisation; Linux exposure is desirable.
* Exposure to PAM or IGA platforms such as CyberArk and SailPoint is advantageous.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, IAM or security certifications are desirable but not essential.

Personal Attributes
  

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and seek guidance for complex or high-risk matters.
* Balanced interest in operational support, incident resolution, debugging and engineering delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to approvals, testing, evidence and record keeping.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build constructive relationships with technical teams and business partners.
* Able to prioritise assigned work, meet agreed deadlines, raise blockers early and contribute effectively in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
