**Job Description**
-------------------

Job Description – Data Engineer (Azure Synapse & Data Platform) Role Overview We are looking for a technically strong Data Engineer to join an existing enterprise data platform team. This is not a traditional reporting analyst role — we need someone who is equally comfortable writing complex SQL and understanding the underlying data architecture as they are surfacing insights. The primary focus will be on interrogating foundational data products, tracing data lineage across platform layers, and identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and quality issues in what has been built. This person will act as a critical bridge between the engineering team and the business, helping to validate what the platform produces and surface what is missing or incorrect.

Key Responsibilities • Interrogate foundational and use case data products across the platform to assess completeness, correctness, and consistency • Write complex SQL queries to explore, profile, and validate data across multiple layers — from raw ingestion through to conformed and consumption datasets • Trace data lineage end-to-end: understand where data originates, how it is transformed at each layer, and what reaches the consumption layer • Identify data gaps, anomalies, unexpected transformations, and discrepancies between source systems and downstream data products • Document findings clearly — translating technical observations into structured gap analyses and data quality assessments that both engineers and business stakeholders can act on • Work closely with senior data engineers and the solution architect to provide ground-level data evidence that informs re-engineering and migration decisions • Validate business logic embedded in transformation layers by comparing expected versus actual outputs across datasets • Support data governance efforts by profiling datasets, cataloguing findings, and contributing to data quality rule definitions • Collaborate with business and analytics stakeholders to understand expected data behaviour and reconcile against what the platform currently delivers • Contribute to the development of semantic views, analytical datasets, and self-serve reporting assets where required

Must-Have Skills SQL & Data Querying • Expert-level SQL — able to write complex analytical queries involving multi-table joins, window functions, aggregations, CTEs, and recursive logic • Strong ability to profile and explore unfamiliar datasets without prior documentation • Experience querying large-scale data platforms — comfortable working with partitioned tables, Delta tables, and distributed query engines • Experience with Azure Synapse SQL Pool and/or Synapse Serverless SQL • Ability to reverse-engineer data transformations by reading query outputs and comparing across layers

Data Platform & Architecture Literacy • Solid understanding of medallion / lakehouse architecture (Raw / Harmonized / Conformed / Consumption) — able to navigate a multi-layer platform and understand the purpose and content of each layer • Familiarity with data modelling concepts: surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions, denormalization, conformed dimensions • Understanding of CDC and SCD patterns and their impact on historical data • Ability to read and interpret data pipeline logic — not necessarily build it, but understand what a pipeline is doing and whether the output is correct • Experience working with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and Delta Lake format (Parquet, Delta tables) • Familiarity with Azure Synapse Analytics environment — navigating SQL Pools, Spark outputs, and storage layers • Must have strong insurance-domain knowledge, including familiarity with core insurance concepts and data such as policies, products, premiums, claims, customers, sales, and CRM structures

Analytics Engineering • Experience building or contributing to semantic layers, data models, or analytical datasets consumed by BI tools • Familiarity with dbt or similar analytics engineering frameworks is a plus • Ability to translate business questions into well-structured analytical data models • Experience with Power BI or equivalent BI tools — understanding of how semantic models consume underlying data products Data Quality & Investigation • Strong analytical mindset — able to form hypotheses about data issues, design SQL-based tests to validate them, and clearly document conclusions • Experience with data profiling: null rates, cardinality, referential integrity checks, distribution analysis • Ability to compare datasets across systems or layers and surface meaningful discrepancies • Familiarity with data quality frameworks and rule-based validation approaches

Nice to Have • Exposure to Python (Pandas / PySpark) for data exploration beyond SQL • Familiarity with Azure Purview or Unity Catalog for data cataloguing and lineage • Experience with dbt for analytics engineering and data model documentation • Exposure to data observability or monitoring tooling

Experience & Profile • 5–8+ years of experience in a data engineering role, with strong SQL, data platform, and analytical capabilities • Demonstrated ability to work directly with complex, undocumented, or legacy datasets and make sense of them independently • Comfortable operating in ambiguity — this role requires curiosity and persistence when the data does not behave as expected • Strong documentation skills — able to produce clear gap analyses, data dictionaries, and investigation findings that non-technical stakeholders can understand • Collaborative and inquisitive — works well embedded within an engineering team while also engaging directly with business users • Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture — able to flag granular data issues in the context of platform-level quality and completeness • Experience working in regulated or enterprise-scale environments (financial services a plus)

title: Senior Engineer, AI Security
description:
The **AI Security Engineer** is responsible for building and running the security controls that find and govern the use of artificial intelligence across Danaher, including chat tools, AI platforms, and autonomous agents. The engineer configures and tunes policies and detections in CrowdStrike Falcon and AI gateways, and builds the automation that lets Danaher adopt AI safely.

This position reports to the **Senior Manager, AI Security & Governance** and is part of the **DIS Corporate Cybersecurity - AI Security** team located in **Bangalore or Pune India** and will be an on-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Configure, tune, and maintain security policies for the AI control plane in CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) and Falcon Shield, including access rules, prompt rules, and report, transform, or block actions.
* Manage policy and configuration for AI gateways that cover gaps the CrowdStrike tools cannot reach.
* Build alerts and detections for unapproved AI use, risky agent behavior, and policy violations, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.
* Build the automation yourself: prove a task by hand in the platform, then automate it with Python, PowerShell, and platform APIs.
* Contribute to AI security design with the AI Security Architect, and coordinate with the Security Operations Center and the CrowdStrike engineering team.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 9+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on work on endpoint, software-as-a-service, or cloud security platforms.
* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or customizing CrowdStrike Falcon, such as policy authoring, integrations, detection logic, or console administration.
* Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
* Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.

title: Senior Security Engineer

title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.  
  
Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.  
  
You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.  
  
Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and ITIL processes.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
* Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
* A client-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.
* Willingness to work hard and put in longer hours when necessary.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT or Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

**Workplace type****:**

On-site Working

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:

You will take ownership of your work and provide first-class support to our clients with expertise and care.
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
To design, implement, and maintain robust MLOps frameworks that streamline the deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models, ensuring efficient and reliable production operations on AWS.
  
  
**Responsibilities Of The Role**

* Build and optimize scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS-based infrastructure for ML/GenAI workloads
* Develop automated workflows for data ingestion, model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring using tools like AWS SageMaker, Step Functions, and Lambda
* Implement data quality checks, lineage tracking, and compliance standards for curated datasets
* Integrate ML pipelines with DevOps practices, ensuring seamless collaboration between data science and engineering teams

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! title: Principal Analyst, BI Service Delivery
description:
**Principal Analyst, Business Intelligence Service Delivery:**
This role is responsible for leading development and support for the analytics solutions on SAP BW, Azure, Databricks, PBI and BPC. This individual is responsible for leading the business requirement gathering, design technical solutions, implementation, and optimization of solutions.
  
  
This role combines technical expertise with business acumen to ensure efficient and effective IT solutions delivery for analytics operations and automation.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgement in applying professional expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision. This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.
  
  
This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.
* Provide technical leadership to internal and vendor development teams, including solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, implementation, troubleshooting, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Drive operational excellence by overseeing day-to-day application support and maintenance while identifying opportunities to improve system performance, process efficiency, and overall customer experience.
* Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, resolving complex technical issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve application stability and service reliability.
* Transform support operations through automation, AI, self-service, and shift-left approaches, reducing manual effort and continuously improving service effectiveness and user experience.
* Own service excellence and continuous improvement, establishing service roadmaps, proactive monitoring, support procedures, and improvement initiatives based on stakeholder demand and customer feedback.
* Manage onshore/offshore teams and technology vendors, monitoring performance against agreed service expectations and driving accountability for high-quality development, support, and service delivery.
* Ensure strong governance and operational readiness through adherence to release management processes and maintenance of accurate system documentation, requirements, test scripts, knowledge articles, configuration information, and support procedures.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in data and analytics, including designing and developing scalable, high-quality solutions across SAP BW and Microsoft Azure platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise with SAP BW, Databricks, Power BI, Azure Data Factory (ADF) and ETL technologies such as Informatica; SAP BW certification preferred.
* Strong production/application support experience, with strong capabilities in Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management, including root cause analysis and systematic troubleshooting.
* Proven experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and solutions, covering architecture, data flows, design, development, testing, documentation, deployment, and enhancements.
* Strong understanding of ITIL, SDLC, Agile, and Waterfall methodologies; ITIL Foundation v4 or equivalent certification preferred.
* Experience designing and supporting cross-application integrations involving SAP, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms, along with exposure to AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal/external relationships and simplify complex technical concepts into actionable plans; MedTech industry experience preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description:
**Description**
Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.
  
  
This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.
  
  
The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.
  
  
What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.
  
  
**About The Team**
The AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end-to-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Associate Manager, Data Delivery & Dashboard
description:
**Job Description**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of complex data outputs for our healthcare market research projects. The team is responsible for conducting comprehensive quality checks on large datasets, transforming and standardising data files to meet project and client requirements, and managing delivery through automated and off-the-shelf dashboard solutions. By combining technical precision with a client-focused approach, the team enables timely, insightful, and accessible data visualisation that supports strategic decision-making across our global research initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team Lead role will report into the Sr Manager. The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team lead will be a key member of the India-based Data Management & Delivery Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets for STEM. As a Dashboard Developer Team lead, you build and maintain high impact dashboards and data visualizations that transform raw market research data into actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with researchers, analysts, and engineers to ensure data flows seamlessly from collections to visual storytelling. You will also support the team in delivering insightful, user-friendly dashboards through automated tools and off-the-shelf solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in data management, quality assurance, and data visualisation, while working alongside an experienced team in a dynamic, global environment. Skill Set required
  
  
**STEM Dashboard Discovery Phase**
One of primary responsibilities would be to streamline the overall data collection process and create dashboards
  
  
**Brand Equity tracking support with our in-house platform:**

* Maintain the pipeline for the project data process flow (this includes receival of data into in-hosue Tool, through the data processing stage into the storage mart, through the python utilities into required outputs)
* Maintain and update Power BI Dashboard when required due to changes from the research team
* Manage and rectify when failures occur in the dashboard, liaising with both the data providers, research team and developers on the Pipeline
* Manage the storage mart and data warehouse
* Support team with edits in-house platform

**Data Quality Checks:**
Assist in performing detailed quality control checks on large and complex datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  
  
**Data Transformation & Standardisation:**
Support the transformation and standardisation of data files to align with internal data structures, project needs, and client-specific formats.
  
  
**Dashboard Support & Maintenance:**
Lead in the creation, population, and maintenance of dashboards using off-the-shelf tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms), ensuring outputs are clear, accurate, and aligned with research objectives.
  
  
**Data Delivery Management:**
Manage and organise the final delivery of data files and dashboards to internal teams and clients, ensuring timely and error-free execution.
  
  
**Collaboration Across Teams:**
Work closely with internal stakeholders including Development team, Data Processing, Scripting, Project Management and Research teams to ensure smooth handovers and integration of deliverables.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting:**
Maintain clear documentation of processes, data transformation steps, and QC logs to support transparency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness.
  
  
**Continuous Learning & Development:**
Engage in training opportunities to build knowledge in healthcare data, market research workflows, dashboarding tools, and data handling best practices.
  
  
**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**
**Technical Expertise**

* At least 6+ years expertise in Power BI, Power query , DAX, data modeling, Quality assurance, SQL
* Experience in Building interactive, user-friendly dashboards
* Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, etc.)
* Understanding and building of ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Expert level Knowledge of Python
* Proficient in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Cloud platform expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP), and building ETL/ELT pipelines is a plus
* Experience in version control system.

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
We love what we do and continuously strive for innovation and creativity. We believe everyone should continuously be learning and provide:
  
  

* A comprehensive training and development programme for all staff, from entry level apprentice to senior management
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration
* A relaxed and friendly working environment

**About Inizio Advisory:**
Research Partnership is part of Inizio Advisory, a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose-built for mid-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.

**The role**

You own how the platform is built. You are the hands-on technical lead for the core platform and the data layer that every product runs on. You set the architecture, write and review the critical code, and hold the bar on quality, security and scale. You take over day-to-day platform and data architecture from the CTO.

Engineers across the platform look to you for technical direction, design review and code review.

Stack you should be familiar with

* **Data:**
  open lakehouse (Trino, Apache Iceberg), change data capture, data quality monitoring
* **Ingestion:**
  AI-assisted connectors for ERP, SQL databases, files and SaaS sources
* **AI:**
  leading LLMs on AWS and GCP, agents and tool-calling (MCP), vector search
* **Apps and services:**
  Python, FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Postgres
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM tracing and evals, product analytics
* **Cloud:**
  AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Compliance:**
  SOC 2, HIPAA-ready deployments

**What you will own**

* **Core platform architecture:**
  security, scalability, multi-tenancy, connector standards, extension points.
* **Data access and performance:**
  a governed data access layer that serves interactive apps with fast response times alongside heavy AI agent workloads, with cost and latency under control.
* **Interfaces between teams:**
  clear, written contracts between platform components so product teams build on the platform, not around it.
* **Code quality:**
  review standards, design reviews, hands-on review of critical paths. Raise the bar for the whole team.
* **Security and compliance by design:**
  least privilege, fine-grained data access controls that AI cannot bypass, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit trails. Turn compliance requirements into architecture, not paperwork.
* **Reliability:**
  SLOs, observability, on-call design, self-healing pipelines, and scaling as customer usage grows.
* **Technical direction**
  for data engineers and full stack engineers.

**Must have**

* 8+ years building backend and data platforms, with recent hands-on coding. You still ship.
* Built production data pipelines and platform infrastructure: lakehouse or distributed query engines (Trino, Spark, Iceberg, Delta or similar), CDC and ingestion, data quality.
* Strong distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Security-first: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit. Experience in a SOC 2, HIPAA or similarly regulated environment.
* Hands-on AI exposure: shipped LLM or agent features in production, and understand evals, tool-calling and MCP well enough to design platforms for them.
* Has made architecture decisions at scale and lived with the consequences.
* Leads through design and code review. People want your review.

**Nice to have**

* Query engine internals, catalog performance, query planning
* OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS and GCP
* Enterprise system integration (ERP and other line-of-business systems)
* Healthcare, defense or financial compliance programs

**This role is not**

A people manager. A pure DevOps or SRE role.

**How we hire**

* Intro with the CTO
* Architecture deep dive: walk us through a platform you designed, including what you would change
* Live design: a governed data access layer for a multi-tenant AI platform
* Code review exercise
* Final with CEO

**What you get**

Ownership of the platform every product runs on, direct work with the CTO, real enterprise data problems, and meaningful equity.

title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
Gurugram · Full-time · Senior

#### **About The Position**

**About Coralogix**

Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.

We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.

**The Role**

Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.

Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.

A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.

  
  

**What You Will Build**

**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade
  

  

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets
  

  

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data
  

  

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

#### **Requirements**

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  

  

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones
  

  

**Cultural Fit**

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect - Source.AI
description:

description:

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.

  

Identify and Prioritise Risk

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.  

Coordinate Remediation

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.  

Improve Security Practices

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.  

Report and Govern

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

  

Essential

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.  

Desirable

* Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate.
* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

title: Vice President, Engineering
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner.

**Quick Take -**

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals.
* Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well.
* Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders.

**The Work -**

***Engineering for the customer journeys***

* **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery.
* **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each.
* **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product.

***Partnership with Data & Intelligence***

* **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations.
* **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models.
* **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards.

***Delivery and engineering excellence***

* **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions.
* **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root.
* **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development.
* **Production ownership.** Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations.
* **Architecture and standards.** Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately.

***Leadership and management***

* **Organization.** Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them.
* **Global teams.** Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices.
* **Talent.** Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer.
* **Budget and reporting.** Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run.

**First-Year Priorities**

* Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them.
* Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios.
* Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards.
* Assign a lead team for each supplier–buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow.
* Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it.
* Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations.
* Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track.

**Required Skills**

* 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS.
* A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems.
* Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale.
* Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery.
* Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development.
* Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures.
* A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers.
* Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones.
* Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001).
* Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

**Preferred Skills**

* Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech.
* Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Senior Executive, Application Development
description:
**Job Description**

* Analyse functional and business integration requirements and translate them into detailed technical interface designs.
* Develop interfaces between SAP S/4HANA and SAP/non-SAP systems using appropriate SAP integration technologies.
* Work hands-on with technologies and protocols such as:

+ SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration
+ SAP CPI
+ SAP PI/PO, where applicable
+ IDoc / ALE
+ RFC / BAPI
+ OData APIs
+ REST APIs
+ SOAP Web Services
+ EDI
+ XML / JSON
+ SFTP / File-based integration
+ Event-driven/API-based integration

* Configure and develop integration flows, message mappings, routing, transformations, validations, exception handling, and acknowledgements.
* Work with standard SAP APIs and integration content before considering custom interfaces.
* Support SAP S/4HANA integration with applications such as:

+ Manufacturing and shop-floor systems
+ Laboratory/LIMS systems
+ Warehouse and logistics applications
+ Quality systems
+ Banking and treasury applications
+ Master data systems
+ CRM and commercial applications
+ Regulatory and serialization solutions
+ Identity/access management applications
+ Third-party vendor and cloud platforms

* Understand SAP business objects and interface structures across relevant SAP functional modules.
* Work closely with SAP functional consultants, ABAP developers, Basis, Security, Infrastructure, middleware teams, and external vendors.
* Perform technical troubleshooting using SAP and middleware monitoring/debugging tools.
* Analyse IDoc failures, API errors, message failures, connectivity issues, data mapping errors, and application-level exceptions.
* Design appropriate:

+ Error handling
+ Retry mechanisms
+ Reprocessing
+ Alerting
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation
+ Audit trail mechanisms

* Participate in technical design reviews and ensure interfaces meet enterprise integration architecture standards.
* Prepare and maintain technical/interface specification documents covering end-to-end integration from source system through middleware to target system.
* Ensure specifications clearly document:

+ Source and target systems
+ Interface direction
+ Business triggers
+ Data structures and mappings
+ Transformation rules
+ Frequency and volumes
+ Authentication/security
+ Error handling
+ Reprocessing
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation
+ Dependencies
+ Batch scheduling
+ Performance requirements

* Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, cutover, and production deployment.
* Prepare test data and technically support defect investigation and resolution.
* Participate in interface migration and deployment activities across SAP development, quality, validation, and production environments.
* Support cutover planning, interface activation/deactivation, data synchronization, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Provide Level 2/Level 3 technical support for production integration issues.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective solutions for recurring interface failures.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors for API specifications, connectivity, certificates, endpoints, firewall requirements, and technical issue resolution.

**SAP Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP interface/integration development.
* Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA integration architecture.
* Strong knowledge of at least one major SAP middleware/integration platform, preferably SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration.
* Experience with SAP PI/PO is desirable, particularly for migration or hybrid landscapes.
* Strong knowledge of IDoc/ALE, RFC, BAPI, OData, REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, and API technologies.
* Understanding of SAP standard APIs and SAP Business Accelerator Hub content.
* Working knowledge of ABAP sufficient for interface troubleshooting, debugging, enhancements, user exits/BAdIs, and technical coordination with ABAP teams.
* Knowledge of SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF) is desirable.
* Experience with integration monitoring and error-handling frameworks.
* Understanding of certificate management, OAuth, Basic Authentication, SAML, API keys, encryption, and secure communication protocols.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP and API Management is preferred.
* Understanding of event-driven integration, Event Mesh, or similar technologies is an advantage.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles and API-first integration architecture is preferred.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 8+ years of overall SAP technical/integration experience.
* Significant hands-on experience in SAP interface design, development, testing, and production support.
* Experience working in SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, transformation, or support programs.
* Greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation experience is preferred.
* Experience integrating SAP with multiple enterprise and third-party applications.
* Experience working with geographically distributed functional, technical, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
* Pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical device, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience is preferred.
* Experience from either service/consulting organizations or product/end-user organizations is acceptable, provided the candidate demonstrates strong hands-on SAP integration capability.

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Associate – Integration Developer / SAP Integration Suite certification.
* SAP BTP-related certification.
* SAP S/4HANA-related certification.
* Other relevant SAP technical/integration certifications.

**Key Success Measures**

* Delivery of stable, secure, scalable, and maintainable SAP interfaces.
* High-quality technical specifications and interface documentation.
* Minimal production failures and effective error/reprocessing mechanisms.
* Compliance with SAP Clean Core and enterprise architecture principles.
* Successful completion of required testing and validation activities.
* Timely resolution of integration incidents and defects.
* Strong end-to-end ownership from design through production support.
* Effective collaboration across SAP, middleware, business, infrastructure, security, CSV/QA, and external vendor teams.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum 8+ years of relevant SAP and integration development experience
* Industry: Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences experience preferred
* Employment Background: Candidates from IT services, consulting, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or product organizations may be considered
* Education: Any recognized graduate/postgraduate educational background
* Certification: Relevant SAP certification preferred but not mandatory
* Role Type: Hands-on technical role with responsibility for SAP and non-SAP integrations

title: Head of Delivery
description:
- Description

  The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

  You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

  Responsibilities

  **Portfolio and P&L**

  * Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.
  * Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.
  * Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.
  * Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

  **Delivery operating model**

  * Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.
  * Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.
  * Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.
  * Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

  **Client delivery governance**

  * Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.
  * Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.
  * Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

  **Pre-sales support**

  * Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.
  * Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

  **People and leadership**

  * Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.
  * Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.
  * Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

  **Quality and compliance**

  * Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.
  * Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

  Required Skills

  * 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.
  * Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.\
  * Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.
  * Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.
  * Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.
  * Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.
  * Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.
  * Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.
  * Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

  **Nice to have**

  * Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.
  * Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.
  * Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.
  * PMP, PgMP or equivalent; an MBA is a plus, not a substitute for delivery track record.
  * Has built a PMO or delivery excellence function from scratch.
