title: Engineer IT
description:
The **Engineer – IT** will support and maintain production operator IT, cloud, and telecom infrastructure. The role includes resolving hardware, operating system, software, network, server, virtual machine, security, backup, access management, and voice-connectivity issues, as well as coordinating with operator IT teams and cloud service providers to maintain service availability.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Operator IT Infrastructure & Security

* Attend to and resolve production hardware (HP, Dell, Lenovo, IBM) and network-related complaints.
* Resolve production operating system (Linux and Microsoft Windows) and software-related complaints.
* Coordinate server resource upgrades, including RAM and HDD.
* Configure web publishing/hosting on IIS Web Server.
* Monitor production server hardware health and alerts; maintain production asset data.
* Manage software and operating system licences, production server backups, user accounts, access permissions, and passwords.
* Submit URL whitelisting and firewall-opening requests to the Operator IT Team.
* Create VPN user IDs with the operator support team for Operations & Maintenance access.
* Apply server security patches, support closure of security audit findings, and perform OS hardening.
* Integrate with security platforms such as SIEM, ViPAM, LDAP, and FireEye.
* Perform pre-activity and post-activity sanity checks for planned telecom activities and confirm service functionality.
* Support operator-side platform changes, such as proxy and SMTP gateway migrations.
* Provide network-level troubleshooting using Wireshark and support IPsec VPN tunnels.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Security

* Resolve production Linux, Microsoft Windows, and software-related issues in cloud environments.
* Coordinate virtual machine (VM) resource upgrades with the Cloud Service Provider.
* Configure web publishing/hosting on IIS Web Server.
* Monitor production VM health and alerts; maintain production VM asset data.
* Manage software and operating system licences, VM backups, user accounts, access permissions, and passwords.
* Submit firewall-opening requests to the Cloud Service Provider and create VPN user IDs with the provider for Operations & Maintenance access.
* Apply security patches to VMs, support vulnerability closure, and perform OS hardening.
* Perform pre-activity and post-activity sanity checks for planned activities and support cloud-provider platform changes. Provide Wireshark-based network troubleshooting and IPsec VPN tunnel support.

3. Telecom Infrastructure Support

* Support the Customer Desk in resolving customer call-connectivity complaints, including packet capture (pcap) and Wireshark trace analysis.
* Attend to and resolve E1/SIP media and channel-state complaints.
* Support voice-channel upgrades and E1 rearrangements as required.
* Submit call-routing requests to the Operator Switch.
* Monitor the health of production server voice circuits.

Education & Qualifications:

Any degree or a three-year diploma.

Mandatory Skills / Certifications :

* Course completion or certification in Linux (RHCE) – mandatory.
* Course completion or certification in Computer Hardware Service – mandatory.
* Course completion or certification in Microsoft Windows Server Administration (MCSE/MCP) – mandatory.

Preferred / Optional Skills :

* Course completion or certification in Cisco Networking (CCNA/CCNP).
* Course completion or certification in DevOps.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Job Title: Windows & Linux Compliance SME**

**Job Summary:**

  

The MSFT Windows Compliance SME supports the Stay in Compliance Lead by managing compliance, risk and control activities across the global on-premises Windows Server estate. The role provides deep technical expertise for Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell Desired State Configuration, server hardware, virtualisation and associated hybrid-cloud management capabilities. The role helps maintain a secure, supported and consistently configured estate through vulnerability remediation, security hardening, patch and version currency, configuration baselines, identity and access controls, automation, hardware lifecycle management and audit assurance.

  

Working with On-Prem Hosting Engineering and Operations, Information Security, Active Directory, Service Management, hardware, virtualisation, cloud and application teams, the role assesses security findings and configuration drift, engineers and coordinates large-scale remediation, and produces traceable governance and audit reporting. The position provides Windows-specific subject-matter expertise and clear escalation to the Stay in Compliance Lead, while coordinating cross-platform dependencies where Windows services interact with Linux, Azure, AWS, VMware, Nutanix AHV or Hyper-V environments.

  

**Job Description**

* Serve as the compliance SME for the global on-premises Microsoft Windows Server estate, supporting environments at enterprise scale, including estates exceeding 10,000 servers.
* Monitor Microsoft security advisories, vulnerability findings, operating-system alerts, configuration data and vendor notifications to identify exposure affecting Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.
* Assess technical impact, affected versions, exploitability, business criticality, service dependencies and compensating controls, and support risk-based prioritisation in line with agreed standards and remediation SLAs.
* Engineer, package, test and coordinate large-scale remediation for security vulnerabilities, configuration changes and software updates using Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell, Desired State Configuration and Ansible.
* Design, implement and maintain Group Policy Objects and verify consistent application across relevant Active Directory forests and domains.
* Create and maintain security configuration items, baselines, compliance rules and automated corrective controls using PowerShell DSC and approved enterprise tooling.
* Plan and schedule deployment waves for patches, security configurations, GPO changes, software packages, firmware and drivers, balancing remediation urgency with production stability.
* Maintain compliance visibility across physical and virtual Windows servers hosted on VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper-V, including hardware, firmware, drivers, operating-system versions and support lifecycle.
* Support secure account and access management for Windows servers, including privileged access, service accounts, local administrator controls, authentication policy and role separation.
* Perform security and performance analysis and recommend hardening, tuning and configuration changes for mission-critical production systems in data-centre environments.
* Support hybrid management of on-premises servers through Microsoft Azure capabilities, including Azure Arc-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update-management concepts where adopted.
* Coordinate cross-platform remediation dependencies with Linux teams using Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform when shared services, automation or controls span Windows and Linux environments.
* Prepare implementation plans, technical procedures, validation steps, rollback plans, change records and stakeholder communications for compliance deployments.
* Track remediation actions, ageing, exceptions, deployment failures, dependencies and closure evidence, escalating material risk or delivery delays to the Stay in Compliance Lead.
* Maintain accurate compliance records covering server inventory, patch and configuration status, GPO application, software and firmware currency, lifecycle, vulnerabilities, ownership, approved exceptions and evidence.
* Use ServiceNow, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Power BI, Dell OpenManage Enterprise, monitoring platforms, SharePoint, scripts and APIs to analyse compliance, automate recurring tasks and produce dashboards and reports.
* Support internal and external audits by providing timely, complete and traceable Windows Server configuration, access, patching, lifecycle and remediation evidence.
* Identify opportunities to standardise and automate vulnerability assessment, packaging, deployment, compliance validation, evidence collection and reporting using DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Build effective working relationships across Engineering, Operations, Information Security, Service Management, Active Directory, Linux, cloud, virtualisation, hardware and application teams while operating within the governance direction set by the Stay in Compliance Lead.

  

**Knowledge & Competencies Required:**

* Advanced hands-on administration and compliance experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025 in large, globally distributed production environments.
* Expert knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy design and management, domain and forest structures, authentication, service accounts and privileged-access controls.
* Proven experience assessing security risk, remediating Windows Server vulnerabilities, applying security baselines and tuning systems securely without compromising service availability.
* Deep scripting and automation capability in PowerShell, WMI and Python; experience with Ansible is required, while VBS and Perl knowledge is beneficial for legacy environments.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager and packaging and deploying software, scripts, updates and remediation controls at enterprise scale.
* Experience creating configuration items, security baselines and desired-state controls using PowerShell DSC or equivalent configuration-as-code capabilities.
* Ability to interpret Microsoft security advisories, CVEs, severity scores, vulnerability scan findings, support lifecycle information and technical prerequisites and translate them into deployment actions.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server hardware management, firmware and driver currency, remote management and lifecycle controls; Dell OpenManage Enterprise experience is advantageous.
* Good knowledge of VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper-V virtualisation and the operational dependencies between guest operating systems and hosting platforms.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and hybrid-cloud management, including Azure Arc-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update-management concepts; AWS familiarity is beneficial.
* Working knowledge of Linux security and administration, Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform sufficient to coordinate shared compliance and automation dependencies.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, monitoring and systems-management platforms for remediation tracking, data analysis, dashboarding and audit reporting.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL, Agile, Kanban, Scrum and DevOps practices, particularly Change, Incident, Problem, Risk and Release Management.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, procedures, implementation plans, rollback instructions, validation evidence and management reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a disciplined approach to risk, data quality, control traceability and production stability.
* Clear communication, stakeholder coordination and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively across global, geographically dispersed teams.

  

**Job Requirements:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

  

**Experience:**

Seven to eight years of relevant experience in enterprise Windows Server engineering, systems administration, infrastructure security or compliance, including substantial hands-on experience with Active Directory and GPO, Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell automation, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, hardware lifecycle and mission-critical data-centre systems. Experience operating at large scale and coordinating complex global deployments is required.

  

**Certification Requirements:**

ITIL Foundation certification is required. Current Microsoft Windows Server, Azure Administrator, Azure Fundamentals or Microsoft security certifications are preferred. Red Hat, Linux Foundation, Ansible, VMware, Nutanix or CISSP certifications are beneficial. Legacy MCSA or MCSE Windows Server certification will be recognised where held.

title: Business Analyst - Revenue & Operations
description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst – Revenue & Operations**

**About Apna**

Founded in 2019, Apna is one of India’s leading professional networking platforms, dedicated to empowering the country’s workforce with employment, professional networking, and skilling opportunities. Operating across 60+ cities in 20+ states, Apna is backed by marquee investors, including Tiger Global, Lightspeed, Sequoia, Owl Ventures, and Greenoaks Capital.

With over 16 million users and 100,000+ employers on the platform, Apna is committed to enabling livelihoods for billions of people across India.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a data-driven and analytical Business Analyst – Revenue & Operations to join our Operations team. In this role, you will work closely with Inside Sales, Field Sales, Enterprise Sales, Support, Marketing, and Account Management teams to drive operational efficiency, improve sales performance, and enable data-driven decision-making.

You will be responsible for analyzing business and operational data, developing dashboards, optimizing SQL queries and data pipelines, monitoring lead distribution and sales performance, and identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and analytical skills with a solid understanding of CRM systems, sales operations, and customer lifecycle management.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. Data Analysis & Business Insights**

* Collect, analyze, and interpret business, sales, and operational data to identify trends, performance gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Generate actionable insights to improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance.
* Analyze customer lifecycle data to identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling, retention, and churn prevention.
* Track key business metrics, including conversion rates, pipeline performance, customer acquisition, and retention.

**2. SQL, Data Pipelines & Reporting**

* Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Build and maintain data pipelines to ensure accurate, reliable, and timely availability of business data.
* Support ETL processes and ensure data consistency across reporting systems.
* Identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and implement improvements to data quality and reporting accuracy.

**3. Dashboard Development & Performance Tracking**

* Build and maintain dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across Inside Sales, Field Sales, Enterprise Sales, and Support operations.
* Track lead-to-conversion funnels, sales productivity, pipeline movement, and high-value business acquisition opportunities.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders and stakeholders.

**4. CRM & Lead Management**

* Monitor CRM data quality, completeness, and accuracy to support effective sales execution and account management.
* Analyze and improve lead-routing, lead-assignment, and distribution processes across multiple sales channels.
* Ensure leads are assigned to the appropriate teams based on business rules, sales segments, and account ownership.
* Identify gaps in CRM workflows and recommend process improvements to prevent lead leakage, duplication, and misallocation.

**5. Revenue Operations & Process Optimization**

* Collaborate with Inside Sales, Field Sales, Enterprise Sales, Marketing, Support, and Account Management teams to streamline business processes.
* Establish and monitor reporting frameworks to distinguish new customer acquisition from existing customer account management.
* Analyze revenue-related metrics, including conversion rates, pipeline velocity, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, and win/loss trends, wherever applicable.
* Partner with stakeholders to define business metrics, standardize reporting, and implement data-backed process improvements.
* Support business reviews, ad hoc analysis, and strategic initiatives through timely and accurate data insights.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Operations Analyst, Sales Operations Analyst, or Revenue Operations Analyst.
* **Strong proficiency in SQL**, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data manipulation, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience with data extraction, transformation, reporting, and preferably building or maintaining data pipelines.
* Experience in creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools.
* Understanding of sales funnels, lead management, revenue reporting, customer lifecycle analytics, and operational KPIs.
* Ability to translate business requirements into meaningful reports, dashboards, and actionable recommendations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present insights to non-technical teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a B2B, SaaS, technology, or high-growth startup environment.
* Exposure to multiple sales channels, including Inbound, Inside Sales, Field Sales, and Enterprise Sales.
* Experience in account management analytics, customer retention, revenue reporting, and sales performance tracking.
* Hands-on experience implementing or optimizing CRM workflows, lead-routing logic, and business reporting processes.

What We’re Looking For  
A proactive, detail-oriented, and business-minded analyst who can connect data with business outcomes. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, solving operational challenges using SQL, building reliable reporting systems, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements in business performance.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Threat Intelligence Analyst – Early Career**
==============================================

  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Threat Intelligence (TI) Analyst supports the collection, analysis, and dissemination of cyber threat intelligence to improve ADI’s ability to anticipate, detect, and respond to cyber threats. Working closely with the SOC, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, and Cyber Defence teams, this role helps identify emerging threats, track adversary activity, and translate intelligence into practical defensive actions. This is an early-career role intended for individuals looking to build expertise in cyber threat intelligence, adversary analysis, threat hunting, and intelligence-driven defence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Collect and analyse cyber threat intelligence from open-source, deep web, dark web, commercial, vendor, and industry sources.

* Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, malware campaigns, credential exposures, data leaks and threat actor activity relevant to ADI.

* Support the creation and distribution of threat intelligence briefings, reports, and summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.

* Maintain awareness of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

* Assist SOC and Incident Response teams by providing contextual intelligence during security investigations.

* Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs) and support operationalisation into security tools and detection platforms.

* Support proactive threat hunting activities by identifying relevant threats and hypotheses for investigation.

* Track industry and sector-specific threats affecting semiconductor, manufacturing, cloud, and enterprise environments.

* Assist with intelligence requirements gathering and mapping threats to business risks.

* Maintain threat intelligence documentation, repositories, watchlists, and reporting dashboards.

* Participate in tabletop exercises, purple-team activities, and lessons-learned reviews to improve defensive readiness.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of threat intelligence processes and intelligence sharing practices.

* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations

* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, intelligence analysis, SOC operations, or related technical field.

* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, ransomware, business email compromise, and common attack techniques.

* Experience conducting threat intelligence collection and monitoring across open-source, deep web, and dark web sources to identify emerging threats, threat actors, compromised credentials, and organizational risks.

* Basic understanding of threat intelligence concepts including IOCs, threat actors, TTPs, and intelligence lifecycle principles.

* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and research skills.

* Ability to identify patterns, connect information from multiple sources, and communicate findings clearly.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience leveraging AI, generative AI, and agentic security capabilities to enhance threat detection, investigation, response, and SOC operational efficiency.

* Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

* Experience with intelligence platforms, security monitoring tools, threat feeds, or OSINT research tools.

* Basic scripting or data analysis experience using Python, KQL, PowerShell, SQL, or similar technologies.

* CompTIA Security+, CySA+, SC-200, CTI-related certifications, or equivalent qualifications.

* Experience with threat hunting, CTFs, internships, malware analysis labs, or cyber research projects.

  
  

**Success Measures**
====================

description:
**Work Schedule**

Second Shift (Afternoons)

Office

**Job Description**

**Join Us as a Senior Programmer Analyst II – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation**
=============================================================================================

The Senior Programmer Analyst II performs advanced statistical and clinical programming activities to support clinical research projects. The role requires strong expertise in end-to-end clinical SAS programming, including SDTM, ADaM, and Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).

The Senior Programmer Analyst II works independently as a Lead Programmer or Study Lead on complex clinical studies, ensuring high-quality deliverables, managing study timelines, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and providing guidance and mentorship to junior programmers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Act as the Lead Programmer or Study Lead on complex clinical studies, working directly with project leaders and client representatives to manage programming activities, timelines, resources, and deliverables.
* Independently manage end-to-end clinical SAS programming activities, including SDTM dataset creation, ADaM dataset development, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).
* Develop, execute, maintain, and validate SAS programs to support clinical trial data analysis and reporting.
* Ensure compliance with CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM, and applicable clinical programming guidelines.
* Lead programming activities across clinical studies, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality datasets, analysis outputs, and supporting documentation.
* Collaborate with Biostatistics, Clinical Data Management, and other cross-functional teams to meet study objectives.
* Perform quality control and validation of statistical programming deliverables, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
* Manage multiple programming assignments, prioritize deliverables, and ensure adherence to project timelines and departmental SOPs.
* Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to junior programmers.
* Participate in client meetings, project discussions, and programming reviews as the primary programming representative.
* Contribute to process improvements, programming standards, training materials, and departmental working practice documents.
* Support resource planning, project forecasting, and bidding activities when required.

**Education & Experience Requirements**
---------------------------------------

* Master's degree in computer science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related field, with relevant clinical programming experience.

**OR**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or an equivalent relevant academic/vocational qualification.

### **Mandatory Experience**

* **Minimum 7 years of end-to-end clinical SAS programming experience, including SDTM, ADaM, and TLF development, with proven experience independently leading clinical studies as a Study Lead Programmer.**
* Strong hands-on experience in SAS programming, including Base SAS, SAS Macros, PROC SQL, and clinical reporting.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing programming deliverables across clinical studies.
* Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
---------------------------------

* Advanced proficiency in SAS programming, including Base SAS, SAS Macros, and PROC SQL.
* Strong knowledge of CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.
* Extensive experience developing and validating Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).
* Proven Study Lead or Lead Programmer experience managing complex clinical studies independently.
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, statistical programming, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
* Ability to independently manage multiple studies, assignments, and challenging timelines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to interact effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with experience mentoring and guiding junior programmers.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and complex clinical data structures.
* Ability to identify process improvements and contribute to programming efficiency.

**Working Conditions and Environment**
--------------------------------------

* Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Occasional travel to site locations, including domestic and international travel, may be required.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence.

You'll work in an environment where collaboration and professional development are part of the everyday experience, and where your contributions make a meaningful difference in advancing clinical research.

**Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.**

title: Global Corporate Services - Travel Data Analyst & Project Management
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the role**

  

We are seeking a highly analytical and operationally focused as ***Global Corporate Services - Travel Data Analyst & Project Management*** professional to support the management and optimisation of our corporate travel programme. This role combines travel operations, data analytics, reporting and project management to improve programme performance, traveller experience and policy compliance, while identifying opportunities for operational efficiency and cost savings. The ideal candidate will bring corporate travel management experience, strong analytical capability and a proven track record of delivering travel-related projects and process improvements.

**Role Responsibilities**

* Oversee day-to-day travel operations, support travellers with travel-related queries and issues, and identify opportunities to improve service delivery and traveller experience.
* Analyse travel and expense data using advanced Excel, including pivot tables, data modelling, Power Query and complex formulas, and develop dashboards and reports using Power BI or similar tools.
* Clean, transform, validate and analyse complex travel and expense datasets to generate actionable insights on spend, booking trends, policy compliance, traveller behaviour, adoption and supplier performance.
* Define, track and report KPIs covering travel programme effectiveness, cost savings, compliance and supplier service-level agreements; automate recurring reports and present recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Lead and support travel-related projects, including process improvements, technology implementations, supplier transitions and programme enhancements; develop plans, manage timelines, track milestones, risks, dependencies and deliverables.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives across Travel, Procurement, Finance, HR, Security and business teams, and support change management and user adoption for new travel tools, policies and processes.
* Partner with the Travel Category Manager, Travel Management Companies and suppliers to monitor contractual obligations and SLAs, support commercial negotiations, and provide analytics for supplier business reviews and sourcing decisions.
Evaluate travel processes, recommend and implement improvements, maintain policy compliance, and support training materials, user guides, audits, governance and employee awareness.  

***Why you?***

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong corporate travel knowledge with advanced analytical, reporting and project management capability. You will be comfortable interpreting large datasets, translating findings into practical business recommendations, managing multiple priorities and influencing stakeholders across functions, while maintaining a high standard of data accuracy and customer focus.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, Power Query, data modelling, advanced formulas and dashboard development.
* Strong experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence and visualisation tools, including automated reports and interactive dashboards.
* Ability to clean, transform and analyse complex travel and expense datasets, design KPIs, measure performance and identify trends.
* Strong project management, organisational, problem-solving and critical-thinking capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
High attention to detail and a collaborative, customer-focused and results-oriented mindset.  

**Basic Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Travel Management, Finance, Data Analytics or a related field, with a minimum of 5+ years’ experience in travel operations, travel analytics, corporate travel management or a related role.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated experience managing travel-related projects and process improvement initiatives within corporate travel programmes and Travel Management Company environments.
* Experience supporting global or regional corporate travel programmes, travel technology implementations, reporting automation or digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of travel industry practices, travel procurement, supplier performance management and travel policy administration.
* Familiarity with travel booking and expense management platforms such as Concur, Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo or other GDS platforms.
Project Management certification such as PMP, Agile, PRINCE2 or equivalent is desirable.

2026-11-20

title: Business Acceptance Analyst
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

#### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Bangalore (On-site)  
**Contract type:** Permanent
  
**Target start date:** January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time (40h/week), aligned with the GMT timezone (**starting** at **1:00 PM IST**)  
**Compensation:** INR 10,00,000 – 22,00,000 per year

#### **What You'll Architect**

As a **Business Acceptance Analyst / Digital Solution Validation**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making.

This role is both analytical and consultative, ideal for someone who can bridge business requirements and delivered digital solutions while ensuring production readiness. We are looking for professionals who can connect business needs with technology delivery, ensuring that solutions meet expectations before moving into production. Professionals who think like architects and act like builders.

You will support a global team responsible for the **processes, tools, and data governance associated with customer installed-base management**, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and digital delivery teams.

##### **Responsibilities**

* Review business and functional requirements to understand expected outcomes and acceptance conditions.
* Translate requirements and specifications into **structured validation scenarios and acceptance criteria**.
* Validate delivered functionality against agreed business requirements and solution specifications.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and deviations between requirements and delivered solutions.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and digital delivery teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain traceability between **requirements, acceptance criteria, validation outcomes, and production readiness**.
* Support business acceptance and pre-production validation activities.
* Provide clear evidence-based reporting of validation results and outstanding issues.
* Challenge unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria before solutions progress toward production.
* Apply **AI-enabled techniques** to improve validation efficiency, requirements analysis, documentation quality, scenario generation, and solution analysis.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI-assisted tools.
* Collaborate effectively with international colleagues while maintaining a strong on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges.
* You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action.
* You balance technical thinking with business understanding.
* You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments.
* You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.
* You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* You have strong attention to detail and enjoy validating whether solutions truly meet business expectations.
* You embrace innovation and are interested in leveraging AI to improve quality and efficiency.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in **business acceptance, solution validation, functional testing, QA analysis, UAT, or a similar role** within digital or technology delivery environments.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and software delivery teams.
* Experience operating within agile or iterative delivery environments.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Availability to work on-site in Bangalore.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Strong understanding of business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to transform functional requirements into effective validation scenarios and acceptance approaches.
* Experience validating delivered functionality against agreed business requirements.
* Proven ability to identify discrepancies between specifications and delivered solutions.

**Role reports to:**

ACCOUNTING COORDINATOR

**Location:**

Asia Pacific, India, Karnataka, Bangalore

**Work Location:**

Hybrid

**What you will do**

**Finance Analyst – Global PICC Inventory**

  

Kenvue Supply Chain Finance is recruiting for a Sr Finance Analyst, located in Bangalore, India.
  
  
The PICC (Principal, Inventory, Costing and Currency) Finance team is responsible for Inventory Management, complex financial transactions and flows, costing, currency and intercompany pricing. PICC team ensures that all supply chain/cost transactions, analysis and reporting are accurate and compliant in line with Kenvue guidelines.
  
  
The Analyst will play a key role in ensuring a high-quality service delivery model through strong collaboration across Business and Finance. In addition, understanding of the Supply Chain Finance processes, systems and ability to effectively frame and communicate with senior leaders, will be important to success and to the team as a whole.
  
  
**Description:**  
**The Analyst may be responsible for the following:**

* Lead financial analysis, and business partnering across manufacturing, logistics, and customer service to optimize cost-to-serve, inventory, and service levels.

* Own month‑end close results and controls for supply chain cost centers and COGS, enabling data‑driven decisions and continuous improvement.

* Collaborate with cross functional teams to analyze and optimize aspects of the supply chain value chain.

* Ensure compliance with all local government and company regulations, policies, and procedures.

* Business partnering (i.e. Tax, Compliance, Supply Chain, Leadership Teams).

* Share business and financial best practices/procedures across the region.

* Focus on process improvement and standardization.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Month End Close & Reporting (high commitment & proactiveness).
* Own COGS, manufacturing variances, freight, duty, warehousing, and distribution expense close—drive accurate accruals, reclasses, and cut-offs.
* Proactively pre reconcile ledgers, validate standard costs, monitor PPV, and resolve data issues before deadlines.

* Maintain tight calendar discipline, on call availability during peak close windows, and contingency plans for systems/data delays.

* Ensure robust inventory valuation, cycle count results analysis, slow moving/obsolete provisioning, and write off governance.

  
  

**Process, Automation & Controls:**

* Design automation for recurring reports (Power Query/BI), improve data flows, and reduce manual touchpoints.

* Strengthen policy adherence (SOX controls, segregation of duties), and support internal/external audits.

  
  

**Competencies & Behaviours:**

* High Commitment & Ownership: Delivers under tight timelines, escalates early, creates backup plans during month end, and ensures “right first time” outputs.

* Proactiveness: Anticipates issues (e.g., material price spikes, supply constraints), proposes mitigation, and follows through to closure.

* Analytical Rigor: Turns data into insights; explains variance bridges in business terms—price, mix, volume, productivity, one offs.

* Business Partnering: Influences cross functional stakeholders (Ops, Procurement, Supply Planning, Logistics) and aligns decisions with P&L and cash goals.

* Communication: Concise, structured, and executive ready presentations; able to challenge constructively.

  
  

**Educational Background:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business or related quantitative field.

* Preferred: Master’s degree (MBA, Finance) or postgraduate in Controller/Corporate Finance.

* Experience: 2-3 years of progressive finance roles, with 3+ years in Supply Chain/Manufacturing/Logistics finance in a multinational environment (CPG/FMCG strongly preferred).

* Certifications (nice to have): CPA/ACCA/CMA; Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent continuous improvement credential.

* Advance English is mandatory.

  
**Technical Skills**

* Excel (Advanced/Expert):

* Complex formulas (INDEX/MATCH/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS), PivotTables, Power Query, array formulas, scenario/sensitivity analysis, what-if modelling, VBA/macros (nice to have).

* Automation & Analytics: • Power BI / Tableau (DAX, data modelling, building refreshable dashboards), Power Query, basic SQL for joins and data extraction.

* Familiarity with RPA (Power Automate/UIPath) and workflow digitization a plus.

  
  

**ERP & Finance Systems:**

* SAP (FI/CO/CO-PA) or Oracle; product costing, standard cost runs, variance analysis (PPV, yield, mix, utilization), inventory accounting, and intercompany flows.

* Consolidation/Planning tools: BPC/SAC, Anaplan, Hyperion/EPBCS (advantageous).

**Controls & Compliance:**

* Strong understanding of SOX/ICOFR, P2P/O2C processes, approval matrices, and audit requirements.

  
  

**What’s In It For You**

* Competitive Benefit Package

* Paid Company Holidays, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!

* Learning & Development Opportunities

* Employee Resource Groups

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

title: Specialist, Product Operations, Reference Data
description:
**Job Purpose**
The primary purpose of this position is to research, analyze, interpret, transform and present reference data for Equity and Funds securities across global markets, while supporting the Index team by providing reference data with precision. The focus of this position is to perform this work with documents written in English.
  
  
The incumbent must successfully complete a 8-to-12-week training program that centers on building enough subject matter expertise and the utilization of the database(s) of record such that the incumbent can independently analyze legal and financial documents associated with Equity and Fund securities . During training, the incumbent must master all of the subject matter and will be required to pass a series of quizzes and tests as well achieve the accuracy and timeliness metrics that were established for trainees.
  
  
The training curriculum for Data Analyst contains high level overviews of the complex structures worked on by more senior personnel as well as reference data client use cases so that the incumbent can differentiate between legal and financial language that is relevant to and required by our client base versus jargon describing information that is not required and, so that the incumbent can identify new financing techniques that come to market. The incumbent must then apply this foundation of knowledge via a logical sequence of decision-making events to determine relevancy of said information to our clients for any of their use cases and if deemed relevant, determine the appropriate next steps to ensure high client satisfaction levels.
  
  
The Equity and Funds asset class consists significantly large volumes of active securities and the reference data provided by ICE Data Services for said securities is used by our clients to make trading decisions, settle trades, make investment decisions, manage portfolios, analyze risk, create security master files, create client statements and conduct other back-office functions. Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within ICE and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

title: Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is seeking a highly analytical and customer-focused
**Customer Success Data Analyst**
to join the global Customer Success organization in India. This mid-senior individual contributor role will support the Reuters Connect and Reuters News Agency portfolio, helping customers realize measurable value from Reuters editorial content, data feeds, and media services.
  
  
The Customer Success Data Analyst will transform customer usage data, engagement signals, commercial information, and product health metrics into clear and actionable insights. This role goes beyond producing reports: it is responsible for identifying the story behind the data, diagnosing adoption and engagement challenges, surfacing commercial risks and opportunities, and enabling Customer Success and Sales teams to make informed retention and growth decisions.
  
  
Reporting to the Director of Customer & Sales Enablement, the successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Editorial, Product, Data, Sales Enablement, and Commercial Policy & Operations teams. The role requires strong critical thinking, advanced business intelligence and reporting skills, data-quality rigor, and the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to both internal stakeholders and clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and enhance customer health scoring methodologies across the Reuters portfolio, including defining metrics, developing models, and identifying early churn-risk indicators.
* Conduct in-depth analysis of individual accounts and customer segments to diagnose declining engagement, adoption gaps, underutilization, and commercial risk.
* Segment customers based on health, usage trends, engagement trajectory, commercial value, and expansion potential to support Customer Success and Sales prioritization.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, engagement, and commercial data to identify retention and growth opportunities.
* Develop and deliver reports, dashboards, scorecards, and insight-led narratives for Customer Success Managers, Sales teams, senior stakeholders, and clients.
* Translate customer data into clear and actionable recommendations that support renewals, retention, adoption, expansion, and customer value realization.
* Support Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, renewal discussions, and customer meetings with tailored data-driven insights.
* Help customers understand their content consumption and product-usage patterns and demonstrate the business value of Reuters products and services.
* Identify trends, anomalies, data patterns, and commercial signals while applying critical thinking to validate findings before presenting conclusions.
* Support customer feedback, Voice of Customer, and customer-sentiment analysis initiatives.
* Partner with the Data team to build, improve, and maintain scalable reporting and analytics infrastructure.
* Use Salesforce and related tools for reporting, dashboard development, data management, customer activity tracking, and commercial analysis.
* Ensure data quality across Customer Success reporting by identifying, investigating, and resolving inconsistencies in CRM, usage, engagement, and customer-record data.
* Collaborate with internal data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reporting data is accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Incorporate AI-enabled tools and automation into reporting and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and analytical depth.
* Work independently in a global, matrixed environment while managing multiple priorities, stakeholder requests, and reporting deadlines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, customer success analytics, sales operations, or a related field.
* Experience working in a SaaS, B2B, technology, media, data services, subscription, or customer-focused commercial environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex reporting, analysis, modeling, and presentation of findings.
* Strong hands-on experience using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and data-visualization platforms.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including report creation, dashboard development, data management, activity tracking, and CRM data analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, customer scorecards, analytical models, and recurring performance reporting.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking ability, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, validate data, and identify actionable findings.
* Experience analyzing customer engagement, product usage, customer adoption, retention, and commercial performance data.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues, investigate root causes, and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Proven ability to present complex data findings clearly and confidently to non-technical audiences, including external clients.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, planning, prioritization, organization, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently in a globally distributed and matrixed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing or improving customer health-scoring frameworks, engagement models, churn-risk models, or customer segmentation methodologies.
* Experience with Net Promoter Score, Voice of Customer, customer-feedback programs, or customer-sentiment analysis.
* Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data extraction, transformation, data cleansing, analysis, and reporting automation.
* Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, or similar customer-health and engagement tools.
* Experience supporting Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, client renewals, account planning, or commercial growth discussions.
* Understanding of the news, media, publishing, information services, financial information, or B2B content industry.
* Experience analyzing how customers consume editorial content, data feeds, media products, or subscription-based services.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools for analytics, reporting automation, data analysis, or workflow improvement.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to develop executive-ready and client-facing presentations.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Editorial, Data, and Commercial Operations teams.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.
  
  
The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Autonomously manage global primary market research (qualitative and quantitative) of all levels of complexity, incorporating diverse stakeholder perspectives to ensure organizational alignment and buy-in. Strength in applying advanced statistical analyses and leveraging business intelligence to support strategic, tactical and operational initiatives as well as planning and implementation of new and potential USP products and programs is essential.
* Steward projects to generate actionable and meaningful insights. Develop research plans to meet business needs, consult with internal business partners, establish and manage schedules, monitor progress, and compellingly communicate the results
* Acquire and manage market research vendors to ensure quality work is provided on-time, on-budget, and that it is reported with a suitable degree of professionalism
* Proactively serve as a thought partner with USP leadership. Participate in corporate planning and new product development processes to identify opportunities, address needs, and support the development of business and marketing plans
* Proactively bring external perspectives and insight into business planning for the organization, accomplished through:
* Monitor trends in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food and other related industries to assess their implications for USP business lines
* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Basic Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Preferred majors in market research, marketing, science, business, or related social science discipline.
* 7 or more years of experience in applying Market Research to solve broad strategic business problems.
* Strong business writing skills – evidence of succinct, distilled reports and attention to detail through thoroughness and accuracy
* Strong verbal and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to present statistical information to non-statistically oriented audiences
* Widespread knowledge of advanced primary market research methodology.
* Business acumen and strong analytical skills
* Advanced Intermediate skills with the following programs:
* MS Excel
* MS PowerPoint
* MS Word
* Online survey tools, bulletin boards and focus group platforms (Qualtrics preferred)
* Statistical software packages – R, SPSS, etc.
* Has the ability to navigate through ambiguity with courage and leadership.
* Must be self-motivated and customer-focused.
* Excellent time and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to concurrently prioritize multiple tasks with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Prior experience in global market research, pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food or related, regulated industries is highly desired.
* Experience working in a not-for-profit organization.
* Experience working in a scientific organization.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Sales & Marketing
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Financial Reporting & Controlling Analyst
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
  
  
You will be part of the IT/R&D and Functional Cost Controlling team, with a primary focus on creating reliable reports, enhancing reporting quality, and strengthening the overall cost-controlling process. This role is not designed as a direct stakeholder-management role; however, the role is expected to flag and escalate deviations, risks or data-quality issues to the Finance Partner when required. The position should be seen as the backbone of the R&D Cost Controlling process, ensuring accurate reporting, strong ownership, and timely support across month-close and planning cycles.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Financial Close & Controlling

+ Own monthly, quarterly and year-end close activities, including journal entries, accruals, provisions and prepayments.
+ Review cost-center results, analyze variances and escalate deviations or data-quality issues to the Finance Partner where required.
+ prior technical knowledge on capitalization especially on project accounting
+ Ensure accurate reporting in line with accounting standards, internal controls and company policies.
+ possess the ability to work with cross-functional and international teams
+ Support internal and external audits with clear, complete and audit-ready documentation.

Reporting, Analysis & Process Support
  
  

* Prepare budgets, forecasts, management reports and variance analysis against plan, forecast and prior periods.
* Track purchase order and invoice balances to monitor commitments and open items.
* Provide clear reporting insights and exception-based analysis to support the Finance Partner and business decision-making.

Process Improvement
  
  

* Drive standardization, simplification and automation of reporting, reconciliation and month-close processes.
* Enhance reporting efficiency through advanced Excel skills, Power BI support, data quality checks and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline.
* 3–4 years of relevant experience in Financial Controlling, Cost Controlling, FP&A, R2R or General Accounting.
* Hands-on experience in month-end close, journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
* Experience in an established multinational, Big 4, global shared services or leading listed-company environment is strongly preferred.
* Practical experience working with global teams and established MNC governance, controls and reporting timelines.
* Experience with financial planning and consolidation tools such as Jedox, Hyperion or equivalent is an advantage.

***Personal competencies***
Commanding knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, Power Query and large-data reconciliations.
  
  
Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Dynamics or equivalent; Power BI knowledge is an advantage.
  
  
Fluent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate clearly with international teams.
  
  
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, ownership and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.
  
  
Comfortable working independently in a complex, global and cross-functional environment.
  
  
Continuous-improvement mindset with high standards of accuracy, compliance and professional conduct.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.
  
  
*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*
