title: Masterdata Analyst I
description:
**Role Overview**
The Masterdata Analyst I owns the new product introduction path through master data: taking a product the business has decided to offer and turning it into a complete, correctly tiered, orderable set of records — base material, regional variants, identifiers, classification references, purchase information records and catalogue readiness — before the first requisition is raised against it. The role originates new material requests on behalf of the channel management function, holds the introduction open until every regional variant is live, and works the approval blockers that are the principal source of delay in the path.
  
  
Where Level I is measured on speed and accuracy against a high-volume queue, Level II is measured on judgement: whether a requested variant is genuinely new or a duplicate of an existing configuration, which tier and identifier rule applies to the asset class in question, which supplier price lines apply to which plants and countries, and when an introduction has stalled and needs escalating with evidence rather than reminders. The role also carries the Level I associates on the shift — reviewing their extraction and creation work, coaching on gating judgement, and taking the cases they should not decide alone.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* New Product Introduction — Origination, Tiering & Gating
* Raise new material requests on behalf of channel management, capturing the full attribute set: identifiers, standardised description, net and gross weights in kilograms where regionally mandated, classification references, unit valuation and supplier detail.
* Apply the correct material tier classification for new product introductions, which differs from the classification used for audio-visual requests — audio-visual assets retain the lower tier, and the carve-out is stated on the request rather than assumed.
* Verify the required identifier type per asset class before origination — manufacturer part number for hardware assets, universal product code for accessories.
* Check for an existing equivalent configuration before originating a new record, using part number, universal product code and technical specification, since a specification-level duplicate passes an identifier-only check and degrades financial reporting accuracy.
* Apply the mandatory validation gate for high-risk request types — hardware additions, managed-service-provider additions and special orders — and release nothing without the documented approval on the record.
* Decide whether a request should proceed at all, and reject or return incomplete or duplicative requests with the specific gap stated rather than completing them to clear the queue.
* Base & Variant Hierarchy and Regional Rollout
* Apply the parent-child model — establish the base material for the core product, then originate regional variant requests for localised configurations such as power plug types and keyboard layouts.
* Keep the parent request open until every regional variant has been created and closed, so a product is never part-released into a region that cannot fulfil it.
* Maintain the variant hierarchy over the product life, adding configurations as regions are enabled and retiring them as configurations are withdrawn.
* Confirm each new item is catalogue-ready before release: description standards met, worldwide availability enabled so the item is visible to every regional workforce, correct category and supercategory mapping, and complete specification content.
* Coordinate the regional rollout sequence with channel management, mobility operations and authorised inventory specialists so launch dates hold against known stock and enablement positions.
* Support product retirement and tier reclassification at end of sale, coordinating obsolescence timing with channel management and regional stock positions so dead inventory does not accumulate cost.
* Supplier Price Files & Purchase Information Records
* Run the weekly price verification cycle across the managed catalogue, comparing live catalogue pricing against current supplier price files and updating where pricing has moved.
* Process supplier price sheets into purchase information records, scrubbing line items for plants, countries and delivery locations that are not maintained, so only in-scope combinations load into the system.
* Validate unit costs, currency and region mappings before release, and escalate discrepancies to channel management and procurement rather than loading a price that will fail downstream.
* Contribute to the monthly pricing review against historical baselines, flagging anomalies before they reach the ordering storefront.
* Keep catalogue pricing reconciled with procurement and finance records, so invoice matching downstream does not break on price variance, and maintain evidence for every price change so disputes are resolved from the record.
* Track recurring pricing discrepancies to root cause with the supplier or channel owner instead of correcting the same line repeatedly. Pricing policy, rate governance and commercial approval remain with the pricing function; this role executes and evidences.
* Pipeline Progression, Defect Root Cause & Continuous Improvement
* Maintain forward visibility of the new product pipeline, so launches are planned against known dates rather than reconstructed from fragments.
* Work approval blockers on new material additions, and produce turnaround-time analysis showing where time is actually lost between hand-offs, then escalate with that evidence.
* Flag at-risk introductions early to the shift lead, naming the specific dependency that is slipping.
* Own the master-data defect queue for introduced products, raising catalogue and data errors with enough detail for root cause and working with Asset Lifecycle Management on the underlying fault rather than the symptom.
* Review a sampled share of Level I output, coach on supplier attribute extraction and gating judgement, and take the cases Level I should not decide alone.
* Identify automation candidates in the price-check, record-loading and variant-creation cycles, support scripted handling including threshold-based validation, and keep procedures current as catalogue administration migrates onto new platforms.

**PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS**
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
  
  

* New Product Onboarding: process ≥98% of complete introduction requests within the agreed onboarding window.
* Variant Completeness: 100% of parent requests closed only once every regional variant is live.
* Tier & Identifier Accuracy: 100% of new introductions released with the correct material tier and the correct identifier type for the asset class.
* Gating Integrity: 100% of high-risk request types validated and documented before release; zero duplicate material records originated.
* Price Verification Cycle: complete the weekly cycle across the managed catalogue on schedule, 100% of cycles.
* Pricing Accuracy: sustain ≥99% of catalogue price lines reconciled to the current supplier price file.
* Catalogue Readiness: 100% of released items with worldwide availability set and correct category mapping at go-live.
* Escalation Evidence: maintain current turnaround-time analysis for approval bottlenecks in the introduction path.
* Ticket Quality: sustain ≥95% against the weighted quality scorecard, which is weighted toward technical accuracy, then completeness, timeliness and communication.
* Customer Satisfaction: sustain ≥95% of responses rated Excellent or Good.

**TOOLS & SYSTEMS**

* Master Data & ERP: SAP Master Data Governance for material, manufacturer and reference record requests, and SAP Materials Management for purchase information records, price conditions and material master.
* Catalogue & Storefront: SAP Hybris for catalogue and storefront entries, taxonomy and availability flags, and IT service management platforms as catalogue administration migrates onto them.
* Supplier Inputs: supplier price files and quotations, manufacturer datasheets and specification sheets, and product compliance declarations.
* Ticketing & Tracking: enterprise ticketing and issue-tracking systems for request lifecycle, parent-child variant tracking and pipeline visibility.
* Analysis & Automation: advanced spreadsheet work, scripted automations for price-threshold checking, and BI reporting for cycle and bottleneck analysis.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Mandatory**

* 3–7+ years in master data management, catalogue management, product or pricing master data, procurement operations, or supplier-facing category support.
* Hands-on SAP experience with material master, purchase information records and price conditions, in a governed request-and-approval workflow.
* Demonstrated ownership of a new product introduction or item-onboarding path end to end, including parent-child or base-variant record structures.
* Demonstrated ownership of a recurring supplier price-file review cycle at volume, with responsibility for what loads and what is rejected.
* Ability to scrub, map and load large supplier data sets against plant, country and delivery scope without breaking existing dependencies.
* Judgement to distinguish a genuinely new configuration from a duplicate, and the willingness to return a request rather than complete it.
* Confident written and spoken English with suppliers, channel stakeholders and internal requesters.
* Willing and able to work a shift-based roster, including night shifts, from the Hyderabad delivery centre.

**Preferred**

* Storefront or e-commerce catalogue administration, including regional visibility rules and staged-to-live catalogue promotion.
* End-of-sale and end-of-purchase transition experience, including regional stock depletion.
* Exposure to trade classification data and cross-border documentation requirements.
* Experience reviewing or coaching junior analysts on data-quality and gating decisions.
* Spreadsheet automation or scripting applied to price-threshold and validation checks.
* Familiarity with IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow.

**About The Job**
Seeking dynamic and detail-oriented Sales Data Quality Analysts to join our team. Analysts will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of sales deal data, focusing on critical elements that impact business decisions and financial outcomes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to validate, maintain, and enhance the quality of sales data, thereby enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough data profiling and analysis to identify data anomalies, inconsistencies, and outliers.
* Execute comprehensive data quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of critical data elements including but not limited to conversion rates, new/renewal splits, incremental Annual Contract Value (ACV) / Total Contract Value (TCV), and deal spans.
* Develop and implement data cleansing and standardization processes to ensure consistency and accuracy across sales deal data.
* Validate the classification of new logos and account segments to ensure alignment with organizational criteria and strategies.
* Conduct thorough reviews of closed lost renewal deals to verify alignment with new business opportunities and prevent discrepancies in deal categorization.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of SPIF attributes and flags associated with sales deals.
* Perform validation checks on opportunity close dates and start dates to ensure timely renewal validation and compliance with contractual terms.
* Perform root cause analysis on data quality issues to identify underlying factors and implement preventive measures.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of data quality rules, processes, and issues.
* Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, IT) to understand data requirements, address data quality issues, and ensure alignment with business objectives.

**Good to have**

* Good to know SaaS Products and their different pricing models offered by companies such as One time cost, Pay-as-You-Go, subscription etc.,
* Knowledge on sales strategies such as Cross Sell, Upsell, Down sell, price uplift is required
* Experience with inventory management data, including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, deal registrations, licenses, contracts is desired
* Ability to understand Sales data flow from different systems to a unified database or CRM tool is a plus
* Working knowledge of identifying and automating manual, repetitive processes using Excel (advanced formulas, VBA), SQL, Power Query and other AI-powered tools, with experience in developing data validation, reconciliation, reporting, and dashboard solutions to enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and data governance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, sales operations, or related roles.
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar data analysis tools.
* Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems preferred.
* Basic understanding of sales processes and deal structures.
* Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.

* Serve as the key business partner working directly AWS senior management and other internal stakeholders to provide financial recommendations.

* Ability to communicate data clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.

* Develop ad hoc business analysis and present recommendations to AWS senior management.
* Monitor compliance with controls and systems and develop new processes to support the fast-growing, global AWS business.

A day in the life
  
  
This role will partner will multiple stakeholders including finance and business leadership to provide insight, analysis and financial leadership as we rapidly expand and evolve the AWS Data Center business. This role will provide extensive cross-functional opportunities to partner with teams. This role will drive how AWS thinks about strategic input drivers to continuously improve the economics of the business.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Asia-Pacific Data Center Finance team operates in a fast-paced environment where high judgment is essential to our success. We partner closely with business leaders to provide strategic financial guidance that shapes directly impacts AWS growth in the region. * 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience

* MBA, or CPA

title: Data Analyst II - Operations
description:
About Signant Health
  
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Data Analyst II works with Client Services staff to process data changes upon request. The Data Analyst II is also responsible for delivering data transfers when needed. The Data Analyst II shows high attention to detail to ensure that data updates they conduct, as well as data transfers they output and deliver to our clients, are of the utmost quality.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function
  
  

* Demonstrates extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work.
* Responsible for executing data changes per request, either through backend database scripts or with the use of validated in-house Data Solution Tools.
* Creates and executes Data Change Guides (DCGs) and determines corresponding risk/impact assessments.
* Creates DTS packages for imports into study databases.
* Writes and executes SQL queries against MS SQL Database to extract data for data transfers and reports.
* May be called upon to execute SAS queries against MS SQL Database to extract data for data transfers and reports.
* Delivers client-requested database transfer datasets upon request.
* Participates in meetings with appropriate Client Services and Technical Delivery team members as it relates to study implementation and maintenance.
* Follows Signant Health Standard Operating Procedures for data change management, data transfer verification, and risk/impact assessment documentation.
* Creates stored procedures to manipulate data for data-driven changes to IXR system functionality if needed.
* Monitors data collected across multiple databases when required.
* May be called upon to verify data change requests.
* May be called upon to verify content of client-requested database transfer datasets per approved Data Transfer specifications.
* Some data entry of data change requests may be required.
* Technical support after-hours, on-call time is required at set intervals.
* Participates in special data-related projects as needed.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* 2–4 years of experience working in a data-driven environment.
* In-depth working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), as well as Microsoft Windows and the suite of Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with standard data mining and data presentation techniques.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced work environment with minimal direct supervision.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to effectively document procedures, processes, and results.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, as interaction with team members occurs daily.
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
* Very strong skills with Microsoft Office applications.
* Comfortable working with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to create and execute SQL queries is required.

**Desirable:**  

* Familiarity with the C# programming language is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Visual Basic is a plus.
* Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 is a plus.

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  + Monitor and analyze incoming alerts from various systems, including access control, other alarms, and camera feeds.

  + Conduct initial analysis & day-to-day duties for the other member to conduct detailed investigation whenever required as per the duties assigned.
  + Execute procedures outlined for physical security incidents, emergency responses (e.g., fire, active threat), and breaches.
  + Initiate immediate verification and containment steps, such as reviewing live camera feeds, checking access logs, and remotely locking doors.
  + Escalate to GSOC and security management as per protocols.
  + Ensure all incident details, root causes, and corrective actions are meticulously documented.
* **Access Control & Badging:**

  + Manage procedures related to employee access, including outboarding, DNA (Do Not Allow Access) requests, and badge issuance for new hires, visitors, or replacements.
  + Verify employee identities and coordinate with HR to ensure proper access levels are granted or revoked.
  + Investigate and respond to unauthorized access attempts, lost/stolen badges, and tailgating incidents by reviewing camera footage and access logs.
* **Monitoring & Maintenance:**

  + Conduct daily health checks of security systems, including cameras and sensors, and log any issues for resolution by facilities or technical support via ticketing mechanism.
  + Respond to security incident calls and system-generated alerts for camera tampering, offline devices, or doors being forced open or left open for long.
  + Conduct yearly access privilege reviews in coordination with HR and local management to ensure compliance and revoke unnecessary permissions.
* **Escalation & Reporting:**

  + Follow predefined escalation paths, providing real-time alerts for critical incidents to the Security management and hourly summaries to local management during active events.
  + Generate and submit post-incident reports to all relevant stakeholders.
  + Prepare briefings for SOC management.
  + Shift reporting and handover/relay for the incoming shift team member.
  + MIS creation of incidents logged and resolved on a weekly/monthly basis.
  + Collaborate with the man-guarding team and other departments (e.g., HR, IT) to ensure a coordinated response to all security incidents.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* **Must Have:**

  + Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  + Ability to maintain high discipline, attention to detail and ethical standards.
  + A problem-solving attitude.
  + Ability to work as a team with other stakeholders as well as external security partners.
  + Exceptional English language communication and documentation, with the ability to write clear, concise, and actionable reports.
  + *Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 operations team.*
  + *Minimum 2 years’ experience.*
  + *Working experience in Security/IOT Technologies like: access control, CCTV/VMS, intrusion detection and/or alarm management platforms.*
  + *Relevant Graduate Degree in Engineering (Bachelors’) or Equivalent.*
* **Preferably:**

* Experienced in a security operations center (SOC) for the two positions.

  + Certified as a PSP (‘Physical Security Professional’ by ASIS).
  + Certified in compliance standards such as ISO 27001.
  + Qualified as an investigator.
  + Able to suggest improvements for effective implementation of procedures.
  + Able to work independently.
  + Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  + Able to handle multiple simultaneous incidents with a calm and decisive demeanor.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

Key Competencies & Behavioural Traits
  
  

* Self-Driven & Proactive: Strong sense of ownership with a desire to impact organizational success.

* Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and reduce manual reporting effort.

* Develop dashboards covering bookings, revenue, collections, inventory, lead generation, conversions, closures and other key business metrics.

* Work closely with Sales, Sourcing, Closing, Marketing, Finance, CRM and Projects teams to understand business requirements and reporting needs.
* Ensure accountability for accurate data submissions and timely updates across functions.
* Prepare management review presentations, variance analyses and action trackers.
* Align reporting across departments to provide leadership with a consistent view of business performance.

* Coordinate with IT teams and external vendors on automation, system integrations, access rights and enhancements.
* Document report logic, data sources, KPI definitions and standard operating procedures.
* Improve reporting turnaround time, analytical capabilities and adoption of reporting tools across the organisation.

* Lead and develop the MIS and analytics team, setting priorities, quality standards and performance expectations.
* Review and validate team output before circulating reports to senior management.
* Build analytical capabilities and promote fact-based decision-making across functions.
* Escalate material data discrepancies, business performance risks and reporting dependencies promptly.

* 12+ years of experience in MIS, business analytics, strategy, performance reporting or business intelligence.

* Proven experience in designing management dashboards, KPI frameworks and executive reporting across multiple functions or projects.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
* Familiarity with CRM, ERP and financial reporting systems.
* Experience leading teams, automating reporting processes and working with senior management.

title: Demand Planning Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Are you ready to join a high-performing Operations team and take ownership of demand decisions that shape business performance, influence senior colleagues, and ensure our products are available when it matters most?
  
  
Bring your planning and forecasting skills to be part of India’s growth journey – Use your excellent stakeholder skills to assure an optimal build up of India’s business plans, that are grounded in market realities while clearly articulating BU-specific assumptions across the planning horizon consolidating key inputs from sales and marketing to create plans.
  
  
*No relocation assistance is offered for this position*
**Core Responsibilities**

  
* Own the end-to-end Demand Plan for a part of the Business Unit, covering both Consumer Sales (CS – sales to consumers, based on retail sell-out data) and Selling-In (SI – sales to retail partners) at theme, customer group, and SKU level.
* Shape BU-level CS and SI decisions by balancing commercial ambitions with supply chain constraints, inventory health, and financial implications
* Define, challenge, and align demand assumptions with Sales and Brand Management, ensuring plans reflect commercial activities, product launches, and promotional strategies.
* Work with the sales and marketing teams to gain an understanding of past performance and reasons for deviations from expectations, as well as the drivers behind Forecasting KPIs.
* Work with the Business Intelligence team to understand drivers impacting consumer sales, including any changes to the category or country macroeconomic environment.
* Monitor and steer forecast performance (topline, theme, and item level), proactively identifying risks and adjusting plans to ensure strong in-stock levels while minimizing excess inventory and waste.
* Represent Demand Planning in key cross-functional forums, shaping plans for critical campaigns and driving alignment on priorities and trade-offs.
* Manage the Gap to Target process with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities to close gaps in Consumer Sales and Retail Inventory
* Build and continuously improve demand planning capabilities, including tools, analytics, and ways of working, driving digitalization, process and collaboration excellence.
* Understanding of different channels & their behaviour which support better planning & forecasting.

**Play your part in our team succeeding**
BU India is one of the fastest growing BUs in the LEGO group and is quite strategic to the growth of the APAC maket. The team provides the operational backbone for sales and marketing functions enabling business continuity covering planning, inventory, customer service and logistics.
  
  
As Demand Planning Manager, you will shape the BU demand plan, aligning Sales and Marketing into one clear, data-driven view that drives critical commercial and supply chain decisions. Your work ensures the business commits to the right volumes at the right time
  
  
**Do you have what it takes?**

  
* Bachelor’s Degree with MBA in Operations or Supply chain management from a Tier 1 institute is preferred
* Proven experience of 5 years or above owning and delivering demand planning, supply planning, or advanced analytics within a multinational FMCG, retail, or consumer goods organization.
* Strong understanding of S&OP processes and demand drivers, with the ability to translate Consumer Sales (CS), Selling-In (SI), and inventory dynamics into clear business decisions and outcomes.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity, prioritize effectively, and take accountability for sound business decisions in fast-paced and volatile environments.
* Strong collaborator management and executive presence; acts as a decisive sparring partner to Sales and Marketing, confidently influencing and constructively challenging decisions.
* Strong analytical and strategic capability; able to synthesize complex datasets, challenge assumptions, and own the development of robust, actionable demand plans.

**NICE TO HAVE**

  
* Result Orientation There is a high expectation to deliver an accurate and insight-based forecast built off an understanding of past performance and the ability to explain its impact on future planning assumptions.
* Collaboration To be effective in this role, you will need to proactively build a culture of collaboration with the Sales, Marketing and Business Intelligence teams where changes in planning assumptions are stress-tested through constructive discussions.
* Functional Expertise You will need to have a strong understanding of Sales and Operations Planning and Forecasting, as well as best practices to be able to drive the continuous improvement within the processes.
* Power BI Passion for data and digital tools advanced proficiency in Excel (including VBA and Power Query) and Power BI, with a focus on driving automation and enabling better decision-making.

description:

* 6+ years of relevant work experience
* Bachelors’ degree in related field (Finance, Accounting or Economics) from an accredited institution

* Strong communication skills will be important; ability to analyze and summarize complex information both verbally and in writing with colleagues in the United States/United Kingdom.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment; excited about working in a start-up environment with the backing and infrastructure of a well-established industry leader.

*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

title: Sr. Analyst – Materials Management
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As a Senior Analyst – Materials Management, you will use supply chain expertise, analytics, and problem-solving skills to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of inbound raw-material supply. You will partner with plants and cross-functional teams across the United States to identify risks, develop practical solutions, and improve material availability, inventory, cost, and service. This role offers the opportunity to influence a complex global supply network while working as an individual contributor in a collaborative virtual team. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Support OU-level performance improvement across OTD, DOS, VN, NPW, utilization, MDRs, lead-time compliance, and related supply-chain metrics.
* Partner with Consultant and ESC stakeholders and lead ESC plant calls from the ISA front to drive improvement in OTD, DOS, LE, LTL, and related metrics.
* Support TLC and critical analysis including warehouse space, inventory projection with freight cost, safety stock, min–max levels, load efficiency, and less-than-truckload (LTL) optimization, to identify cost and service improvement opportunities.
* Support disruption recovery and escalation management by expediting materials, coordinating alternate sources of supply and transportation, reviewing purchase order commitments, and tracking recovery actions through closure. Identify recurring MDR issues, recommend practical corrective actions, and support sustainable solutions to improve supply continuity and reduce repeat disruptions.
* Coach and support new team members through buddying, knowledge sharing, and process guidance as needed.
* Assist with escalation tracking, process-improvement initiatives, and the application of AI-enabled tools and insights to improve decision-making, generate cost improvement opportunities, and deliver measurable cost avoidance.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Full-time graduation from an accredited university.
* At least 6 years of related experience in supply chain, materials management, planning, procurement, logistics, or a comparable analytical function.
* Experience working with supply chain, inventory management, replenishment, and material-availability concepts.
* Experience using SAP Materials Management or a comparable enterprise resource-planning system.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including data manipulation, pivot tables, charts, and data analysis.
* Ability to gather, visualize, analyze, and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, prioritization, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines, navigate ambiguity, and influence stakeholders toward solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in operations, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
* Professional certification such as APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional or Six Sigma.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing plants or a complex, global supply network.
* Experience with material-disruption recovery, supply-risk assessment, network design, landed-cost analysis, or inventory optimization.
* Experience developing or manipulating SAP reports and creating advanced Excel analyses, including macros.
* Demonstrated continuous-improvement mindset and experience coaching or developing junior team members.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Manager : Business Intelligence & Reporting
description:
Bloom Energy faces an unprecedented opportunity to change the world and the way energy is generated and delivered. Our mission is to make clean, reliable energy affordable globally. Bloom’s Energy Server delivers highly reliable and resilient, always-on electric power that is clean, cost-effective, and ideal for micro grid applications. We are helping our customers power their operations without disruption and combustion.
  
  
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Senior Manager to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role would report to the Director of Service Business Intelligence and be based in Mumbai, India.
  
  
The Business Intelligence Senior Manager will lead and develop a team of developers, analysts and data architects to perform complex business analysis, build data analytics and automation into our service strategy. This will include tracking fleet performance, working with forecasting models, and development of automated planning for parts and maintenance. This position will also be responsible for enhanced analytics and visualization capabilities for Senior Level reporting requirements.
  
  
**Requirements:**

* 7–10 years in Business Intelligence, operational analytics, or data analytics
* Team leadership and analyst mentorship experience
* Experience in business analysis and data interpretation
* Experience with data warehousing technologies (such as AWS, GCP, Azure, SQL, NoSQL)
* Strong SQL and Python knowledge
* Good knowledge of statistics and identifying patterns and insights
* Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau or Amazon QuickSight
* Experience in energy or industrial equipment sectors is a plus
* Familiarity with SLAs, dispatch, CM/PM frameworks is a plus
* Exposure to Python/R or predictive modeling is a plus
* Excellent communication and presentation skills!

**Responsibilities:**

* Building and managing a high performing business intelligence team
* Leading the Service Business Intelligence execution of delivering reports, analysis and insights
* Prioritizing and managing analytics demands of internal and external teams
* Establishing best practices for dashboard design, data modeling, QA, and documentation
* Driving a culture of accuracy, speed, and continuous improvement
* Responsible for maintaining KPIs, performing analysis and developing and automating self-service reports and dashboards
* Responsible for working on complex business problems, scenario analysis, performance modeling, and presenting data-driven recommendations
* Solving challenging data and architectural problems using cutting edge technology to improve data pipelines with IT and Data Engineering teams
* Cross functional collaboration with multiple business and technical teams to support QBRs and strategic planning

**Graduate Education in:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Analytics, Computer / Data Science or equivalent; MBA a plus

**About Bloom Energy:**
At Bloom Energy, we support the move toward a 100% renewable future and our fuel-flexible technology offers one of the most resilient electricity solutions for a world facing unacceptable levels of power disruptions. Our resilient platform has proven itself by powering through hurricanes, earthquakes, forest fires, extreme heat and utility failures. Unlike backup generators, our fuel cells creates no harmful local air pollutants. At the same time, Bloom is at the forefront of the transition to renewable fuels like hydrogen and biogas with new hydrogen power generation and electrolyzer solutions. Our customers include but are not limited to; manufacturing, data centers, healthcare, retail, low-income housing, colleges, and more! For more information, visit www.bloomenergy.com.

title: Sustainability and Climate Data Product Associate

title: Manager, Business Process Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
The Business Process Improvement Analyst sits within the Enterprise Transformation Office. This role works under the direction of the Director of Process Transformation to engage with Service Lines or other functions across the business to diagnose root causes of pain points, understand and map current-state processes, define performance metrics and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations including; process redesign, automation AI-enabled solutions, and draft relevant requirements.
  
  
Engagements span the full range from targeted improvements within a single business team to larger, enterprise-wide initiatives. The analyst can engage across the firm, including Tax, Assurance, Advisory and Outsourced Services Service Lines, as well as other operational teams, wherever process improvement work is needed.
  
  
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support ETO business analysts & engage as directed with business unit stakeholders to identify pain points, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities through interviews, workshops, and process observation.
* Map & analyze current-state ("as-is") processes using ETO standard notation (swim lanes, SIPOC, value stream) and validate with process owners.
* Document data flows and system touchpoints as part of process mapping, particularly where they inform automation, integration, or AI-enabled recommendations.
* Design and support the implementation of process performance metrics and KPIs (leading and lagging indicators) to baseline performance and track the impact of improvements.
* Develop future-state ("to-be") process recommendations, including process redesign, automation, and AI/technology-enabled solutions.
* Translate discovery sessions and stakeholder input into structured requirements, process documentation, and decision-ready materials for the Director and business sponsors.
* Understand what’s needed to develop credible business cases for recommended changes, including effort, cost, and expected benefits, and work to gather relevant data/information as part of the initiative documentation.
* Contribute reusable process artifacts (templates, capability maps, documentation standards) to the Process Center of Excellence to promote consistency across projects and across the firm.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams by clearly articulating business requirements and validating that proposed solutions address the root problem.
* Track and report on the status of improvement initiatives, flagging risks and dependencies to the Director.
* Promote a continuous improvement mindset within partner business units.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Process maps and requirements are accurate, validated by stakeholders, and reused without rework.
* KPIs/metrics are in place and actively tracked within [60–90] days of engagement start.
* Improvement recommendations are adopted by business sponsors and show measurable impact against baseline.
* Documentation meets Process COE standards and is contributed back to the shared library.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in business process analysis, operations, consulting, or transformation roles, with demonstrated ownership of process work (not just support/documentation).
* Proven ability in writing business, data, & technical requirements and the development of wireframes to clearly articulate solutions
* Proven proficiency in process mapping (current- and future-state) - able to independently run mapping sessions and produce validated, accurate artifacts with minimal oversight.
* Confident engaging business unit stakeholders directly - able to ask the right questions, surface real pain points, and read between the lines of what's said versus what's actually broken.
* Demonstrated ability to recognize and shape improvement opportunities - not just document "as-is" state, but connect root causes to practical recommendations (process, tech, automation, or AI).
* Experience defining and standing up KPIs/metrics; familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, BPMN, or similar frameworks preferred.
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable working with process and operational data to identify root causes and quantify impact.
* Ability to manage time across multiple projects and escalate when help is required.
* Working knowledge of process/workflow tools (e.g., Visio, Miro) and data/reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to automation or AI-enabled process solutions (RPA, GenAI use cases, workflow tools).
* Process improvement certification (Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP, or equivalent).
* Experience in a shared services or enterprise transformation function.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax and business advisory firms in the U.S., with more than 5000 employees and over 450 partners across the country. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today, and position them for success tomorrow. * Comfort working with large data sets
* Working knowledge of SEBI and Exchange regulations
* Experience with Excel-based data analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, macros)
* Promoting IMC’s Compliance culture, awareness of regulatory developments, and best practices within the business.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills

* Ability to work both independently and in teams.

Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Product Owner
description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
  
  
The Product Owner partners closely with
**Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**
to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
**clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact**
in a complex, enterprise data environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership & Accountability**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

**Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**Governance, Quality & Standards**

* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:

+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.

**Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Product Owner is a
**critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model**
, ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
  

We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone.

You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on.

**What Your Work Looks Like-**

**You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution:**

* Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct.
* Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against.
* Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do.

**What Makes Someone Right for This-**

* 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs
* Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly
* Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition
* Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin
* Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case
* Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to
* SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language
* Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
  

* Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics)
* Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement.
* Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
* Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation.
* Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements.
* Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation.
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years
* Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc

Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Netrix Global is looking for a skilled
**Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics**
owns reporting and analytics for the Netrix Global Service Desk. This role transforms ServiceNow and contact center data into accurate, automated Power BI reporting that supports customer service reviews, SLA governance, and internal operational and financial decision-making. Working directly with customers and alongside Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, and service desk leadership, the Business Analyst ensures that the performance story Netrix tells its customers is timely, consistent, and backed by trusted data.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
*****Customer Service Desk Reporting*****

* Produce, automate, and deliver monthly customer service reports and Netrix template service review presentations, enabling Service Delivery Managers to share them with customers during the first week of each month.
* Report SLA attainment by priority for response and resolution, including tickets opened and closed, backlog, mean time to resolve, reopened rates, escalations, and major incident activity.
* Report customer experience results, including CSAT, NPS, survey response rates, and voice-of-customer themes.
* Report contact center performance metrics, including average speed of answer, average handle time, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, and channel mix across phone, email, portal, and chat.

* Incorporate customer outages, changes, and environmental factors into SLA commentary to ensure performance results are explained accurately.
* Develop trend analysis, identify top contact drivers, and provide improvement recommendations to support quarterly and executive business reviews.

*****Internal Operational and Financial Reporting*****

* Maintain daily operational reporting, including open and aging ticket reports, daily and month-to-date SLA status, and queue health.
* Provide volume and demand analytics by hour, day, and channel to support workforce management and staffing decisions across global follow-the-sun delivery centers.
* Deliver team and queue-level KPI reporting that supports service desk leadership, Quality Assurance, and Training.
* Produce internal financial reporting by customer, including revenue, cost of goods sold, and gross margin, while ensuring internal-only data is never included in customer-facing deliverables.
* Build leadership dashboards and executive summaries for service desk and Managed Services leadership reviews
* Establish reporting baselines and dashboards for new customers during service desk onboarding, transition, and hypercare.

*****Report Migration, Automation, and Modernization*****

* Analyze and redesign existing Excel, SQL, and legacy reports into scalable, automated Power BI solutions.
* Replace manual and semi-automated reporting workflows with automated datasets, dashboards, and scheduled distribution through Power BI Service and paginated reports.
* Standardize KPI definitions, data definitions, and report structures across all service desk customers.
* Optimize reports for performance, scalability, usability, and reduced turnaround time.

* Design and maintain data models using ServiceNow and contact center datasets from the consolidated SQL reporting environment.

* Validate, cleanse, and reconcile data to ensure reported figures are accurate and defensible before release.
* Implement row-level security and access controls so each customer and internal audience sees only authorized data.
* Follow data privacy, confidentiality, and governance requirements, including responsible handling of customer and employee data.

* Partner closely with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, service desk supervisors, Quality Assurance, Training, and workforce management.
* Gather, prioritize, and fulfill customer and internal reporting requests, translating business needs into clear and repeatable reporting solutions.
* Provide training and documentation to help service desk leaders and team members use Power BI and ServiceNow reporting effectively.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operational and customer reporting
* Experience supporting an IT service desk, managed service provider, contact center, or ITSM environment strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate preferred
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and ITIL Foundation preferred.
* Proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel (pivot tables, data validation, complex formulas). Python or R is a plus.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident, Request, Problem, and Change records, SLA definitions and task SLA data, customer surveys, and native ServiceNow reporting
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including Power BI Desktop and Service, data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), row level security, scheduled refresh, and paginated reports.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and professionally with customers during service reviews and other meetings
* Ability to explain data, trends, and SLA results in plain language to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Proven ability to partner with service delivery team members and build trusted working relationships across the organization.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualification**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Financial Systems Analyst
description:
The Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) is a finance function designed to bring together finance and accounting professionals to streamline and enhance processes and tools. Within FSS, the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune, India, provides centralized financial and analytical support across all Wolters Kluwer divisions. The team, comprising finance professionals and data scientists, focuses on finance reporting harmonization, technology enablement, and reporting and analytics enhancements.
  
  
In this role, you would support the Global Business Services (GBS) organization by supporting month end close activities, preparing monthly/quarterly financial reports, Resource labour planning, conducting variance & risk analyses, and assisting with budget and forecast planning. You would also collaborate with stakeholders to enhance financial processes and contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Education :**

* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or data analytics.
* Preferred: Master’s Degree/MBA in finance, accounting, economics, or data analytics.

**Experience :**

* Minimum: 2 years of experience in a finance, accounting, or consulting role.
* Preferred: 2 years of experience in a finance, accounting, or consulting role.

**Technical Skills :**

* Experience supporting Technology and Development organizations.
* Ability to meet tight deadlines and deliver quality results with data accuracy.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, and familiarity with HRIS (e.g., SAP, Workday).
* Excellent analytical skills and fluent in English.
* Proficient in MS Office and visualization tools like Power BI/Tableau.
* Familiarity with Hyperion/PBCS, Tagetik, Care20.
* Advanced analytical techniques, and familiarity with programming languages like SAS/R, Python.
* Proficiency in visualization tools and usage of Hyperion/PBCS.

**Soft Skills :**

* Self-motivated, self-managing and able to work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with diverse teams.

**Essential Duties**

* Ensure timely alignment of the management information system (PBCS) with Workday.
* Reconcile actual reporting and payroll data.
* Prepare clear data, reports, and presentations to share analytical results.
* Collaborate with the PMO team for reconciliation with the time writing tool.
* Implement a resource planning tool for insight into FTE’s availability and utilization.
* Manage financial controls for resource processes.
* Provide decision support, including data preparation, financial rule building, and report generation.
* Prepare forecast models based on past trends, vendor invoices, and volumes.
* Identify and articulate business unit opportunities to optimize performance by analyzing data and modeling trends.
* Represent Wolters Kluwer by maintaining comprehensive product and industry knowledge, and by building professional relationships.
* Coordinate with the accounting team to ensure accurate intercompany cost recharges.
* Create and manage cost centers, including establishing allocation methodologies.

**Other Duties**

* Act as a financial business partner, identifying business issues and opportunities proactively.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with geographically dispersed teams and communicate effectively with leadership at various levels.
* Provide effective reporting by accurately summarizing analyses for executive presentations.
* Support Business Unit Finance Teams in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) tasks.
* Manage and report on the annual budget, and provide regular updates through monthly and quarterly analyses.
* Conduct ad-hoc analyses as required.

**Travel Requirements**
Minimal travel might be required.
  
  
**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
Working from the Kalyani Nagar, Pune office on a hybrid schedule (Mondays and Tuesdays).

title: Investment Performance Analysis- Manager
description:
**State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, including investment servicing, investment management and investment research and trading. With $33.99 trillion in assets under custody and administration and $2.81 trillion\* in assets under management as of September 30, 2018, State Street operates in more than 100 geographic markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, Europe, the Middle East and Asia. For more information, visit State Street’s website at www.statestreet.com.**

**Key Responsibilities & Experience Range**

* Performance analysis and Attribution (i.e. absolute and relative portfolio performance to factors including security selection, asset allocation, currency, etc.)
* Reconcile and update portfolio/benchmark performance and validate, identify, investigate and resolve security level discrepancies at the transaction, position, and pricing level in Global Performance Measurement and Risk applications.
* Retrieve, validate and upload data from various source/vendor systems and upload to the department’s applications.
* Validate completeness and accuracy of data in department’s performance, risk, and analytics tools.
* The analyst must have strong communication skills and must be able to answer questions from other performance analysts, operations associates, portfolio managers and other users regarding the details of performance calculation process and auditing procedures.

**Supportive Responsibilities**

* Effectively communicate with Global Performance Measurement and Risk, Operations, and IT staff to resolve data issues and escalate problems to the appropriate groups.
* Collaborate with team members to develop, create and validate new performance analytical reports.
* Responsible for maintaining & creating a “best practice” process workflow environment in the team & in the designated projects.
* Must be able to independently “troubleshoot” functional and quantitative issues to ensure high quality report production. Must also be able to determine when problems & issues should be elevated to immediate manager.
* Collaborate with multiple departments across the firm to achieve firm wide goal of performance return centralization.
* Exceptional interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, required.
* Must be prepared to work flexible hours, potentially alongside US based colleagues for production and other issues that Require immediate escalation and/or resolution.
* Ability to remain calm during stressful periods like quarter end and work well under pressure.
* Active participation in various forums of the organization and providing valuable inputs time to time.

**Skills & Knowledge**

* Qualification & Certifications
* Postgraduate, preferably an MBA in Finance from a reputed institute.
* FRM/CFA/Financial industry related certification is an added advantage.
* Experienced candidate with 6 - 8-year post-graduation experience in any financial firm.
* Experience in Performance Measurement will be an added advantage.

**Primary Skills (Must Have)**

* Good understanding of Equity, Fixed Income and Derivative instruments.
* Knowledge of Investment Management industry.
* Knowledge of security analysis and portfolio management, stock exchange markets, financial markets, dividends, trading and settlements is required.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Basic MS office skills.
* Exposure to POINT/Yield book/Factset is an added advantage.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data flows, reports, and system integrations.
* Stay current with the latest developments in SAP analytics technologies and best practices.
* Collaborate with functional teams for issue resolution
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Work effectively within structured, process-driven environments

Deloitte’s SAP Service Line is among the world’s largest, with 8,000 global practitioners and over 1,700 SAP implementation projects completed. + Understanding and implementing ingestion to Data platform via extractors, CDS, SDI, SLT, ODP frameworks
+ Modelling in BW / Datasphere with different artifacts like ADSO, Composite Providers, Open ODS Views, Hybrid modelling, dataflows, transformational flows, graphical views, calculations views, script scripts/procedures, analytical models, etc.

+ Integrate CDS views with Fiori Elements, Analytical List Pages (ALP), KPIs, and Smart Business Cockpits
+ Techniques for performance optimization of Views, query performance and data load processes.

Familiarity with connecting and consuming data from SAP BW/Datasphere/S/4HANA and embedding SAC in Fiori or other business apps.
