title: Principal Central Monitor-India
description:
Centralized monitoring is an integral part of risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.
  
  
The Principal Central Monitor is responsible for leading the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses essential for centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock. The Principal Central Monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level.
  
  
More specifically, the Principal Central Monitor must:
  
  

* Lead effort on the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses within the area of specialty, including complex and collaborative approaches with other functions.
* Lead the development and setup of study-specific tools, analyses, and centralized monitoring plans, ensuring that the monitoring approach is aligned with study risks, critical data, and critical processes.
* Act as the strategic and technical lead for centralized monitoring across multiple studies and for function-wide initiatives, providing direction on complex analyses, resolving escalated issues, and establishing consistent approaches and standards.
* Assist in creating tools, techniques and processes for automating risk-based monitoring tasks (data integration automation, data retrieval automation, data mapping automation, and automated report generation).
* Act as mentor as well as train new team members and junior staff.
* Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site level and track evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
* Represent centralized monitoring in cross-functional study risk assessment meetings and provide expert guidance on identification, evaluation, prioritization, mitigation, and ongoing review of study risks.
* Provide input to leadership as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.

Employees may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in central statistical monitoring with an overall 10 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
* Excellent understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
* Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
* Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS etc.).
* Excellent computer skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
* Advanced level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
* Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and reviewing clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
* Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.
* Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
* Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
* Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
* Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
* Good understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
* Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
* Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
* Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems

The Global Product Analyst program is seeking a junior to mid-level analyst with some work experience to work in Pune as part of our global teams. Balancing multiple responsibilities requires the analyst to master a broad skill set, have a wide understanding of business development in asset management, and complete projects that are critical to the success of the group, department or firm. * Creativity and a marketing “sense” is a distinct plus

title: Data Engineer 1
description:
**Job Summary**
Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
  
  
**Competencies**
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
  
  
Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.
  
  
Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:
  
  

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
* Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
* Exposure to Agile software development
* Exposure to building analytical solutions
* Exposure to IoT technology

**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**

* Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers. 3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.
  
  
**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies. 2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products. 3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability. 4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders. 5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products. 2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

**This is a hands-on core development role, not an application or production support role.**
The developer will independently design, build, test, and deploy AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView regulatory reporting solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, and maintain solutions using current AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView releases, including data sources, data models, portfolios, aggregations, shorthand logic, business rules, workflows, and Free Form and Tabular Reports.
* Translate regulatory, functional, and data requirements into technical designs, mappings, calculations, validations, and reporting workflows.
* Develop and optimize SQL and PL/SQL, ETL processes, and Unix/Linux shell scripts used to source, transform, reconcile, and deliver regulatory data.
* Perform source-to-report data analysis, reconciliation, drill-down validation, and root-cause analysis for data-quality and reporting discrepancies.
* Build solutions with traceability, lineage, auditability, maker-checker controls, and evidence required for governance, internal audit, and regulatory review.
* Prepare technical specifications, data mappings, deployment instructions, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Create and execute unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end test cases; support user acceptance testing and maintain evidence of results.
* Manage ControllerView object migration, release onboarding, environment promotion, scheduling, and production deployment in accordance with SDLC and change-management controls.
* Resolve defects in developer-owned solutions and provide limited post-deployment stabilization; routine monitoring and ticket-based support are out of scope.
* Collaborate with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, data providers, infrastructure teams, auditors, and vendor support to deliver accurate and timely reporting.
* Participate in Agile delivery, peer reviews, estimation, backlog refinement, and continuous improvement of development and operational practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–8 years of software development experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on AxiomSL / Adenza ControllerView development in a banking or financial-services environment.
* Proven hands-on experience independently designing and developing end-to-end ControllerView solutions; support-only experience does not meet this requirement.
* Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including complex data analysis, reconciliation, query optimization, and database performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with ETL concepts, enterprise data warehouses, Unix/Linux, shell scripting, and enterprise job schedulers such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Working knowledge of regulatory reporting controls, data lineage, data quality, governance, and production support practices.
* Experience delivering regulatory reports in one or more jurisdictions, such as U.S. Federal Reserve and FFIEC reporting, Basel III/IV, EMEA COREP/FINREP, or APAC regulatory reporting.
* Ability to read business and functional requirements, challenge gaps, and independently develop a technically sound solution aligned with architecture and coding standards.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Controller View 10 or 11, including enhanced import/export, reporting, workflow configuration, lineage and dependency tracking, troubleshooting, and release maintenance.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code-quality controls, and DevOps release practices.
* Experience with regulatory change delivery, platform upgrades, taxonomy updates, remediation programs, or modernization of legacy reporting processes.
* Knowledge of capital, liquidity, counterparty credit risk, financial reporting, or trade and transaction reporting.

**Success Competencies**

* End-to-end ownership of design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while communicating risks, decisions, and dependencies early.
* Attention to detail and a control-focused mindset appropriate for regulatory reporting.
* Ability to explain complex data and technical issues clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics
description:
**About The Opportunity**
-------------------------

Netrix Global is looking for a skilled **Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics** owns reporting and analytics for the Netrix Global Service Desk. This role transforms ServiceNow and contact center data into accurate, automated Power BI reporting that supports customer service reviews, SLA governance, and internal operational and financial decision-making. Working directly with customers and alongside Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, and service desk leadership, the Business Analyst ensures that the performance story Netrix tells its customers is timely, consistent, and backed by trusted data.

**How You Will Make An Impact**
-------------------------------

***Customer Service Desk Reporting***

* Produce, automate, and deliver monthly customer service reports and Netrix template service review presentations, enabling Service Delivery Managers to share them with customers during the first week of each month.
* Report SLA attainment by priority for response and resolution, including tickets opened and closed, backlog, mean time to resolve, reopened rates, escalations, and major incident activity.
* Report customer experience results, including CSAT, NPS, survey response rates, and voice-of-customer themes.
* Report contact center performance metrics, including average speed of answer, average handle time, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, and channel mix across phone, email, portal, and chat.
* Configure customer-specific views that reflect SLA targets, priority matrices, and scope defined in each customer's statement of work.
* Incorporate customer outages, changes, and environmental factors into SLA commentary to ensure performance results are explained accurately.
* Develop trend analysis, identify top contact drivers, and provide improvement recommendations to support quarterly and executive business reviews.

***Internal Operational and Financial Reporting***

* Maintain daily operational reporting, including open and aging ticket reports, daily and month-to-date SLA status, and queue health.
* Provide volume and demand analytics by hour, day, and channel to support workforce management and staffing decisions across global follow-the-sun delivery centers.
* Deliver team and queue-level KPI reporting that supports service desk leadership, Quality Assurance, and Training.
* Produce internal financial reporting by customer, including revenue, cost of goods sold, and gross margin, while ensuring internal-only data is never included in customer-facing deliverables.
* Build leadership dashboards and executive summaries for service desk and Managed Services leadership reviews
* Establish reporting baselines and dashboards for new customers during service desk onboarding, transition, and hypercare.

***Report Migration, Automation, and Modernization***

* Analyze and redesign existing Excel, SQL, and legacy reports into scalable, automated Power BI solutions.
* Replace manual and semi-automated reporting workflows with automated datasets, dashboards, and scheduled distribution through Power BI Service and paginated reports.
* Standardize KPI definitions, data definitions, and report structures across all service desk customers.
* Optimize reports for performance, scalability, usability, and reduced turnaround time.

***Data Modeling, Quality, and Governance***

* Design and maintain data models using ServiceNow and contact center datasets from the consolidated SQL reporting environment.
* Perform data transformation using Power Query (M) and write efficient DAX measures.
* Validate, cleanse, and reconcile data to ensure reported figures are accurate and defensible before release.
* Implement row-level security and access controls so each customer and internal audience sees only authorized data.
* Follow data privacy, confidentiality, and governance requirements, including responsible handling of customer and employee data.
* Maintain documentation for data sources, KPI definitions, report logic, and refresh schedules.

***Customer Engagement and Delivery Partnership***

* Attend and present in customer meetings alongside Service Delivery Managers and leadership, walking customers through metrics, trends, and SLA results and answering questions with confidence.
* Partner closely with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, service desk supervisors, Quality Assurance, Training, and workforce management.
* Gather, prioritize, and fulfill customer and internal reporting requests, translating business needs into clear and repeatable reporting solutions.
* Provide training and documentation to help service desk leaders and team members use Power BI and ServiceNow reporting effectively.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**
------------------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operational and customer reporting
* Experience supporting an IT service desk, managed service provider, contact center, or ITSM environment strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate preferred
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and ITIL Foundation preferred.
* Proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel (pivot tables, data validation, complex formulas). Python or R is a plus.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident, Request, Problem, and Change records, SLA definitions and task SLA data, customer surveys, and native ServiceNow reporting
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including Power BI Desktop and Service, data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), row level security, scheduled refresh, and paginated reports.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and professionally with customers during service reviews and other meetings
* Ability to explain data, trends, and SLA results in plain language to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Proven ability to partner with service delivery team members and build trusted working relationships across the organization.
* Operates independently with minimal supervision, managing competing customer and internal reporting priorities against firm monthly deadlines.

**Shift Timing - 1:00 PM - 11 PM IST**

**About Us**
------------

At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today's most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country's top system integrators.
  
At Netrix, we're driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

To learn more about Netrix Global please go to www.netrixglobal.com (http://www.netrixglobal.com/)

description:
**Company Description**

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description**

The purpose of the role “Product Support Analyst” is to provide functional Level 2 support to global customers for the application through different channels. The role will be responsible for issue analysis, coordination with internal cross-functional teams, testing, data validation, client communication, SLA adherence, and continuous process improvement.

The Product Support Analyst will also be expected to leverage AI and Generative AI tools responsibly and effectively to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, process efficiency, and overall quality of deliverables.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This role is focused on managing Level 2 support of the Product.
* Perform the first level of analysis after an issue or change is reported by the client and coordinate with internal cross-functional teams to drive resolution.
* Perform testing after bug fixes or changes in UAT/Pre-Production environments before Production deployment and/or client sign-off.
* Conduct smoke testing and sanity checks in Production environments.
* Continuously follow up with cross-functional teams to ensure tasks and bug fixes are completed within predefined SLAs.
* Act as an effective communicator and coordinator between internal teams and clients to ensure timely resolution and closure of issues.
* Interact directly with global clients through calls, emails, chats, and other communication channels.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs and drive timely closure of client requests, incidents, changes, and ad hoc requests.
* Perform data loads through ETL procedures and validate data accuracy and completeness.
* Analyze data, identify issues or trends, and support troubleshooting and resolution activities.
* Develop, document, and continuously improve business and support processes.
* Maintain a high standard of quality across all deliverables and client interactions.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve support processes, efficiency, quality, and customer experience.
* Strive to generate strong customer satisfaction scores through effective communication, ownership, and timely resolution.

**AI & GENERATIVE AI PROFICIENCY:**

The candidate should be proficient in the responsible use of AI, Generative AI, and Large Language Model (LLM) tools to improve the speed, quality, accuracy, and efficiency of project and support-related work.

This includes the ability to:

* Use AI/LLM tools for research, self-learning, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and understanding functional or business requirements.
* Use AI tools to assist in creating, editing, reviewing, and improving deliverables such as support documentation, incident summaries, root cause analysis documents, test scenarios, test scripts, test data, process documentation, status reports, client communications, and project assessments.
* Apply effective prompting techniques to obtain relevant and useful outputs while independently validating the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.
* Demonstrate sound judgment regarding what AI-generated content can be trusted, edited, escalated, or rejected.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and alignment with business and organizational standards.

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Principal Analyst, BI Service Delivery
description:

This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.
  
  
This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.

Analyst

**About Airtel Finance**

Airtel is building one of India’s most ambitious consumer financial services franchises under the Airtel Finance brand. Airtel already reaches hundreds of millions of customers across the country; the task now is to turn that reach into a financial relationship spanning a customer’s whole financial life across save, pay, borrow, invest and insure use cases. **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously monitor the product funnels across the app and assisted channels, from journey start to KYC completion, account activation and repeat transactions.

* 1–3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Growth Analytics or a related role.
* Strong problem-solving ability and hypothesis-driven thinking.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Proficiency in Excel, Tableau, Mongo, Kibana and other data visualisation tools.
* Working knowledge of experimentation and A/B testing.
* Experience in fintech, banking, digital payments or consumer internet products preferred.
* Ability to translate data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

**What We Offer**

* Scale from day one: products used by millions of customers across India.
* A seat inside a cross-functional POD, with analysis that directly drives product decisions.
* Close proximity to senior leadership, with real influence over the product agenda.

title: Associate Manager, Data Delivery & Dashboard
description:
**Job Description**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of complex data outputs for our healthcare market research projects. The team is responsible for conducting comprehensive quality checks on large datasets, transforming and standardising data files to meet project and client requirements, and managing delivery through automated and off-the-shelf dashboard solutions. By combining technical precision with a client-focused approach, the team enables timely, insightful, and accessible data visualisation that supports strategic decision-making across our global research initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team Lead role will report into the Sr Manager. The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team lead will be a key member of the India-based Data Management & Delivery Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets for STEM. As a Dashboard Developer Team lead, you build and maintain high impact dashboards and data visualizations that transform raw market research data into actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with researchers, analysts, and engineers to ensure data flows seamlessly from collections to visual storytelling. You will also support the team in delivering insightful, user-friendly dashboards through automated tools and off-the-shelf solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in data management, quality assurance, and data visualisation, while working alongside an experienced team in a dynamic, global environment. Skill Set required
  
  
**STEM Dashboard Discovery Phase**
One of primary responsibilities would be to streamline the overall data collection process and create dashboards
  
  
**Brand Equity tracking support with our in-house platform:**

* Maintain the pipeline for the project data process flow (this includes receival of data into in-hosue Tool, through the data processing stage into the storage mart, through the python utilities into required outputs)
* Maintain and update Power BI Dashboard when required due to changes from the research team
* Manage and rectify when failures occur in the dashboard, liaising with both the data providers, research team and developers on the Pipeline
* Manage the storage mart and data warehouse
* Support team with edits in-house platform

**Data Quality Checks:**
Assist in performing detailed quality control checks on large and complex datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  
  
**Data Transformation & Standardisation:**
Support the transformation and standardisation of data files to align with internal data structures, project needs, and client-specific formats.
  
  
**Dashboard Support & Maintenance:**
Lead in the creation, population, and maintenance of dashboards using off-the-shelf tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms), ensuring outputs are clear, accurate, and aligned with research objectives.
  
  
**Data Delivery Management:**
Manage and organise the final delivery of data files and dashboards to internal teams and clients, ensuring timely and error-free execution.
  
  
**Collaboration Across Teams:**
Work closely with internal stakeholders including Development team, Data Processing, Scripting, Project Management and Research teams to ensure smooth handovers and integration of deliverables.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting:**
Maintain clear documentation of processes, data transformation steps, and QC logs to support transparency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness.
  
  
**Continuous Learning & Development:**
Engage in training opportunities to build knowledge in healthcare data, market research workflows, dashboarding tools, and data handling best practices.
  
  
**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**
**Technical Expertise**

* At least 6+ years expertise in Power BI, Power query , DAX, data modeling, Quality assurance, SQL
* Experience in Building interactive, user-friendly dashboards
* Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, etc.)
* Understanding and building of ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Expert level Knowledge of Python
* Proficient in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Cloud platform expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP), and building ETL/ELT pipelines is a plus
* Experience in version control system.

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
We love what we do and continuously strive for innovation and creativity. We believe everyone should continuously be learning and provide:
  
  

* A comprehensive training and development programme for all staff, from entry level apprentice to senior management
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration
* A relaxed and friendly working environment

**About Inizio Advisory:**
Research Partnership is part of Inizio Advisory, a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring

**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1

Who You'll Work With

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.

Management program by helping embed responsible sourcing practices and supplier due diligence
  
into our procurement processes. Working as part of the ESG Supplier Risk team, you will

compliance efforts, and responses to ESG reporting requests from clients and internal
  
stakeholders.

Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, and

generate meaningful insights.

compliance is preferred.  

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with procurement, reporting, or supplier

risk management platforms is a plus.  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively

across global, cross-functional teams.  

* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple

priorities while delivering high-quality work.  

* A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning and process

improvement

As an EP&P Senior Analyst, Supplier Risk, you will sit within BCG's Procurement function and
  
report directly to BCG's ESG & Diversity Supplier Risk Director.
  
You will collaborate closely with key participants within the Procurement team, particularly the
  
Third Party and the Data Analytics team, to ensure seamless integration and alignment with
  
BCG’s procurement strategies. Additionally, you will interact with other functions including
  
compliance, legal, and sustainability teams to ensure a comprehensive approach to ESG risk
  
management, and partner extensively with teams in our local geographies to support local
  
regulatory requirements.

Additional info

YOU’RE GOOD AT  

* Data analysis and attention to detail – You are comfortable working with large datasets to

identify trends, validate information, and generate insights that support ESG supplier risk
  
management and reporting.
  

* Supplier due diligence and risk support – You can support supplier ESG due diligence

activities by coordinating information, tracking progress, and maintaining accurate
  
documentation.
  

* Cross-functional collaboration – You build effective working relationships and collaborate

with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Sustainability, and regional teams to deliver shared

* Organization and execution – You manage multiple priorities, maintain high-quality

documentation, and deliver work accurately and on time in a fast-paced, global
  
environment.
  

* Process improvement – You look for opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of

working, and support the adoption of new tools and technologies.
  

* Communication – You communicate clearly and confidently, preparing reports,

documentation, and presentations while supporting responses to client and internal ESG
  
reporting requests.
  

* Learning agility – You are curious, adaptable, and eager to develop your knowledge of ESG

regulations, supplier risk management, and responsible sourcing practices.

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce professional to design and deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly solutions for complex business requirements. In this role, you will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to translate requirements into effective declarative solutions across the Salesforce platform.

You will take ownership of advanced automation, security, and configuration while helping improve platform standards and reduce technical debt. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing the long-term evolution of a Salesforce environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement complex declarative solutions across multiple Salesforce objects and business processes.
* Build and maintain advanced Salesforce Flow orchestrations and reusable automation frameworks.
* Configure sophisticated sharing and security models, including organization-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing rules, permission sets, and access controls.
* Maintain clear traceability between business requirements, solution designs, and platform configurations.
* Create and maintain solution design documents and other technical documentation.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving configurations, automations, data access, and user permissions.
* Support user acceptance testing, release planning, deployment readiness, and post-release validation.
* Conduct peer reviews of configuration and automation changes to promote quality and adherence to platform standards.
* Identify opportunities to simplify solutions, standardize processes, improve maintainability, and reduce technical debt.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, architects, administrators, and testing teams.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or another relevant field.
* Five to seven years of hands-on Salesforce configuration and implementation experience.
* Current Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
* Strong expertise in Salesforce Flow, security model design, sharing architecture, and complex business-process configuration.
* Experience delivering declarative solutions across multiple objects and integrated business processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Grid Research Associate
description:
**Department:**
Research

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Description**
**About the role:**
Aurora is seeking an Associate to join our India Grid Research team in Gurugram. This is a quantitative and client-facing role at the intersection of power systems, electricity markets and investment analysis.
  
  
You will play a central role in the continued rollout and development of Aurora’s India Grid product, helping developers, investors and lenders understand how transmission build-out, grid congestion, connectivity and curtailment affect renewable projects and investment decisions.
  
  
You will take ownership of analytical workstreams and the delivery of Grid coverage across individual Indian states and regions. This will include analysing transmission infrastructure and connection queues, developing and quality-assuring forward-looking grid and curtailment analysis, and translating complex technical outputs into clear commercial insights.
  
  
We are looking for someone who combines four core strengths:

* **Engineering and grid understanding**
  – a strong understanding of power systems, transmission networks and the physical drivers of congestion and curtailment.
* **Quantitative modelling**
  – the ability to work confidently with complex datasets and modelling frameworks to develop robust forward-looking analysis.
* **Market understanding**
  – an understanding of how generation, demand, storage, transmission and electricity-market dynamics interact, and what these changes mean commercially.
* **Communication**
  – the ability to turn sophisticated technical analysis into clear, compelling insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will work closely with Aurora’s India Research, Grid modelling and Software teams and have the opportunity to develop deep expertise in India’s rapidly evolving power system.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the rollout and ongoing development of Aurora’s Grid analysis across new and/or existing Indian regions, taking responsibility for analytical delivery, quality assurance and ongoing updates.
* Analyse India’s transmission system, including network build-out, connectivity queues, transmission constraints, project commissioning timelines and grid headroom.
* Develop and quality-assure quantitative analysis of congestion and renewable curtailment, assessing how these evolve as generation, storage, demand and transmission capacity change.
* Work closely with Aurora’s Modelling team to translate engineering, power-system and electricity-market assumptions into robust forward-looking analysis.
* Combine grid modelling with electricity-market fundamentals to understand the commercial implications of transmission constraints and curtailment for renewable and storage assets.
* Analyse large and complex datasets using tools such as Python, SQL and Excel, improving analytical processes and identifying opportunities for automation.
* Translate complex modelling results into clear, commercially relevant conclusions, explaining what is happening, why it is happening and what it means for developers, investors and lenders.
* Communicate Aurora’s analysis confidently through client meetings, subscriber calls, webinars, reports and presentations, adapting technical detail to different audiences.
* Work collaboratively across Research, Modelling and Software teams, clearly communicating assumptions, analytical issues and development priorities.
* Support and review the work of Analysts and interns contributing to infrastructure tracking, data collection and validation.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:**

* 3-5 years relevant professional experience in power systems, electricity markets, transmission, renewable energy, energy modelling or energy consulting.
* A strong university degree, ideally in electrical engineering, power systems, energy systems, economics, mathematics, physics or another quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of power systems and grid fundamentals, including the interaction between generation, demand, transmission and system constraints.
* Strong quantitative and modelling capability, with experience working with complex datasets, models and analytical outputs. Experience using Python, SQL, advanced Excel or power-system modelling software.
* Good understanding of electricity-market fundamentals, with the ability to connect physical grid developments with their implications for renewable and storage projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical analysis into clear, concise and commercially relevant insights.
* Confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to structure a clear analytical argument, identify the key drivers behind modelling results and communicate the “so what”, rather than simply reporting outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own complex analytical workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs to deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality and robust quality assurance.
* Self-starting, intellectually curious and comfortable working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Desirable attributes:**

* Familiarity with the Indian power sector, including renewable development, transmission infrastructure and electricity-market arrangements.
* Experience working for a transmission or network organisation, renewable developer, power-market consultancy, utility, system operator, IPP or energy analytics firm.
* Understanding of the commercial considerations facing renewable developers, IPPs, lenders and infrastructure investors.
* Experience working with commercial power system software (PSS/E, Powerworld, etc) and/or doing grid connection studies
* Experience analyzing renewable project connectivity and transmission expansion.
* Experience communicating complex quantitative analysis through client presentations, reports, workshops, webinars or other external-facing formats.
* Master’s degree or PhD in electrical engineering, power systems, energy systems or a related quantitative field.

**What we offer**
Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.
  
  
Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

title: Statistician
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Research & Development
  
  
In Research and Development, we're full of highly skilled talents that include Scientists, Engineers, Medical, Clinical and Regulatory professionals - all working to create a cleaner, healthier world. With nine Centres of Excellence, we continually seek out new opportunities by using science, our entrepreneurial flare and our fearless innovation to develop and enhance our existing portfolio, never compromising on quality or performance.
  
  
We do the right thing, always, by ensuring we act with responsibility and integrity, by complying with regulatory legislation across the globe, whilst ensuring our products are safe for our consumers and are to the highest quality.
  
  
The size of our organisation means you'll have the opportunity to learn and work in different functions within R&D, giving you exposure to different disciplines, teams and environments. You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Reckitt, we're looking for an insightful Senior Associate in Category Medical Affairs to join our innovative R & D team. You're not just providing scientific support; you're shaping the future of consumer wellbeing with every project you touch. With your expertise, you'll ensure our products are not only effective but backed by sound science and regulatory compliance. If you're ready to take on a role where your strategic thinking and eye for detail will lead to real-world impact, then we are excited to meet you.
  
  
Role/ Purpose
  
  

* To provide expert statistical input across the portfolio of work for EG&CR including but not limited to evidence brief, protocol, SAP, topline and CSR using consumer insights to meet business needs
* To select and work efficiently and effectively with outsourcing partners ensuring high quality deliver on time to agreed costs
* To provide data generation know how across the business as required

Scope of Role
  
  

* Provide execution of analysis based on primary and secondary use data across the portfolio, supporting the Manager of Statistics

Your responsibilities
  
  
Serve as a leading figure within the Medical Sciences team, actively contributing to our cross-functional project successes.
  
  

* Balance commercial insights with scientific rigour to drive the business forward while upholding compliance.
* Establish key external partnerships that reinforce our category initiatives and help navigate product classification strategies.
* Interpret data thoughtfully to provide meaningful insights, encouraging innovative solutions that resonate with our consumers.
* Guide our claim development and defence, setting the bar high for industry standards.
* Embody change leadership and champion continuous improvement across medical affairs to enhance our practises.

Accountabilities
  
  

* The role is responsible for individual excellence in a team setting to design and deliver the innovation portfolio as well as develop sound statistical thinking in the wider Reckitt medical team and beyond.

Key Challenges
  
  

* Provide expert statistical input to the portfolio of work ensuring scientifically robust evidence generation activities are integrated into the project (e.g. innovative approaches such as methods, models and techniques to achieve claims and end points).
* Deliver key evidence supporting product claims and registration.
* Collaborate and integrate expertise from EG&CR and Medical Affairs to incorporate clinical endpoints, comparators etc
* Assist in efforts to identify, integrate, and/or develop valid clinical outcome assessments (PRO/COA) measurements for use in clinical programs.

OVERSIGHT
  
  
Compliance and adherence to SOPs:
  
  

* Compliance with necessary regulations for quality and disclosure.
* Input into and ownership of relevant standard operating procedures.
* Ensure best practices and consistency within the team.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Skilled at interpreting scientific and clinical data, with a knack for detail-oriented document preparation.
* Adept at developing strategic partnerships and engaging with industry bodies.
* Forward-thinking in compliance and regulation, with a strong understanding of its business impact.
* Capable of managing relationships and leading through change, with an eye on consumer insights and creative direction.
* Open to adopting new technologies and challenging the conventional to foster improvement.

Professional Qualification/Experience
  
  

* BSc in a numerate degree and experience in a clinical trial setting
* MSc in a statistical/numerate degree with good knowledge of medical statistics.

The skills for success
  
  
Task Execution Under Pressure, Makes strategic Business Decisions, Business accumen, Commercial Awareness, Objective Setting, Accountability, Consumer Insight, Creative Direction, R&D, Change Leadership, Product Lifecycle Management, Intellectual Property, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Relationship Management, Adapt to changes in technological development plans, Ability to challenge the status quo and propose improvement, Innovation Processes, Digital transformation for R&D, Quality and Manufacturing.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.
