title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
**Role purpose:-**

The Anaplan Model Builder will design, build, test, deploy and support scalable Anaplan solutions across Finance and the wider business. Reporting to the Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan), the role will translate business requirements into robust models, workflows, dashboards and data structures, while supporting effective platform operation and continuous improvement.

The role will support Anaplan use cases spanning corporate planning, budgeting and forecasting, client and product profitability, cash flow and liquidity forecasting, funding forecasts, management reporting and scenario analysis.

**Key responsibilities:-**

* **Model design and build:**
  Develop modules, lists, hierarchies, calculations, dashboards and user experiences using scalable, maintainable design principles.
* **Requirements and solution design:**
  Work with Finance and business stakeholders to translate planning and reporting needs into functional requirements, model designs, business rules and acceptance criteria.
* **Data and integration:**
  Build and maintain imports, exports, actions and processes; define source-data requirements; validate and reconcile data; investigate load failures with Technology and data teams.
* **Testing and quality:**
  Complete unit testing and support system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing. Reconcile outputs, resolve defects and retain appropriate evidence.
* **Release and change management:**
  Prepare model changes, impact assessments, release documentation and deployment instructions within the agreed environment and governance framework.
* **Platform support:**
  Provide hands-on support for live models, recurring planning cycles, incidents, data issues and performance problems. Maintain and optimise models and identify technical debt.
* **Controls and governance:**
  Maintain roles, selective access, validation controls, documentation, data dictionaries and calculation definitions. Follow access, segregation-of-duties and audit requirements.
* **Adoption and knowledge transfer:**
  Create intuitive user experiences, guides and training materials; support demonstrations and adoption; capture knowledge from delivery partners and build internal capability.

**Key working relationships:-**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan); Finance process owners and users; Finance Systems and Technology teams; data and integration teams; external implementation and managed-service partners.

**Key deliverables:-**

* Robust and scalable Anaplan models aligned with approved requirements and architecture.
* Accurate calculations, planning logic, dashboards, workflows and management outputs.
* Reliable data integrations, imports, exports, validations and reconciliations.
* Complete functional, technical, testing, release and operational documentation.
* Stable support for live models and key planning cycles, with timely defect resolution.
* Effective knowledge transfer and reduced reliance on external delivery resources.

**Skills and experience:-**

**Essential**

* Practical experience designing and building Anaplan models in a business environment.
* Strong knowledge of lists, modules, hierarchies, line items, actions, processes and dashboards.
* Experience translating Finance or business requirements into model designs.
* Understanding of multidimensional modelling, data structures and model performance.
* Experience with data imports, exports, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
* Ability to diagnose calculation, data, model and performance issues.
* Experience supporting testing, deployment and live operational models.
* Understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting or management reporting.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Anaplan Model Builder certification or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Experience with FP&A, profitability, unit economics, cash flow or liquidity models.
* Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP, data warehouse or reporting platforms.
* Knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management and controlled deployment.
* Experience in Financial Services or another controlled or regulated environment.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, data governance, access controls and audit requirements.
* Experience working with external implementation or managed-service partners.

**Personal attributes**

* Hands-on, structured and delivery-focused, with strong attention to detail.
* Able to simplify complex calculations and challenge unnecessary complexity.
* Collaborative across Finance and Technology, with clear stakeholder communication.
* Proactive in identifying risks, control gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Pragmatic, dependable and committed to sustainable internal capability.

**Success measures**

* Delivery of assigned developments to agreed scope, quality and priorities.
* Accuracy, reliability, usability and performance of models and outputs.
* Adherence to design, documentation, security and governance standards.
* Successful business testing, adoption and support through planning cycles.
* Reduction in manual activity, defects and dependency on external resources.

**Role boundary**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan) owns platform strategy, roadmap, delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, supplier management and overall platform outcomes.
**The Anaplan Model Builder**
owns the detailed design, build, testing, documentation, deployment support and maintenance of assigned solutions. Business process owners approve requirements, assumptions, processes and outputs.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Revenue Manager with strong OTA management expertise**
to drive revenue growth, optimize occupancy, and improve property performance through dynamic pricing and data-driven strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. OTA Management**

* Manage listings, pricing, inventory, availability, and promotions across Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, and other OTA platforms.
* Monitor bookings, conversions, cancellations, and guest reviews to improve visibility and revenue.
* Coordinate with OTA account managers to resolve issues, improve rankings, and optimize commercial terms.

**2. Revenue & Pricing Strategy**

* Implement dynamic pricing based on demand, seasonality, occupancy, and competitor rates.
* Track ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and overall revenue performance.
* Develop demand forecasts and pricing strategies to maximize revenue and profitability.

**3. Occupancy & Business Growth**

* Drive occupancy and room-night growth across the Gurugram portfolio.
* Analyze booking trends and identify opportunities to increase direct bookings and reduce OTA commission costs.
* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Marketing teams to optimize revenue.

**4. Market & Competitor Analysis**

* Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, and market trends.
* Identify demand drivers, local events, and seasonal opportunities to recommend pricing adjustments.

**5. Reporting & Channel Management**

* Prepare regular reports on revenue, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and OTA performance.
* Manage room inventory across channels to prevent overbookings and pricing discrepancies.
* Work with PMS, channel managers, and revenue management tools to maintain accurate rates and availability.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Hotel Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* **3+ years of experience in Revenue Management and OTA Management**
  , preferably in hospitality, hotels, serviced apartments, or co-living.
* Hands-on experience with Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Agoda, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of dynamic pricing, forecasting, inventory management, and revenue optimization.
* Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with PMS and channel management systems is preferred.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Occupancy and room-night growth.
* ADR, RevPAR, and revenue achievement.
* OTA performance and conversion rates.
* Improved net revenue and reduced commission costs.
* Pricing accuracy, inventory management, and forecasting accuracy.

**Ideal Candidate**

A commercially driven professional with hands-on OTA expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to optimize pricing, occupancy, and revenue across multiple properties.

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
**Job Description**
As part of the Financial Reporting Quality Assurance (FRQA) organization within Corporate Controllership, this role is accountable for overseeing critical Level 1 production support processes for financial systems, including data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, validation, operational calendar management, end-to-end process coordination, and incident management.
  
  
The team maintains deep knowledge of data sources, processing workflows, and regulatory reporting requirements, and is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across a broad range of finance technology platforms. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, disciplined operational execution, proactive monitoring, and timely incident resolution.
  
  
The Service Management Financial System Analyst is expected to be collaborative, highly organized, and results oriented, with responsibility for end-to-end operational monitoring, incident tracking, triage, problem management, and support of financial system reliability, stability, and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role is responsible for ensuring financial systems operations are effectively governed, executed, monitored, controlled, and continuously improved. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage operational processes to ensure financial systems function as intended, processes run efficiently, and required controls and auditability are maintained.
* Ensure successful completion of daily operational activities in alignment with established processing calendars, controls, and service expectations.
* Collaborate with business, finance, and technology stakeholders to triage incidents, manage resolution activities, and support timely root cause analysis.
* Identify recurring incident themes and partner with technology and business teams to drive sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, and automation.
* Assess the operational impact of production changes and ensure runbooks, procedures, and related documentation are updated accurately and on time.
* Develop, operationalize, and monitor dashboards that provide transparency into process health, operational performance, and service management trends.
* Document business and technical requirements for enhancements, standard operating procedures, and process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and control management requirements.
* Identify, document, implement, and periodically test operational controls in accordance with RCSA/PRSA guidelines to confirm control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technology-related field, preferably Computer Science.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial systems implementation, production support, and incident management for financial systems.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database and data management concepts, with strong proficiency in SQL and exposure to both traditional and modern data technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial, business, and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Ability to perform effectively in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in challenging situations.
* Proven transformational mindset, with a focus on improving process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Self-starter and proactive team player with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality service and meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Experience with accounting and reporting processes, including financial and regulatory reporting, is preferred.
* Flexibility is essential for this production support role, including the ability to work in shifts and provide weekend support on a rotational basis.

Technical Skills & Knowledge of Platforms
  
  

* Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and production incident troubleshooting, including the ability to write complex queries and perform multi-table joins.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, MemSQL, and Putty for incident triage, reporting, and operational support.
* Advanced knowledge of job scheduling tools such as Airflow and Automic is required.
* Experience in Generative AI frameworks would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, monitoring, logging, IAM, production support, maintenance, and troubleshooting, is preferred.
* Experience with AxiomSL is preferred.
* Knowledge of Flink and Beam server is preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira is preferred.

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

**Job Description: Senior Technology Consultant – Capital Markets (Calypso Specialist)**
**Job Purpose:**

* Need to work as a Senior Technology Consultant in the capacity of Capital Market – Calypso Implementation Specialist in Capital Market core modernisation and migration projects.
* Should exhibit deep experience in financial services during the client discussions and be able to convince the client on the solution.

* Work Experience Requirements
* Functional Experience

+ 4 to 8 years of hands on experience in Capital Markets with strong exposure to Front to Back trade lifecycle.
+ Solid understanding of:

- Securities trading, settlements, confirmations, reconciliation, and clearing.
- Middle office processes including trade validation, enrichment, allocation, and reporting.
- Regulatory reporting and compliance across capital markets.

+ Demonstrates experience interacting with business stakeholders, product controllers, operations, and risk teams.
+ Prior exposure to transformation, modernization, or migration programs in Capital Markets.

* Technical Experience
* Strong implementation experience in Calypso, particularly Version 14+ (preferred), across:

+ System configuration in trading, static data, settlement, and middle office modules.
+ Workflow design and exception handling.
+ Integration with upstream and downstream systems.

* Hands on experience with:

+ Trade processing engines
+ Static and reference data frameworks
+ Interfaces, messaging standards (ISO15022/20022, FIX), and APIs

* Experience working in Agile environments and contributing to functional & technical design workshops.

**Mandatory Skills**
**Functional Skills**

* Calypso platform expertise, including:

+ Calypso Securities Instance (CSI)
+ Trade Representation & Processing
+ Static Data Configuration
+ Workflow creation & orchestration
+ Trade Validation & Enrichment logic
+ Loss & Claim Management module
+ Settlement Status Processing
+ Middle Office Reporting Framework
+ Block Allocation – Vinci SS1 enrichment
+ Archiving concepts and strategy

* Ability to write and analyze SQL queries.
* Good understanding of system integration, APIs (SOAP/REST), and messaging.
* Ability to interpret technical logs, troubleshoot issues, and guide development teams.
* Strong knowledge of financial instruments:

+ Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Listed & OTC Derivatives, Repos, and Structured Products.

* Understanding of:

+ Trade lifecycle from booking to settlement
+ Risk factors, pricing inputs, and PnL drivers
+ Collateral management fundamentals
+ Treasury and liquidity processes

* Experience in requirements gathering, gap analysis (OOTB vs. custom), and functional documentation.
* Exposure to Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban).

**Technical Skills**

* Application and Solution (workflow, interface) technical design.
* Business requirements, definition, analysis, and mapping.
* Understanding of technology landscape and providing system configuration design in Market, Static and Reference data.
* Knowledge of databases, infrastructure, application servers, Technical Architecture, Security and Performance management.
* Expertise in writing integration specifications and knowledge of Soap or Rest APIs.

**One or more of following Tech skill categories:**

* Database skills – Able to write SQL queries of moderate complexity,
* Programming/ Scripting skills: One of {Python, Java, C#} - able to write methods calling APIs
* Experience in Cloud and CI/CD (Devops Automation environment)
* Data Visualization – Dashboard analysis with Tableau, Power Bi

**Education And Experience**

* MBA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent degree.
* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets, preferably within banking, investment banking, or financial technology domains.

**Position Summary**
Job title: Consultant, Technology Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance
  
  
**About**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
Work you’ll do
  
  
As an consultant, you will build and nurture positive working relationships with Deloitte teams who work with clients with the intention to exceed client expectations. You will:
  
  

* Identify and evaluate complex business/ technological risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement
* Perform system evaluation and/or audit IT and business process as a part of SOX 404, SSAE 18 or ICFR assessment in accordance with PCAOB/AICPA guidance using Deloitte methodology for whole point
* Perform complete GITC evaluation and testing across IT platform including, operating systems, databases, and network components
* Manage multiple assignments and deal with ambiguity. Ensure timely completion of activities with quality, complete ownership of deliverables and early escalations to management, if required
* Communicate and coordinate with local & remote team members within Deloitte and also with client stakeholders
* Share periodic status updates with the stakeholders
* Continually develop technical and industry knowledge as well as soft skills
* Support organization and function initiatives.

**Required Skills**

* One to Four years of relevant work experience, with industry focus a plus
* Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, and IT auditing
* Experience with SOX, Internal Audit, and SSAE 18 (At least one of three)
* Experience of assessing and reviewing technology risks and controls over areas including access management, change management & computer operations for IT platforms (operating systems, databases, applications and network components)
* Exposure to any one industry—Finan cial Services; Technology, Media & Telecom; Life Sciences & Health Care; Energy & Resources; Consumer & Industrial Products
* Demonstrate MS office proficiency, problem solving & analytical skills, and strong verbal & written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, manage ambiguity, and work independently or as part of a team with professionals at all levels

**Preferred Skills**

* Big 4 experience

Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* MBA in Finance/Accoun ting/IT/Inform ation security and or CA/CPA/CIA/CIS A/CISSPs

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
description:
**About Us**
Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.
  
  
**Our Mission**
Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.
  
  
Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.
  
  
You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.
  
  
You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.
  
  
And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.
  
  
We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.
  
  
Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.
  
  
Opensity is committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and the work we do for our clients.
  
  
Opensity provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, family status, marital status, source of income, record of offences, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal or provincial human rights legislation.
  
  
We are committed to fair and barrier free recruitment, selection, and employment practices, and to providing reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process and employment lifecycle, in accordance with applicable human rights legislation.
  
  
Candidates who require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process are encouraged to advise our Talent team so appropriate support can be provided.

title: Sr Manager - Ecommerce - Beardo
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Senior Manager – E-commerce will be responsible for driving growth, profitability, and operational excellence across all eCommerce marketplaces for Beardo. The role will focus on scaling revenue, channel inputs, AOP planning, ensuring healthy inputs, commercial health, On-platform media planning, identifying white spaces, eCommerce partnerships and owning P&L/JBP for marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho)

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Growth & P&L Ownership:**
  Own and deliver the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) with full accountability for Top-line (Revenue) and Bottom-line (EBITDA/Contribution Margin) across marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Nykaa etc. Plan and execute monthly/quarterly revenue and bottomline targets.
* **Budgetary Control:**
  Manage multi-crore monthly budgets across performance marketing, and platform promotions
* **Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management:**
  Lead and mentor a team, work cross-functionally with marketing, supply chain, finance, and brand teams, present performance insights and growth strategies to leadership.
* **Portfolio Strategy:**
  Define the channel-specific product mix. Decide which "hero" products (e.g., Whisky Smoke, Beard Oils) lead on marketplaces
* **Performance Marketing Strategy:**
  Oversee the PPC/AMS strategy. Move beyond execution to "Portfolio ROAS" management, balancing brand-building spends with high-intent conversion ads. Work closely with digital marketing teams on campaign planning and optimization. Use data to drive decision-making and continuous optimization
* **Product Innovation:**
  Identify "White Spaces" by analysing search trends and competitor gaps. Provide data-backed inputs to the R&D/NPD teams for new launches (e.g., trimmers, premium fragrances).
* **Inventory Governance:**
  Work with the Supply Chain and Demand Planning teams to ensure 98%+ fill rates. Prevent OOS (Out of Stock)
* **Regional Disposition:**
  Lead the strategy for Pan-India inventory placement (FBA/FBF/Regional Centers) to ensure "Next Day Delivery" for the urban Beardo consumer.
* **Account management:**
  Liaising with marketplace managers of Amazon, Flipkart etc for solving account issues, building relationships, aligning internal teams for success
* **Operations and channel hygiene:**
  Manage and overseeday-to-day operations of the E-commerce platform (viz. Amazon,Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, etc.) Cover all activities including listing, forecasting, marketing, supply chain, payments reconciliation
* **Listing Hygiene:**
  Audits on listing - competition, own products, keywords, providing deep insightsand inputs on observations, driving interventions to completion to achieve goal
* **Dashboarding:**
  Shift from manual reporting to automated, real-time BI. Monitor health metrics: CAC, LTV, Retention Rate, AOV, and Contribution Margin 1 & 2.
* **Competitor Intelligence:**
  Proactively track competitor pricing and share-of-voice (SOV) to drive tactical interventions.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* **Experience:**
  6–10 years in eCommerce, preferably within Beauty/Personal Care (BPC) or FMCG.
* **Platform Expertise:**
  Deep knowledge of the Amazon/Flipkart

**Financial Acumen:**
Must understand the "Unit Economics" of eCommerce—shipping costs, payment gateway fees, marketplace commissions, and return rates (RTO).

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Anantara Atelier is a design-focused studio dedicated to elevating interiors with global inspiration and a strong emphasis on serenity and balance. Guided by the philosophy of “Infusing Zen into Design,” the company creates spaces that blend aesthetic appeal with a calm, mindful atmosphere. Its work centers on transforming interiors into harmonious environments that support wellbeing and comfort. Team members collaborate closely to bring thoughtful, detail-oriented design solutions to clients. Applicants can expect a creative, quality-driven workplace that values innovation and refined interior experiences.

**Role Description**
We are seeking a skilled Lead Generation Specialist with hands-on expertise in both
**Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads**
. The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and monitoring paid advertising campaigns to generate qualified leads for our interior design and turnkey projects.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, audience targeting, lead generation strategies, campaign analytics, and conversion optimization.Key Responsibilities

**1. Meta Ads Management**

* Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
* Develop effective audience targeting strategies based on demographics, interests, locations, and buyer intent.
* Run lead generation, website conversion, remarketing, and retargeting campaigns.
* Test different ad creatives, copy, audiences, and campaign objectives to improve performance.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets to achieve lower cost per qualified lead.

**2. Google Ads Management**

* Plan and manage Google Search, Display, and other relevant Google Ads campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent search terms relevant to interior design and turnkey interior services.
* Optimize bidding strategies, ad copies, audience targeting, and campaign structure.
* Monitor search terms, negative keywords, conversion tracking, and landing page performance.
* Improve lead quality while maintaining an efficient cost per acquisition.

**3. Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Develop and implement digital strategies to generate consistent, high-quality leads.
* Focus on lead generation for 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK, and premium residential interior projects.
* Understand the target audience, customer journey, and factors influencing purchase decisions.
* Coordinate with the sales team to track lead quality, follow-ups, site visits, and booking conversions.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-booking conversion rates.

**4. Analytics & Reporting**

* Track campaign performance, cost per lead (CPL), cost per qualified lead, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS), where measurable.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Use Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Tag Manager as required.
* Ensure accurate conversion tracking and identify areas for campaign improvement.
* Allocate budgets based on campaign performance and business priorities.

**5. Creative & Marketing Coordination**

* Work with the internal design and content team to develop effective ad creatives, videos, reels, and campaign concepts.
* Provide creative briefs based on campaign performance and audience insights.
* Suggest new marketing strategies, offers, and campaigns to improve lead generation.
* Stay updated with digital advertising trends, platform changes, and competitor activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing and paid lead generation.
* Strong practical expertise in both
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Proven experience generating leads for real estate, interior design, home interiors, architecture, or other high-value services is preferred.
* Good understanding of audience segmentation, remarketing, conversion tracking, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion APIs is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed decisions.
* Understanding of landing pages, lead forms, keyword research, and conversion rate optimization.
* Ability to manage advertising budgets and deliver measurable results.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with the sales and creative teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified leads generated per month.
* Cost per lead (CPL) and cost per qualified lead.
* Lead quality and relevance to the company's services.
* Lead-to-site-visit and lead-to-booking conversion rates.
* Campaign performance and advertising budget efficiency.
* Accuracy of tracking, reporting, and performance analysis.
* Consistency in achieving agreed monthly lead generation targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Can independently manage Meta and Google Ads without relying entirely on an external marketing agency.
* Understands the difference between generating a high volume of leads and generating leads that actually convert into business.
* Is confident in analyzing campaign data and making performance-driven decisions.
* Takes ownership of advertising budgets, lead quality, and campaign results.
* Is proactive, creative, analytical, and focused on business growth.

title: SME-Learning & Development
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in learning and development focuses on creating and delivering training solutions for claims adjudication and health care compliance within provider and payer environments. The position supports night shift operations enabling global coverage while ensuring accurate claims handling regulatory alignment and continuous capability building across multiple functional teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive training programs that build strong capability in claims adjudication processes for provider and payer operations while aligning with current business objectives and quality standards.
* Develop detailed learning content that simplifies complex health care claim rules and workflows so that new and existing team members can perform adjudication tasks with high accuracy and consistency.
* Deliver engaging virtual and classroom training sessions during night shift hours to support hybrid team members and ensure consistent knowledge transfer across locations.
* Conduct targeted training needs analysis by collaborating with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps in claims adjudication and prioritize high impact learning interventions.
* Monitor learner performance data and quality audit outcomes to refine course materials and ensure that training directly improves claim resolution accuracy and turnaround time.
* Ensure that all learning content reflects current health care regulations and privacy requirements related to HIPAA so that team members handle sensitive information responsibly.
* Create practical simulations and case based exercises that mirror real life provider and payer claim scenarios to help learners build confidence and decision making skills.
* Provide ongoing floor support during production hours by answering process queries and clarifying adjudication rules so that associates can resolve complex claims efficiently.
* Collaborate with process experts and compliance teams to update training materials whenever there are changes in benefit designs coding standards or regulatory guidance.
* Track training effectiveness through feedback surveys assessments and quality metrics and present insights that show how learning programs support business performance and member satisfaction.
* Maintain detailed training records and documentation that support internal audits and demonstrate adherence to organizational learning standards and regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with workforce management and team supervisors to schedule training sessions that minimize business disruption while meeting the needs of night shift hybrid associates.
* Support the adoption of digital learning tools and knowledge repositories so that team members can access updated claims adjudication and HIPAA guidance on demand.

**Qualifications**

* Apply strong knowledge of health care claims adjudication rules benefit structures and payment policies to design technically accurate learning content for provider and payer processes.
* Use hands on experience with provider and payer workflows to explain real world scenarios and guide learners in applying policy rules to complex claim situations.
* Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and data privacy expectations to embed compliance guidelines into every stage of the learning and support process.
* Utilize prior operations or quality experience within claims environments to connect training topics with performance outcomes such as first pass resolution and reduced rework.
* Demonstrate proficiency with common office productivity tools and learning platforms to create clear presentations job aids and reference guides for hybrid teams.
* Communicate clearly and inclusively with diverse audiences across global locations while adapting explanations to suit different experience levels and learning styles.
* Show readiness to work permanent night shifts in a hybrid work model while maintaining high levels of responsiveness reliability and collaboration with onshore and offshore partners.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets: Finacle Core Banking**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Our Commitment
  
  
**As a commitment,**
we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data Analyst
description:
WE ARE HIRING! DATA ANALYST

**Company:** VVS Fresh N Fine  
**Department:** MIS / Business Analytics  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2+ years preferred  
**Industry:** Retail / FMCG / Supermarket / Wholesale  
**Work Location:** Cherthala, Kerala 688539 (In-person)

About VVS Fresh N Fine

At VVS Fresh N Fine, our core purpose is simple yet powerful: **To Make Life Better by Creating Value** for our customers, partner brands, team members, and communities.

We are a growing supermarket and wholesale business with multi-location operations across Kerala. We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical **Data Analyst** to support business performance, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Job Overview

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting business data related to sales, inventory, purchasing, finance, and operations. You will prepare reports and dashboards, identify trends and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to support management decisions and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze sales, inventory, purchasing, and operational data to identify trends and business opportunities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, dashboards, and performance summaries.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including sales, margins, stock movement, inventory turnover, and profitability.
* Develop and maintain reports using MS Excel and business intelligence tools.
* Use data visualization tools such as Power BI to present insights clearly.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
* Identify performance gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support sales forecasting, inventory planning, budgeting, and business planning.
* Assist management in making informed, data-driven decisions.
* Maintain data confidentiality and follow company reporting standards.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. A master's degree is an advantage.
* **Experience:** Relevant experience in data analysis, MIS reporting, business intelligence, or a similar role is preferred.
* **MS Excel:** Strong proficiency in advanced Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, formulas, and data analysis.
* **Technical Skills:** Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, and data visualization tools is an advantage.
* **Analytical Skills:** Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights.
* **Business Understanding:** Knowledge of retail, FMCG, supermarket, or wholesale operations is preferred.
* **Attention to Detail:** Strong commitment to data accuracy and quality.
* **Communication:** Ability to present findings clearly and work effectively with different departments.
* **Problem-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying issues and recommending improvements.

Our Core Values

* Innovation & Growth
* Teamwork
* Adaptability
* Dedication & Commitment
* Continuous Learning

How to Apply

If you are passionate about data, possess strong analytical skills, and want to contribute to a growing retail and wholesale business, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your updated CV/Resume to:

**Email:** vvs.vvsfreshnfine@gmail.com

**Work Location:** Cherthala, Kerala 688539  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, in-person  
**Commute/Relocation:** Candidates must be able to commute reliably or plan to relocate before joining.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: DEVOPS ARCHITECT - AWS
description:

Bangalore

This role modernizes our software delivery platform and evolves Developer Experience (DevXP) toward an AI-enabled, agentic model. It blends CI/CD platform engineering with practical AI application focused on real engineering problems such as pipeline migration, automation, code understanding, and testing enablement. This is not an AI research role.

Enable faster, safer software delivery with minimal friction by building a standardized, AI-enabled developer platform.

* Proven track record building reusable workflows and developer tooling.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, TypeScript, or Go.
* Experience with containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native delivery practices.
* Deep understanding of GitHub workflows including PRs, CODEOWNERS, and repository standards.
* Ability to unify fragmented environments and drive enterprise-wide adoption.

**AI & Agentic Practices**

* Hands-on experience with LLM-powered tooling such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.
* Practical application of AI to code understanding, automated testing, and migration tasks.
* Experience managing repository-level AI context (e.g., .github/instructions.md or prompt files).

* Experience designing safe, human-in-the-loop AI patterns with manual validation checkpoints.

  - Own the platform modernization roadmap from conception through execution.
* **Bias for Action**
  - Deliver tangible tooling and automation, not just high-level strategy.
* **Pragmatism**
  - Turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, everyday engineering workflows.
* **Strategic Influence**
  -  Balance standardization requirements with real-world project constraints.
* **Leadership by Example**
  - Influence teams through highly usable solutions and clear, concrete examples.

**Key Responsibilities**

**CI/CD Modernization**

* Migrate legacy Jenkins pipelines to GitHub Actions.
* Build reusable workflows, templates, and standards to reduce fragmentation.
* Improve visibility and observability across all delivery flows.

**AI-Assisted Engineering**

* Apply AI to accelerate migrations, code analysis, testing, and documentation.

**Agent-Ready Repositories**

* Define and implement repository standards covering metadata, documentation, instructions, and templates.

* Integrate AI into engineering workflows across GitHub, CI/CD, Jira, and related systems.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
**Role Summary**
We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to take ownership of reliability, performance, and operational excellence across our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms. You'll lead the response to complex, high-severity incidents, raise the bar on automation and observability, and mentor other engineers as the team scales.
  
  
This is a
**Rotational Shift role**
and an
**onsite**
position located at Bangalore, India. You will be required to work from the office on a full-time basis. We are only considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
  
  
**Position Details**
**About The Role**

* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex, high-severity incidents across AWS/GCP infrastructure and EKS/GKE clusters, often serving as incident commander for major incidents.
* Design and build Python-based automation frameworks and tooling that eliminate manual toil and improve reliability at scale, not just one-off scripts.
* Architect and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, establishing reusable, secure, and scalable patterns across AWS/GCP environments.
* Drive observability strategy — design Grafana dashboards and alert frameworks that surface the right signals to the right teams at the right time.
* Use SQL and CloudWatch Logs Insights to perform deep root-cause analysis on complex, cross-service incidents.
* Own end-to-end ITSM processes — Incident Management and Problem Management — including root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and long-term remediation plans.
* Mentor junior and mid-level SREs, reviewing their troubleshooting approach, automation, and incident handling.
* Partner with engineering, product, and leadership teams to communicate incident impact, risk, and remediation plans clearly and confidently.
* Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents.
* Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones.
* Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks.
* Participate in and provide senior-level escalation support for on-call rotations.

**About You**

* You should have 5-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with a proven track record of owning the reliability and performance of production-critical systems.
* You should possess deep hands-on expertise across AWS services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, networking, and related cloud infrastructure technologies.
* You should have demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex EKS and GKE environments, including cluster failures, networking issues, autoscaling challenges, performance bottlenecks, and platform upgrades.
* You should be highly proficient in Python for developing automation frameworks, operational tooling, and scalable engineering solutions, as well as Terraform for designing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code patterns at scale.
* You should have strong experience with ITSM practices, including hands-on ownership of Incident and Problem Management processes, complemented by advanced skills in SQL and AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights for root-cause analysis and operational investigations.
* You should be experienced in designing Grafana dashboards and alerting strategies that provide meaningful observability across multiple teams, services, and environments.
* You should communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor other engineers, contribute to reliability strategy, and demonstrate ownership, accountability, and composure during high-severity incidents.
* You should hold an AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) and a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent Kubernetes certification, along with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Company Benefits And Perks**

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Skan AI**

**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Lead DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and infrastructure automation that power Skan's customer delivery operations. Working within the Customer Ops team, this role is the engineering engine behind deployment velocity — ensuring that customer environments are provisioned, upgraded, and maintained reliably, securely, and at pace.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure operations. The DevOps Engineer is responsible for making deployment a repeatable, automated, and quality-assured activity — eliminating manual overhead, enforcing DevSecOps standards, and giving the wider Customer Ops and Systems Engineering teams the tooling they need to operate efficiently at scale.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

As Skan's enterprise customer base grows, so does the complexity of managing deployments across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted, and hybrid environments. Without dedicated DevOps engineering, deployment activities are manual, inconsistent, and slow — creating delivery risk, increasing the chance of environment-related incidents, and preventing the Customer Ops team from scaling without linear headcount growth.

The DevOps Engineer provides the automation and tooling layer that makes Skan's customer delivery operations scalable, auditable, and professionally run — directly supporting SLA commitments, deployment quality, and time-to-value for enterprise clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for customer environment deployments, upgrades, and patch cycles — covering cloud-hosted and customer-hosted models
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Helm, Ansible)
* Implement and enforce DevSecOps practices across all product and client deployment pipelines — including security scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code controls
* Develop and maintain deployment tooling, scripts, and environment templates that reduce manual effort and improve deployment consistency
* Support Systems Engineers during new customer environment builds, patch cycles, and major upgrades — providing tooling, automation, and hands-on assistance
* Build and maintain ops process tooling: SLA tracking dashboards, deployment status portals, environment health monitors, and internal reporting utilities
* Maintain deployment metrics and reporting — pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate — to inform continuous improvement
* Identify and remediate deployment bottlenecks, pipeline failures, and infrastructure configuration drift across customer environments
* Collaborate with the SRE team to align infrastructure design with operational monitoring and incident response requirements
* Participate in change management processes — ensuring all production environment changes are logged, reviewed, and reversible
* Contribute to the Automation Engineering team's agentic workflow initiatives — developing automation that further reduces operational toil
* Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all pipelines, playbooks, and environment configurations

**KEY DELIVERABLES**

* CI/CD pipeline designs and live implementations for all customer deployment models — cloud, on-prem, and hybrid
* Infrastructure-as-Code templates and reusable deployment playbooks — maintained, versioned, and documented
* DevSecOps controls documentation and compliance evidence for all customer-facing pipelines
* Automated environment provisioning and teardown scripts — reducing manual setup time per new customer deployment
* Deployment metrics dashboard: pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate — reported monthly
* Ops tooling: SLA trackers, status portals, and environment health dashboards operational and actively used by Customer Ops teams
* Target: pipeline success rate ≥ 95%; zero unplanned production outages attributable to deployment tooling failures

**KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of experience.
* CI/CD platforms: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps — pipeline design, implementation, and maintenance at enterprise scale
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible — provisioning, configuration management, and drift detection
* Container platforms: Docker and Kubernetes — build, deployment, and runtime management in production environments
* DevSecOps: security scanning (SAST/DAST), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent), policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel)
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP — provisioning, networking, IAM, and cost-aware infrastructure management
* Scripting and automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell — automating deployment workflows and operational tasks
* Monitoring integration: ability to instrument pipelines with observability hooks compatible with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent
* Change management: familiarity with ITSM processes and structured change control in enterprise environments
* Collaboration skills: able to work effectively with Systems Engineers, SRE, and customer-facing teams in a fast-moving environment
* Documentation: clear, maintainable runbooks and pipeline documentation — written for both technical peers and operational teams

**This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.**

*Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.*

*We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.*

title: Embedded DevOps Engineer
description:

* Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
* Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
* Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!
  
  
X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc.). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software.
  
  
As an Embedded DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in enabling efficient and reliable development, testing, release, and maintenance of X-Rite's embedded software platforms. You will work closely with software, firmware, QA, and systems engineering teams to design, develop, and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and automation that accelerate product development while ensuring high levels of quality, security, and reliability.
  
  
This role combines software engineering, infrastructure automation, CI/CD development, and release management for embedded Linux-based products. You will contribute to building modern engineering practices and automation frameworks that support X-Rite's global product portfolio, ranging from handheld spectrophotometers to advanced imaging and measurement systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting embedded software development, testing, and release activities.
* Build and maintain automated build, packaging, deployment, and release processes for embedded Linux-based products.
* Collaborate with software, firmware, QA, and systems engineering teams to streamline development workflows and improve engineering productivity.
* Develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve software delivery efficiency.
* Support product cybersecurity initiatives by integrating security scanning, vulnerability analysis, and compliance checks into the development lifecycle.
* Monitor CI/CD pipeline health, build quality, infrastructure performance, and deployment reliability.
* Assist engineering teams in troubleshooting build, deployment, infrastructure, and automation-related issues.
* Participate actively in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.
* Drive adoption of DevOps best practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, AI-assisted development tools, and engineering excellence across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
3–6 years of professional experience in DevOps, Software Engineering, or related technical roles.
  
  
Experience and training in most of the following areas are required:
  
  

* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience developing automation tools and scripts using Python and Bash.
* Experience working with Linux-based development environments.
* Understanding of software build systems, release management practices, and software lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of software quality practices, automated testing integration, and deployment automation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer (Hybrid in Bangalore)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
Automation is the key to creating highly reliable and secure large-scale software systems. Are you someone who engineers solutions to problems rather than simply fixing the same thing over and over again? Can you protect Smartsheet against attackers?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior DevSecOps Engineer**
to join our global Security Operations team. In this critical role, you will be a leader in maturing our security and reliability posture by treating both as software engineering challenges. You will engineer and operate a highly reliable, scalable, and defensible production environment, directly impacting our ability to deliver a world-class service to our customers 24/7. This is a unique opportunity to blend deep expertise in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and modern Security Operations, working at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, and security to build a platform that is resilient and secure by design.
  
  
**You Will**

* Engineer Secure and Resilient Infrastructure: Design, build, maintain, and improve secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure in our multi-cloud environment (primarily AWS) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Automate Proactive Security: Engineer and automate threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management processes. You will build the tools and workflows that allow us to respond to threats at machine speed.
* Secure the Software Development Lifecycle: Architect and secure our CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) to provide developers with fast, actionable feedback.
* Master Container Security: Manage, operate, and secure our container orchestration platform (Kubernetes), implementing best practices for container security from the registry to runtime, including knowledge of hardening requirements such as CIS Benchmarks or DISA STIG.
* Lead Incident Response: Act as a technical lead during security and reliability incidents, driving resolution and conducting blameless post-mortems to engineer preventative solutions.
* Drive Automated Compliance: Implement and automate technical controls to ensure continuous compliance with frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, and ISO 27001.
* Mentor and Lead: Serve as a subject matter expert for security and reliability, mentoring other engineers and championing a culture of operational excellence and security ownership across the organization.

**You Have**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in technology, with at least 5 years in a hands-on senior role such as Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Security Engineering.
* A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* Expert-level proficiency in at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS, with deep knowledge of core infrastructure and security services.
* Expert-level proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform.
* Expert-level proficiency in a scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, or Ruby, with a proven history of building automation and custom tooling.
* Deep experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes), including securing containerized environments.
* Proficiency with the modern security operations toolchain, including SIEM, EDR, and vulnerability scanning technologies.
* Experience integrating security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into CI/CD pipelines.
* A critical thinker with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex problems in high-pressure production environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a collaborative spirit. This will include fluency in English.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or cloud-specific security certifications.
* Experience with compliance frameworks like FedRAMP, ISO27001, SOC2.

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
