title: Member of Technical Staff 2
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a curious, hands-on DevSecOps Engineer who is excited about building the next generation of cloud and developer platforms through AI, automation, and engineering innovation.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys asking questions such as:
  
  
“Why are we doing this manually?”
  
  
“Can we automate this?”
  
  
“Can AI help us understand or operate this system better?”
  
  
“Is there a better open-source technology or engineering approach we should explore?”
  
  
You do not need to know every technology we use. We care deeply about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, experimentation, and your ability to learn quickly.
  
  
You will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, security, observability, and AI-assisted operations. You will have opportunities not only to operate platforms, but also to research new approaches, build prototypes, automate repetitive work, and turn successful ideas into production capabilities.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team builds and operates platforms that enable engineering teams to deliver software securely, reliably, and efficiently.
  
  
We are evolving traditional DevOps toward a platform engineering and AI-assisted operations model. Our goal is to reduce repetitive operational work, improve developer experience, increase reliability and security, and use AI and automation wherever they can create meaningful engineering leverage.
  
  
We value engineers who are willing to experiment, challenge existing approaches constructively, share what they learn, and take ownership of making things better.
  
  
**Your Role**
**As a DevSecOps Engineer, You Will**

* Build, improve, and automate CI/CD workflows for application and infrastructure delivery.
* Work with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes to deploy and operate scalable services.
* Develop automation using Python, Go, Bash, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Identify repetitive operational activities and convert them into reliable automation or self-service capabilities.
* Explore how AI, LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation can improve troubleshooting, observability, incident response, infrastructure management, and developer productivity.
* Participate in technical research and proof-of-concepts, evaluate emerging technologies and open-source projects, and present recommendations based on your findings.
* Build and maintain infrastructure using tools such as Terraform and other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
* Improve observability through metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and intelligent analysis of operational data.
* Integrate security into software delivery through vulnerability scanning, dependency management, secrets management, policy enforcement, and secure engineering practices.
* Troubleshoot production and platform issues and use those experiences to identify opportunities for permanent engineering improvements.
* Contribute to platform documentation, architecture discussions, engineering standards, and reusable automation.
* Collaborate with application, security, SRE, platform, and AI/ML engineering teams.
* Continuously learn new technologies and share your experiments, findings, successes, and failures with the broader team.

**What You Will Bring**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 2–6 years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, software engineering, or a related area.
* Good understanding of Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, containers, and software delivery fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container technologies, or a strong demonstrated interest in developing deeper expertise in this area.
* Experience with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and technologies.
* Ability to write useful automation using Python, Go, Bash, or another programming/scripting language.
* Understanding of source control and modern software development practices.
* Basic understanding of application, infrastructure, container, or software supply-chain security.
* Experience working with monitoring, logging, or observability technologies.

**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
  
  
--

* Eliminate complex operational toil by writing production-grade Python or Go tooling, platform automation, and custom integrations.
  
* Champion AI-assisted software development workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate automation, runbook creation, and incident triage across the team.
  
* Author operational runbooks, architecture decision records, and mentor mid-level/junior engineers to raise the overall technical bar.
  
  

  
**We’re Looking For:**
  

  
* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering operating 24/7 mission-critical, highly available distributed systems.
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.
  
* Strong Python/Go Capabilities: Advanced software engineering skill set for writing internal SRE platforms, tools, and API integrations.
  
* Deep Kubernetes Expertise: Hands-on experience with production EKS/GKE cluster lifecycles, ingress/egress, networking, RBAC, and GitOps tooling (Argo CD).
  
* Advanced IaC & AWS/GCP: Deep Terraform proficiency (module architecture, state management refactoring) across complex multi-account AWS environments (IAM, VPCs, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Route53).
  
* FinOps & Cost Optimization Leadership:
  Demonstrated experience driving cloud cost-efficiency strategies, resource right-sizing, cost-allocation tagging, workload optimization, and building FinOps dashboards to embed financial accountability into engineering workflows.
  
* Disaster Recovery & High Availability: Proven background in designing and testing multi-region Disaster Recovery architectures, automating failover systems, and monitoring recovery health via DR dashboards.
  
* Observability & Reliability Architecture: Track record of defining SLI/SLOs, managing PagerDuty schedules, and optimizing production observability platforms.
  
* Experience designing and operating enterprise service meshes (Istio, Linkerd, or similar) and production ingress/proxy systems (HAProxy, NGINX, or similar).
  
* Technical Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions, write architectural design docs/RFCs, and mentor engineering peers.
  
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a passion for solving complex distributed systems challenges at scale.
  
* A strong team player who helps us live by our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.
  
  

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
  

  
* Basic understanding of chaos engineering principles or testing resilience in staging/production.
  
* Experience with secrets management architectures (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator, Cert-Manager).
  
* Background in DevSecOps practices, service meshes (Istio), and automated vulnerability remediation within cloud infrastructure code.
  
* Background supporting identity services, IAM, enterprise directory platforms, or security-focused SaaS solutions.

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
The Lead Site Reliability Engineer leads the reliable delivery and operation of OpenText solutions, including xECM, Teamsite , OTMM and related platforms. The role combines hands-on SRE and cloud engineering with AI-assisted development, agentic automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and technical leadership.
  
  
The engineer will work across the application lifecycle—from design and provisioning through testing, migration, upgrades, patching, operations, and decommissioning—and will use AI and automation to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed, quality, and service reliability.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**
Work within an OpenText technical delivery team in order to:
  
  

* Lead the technical design, deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of OpenText solutions across on-premises and public-cloud environments.
* Apply GitHub Copilot and other approved AI-assisted engineering tools for code generation, refactoring, test creation, documentation, and operational automation.
* Design and develop agentic AI solutions and workflows that automate repeatable engineering, deployment, support, and reliability tasks with appropriate controls.
* Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD pipelines and shared libraries for automated build, test, security validation, deployment, approvals, rollback, and release management.
* Design, deploy, and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, including cluster configuration, workload management, scaling, upgrades, security controls, observability, and troubleshooting; automate supporting cloud infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure.
* Drive observability, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, reliability improvements, upgrades, and patching; participate in on-call and planned weekend activities when required.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Tools, and Operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, review deliverables, mentor engineers, and act as Scrum Lead or technical lead when needed.

**What You Need To Succeed**
BE/B. Tech. or equivalent technical qualification
  
  
**Minimum Of 8 Years Of Relevant Experience**
Strong hands-on experience deploying, administering, automating, and troubleshooting OpenText xECM , and related components; cloud deployment experience is strongly preferred.
  
  

* AI-assisted engineering: hands-on use of GitHub Copilot or comparable approved tools for code generation, refactoring, unit tests, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Agentic AI development: ability to design and build AI agents or multi-step agentic workflows using programming languages, APIs, prompt and context design, tool integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and responsible-AI controls.
* GitLab CI/CD: practical knowledge of pipeline configuration, reusable templates and shared libraries, automated build and testing, security checks, artifact management, approvals, deployment, rollback, and release management.
* Automation and infrastructure as code: experience with Terraform, Helm, Ansible, scripting, APIs, and automation of provisioning and operational workflows.
* Kubernetes and container orchestration: strong hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. Skills should include pods, deployments, services, ingress, ConfigMaps, secrets, namespaces, persistent storage, resource limits, autoscaling, rolling updates, health probes, RBAC, network policies, logging, monitoring, upgrades, and root-cause troubleshooting. Exposure to managed Kubernetes services such as GKE, EKS, or AKS is preferred.
* OpenText solutions: deployment, administration, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting experience with TeamSite, LiveSite, Exstream, OTMM, xECM, Documentum, or related platforms.
* Platform engineering: working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, web and application servers, databases, and secure application operations.
* Service reliability: experience with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management in Agile or Scrum delivery environments.
* Ability to lead a small technical team, review technical deliverables, mentor engineers, and provide clear technical direction.
* Strong problem-solving, ownership, and customer-service mindset, with disciplined attention to reliability and quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
* Continuous-learning mindset and willingness to evaluate and adopt new AI, automation, cloud, and SRE practices.

**One last thing**

* Programming or scripting experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Shell, or PowerShell.
* Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, LDAP, object-oriented programming, and application integration patterns.
* Exposure to AI-agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps practices is an advantage.

title: Senior Engineer,  Site Reliability Engineering
description:
**Role Summary**
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you’ll provide deep reliability and operational expertise for business-critical cloud services. You’ll help set the reliability strategy (for example, defining SLOs and error budgets), design the observability and automation that keep services balanced, and lead improvements that reduce operational risk and customer impact. This role suits people who enjoy solving complex production problems and raising the standard for engineering excellence—regardless of whether your background is SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering with strong operations experience.
  
  
On-call: You’ll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. As a senior specialist, you’ll help improve how we run on-call by reducing noisy alerts, automating repetitive tasks, and strengthening operational readiness so incidents become less frequent and easier to resolve. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly and continuously improve the on-call experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own reliability outcomes for critical user journeys and cloud components by defining SLIs/SLOs, setting error budgets, and using data to prioritise resilience work.
* Design observability standards (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting) using tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly.
* Lead major incident response as incident commander when needed, drive blameless post-incident reviews, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and measured.
* Improve platform resilience and scalability through reliability architecture reviews, capacity and performance engineering, and proactive risk assessments.
* Reduce toil by automating repetitive operational work (for example with Terraform, CI/CD, and scripting), and track improvements through clear operational metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Security, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, compliance obligations, and customer impact.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and change procedures, and raise standards through reviews, templates, and shared practices.
* Coach and mentor engineers, helping teams adopt SRE ways of working and strengthening operational ownership.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Significant experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) supporting production services and making reliability improvements that stick.
* Demonstrated ownership of reliability practices such as SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident actions, and operational readiness.
* Strong AWS knowledge and hands-on experience operating cloud services (for example: EKS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and CloudWatch/CloudWatch Insights).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (for example, Terraform) and with CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitLab CI/CD).
* Experience with Kubernetes, including production operations on managed platforms such as Amazon EKS.
* Ability to script to automate and solve (for example, Python and/or JavaScript), with an engineering approach to testing, review, and maintainability.
* Experience building actionable monitoring and alerting that balances sensitivity and noise (for example, Datadog and CloudWatch).
* Confidence presenting, staying calm during incidents, and influencing teams through data, clear writing, and pragmatic recommendations.

**Good to have Skills:**
Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, networking, security, policy, and multi-tenant considerations).
  
  
Experience with performance testing, load testing, and capacity modelling for cloud-native services.
  
  
Software engineering experience in Python and/or JavaScript beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews).
  
  
Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric develop, alert tuning, incident analytics).

title: Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on-call rotation.
  
  
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
  
  
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
  
  

* Provision bare-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring-up free of manual per-node steps
* Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over

Kubernetes Cluster Operations
  
  

* Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control-plane topology, including etcd members, kube-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure-domain placement
* Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
* Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts

GitOps & Fleet Configuration
  
  

* Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
* Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
* Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team

Upgrades & Patching
  
  

* Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
* Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Observability & On-Call
  
  

* Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
* Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
* Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
* Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate

What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months
  
  

* Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
* Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
* Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
* Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
* Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
* Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
* Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
* Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
* Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
* Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
* On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
* Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it

**Preferred**

* Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi-cluster management plane
* Familiarity with DPDK-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR-IOV NIC tuning
* Exposure to SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Technical Architect- Salesforce Devops
description:
**Description**
**ROLE OVERVIEW**
The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**S**

* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
* DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
* Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
* Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
* Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
* CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
* Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
* Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
* Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
* Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.

title: Embedded DevOps Engineer
description:
Are you…

* Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
* Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
* Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc.). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software.

As an Embedded DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in enabling efficient and reliable development, testing, release, and maintenance of X-Rite's embedded software platforms. You will work closely with software, firmware, QA, and systems engineering teams to design, develop, and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and automation that accelerate product development while ensuring high levels of quality, security, and reliability.

This role combines software engineering, infrastructure automation, CI/CD development, and release management for embedded Linux-based products. You will contribute to building modern engineering practices and automation frameworks that support X-Rite's global product portfolio, ranging from handheld spectrophotometers to advanced imaging and measurement systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting embedded software development, testing, and release activities.
* Build and maintain automated build, packaging, deployment, and release processes for embedded Linux-based products.
* Collaborate with software, firmware, QA, and systems engineering teams to streamline development workflows and improve engineering productivity.
* Develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve software delivery efficiency.
* Support product cybersecurity initiatives by integrating security scanning, vulnerability analysis, and compliance checks into the development lifecycle.
* Monitor CI/CD pipeline health, build quality, infrastructure performance, and deployment reliability.
* Assist engineering teams in troubleshooting build, deployment, infrastructure, and automation-related issues.
* Participate actively in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.
* Drive adoption of DevOps best practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, AI-assisted development tools, and engineering excellence across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

3–6 years of professional experience in DevOps, Software Engineering, or related technical roles.

Experience and training in most of the following areas are required:

* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience developing automation tools and scripts using Python and Bash.
* Experience working with Linux-based development environments.
* Understanding of software build systems, release management practices, and software lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of software quality practices, automated testing integration, and deployment automation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto-based systems.
* Familiarity with C/C++, Python, and Bash development environments.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with cybersecurity tooling, static code analysis, and security scanning solutions.
* Exposure to AI-assisted software engineering and automation tools.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on reliability, automation, and engineering efficiency.
* Passion for continuous improvement and modern DevOps practices.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic international engineering environment.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.

**We Offer**
------------

* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human sized organization where you’ll have contact beyond the R&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart.

X-Rite Pantone is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 16,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment *where purpose meets possibility*: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: R&D Platform Engineer – GPQSS Digital- IDC
description:
Platform Engineer
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Platform Engineer to design, build, automate, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable engineering platforms that enable development teams to deliver cloud-native applications faster and with higher quality. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure DevOps, GitOps, observability, and platform automation.
  
  
This role requires strong ownership of developer experience, infrastructure automation, cloud operations, security-by-design, and platform reliability. The candidate will collaborate with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, cybersecurity teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to establish reusable platform capabilities, standards, and self-service solutions across the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Design, build, and maintain internal developer platforms that provide reusable services, templates, pipelines, and automation for application teams.
* Create and manage cloud-native platform components on Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, and container registries.
* Standardize CI/CD pipeline templates using Azure DevOps for build, test, security scanning, deployment, and release automation.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or similar tools to provision and manage consistent environments.
* Enable GitOps and configuration-driven deployment practices for repeatable, auditable, and scalable platform operations.
* Build self-service capabilities for developers, including environment provisioning, deployment templates, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Improve platform reliability through observability, logging, metrics, alerting, SLOs, incident analysis, and continuous operational improvements.
* Integrate platform security controls including secrets management, container security, dependency scanning, image scanning, and policy enforcement.
* Support DevSecOps practices by integrating tools such as SonarCloud, Black Duck, MetaDefender, or equivalent security and quality gates into delivery pipelines.
* Implement authentication, authorization, API gateway, ingress, service mesh, and secure connectivity patterns for platform services.
* Partner with application teams to troubleshoot deployment, performance, networking, availability, and operational issues.
* Define platform standards, reusable architecture patterns, documentation, and best practices to improve developer productivity and governance.
* Evaluate and introduce automation, AI-assisted development, and platform engineering improvements that reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 7+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or cloud-native application delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, container registries, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* Strong experience in Azure DevOps pipeline design, YAML pipelines, release automation, branching strategies, and reusable pipeline templates.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, ARM/Bicep, or equivalent tools.
* Good understanding of platform engineering concepts such as developer portals, golden paths, self-service automation, reusable templates, and paved-road standards.
* Experience with GitOps tools and practices such as Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent configuration-driven deployment approaches.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of networking, ingress controllers, DNS, certificates, load balancing, API gateways, and secure service-to-service communication.
* Experience with secrets management, identity, access control, OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect, Keycloak, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps, secure SDLC, threat modeling, vulnerability management, dependency scanning, image scanning, and compliance readiness.
* Experience supporting event-driven or distributed systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ, background jobs, or similar integration patterns is an advantage.
* Good understanding of application architecture, microservices, REST APIs, .NET Core, Angular, or full stack development concepts is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex platform and production issues.
* Strong communication, collaboration, ownership, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, guide engineering teams, and drive adoption of platform standards and best practices.
* Proficiency in English, both speaking and writing.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot is an advantage.

title: Technical Anchor, Software Engineering
description:
As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.
  
  

* Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
* Anchor Technical Delivery: Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Core Technology Infrastructure (CTI), part of the Global Technology & Operations organization, consists of more than 6,600 employees worldwide. With presence in more than 35 countries, TI designs, builds, and operates end-to-end technology infrastructure solutions and manages critical systems and platforms across the bank. TI delivers industry-leading infrastructure products and services to the company’s employees, customers, and clients around the world.
  
  
**Job Description**
An Infrastructure Engineer for Db2 z/OS is required to support software installation, upgrades, maintenance, 24x7 on-call coverage, disaster recovery testing, automation, monitoring, alerting, and security administration for resilient mainframe database and replication services.
  
  
The role contributes to the installation, upgrade, maintenance, certification, and operational support of IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
  
  
The engineer will help maintain service stability through monitoring, automation, security administration, documented operational procedures, disaster recovery readiness, and effective coordination with internal support teams, software vendors, and management.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Install, upgrade, maintain, test, and support IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, CDC etc.
* Perform software certification testing and maintain clear operational, maintenance, and recovery procedures.
* Support disaster recovery planning and testing to validate service recoverability and operational resilience.
* Develop and enhance automation, monitoring, alerting, health checks, and operational controls.
* Administer security-related activities, including access controls, RACF coordination, TCP/IP connectivity, and network certificates.
* Analyze and resolve complex Db2, replication, infrastructure, performance, and production support issues.
* Work with support teams, software vendors, and management; communicate technical risks, status, and resolution plans clearly.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours support as required.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/Computer Science degree preferred or substantially equivalent experience.
  
  
Certifications If Any: NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
8-10+ years
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* Hands-on experience supporting IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
* Experience with software installation, version upgrades, maintenance, certification testing, operational documentation, and disaster recovery testing.
* Ability to participate in 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours production support when required.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and production incident resolution skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with support teams, software vendors, and management.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience supporting BMC for Db2 tools, IBM z/OS Connect, and Software AG ADABAS and Natural products.

title: Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer
description: Job DescriptionCiklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer to join our team full-time in India.We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.About The RoleAs a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.This is a high-visibility role where we establish the production-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. title: DevSecOps Engineer II
description:
DevSecOps Engineer
  
  
Are you passionate about building secure, scalable cloud infrastructure? Join our innovative team and lead the DevSecOps function that powers our cutting-edge facultative reinsurance platform. This is your chance to make a significant impact on a global application while working with state-of-the-art technologies in an empowered agile environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
As our DevSecOps Engineer, you'll be the driving force behind our secure infrastructure and deployment practices, ensuring our innovative platform continues to deliver exceptional value to users worldwide.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Infrastructure Leadership - Plan and execute infrastructure improvements to guarantee stable feature rollouts in collaboration with feature Squads and architects

* Strong expertise in developing Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform for Azure Cloud Infrastructure and Private Cloud PCF (Pivotal Cloud Foundry).

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
**About The Role**
Seismic is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to advance reliability across our AWS, Azure, IBM Cloud, and OCI environments, working hands-on to build automation, improve observability, and strengthen incident response as part of a globally distributed SRE org. We prioritize a cloud agnostic approach to architecture, automation, and engineering standards to support velocity and scale. You will contribute to our reliability roadmap, provide technical guidance on reliability best practices, participate in major incident response, and work collaboratively across Product & Engineering, Security, and Customer-facing teams.
  
  
Who You Are:
  
  

* Experience in a production facing SRE role supporting a complex SaaS environment.
* You approach discussions about existing solutions, processes, and proposals with curiosity, respect, and a collaborative mindset.
* Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, multi-cloud environments, Kubernetes, networking, various infrastructure technologies, GitOps, and CI/CD.
* Experience establishing and maturing SRE principles and practices, including SLOs, error budgets, observability, capacity planning, incident response, and toil elimination.
* Proficient in using observability data to resolve high-severity incidents and dig deeper into root cause during postmortems.
* Experience leading through high-pressure incidents and communicating clearly with technical teams, executives, customer-facing stakeholders, and third-party vendors.

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering
* 4+ years of experience in Devops roles, with a strong focus on building CI/CD pipelines
* Expertise in Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration tools.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Chef, or Ansible.
* Hands-on experience with observability tools (e.g., New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Proficient in scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).
* Knowledge of event-driven autoscaling and advanced Kubernetes configurations.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Buildkite, Spinnaker or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with modern software development practices such as microservices architecture, containerization, and DevOps.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, high availability and performance optimization.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

**What you’ll be doing:**
**Operating Model:**

* Design, build, and maintain automation and tooling that reduces operational toil.
* Contribute to maturing reliability practices in partnership with Product & Engineering leaders.
* Contribute to an inclusive, high-accountability culture that encourages curiosity, collaboration, and blameless improvement.

**Incident Management and Operational Excellence:**

* Actively participate in the health and continuous improvement of the incident-management lifecycle, including detection, engagement, escalation, mitigation, stakeholder communication, post-incident review, and corrective-action follow-through.
* Participate in a 12-hour follow-the-sun on-call rotation within the Global SRE team.
* Ensure incident practices are customer-centered, data-driven, blameless, and consistent across teams while preserving accurate severity and escalation decisions.
* Use alert, incident, support, and SLO trends to move the organization from reactive response toward proactive risk reduction.
* Build measurable feedback loops that connect incident learning to engineering standards, service maturity, product priorities, and vendor actions.
* Work closely with application engineering teams and incorporate their feedback to improve developer experience and reduce toil.

**Reliability Strategy and Service Maturity:**

* Partner with service owners to ensure production readiness standards are met before each release stage.
* Provide an SRE point of view on capacity planning, resilience testing, game days, disaster-recovery readiness, and modernization of fragile or legacy workloads.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to document critical customer workflows, define health expectations, surface dependencies early, and align reliability investment with business priorities.
* Participate in cross-team reliability engagements, influencing outcomes without relying on direct authority.
* Build strategic relationships with vendors in the observability, incident response, and cloud infrastructure domains.

**AI-First Reliability Engineering:**

* Responsibly adopt AI-assisted and agentic workflows for alert triage, incident mitigation, postmortems, trend analysis, capacity planning, SLO analysis, and self-service knowledge.
* Keep qualified humans in the decision loop for production-impacting actions.
* Improve the context available to reliability workflows by strengthening service metadata, observability data, incident records, runbooks, architecture documentation, and corrective-action quality.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

title: Engineer II - Cloud Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
  
  
At LPL, observability is how a Tier 1 financial firm earns trust at midnight — and Engineer 2 Monitoring engineers spend their day in the dashboards, alerts, and incident channels that make that trust real. You'll grow into observability depth across CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (with the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow inside the Monitoring pod within Foundations, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring close at hand. If you want to learn observability at a Tier 1 financial firm with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the Engineer 2, Cloud Monitoring Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level observability engineer in the Monitoring pod within the Foundations team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support the implementation and operations of LPL's CCOE observability platform across our multi-account landing zone and the hybrid on-premises footprint. The stack spans AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch), Grafana / Prometheus (including Amazon Managed Prometheus and Managed Grafana where appropriate), Dynatrace, the legacy ELK stack where it still exists, and ServiceNow for ITSM and incident ticketing. You partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring, and you partner closely with the Support team on incident response and the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod on the observability paved road for application teams. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in dashboards, alerts, Terraform, and incident response — primarily as a primary on-call responder with support from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, SLO definitions, and runbooks across the CCOE observability stack: CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (and the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow ITSM
* Implement Terraform and Helm changes against the observability paved road; consume the private Terraform module library and raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared observability modules and reference dashboards
* Partner with the Support team on incident response: tune alert routing into ServiceNow, execute runbooks, and feed lessons from incidents back into durable monitoring improvements
* Pair with senior engineers and AVPs in the Monitoring pod on noisy alert chains, missing-signal investigations, and SLO refactors; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day-to-day observability work: AI-assisted alert triage, dashboard drafts from natural-language intent, summary of recent telemetry during incidents via MCP-backed agents, and runbook generation for known incident classes
* Operate as a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 3+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1+ years of hands-on production AWS in a multi-account environment with hands-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Working knowledge of an enterprise observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting — across AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch) and at least one of Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace (or comparable APM), or the ELK stack

**Core Competencies**

* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high-quality, well-tested, code-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description

**Preferences**

* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day-to-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate
