title: Salesforce Dev Ops Administrator
description:
**Job Description**
**R413871**
**Salesforce Dev Ops Administrator**
**Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech CenteThe Lab Integration Platform is a critical enabler ofdigital transformation strategy, supporting secure, compliant, and efficient data exchange across laboratory systems.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**The position**
As a Salesforce DevOps & Digital SDLC Engineer, you will play a key role in leading the Salesforce development lifecycle and deployment activities, owning release governance. You will design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and own digital SLDC adoption, documentation completeness, audit readiness and alignment to SDLC expectations. You will take part in ensuring development teams follow release governance procedures, best practices and principles. You will ensure deployments and documentation are inline with our GxP requirements ensuring we meet our deliverables automation traceability, and audit/inspection readiness.
  
  
**Who are you?**
You are a Salesforce DevOps Engineer who has worked on Salesforce projects. You have experience administering Salesforce platform and a good understanding of the platform and it’s metadata. You understand SDLC controls, regulated delivery, and can help the teams translate delivery work into compliant lifcycle evidence without slowing down agile delivery.
  
  
You possess holistic experience across the platform and are willing to use pro-code and no-code solutions where they are suitable. You enjoy collaborating with the wider Salesforce team and working on cross-functional projects together.
  
  
You are experienced with agile and Scrum methodologies and using deployment tools to support the release management process across multiple sandboxes. In addition, you can support and advise the rest of the team on the topic of Salesforce development lifecycle and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  
  
**What will you do?**
Your primary activities include (but are not limited to)
  
  

* DevOps Using Salesforce tools to commit, analyze, validate, deploy and release changes.
* Perform Release Management activities.
* Design, implement, document and maintain Salesforce Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines.
* Maintain the configuration of Salesforce tools, document development lifecycle and deployment processes.
* Act as the Salesforce team’s Digital SDLC focal point for releases.
* Ensure QAP, RS, DCS, RTM, QASR and other committed deliverables are planned, maintained and completed where applicable.
* Support GxP/regulatory determination, risk profile inputs, traceability, test evidence and release readiness.
* Partner with Product Owners, QA/Compliance, Technical Business Analysts, Technical Delivery teams and Business Unit stakeholders.
* Promote automation such as Jira integration, test management integration, change automation, CI/CD evidence capture and compliance-as-code where appropriate. This is supported by Digital SDLC maturity guidance.
* Coaching and training colleagues.
* Adhering to Salesforce best practices.
* Perform Salesforce Administrator activities.
* Collaborating with IT and developers of other systems to integrate across the business.
* Supporting Salesforce development teams on a daily basis.
* Working closely with business, gathering requirements.
* undefined

**Qualifications, Skills & Experience Required**

* At least 3 years of Salesforce experience.
* At least 2 years of Salesforce DevOps experience using Salesforce DevOps tools such as Copado, Gearset or Flosum.
* Good understanding of git and branching strategies.
* Certified Salesforce Administrator
* Good understanding of Salesforce and it’s Metadata API.
* Knowledge of Salesforce Sales, Service, as well as an understanding of standard Salesforce implementation processes, including design patterns, release management, deployment strategies, and testing.
* Ability to work independently.
* Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with business stakeholders and other Salesforce team members.
* Proficient in Salesforce development lifecycle and environment strategy.
* Ability to write, interpret, and critique technical specifications.
* Experience working with large datasets and bulkification.
* Ability to gather requirements and present and communicate solutions to stakeholders.
* Ability to create and maintain clear, concise, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* Ability to demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a positive team environment.

**Desireable**

* Additional Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Platform App Builder, Salesforce Platform Developer and/or Salesforce Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect.
* A Bachelor’s/Postgraduate degree, a professional qualification, or relevant experience.
* Competency in other programming languages, development tools, DevSecOps and IT in general.
* Demonstrates continued personal and professional development.

title: Cloud Operations Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious Cloud Operations(SRE) Intern to join our CloudOps team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in day-to-day cloud operations, monitoring and incident triage, infrastructure automation and CI/CD, cloud cost management (FinOps), security and compliance, and AI-assisted operations while collaborating with experienced cloud engineers, and application development teams.
  
  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the platform end to end, connect application and business needs to reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud operations, evaluate state-of-the-art automation approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and agentic operations solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the platform architecture (mainly AWS, with some Azure), the multi-account setup across production and non-production environments, service dependencies, deployment workflows, and the main reliability, security, and cost risks.
* Assist with day-to-day cloud operations, including environment health checks, configuration reviews, access requests, backups, and resource inventory, starting in non-production environments under guidance.
* Build and maintain monitoring for cloud services, including CloudWatch metrics, log-based metric filters, alarms, and dashboards, and help tune thresholds to reduce alert noise.
* Participate in incident investigation and log triage; query logs and metrics with tools such as CloudWatch Logs Insights, reproduce issues, support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and turn findings into runbooks and triage playbooks.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation, Terraform) and Python or Typescript automation for repeatable operational tasks, following peer review and change-management practices.
* Support Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure; analyze pipeline results, build logs, and agent failures, and help keep controllers and agents healthy and current.
* Contribute to FinOps work across AWS and Azure, such as cost reporting and dashboards, tagging hygiene, finding idle or unused resources, rightsizing, and Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage reviews.
* Support security and compliance work, including IAM least-privilege reviews, key and secret hygiene, audit evidence collection, and control mapping for SOC 2 and FedRAMP.
* Prototype AI-assisted operations using LLMs, Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as alarm and ticket triage, log summarization, incident analysis, cost anomaly explanation, and runbook maintenance.
* Contribute to the team’s Amazon Bedrock CloudOps prototype, an agentic AI assistant that plans read-only investigations, queries logs, metrics, and platform data through approved tools, uses the team’s playbooks as a knowledge base, and reports findings, with PII masking, guardrails, and human review built in.
* Measure monitoring and automation effectiveness by tracking alert noise, time to detect and resolve incidents, automation coverage, and cost savings, and recommend practical improvements.
* Learn and apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework, SRE principles such as toil reduction, the FinOps lifecycle, and secure operations practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, identity and access management, and virtual networks, along with Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing).
* Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, TypeScript.
* Foundational understanding of source control (Git), CI/CD concepts, APIs, JSON and YAML, SQL, and ticketing tools such as Jira.
* Essential exposure to and conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI, including their practical use in software engineering or IT operations.
* Ability to understand a system end to end, troubleshoot methodically from symptom to cause, learn unfamiliar technologies, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment and learn, with care and discipline around production systems.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills :**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, identity and access management, and virtual networks, along with Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing).

* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment and learn, with care and discipline around production systems.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Hands-on exposure to AWS, and ideally Azure, through coursework, labs, or personal projects; entry-level certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) are a plus.

* Academic, personal, or open-source projects involving cloud infrastructure, automation, monitoring, cost analysis, or AI-assisted and agentic workflows.

**Who We Are**

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About Us

Agivant is a new-age AI-First Digital and Cloud Engineering services company that drives Agility and Relevance for our client’s success.

Powered by cutting-edge technology solutions that enable new business models and revenue streams, we help our clients achieve their trajectory of growth.

Agility is a core muscle, an integral part of the fabric of a modern enterprise. To succeed in an ever-changing business environment, every modern organization needs to adapt and renew itself quickly. We help foster a more agile approach to business to reconfigure strategy, structure, and processes to achieve more growth and drive greater efficiencies.

Relevance is timeless and is the only way to survive and thrive.

The quest for relevance defines the exponential acceleration of humanity. This has presented us with a slew of opportunities, but also many unprecedented challenges. With technology-led innovation, we help our customers harness these opportunities and address myriad challenges.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Senior Automation Engineer – Jenkins Administration & CI/CD Integrations**
to join a dedicated Agivant engineering pod. This role is ideal for a hands-on Jenkins expert with strong experience in Jenkins administration, pipeline automation, GitLab integration, and CI/CD troubleshooting.

You will play a key role in optimizing CI/CD workflows by integrating GitLab with Jenkins, automating repository configurations, and developing reliable webhook-based integrations. The primary objective is to reduce manual effort, improve pipeline reliability, and streamline configurations across 40+ repositories.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Jenkins Administration:**
  Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Jenkins environments, including jobs, pipelines, plugins, credentials, agents/nodes, and build execution.
* **CI/CD Pipeline Management:**
  Develop, optimize, and maintain Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy scripting. Ensure reliable pipeline execution and efficient build and deployment workflows.
* **GitLab–Jenkins Integration:**
  Configure and maintain GitLab integrations with Jenkins, enabling automated pipeline triggers through webhooks and repository events.
* **Webhook Integration & Routing:**
  Configure and troubleshoot webhook delivery from GitLab to multiple downstream Jenkins pipelines. Develop or maintain intermediary services such as RelayProxy, or configure suitable tunneling and routing tools where required.
* **Automation & Infrastructure as Code:**
  Develop and maintain Terraform configurations to automate repository-related setup and configuration migration from Gerrit to GitLab.
* **API-Based Automation:**
  Use GitLab REST APIs and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Go to automate configurations, validate migrations, and reduce repetitive manual work.
* **Bulk Repository Configuration:**
  Execute and validate automated configuration changes across 40+ repositories, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
* **Monitoring & Troubleshooting:**
  Diagnose Jenkins build failures, webhook delivery issues, plugin conflicts, agent connectivity problems, authentication errors, and CI/CD integration bottlenecks.
* **Documentation & Operational Support:**
  Maintain technical documentation, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures while ensuring reliable day-to-day CI/CD operations.

**Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD engineering, build and release automation, or Jenkins administration.
* **Strong hands-on expertise in Jenkins administration**
  , configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting in production environments.
* Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy.
* Strong understanding of Jenkins architecture, controller-agent configuration, plugins, credentials management, build execution, and pipeline security.
* Practical experience integrating Jenkins with GitLab using webhooks, repository events, APIs, and authentication mechanisms.
* Experience troubleshooting pipeline triggers, failed builds, webhook delivery, and connectivity issues.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, preferably Python, Bash, or Go.
* Working knowledge of GitLab REST APIs and Git-based repository management.
* Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for configuration automation.
* Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, network routing, reverse proxies, webhook payloads, and request/response handling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating CI/CD integrations or repository configurations from Gerrit to GitLab.
* Experience developing custom webhook relay or proxy services to route events to multiple Jenkins pipelines.
* Familiarity with Docker, Linux administration, Git, and CI/CD security best practices.
* Experience managing Jenkins at scale across multiple repositories, teams, or build agents.
* Experience automating repetitive administrative tasks through APIs and Infrastructure as Code.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a
**Jenkins-first engineer who can administer, optimize, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD systems hands-on**
. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab integrations, writing automation scripts, and using Terraform where required.

Candidates with strong Jenkins administration and pipeline expertise, supported by practical GitLab integration and automation experience, will be preferred over candidates whose experience is limited to general DevOps operations.

You will work with reliability initiatives, drive platform improvements, and partner with multiple engineering teams to build resilient, scalable services. AI-enabled operations, observability, and automation will be core components of your approach to reliability engineering.

* Manage and optimize complex CI/CD pipelines including automated testing, blue-green deployments, and canary releases
* Optimize Kubernetes environments for availability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency

* Troubleshoot and resolve large-scale reliability, latency, and performance issues

* Implement cloud security, identity, access control, and infrastructure governance best practices
* Drive incident management, root-cause analysis, and operational improvement initiatives

title: People Tech Application Engineer
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
  
  
The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
  
  
The People Team drives Snap’s values of being kind, smart, and creative across our global workforce. We help teams hire thoughtful and passionate innovators, do their best work, grow their careers, and build healthy, productive workspaces in a safe and cohesive community.
  
  
We’re looking for a technical hands engineer for our newly formed application development team in India. The People tech team is building the next generation AI powered HR software suite for Snap and looking to accelerate the deployment of these transformative full-stack software solutions. This role is for a hands-on technical developer who can translate product management ideas, stakeholder needs, and People Team priorities into clear product designs, technical specifications, prototypes, executable engineering plans, and consumer-grade solutions.
  
  
This person will code, architect, and build. They will also be responsible for reviewing PRs and test plans, writing technical design documents, building, testing and deploying brand new solutions.
  
  
What you’ll do:
  
  

* Translate product management ideas and business concepts into product designs, technical specifications, prototypes, and implementation plans.
* Partner across Product, People, HR Technology, IT, Security, Legal, Finance, and Engineering teams to understand requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and deliver solutions that support People Team products and services.
* Contribute directly to the codebase, developing production code, reviewing pull requests, and resolving complex technical issues, building and testing solutions.
* Architect scalable People Tech solutions that support internal tools, workflow automation, integrations, reporting, AI-enabled experiences, and operational processes.
* Own the quality of technical design by writing, reviewing, and approving technical design documents and PRs.
* Advocate for and apply best practices for availability, scalability, operational excellence, maintainability, cost management, and production support.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI, LLM, and chatbot solutions into People Tech systems where appropriate.
* Design and develop middleware, APIs, services, and integrations across systems such as Slack, Workday, Jira, Confluence, internal People data services, and other enterprise platforms.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  
  

* Experience with backend services or distributed systems.
* Experience with database design and data modeling.
* Experience with event-driven architectures, including message queues, pub/sub systems, and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware, and integrations across multiple systems.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deploying services to cloud environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and API integration patterns.
* Experience with Workday integrations, automations, and People data workflows.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and other cloud-based services.
* Ability to translate ambiguous product or stakeholder requirements into product designs, technical specs, prototypes, and delivery plans.
* Ability to lead technical design for complex or cross-system initiatives.
* Ability to contribute directly to production code while also managing team delivery.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions.
* Ability to work independently without mature existing infrastructure or support.
* Proven track record of building applications from scratch.
* Ability to evaluate and apply AI/LLM capabilities responsibly in internal tools, workflow automation, and employee-facing experiences.

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent years of experience.
* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, backend services, enterprise integrations, or related technical roles.
* Experience with Node.js, TypeScript, SQL, APIs, and cloud-based application development.
* Experience reviewing production code, technical designs, and test plans.
* Experience translating product requirements or ambiguous stakeholder needs into technical specifications and implementation plans.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, backend services, enterprise integrations, or related technical roles.
* Experience building People Tech, HR Technology, Workday, internal tools, workflow automation, or enterprise platform solutions.
* Experience with Spanner and GCP

description:

* 私たちについて

企業概要
  
  
ログラスはこれまで、Excelのバケツリレーをなくし、経営データを集約する「SaaS」として国内No.1の実績を築いてきました。しかし、私たちが目指すのは「集計作業の効率化」にとどまりません。経営層が「未来の事業をどう伸ばすか」という高度な意思決定を迅速に行える世界です。「経営のコンテキスト」そのものをシステム上で柔軟に定義でき、人員計画や設備投資など様々なアプリケーションがシームレスにつながる「経営の意思決定プラットフォーム」をゼロから構築しています。
  
  
顧客の企業価値向上と社会全体の「良い景気」の実現にチャレンジしています。ログラスでは、個人・組織が飛躍的に成長するために、以下の6つバリューを設けています。
  
  
Feed Forward すべての行動は、未来への前進のために。
  
  
But We Go どんな壁でも、必ず越える。
  
  
Fail Fast 爆速で挑戦し、失敗から学ぶ。
  
  
Moon Shot 夢を掲げる。高みへ挑む。
  
  
Customer Win お客様と、ともに勝利する。
  
  
Clean Fight 正々堂々と、闘う。
  
  
株式会社ログラス 採用サイト
  
  
会社紹介資料
  
  

* ポジションについて

募集背景
  
  
ログラスが推進するマルチプロダクト戦略の中で、限られた人員でプロダクトの急増を支えるために、クラウド基盤チームはAmazon EKSを基盤とした共通コンピュート基盤の構築・本格展開に取り組んでいます。
  
  
「インフラを整える」にとどまらず、開発チームがチケット依頼なしに自律的にデプロイ・運用できるプラットフォームを構築するPlatform Engineeringの推進フェーズに入っており、2026年度内の本格稼働開始を目指して活動しています。共にリードしていくメンバーを募集しています。
  
  
仕事内容
  
  
ログラスのあらゆるプロダクトに横串で関わりながら、Amazon EKSを中核とした共通コンピュート基盤（Platform）の設計・開発・運用と、SREプラクティスの組織全体への展開を通じて、全プロダクトの信頼性向上に貢献していただきます。
  
  
現在はPlatform Engineeringへの本格転換フェーズにあります。ArgoCD（GitOps）＋ Helmチャートによる宣言的プラットフォームを整備し、開発チームがvalues.yamlのみを管理すれば短時間でデプロイできる仕組みを実現しました。
  
  
今後は全プロダクトへの展開を推進しながら、Observability・Security・Incidentの各領域をプラットフォームに統合し、「SREを努力から仕組みへ」変えていくことがミッションです。
  
  
各開発チームがセルフサービスで自律的にデプロイ・運用でき、信頼性を高め続けられるプラットフォームと開発文化の構築をリードしていただきます。Platform Engineeringの推進と、開発チームへの伴走支援という、SREとしての広範な活動を担っていただきます。
  
  
具体的な業務内容
  
  
EKSベースの共通コンピュート基盤の設計・開発・運用と、SREプラクティスの組織全体への展開を担っていただきます。
  
  

* EKSベースの共通コンピュート基盤の設計・開発・運用

+ ArgoCD（GitOps）＋ Helmチャートによる宣言的プラットフォームの設計・運用
+ Karpenter / HPA / KEDAを用いたキャパシティ管理・最適化
+ TerraformによるIaC推進とプラットフォームの継続的改善

* Platform Engineeringの推進・開発者体験の向上

+ Golden Path（サービス立ち上げの標準パス）の構築・改善
+ セルフサービス化の推進（チケット依頼ゼロを目指す開発者体験の実現）
+ Namespace / RBACによる組織境界の設計とガードレール整備

* SREプラクティスの組織展開・イネーブリング

+ Datadogを活用したObservability基盤の整備・高度化
+ インシデントコマンダー体制の運営・育成とポストモーテム文化の醸成
+ 開発チームへのSRE原則の導入支援、アラート・モニタリングの自律管理化促進

将来的な構想について
  
  
クラウド基盤チームでは、Amazon EKSを基盤とした共通コンピュート基盤の構築を進めており、一部プロダクトではすでに本番環境への展開を開始しています。
  
  
年度内の全プロダクトへの移行完了・本格稼働開始を目標に活動しています。
  
  
限られた人員でプロダクトの急増に対応するため、EKSを用いたプラットフォームで開発チームのセルフサービス化を実現し、さらにAI/LLMワークロードの増加に伴うインフラ認知負荷もプラットフォームで吸収できる設計を見据えています。
  
  
Platform Engineering実践の取り組みについては、AWS Summit 2026の事例共有にも採用されたので、登壇資料をぜひご覧ください。
  
  
スタートアップにAmazon EKSは早すぎる？ マルチプロダクト戦略を加速する Platform Engineeringの実践
  
  
開発に使っている主なツール
  
  

* インフラ：AWS, GCP, IaCツールとしてTerraform
* モニタリング/監視：Datadog, Sysdig
* CI/CD：GitHub Actions / AWS Code Pipeline
* AI：Claude Code / Cursor / Gemini など
* その他：Slack / Gather / Figma / Findy team＋ / Notion / diaglams.net
* 要件

MUST
  
  

* クラウドインフラ（AWS）を使ったインフラの構築運用経験（3年以上）

+ 特に提供するインフラをコード化しながら、構築・運用をした経験

* コンテナ技術（Docker / Kubernetes等）を用いたインフラの構築・運用経験
* ソフトウェアエンジニアとしてアプリケーションの開発経験（学習/実務問わず）

+ アプリ開発チームがやっていることを理解するために、Web開発の経験を求めています
+ 開発言語などは特に指定はありません

* 採用・技術発信などを通して、事業成長へコミットする意思がある方

WANT
  
  

* Platform Engineeringの理解・実践経験
* GitOps（ArgoCD / Flux 等）の経験
* Helm 等のKubernetesパッケージ管理経験
* SREプラクティスの理解・実践経験
* マルチプロダクトサービス運用のご経験
* セキュリティ対策への関与経験
* ドキュメント整備・属人性排除への主体的な取り組み経験

参考記事
  
  
SREを「努力」から「仕組み」へ — Platform Engineeringという選択 Platform Engineeringをどう進めてきたか ─ 使われるプラットフォームにするために大事にしたこと

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
  
  
UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with very large distributed systems
* Knowledge of design process
* Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**

description:

:

10. Coordinate patch management/Remediation activities for all IT assets (workstations, network, server, application, database etc.)
11. Develop and Monitor patch deployment schedules for all Vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on an ongoing basis as well as auditing for completeness
12. Provide communications across the organization, interfacing senior leadership on vulnerability remediation, driving security hardening best practices, and representing the Vulnerability and Patch Management team
13. Maintain relationship with managed security services vendor leadership to ensure effective implementation and operation of security programs, ongoing support and deployment of competent resources
14. Oversee the development, implementation and maintenance of vendor standard operating procedures/ run book in line with SBI Card policies & standards
15. Provide technical & program management expertise and oversight over vendor teams
16. Monitor vendor SLAs, perform regular review with vendor management and report to SBI Card leadership
17. Ensure process documentation and compliance adherence

**Measures of Success:**

1. Reduction in security vulnerabilities in SBI Card IT platforms
2. Number of enhancement opportunities identified for the security posture to reduce overall risk to SBI Card
3. Reduction in information leakage and exploitation from vulnerabilities
4. Security metrics / SLA / KPIs are within acceptable threshold
5. Timely updation of Application Security & Vulnerability Management related standards and SOPs and other documents
6. No adverse observations in Internal / External Audits
7. Process Adherence as per MOU.

**Technical Skills / Experience / Certifications:**

1. Understanding of Vulnerability Management Program including Assessment and Remediation
2. Experience analyzing risk and prioritization of vulnerabilities, validating vulnerability reports and driving remediation.
3. Understanding of the overall threat and vulnerability management process, including metrics to measure performance
4. Working knowledge of compliance frameworks and security management standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF. PCI-DSS etc.)
5. Thorough understanding of enterprise security controls, network protocols and operating system (Windows/Linux environments).
6. Strong knowledge in industry standard VAPT tools like Nessus, Rapid7, AWS Inspector and open-source tools.

**Competencies critical to the role:**

1. Stakeholder Management
2. Analytical ability
3. Innovation & Problem Solving
4. Market Awareness

**Qualification**
: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science / Engineering, master’s in computer science.

**Preferred Industry**
: BFSI / NBFC /E-commerce/IT & ITES / Telecom

title: Manager Technology | Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Technology Intern
description:
**About Credgenics**

Credgenics is a technology-driven, SaaS-based debt collections and NPA resolution platform backed by investors including Accel Partners and Titan Capital. We work with banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and digital lending firms to improve collections efficiency through technology, automation, intelligence and digital workflows. Our platform helps financial institutions improve recovery outcomes, operational efficiency, reach and customer experience.

**The Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic Technology Interns who are eager to learn, build and solve real-world engineering problems in a fast-paced product environment. Depending on their skills and interests, interns may contribute to backend services and APIs, frontend web applications, or DevOps and cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to develop, test, deploy and maintain reliable software systems while learning industry-standard engineering practices.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Backend Development: Support the development and maintenance of backend services, REST APIs and database-driven applications.
* Frontend Development: Build and improve user-facing web features using JavaScript and React.js, with HTML and CSS.
* DevOps & Cloud: Assist with application deployments, cloud services, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation and monitoring.
* Write clean, readable and maintainable code, and participate in debugging, testing and code reviews.
* Work with databases and APIs to support reliable data flow between application components.
* Collaborate with backend, frontend, QA and DevOps engineers to deliver integrated product features.
* Help identify and troubleshoot performance, reliability and deployment issues.
* Document technical work and follow team practices for source control, testing, security and release management.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech/BE, MCA or a related technical degree.
* Strong fundamentals in programming, data structures, algorithms and problem-solving.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript or a similar language.
* For frontend work: familiarity with JavaScript, React.js, HTML5, CSS and responsive web design.
* For backend work: understanding of REST APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases and basic software design principles.
* For DevOps work: basic familiarity with Linux/Unix, AWS or another cloud platform, Git, Docker, scripting or CI/CD concepts.
* Familiarity with Git or another source-control tool; exposure to testing and debugging is an advantage.
* Curiosity to learn new technologies, attention to detail, good communication and a collaborative mindset.
* Ownership, adaptability and a willingness to work in a fast-paced, product-focused environment.

**Good to Have**

* Academic, personal or internship projects in web development, backend engineering, cloud or automation.
* Exposure to microservices, system design basics, CI/CD tools, Docker, AWS services, infrastructure as code or monitoring tools.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, unit testing and code reviews.

**Why Credgenics?**

Join a collaborative, fast-paced technology environment where you can work on real product challenges, learn from experienced engineers and contribute to technology that is transforming the financial services ecosystem.

**Internship Details**

title: Systems Engineer, AI Platforms - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the Global AI & Knowledge Organization (GAIKO), which leads A&M’s AI strategy, enablement, and knowledge infrastructure. Within GAIKO’s AI & Data organization, the AI Tools team manages the enterprise AI platforms practitioners use in their daily work. The team brings together business needs, vendor capabilities, and firm requirements to evaluate, introduce, and continually improve AI tools for thousands of global practitioners.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As a
**Systems Engineer**
, you will provide technical direction and oversight for A&M’s Enterprise AI tools offering. You will help shape the technology strategy, manage and evolve existing platforms, evaluate new AI capabilities, oversee the enterprise API offering, and govern the MCP integrations and connectors that extend the core platforms.
  
  
This hands-on role requires strong technical expertise in Enterprise AI and SaaS platform management, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and the governance and controls needed to operate these capabilities securely at scale. You will assess capabilities from a technical standpoint, configure approved services, implement appropriate guardrails, and support reliable operation at scale.
  
  
You will work closely with the Product and colleagues across Architecture & Engineering, Enterprise IT, Security, Risk, and Legal to take capabilities from technical evaluation through pilot, deployment, and ongoing operation
  
  

* Manage Existing AI Platforms
* Platform administration: Own configuration and administration of approved platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, including workspaces, feature settings, provisioning, groups, roles, and permissions; automate recurring administrative tasks.
* Capability evaluation: Define and apply technical evaluation criteria for new models, features, and agents within approved platforms, documenting capabilities, performance, and limitations to inform adoption decisions.
* Controls and governance: Identify security and risk control gaps, recommend guardrails, and work with compliance teams (security, risk, legal) to review risks and implement agreed controls for safely rollout capabilities
* Deployment management: Manage the deployment lifecycle for approved capabilities and configuration changes, including approval gates, controlled pilots, phased rollout, post-launch validation, and rollback procedures.
* Service operations: Maintain platform health, operational documentation, and support arrangements; coordinate incident resolution and vendor escalations.
* Manage the Enterprise API Offering
* Offering management: Define and evolve the enterprise API offering, including supported services, technical configurations, service standards, and support requirements
* Access governance: Provision and govern access for approved teams and applications, managing accounts, projects, service identities, model permissions, credential lifecycles, and access ownership.
* Consumption management: Configure available usage limits, budgets, and alerts; monitor consumption and spend and recommend adjustments.
* Service operations: Support API consumers with onboarding, documentation, and troubleshooting; manage service reliability and coordinate responses to vendor changes, deprecations, and incidents.
* Manage MCPs and Connectors
* Integration enablement: Assess and enable MCP connections and native connectors between core AI platforms and enterprise applications, data, and services, including the use of approved MCP wrappers for existing APIs.
* Connection governance: Configure and validate authentication, tool permissions, data boundaries, and permitted actions; conduct access reviews and maintain ownership, dependency, and configuration records.
* Lifecycle and operations: Manage connection health, changes, and support issues; assess capacity and scaling requirements and coordinate improvements or retirement.
* Evaluate New AI Tools
* Evaluation framework: Establish reusable technical frameworks for assessing AI tools and capabilities, defining evaluation criteria, test scenarios, evidence requirements, and decision gates.
* Technical evaluation: Run hands-on security and risk assessments of candidate tools, models, and agents for technical fit and enterprise readiness, including performance, integration requirements, scalability, and supportability; document capabilities, limitations, and gaps.
* Risk and control assessment: Work with Architecture, Security, and other stakeholders to assess technical risks, identify control gaps, and agree requirements for enterprise approval.
* Adoption recommendation: Recommend whether and how to introduce new offerings, documenting the rationale, deployment options, dependencies, implementation effort, and operational requirements.

**Qualifications**

* (At least 8-10+ years of relevant professional experience in systems engineering, SaaS administration, Enterprise AI platform management, or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience managing Enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, including configuration, access management, platform controls, and production support.
* Strong understanding of LLM platform capabilities, including models, features, and agents.
* Advanced knowledge of AI workflow design, security, and risk management
* Experience defining and applying technical evaluation criteria, with strong judgment in assessing architectural fit, performance, integration dependencies, controls, scalability, and deployment options.
* Strong working knowledge of REST APIs and webhook integrations, including authentication, service identities, credential management, usage limits, consumption monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of MCP, including client-server interactions, tool discovery and invocation, authentication, permission scopes, and how existing APIs can be exposed through MCP wrappers.
* Working knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, including SSO, SAML or OpenID Connect, SCIM provisioning, and role-based access controls.
* Ability to use administrative consoles, logs, API testing tools, and lightweight scripts in Python, PowerShell, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Experience managing SaaS service lifecycles, including controlled pilots, release testing, deployment, change management, monitoring, incident resolution, vendor escalation, and retirement.
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings, communicate controls and guardrails, document operational procedures, and work effectively across product, engineering, IT, and security teams.
* Experience supporting MCP services at enterprise scale, including hosted service dependencies, capacity planning, and operational efficiency
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 integrations, or Power Automate.
* Experience with risk monitoring and enterprise controls such as data loss prevention, audit logging, retention, and access reviews.
* Experience in consulting, professional services, or another environment with complex client-data requirements.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

The hands-on Solution Architect is responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of cohesive technical solutions across BCG business, primarily focusing on implementation of new solutions, solution enhancements, and system/data integration. The Solution Architect likely will be aligned with one or more business area, such that they can develop a thorough understanding of the business and drive consistency and integration across solutions for that business area. They will also maintain awareness of emerging technologies relevant to their areas of expertise and responsibility.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a highly motivated strategic thinker, engaging collaborator, and effective influencer. Key objectives of the role are to drive digital transformation and the strategic and tactical use of technology to deliver business capabilities, while the organization with cutting edge technologies in a high paced environment. Critical to the Solution Architect’s success is their ability to drive projects and teams to deliver results for the business, balanced with adherence to standards and processes. The Solution Architect will also facilitate cross-enterprise coordination, ensuring that we accommodate requirements across the business and address system integration needs for solutions. They will also work as an interface point with strategic partners, determining where they may offer value to business partners and facilitating coordination on joint initiatives.

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Essential Education**

* Master’s Degree in Computer Science
* 14 years of work experience + 10 years of experience designing and implementing business critical applications in multi-region environments +1 year of deep exposure to LLM based business applications

**Essential Experience & Job Requirements**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a software developer, preferably in multitenant/SaaS projects
* Work experience as a Solutions Architect in at least one project
* Demonstrated hands-on Solution Architect experience; able to build reference implementations and unblock teams.
* Strong experience with AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, equivalents) and safe enterprise usage.
* Familiarity with GenAI dev platforms (e.g., AI Studio, Replit, Devin, equivalents) for rapid prototyping.
* Deep expertise in agent patterns (RAG, tool use, planning, memory, guardrails, HITL) and production operations.
* Experience with agent orchestration/deployment (CI/CD, runtime, monitoring, incident response).
* Experience building/managing MCP ecosystems (registry, access, versioning, performance/cost controls).
* Critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex technical challenges
* Experience in conducting technical assessments and feasibility studies
* Advanced Expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and practices

* Experience with one or more application development languages and/or system integration platforms
* Knowledge of and exposure to Azure and AWS application services, including serverless solutions.
* Excellent collaboration skills, evidence of building highly effective partnerships with projects, vendors, peer architects, security teams and operational Service lines and engagement with senior stakeholders
* Provide technical coaching and mentoring, actively keeps current with developments
* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects, at times with conflicting priorities with a strong track record of delivery
* Ability to estimate tasks and workload to achieve deliverables and goals, delivering on time and on estimation
* Ability to work with multiple external teams and accomplish shared goals
* Demonstrated ability to constantly learn outside of a classroom environment, and successfully apply learnings

title: Reflections Info Systems - Senior Performance Engineer - JVM/Linux
description:
**Job Description**
6+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in Performance Engineering - Application Performance Management.
  
  
Proven experience troubleshooting complex performance issues in enterprise applications.
  
  
Strong understanding of JVM internals, memory management, threading, GC, CPU and I/O behavior.
  
  
Strong Linux troubleshooting skills.
  
  
Ability to independently perform performance analysis and identify root causes rather than only execute predefined performance test scripts.
  
  
Experience working with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and database teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Lead end-to-end application performance engineering and troubleshooting activities.
* Analyze application and server performance issues across development, test, and production environments.
* Perform detailed Linux system-level performance analysis, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, processes, and system resource utilization.
* Analyze JVM heap dumps to identify memory leaks, excessive object creation, and memory-related bottlenecks.
* Analyze thread dumps to identify deadlocks, thread contention, blocked/waiting threads, thread pool issues, and CPU-consuming threads.
* Perform Garbage Collection (GC) analysis, including GC logs, pause times, heap utilization, allocation patterns, and JVM tuning opportunities.
* Conduct database performance analysis, including slow queries, execution plans, connection pools, locks, waits, indexing, and database resource utilization.
* Generate and analyze flame graphs for identifying CPU hotspots and application-level performance bottlenecks.
* Use application and server-side monitoring/observability tools to identify performance degradation and correlate application, infrastructure, and database metrics.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of performance incidents and provide actionable recommendations.
* Work with development teams to identify inefficient code paths, resource utilization issues, memory problems, and concurrency-related bottlenecks.
* Define performance baselines and monitor application performance against agreed SLAs/SLOs.
* Lead performance optimization initiatives and validate improvements through benchmarking and load testing.
* Prepare technical performance reports, bottleneck analysis, and optimization recommendations.
* Mentor junior performance engineers and provide technical leadership across performance engineering initiatives.

**Primary Skills**
Candidates must have strong hands-on experience with:
  
  

* Linux - system-level troubleshooting and performance analysis
* Heap Dump Analysis
* Thread Dump Analysis
* Garbage Collection / GC Analysis
* Database Performance Analysis
* Flame Graphs
* Application-side Monitoring
* Server-side Monitoring
* JVM performance troubleshooting and tuning
* Application performance bottleneck identification
* Root-cause analysis and performance optimization

**Secondary Skills**

* Java/JVM performance engineering
* JProfiler, VisualVM, Eclipse MAT, YourKit or similar profiling tools
* Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or similar observability platforms
* Splunk or ELK for log analysis
* APM and distributed tracing
* Kubernetes/container performance monitoring
* SQL performance tuning
* Load/performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling or similar
* CI/CD performance monitoring and engineering
* Cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or GCP

**Role Description**
Job Summary
  
  
UST is looking for an experienced
**SCCM / MECM Administrator**
with 5–8 years of system administration experience. The role focuses on administering and maintaining enterprise Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager environments, ensuring endpoint health and reliability, and supporting administration and deployment activities. Strong
**SCCM / MECM**
expertise and
**PowerShell scripting**
capabilities are essential.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform daily administration, maintenance, and monitoring of SCCM / MECM infrastructure, including primary and secondary site servers, distribution points, and management points.
* Monitor SCCM / MECM client health across enterprise endpoints and troubleshoot client communication and agent installation issues.
* Administer role-based access control, boundary groups, site structures, and endpoint inventory capabilities within SCCM / MECM.
* Participate in SCCM / MECM infrastructure upgrades, hotfix installations, and site maintenance activities.
* Create, test, deploy, and monitor applications and software deployments through SCCM / MECM.
* Manage enterprise endpoint update and patch deployment cycles using SCCM / MECM, including deployment scheduling and maintenance windows.
* Create and maintain queries and endpoint collections based on defined inventory or directory criteria.
* Monitor configuration compliance and support endpoint remediation through SCCM / MECM.
* Use PowerShell scripting to automate SCCM / MECM administration, software deployment, client remediation, and other repeatable endpoint-management activities.
* Generate and maintain operational reporting for areas such as patch compliance, inventory, deployment status, and client health.

Active Directory, CI/CD, Compliance Management

title: Oracle EPM Specialist - IT Architect
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as an IT Architect III and be part of our mission to enable customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. In this role, you'll design and implement effective cloud solutions, focusing on EPM architecture and automation. You'll contribute to technology advancement, transforming on-premise applications into cloud-centric solutions while ensuring reliability and disaster recovery. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, propose innovative approaches, and advance cloud technology. You'll support and guide application owners while maintaining expertise in emerging technologies and industry best practices. Your work will directly impact operations through the implementation of sophisticated machine learning solutions, cloud infrastructure optimization, and the development of scalable IT architectures.  
  
We are seeking an Oracle EPM Consultant with strong expertise in Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS) to support, develop, and optimize enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting solutions.

The consultant will serve as the primary functional and technical resource for EPBCS, ensuring application stability, data accuracy, security, and performance during planning and financial close cycles. This role involves translating business requirements into scalable solutions, managing integrations, troubleshooting issues, and delivering application enhancements.

Working closely with Finance, IT, implementation partners, and Financial Systems leadership, the consultant will take ownership of knowledge transfer and support the execution of the EPM roadmap. Exposure to PCMCS and EDMCS is desirable, with these applications representing a secondary area of responsibility.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**EPBCS Solution Design & Development**

* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs, technical specifications, and EPBCS solutions.
* Configure and maintain planning applications, dimensions, hierarchies, forms, dashboards, navigation flows, task lists, and approval workflows.
* Develop and optimize business rules, calculation scripts, member formulas, and allocation logic using Calculation Manager and, where applicable, Groovy.
* Support planning models across scenarios, versions, entities, currencies, and business units.
* Enhance budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and management reporting processes.
* Configure and support relevant EPBCS frameworks, such as Financials, Workforce based on business requirements.

**Data Integration & Management**

* Configure, administer, and monitor Data Integration/Data Exchange processes, data mappings, pipelines, and import/export definitions.
* Manage actuals, budget, forecast, and metadata integrations between EPBCS and source systems.
* Validate and reconcile financial data to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system owners to assess dependencies and resolve integration issues.
* Automate routine data loads, metadata updates, and application processes using EPM Automate, REST APIs, or scripting.

**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide functional and technical support during budgeting, forecasting, financial close, and reporting cycles.
* Investigate and resolve data load failures, mapping errors, calculation issues, validation failures, and performance problems.
* Support users with forms, dashboards, approvals, reporting, and Smart View queries.
* Perform root cause analysis, implement preventive fixes, and manage Oracle Service Requests through resolution.
* Monitor scheduled jobs, business rules, integrations, and application performance.

**Security, Maintenance & Release Management**

* Administer user access, predefined roles, application permissions, and dimension-level security.
* Review monthly Oracle EPM release notes, assess impacts, and coordinate regression testing.
* Manage controlled migration of application changes across development, test, and production environments.
* Maintain application backups, configuration documentation, support runbooks, and operating procedures.
* Follow change management processes and support audit and internal control requirements.

**Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Finance and IT teams to improve planning processes, application usability, and operational efficiency.
* Assess the downstream impact of application and integration changes.
* Lead knowledge transfer from implementation partners and establish sustainable application support practices.
* Work with Financial Systems leadership to prioritize enhancements and deliver EPM roadmap initiatives.

**Secondary Support – PCMCS & EDMCS**

* Provide limited support for PCMCS allocation models and profitability processes, as required.
* Assist with EDMCS metadata updates, hierarchy maintenance, and subscriptions.
* Coordinate with application specialists for complex PCMCS and EDMCS requirements.

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience implementing, developing, or supporting Oracle EPBCS/EPM Planning applications.
* Understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial close dependencies.
* Experience with dimensions, forms, dashboards, approval workflows, business rules, calculation scripts, and Smart View.
* Strong knowledge of Essbase concepts, multidimensional modeling, and calculation performance optimization.
* Experience with Data Integration/Data Exchange, data mappings, metadata management, and financial data reconciliation.
* Experience managing application security, migrations, monthly update testing, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to translate Finance requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Groovy, EPM Automate, REST APIs, and scripting.
* Experience with EPBCS Financials, Workforce.
* Exposure to Oracle ERP or other financial source-system integrations.
* Familiarity with PCMCS and EDMCS.

title: Senior SOC Verification Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (*SCHIE*) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the **Verification & Validation** team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a **Sr SOC Verification Engineer** to join the team to support our mission and culture. This key role will impact the organization by **driving SoC verification strategy and execution for complex IP/SOC designs.**

#SCHIE #CSME

  
  
**Responsibilities**

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

* Establish yourself as an integral member of a pre-silicon SoC verification team, owning aspects of SoC verification, and aligning with architecture, design, firmware, and emulation.
* Become knowledgeable on the overall SoC architecture.
* Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies.
* Apply your knowledge of SoC verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral.
* Run tests, correlate results with architecture, debug failures to root cause, and recommend fixes.

title: Digital Sol/Serv Line Sr Manager
description:
**Title:** Technical Solutions Architect
  
  
**Practice:** AI Contact Center Transformation
  
**Focus:** Technical Architecture, Platform Engineering, Integration Design (Presales Early Delivery)
  
  
ROLE SUMMARY
  
  
The Technical Solutions Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing, validating, and architecting AI-powered contact center solutions that are scalable, secure, and operationally sound. You translate business requirements into detailed technical blueprints, working closely with presales teams, Solution Consultants, and client IT/engineering stakeholders to ensure solutions are feasible, performant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Your primary focus is on the technical design and integration strategy—ensuring that AI agents, CCaaS platforms, CRM systems, and enterprise data layers work together seamlessly. You will lead technical discovery, design solution architectures, validate integrations, and provide the engineering guardrails that enable successful delivery by POD teams.
  
  
You ensure that what we sell can actually be built—and built well.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
1. Technical Discovery Infrastructure Assessment
  

* Lead technical discovery sessions with client IT, telephony, and infrastructure teams to assess current environment and readiness.
* Evaluate existing CCaaS platforms (Genesys Cloud/Engage, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Twilio, etc.) for AI agent integration capabilities.
* Assess CRM such as ServiceNow/MS Dynamics/Salesforce, knowledge base, and backend system APIs for data accessibility, and integration feasibility.
* Analyze telephony infrastructure (SIP trunking, IVR legacy systems, call routing) and identify migration or integration requirements.
* Identify technical risks, constraints, and dependencies (network latency, API rate limits, data compliance, PII/PCI requirements).

2. AI Agent CCaaS Platform Architecture Design
  

* Design end-to-end technical architectures for AI agent deployments, including conversational AI platforms, LLM orchestration, knowledge retrieval (RAG), and real-time integrations.
* Define integration patterns between AI agent platforms and CCaaS environments.
* Architect omnichannel solutions spanning voice, chat, SMS, and digital channels with consistent agent behavior and context management.
* Design call flow logic, escalation routing, fallback strategies, and human-in-the-loop handoff mechanisms.
* Define data flow diagrams, API contracts, authentication/authorization schemes (OAuth, API keys, SSO), and middleware requirements.

3. Integration Data Architecture
  

* Design integration architecture for connecting AI agents to backend systems: CRMs, ERPs, billing systems, knowledge bases, and ticketing platforms.
* Define data schemas, payload structures, and real-time vs. batch integration strategies.
* Architect secure data handling for PII, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR-compliant environments, including data masking, encryption, and audit logging.

4. Platform Selection Technical Validation
  

* Conduct technical proof-of-concepts (POCs) and feasibility studies to validate platform capabilities, integration complexity, and performance benchmarks.
* Assess CCaaS native AI capabilities vs. third-party AI agent platforms to determine optimal architecture.
* Define build vs. buy strategies for conversational components, analytics, and quality management tools.

5. Presales Technical Enablement RFP Response
  

* Partner with Solution Consultants during presales to provide technical depth, validate feasibility, and design proposed architectures.
* Lead technical portions of client presentations, solution demos, and architecture review sessions.
* Author technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs, including architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and infrastructure requirements.
* Articulate technical differentiators, platform advantages, and engineering best practices to client technical stakeholders.
* Defend solution designs against client technical objections and provide alternative approaches when needed.

6. SOW Scoping Engineering Handoff
  

* Define detailed technical scope for Statements of Work (SOWs), including integration points, data requirements, infrastructure dependencies, and deliverables.
* Specify technical assumptions, constraints, and exclusions to protect delivery feasibility and margins.
* Create engineering handoff documentation: architecture diagrams, integration specs, API documentation, and technical requirements.
* Conduct transition sessions with Delivery PODs to ensure technical intent, design rationale, and risk mitigation strategies are clearly understood.
* Participate in design reviews and critical milestones (e.g., technical design approval, integration validation, UAT) to ensure delivery aligns with architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Presales, or Platform Engineering, with a focus on contact center or enterprise communication platforms.
* Deep CCaaS Expertise: Hands-on experience with at least two major CCaaS platforms (Genesys Cloud/Engage, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Twilio Flex, Cisco Webex Contact Center).
* AI Agent Conversational AI Knowledge: Familiarity with AI agent platforms, LLM orchestration, NLU/NLP, intent recognition, dialogue management, and knowledge retrieval (RAG).
* Integration Architecture: Proven experience designing RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware , and real-time data integration patterns.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and defend architectural decisions with technical teams.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; understanding of compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AI agent platforms
* Hands-on experience with telephony protocols
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, utilities) with PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR compliance requirements.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect) or CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Five9, NICE).

KEY SUCCESS METRICS
  

* Quality and feasibility of technical architectures and integration designs.
* Client technical stakeholder confidence in proposed solution and delivery approach.
* Accuracy of technical scoping in SOWs (minimal scope creep or technical surprises during delivery).
* Successful engineering handoffs with clear, actionable technical documentation.
* Delivery POD velocity and technical alignment with original architecture vision.
* Contribution to won deals through technical credibility and solution differentiation.

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
