The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects

* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.

title: Digital Product Professional
description:

We are seeking an experienced digital product professional to lead the strategy, development, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of customer-facing mobile applications. The role requires strong product ownership, technical understanding, stakeholder management, and experience managing complex digital platforms throughout their lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will combine customer experience expertise with technical product knowledge to drive product adoption, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Product Strategy and Ownership**

* Define and manage product vision, roadmaps, feature priorities, and business outcomes for mobile applications.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable deliverables.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, release schedules, dependencies, and delivery priorities.

**Mobile Application Delivery and Technology**

**Customer Experience and Product Optimisation**

**Operations and Partner Management**

**Stakeholder and Performance Management**

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**Principal DevOps / Software Engineer (Cloud Orchestration & Platform Engineering)**

The Software Engineering team delivers next-generation application enhancements and new products for a changing world. Working at the cutting edge, we design and develop software for platforms, peripherals, applications and diagnostics — all with the most advanced technologies, tools, software engineering methodologies and the collaboration of internal and external partners.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Software Principal Engineer on our Software Engineering Team in **Bangalore, India**.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal DevOps / Software Engineer, you will architect, build, and evolve the cloud automation, orchestration, and platform capabilities that power our global development ecosystem. You will work deeply within our VMware‑based infrastructure stack, spanning Aria Automation, Aria Operations, VCF, ESXi, and vCenter, while driving modernization toward next‑generation VCF Operations and AI‑enabled orchestration frameworks.

You will partner closely with our software engineering Scrum teams to deliver resilient, intelligent, and scalable automation services that enhance developer productivity, streamline reservation and deployment workflows, and maintain the reliability of critical DevOps tool chains. Your leadership will influence both technology strategy and hands‑on implementation across complex hybrid‑cloud environments.

**You will:**

* Design, implement, and evolve cloud automation and orchestration workflows for VMware‑based platforms, including Aria Automation/Operations and emerging VCF Operations
* Architect and maintain integrations with ServiceNow, reservation systems, deployment services, and asset management platforms supporting global engineering teams
* Develop, enhance, and maintain automation pipelines and services supporting virtual and physical asset provisioning
* Lead modernization initiatives as Aria is modernized, transitioning orchestration capabilities into new VCF‑based platforms and intelligent automation ecosystems
* Create automation frameworks, APIs, and services enabling self‑service provisioning, developer tooling, and global platform operations
* Collaborate closely within Agile/SCRUM teams to design high‑quality automation, observability, and platform capabilities aligned with product engineering needs
* Drive architectural discussions, document solutions, and mentor engineering peers in DevOps engineering, platform automation, and VMware‑centered cloud technologies
* Champion secure-by-design engineering practices, reliable CI/CD methodologies, and scalable operational patterns across the stack

  

**Take the first step towards your dream career**  
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* **8–12 years of professional experience** in DevOps engineering, cloud automation, or software engineering, with senior‑level ownership of infrastructure orchestration and developer‑focused services
* Expert-level proficiency with **VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vCenter, ESXi**, and enterprise‑scale virtualization management
* Extensive hands-on experience with **VMware Aria Automation (vRA/vRealize), Aria Operations, and orchestration tooling**, including lifecycle management, blueprints, policies, and extensibility
* Demonstrated experience architecting and developing **complex automation pipelines**, including API-driven workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and multi‑platform integrations
* Strong programming or scripting expertise (Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or equivalent) for automation, platform integration, and orchestration logic
* Experience integrating DevOps automation with **ServiceNow**, including CMDB synchronization, workflow automation, and custom orchestration triggers
* Deep understanding of **cloud automation frameworks**, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and enterprise DevOps practices
* Strong knowledge of **platform observability**, operational analytics, and distributed system diagnostics
* Ability to lead architectural initiatives, produce clear technical documentation, and mentor cross-functional engineering teams
* Experience operating within Agile/SCRUM teams, influencing strategy across multiple software and infrastructure groups
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with global engineering, operations, and platform teams

  

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with **ServiceNow development**, including scripting, custom integrations, API development, and platform configuration
* Exposure to **IPAM solutions** or network services automation (e.g., Infoblox or equivalent)
* Strong familiarity with **Agile/SCRUM methodologies** and enterprise SDLC practices
* Experience with **GitOps** and container‑oriented tooling such as Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, or related platforms
* Exposure to **Agentic AI / GenAI** as applied to workflow automation, intelligent orchestration, or advanced developer tooling
* Experience developing automation for hybrid cloud or multi‑cloud environments
* Understanding of infrastructure security, RBAC models, and enterprise compliance frameworks

  

**Who we are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.  
Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

title: DE-ET-FDE-Senior
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 23, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1743006

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Position: Forward Deployed Engineer – Digital Engineering (Senior)**

EY Consulting Digital Engineering is seeking highly skilled and customer focused Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to operate at the frontlines of enterprise transformation. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, platform architecture, AI-led solutioning, and client value realization, requiring deep hands-on technical expertise combined with strong consulting acumen.

  

**The Opportunity**

As an FDE in Digital Engineering, you will work directly with clients to co-create, engineer, and scale AI-first digital solutions that accelerate business outcomes. You will play a critical role in translating business problems into PDLC-driven solutions, rapidly moving from POCs to enterprise-grade platforms, and embedding GenAI, data, and cloud-native engineering into core business workflows.

You will be instrumental in driving future-ready digital engineering capabilities across product engineering, platform modernization, and AI-enabled transformation programs.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Engagement & Solution Delivery**

* Partner with clients to shape business problems into solution hypotheses aligned to PDLC (Product Delivery Lifecycle).
* Drive co-creation workshops, rapid prototyping, and outcome-led solution design.
* Translate ambiguous requirements into architecture, data flows, and scalable engineering constructs.
* Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning discovery, POC, MVP, and enterprise-scale rollout.
* Anchor business value realization (cycle time reduction, cost efficiency, productivity gains) as part of delivery.

  

**Engineering & Development**

* Build AI-first, cloud-native applications and platforms using modern engineering practices.
* Develop accelerators, reusable components, and engineering patterns for repeatable delivery.
* Work across APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, and composable architectures.
* Integrate GenAI copilots, agents, and automation into enterprise workflows.
* Drive engineering excellence (performance, scalability, resilience, security).

  

**Emerging Technology Enablement**

* Apply and scale cutting-edge capabilities across:
* + Generative AI & Agentic AI (LLMs, copilots, multi-agent systems)
  + Data platforms & real-time intelligence
  + Cloud-native & platform engineering (Azure/AWS/GCP)
  + Automation & intelligent workflows
* Evaluate, incubate, and industrialize new tools, frameworks, and accelerators within DE.
* Contribute to future readiness initiatives (e.g., advanced compute paradigms, next-gen architectures).

  

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with cross-functional squads (architects, data scientists, designers, and product teams).
* Provide technical leadership in FDE engagements, influencing architecture and delivery direction.
* Present value articulation, solution architecture, and outcomes to CXO and senior stakeholders.

  

**Deployment & Support**

* Lead CI/CD, DevSecOps, and production rollout strategies.
* Ensure seamless transition from POC to scaled deployment across environments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues in client environments.
* Drive continuous optimization using telemetry, feedback, and usage insights.

  

**Soft Skills**

* Consulting excellence: Strong client engagement and storytelling skills with ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Outcome orientation: Focus on measurable business impact, not just technical output.
* Architectural mindset: Ability to design modular, composable, scalable digital platforms.
* Bias for action: Thrive in ambiguity with a build-first, iterate-fast mindset.
* Leadership: Ability to guide teams, mentor engineers, and own delivery outcomes.

  

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in digital/product engineering, solution architecture, or FDE/customer-facing engineering roles.
* Strong programming expertise (Python, Java, JavaScript, Go or similar).
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience in distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
* Strong exposure to data engineering, pipelines, and modern data platforms.
* Proven experience in client-facing engagements or consulting-driven delivery models.

  

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Experience working in AI-led engineering / GenAI use cases / intelligent automation
* Exposure to PDLC, product-centric delivery models, or platform engineering
* Experience building POCs and scaling them to enterprise-grade solutions
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking approach
* High adaptability in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset

  

**What Working at EY Offers**

At EY Digital Engineering, you will operate in a high-impact, front-line engineering model, solving real-world business problems using AI, data, and platform engineering at scale.

You will:

* Work on transformative FDE engagements with global clients
* Build industry-leading AI-led digital solutions
* Be part of next-gen engineering transformation (GenAI, agentic systems, platformization)
* Gain access to continuous learning, innovation programs, and leadership opportunities

  

**EY Offers**

* A collaborative environment with global engineering talent and leadership
* Opportunities to drive end-to-end AI-led transformation programs
* Flexible work culture with strong focus on innovation and growth

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-23

  

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a senior, hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Senior Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: Design and implement secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: Architect and integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Technical leadership: Define standards, review code and designs, mentor engineers and work closely with architects, vendors and business stakeholders.

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 7+ years (recommended) in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform – Expert level: Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Expert level: Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - Advanced: REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - Advanced: MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - Advanced: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - Advanced: IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Senior, hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: Strong background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with a strong back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Advanced Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Solid data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, data modelling, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Hands-on technical leader who still writes code and builds solutions.
* Strong architectural thinking, balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Drives large initiatives with ownership, structure and focus on outcomes.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Mentors and raises the technical level of the team.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Site Reliability Engineer Manager
description:
Role Overview:

We're looking for an experienced SRE Manager to lead our Site Reliability Engineering team and own reliability strategy across our Cloud and Kubernetes platforms. You'll combine deep technical credibility with strong people leadership — setting direction, growing the team, and acting as the senior escalation point during the most critical incidents — while partnering closely with engineering and business leadership.

This is a **Rotational Shift role** and an **onsite** position located at Bangalore, India. You will be required to work from the office on a full-time basis. We are only considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.

Position Details:

**About the role:**

* Lead and grow a team of SREs, setting technical direction and reliability strategy across AWS, GCP infrastructure and EKS platforms, and GKE platforms.
* Own the organization's Incident and Problem Management processes, ensuring major incidents are handled efficiently, with timely executive communication and thorough post-incident reviews.
* Drive the team's automation strategy, championing Python-based tooling and frameworks that reduce manual toil and improve reliability at scale.
* Set standards for Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, ensuring secure, scalable, and consistent provisioning practices across teams.
* Define the organization's observability strategy, ensuring Grafana dashboards, alerting, and SQL/CloudWatch-based analysis practices scale effectively.
* Act as a senior escalation point and incident commander for the most critical, high-severity incidents, providing calm, decisive leadership under pressure.
* Partner with senior leadership, product, and engineering stakeholders to communicate risk, reliability posture, and remediation roadmaps clearly and confidently.
* Own hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career development for the SRE team.
* Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents.
* Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones.
* Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks.
* Drive ITSM process maturity across the organization, partnering with other teams to embed Incident and Problem Management best practices.
* Manage on-call structure, escalation paths, staffing, and operational readiness for the team.
* Report on reliability metrics, incident trends, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership.

**About You:**

* You should have 8-12 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or related disciplines, including significant experience leading and managing technical teams.
* You should have deep hands-on expertise with AWS infrastructure and the technical credibility to guide architecture, operational, and reliability decisions across complex cloud environments.
* You should have successfully led teams through complex EKS and GKE operational challenges, demonstrating strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in large-scale distributed systems.
* You should possess advanced proficiency in Python for automation and Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, with the ability to mentor engineers, review technical designs, and establish engineering best practices.
* You should have extensive experience owning and improving Incident and Problem Management processes, along with a strong understanding of observability tools and practices, including Grafana, SQL, CloudWatch Logs Insights, and alerting strategies.
* You should be an exceptional communicator who can clearly articulate technical risks, incident impacts, and reliability strategies to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders while building strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams.
* You should have a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing technical teams, creating an environment focused on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and long-term reliability.
* You should hold an AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) and a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent Kubernetes certification, and you demonstrate strong leadership qualities through strategic thinking, incident leadership, people development, and stakeholder trust.

title: AWS Architect-Lead AI and Data Solutions Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level: Lead**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer II**
As a Lead AI and Data Solutions Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise-scale software solutions, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end-to-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Collaborate with the functional team and client to thoroughly understand business requirements. Oversee technical delivery by providing architectural and implementation recommendations. Lead documentation efforts, ensuring adherence to standards and best practices. Direct the design and development of solutions, ensuring timely delivery according to project plans. Work closely with project leadership to identify and escalate potential risks and prepare status reports. Mentor junior team members and facilitate communication between various teams within the engagement. Respond to proposals by providing accurate estimations and technical input, supporting the overall success and alignment of project objectives with client needs.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 10+ years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Experience in provisioning and spinning up AWS EC2 instances - on-Demand, Spot, dedicated instances, and cost calculation.
* Experience with server less architecture (Lambda), API gateway and RESTful services/JSON etc.
* Experience with one or more relational databases on AWS RDS – Oracle/ SQL Server/ MySQL and/or cloud data warehouse databases such as AWS Redshift
* Exposure to Data migration facilities such as DMS, S3 COPY, streaming, Kinesis, Batch
* Experience in developing applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to DevOps tools, deployment and orchestration technologies such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline etc.
* Experience with monitoring resources and applications using CloudWatch metrics, alarms and logs and tracking user activity, API usage using CloudTrail
* Experience with cloud assessment and migration on-premise workloads onto AWS.
* Expertise in AWS Architecture, Automation Tools and understanding of the agile development process.
* Experience in Migration from on-prem to Cloud using AWS migration tools
* Experience with VPN connectivity between regions and subnets
* Experience with Business Continuity and Disaster Recover design, planning and implementation for cloud infrastructures
* Exposure to one or more - Python, Perl, Ruby or UNIX shell scripting.
* Experience working with AWS Command line utility (CLI) and SDKs.
* Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest & Motion)

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in AWS Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing scripts in one or more languages such as Python, UNIX Scripting and/or similar.
* AWS Certified Associate or Professional

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

**Databricks Data Architect**
to lead the architecture, design, and optimization of our enterprise Databricks Lakehouse platform.

* **Lakehouse Architecture:**
  Design & implement enterprise-scale Databricks Lakehouse solutions leveraging Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and Databricks SQL.
* **Modernization & Migration:**

* **Data Modeling & Performance:**
  Architect Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) models and implement Liquid Clustering, Z-Ordering, partitioning, and cost optimization strategies.
* **Real-time Ingestion:**
  Build robust streaming and batch ingestion frameworks using Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, and Delta Change Data Feed (CDF).
* **Governance & Security:**
  Integrate enterprise security, data quality, lineage, and compliance via Unity Catalog.
* **Automation & DataOps:**
  Establish CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), and Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB).

**💡 Key Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  12+ years in Data Engineering/Architecture, with
  **5+ years specifically in Databricks architecture**
  .
* **Core Tech Stack:**
  Databricks Lakehouse, PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, DLT, and MLflow.
* **Cloud Platform:**
  Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (ADLS Gen2, ADF, Azure Entra ID, Event Hubs).
* **Automation:**
  Hands-on experience with Git, Terraform, Azure DevOps, and DABs.
* **Domain:**
  Banking and Financial Services (BFS) domain experience is highly preferred.
* **Concepts:**
  Deep understanding of Data Mesh principles, Data Products, and enterprise modernization.

title: R&D Platform Engineer – GPQSS Digital- IDC
description:
Platform Engineer
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Platform Engineer to design, build, automate, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable engineering platforms that enable development teams to deliver cloud-native applications faster and with higher quality. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure DevOps, GitOps, observability, and platform automation.
  
  
This role requires strong ownership of developer experience, infrastructure automation, cloud operations, security-by-design, and platform reliability. The candidate will collaborate with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, cybersecurity teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to establish reusable platform capabilities, standards, and self-service solutions across the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Design, build, and maintain internal developer platforms that provide reusable services, templates, pipelines, and automation for application teams.
* Create and manage cloud-native platform components on Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, and container registries.
* Standardize CI/CD pipeline templates using Azure DevOps for build, test, security scanning, deployment, and release automation.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or similar tools to provision and manage consistent environments.
* Enable GitOps and configuration-driven deployment practices for repeatable, auditable, and scalable platform operations.
* Build self-service capabilities for developers, including environment provisioning, deployment templates, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Improve platform reliability through observability, logging, metrics, alerting, SLOs, incident analysis, and continuous operational improvements.
* Integrate platform security controls including secrets management, container security, dependency scanning, image scanning, and policy enforcement.
* Support DevSecOps practices by integrating tools such as SonarCloud, Black Duck, MetaDefender, or equivalent security and quality gates into delivery pipelines.
* Implement authentication, authorization, API gateway, ingress, service mesh, and secure connectivity patterns for platform services.
* Partner with application teams to troubleshoot deployment, performance, networking, availability, and operational issues.
* Define platform standards, reusable architecture patterns, documentation, and best practices to improve developer productivity and governance.
* Evaluate and introduce automation, AI-assisted development, and platform engineering improvements that reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 7+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or cloud-native application delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, container registries, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
* Strong experience in Azure DevOps pipeline design, YAML pipelines, release automation, branching strategies, and reusable pipeline templates.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, ARM/Bicep, or equivalent tools.
* Good understanding of platform engineering concepts such as developer portals, golden paths, self-service automation, reusable templates, and paved-road standards.
* Experience with GitOps tools and practices such as Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent configuration-driven deployment approaches.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of networking, ingress controllers, DNS, certificates, load balancing, API gateways, and secure service-to-service communication.
* Experience with secrets management, identity, access control, OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect, Keycloak, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps, secure SDLC, threat modeling, vulnerability management, dependency scanning, image scanning, and compliance readiness.
* Experience supporting event-driven or distributed systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ, background jobs, or similar integration patterns is an advantage.
* Good understanding of application architecture, microservices, REST APIs, .NET Core, Angular, or full stack development concepts is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex platform and production issues.
* Strong communication, collaboration, ownership, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

The Digital Acceleration Commerce team owns services supporting the publishing, pricing and purchase of Digital content, including Kindle Books, Amazon AppStore, Amazon Music, Amazon Video, etc.
  
  
This candidate will be joining a team working on scalable web services using cloud technologies. The work will be highly visible to Amazon customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, this person will lead the architecture and development of high-scale web services and workflows. A successful candidate will have an established background in designing and developing back-end web services, strong technical skills, a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment, high creativity, and great analytical reasoning skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer III (SDE3) on the Digital Pricing and Promotions team, you will design and build software solutions that power promotional capabilities across Amazon's Digital Acceleration (DA) businesses — including Kindle, Prime Video, and Music. You will own and evolve critical platforms that deliver promotional management, competitive pricing intelligence, and operational automation to pricing managers, business teams, and product managers across DA.
  
  
You will take meaningful ownership of key products — particularly the Promos UI platform — driving features from initial design through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Your work will span full-stack development: crafting user interfaces with modern web technologies, building robust backend services in Java on AWS, and integrating with Retail promotion systems such as PLM (Promotion Lifecycle Management).
  
  
In this role, you will make architectural decisions that balance near-term business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability. You will think across systems — considering performance at scale, multi-business extensibility, and integration with diverse data sources and downstream services. You will lead technical designs independently, engage actively in design reviews, and provide substantive code review feedback that raises the bar for the team.
  
  
Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with operations teams, business stakeholders, Retail promotion platform teams, and partner engineering organizations. You will develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and pain points, translating them into well-designed, reliable solutions. You will champion operational excellence through proactive monitoring, incident response, and identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  
  
Beyond individual delivery, you will help grow the team — mentoring junior engineers, contributing to development best practices, and driving technical improvements that increase the team's overall velocity and reliability. Success in this role means consistently shipping high-quality features that advance our promotional capabilities while setting a strong example for engineering craft and customer focus.

title: Director, Engineering
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Engineering Director to lead the Chennai engineering organization for 2 scrum teams, shared platform resources (Architect, ML Engineer, SDET), and a team of ~20 engineers across backend, frontend, AI, and QA disciplines. You will own delivery accountability, team health, technical quality, and the cross-team coordination that keeps two scrum teams moving in the same direction. You will be the primary technical counterpart to the US-based Product leadership, the direct interface to platform teams, and the person who sets the engineering culture for the entire team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the full Chennai engineering organization (~20 engineers): two Scrum teams, two Engineering Managers, Staff/Senior engineers, Applied ML, and Staff SDET.

* Own delivery accountability: sprint cadence, cross-team dependency management, risk tracking, and executive reporting on engineering progress.

* Set and enforce technical standards: hexagonal architecture discipline, AI-native integration patterns, code quality gates, and observability standards across both teams.

* Act as the primary technical counterpart to US-based Product leadership — translate business requirements into engineering execution plans, surface trade-offs early, and maintain shared understanding of what is being built and why.

* Own the cross-team coordination interface to platform teams (Agentic Engine, Core Platform, ARC backend, Design) — ensuring product dependencies are tracked, escalated, and resolved on schedule.

* Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent: own the full hiring pipeline, define career ladders, conduct performance reviews, and make compensation decisions.

* Drive the technical roadmap for Phase 2 in partnership with the ML Architect, Applied Scientist, and Product leadership — shaping the next wave of AI capabilities.

* Maintain technical depth: actively participate in architecture reviews, challenge design decisions, and unblock engineers on complex distributed systems and AI integration challenges.

* Build and sustain a high-trust, high-accountability engineering culture where engineers feel ownership, psychological safety, and pride in their craft.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership — managing managers and leading teams of 15+ engineers.

* Deep technical background in Java backend systems, distributed microservices, and event-driven architecture — able to engage credibly in architecture reviews and design decisions.

* Proven track record building and operating SaaS platforms on AWS with multi-database stacks (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis/Aerospike).

* Demonstrated experience with hexagonal architecture at scale — enforcing domain isolation as teams and services grow.

* Strong cross-functional leadership: experience working closely with Product Management, Design, and executive stakeholders across geographies (US-India distributed teams).

* Track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent — building teams from the ground up in competitive markets.

* Experience delivering in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with evolving platform dependencies and shifting priorities.

Good to Have

* Experience leading engineering teams building AI-native products (LLM integration, agentic systems, scoring pipelines, MCP tool design).

* Background in martech, customer data platforms, or dealer/automotive technology.

* Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines within the same org.

Exposure Temporal for durable workflow orchestration at the team level.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options.

* Medical insurance coverage.

* Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies.

title: Pyspark Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven **PySpark / Big Data Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Data Pipeline Design & Development**
--------------------------------------

* Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using **PySpark** and **Python** to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage).
* Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as **Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi**.
* Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing.

**Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization**
-------------------------------------------

* Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection.
* Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks).

**Data Modeling & Architecture**
--------------------------------

* Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads.
* Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro).

**Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps**
---------------------------------

* Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as **Apache Airflow**, Prefect, or Dagster.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines.
* Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest).

**Governance, Security & Quality**
----------------------------------

* Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
* Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

**Required Technical Qualifications & Skills**
----------------------------------------------

* **Core Technologies -** Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x
* **Database & Querying -** Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions
* **Data Lake & Lakehouse -** Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC
* **Workflow & Orchestration -** Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows
* **Cloud Platforms -** AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS)
* **Streaming Technologies -** Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Event Hubs, or Kinesis

**Key Competencies & Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Distributed Computing Fundamentals:** In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies).
* **Production Experience:** Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale.
* **Problem Solving:** Proven track record in debugging memory bottlenecks, Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors, and resolving data skew issues.
* **Data Engineering Best Practices:** Experience implementing modular code architectures, logging, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch), and alerting.

**5. Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)**
----------------------------------------------

* Hands-on experience with **Databricks platform** (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon engine, MLflow).
* Familiarity with **Scala/Java** in addition to Python.
* Knowledge of DataOps and Infrastructure as Code (**Terraform**, CloudFormation).
* Experience with modern analytical data warehouses (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift).
* Relevant certifications: *Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional AWS Certified Data Engineer / Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)CCA Spark and Hadoop Developer (or equivalent)*

**6. Educational Requirements**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Validate correct operation of protection schemes by simulating fault conditions and verifying product response.
* Expert in validating and testing industrial communication protocols like IEC 61850, IEC 60870, Modbus, DNP3

* Design, develop, and operate advanced Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Firmware-in-the-Loop (FIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test environments to simulate real-world grid conditions and validate embedded firmware performance.

* Develop and interpret wiring diagrams to ensure accurate system understanding and effective fault isolation.

* Define and implement overall testing strategies including functional, regression, performance, security, and automation testing.

* Perform end-to-end system analysis and design of complex systems (hardware, software, communications).

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in electrical/Electronics/Software Engineering (or) Equivalent
* Minimum 10 to 15 years related Experiences in Protective Relaying & Substation Communication Solutions and Lateral Protection (Medium/High Voltage Products).

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication

Provide architecture leadership, platform ownership and delivery governance for enterprise-scale AWS Data & AI platforms. * Define target-state architecture using AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Athena, Redshift, EMR, MWAA/Airflow, Step Functions, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Lake Formation and lakehouse patterns.
