**APIs, service integration and AWS platform connectivity**

* Define standards for REST APIs, event-driven ingestion, CDC, streaming, file ingestion, database integration, authentication, retries, error handling and dependency monitoring.

**Git connectivity, DevSecOps and platform automation**

* Establish Git connectivity across code repositories, branching strategy, pull requests, code reviews, release controls, artefact versioning and environment promotion.
* Lead CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption using GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform/OpenTofu, CloudFormation and policy-as-code practices.

* Establish Data SRE practices for AWS data pipelines, lakehouse services, orchestration, ML/AI workloads and platform operations.
* Define observability dashboards covering Glue/EMR/MWAA job health, data freshness, data quality, SLA/SLO, cost, capacity, access activity, incident trends and dependency failures.
* Act as escalation point for complex production issues, root-cause analysis, recurring incident elimination, performance tuning and long-term platform improvement.
* Drive restartability, retry logic, alert rationalisation, runbooks, service transition, support operating model and operational continuity.

**SageMaker, AI integration and agentic AWS operations**

* Integrate AWS data platforms with Amazon SageMaker for data preparation, feature engineering, model training, deployment, model monitoring, MLOps and inference-ready data products.
* Support AI/GenAI workloads using SageMaker, Bedrock where relevant, vector databases, knowledge bases, RAG, GraphRAG, model evaluation and enterprise AI governance patterns.
* Drive agentic and AI-assisted operations for metadata discovery, mapping, lineage, data quality rule generation, anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, automated remediation and self-healing workflows.
* Ensure AI-enabled AWS data solutions remain secure, governed, explainable, observable and aligned with enterprise risk controls.

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**
:
  
  
Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.
  
  
We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.
  
  
**About the opportunity:**
As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.
  
  
You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
  
  
You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.
* Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

**Your technical toolkit:**
**Languages and software engineering**
Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.
  
  
**Models and AI ecosystem**

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**Description**
Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.
  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.
  
  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

A day in the life
  
  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.
  
  
**About The Team**
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 10+ years experience with Cloud and AI technologies, including Azure, data platforms, application modernization, AI, agentic solutions, security, resiliency, and/or cloud architecture, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, GitHub, Agentic DevOps, AI Agent development, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.
* Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.
* Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
* Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities.
* Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability.
* Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team.
* Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development.
* Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation.
* Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities.
* Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.
* Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality.
* Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities.
* Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Production Ownership**

* Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations.
* Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked.
* Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability.
* Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution.
* Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery.
* Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications.
* Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities.
* Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
* Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows.
* Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions.
* Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience leading engineering teams supporting Billing, Payments, Collections, or Commerce platforms.
* Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or in an architecture-focused role, bringing additional depth in technical design and engineering decision-making.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization, platform migration, or technical transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams or multiple engineering workstreams.
* Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted software development, or emerging agentic AI technologies.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. title: 1-5 yrs Exp Revit Architecture and structural modeler
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Revit Architectural and Structural Modeler with 2–5 years of experience in Building Information Modeling (BIM). The candidate will be responsible for developing accurate 3D architectural and structural models using Autodesk Revit, preparing detailed drawings, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring compliance with project standards and BIM requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesArchitectural Modeling

* Develop and maintain 3D architectural models using Autodesk Revit.
* Create architectural floor plans, elevations, sections, reflected ceiling plans, and detailed drawings.
* Model walls, doors, windows, floors, roofs, stairs, ceilings, and other architectural elements.
* Prepare architectural schedules, annotations, dimensions, and construction documentation.
* Interpret architectural design drawings, CAD drawings, and project specifications.
* Develop and manage Revit families and parametric components as required.

Structural Modeling

* Develop 3D structural models using Revit Structure.
* Model structural elements, including foundations, footings, columns, beams, slabs, shear walls, and structural framing.
* Prepare structural plans, sections, elevations, and reinforcement details where required.
* Coordinate architectural and structural models to identify and resolve clashes.
* Understand structural drawings and coordinate with structural engineers to address discrepancies.
* Maintain model accuracy and consistency with approved structural design drawings.

BIM Coordination and Documentation

* Perform architectural and structural model coordination.
* Identify and report clashes and discrepancies between disciplines.
* Work with Navisworks for clash detection and model review, where required.
* Maintain project-specific BIM standards, naming conventions, worksets, and model organization.
* Support the preparation of construction drawings, shop drawings, and as-built models.
* Update models based on design revisions and coordination comments.
* Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, BIM coordinators, and other project team members.
* Meet project deadlines while maintaining quality and accuracy.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Autodesk Revit Architecture and/or Revit Structure.
* Good understanding of architectural and structural drawings.
* Knowledge of 3D modeling, BIM workflows, and construction documentation.
* Familiarity with Revit families, worksharing, worksets, and model linking.
* Understanding of architectural and structural coordination principles.
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD.
* Familiarity with Navisworks, clash detection, and BIM coordination is an advantage.
* Good communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver accurate models within project timelines.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of BIM execution plans (BEP) and Level of Development (LOD) requirements.
* Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360.
* Understanding of ISO 19650 BIM standards.
* Experience working on residential, commercial, industrial, or infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of Dynamo or other BIM automation tools is an added advantage.

title: Senior Specialist - Architecture
description:
**Role Description**
**Role Summary**

* Customer-facing technical owner for opportunities and implementations.
* Convert media, data and AI problems into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
* Own architecture from discovery and pilot through engineering, deployment and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery with customer business, product, data, AI, security and engineering teams.
* Define use cases, target workflows, architecture, integrations, data flows, non-functional requirements and roadmaps.
* Preserve a reusable, model-agnostic core while allowing controlled customer configuration.
* Assess data readiness, model fit, integration effort, cost, assumptions and delivery risks.
* Support proposals and SOWs, and remain accountable through architecture reviews and production sign-off.

AI, Platform & Cloud Architecture
  
  

* Apply deep knowledge of video/multimodal AI, computer vision, speech AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, reranking, RAG, recommendations and agentic workflows.
* Turn model outputs into reliable decisions using metadata, ontology, business rules, confidence thresholds, ranking, temporal logic, human review and feedback.
* Define model evaluation across accuracy, precision, recall, relevance, temporal grounding, latency, throughput, explainability and cost.
* Design AI pipelines for ingestion, preprocessing, retrieval, inference, validation, feedback and continuous evaluation.
* Architect APIs, microservices, event-driven services, workflow engines, vector databases, model serving and enterprise integrations.
* Integrate with MAM/DAM, CMS, media supply chain, data platforms, OTT/player, AdTech, localization and observability systems.
* Define Hyperscaler deployment, Kubernetes/container patterns, security, resilience, observability, DR and cost controls.
* Shape MLOps for model/prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, rollback, lineage and cost tracking.

**Hands-On & Collaboration**

* Create or review prototypes, APIs, notebooks, model evaluations, architecture diagrams and deployment designs.
* Inspect payloads, logs, traces, model outputs and performance metrics to resolve issues with engineering teams.
* Guide AI/ML, Data, Backend, Frontend, DevOps and QA teams on architecture and quality standards.
* Partner closely with the Product Lead and Engineering Head on reusable capabilities and implementation sequencing.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 9–10 years of technology experience, including Building and shipping AI Saas products / solutions , solution architecture, enterprise integration or cloud-native engineering ownership.
* At least 3–4 years of substantive AI/ML, data, automation or intelligent-platform architecture experience.
* Proven customer-facing experience leading discovery workshops, technical reviews and complex stakeholder discussions.
* Ownership of at least one solution from discovery or presales through pilot, engineering, deployment and handover.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, data pipelines, CI/CD, observability and security.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to validate integrations and prototypes.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and container/Kubernetes deployments.
* Strong communication, estimation, problem structuring, risk management and architecture-documentation skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.

**Preferred Media Experience**

* Media & Entertainment, OTT/streaming, broadcast, studios, MAM/DAM, AdTech, localization, live sports, QoE or video-processing workflows.

title: IT COE Head [T500-30365]
description:
**About VIP (Vermont Information Processing, Inc.)**

We are the leading technology provider powering the beverage industry, delivering integrated software solutions that connect suppliers, distributors, bottlers, and retailers across all three tiers. Since 1972, from our headquarters in Colchester, Vermont, we have focused on optimizing daily workflows and driving efficiency, visibility, and value through innovative applications like KARMA and Order Stream for businesses of every size and type. Today, with over 800 employees across 20 states and 3 countries, more than 63,000 monthly active users, and systems that process over 80% of U.S. beer volume, we enable seamless data exchange, stronger performance, and industry-wide growth by working side by side with our customers.

**About VIP India:**

India’s deep and diverse talent pool plays a major role in our global growth strategy. That is why we have expanded our global footprint with the establishment of VIP India, a state-of-the-art innovation hub in Mumbai. At VIP India, we are a high-impact, inclusive, and collaborative ecosystem where a community of talented professionals come together to drive digital innovation and transform the global beverage industry.

**Life at VIP India:**

Life at VIP India reflects our belief that great work happens when people are both challenged and cared for. An enjoyable work environment, flexible/hybrid options, and benefits that promote well-being and work-life balance encourage you to bring your best self to work.

As part of the wider VIP community, India teams share in traditions of giving back and team building—from local initiatives to supporting broader company efforts that strengthen our communities. If you want to grow your career, stay close to the latest in industry technology, and be part of a team that genuinely looks out for one another, VIP India is the place to grow together.

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on IT COE Head to scale our Global Capability Center (GCC) operations in India. Working in close partnership with US Executive Leadership and India Executive Leadership, the role holder will drive end-to-end technology infrastructure, cloud environments, enterprise security, and compliance. This role bridges global strategic vision with India operational capabilities—acting as a trusted technology co-partner across both regions while building, mentoring, and leading high-performing IT teams locally. Vermont Information Processing

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strategic & Global Alignment: Work in close partnership with US IT Leadership and India Leadership to align the India GCC technology roadmap, infrastructure strategies, and digital/AI initiatives with global enterprise goals.
* GCC IT Operations & Governance: Partner with India Executive Leadership to direct day-to day enterprise IT operations, infrastructure availability, service management, and end-user support across the GCC.
* IT Steering & Risk Management: Establish local IT governance, report on security KPIs, compliance posture, and technology risk metrics to executive leadership.
* Vendor & Asset Management: Oversee local IT procurement, cloud vendor relationships, software licensing, and hardware assets, driving cost optimization and efficiency. Cloud Infrastructure & Enterprise Systems
* Cloud Architecture: Oversee secure, scalable, and resilient cloud/multi-cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Modernization & Migration: Lead infrastructure modernization programs, cloud migrations, containerization, and virtual machine management.
* Enterprise Tooling & AI Integration: Implement automated IT workflows, endpoint management (O365, Active Directory), and AI/ML-driven internal tooling to improve operational velocity.
* Reliability & DR: Ensure availability, continuous monitoring, and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) and business continuity strategies. Cybersecurity, Compliance & DevSecOps
* Security & Zero Trust: Enforce enterprise-wide Zero-Trust security frameworks, IAM controls, endpoint compliance, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
* Compliance Standards: Lead local execution and maintenance of security certifications and regulatory frameworks such as SOC1, SOC2, and data protection policies.
* Incident Response & SRE: Establish monitoring, observability and incident response frameworks to maintain low MTTR and proactive threat remediation. Vermont Information Processing Team Building & Stakeholder

**Management:**

* Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and manage a multi-disciplinary team spanning Cloud/Infra Ops, DevOps, IT Support, and Security.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a key liaison between US stakeholders, local business leadership to ensure clear communication and smooth delivery.
* Required Qualifications & Experience:
* Experience: 15–20+ years of total experience in IT infrastructure, enterprise cloud architecture, and technical management. • Leadership Experience: Proven track record in a senior IT leadership role within a GCC, multinational organization, or SaaS Base product company.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s in Cyber Security or Management is a plus).

**Technical Competencies & Expertise:**

* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on architecture and operational depth across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Security & Governance: Deep understanding of Zero-Trust architecture, Identity Access Management (IAM), SOC1, SOC2, and enterprise security stacks.
* Enterprise Operations: Active Directory, O365, MDM, ITIL-aligned ITSM processes, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and patch automation.
* Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with AI/ML tools integration, workflow automation
* Certifications (Preferred): ITIL v3/v4 Foundation, Lead Auditor/Implementer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Architect/Machine Learning, or PMP.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data & Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high-quality agent & customer experience.

* Vendor & Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.

* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.

**:**

* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large-scale enterprise environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI & cloud infrastructure. #aws-ags-India

Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate should have worked on solution design & architecture of as part of a CoE, Cloud Practice team etc. Candidate must have have in-depth experience one or more of following technologies - Full stack application development/ DevOps / Databases / Networking / Security / Observability / Data Analytics & AIML. Good understanding of patterns and frameworks and ability to identify trade-offs is required. Candidate should have a flair for hands-on coding to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies. Candidate should be good at identifying repeatable pattern and best practices, and able to learn new technologies and customer business domain.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS India well within a customer’s or partner's environment and drive discussions with mid to senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. This will include but not limited to, understanding various design patterns & discern between various data & compute technologies. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional & non-functional requirements. The candidate will also guide on building DevSecOps, Observability & Monitoring of Infrastructure & Applications; conduct Well Architected Reviews; partner with AWS Domain & Technology Specialists to implement innovative solutions; collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps & engage with Technical communities and Customer C-Suite on Technology strategy & Best practices.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency & Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e-Commerce, Telco, Travel & Hospitality - this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers & shakers of India's push to $5T economy.

* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI-native approaches into every engagement.
  
  
This is a customer-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre-sales leadership, and practice development.
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

## Required Qualifications
  
  
### Technical Expertise
  
  

* \*\*10+ years\*\* of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi-region, multi-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000+ concurrent contacts

### Consulting & Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Pre-sales experience\*\* — led or co-led 5+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end-to-end delivery on engagements with 5+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions

### Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)

\* \* \*
  
  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step-by-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking

\* \* \*
  
  
## Working Model
  
  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

\* \* \*
  
  
## About the Team
  
  
AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
  
  
We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
  
  
\* \* \*
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Delivery (80%)

Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
  
  

* Design end-to-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
