title: AI Architect(Gen AI & Agentic AI) 7 to 8yrs
description:
Job Description: AI Architect – Generative AI & Agentic AI

Experience: 7–8 Years

Industry: Banking / Financial Services preferred

Location: Mumbai(Thane /BKC) Work from Office

Role Type: Architecture, Engineering & Technology Leadership

1. About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI Architect with 7–8 years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and cloud-native architectures.

The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions, with a focus on banking and financial services use cases. The role requires hands-on technical leadership, architectural decision-making, rapid prototyping, and collaboration with engineering, data, security, and business teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Solution Design

\* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.

\* Design scalable AI platforms integrating LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native infrastructure.

\* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and inference strategies.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, reference implementations, design principles, and engineering standards.

\* Design for high availability, scalability, low latency, cost optimisation, observability, and resilience.

Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineering

\* Architect and implement RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, retrieval, reranking, and contextual response generation.

\* Design intelligent AI agents capable of tool calling, multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, and controlled execution of enterprise business processes.

\* Develop multi-agent workflows where appropriate, with clear boundaries, state management, human approval, and failure-handling mechanisms.

\* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, model routing, context management, and conversation memory.

\* Apply guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, and unauthorised tool execution.

\* Build proof of concepts and convert successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Enterprise Integration & Banking Use Cases

\* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, REST APIs, event-driven systems, microservices, and secure data platforms.

\* Design AI solutions for banking use cases such as customer service automation, knowledge assistants, document intelligence, regulatory compliance, fraud investigation support, and developer productivity.

\* Ensure AI services integrate seamlessly with existing authentication, authorisation, audit, and monitoring frameworks.

\* Work with domain architects and business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into technical solutions.

MLOps, LLMOps & Production Engineering

\* Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices for AI applications and model-serving components.

\* Implement model evaluation, regression testing, prompt/version management, retrieval-quality assessment, and continuous monitoring.

\* Define evaluation frameworks covering factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, latency, safety, and token consumption.

\* Monitor model performance, drift, failure rates, inference costs, and application reliability.

\* Optimise inference performance through caching, batching, model selection, quantisation, and other suitable techniques.

Security, Governance & Responsible AI

\* Design AI solutions with security and privacy by design, including encryption, role-based access control, secrets management, and data minimisation.

\* Implement responsible AI controls, explainability where appropriate, traceability, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

\* Address threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, and sensitive information leakage.

\* Collaborate with information security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to meet applicable regulatory and organisational requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

\* Provide hands-on technical leadership to developers and engineering teams throughout the solution lifecycle.

\* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and proof-of-concept evaluations.

\* Mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices, design patterns, and production-readiness standards.

\* Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation roadmaps to technical and business stakeholders.

3. Required Technical Skills

Generative AI & LLMs

\* Strong understanding of LLMs, transformer-based models, embeddings, tokenisation, context windows, and inference.

\* Hands-on experience with commercial and/or open-source models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or equivalent.

\* Expertise in RAG, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt engineering, and structured generation.

\* Practical experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Programming & Backend Engineering

\* Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-grade AI applications.

\* Solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, API security, and distributed systems.

\* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent backend frameworks.

\* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot and microservices is an advantage.

Data & Search Technologies

\* Experience with vector databases or vector search technologies such as pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.

\* Strong understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases, document processing, data pipelines, and data quality.

\* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, hybrid search, and enterprise data integration is desirable.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

\* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

\* Experience deploying AI workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based architectures.

\* Familiarity with API gateways, event-driven architecture, secrets management, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

\* Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, or equivalent.

AI Quality, Evaluation & Operations

\* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks, automated testing, tracing, and observability tools.

\* Understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, model safety, and retrieval-quality optimisation.

\* Knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

4. Qualifications & Experience

\* 7–8 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or related technology roles.

\* Demonstrable hands-on experience delivering AI or GenAI solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage.

\* Strong architectural problem-solving skills and ability to make informed build-versus-buy and model-selection decisions.

\* Experience working with enterprise-scale applications, sensitive data, and production deployment constraints.

\* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

\* Banking, financial services, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience is highly desirable.

5. Preferred Experience

\* Experience building agentic AI systems that invoke enterprise tools and APIs under controlled permissions.

\* Knowledge of AI security testing, red teaming, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.

\* Experience with multimodal AI, document intelligence, speech, or vision-based solutions.

\* Familiarity with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms and integration with microservices.

\* Experience designing AI solutions for high-volume, low-latency, business-critical environments.

6. Success Criteria

The AI Architect will be measured on the ability to:

\* Deliver secure, scalable, production-ready AI solutions aligned with business outcomes.

\* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns that accelerate delivery across engineering teams.

\* Improve answer quality, retrieval accuracy, reliability, and user adoption.

\* Optimise inference cost, response latency, and infrastructure utilisation.

\* Demonstrate measurable business value through automation, productivity improvements, and reduced manual effort.

\* Ensure AI solutions meet defined security, governance, auditability, and operational-readiness requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A hands-on AI architect who can move from business problem definition to solution architecture, working code, production deployment, and measurable business impact—not just develop GenAI proofs of concept.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Agentic AI & gen AI: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
description:
What do we do?
  
  
**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**
Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
  
  
By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
  
  
What your day will look like
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for two
**Cloud Application Modernisation & Agentic Architects (f/m/d)**
to own the end-to-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio — 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6–8 months.
  
  
This is not a design-and-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP & Network Agentic Architect — and turn them into modernised, cloud-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run.
  
  
**Time allocation (approximate):**
~50% hands-on application refactoring & migration | ~25% project management, planning & stakeholder coordination | ~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance & SRE | ~10% observability, testing & validation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Refactoring & Modernisation**

* Own the end-to-end refactoring of your assigned applications — from assessment and design through implementation and validation
* Apply 12-factor app principles, event-driven architecture patterns, and cloud-native design to legacy codebases
* Migrate workloads from on-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
* Design for scalability and on-demand resource consumption — cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
* Use LLM-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation

**Project Management & Delivery**

* Own the migration plan for your applications: timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
* Track and report progress with precision - this is a time-boxed programme (6–8 months); delays must be surfaced early
* Split application ownership with your paired architect: clear DRI per application, shared standards

**Resilience & Rollback**

* Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins - you have crisis experience and you use it
* Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
* Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
* Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
* Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post-migration
* Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog — you are one of its primary consumers

What you need to fulfill the role
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
You have migrated complex, production applications from on-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically:
  
  

* Proven on-prem to cloud migration experience — at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
* Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform — networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
* Deep hands-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
* Strong 12-factor app knowledge — you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
* Strong event-driven architecture experience — Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
* Crisis and rollback experience — you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post-mortems
* Proven focus on scalability and on-demand resource design — your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
* Proven hands-on agentic experience: must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity — 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
* FinOps awareness — cost attribution and rightsizing post-migration
* Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
* Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme

**Soft Skills**

* Extreme ownership — you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
* Strong project management discipline: you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
* Collaborative by default — you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
* Crisis-calm: you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
* Fact-driven communicator: you report progress with data, not narrative

**What Success Looks Like**

* Month 2: Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
* Month 4: First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major + 2 add-on) — observable, scalable, cost-attributed
* Month 6: 7–8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
* Month 8: All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application

Success is defined as: more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost — across all 10 applications.
  
  
**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
* You need a stable architecture foundation before you start — legacy migration means working with what exists
* You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
* You treat project management as someone else's job
* You have not handled a production rollback under pressure

What we offer
  
  

* Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
* Hybrid-first working
* Continuous learning & certification budget
* Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
* Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.
**Hybrid working | Work from abroad | Flexible working hours | Thinkproject Academy | Free English lessons | Unlimited learning | Headspace community access | Women's Network | Corporate volunteering | Social events**
We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.
  
  
**Your Contact**
Mehal Mehta
  
  
**How To Apply**
Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:
  
  

* Salary expectations
* Potential start date
* A short write-up (max 300 words) on the most complex on-prem to cloud migration you have delivered - what went wrong, how you handled it, and what the outcome was, this is the most important part of your application

Working at thinkproject.com -
**think career. think ahead.**

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
AI Principle Architect
  
  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Functional EVP:**

Shape the technology behind every stage of the customer relationship Work on technology that supports customers beyond their initial interaction with DIRECTV and throughout their ongoing relationship with the brand. You’ll contribute to digital journeys and customer-facing capabilities that make interactions simpler, more connected and easier to manage. The work brings together software engineering and quality engineering to address real customer needs across the lifecycle.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking an experienced and innovative Principal Engineer, Software Engineering to serve as a technical leader within our Digital Services & Support engineering organization. This role defines technical strategy, drives architectural excellence, and delivers modern digital experiences that support customer engagement across DIRECTV platforms. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to build scalable, secure, and high-performing applications while advancing technology modernization initiatives across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep full-stack engineering expertise, proven technical leadership, and a passion for building innovative customer-facing solutions using modern web technologies and cloud-native architecture.

* Serve as a senior technical leader for DIRECTV's digital platforms and customer-facing applications.

* Design and implement enterprise-scale digital solutions using modern full-stack technologies.

* Establish architectural standards that support scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

* Drive code quality, automation, observability, and continuous integration practices.
* Support platform performance optimization, reliability improvements, and technical debt reduction.
* Influence strategic technology decisions and long-term platform roadmaps

**Innovation & Modernization:**

* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies where appropriate.
* Drive innovation across digital customer experience platforms.
* Champion cloud-native architectures and modern engineering approaches.
* Support experimentation that improves customer engagement and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 8-12 years of progressive software engineering experience.
* Extensive experience architecting and building large-scale digital applications.
* Strong experience leading complex engineering initiatives in modern web environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in full-stack application architecture and software design.
* Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Full Stack Development
* React

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Experience designing enterprise-scale customer-facing applications.
* Cloud-native architecture experience.
* Microservices and API architecture expertise.
* Modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Experience driving technology modernization initiatives.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent

This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune.

At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.

From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**Overview**

The Identity and Access Management Engineer (Junior) will supports the secure and reliable operation of identity services across the organisation. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role assists with user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication, single sign-on, privileged access and identity governance activities.

The position contributes to project delivery and operational support by following approved standards, documenting work, resolving routine issues and escalating risks or complex technical matters appropriately.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Support the secure and reliable operation of identity and access management services across the organisation.
* Contribute to IAM, PAM and identity governance initiatives through project delivery and operational support activities.
* Assist in implementing identity standards, controls and automation aligned with the organisation’s security strategy.
* Support continuous improvement of identity lifecycle, authentication and privileged access capabilities.

Operational Management

* Manage approved joiner, mover and leaver activities, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes and routine IAM troubleshooting.
* Provision, modify and remove user, service and privileged accounts across supported on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Apply approved access models, including role-based and attribute-based access controls, group membership and entitlements.
* Support periodic access reviews and follow up outstanding certifications, exceptions and remediation actions.
* Assist with the administration, configuration, testing and support of hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
* Support application onboarding for single sign-on, multifactor authentication and automated provisioning using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Contribute to PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other scripts or workflows that automate repeatable IAM activities, with peer review before production use.
* Assist with identity services hosted across Azure and AWS and their supporting Windows, Linux and virtualised infrastructure.
* Maintain daily IAM platform stability and compliance through service monitoring, BAU engineering, incident troubleshooting, fulfilment of service requests and controlled changes.
* Troubleshoot access, authentication, federation, directory and provisioning issues using documented procedures, system logs and structured diagnostic techniques.
* Support Active Directory Domain Services and related technologies such as LDAP, Group Policy, DNS, certificate services, forest trusts and remote access services under appropriate guidance.
* Maintain accurate tickets, work notes, configuration records, operational procedures and handover information.

People Leadership

* Build effective working relationships with application owners, Service Desk, infrastructure, cloud, security and project teams.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Identity Architects to deliver IAM and PAM enhancements.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
* Share knowledge and contribute to team capability through structured learning and practical assignments.

Governance & Risk

* Support the discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
* Assist with implementation and uplift of privileged-access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, least privilege, account discovery and automated password rotation.
* Follow least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, privacy and privileged-access requirements when administering identity services.
* Support audit and assurance activities by maintaining complete access records, approvals, evidence and operational documentation.
* Identify control gaps, recurring incidents and opportunities for automation or service improvement and escalate recommendations through the appropriate process.
* Escalate risks, exceptions and complex technical matters through appropriate governance processes.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

Experience

* Degree, diploma or equivalent practical training in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in IAM, directory services, systems administration, IT support or cybersecurity; graduates with relevant practical exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Foundational understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, conditional access, multifactor authentication, RBAC and ABAC.
* Practical exposure to Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in a hybrid environment; familiarity with Microsoft Identity Manager or Entra ID Connect is advantageous.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, federation and API concepts.
* Basic to intermediate PowerShell and scripting capability; exposure to Microsoft Graph is desirable.
* Awareness of Windows Server and Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, certificate services and forest trusts.
* Foundational cloud knowledge across Azure or AWS and basic familiarity with virtualisation; Linux exposure is desirable.
* Exposure to PAM or IGA platforms such as CyberArk and SailPoint is advantageous.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, IAM or security certifications are desirable but not essential.

Personal Attributes
  

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and seek guidance for complex or high-risk matters.
* Balanced interest in operational support, incident resolution, debugging and engineering delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to approvals, testing, evidence and record keeping.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build constructive relationships with technical teams and business partners.
* Able to prioritise assigned work, meet agreed deadlines, raise blockers early and contribute effectively in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Engineer, AI Security

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
JD:
**Senior Platform Architect (Tech Lead)**

**Location:**
Noida

**Reports to:**
CTO

**Type:**
Full-time, individual contributor tech lead

**About Sutra.AI**

Sutra.AI is a complete ‘Data to Value’ AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose-built for mid-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.

**The role**

You own how the platform is built. You are the hands-on technical lead for the core platform and the data layer that every product runs on. You set the architecture, write and review the critical code, and hold the bar on quality, security and scale. You take over day-to-day platform and data architecture from the CTO.

Engineers across the platform look to you for technical direction, design review and code review.

Stack you should be familiar with

* **Data:**
  open lakehouse (Trino, Apache Iceberg), change data capture, data quality monitoring
* **Ingestion:**
  AI-assisted connectors for ERP, SQL databases, files and SaaS sources
* **AI:**
  leading LLMs on AWS and GCP, agents and tool-calling (MCP), vector search
* **Apps and services:**
  Python, FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Postgres
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM tracing and evals, product analytics
* **Cloud:**
  AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Compliance:**
  SOC 2, HIPAA-ready deployments

**What you will own**

* **Core platform architecture:**
  security, scalability, multi-tenancy, connector standards, extension points.
* **Data access and performance:**
  a governed data access layer that serves interactive apps with fast response times alongside heavy AI agent workloads, with cost and latency under control.
* **Interfaces between teams:**
  clear, written contracts between platform components so product teams build on the platform, not around it.
* **Code quality:**
  review standards, design reviews, hands-on review of critical paths. Raise the bar for the whole team.
* **Security and compliance by design:**
  least privilege, fine-grained data access controls that AI cannot bypass, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit trails. Turn compliance requirements into architecture, not paperwork.
* **Reliability:**
  SLOs, observability, on-call design, self-healing pipelines, and scaling as customer usage grows.
* **Technical direction**
  for data engineers and full stack engineers.

**Must have**

* 8+ years building backend and data platforms, with recent hands-on coding. You still ship.
* Built production data pipelines and platform infrastructure: lakehouse or distributed query engines (Trino, Spark, Iceberg, Delta or similar), CDC and ingestion, data quality.
* Strong distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Security-first: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit. Experience in a SOC 2, HIPAA or similarly regulated environment.
* Hands-on AI exposure: shipped LLM or agent features in production, and understand evals, tool-calling and MCP well enough to design platforms for them.
* Has made architecture decisions at scale and lived with the consequences.
* Leads through design and code review. People want your review.

**Nice to have**

* Query engine internals, catalog performance, query planning
* OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS and GCP
* Enterprise system integration (ERP and other line-of-business systems)
* Healthcare, defense or financial compliance programs

**This role is not**

A people manager. A pure DevOps or SRE role.

**How we hire**

* Intro with the CTO
* Architecture deep dive: walk us through a platform you designed, including what you would change
* Live design: a governed data access layer for a multi-tenant AI platform
* Code review exercise
* Final with CEO

**What you get**

Ownership of the platform every product runs on, direct work with the CTO, real enterprise data problems, and meaningful equity.

title: Experienced Architect
description:

title: Principal Enterprise Architect - Source.AI
description:

* Gurugram

Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.**

You will lead the engineering function for Source.AI, McKinsey's GenAI-powered, agentic category-management and sourcing platform.

You will set and drive the end-to-end technical vision across data engineering, data science, and full-stack software development, ensuring the platform is designed, built, and scaled to meet the needs of enterprise procurement clients globally.

You will own technical direction for a multi-surface product stack: AWS based, a NestJS and Next.js monorepo (Nx, pnpm), Python FastAPI microservices, per-client Snowflake data tenants, and an agentic AI layer spanning spend intelligence, market radar, category strategy, negotiation coaching, and tail-spend repricing. You will architect and operationalize GenAI capabilities at production scale, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), NL2SQL, prompt engineering, vector search, and multi-agent orchestration, all routed through McKinsey's enterprise AI Gateway with Responsible-AI guardrails. You will establish engineering best practices, AI-assisted SDLC workflows, and observability standards so the team ships secure, reliable, and governable AI-driven features on a continuous cadence.

You will play a critical role in scaling Source.AI from a proven PoC portfolio to an enterprise-grade SaaS platform, driving transformative impact by enabling intelligent, scalable, and secure agent-based technologies that unlock measurable savings, productivity, and risk visibility for procurement teams worldwide.

title: Vice President, Engineering
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner.

**Quick Take -**

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals.
* Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well.
* Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders.

**The Work -**

***Engineering for the customer journeys***

* **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery.
* **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each.
* **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product.

***Partnership with Data & Intelligence***

* **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations.
* **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models.
* **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards.

***Delivery and engineering excellence***

* **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions.
* **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root.
* **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development.
* **Production ownership.** Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations.
* **Architecture and standards.** Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately.

***Leadership and management***

* **Organization.** Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them.
* **Global teams.** Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices.
* **Talent.** Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer.
* **Budget and reporting.** Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run.

**First-Year Priorities**

* Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them.
* Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios.
* Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards.
* Assign a lead team for each supplier–buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow.
* Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it.
* Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations.
* Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track.

**Required Skills**

* 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS.
* A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems.
* Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale.
* Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery.
* Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development.
* Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures.
* A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers.
* Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones.
* Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001).
* Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

**Preferred Skills**

* Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech.
* Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Principal Lead-Infrastructure Operations
description:
**About Our Company**

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**

The position will lead the enterprise Application Configuration Management and Drift Governance program supporting regulatory and cyber risk remediation initiatives. This role will be responsible for governing application security baselines, configuration compliance, drift monitoring, enterprise-wide patch governance, exception management and executive reporting.  
  
The individual will work closely with Application CDOs, Information Security, Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, ServiceNow, CMDB, and Technology Governance teams to drive configuration hardening, baseline compliance, continuous monitoring of application configuration controls, patch compliance oversight, audit evidence readiness, and scalable governance designs for future configuration management processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Application Configuration Management and Drift Governance program across enterprise applications.
* Establish governance processes for configuration baseline creation, review, approval, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Own and manage the ongoing enterprise patch audit governance process on a day-to-day basis once the operating model transitions into BAU.
* Establish and run enterprise-wide patch governance routines, including audit scheduling, compliance tracking, escalation management, evidence collection, and reporting across technology teams.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, vulnerability management, and technology governance teams to ensure patch compliance gaps are reviewed, tracked, remediated, or risk accepted in line with enterprise policy and SLA expectations.
* Develop governance playbooks and repeatable control designs that can be extended from patch audit governance into future configuration management and configuration drift processes.
* Partner with Application CDOs and Information Security teams to identify applications eligible for configuration drift governance.
* Drive onboarding of applications into Configuration Drift Management phases including Baseline Documentation, Verification Capability, and Compliance Reporting.
* Govern application configuration compliance against approved baselines, enterprise security standards, vendor recommendations, and industry frameworks.
* Manage configuration exceptions, risk acceptance reviews, remediation tracking, and issue escalation.
* Monitor configuration drift trends and ensure timely remediation of identified gaps.
* Define and track KPIs, KRIs, compliance metrics, coverage metrics, and remediation SLAs.
* Define patch governance KPIs and KRIs covering audit completion, patch compliance, overdue remediation, exception ageing, SLA adherence, and control effectiveness.
* Prepare executive dashboards and governance reports for technology and cyber risk leadership.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, and compliance evidence requests related to configuration governance.
* Collaborate with ServiceNow, CMDB, Vulnerability Management, and Technology Governance teams to improve governance maturity and reporting automation.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen enterprise configuration compliance and cyber resilience.

**Required Qualifications**

description:
**Job Description**
Provana is looking for a rare engineering leader. Someone who doesn't just manage software teams, but actively reshapes how software is built.
  
  
As our AI Native Software Engineering Manager, you will be the company's foremost practitioner of agentic AI software development practices compressing entire development cycles and turning ideas into production in days rather than months owning the full engineering lifecycle from idea to production across both internal enterprise transformation and externally-facing product lines.
  
  
You will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers embedded across Provana's business units and product divisions. You will be equally at home architecting a multi-agent workflow that automates legal document processing and pairing with an engineer on a complex PostgreSQL schema migration. Hands-on coding is not optional it is core to how you lead.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of organizational transformation and product innovation. You will compress the distance between what AI can do and what Provana ships at speed and at scale.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**INTERNAL ENTERPRISE TRANSFORMATION (Org-Wide) :**

* Lead engineering for AI-driven transformation across Finance, Legal, HR, IT, and Accounts replacing manual workflows with rule bases and/or intelligent, agentic systems that deliver measurable efficiency and productivity gains.
* Define and enforce a spec-driven development culture internally ensuring every project begins with a precise, versioned specification before a single line of code is written.
* Establish BMAD-based multi-agent workflows that mirror real team structures (Analyst PM Architect Dev QA), enabling fast, high-quality delivery by small teams.
* Build context engineering standards: like CLAUDE.md files, organizational skill libraries, MCP server integrations, and agentic toolchains that become institutional assets in the pod based FDE model.

**External-facing Products & Services**

* Architect and deliver agentic capabilities within Provana's legal tech products including foreclosure legal support, dispute resolution, compliance management, and automated e-filing systems.
* Drive the next generation of Healthcare RCM products, embedding generative AI and agentic workflows into billing, coding, credentialing, denial management, and patient access pipelines.
* Lead development within Provana's Agentic BPM platform building compound agent systems for process orchestration, workflow automation, and operational intelligence at enterprise scale.
* Extend Provana's Speech AI and Conversational AI capabilities designing and shipping production-grade voice and language products for contact center, compliance monitoring, and customer interaction domains.
* Collaborate with product and domain teams to ship AI features that directly improve client outcomes: reduced denial rates, faster cycle times, improved compliance coverage, and lower cost-to-serve.

**Team Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of forward-deployed engineers across product and internal domains defining career paths, conducting code reviews, and setting quality standards.
* Act as the primary technical thought leader on AI-native development practices: agentic software development, swarm architectures, context engineering, and spec-driven workflows.
* Partner with executive and product leadership to translate business priorities into engineered solutions with clear ROI, defined success metrics, and delivery timelines.
* Build and maintain Provana's internal AI engineering playbook a living system of standards, tools, agent skills, and practices that every engineer can leverage.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI coding tools, models, and frameworks; maintain hands-on proficiency with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and next-generation agentic platforms.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 - 12 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead or engineering management role.
* Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent agentic coding tools as core development workflow.
* Deep hands-on coding ability you write, review, and architect production code daily, not just in theory.
* Solid data engineering skills: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, vector databases, RAG pipeline design, and data modeling for AI applications.
* Demonstrated experience with agentic software development: building, orchestrating, and deploying multi-agent systems in production environments.
* Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool use, eval harnesses, and production observability.
* Fluency in spec-driven development structured PRDs, versioned specs as source of truth, and context engineering discipline.
* Generative AI integration experience: RAG systems, structured generation, agent memory, multi-step reasoning, and output validation.
* Proficiency with the BMAD method or equivalent multi-agent orchestration frameworks for structured software delivery.
* Strong communication skills ability to write clear technical specifications, architectural decision records, and executive-level summaries.
* Strong Azure platform skills including Azure OpenAI, AKS, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL / Cosmos DB.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive engineering culture across cross-functional teams.

**Technical Stack**
**AI & Agentic :**

* Claude Code - OpenAI Codex - Cursor - BMAD Method - Spec-Driven Dev - Agentic Swarms - RAG - MCP Servers - Context Engineering.

**Cloud (Azure)**

* Azure OpenAI - Azure AKS - Azure Functions - Azure DevOps - Azure AI Studio - CI/CD Pipelines - Docker / Kubernetes.

**Data & Backend**

* PostgreSQL - MongoDB - Vector DBs - Python - Node.js / TypeScript - REST / GraphQL APIs - Event-Driven Architecture.
