title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech, UTR Tech
description: DescriptionAmazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises - Same-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1-hr/3-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time-critical orders on-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.Key job responsibilitiesAs an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellencePreferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience with very large distributed systems Knowledge of design process Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, RustOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, driving adoption, business value realization, platform optimization, and long-term success. Experience with customer community platforms such as Sprinklr Community or similar solutions is highly desirable and will be considered an advantage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end managed services delivery, ensuring platform stability, governance, adoption, and alignment with customer business objectives.
* Drive strategic consulting engagements, helping customers optimise digital experiences, engagement models, operational processes, and platform utilisation.
* Act as the primary advisor to customer stakeholders, providing guidance on best practices, platform capabilities, governance frameworks, and roadmap planning.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution design, enhancement planning, and execution of continuous improvement programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks covering user administration, access management, workflows, content lifecycle management, and operational controls.
* Oversee platform health checks, audits, release management activities, and optimisation reviews.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience challenges.
* Own reporting, analytics, adoption measurement, and recommendations to improve customer outcomes.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams supporting managed services engagements.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Provide architectural guidance on integrations, APIs, authentication, SSO, enterprise connectivity, and ecosystem solutions.
* Establish reusable delivery standards, governance playbooks, operational frameworks, and best practice models.
* Contribute to customer digital transformation initiatives, ensuring scalable and sustainable platform adoption.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and customer-facing managed services engagements.
* Strong consulting experience involving solution design, customer advisory services, governance reviews, and stakeholder management.
* Expertise in platform governance, operational excellence, adoption strategies, user management, workflows, and business process optimisation.
* Strong understanding of user experience principles, digital engagement strategies, information architecture, and customer journey optimisation.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and modern digital experiences.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, integrations, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience facilitating workshops, executive reviews, solution discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer management skills.
* Experience leading distributed delivery teams and managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer-to-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.
* Experience with customer communities and digital engagement platforms is considered a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realisation.
* Well-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**

Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. title: Service Delivery Program Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.
  
  
With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization
  
  
**Location & Flexibility**
Noida, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Program Manager / Senior Manager to lead end-to-end cloud migration and modernization initiatives across multi-cloud environments — including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure. In this highly visible role, you will drive large-scale transformation programs that accelerate the organization's cloud adoption, modernize legacy workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and vendors to define program strategy, govern delivery, manage risk, and champion cloud-native best practices across the enterprise. This role requires a blend of technical acumen, program governance expertise, and leadership presence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership & Governance**

* Develop and own the end-to-end program roadmap for cloud migration and modernization, spanning GCP, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Establish and manage program governance frameworks including steering committees, status reporting, RACI structures, and decision-making processes.
* Lead cross-functional teams of architects, engineers, DevOps practitioners, and business analysts across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Track and report on program health — scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality — to senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.
* Drive milestone delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve escalations to keep programs on track.

**Cloud Migration Execution**

* Define and execute migration strategies including Rehost (lift & shift), Replatform, Refactor,Repurchase, Retire, and Retain (6Rs/7Rs).
* Oversee infrastructure assessments, application portfolio rationalization, and cloud readiness evaluations.
* Coordinate migration waves, manage cutover planning, and ensure zero-downtime or minimal-disruption transitions for critical workloads.
* Manage relationships with hyperscale partners (Google, AWS, Microsoft) and third-party migration tooling vendors.
* Ensure proper implementation of cloud landing zones, networking, IAM, security controls, and compliance requirements.

**Modernization & Transformation**

* Champion cloud-native modernization initiatives including containerization(Kubernetes/GKE/EKS/AKS), microservices adoption, and serverless architectures.
* Drive application re-platforming to managed cloud services (e.g., Cloud SQL, RDS, Azure SQL, Big Query, Redshift, Synapse).
* Lead DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline modernization to enable continuous delivery and cloud-native development practices.
* Partner with data and AI/ML teams to enable cloud-native analytics and AI workloads on GCP(Vertex AI), AWS (SageMaker), and Azure (Azure AI).

**Financial & Risk Management**

* Own program budgets ranging from $5M to $50M+, with responsibility for FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud spend visibility.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, operational, and business risks throughout the program lifecycle.
* Drive business case development, ROI modeling, and benefits tracking for cloud transformation investments.

**Stakeholder Management & Change Management**

* Act as the primary program interface for senior technology and business leaders, building trust and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
* Develop and execute organizational change management plans to drive cloud adoption and new ways of working.
* Build cloud capability and literacy across engineering and product teams through training, communities of practice, and enablement programs.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of program/project management experience with 5+ years directly in cloud migration or transformation programs
* Demonstrated delivery of large-scale migrations ($10M+ budgets) on at least two of: GCP, AWS, Azure
* Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments with 500+ workloads or applications
* Track record of managing cross-functional teams of 20+ people across engineering, architecture, and business functions
* Experience with enterprise change management and organizational transformation
* Deep familiarity with cloud architecture patterns: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, serverless,containers
* Understanding of networking (VPC,VPN, DirectConnect/Interconnect/ExpressRoute), IAM, and security in cloud
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes,CI/CD, Terraform/IaC, and DevOps toolchains
* Familiarity with migration tooling: AWS MGN, Google Migrate, Azure Migrate, Velostrata, CloudEndure, etc.
* Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization levers

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*
We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
  
  
For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

description:

**About Our Client:**

Our client is an established AEC outsourcing firm based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, providing architectural BIM modeling and CAD drafting services to international clients across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe. With a track record spanning over a decade, the firm specializes in delivering high-precision Revit models, construction documentation, and drawing production support for commercial, residential, and mixed-use building projects. The company operates as a production partner for overseas architecture and construction firms, executing projects aligned with US and UK building standards and BIM protocols.

**About the Role:**

This is a production-focused BIM Architect role suited to professionals who thrive in a fast-paced outsourcing environment and have hands-on experience delivering international architectural projects. You will work directly on US and UK project workflows, producing detailed Revit models, construction documentation sets, and CAD drawings that meet strict client standards.In this position, you will be responsible for the accuracy and completeness of your deliverables from model creation through documentation production. You will work alongside a collaborative production team, performing self-checks on your work before handing off to coordinators. This role offers direct exposure to international building codes, AIA and ISO 19650 standards, and the satisfaction of contributing to high-profile overseas projects from our Ahmedabad studio.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* BIM Modeling & Documentation: Develop detailed 3D BIM models at LOD 200–400 and complete architectural construction documentation sets using Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD.
* International Project Execution: Produce architectural deliverables aligned with US standards (AIA guidelines, imperial units) and UK standards (BS EN ISO 19650, metric units) across commercial, residential, and mixed-use projects.
* Quality Control & Coordination: Perform self-checks on models, clean CAD base files, manage sheet layouts, and resolve architectural clashes before coordinator review.
* Revit Family Creation: Create and maintain parametric Revit families (doors, windows, casework, architectural details) in accordance with client templates.
* Drawing Production: Convert PDFs, hand sketches, and point-cloud data into accurate 2D CAD drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections, and shop drawings.
* Standards Compliance: Ensure all deliverables comply with project-specific BIM standards, drawing conventions, and client requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* **Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture (B.Arch) Mandate**
* Experience: 1–4 years of hands-on experience in an architectural AEC outsourcing firm or design studio.
* Software Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Autodesk Revit Architecture and AutoCAD.
* Project Experience: Direct, verifiable experience working on US and UK architectural projects (commercial, residential, or mixed-use).
* Standards Awareness: Sound understanding of US imperial dimensions and drawing standards OR UK BIM protocols and ISO 19650 standards.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Basic exposure to clash detection using Navisworks.
* Experience interpreting markups, redlines, and international architectural codes.
* Familiarity with both US and UK project workflows.

**Technical Skills:**

* Software: Autodesk Revit Architecture (Expert), AutoCAD (Expert), Navisworks (preferred)
* Technical: BIM modeling (LOD 200–400), construction documentation, parametric family creation, CAD base file management, sheet layout management, clash resolution
* Standards: US AIA drawing standards and imperial units OR UK BS EN ISO 19650 and metric units
* Project Types: Commercial, residential, mixed-use architecture

**What You Will Bring:**

* Strong understanding of architectural construction details, wall sections, and building components.
* Ability to interpret markups, redlines, and international architectural codes efficiently.
* High attention to detail with a deadline-driven approach to production work.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for inter-team coordination.
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to perform thorough self-checks on your own work.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to resolve clashes and drawing discrepancies independently.

**Why This Opportunity:**

* Work on high-profile international architectural projects across the US, UK, and Europe.
* Gain direct exposure to global BIM standards including AIA guidelines and ISO 19650.
* Stable full-time career with a growing AEC outsourcing firm.
* Collaborative and continuous learning work environment with opportunities for skill development.

Work Location: In person

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
The Rockit Rangers is shaping “sports entertainment 2.0” by combining physical experiences with advanced AI and safety systems. The company transforms extreme ride concepts into supervised, scored, and filmed attractions that can be offered safely to the public. Its first product, the Splash-Hover, is a flying jet ski that showcases the fusion of cutting-edge engineering, real-time control systems, and immersive entertainment. Team members collaborate at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI to build reliable, high-impact experiences for riders.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior System Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining complex systems that power Rockit Rangers’ entertainment platforms, including the Splash-Hover. This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves overseeing end-to-end system architecture, integrating hardware and software components, and ensuring stability, performance, and safety. Day-to-day activities include configuring and administering systems, monitoring system health, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, and refining system design based on operational feedback. The role also includes collaborating with cross-functional teams, documenting system configurations and procedures, and providing guidance to junior engineers on best practices and standards. The Senior System Engineer will contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, supporting scalability and reliability as products evolve.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Systems Engineering and Systems Design skills, with experience in architecting and integrating complex, multi-component systems.
* Hands-on System Administration and Technical Support experience, including configuration management, performance tuning, and incident resolution.
* Proficiency in Troubleshooting, with the ability to diagnose and fix hardware, software, and network issues in real time.
* Experience working with safety-critical or real-time control systems (e.g., robotics, embedded systems, automotive, aviation) is highly beneficial.
* Solid understanding of operating systems, networking fundamentals, and cloud or virtualized infrastructure.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated capability to lead technical initiatives, mentor team members, and drive system improvements.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Amazon Connect Administrator
description:
**Position Summary**
The Amazon Connect Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the Amazon Connect cloud contact center platform. This role ensures reliable contact center operations, manages system configurations, supports users and business stakeholders, and drives continuous improvements across customer service technologies and workflows.
  
  
**Sample Job Objective**
*"The Amazon Connect Administrator is responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of the organization's Amazon Connect contact center platform. This role partners with business and technology teams to deliver efficient customer experiences, streamline operations, and support strategic contact center initiatives."*
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Administration**




+ Administer and maintain the Amazon Connect environment, including users, security profiles, routing profiles, queues, and contact flows.
+ Configure and manage inbound, outbound, and callback contact center capabilities.
+ Monitor platform performance, availability, and service quality.
+ Maintain system documentation, procedures, and configuration standards.

**Contact Center Configuration**




+ Design, build, and modify contact flows, IVRs, routing strategies, and queue management processes.
+ Configure integrations with AWS services including:
+ Amazon Lex
+ AWS Lambda
+ Amazon S3
+ Amazon CloudWatch
+ Amazon Kinesis
+ Amazon DynamoDB
+ Support omnichannel capabilities such as voice, chat, and task management.

**Reporting & Analytics**




+ Develop and maintain operational dashboards and reports.
+ Monitor KPIs including:
+ Service Level
+ Average Handle Time (AHT)
+ Abandonment Rate
+ First Contact Resolution (FCR)
+ Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
+ Analyze trends and provide recommendations for performance improvement.

**System Support & Troubleshooting**




+ Serve as the primary point of contact for Amazon Connect-related issues.
+ Troubleshoot call routing, telephony, agent desktop, and system integration issues.
+ Coordinate with AWS Support and internal technical teams to resolve platform incidents.
+ Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.

**Security & Compliance**




+ Manage access controls and user provisioning.
+ Ensure compliance with organizational security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
+ Support audit activities and maintain appropriate system controls.

**Integration & Enhancements**




+ Collaborate with IT, Operations, Workforce Management, and Business stakeholders on enhancements.
+ Support integration with CRM, ticketing, workforce management, and reporting platforms.
+ Participate in testing, deployment, and change management activities.

**Required Qualifications**




+ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
+ 3+ years of contact center technology administration experience.
+ 2+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Connect.
+ Experience with AWS services and cloud-based architectures.
+ Strong understanding of call center operations and customer service processes.
+ Experience troubleshooting telephony and contact center systems.
+ Knowledge of reporting and analytics tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**




+ AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect, or Amazon Connect Specialty-related certifications.
+ Experience with:
+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ ServiceNow
+ Microsoft Dynamics
+ NICE, Verint, or Calabrio WFM solutions
+ Contact Lens for Amazon Connect
+ Knowledge of APIs, REST services, and integrations.
+ Experience with scripting or automation tools.

**Technical Skills**




+ Amazon Connect Administration
+ Contact Flow Development
+ AWS Lambda
+ Amazon Lex
+ CloudWatch Monitoring
+ S3 Storage Management
+ Identity and Access Management (IAM)
+ SQL Reporting
+ API Integrations
+ Workforce Optimization Tools

**Soft Skills**




+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
+ Strong attention to detail and commitment to service excellence.
+ Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

title: Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on-call rotation.
  
  
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
  
  
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
  
  

* Provision bare-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring-up free of manual per-node steps
* Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over

Kubernetes Cluster Operations
  
  

* Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control-plane topology, including etcd members, kube-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure-domain placement
* Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
* Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts

GitOps & Fleet Configuration
  
  

* Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
* Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
* Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team

Upgrades & Patching
  
  

* Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
* Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Observability & On-Call
  
  

* Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
* Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
* Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
* Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate

What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months
  
  

* Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
* Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
* Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
* Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
* Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
* Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
* Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
* Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
* Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
* Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
* On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
* Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it

**Preferred**

* Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi-cluster management plane
* Familiarity with DPDK-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR-IOV NIC tuning
* Exposure to SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

title: IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru, India | On-site
  
  
Company: Ayar Labs
  
  
**Position Overview**
Great engineering depends on a workplace that works: laptops ready on day one, reliable connectivity, an organized lab, and someone nearby who can figure out what’s wrong and get it fixed.
  
  
At Ayar Labs, we’re building optical I/O technology for high-performance computing. We’re looking for a resourceful, hands-on IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager to support our India office and help our engineers do their best work. You’ll be the local person people turn to for technical help and practical solutions, working closely with the office manager and our global IT and lab teams.
  
  
This is an on-site role with plenty of variety. One morning, you might help a colleague get connected, set up a new workstation, or troubleshoot hardware with a remote IT teammate. Later, you might organize a lab bench, check a portable clean dry air (CDA) system, or coordinate a repair with a service provider. You’ll manage day-to-day operations through direct, hands-on work, with room to improve how the site runs as it grows.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**

* An engineering team that can stay focused. Provide friendly, responsive helpdesk support for computers, software, accounts, connectivity, and meeting-room technology. Help new colleagues get started, keep users informed, and follow issues through to resolution. Work with global IT on access, device setup, updates, and security practices.
* Reliable cloud support for the EDA team. Support engineering teams in an AWS environment. Partner with global IT and EDA to help provision and maintain Linux compute environments, manage user access, and troubleshoot connectivity, storage, and tool-license access issues so engineers can keep design and simulation workloads running.
* Local hands for a global team. Be the on-site eyes and hands for remote IT and engineering colleagues. Help install and connect equipment, inspect hardware, trace and label cables, replace approved components, and carry out guided troubleshooting. Capture useful details so specialists can resolve issues quickly.
* Labs and workspaces that are ready to use. Keep benches, equipment, tools, spares, and supplies organized and easy to find. Maintain practical inventory and maintenance records, support equipment setup and moves, and coordinate service or calibration with lab owners and vendors. Follow lab safety and equipment-handling procedures, including electrostatic discharge (ESD) precautions where applicable.
* Small facilities problems are handled before they become disruptions. Partner with the office manager on everyday upkeep, minor repairs, and simple installations. Support routine checks and basic upkeep of portable CDA systems and other supporting equipment within your training and approved procedures. Coordinate with building management and qualified service providers when work needs specialist attention, and follow through until it’s complete.
* Better ways of working. Turn recurring problems into practical improvements. Keep clear support notes, useful checklists, and straightforward how-to guides. Help plan equipment and supply needs, flag risks early, and coordinate priorities with the office manager, IT, and engineering.

**Skills You’ll Need to Bring**

* 5+ years of IT experience , with hands-on helpdesk, desktop support, systems administration, or similar work supporting employees directly.
* A practical troubleshooting foundation across computer hardware, operating systems, business applications, user access, and basic networking. You can work through an unfamiliar problem and recognize when to bring in a specialist.
* Comfort with light facilities work: using basic tools, fixing small problems, helping set up workspaces, and learning the routine care of equipment such as portable CDA systems.
* Strong organization skills and a habit of leaving labs, workspaces, equipment records, and shared supplies easier for others to use.
* Clear communication, patience with users, and dependable follow-through. You can work independently on-site while coordinating effectively with remote colleagues and local vendors.

Experience in a semiconductor, electronics, or photonics lab is a plus. Familiarity with Linux, Windows, lab equipment handling, ESD practices, asset tracking, or small-office facilities support will also help. You don’t need to have done every part of this role already; we’re looking for a solid IT foundation, practical judgment, and an interest in learning the rest.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
You’ll see the impact of your work every day: a new hire ready to contribute, a lab setup back in service, or an engineer able to keep working because you spotted and solved a problem. You’ll work close to the engineering team, build experience across IT and lab operations, and help shape a workplace people can rely on.
  
  
If you enjoy helping people, working with your hands, and making things run better, we’d like to hear from you.
  
  
NOTE TO RECRUITERS: Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. Remuneration for recruiting activities is only applicable subject to a signed and executed agreement between the parties. Please don’t send candidates to Ayar Labs, and do not contact our managers.
  
  
**About Ayar Labs**
At Ayar Labs we’re about to revolutionize computing by moving data with light. We’re unleashing processing power for artificial intelligence, high performance computing, cloud and telecommunications by removing the bottlenecks created by today’s electrical I/O -- making it possible to continue scaling computing system performance. Ayar Labs is the first to deliver an optical I/O solution that combines in-package optical I/O chiplets and multi-wavelength remote light sources to replace traditional electrical I/O. This silicon photonics-based I/O solution enables chips to communicate with each other from millimeters to kilometers, to deliver orders of magnitude improvements in latency, bandwidth density, and power consumption.
  
  
With our strong collaborations with industry leaders and government, our deep ties to MIT and UC Berkeley, and our commitment to hiring the best engineers in photonics and electronics, joining our team gives you the opportunity to collaborate with renowned experts on challenging, paradigm-shifting work.
  
  
We are passionate about delivering in-package optical I/O at scale, leveraging the strength of our patent portfolio and our team of leading interdisciplinary experts. We believe that deep cross-collaboration between teams facilitated by honest, open debate is the best way to drive innovation and achieve big wins. Join our team and experience the possibilities.

description:
**Bangalore**
-------------

**Job Brief**
-------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Windows Server & Virtualization Administrator to manage, optimize, and secure the organization’s virtualization and Windows server infrastructure. The candidate should have hands-on experience with Microsoft Hyper-V, VMware vSphere, Windows Failover Clustering, and enterprise-class virtualization environments. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, and operational efficiency across virtualized platforms while supporting infrastructure growth, patch management, and compliance initiatives.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Design, implement, maintain, and upgrade Microsoft Hyper-V Failover Clusters, including Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV), quorum/witness configurations, virtual networking, and Hyper-V Replica.
* Administer and support VMware ESXi hosts and vCenter Server environments, including High Availability (HA) and Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS) configurations.
* Manage Windows Failover Clustering across enterprise virtualization platforms to ensure optimal uptime and business continuity.
* Provision, configure, modify, migrate, and decommission virtual machines using vCenter, SCVMM, Hyper-V Manager, and Windows Admin Center.
* Monitor cluster health, virtualization performance, storage utilization, datastore capacity, and system alerts; perform regular cluster validation and health checks.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot storage connectivity technologies including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, SMB 3.0, MPIO, and HBA configurations in collaboration with storage teams.
* Monitor physical server health using vendor management tools such as iDRAC and iLO, coordinate hardware support activities, and manage vendor escalations.
* Implement and maintain virtualization and server security best practices, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Plan and execute server and virtualization platform patching, upgrades, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and disaster recovery processes.
* Participate in infrastructure capacity planning, performance tuning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide operational support and promptly resolve virtualization and server-related incidents and service requests.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4-6 years of hands-on experience administering enterprise Windows Server and virtualization environments.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Failover Clustering, Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV), quorum configurations, and Hyper-V Replica.
* Experience administering VMware vSphere, including ESXi, vCenter Server, HA, and DRS.
* Proficiency with virtualization management tools such as SCVMM, Hyper-V Manager, Windows Admin Center, and vCenter.
* Solid understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, SMB 3.0, MPIO, and HBA management.
* Experience with backup and recovery solutions such as Veeam, Commvault, or equivalent enterprise backup platforms.
* Hands-on experience with physical server hardware, firmware management, and remote administration tools such as Dell iDRAC and HPE iLO.
* Knowledge of server hardening, virtualization security controls, vulnerability management, and patch management processes.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
* Flexibility to work in shifts and support multiple locations based on business requirements.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.

At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

### **Your day-to-day:**

* Support and maintain the Business Systems function at Greenlight
* Apply growing systems knowledge (NetSuite, Maxio, HubSpot, etc.) to troubleshoot and resolve technical and functional issues
* Configure and support solutions (i.e. automations, IPaaS, etc.) that improve billing, procurement, accounts receivable, accounts payable, General Ledger, and T&E operations, ensuring alignment with business requirements
* Contribute to Month End and Quarter End processes, and help bring efficiencies to business processes through systems
* Help optimize business processes and workflows by supporting integrations and automations across Business Systems
* Administer and maintain business systems (NetSuite, FloQast, Workiva, HubSpot, Maxio, ZIP, etc.), supporting optimal performance and alignment with business goals
* Perform daily business systems administration duties, including user and role maintenance, configuration maintenance, and integration maintenance
* Execute and support IT General Controls (ITGC) initiatives, including (but not limited to), access review, procedural documentation, business system change management, etc.
* Document system configurations and system processes
* Collaborate with global IT team members to support business systems
* Partner with the Security team to help strengthen the security posture of business systems
* Contribute to system enhancements and share feedback to support ongoing improvement

### **What you’ll bring to the team:**

* 7+ years of experience as a NetSuite administrator or business systems analyst
* NetSuite Administrator Certification preferred
* Working knowledge of SuiteBuilder; familiarity with SuiteScript and SuiteTalk
* Exposure to the SuiteCloud Development Framework and version control systems (e.g., GitHub)
* Familiarity with NetSuite modules such as Fixed Assets and OneWorld is a plus
* Some experience integrating NetSuite with other financial and business systems, or a strong interest in learning
* Experience supporting other financial systems that perform billing, reconciliation, travel management, revenue recognition, and CRM functions is a plus (e.g., FloQast, Workiva, HubSpot, Maxio)
* Exposure to global or multi-entity system environments is a plus
* Understanding of ITGCs and exposure to SOC, ISO, or SOX compliant environments
* Familiarity with core accounting processes such as order to cash, procure to pay, and record to report
* Exposure to agile project management tools such as Jira, Asana, Confluence, and LucidChart
* Accounting or Finance background is a plus
* Exposure to no-code automation or IPaaS platforms (e.g., StackSync, UiPath) is a plus
* Have experience with using AI to enhance and optimize accounting, finance, and business systems process is a plus
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot issues and support solutions from design to implementation
* A proactive attitude with a desire to learn new skills in a flexible, fast-paced environment

**Who we are:**

It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.

Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Greenlight is committed to an inclusive work environment and interview experience. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in our hiring process, please reach out to your recruiter directly or email accomodations@greenlight.me.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Mainframe DB2 DBA Support Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a Mainframe DB2 DBA Support at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next for us, our customers and global industries as a whole.

  

Key Responsibilities :

  

* Administer and support DB2 for z/OS database environments.
* Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity utilization.Perform database installation, configuration, maintenance, and upgrades.
* Execute backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.Analyze and resolve database-related incidents, problems, and performance issues.Support application teams with database design reviews, SQL tuning, and troubleshooting activities.
Perform object management activities, including creation and modification of databases, tablespaces, indexes, and related objects.  

  
  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others

  
  

**Required skills and Experience:**

  

* Strong experience in IBM DB2 for z/OS Database Administration in large-scale enterprise and production environments.
* Hands-on expertise with DB2 utilities including REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, RECOVER, LOAD, UNLOAD, REBUILD INDEX, and CHECK DATA.
* Experience supporting DB2 subsystem installation, upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and version upgrades (DB2 v11/v12/v13).
* Strong knowledge of z/OS, JCL, TSO/ISPF, REXX, SMP/E, RACF, and Mainframe infrastructure.
* Experience with database performance tuning, SQL optimization, access path analysis, buffer pool tuning, and capacity planning.
* Expertise in backup, recovery, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity support for DB2 environments.
* Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting DB2 issues using tools such as OMEGAMON, SPUFI, QMF, BMC MainView, and DB2 Admin Tool.
* Experience managing database security, authorizations, auditing, compliance, and RACF coordination.
* Ability to automate operational tasks and health checks using REXX, JCL, and scripting techniques.
Experience supporting 24x7 production environments, incident resolution, problem management, and root cause analysis.  

  

**Preferred skills and Experience:**

  

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise mainframe environments.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, change management, release management, and service delivery operations.
* Ability to coordinate with system programmers, application teams, storage teams, and infrastructure stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in disaster recovery exercises, audits, compliance reviews, and operational governance.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to support global delivery and customer-facing environments
IBM DB2 for z/OS certifications.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Summary**
The Linux Desktop Engineer will own the design, deployment, configuration, and structural maintenance of Celestica's high-performance Linux computing platform. This role directly supports the Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) engineering group by managing a fleet of approximately 50 HP ZBook Mobile Workstations preinstalled with Ubuntu and optimized for advanced AI-based software development.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of enterprise endpoint compliance and agile engineering infrastructure , the successful candidate will use HCL BigFix as the primary Endpoint Management framework. Responsibilities include developing deployment packages for core endpoint security software , managing monthly patching cycles , and troubleshooting highly specialized developer toolchains to maximize engineering velocity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Fleet Configuration & Baseline Optimization: Own the baseline golden imaging, mass deployment, and configuration maintenance of the HP ZBook workstation fleet utilizing HCL BigFix.
* Silent Software Packaging: Architect and deploy automated, silent installation packages for all enterprise and custom engineering endpoint software via BigFix fixlets.
* Endpoint Security Management: Install and administer Celestica’s standard security applications, including CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker, and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Persona Customization: Configure application controls specifically for the engineering developer workspace. This involves deploying ThreatLocker in a persistent Learning Mode with dedicated sandbox path exceptions (such as ~/Workspace) to prevent process blocks during source compilation.
* Exclusion Path Auditing: Implement and maintain required anti-malware scan exclusions across engineering build paths (e.g., /home/\*/src/, make, gcc, cargo) to ensure frictionless local compilation.
* Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Support and execute monthly operating system and application patching cycles. Ensure critical security patches are vetted and pushed to engineering systems within a mandatory 24-hour window when required.
* Privileged Access Governance: Administer scoped sudo access on developer workstations using secure alternative authentication models (such as SSH agent-based PAM) and manage compliance audits via session recording tools like tlog.
* Engineering Toolchain Support: Act as the primary technical interface for HPS Software Engineers, ensuring local access to build essentials, containerization software, and integrated development environments.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  
**Preferred Technical Qualifications**

* Operating Systems: Expert-level administration of native Ubuntu Linux (specifically 22.04 LTS and 24.04 LTS Desktop environments).
* Endpoint Management: Deep technical expertise using HCL BigFix for software asset tracking, package packaging, enterprise scripting, and automated deployment.
* Endpoint Security: Direct experience administering patches and Fixlets for enterprise security suites: CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker (including allowlisting/ringfencing policy adjustments), and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Environments: Familiarity supporting low-level compilation workflows and toolchains: build essentials (GCC, Clang, CMake, Rust/cargo), Python 3.10+, Docker CE, MicroK8s/Kind, and VS Code.
* Scripting & Automation: Advanced proficiency in Bash or Python scripting to automate workstation configuration, environment provisioning, and repetitive IT administrative tasks.
* Workstation Hardware: Experience configuring high-density workstations (such as the HP ZBook Fury series), including managing system BIOS updates and optimizing dedicated NVIDIA hardware driver profiles.

**Core Competencies**

* Developer Velocity Orientation: Possesses an intense focus on minimizing developer friction, reducing environment downtime, and protecting the engineer's flow state.
* Matrix Collaboration: Exceptional diplomatic and relationship-building skills to successfully co-develop frameworks with Global Information Security and remote site infrastructure divisions.
* Advanced Technical Problem Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot unique, non-standard software-hardware boundary failures that fall outside typical corporate enterprise IT ticketing scripts.

Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Systems, with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience supporting specialized R&D or engineering IT environments.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.
