title: Senior System Analyst (Finance)
description:
Who are Inchcape
  
  
At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.
  
  
We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.
  
  
Job Location : Chennai, Pune
  
  
Job Purpose :
  
  
The Senior Systems Analyst is responsible for analysing, impact assessing and implementing changes to ISS’s portfolio of finance applications (Unit4, Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara, Eyeshare and related integrations), supporting the business processes of:
  
  

* Procure to Pay
* Record to Report
* Order to Cash
* Treasury and Cash Management
* Indirect Tax
* Financial Reporting

The role owns change end to end: from understanding the business requirement and assessing its impact on processes, integrations, controls and data, through configuration and testing, to controlled release into production. In doing so it keeps the finance application landscape stable, compliant and aligned with best practice.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities :
  
  
Analysis and Design
  
  

* Work with Finance stakeholders, Product Owners and Business Analysts to understand requirements, pain points and process gaps, and translate them into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Conduct gap analysis against current configuration and standard product capability, recommending solutions that make full use of the platform before considering customisation.
* Produce solution designs and realistic effort estimates for changes and enhancements.

Impact Assessment
  
  

* Impact assess every proposed change, covering affected business processes, upstream and downstream integrations, reporting, data, security roles and financial controls. Document the risk, test scope and rollback approach before implementation.
* Review vendor release notes for Unit4, Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara and other SaaS platforms, assess the impact on ISS configuration and processes, and plan regression testing and any required changes ahead of each release.
* Maintain an end-to-end understanding of how data flows between the finance applications and connected operational systems, so that the knock-on effects of change are identified early

Implementation
  
  

* Configure and maintain Unit4, Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara, Eyeshare and related integration processes to a high and maintainable standard.
* Implement changes through the agreed change control process, including CAB approval where required, promoting configuration between environments in a controlled and documented way.
* Schedule changes around the financial calendar, avoiding month-end, year-end and other critical business windows.
* Roll out configurations globally across the product suite in line with the deployment plan.

Testing and Quality
  
  

* Plan and carry out system, integration and regression testing against documented acceptance criteria, and support business users through user acceptance testing.
* Validate data and reconcile outputs after go-live to confirm that changes have had no unintended financial impact.

Controls and Compliance
  
  

* Ensure changes maintain segregation of duties, audit trail and internal control requirements, and retain change evidence suitable for internal and external audit.

Support and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Provide L3 support for complex issues, including root cause analysis and permanent resolution, and provide hypercare following deployments.
* Act as the technical point of contact with application vendors, raising and managing support cases through to resolution.
* Maintain functional and technical documentation, including configuration baselines, process flows and integration maps, in Confluence.
* Work within the Agile delivery model, keeping Jira up to date and participating fully in Scrum ceremonies.
* Deliver user training and knowledge transfer, and identify opportunities to improve processes and system efficiency.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, support teams and peer analysts, sharing knowledge and continuously improving how the team delivers value to the business.

Knowledge :
  
  

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science or a related discipline. A professional accounting qualification (CA/ICWA/CIMA) is desirable.
* Strong understanding of core finance processes: Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, treasury and cash management, and indirect tax.
* Functional and configuration knowledge of SaaS finance applications, ideally Unit4 ERP.
* Knowledge of Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara or Eyeshare is highly desirable'
* Understanding of financial controls, including segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX-style compliance, and of change management.
* Technical knowledge: SQL; web services and APIs (REST, SOAP, XML, JSON); testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
* Agile tools: Jira and Confluence (or Azure DevOps/Rally).
* Knowledge of the maritime or shipping industry (desirable).

Skills :
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to trace an issue across multiple systems to its root cause.
* Structured approach to impact assessment and risk identification.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Strong testing discipline, including test planning, regression testing and data reconciliation.
* Clear verbal and written communication; able to explain technical impacts to Finance users and finance
* requirements to technical teams.
* Collaborative, partner-focused approach with stakeholders and vendors.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple changes at once while meeting deadlines

Experience :
  
  

* 5+ years as a systems analyst or functional/techno-functional consultant on finance applications, ideally in a SaaS ERP environment (Unit4 preferred).
* Proven track record of impact assessing and implementing configuration changes in live finance systems.
* Managing SaaS vendor releases and the associated regression testing.
* Supporting finance integrations and middleware, including troubleshooting interface failures.
* Data migration, reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI).
* Working within formal change control and release management processes.
* L2/L3 production support and post-deployment hypercare.

Other requirements :
  
  

* Ability to travel (national and international) and work flexibility.
* Able to work from home.
* Out of hours or on call support as required

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?
  
  
We believe in building a diverse and high performing workforce, that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realise the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.
  
  
Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:
  
  
Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture.
  
  
The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
  
  
Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.
  
  
In return, we will offer you:
  
  
A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally as a minimum you will receive:
  
  

* A retirement savings plan
* Life assurance

* Career development and progression opportunities
* Values Award celebration events

* Hybrid Working Model (Role Dependant)

Plus, much more!
  
  
If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!
  
  
#ISSthebiggerpicture

title: Senior Billing Executive
description:
Hospital Billing Sr. Executive – Hyderabad

**Department:** Cash & Insurance Billing  
**Job Title:** Senior Executive – Hospital Billing  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Reporting To:** Billing Manager / Assistant Manager – Billing  
**Experience:** 3–5 years in hospital billing  
**Qualification:** Any Graduate, preferably B.Com, BBA, Hospital Administration, or Healthcare Management.

This job description is structured around hospital billing responsibilities commonly required in Hyderabad hospitals, including IPD/OPD billing, insurance and TPA coordination, discharge billing, and revenue cycle management. raosentcare.com

1. Job Purpose

The Hospital Billing Sr. Executive is responsible for managing daily billing operations, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of patient bills, coordinating with insurance companies and Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), monitoring outstanding payments, and facilitating smooth patient admission and discharge processes.

The position ensures billing accuracy, proper documentation, compliance with hospital policies, and improved revenue collection.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Hospital Billing Operations**

* Supervise and manage daily IPD, OPD, emergency, cash, credit, and corporate billing activities.
* Prepare and verify interim bills and final bills for admitted patients.
* Ensure accurate billing of room rent, doctor consultations, investigations, procedures, OT charges, pharmacy, consumables, implants, and other hospital services.
* Verify patient details, billing entries, approved tariffs, packages, discounts, and concessions.
* Ensure all billable services are captured correctly in the Hospital Information System (HIS).
* Monitor billing accuracy and minimize billing errors and revenue leakage.

**B. Insurance and TPA Billing**

* Coordinate with insurance companies and TPAs for cashless approvals and claim processing.
* Ensure timely submission of pre-authorization requests, enhancement requests, and final bills.
* Verify insurance approvals, policy limits, package rates, exclusions, and non-payable items.
* Follow up on pending approvals, claim queries, rejected claims, and outstanding insurance payments.
* Maintain complete documentation for insurance, reimbursement, and corporate billing.
* Coordinate with the insurance department to resolve billing discrepancies and claim-related issues.

**C. Patient Discharge Management**

* Ensure timely preparation and verification of final bills before discharge.
* Coordinate with nursing, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, OT, and other departments to verify all charges.
* Ensure the collection of pending patient balances after insurance approval, wherever applicable.
* Explain billing details, deductions, non-payable items, and outstanding amounts to patients and their attendants.
* Monitor discharge turnaround time (TAT) and take corrective action to avoid unnecessary delays.

**D. Revenue Cycle and Collection Management**

* Monitor daily billing, collections, credit billing, and outstanding receivables.
* Follow up on pending payments from corporate clients, insurance companies, and TPAs.
* Reconcile daily billing transactions, receipts, refunds, and adjustments.
* Identify billing discrepancies and coordinate with the Finance Department for resolution.
* Prepare accounts receivable ageing reports and follow up on overdue accounts.
* Support revenue cycle improvement initiatives to improve collection efficiency.

**E. MIS and Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly billing reports.
* Submit reports on total billing, collections, outstanding amounts, pending claims, and rejected claims.
* Monitor billing errors, discharge delays, and claim settlement status.
* Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documents.
* Submit regular performance reports to the Billing Manager.

**F. Team Coordination and Compliance**

* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, pharmacy, diagnostics, front office, insurance, and finance teams.
* Guide billing executives and ensure adherence to established billing procedures.
* Handle escalated patient billing complaints professionally.
* Ensure compliance with hospital policies, approved tariffs, and insurance requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and financial records.
* Support internal and external billing audits.

3. Educational Qualifications and Experience

* Graduate in any discipline; B.Com, BBA, Hospital Administration, or Healthcare Management preferred.
* Minimum **3–5 years of experience in hospital billing operations**.
* Experience in a multispecialty or super-specialty hospital is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of IPD, OPD, cash, credit, corporate, insurance, and TPA billing.
* Experience in discharge billing, claim processing, and payment follow-up.
* Knowledge of hospital billing software and Hospital Information Systems (HIS/HMS).

4. Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of hospital billing procedures.
* Good understanding of insurance and TPA processes.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and hospital billing software.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple billing activities under time pressure.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good coordination and team management skills.
* Ability to handle patient complaints professionally.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Specialist, Product Operations, Reference Data
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

The primary purpose of this position is to research, analyze, interpret, transform and present reference data for Equity and Funds securities across global markets, while supporting the Index team by providing reference data with precision. The focus of this position is to perform this work with documents written in English.

The incumbent must successfully complete a 8-to-12-week training program that centers on building enough subject matter expertise and the utilization of the database(s) of record such that the incumbent can independently analyze legal and financial documents associated with Equity and Fund securities. During training, the incumbent must master all of the subject matter and will be required to pass a series of quizzes and tests as well achieve the accuracy and timeliness metrics that were established for trainees.

The training curriculum for Data Analyst contains high level overviews of the complex structures worked on by more senior personnel as well as reference data client use cases so that the incumbent can differentiate between legal and financial language that is relevant to and required by our client base versus jargon describing information that is not required and, so that the incumbent can identify new financing techniques that come to market. The incumbent must then apply this foundation of knowledge via a logical sequence of decision-making events to determine relevancy of said information to our clients for any of their use cases and if deemed relevant, determine the appropriate next steps to ensure high client satisfaction levels.

The Equity and Funds asset class consists significantly large volumes of active securities and the reference data provided by ICE Data Services for said securities is used by our clients to make trading decisions, settle trades, make investment decisions, manage portfolios, analyze risk, create security master files, create client statements and conduct other back-office functions. Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within ICE and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze, interpret, collate, and transform reference data for multi structure/events/sub processes with high complexity in either the primary market or the secondary market (but not both) provided in a variety of legal and financial documents, third party reports and vendor information, while ensuring that the reference data provided in ICE’s products and services accurate, comprehensive and in a timely manner, namely best in class.
* Demonstrate familiarity with reference data products to support client challenges and resolve data problems.
* Build core competencies in the maintenance of reference data captured in alternate databases used to produce products.
* Independently perform all assigned business processes completely and accurately.
* Conduct user acceptance testing of new enhancements and bug fixes made to the database(s) of record
* Craft external facing responses for those clients that submitted customer inquiries containing a meaningful, well-thought out, well-constructed answer that includes a restatement of the challenge or question, the analysis completed to satisfy the request and where appropriate, the methodology used to determine the solution when researching and resolving client inquiries.
* Identifies trends and causation of inaccurate and/or incomplete data including but not limited to staying current with regulatory initiatives, new financing techniques used by the marketplace and organizations that impact coverage and completeness.
* Create simple excel and macro functions to organize, analyze, convert, and create reference data.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge and understanding of policies and procedures and work with training team to augment best practices as changes in the marketplace evolve.
* Applies problem-solving skills to identify and help to resolve data quality issues and/or work-flow inefficiencies and process improvements resulting in increased accuracy levels, time to market and productivity.
* Participate in root cause analysis efforts to identify system data issues and participate in creating process improvements. Resolve complex data challenges and time critical sensitive projects.
* Create charts, graphs, and presentations for leadership teams.
* Communicate with and influence market participants including underwriters, issuers, trust administrators and exchanges through phone and email correspondence to procure required reference data content, resolve data discrepancies and gain an understanding of undefined terms.
* Make sound, subjective decisions when interpreting legal and financial information by utilizing subject matter expertise to infer, deduce and ultimately draw the correct conclusions. Mentor junior employees provide guidance; serve as subject matter experts.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* 5+ years corporate level experience, or 2+ years direct experience.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressured, fluid environment
* Ability to distill large amounts of varied information into specific takeaways
* Excellent attention to detail and high degree of demonstrated decision-making and problem-solving skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Eagerness to learn and collaborate with others
* Strong excel skills required

title: SQL Server Database Architect
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced SQL Server Database Architect to lead the architecture, governance, modernization, and operational excellence of enterprise SQL Server platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, database security, and operational resilience.

  

* **Role: SQL Server Database Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 12 to 17 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architecture for SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and decision frameworks for SQL Server platforms.
* Establish standards for clustering, Always On Availability Groups, backup, recovery, monitoring, encryption, and privileged access management.
* Develop lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernization, consolidation, and database migration roadmaps.
* Act as the technical design authority for enterprise database solutions.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, resilience, data governance, and service management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform modernization initiatives.
* Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions aligned to business requirements.
* Lead recovery planning, failover testing, restore validation, and resilience assessments.
* Define standards for indexing strategies, query optimization, workload management, and database performance tuning.
* Establish performance baselines, capacity models, and forecasting processes.
* Lead technical response during critical incidents and major platform outages.
* Drive root-cause analysis and implement long-term engineering improvements.
* Define database security architectures and governance standards.
* Implement controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, patching, hardening, secrets management, and service accounts.
* Partner with cybersecurity, audit, risk, and compliance teams to address control requirements and audit findings.
* Ensure database platforms comply with relevant regulatory and operational resilience requirements.
* Support data protection, retention, governance, and compliance initiatives across the organization.
* Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to database administrators and engineering teams.
* Review and approve complex implementation plans and solution designs.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools.
* Evaluate database technologies, vendor solutions, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to manage technical dependencies.
* Maintain architecture repositories, service maps, support models, standards, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to strategic technology planning and database platform governance.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 12-17 years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Architecture roles.
* Extensive experience with SQL Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 in large enterprise production environments.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).
* Deep understanding of High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, Restore, and Business Continuity strategies.
* Strong experience supporting mission-critical business applications under formal change, incident, problem, and release management frameworks.
* Expertise in database modernization, upgrade, consolidation, and cloud migration programs.
* Advanced T-SQL development, execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Windows Server administration and supporting infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos Authentication, storage systems, networking, virtualization, and monitoring platforms.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server security architecture, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with automation using PowerShell and scripting technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture frameworks and technical governance processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  

***"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."***

description:

Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain all D365 F&O environments (Production, Sandbox, UAT, Test, Dev), including configuration, environment refreshes, and general housekeeping. Manage environment strategy and topology (Tier 2, Tier 1, build environments), including capacity planning and coordination with the hosting provider or Microsoft. Coordinate and execute application updates, hotfixes, and cumulative updates via LCS, including scheduling, impact assessment, and smoke testing coordination. Own and operate the deployment pipeline, including build and release management, code promotion between environments, and alignment with ALM standards (Azure DevOps). Manage user provisioning and de provisioning, security roles, duties and privileges, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) policies in collaboration with security and audit teams. Monitor system health, performance, and integrations, proactively identify issues, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and Microsoft support. Support integrations (dual write, Data Management Framework, recurring data jobs, interfaces), monitor data flows, and work with integration teams to resolve failures. Ensure adherence to change management processes, including CAB approvals, release calendars, deployment checklists, and rollback plans. Participate in incident and problem management, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive and corrective actions. Familiarity with D365 data management (Data Management Framework, entities, recurring jobs) and common integration patterns. Strong coordination and communication skills to work with cross functional teams (infra, development, functional, business stakeholders). Experience working in ITIL based support environments (incident, problem, change management) is preferred.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

title: Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India**
======================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals

title: Senior Specialist/Engineer Service Operations
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO**
**SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
You will be the first point of contact for customers, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused IT support. You will own incidents and service requests through to resolution or approved handover, ensuring clear communication and high-quality service at every stage. Working within SITA's global service model, you will leverage ServiceNow, standardized processes, and defined escalation paths to provide a consistent support experience across regions and channels while contributing to operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The Service Desk provides 24/7 global support from Delhi and Montreal, managing incidents, service requests, customer communications and escalations through to resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Incident End-to-End Ownership**

* Own assigned incidents and requests from logging through resolution, closure or accepted handover.
* Complete diagnosis,use approved knowledge and engage resolver groups with clear evidence while retaining customer-facing ownership.
* Recognize potential P1 or Major Incident conditions,invoke the defined escalation path and support coordination, timeline capture and communications.
* Maintain disciplined shift handovers so priority work and customer commitments remain owned during reduced coverage.

**Customer Outcomes**

* Prioritize restoration and reduction of customer impact, not ticket completion alone.
* Communicate progress, ownership, next steps and follow-up in clear language.
* Confirm the agreed outcome before closure and record unresolved concerns.

**AI, Automation and Tooling Adoption**

* Use approved AI-assisted triage, summarization, knowledge recommendation and routing with required human validation.
* Use automated workflows and self-service handoffs correctly and intervene when automation does not protect the customer outcome.
* Identify repetitive demand, failed automation and missing knowledge with supporting evidence.

**Data, Service Intelligence and Predictive Awareness**

* Use queues, dashboards, service status and known-error information to prioritize work.
* Recognize patterns indicating repeat failure, rising demand or degradation and escalate with evidence.
* Record accurate categorization, timestamps, impact, diagnosis and resolution information.

**ServiceNow Greenfield and CMDB Maturity**

* Follow approved ServiceNow workflows, states, assignment paths and closure controls.
* Use available service and configuration data in diagnosis and routing.
* Report suspected CMDB inaccuracies and maintain records that support reporting, automation and auditability.

**Workforce Transformation and Continuous Improvement**

* Adopt global queues, new channels, revised processes and changing skills requirements.
* Complete required learning and share knowledge across shifts.
* Contribute practical improvement feedback based on operational evidence.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

* 5+ years of experience in Service Desk, technical support, customer support or operations.
* Practical incident handling, troubleshooting, communication and escalation experience.
* Ability to use ITSM workflows, knowledge and dashboards.
* Relevant technical, service management, operations or equivalent professional experience.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent demonstrated ITSM knowledge.

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Experience with ServiceNow, AI-assisted support, automation, self-service or virtual agents.
* Exposure to CMDB or service configuration data.

**What We Offer**
We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎
**Flex Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development**
: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning**
,
**Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative**
, and
**Airport Council International**
—available to all employees—to specialized solutions like
**Pluralsight**
for technology upskilling,
**Harvard Business Publishing**
for people leadership,
**Stanford**
for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
**🙌🏽 Competitive Benefits**
: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

description:
**Req ID:**
392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**POSITION DETAILS**
Job Title: SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
  
Location: India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent)
  
  
Experience: 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
  
Compensation: Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
  
Work Hours: IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
OS Deployment & Image Management
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test & Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline & Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application & Software Management
  
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure & Platform Management
  
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

**Required Skills**

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

title: Systems Engineering Advisor - Endpoint Management
description:
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer – Enterprise Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 9–12 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with proven technical leadership in large-scale ManageEngine and Microsoft Intune environments, ideally within an India-based global delivery model.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with seniority. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance (self, spouse, children, and parents), PF, gratuity, performance bonus, LTA, NPS, and professional certification reimbursement.
  
**Work Hours:** IST-aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking an experienced ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex ManageEngine/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Technical Leadership Architecture
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise ManageEngine/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with ManageEngine/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment Provisioning
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation Integration
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement Delivery Governance
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* ManageEngine Endpoint Management Tool (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
Gurugram · Full-time · Senior

#### **About The Position**

**About Coralogix**

Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.

We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.

**The Role**

Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.

Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.

A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.

  
  

**What You Will Build**

**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade
  

  

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets
  

  

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data
  

  

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

#### **Requirements**

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  

  

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones
  

  

**Cultural Fit**

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Microsoft 365 Specialist to manage, optimize, and support our global Microsoft 365 environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of core collaboration and productivity platforms, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and related services across a geographically distributed organization.

**Administration & Operations**

* Monitor service health, performance, and availability; troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, and data protection policies
* Support compliance initiatives (eDiscovery, retention policies, audit logs, DLP)
* Monitor and respond to security alerts and vulnerabilities within the M365 environment
* Ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory security standards

**End User Support & Enablement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for Microsoft 365-related issues and escalations
* Deliver user training, documentation, and knowledge base content to drive adoption
* Act as an escalation point for complex collaboration, messaging, and identity-related issues

* Lead or support migrations to/from Microsoft 365 (email, file shares, tenant consolidation)
* Implement governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive usage
* Integrate M365 with enterprise systems and third-party applications
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, automation, and platform efficiency

**Automation & Documentation**

* Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell or native M365 tools
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Develop and maintain reporting dashboards for usage, health, and compliance

* Strong expertise in:
* Exchange Online
* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive for Business
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and identity/access management
* Proven experience implementing Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps)
* Hybrid environments (Azure AD Connect, on-prem AD integration)
* Familiarity with governance frameworks, ITIL processes

**Key Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Continuous learning mindset to stay current with M365 roadmap and emerging capabilities
* Focus on security, compliance, and operational excellence

**Work arrangements**

* Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
* Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.

* Manage onshore/offshore teams and technology vendors, monitoring performance against agreed service expectations and driving accountability for high-quality development, support, and service delivery.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
