title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.
  
  
Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.
  
  
Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.
  
  
**About Sarvam**
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
  
  
****What this role promises you****
You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.
  
  
****What you'll do****

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.
  
  
****Who you are****
We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.
  
  

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

****Bonus points****

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: Database Technical Architect
description:
Our client is looking for an experienced
**Database Solutions Architect**
to join their ITS team. The Application Database & Middleware Architect will establish and govern database and database-facing middleware architecture across the manufacturing application portfolio, including MES, Test Solutions, Scheduling and Simulation, AI/ML, and other plant applications.

**Responsibilities include**

* Define and govern database and database-middleware architecture across MES, Test Solutions, Scheduling and Simulation, AI/ML and other manufacturing applications
* Establish standards for data modelling, schema design, SQL development, indexing, partitioning, transaction management and data retention
* Deep expertise in at least two of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase
* Provide technical leadership across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase
* Lead application and database performance optimization, including query tuning, execution-plan analysis, locking, deadlocks and connection management
* Define resilient application patterns for connection pooling, retries, failover, replication, change data capture and data synchronization
* Review database designs for new applications, major releases, integrations and multi-site deployments
* Drive database modernization, platform migrations, legacy-system rationalization and adoption of appropriate modern database technologies
* Establish monitoring and observability across applications, middleware and databases
* Act as L3 technical authority for major incidents, root-cause analysis, problem management and permanent corrective actions
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, deployment checklists, runbooks and troubleshooting guides for Site Teams
* Mentor database engineers and analysts and build cross-platform capability within the team

**Minimum Requirements**

* 9 –15 years of experience in database engineering, application architecture or database performance engineering, including experience in a technical lead or architect role
* Strong expertise in at least two of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase, with working knowledge across the remaining platforms
* Advanced knowledge of SQL tuning, execution plans, indexing, stored procedures, transactions, locking and concurrency management
* Experience with JDBC/ODBC, connection pools, database proxies, replication, CDC and application integration technologies
* Strong understanding of database availability, scalability, security, performance and application-side failover patterns
* Experience with database migrations, legacy modernization, automation and controlled database deployments
* Experience supporting high-volume, business-critical and 24x7 production applications
* Strong incident-management, root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to work effectively across Platform Teams, Site Teams, Infrastructure Operations, cybersecurity and external vendors
* Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, MES, equipment integration, scheduling or manufacturing applications is preferred
* Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem, change, availability and capacity-management practices
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline

title: Exchange and Active Directory Administrator
description:
**Bangalore**
-------------

**Job Brief**
-------------

We are seeking an experienced Exchange and Active Directory Administrator to manage, secure, and optimize the organization’s messaging and identity infrastructure across Microsoft Exchange Server, Exchange Online, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID environments. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and compliance of enterprise messaging and directory services, supporting hybrid identity solutions, mailbox migrations, disaster recovery, and automation initiatives.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2016/2019 and Exchange Server Subscription Edition (SE) environments.
* Design and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAGs), load balancing configurations, SSL certificates, and high-availability solutions for Exchange environments.
* Administer and support Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange deployments, including mailbox provisioning, migrations, coexistence, and hybrid connectivity.
* Manage mail flow components, including connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, message tracking, and troubleshooting email delivery issues.
* Implement and maintain email security controls, including Anti-Spam, Anti-Malware, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
* Administer and maintain Active Directory domains, forests, sites, trusts, domain controllers, FSMO roles, and replication services.
* Manage user accounts, groups, organizational units (OUs), service accounts, and delegated permissions throughout the account lifecycle.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to support organizational security and operational requirements.
* Administer and maintain AD-integrated DNS and DHCP services.
* Manage hybrid identity solutions using Microsoft Entra Connect and Cloud Sync, ensuring synchronization health and resolving identity-related issues.
* Perform Active Directory and Exchange backup, recovery, and disaster recovery testing, including authoritative restores and AD Recycle Bin recovery.
* Monitor Exchange and Active Directory performance, replication health, service availability, and capacity utilization.
* Plan and execute Exchange and Active Directory patching, cumulative updates, security updates, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Implement security best practices for messaging and identity platforms and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and administrative tools using PowerShell, including Exchange Management Shell and Active Directory modules.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), system architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Provide L2/L3 support for escalated incidents, changes, and problem management activities following ITIL-based processes.

**Requirements**
----------------

* + Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  + 4-6 years of hands-on experience administering enterprise Microsoft Exchange and Active Directory environments.
  + Strong experience with Exchange Server 2016/2019, Exchange Server SE, and Exchange Online administration.
  + Proven expertise in managing Database Availability Groups (DAGs), Exchange hybrid configurations, and mailbox migration projects.
  + Strong knowledge of email routing, mail flow management, connectors, transport rules, and messaging troubleshooting.
  + Experience implementing and managing email security solutions, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and anti-spam/anti-malware technologies.
  + Deep understanding of Active Directory architecture, including domains, forests, trusts, replication, FSMO roles, and Group Policy.
  + Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Entra Connect, and hybrid identity synchronization.
  + Proficiency in administering DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server environments supporting Active Directory services.
  + Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills for Exchange and Active Directory administration.
  + Experience with backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning for messaging and identity platforms.
  + Knowledge of identity security, privileged access management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance best practices.
  + Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  + Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
  + Customer-focused mindset with strong organizational and documentation skills.
  + Flexible to work in shifts and provide support across multiple locations based on business requirements.
  + Relevant industry certifications are highly desirable, including:
  + - Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate
    - Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
    - Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
    - Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
    - ITIL Foundation Certification
  + Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development in messaging, identity, and cloud technologies.

title: Snowflake Architect-AI and Data Solutions Engineer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 6-9 years in data architecture, with at least 2+ years focused on Snowflake.
* Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data solutions using Snowflake’s cloud-based data platform. This position requires hands-on experience with cloud data warehousing, a deep understanding of Snowflake features and architecture, and the ability to lead complex data migration and integration projects across business units.
* Snowflake advanced features (Streams, Tasks, Zero Copy Cloning, Data Sharing).
* SQL, Python, or Spark for data transformation and scripting.
* Experience with ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, Talend, Matillion, Fivetran, etc.).
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Understanding of data visualization/BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
* Experience in developing on J2EE platforms, .Net platforms, RDBMS platforms (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server)
* Develop robust and scalable Snowflake data architectures.
* Design ETL pipelines, data governance frameworks, and efficient schema models.
* Ensure security, compliance, and cost optimization within Snowflake environments.
* Lead end-to-end implementation of Snowflake solutions, including integration with third-party data sources and downstream analytics tools.
* Write efficient SQL and leverage Snowflake’s features (e.g., Streams, Tasks, Time Travel, Cloning).
* Assess existing data warehouse solutions (e.g., Teradata, Redshift, SQL Server).
* Build strategies for migration to Snowflake, focusing on minimal disruption and maximum data integrity.
* Continuously optimize performance and cost through warehouse sizing, partitioning, and indexing strategies.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, Business Intelligence teams, and key business stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentor junior team members.
* Create documentation, conduct workshops, and manage Snowflake roadmaps.
* Implement robust RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).
* Design and automate monitoring solutions for data quality, lineage, and platform health.
* Ensure platform compliance with relevant industry standards (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).

**Preferred:**

* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in Cloud Platform.
* Project management experience is a plus.
* Certified Associate or Professional

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc degree or equivalent from accredited university

title: Senior Software Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)
description:
**Role: Senior Software Engineer -**
**Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)**
**Location: Bengaluru/Chennai - Hybrid (3 days in Office per week)**

  
  

**About Pearson**

  
  

Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through education. We deliver high-quality content, assessments, and digital services to learners, educators, and institutions globally. Our mission is to empower every learner to achieve their potential.

  
  

**Role Summary**

  
  

We are seeking a
**Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)**
who combines strong software engineering expertise with a customer-centric mindset to solve complex business problems and deliver production-ready solutions.

  
  

The FDE works closely with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and engineers to understand customer needs, validate ideas, build proof-of-concepts, and deliver scalable capabilities using modern engineering practices.

  
  

This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

  
  

Success is measured by delivering customer value, accelerating solution delivery, and enabling successful adoption of the capabilities delivered.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Customer-Centric Solution Delivery**

* Analyse customer journeys, business workflows, and user pain points.
  
  
* Translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
  
  
* Ensure customer value remains at the centre of the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Gather feedback and continuously improve delivered solutions.
  

  

**Solution Discovery & Proof of Concepts**

  

  
* Lead technical discovery sessions and solution design workshops.

* Evaluate technology options and recommend suitable approaches.
  
  
* Present technical recommendations and trade-offs to stakeholders.
  
  
* Support solution shaping and implementation planning activities.
  

  

**Software Engineering**

  

  
* Design, develop, test, and deploy production-grade software solutions.

* Participate in architecture and design discussions.
  
  
* Apply software engineering best practices, coding standards, and testing approaches.
  
  
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems.
  

  

**Cloud Engineering**

* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and operational controls.
  
  
* Design and contribute to scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
  
  
* Follow cloud engineering and operational excellence practices.
  

  

**Secure-by-Design Engineering**

  

  
* Apply secure-by-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
* Implement secure coding practices and security controls.
  
  
* Participate in threat modelling, vulnerability remediation, and security reviews.
  
  
* Apply DevSecOps practices, including automated security validation and compliance checks.
  
  
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise security and governance standards.
  

  

**AI-Assisted Engineering**

  

  
* Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity and software quality.
  
  
* Apply AI-supported approaches for coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation.
  
  
* Contribute to agentic and automation initiatives where appropriate.
  
  
* Follow responsible AI and data governance practices.
  

  

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

  

  
* Provide technical leadership within project teams.
  
  
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing.
  
  
* Lead code reviews, design reviews, and engineering discussions.
  
  
* Collaborate with architects, security teams, product teams, and cloud engineers.
  
  
* Influence technical decisions through technical expertise, collaboration, and data-driven recommendations.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Customer Focus & Business Acumen**

  

  
* Strong customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business value.
  
  
* Experience engaging directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand problems, validate assumptions, and shape technical solutions.
  
  
* Ability to balance customer experience, business priorities, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational considerations.
  

  

**Software Engineering**

  

  
* Strong software development experience using Python, Java, TypeScript, or similar technologies.
  
  
* Experience building APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
  
  
* Understanding of microservices architecture and modern software engineering principles.
  
  
* Experience delivering production-grade solutions.
  

  

**Cloud Engineering**

  

  
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure.
  
  
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud automation, and deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence practices.
  
  
* Understanding of cloud security, scalability, resilience, and cost optimisation.
  

  

**Security**

  

  
* Experience applying secure software development practices.
  
  
* Understanding of authentication, authorisation, data protection, encryption, and application security.
  
  
* Familiarity with DevSecOps principles and security automation.
  

  

**AI-Assisted Engineering**

  

  
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools within development workflows.
  
  
* Understanding of automation, agentic engineering concepts, and modern AI-assisted delivery practices.
  
  
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices and governance considerations.
  

  

**Leadership & Communication**

  

  
* Demonstrated technical leadership within engineering teams.
  
  
* Experience leading proof-of-concepts, pilots, or complex technical initiatives.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  
  
* Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  
  
* Passion for continuous learning and innovation.
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

**Success in this role is demonstrated through:**

  

  
* Successful delivery of secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
* Effective execution of proof-of-concepts and technology validations.
  
  
* Positive customer, stakeholder, and business outcomes.
  
  
* High-quality engineering practices and code quality.
  
  
* Adoption of cloud engineering, automation, security, and AI-assisted development practices.
  
  
* Strong technical leadership and collaboration within teams.
  
  
* Contribution to reusable engineering patterns and continuous improvement.
  

  

**What This Role Is Not**

  

  
* Not a pure Enterprise Architect.
  
  
* Not a traditional Software Engineer working only from a predefined backlog.
  
  
* Not a Consultant providing recommendations without accountability.
  
  
* Not a Project Manager.

**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep expertise in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch to own and support mission-critical database platforms serving enterprise SaaS applications. This role is not suitable for candidates with only development or basic DBA experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale production environments containing millions of records, supporting 24x7 high-availability systems with strict uptime SLAs. The engineer will independently diagnose complex database failures, perform failovers, optimize performance under load, ensure business continuity, influence technical direction, and mentor junior engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Database Design & Architecture**

* Architect and implement scalable, high-availability MongoDB solutions including replica sets, sharded clusters, Atlas deployments, and disaster recovery architectures.
* Design, implement, and manage MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch environments across development, staging, and production.
* Define schema design standards, sharding strategies, indexing approaches, data lifecycle management, and capacity planning.

**Production Reliability & Operations**

* Own 24x7 production database operations with accountability for uptime, reliability, and SLA compliance.
* Diagnose and resolve complex database incidents, execute failovers, recovery activities, root-cause analysis, and business continuity procedures.
* Lead rolling upgrades, patching, migrations, and maintenance with minimal or zero downtime.

**Performance & Optimization**

* Analyze query patterns, design optimal indexes, tune aggregation pipelines, and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvements using profiler, explain plans, Atlas tools, and observability platforms.
* Optimize high-volume databases containing millions of records and heavy workloads.

**Security & Reliability**

* Implement RBAC, TLS/SSL, encryption, LDAP integration, auditing, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Ensure enterprise-grade database security, resilience, and operational governance.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Define database best practices, review data models, and provide technical leadership.
* Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with development, platform, SRE, and DevOps teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of database engineering, DBRE, DBA, or related experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on MongoDB production support experience.
* Deep expertise in replica sets, sharding, Atlas, replication, failover, query tuning, and aggregation framework.
* Strong PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch administration and performance tuning experience.
* Experience managing databases supporting enterprise SaaS applications and millions of records.
* Cloud experience on Azure , AWS, or GCP and strong Linux administration skills.
* Programming experience in .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or similar technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MongoDB Certified DBA or Developer certification.
* MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, time-series collections, Ops Manager, or Cloud Manager experience.
* Experience with Kafka, Spark, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure Cosmos DB, and database migrations.
* Background in SaaS, telemetry, IoT, or large-scale enterprise data platforms.

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

A day in the life
  
  

* Work with Data engineering teams in fixing and building data pipelines
* Supporting and building automations (SQL, Pythons, AWS, Glue, S3)
* Understanding and executing manual process supporting Benefits Domain, identifying and building use cases for Automation

* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 2+ years of progressive experience in support engineering or software development or a related field
* 2+ year of experience with at least one scripting language such as JavaScript, Python, Ruby or similar
* 2+ year of experience writing SQL queries including but not limited to using joins, aggregate functions and window functions
* Experience with AWS services, S3 and Glue

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON
* Experience in systems patching and maintenance
* Experience with ETL processes
* Experience with AWS services and Linux operating systems
* Experience in automation with CI/CD, Data Quality Management and Operations
* Good understanding of systems monitoring, debugging and troubleshooting

title: Specialist, Product Operations, Reference Data
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

The primary purpose of this position is to research, analyze, interpret, transform and present reference data for Equity and Funds securities across global markets, while supporting the Index team by providing reference data with precision. The focus of this position is to perform this work with documents written in English.

The incumbent must successfully complete a 8-to-12-week training program that centers on building enough subject matter expertise and the utilization of the database(s) of record such that the incumbent can independently analyze legal and financial documents associated with Equity and Fund securities. During training, the incumbent must master all of the subject matter and will be required to pass a series of quizzes and tests as well achieve the accuracy and timeliness metrics that were established for trainees.

The training curriculum for Data Analyst contains high level overviews of the complex structures worked on by more senior personnel as well as reference data client use cases so that the incumbent can differentiate between legal and financial language that is relevant to and required by our client base versus jargon describing information that is not required and, so that the incumbent can identify new financing techniques that come to market. The incumbent must then apply this foundation of knowledge via a logical sequence of decision-making events to determine relevancy of said information to our clients for any of their use cases and if deemed relevant, determine the appropriate next steps to ensure high client satisfaction levels.

The Equity and Funds asset class consists significantly large volumes of active securities and the reference data provided by ICE Data Services for said securities is used by our clients to make trading decisions, settle trades, make investment decisions, manage portfolios, analyze risk, create security master files, create client statements and conduct other back-office functions. Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within ICE and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze, interpret, collate, and transform reference data for multi structure/events/sub processes with high complexity in either the primary market or the secondary market (but not both) provided in a variety of legal and financial documents, third party reports and vendor information, while ensuring that the reference data provided in ICE’s products and services accurate, comprehensive and in a timely manner, namely best in class.
* Demonstrate familiarity with reference data products to support client challenges and resolve data problems.
* Build core competencies in the maintenance of reference data captured in alternate databases used to produce products.
* Independently perform all assigned business processes completely and accurately.
* Conduct user acceptance testing of new enhancements and bug fixes made to the database(s) of record
* Craft external facing responses for those clients that submitted customer inquiries containing a meaningful, well-thought out, well-constructed answer that includes a restatement of the challenge or question, the analysis completed to satisfy the request and where appropriate, the methodology used to determine the solution when researching and resolving client inquiries.
* Identifies trends and causation of inaccurate and/or incomplete data including but not limited to staying current with regulatory initiatives, new financing techniques used by the marketplace and organizations that impact coverage and completeness.
* Create simple excel and macro functions to organize, analyze, convert, and create reference data.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge and understanding of policies and procedures and work with training team to augment best practices as changes in the marketplace evolve.
* Applies problem-solving skills to identify and help to resolve data quality issues and/or work-flow inefficiencies and process improvements resulting in increased accuracy levels, time to market and productivity.
* Participate in root cause analysis efforts to identify system data issues and participate in creating process improvements. Resolve complex data challenges and time critical sensitive projects.
* Create charts, graphs, and presentations for leadership teams.
* Communicate with and influence market participants including underwriters, issuers, trust administrators and exchanges through phone and email correspondence to procure required reference data content, resolve data discrepancies and gain an understanding of undefined terms.
* Make sound, subjective decisions when interpreting legal and financial information by utilizing subject matter expertise to infer, deduce and ultimately draw the correct conclusions. Mentor junior employees provide guidance; serve as subject matter experts.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* 5+ years corporate level experience, or 2+ years direct experience.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressured, fluid environment
* Ability to distill large amounts of varied information into specific takeaways
* Excellent attention to detail and high degree of demonstrated decision-making and problem-solving skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Eagerness to learn and collaborate with others
* Strong excel skills required

title: Software Engineer I
description:
TITLE
  
  
Software Engineer I
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Software Engineer I is responsible to design, code, and/or configure solutions for moderate complexity Agile stories, as well as writing automated unit and integration-level tests.
  
  
**WHAT YOU’LL Do**

* Designs, codes, and/or configures solutions for moderate complexity Agile stories with some guidance from a senior software engineer, using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation while critically validating all AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Debugs and resolves moderate complexity software bugs or issues, working independently to find the real root cause and provide a fix without collateral damage — applying systematic debugging practices rather than trial-and-error, including when using AI tooling to assist investigation.
* Writes automated unit and integration-level tests under own direction, including end-to-end test coverage using modern test automation frameworks.
* Contributes to Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline definitions for cloud-based (Azure) deployments as part of feature delivery.
* May create or support the creation of a conceptual design/architecture for small-scale software solutions with guidance from an architect or more senior developer.
* May provide guidance and mentoring to more junior software engineers, including on the effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.
* Follows development standards and effectively demonstrates technical solutions to other software engineers in code reviews — including reviewing AI-assisted contributions with the same rigor as hand-written code.
* Assists in making source code management decisions for one or more teams.
* Performs source code management tasks (Git-based workflows, branching, PR hygiene) without specific guidance required from other team members.
* Performs other related duties and activities as required.

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree, or higher education level, or its foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Information Sciences, and/or related field
* Total Work Experience: 6+ years (software development), 4 years minimum,
* Product Experience: 2 years minimum, 4+ years preferred
* Domain Experience: 2 years minimum, 4+ years preferred

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Expert in object-oriented design, Java or .NET development, relational OLTP queries, and relational database design.
* Capable of XML/XSLT document design, JavaScript/TypeScript development, HTML5 & CSS.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure fundamentals (Azure preferred) and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling such as Terraform.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes) as used in modern deployment pipelines.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or equivalent) and automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Pester, or similar).
* Expert in Duck Creek Policy, Billing, Claims, Engagement (AP), or Data Insights.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) as part of the daily development workflow, paired with sound judgment on when to trust, verify, or override AI suggestions.
* Ability to manage deadlines, communicate in a team, and operate independently with guidance.
* Understands how to estimate, analyze, and execute the Software Product Development Lifecycle with Agile methodology.
* Understands Insurance domain knowledge.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

Job Description

**About Persistent**

Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced SQL Server Database Architect to lead the architecture, governance, modernization, and operational excellence of enterprise SQL Server platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, database security, and operational resilience.

  

* **Role: SQL Server Database Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 12 to 17 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architecture for SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and decision frameworks for SQL Server platforms.
* Establish standards for clustering, Always On Availability Groups, backup, recovery, monitoring, encryption, and privileged access management.
* Develop lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernization, consolidation, and database migration roadmaps.
* Act as the technical design authority for enterprise database solutions.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, resilience, data governance, and service management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform modernization initiatives.
* Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions aligned to business requirements.
* Lead recovery planning, failover testing, restore validation, and resilience assessments.
* Define standards for indexing strategies, query optimization, workload management, and database performance tuning.
* Establish performance baselines, capacity models, and forecasting processes.
* Lead technical response during critical incidents and major platform outages.
* Drive root-cause analysis and implement long-term engineering improvements.
* Define database security architectures and governance standards.
* Implement controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, patching, hardening, secrets management, and service accounts.
* Partner with cybersecurity, audit, risk, and compliance teams to address control requirements and audit findings.
* Ensure database platforms comply with relevant regulatory and operational resilience requirements.
* Support data protection, retention, governance, and compliance initiatives across the organization.
* Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to database administrators and engineering teams.
* Review and approve complex implementation plans and solution designs.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools.
* Evaluate database technologies, vendor solutions, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to manage technical dependencies.
* Maintain architecture repositories, service maps, support models, standards, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to strategic technology planning and database platform governance.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 12-17 years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Architecture roles.
* Extensive experience with SQL Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 in large enterprise production environments.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).
* Deep understanding of High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, Restore, and Business Continuity strategies.
* Strong experience supporting mission-critical business applications under formal change, incident, problem, and release management frameworks.
* Expertise in database modernization, upgrade, consolidation, and cloud migration programs.
* Advanced T-SQL development, execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Windows Server administration and supporting infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos Authentication, storage systems, networking, virtualization, and monitoring platforms.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server security architecture, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with automation using PowerShell and scripting technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture frameworks and technical governance processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

title: DBA & Data Migration Specialist
description:
**Location** - New Delhi **Experience** - 8Years

###### **Vacancies - 1**

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced DBA & Data Migration Specialist to manage database administration, legacy data migration, data validation, and database performance optimization for Government IT and e-Governance projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing migration strategies, reviewing migration scripts, ensuring data accuracy and integrity, validating dashboards and reports, and maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing database environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Database Administration & Performance Management**

* Administer, configure, monitor, and maintain relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Review database architecture, schema design, indexing strategies, queries, and execution plans.
* Monitor database performance, availability, storage utilization, and resource consumption.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, query inefficiencies, and database-related issues.
* Manage database backup, recovery, replication, access controls, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Ensure database security, data integrity, availability, and compliance with applicable policies.

### **2. Legacy Data Migration Strategy & Mapping**

* Develop and review legacy data migration strategies for transferring data from existing systems to new applications and databases.
* Assess source and target databases, legacy data structures, data formats, dependencies, and migration risks.
* Prepare and validate source-to-target data mapping documents, transformation rules, and migration specifications.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, obsolete, or invalid records before migration.
* Define data cleansing, transformation, normalization, and validation procedures.
* Plan migration activities, timelines, rollback mechanisms, and contingency arrangements to minimize operational disruption.
* Coordinate with application teams, business analysts, and project stakeholders to ensure migration requirements are met.

### **3. Migration Script Assessment & Execution Oversight**

* Review SQL scripts, ETL workflows, stored procedures, and data transformation logic used for migration.
* Assess migration scripts for accuracy, completeness, performance, security, and data integrity.
* Validate data extraction, transformation, loading, and error-handling mechanisms.
* Oversee migration testing, trial runs, production migration activities, and post-migration verification.
* Identify migration risks, resolve technical discrepancies, and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain migration logs, exception reports, execution records, and rollback documentation.

### **4. Data Reconciliation & Accuracy Validation**

* Perform source-to-target data reconciliation to verify that migrated data is complete, consistent, and accurate.
* Validate record counts, field-level values, relationships, business rules, and referential integrity.
* Identify and investigate missing records, duplicate entries, transformation errors, and data mismatches.
* Coordinate with business and technical teams to resolve discrepancies and obtain validation confirmation.
* Conduct post-migration quality checks and document reconciliation results.
* Ensure appropriate approval and acceptance of migrated datasets before production sign-off.

### **5. Dashboard & Reporting Data Accuracy**

* Validate the accuracy and consistency of data displayed in dashboards, MIS reports, analytical reports, and management information systems.
* Verify report calculations, aggregations, filters, totals, and underlying database queries against source records.
* Ensure dashboard indicators and reports reflect approved business rules and validated datasets.
* Investigate discrepancies between database records, application screens, dashboards, and generated reports.
* Coordinate with reporting, business intelligence, and application teams to resolve data quality issues.
* Prepare data validation reports and maintain supporting evidence for review and approval.

### **6. Data Governance, Security & Documentation**

* Implement data quality controls, database access management, and appropriate audit mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with applicable data privacy, retention, archival, and information security requirements.
* Maintain database documentation, data dictionaries, schema details, migration plans, and validation records.
* Support database audits, technical reviews, testing activities, and operational handover.
* Coordinate with project managers, developers, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and government stakeholders.

**Key Deliverables**
--------------------

* Legacy data migration strategy and source-to-target mapping documents.
* Database assessment and performance review reports.
* Migration script assessment and validation reports.
* Data cleansing, transformation, and migration execution documentation.
* Source-to-target reconciliation and data accuracy validation reports.
* Dashboard and MIS report data validation reports.
* Database backup, recovery, security, and operational documentation.
* **A signed Migration Review Note for each engagement**, documenting the migration approach, script assessment, reconciliation results, identified discrepancies, corrective actions, data quality status, and review approval.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in database administration, data migration, data validation, and database performance management.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database management systems such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Experience in legacy database assessment, source-to-target mapping, data transformation, and migration planning.
* Practical knowledge of migration script review, ETL processes, data reconciliation, and data integrity validation.
* Experience in database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, backup, and recovery.
* Ability to validate MIS reports, dashboards, and application data against source databases.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience in Government IT, public sector, or e-Governance projects involving legacy system modernization.
* Familiarity with ETL tools, data integration platforms, and database migration utilities.
* Knowledge of database monitoring, high availability, replication, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with large-volume data migration and post-migration reconciliation.
* Understanding of data governance, audit trails, data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Familiarity with BI and reporting platforms such as Power BI or equivalent tools.

**Qualification - B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.Tech. or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Management or a related discipline.**

title: Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn
* Experience with massively parallel processing (MPP) databases - Redshift, Teradata etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
