title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
**Job Description**
As part of the Financial Reporting Quality Assurance (FRQA) organization within Corporate Controllership, this role is accountable for overseeing critical Level 1 production support processes for financial systems, including data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, validation, operational calendar management, end-to-end process coordination, and incident management.
  
  
The team maintains deep knowledge of data sources, processing workflows, and regulatory reporting requirements, and is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across a broad range of finance technology platforms. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, disciplined operational execution, proactive monitoring, and timely incident resolution.
  
  
The Service Management Financial System Analyst is expected to be collaborative, highly organized, and results oriented, with responsibility for end-to-end operational monitoring, incident tracking, triage, problem management, and support of financial system reliability, stability, and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role is responsible for ensuring financial systems operations are effectively governed, executed, monitored, controlled, and continuously improved. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage operational processes to ensure financial systems function as intended, processes run efficiently, and required controls and auditability are maintained.
* Ensure successful completion of daily operational activities in alignment with established processing calendars, controls, and service expectations.
* Collaborate with business, finance, and technology stakeholders to triage incidents, manage resolution activities, and support timely root cause analysis.
* Identify recurring incident themes and partner with technology and business teams to drive sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, and automation.
* Assess the operational impact of production changes and ensure runbooks, procedures, and related documentation are updated accurately and on time.
* Develop, operationalize, and monitor dashboards that provide transparency into process health, operational performance, and service management trends.
* Document business and technical requirements for enhancements, standard operating procedures, and process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and control management requirements.
* Identify, document, implement, and periodically test operational controls in accordance with RCSA/PRSA guidelines to confirm control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technology-related field, preferably Computer Science.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial systems implementation, production support, and incident management for financial systems.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database and data management concepts, with strong proficiency in SQL and exposure to both traditional and modern data technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial, business, and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Ability to perform effectively in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in challenging situations.
* Proven transformational mindset, with a focus on improving process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Self-starter and proactive team player with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality service and meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Experience with accounting and reporting processes, including financial and regulatory reporting, is preferred.
* Flexibility is essential for this production support role, including the ability to work in shifts and provide weekend support on a rotational basis.

Technical Skills & Knowledge of Platforms
  
  

* Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and production incident troubleshooting, including the ability to write complex queries and perform multi-table joins.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, MemSQL, and Putty for incident triage, reporting, and operational support.
* Advanced knowledge of job scheduling tools such as Airflow and Automic is required.
* Experience in Generative AI frameworks would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, monitoring, logging, IAM, production support, maintenance, and troubleshooting, is preferred.
* Experience with AxiomSL is preferred.
* Knowledge of Flink and Beam server is preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira is preferred.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Associate Manager, Data Delivery & Dashboard
description:
**Job Description**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of complex data outputs for our healthcare market research projects. The team is responsible for conducting comprehensive quality checks on large datasets, transforming and standardising data files to meet project and client requirements, and managing delivery through automated and off-the-shelf dashboard solutions. By combining technical precision with a client-focused approach, the team enables timely, insightful, and accessible data visualisation that supports strategic decision-making across our global research initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team Lead role will report into the Sr Manager. The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team lead will be a key member of the India-based Data Management & Delivery Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets for STEM. As a Dashboard Developer Team lead, you build and maintain high impact dashboards and data visualizations that transform raw market research data into actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with researchers, analysts, and engineers to ensure data flows seamlessly from collections to visual storytelling. You will also support the team in delivering insightful, user-friendly dashboards through automated tools and off-the-shelf solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in data management, quality assurance, and data visualisation, while working alongside an experienced team in a dynamic, global environment. Skill Set required
  
  
**STEM Dashboard Discovery Phase**
One of primary responsibilities would be to streamline the overall data collection process and create dashboards
  
  
**Brand Equity tracking support with our in-house platform:**

* Maintain the pipeline for the project data process flow (this includes receival of data into in-hosue Tool, through the data processing stage into the storage mart, through the python utilities into required outputs)
* Maintain and update Power BI Dashboard when required due to changes from the research team
* Manage and rectify when failures occur in the dashboard, liaising with both the data providers, research team and developers on the Pipeline
* Manage the storage mart and data warehouse
* Support team with edits in-house platform

**Data Quality Checks:**
Assist in performing detailed quality control checks on large and complex datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  
  
**Data Transformation & Standardisation:**
Support the transformation and standardisation of data files to align with internal data structures, project needs, and client-specific formats.
  
  
**Dashboard Support & Maintenance:**
Lead in the creation, population, and maintenance of dashboards using off-the-shelf tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms), ensuring outputs are clear, accurate, and aligned with research objectives.
  
  
**Data Delivery Management:**
Manage and organise the final delivery of data files and dashboards to internal teams and clients, ensuring timely and error-free execution.
  
  
**Collaboration Across Teams:**
Work closely with internal stakeholders including Development team, Data Processing, Scripting, Project Management and Research teams to ensure smooth handovers and integration of deliverables.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting:**
Maintain clear documentation of processes, data transformation steps, and QC logs to support transparency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness.
  
  
**Continuous Learning & Development:**
Engage in training opportunities to build knowledge in healthcare data, market research workflows, dashboarding tools, and data handling best practices.
  
  
**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**
**Technical Expertise**

* At least 6+ years expertise in Power BI, Power query , DAX, data modeling, Quality assurance, SQL
* Experience in Building interactive, user-friendly dashboards
* Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, etc.)
* Understanding and building of ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Expert level Knowledge of Python
* Proficient in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Cloud platform expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP), and building ETL/ELT pipelines is a plus
* Experience in version control system.

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
We love what we do and continuously strive for innovation and creativity. We believe everyone should continuously be learning and provide:
  
  

* A comprehensive training and development programme for all staff, from entry level apprentice to senior management
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration
* A relaxed and friendly working environment

**About Inizio Advisory:**
Research Partnership is part of Inizio Advisory, a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: NetSuite Engineer
description: Company Description Leixir Dental Laboratory Group is a network of full-service, state-of-the-art dental labs offering a complete range of leading-edge dental products and solutions. Strategically located labs provide dentists with superior services that balance innovative digital technology with proven traditional methods. As a leader in cosmetic and restorative dentistry, Leixir delivers up-to-date products including crowns and bridges, implants, surgical guides, dentures, and intraoral scanners. Advanced CAD/CAM systems support the full lifecycle of dental restorations, from initial design through case completion. Every lab in the Leixir network is focused on empowering dental practices with technology-driven solutions and reliable support.Role Description This is a full-time, on-site NetSuite Engineer role based in Gurugram. The NetSuite Engineer will configure, customize, and maintain NetSuite ERP to support dental lab operations, including finance, inventory, order management, and production workflows. The role involves building and optimizing scripts, workflows, custom records, and integrations, as well as troubleshooting system issues and ensuring data integrity. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into NetSuite solutions, and support process improvements and automation. Daily responsibilities also include user support and training, documentation of technical changes, and coordination with external vendors or partners when needed.Qualifications NetSuite ERP skills: strong experience in NetSuite configuration, customization, workflows, SuiteScript, and role/permission management.Technical and integration skills: proficiency with APIs, web services, data migration, and integration tools; solid understanding of SQL or similar query languages.Business process skills: ability to map and optimize processes in areas such as finance, supply chain, inventory, and production within an ERP environment.Analysis and problem-solving skills: strong aptitude for requirements gathering, system analysis, troubleshooting, and root-cause identification.Collaboration and communication skills: ability to work closely with operations, finance, IT, and leadership teams; clear written and verbal communication.Education and experience: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; prior experience as a NetSuite Engineer, Developer, or Administrator is preferred.Additional beneficial experience: familiarity with manufacturing or laboratory operations, knowledge of dental or healthcare industry workflows, and experience in process automation and reporting/dashboard development.

title: AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability
description:
Join us as a "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability" at Barclays, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behavior, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. You will need to take ownership of key initiatives to deliver results through an agile workflow.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
To be successful as an "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Essential Skills And Qualifications**

* Manage change to data platforms.
* Perform incident triage for platform issues.
* Perform root cause analysis on platform performance issues.
* Manage cloud platform usage and costs.
* Educate on the data platforms that are used across the businesses.
* Support users in accessing the platforms and adhering to the required governance.
* Advocate best practice for data platform use to maximize business value delivered.
* Identify common themes in user platform use that is sub optimal and implement training and / or support where needed.
* Championing the features that the business need.
* Translating complex technology into consumable business language. Supporting corporate data modernisation program.
* Design, test and build complex forecast models and simulations to identify causal links between customer behavior and business opportunities and performance.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Communication
* Problem solving
* SQL
* Database query optimization (and understanding of if and when optimization techniques can be used on different platforms)
* Willingness to learn new tools and platforms and then help educate others.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, AOP
description: DescriptionAmazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses.This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside — you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time — that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models.The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you.What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet — they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication — and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports — is what will make you exceptional in this role.About The TeamThe AOP Science Team is the central science team of Amazon APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Operations. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. As a team our goal is to support our customers to make better decisions by leveraging applied statistics, machine learning, OR, deep learning architecture and algorithms. Team owns end-to-end life cycle for science model development which includes data exploration, experimentation, automating near real-time data pipelines, data visualization and model productionization.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modelingPreferred Qualifications Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasetsOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
JD:
**Senior Platform Architect (Tech Lead)**

**Location:**
Noida

**Reports to:**
CTO

**Type:**
Full-time, individual contributor tech lead

**About Sutra.AI**

Sutra.AI is a complete ‘Data to Value’ AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose-built for mid-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.

**The role**

You own how the platform is built. You are the hands-on technical lead for the core platform and the data layer that every product runs on. You set the architecture, write and review the critical code, and hold the bar on quality, security and scale. You take over day-to-day platform and data architecture from the CTO.

Engineers across the platform look to you for technical direction, design review and code review.

Stack you should be familiar with

* **Data:**
  open lakehouse (Trino, Apache Iceberg), change data capture, data quality monitoring
* **Ingestion:**
  AI-assisted connectors for ERP, SQL databases, files and SaaS sources
* **AI:**
  leading LLMs on AWS and GCP, agents and tool-calling (MCP), vector search
* **Apps and services:**
  Python, FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Postgres
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM tracing and evals, product analytics
* **Cloud:**
  AWS and GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Compliance:**
  SOC 2, HIPAA-ready deployments

**What you will own**

* **Core platform architecture:**
  security, scalability, multi-tenancy, connector standards, extension points.
* **Data access and performance:**
  a governed data access layer that serves interactive apps with fast response times alongside heavy AI agent workloads, with cost and latency under control.
* **Interfaces between teams:**
  clear, written contracts between platform components so product teams build on the platform, not around it.
* **Code quality:**
  review standards, design reviews, hands-on review of critical paths. Raise the bar for the whole team.
* **Security and compliance by design:**
  least privilege, fine-grained data access controls that AI cannot bypass, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit trails. Turn compliance requirements into architecture, not paperwork.
* **Reliability:**
  SLOs, observability, on-call design, self-healing pipelines, and scaling as customer usage grows.
* **Technical direction**
  for data engineers and full stack engineers.

**Must have**

* 8+ years building backend and data platforms, with recent hands-on coding. You still ship.
* Built production data pipelines and platform infrastructure: lakehouse or distributed query engines (Trino, Spark, Iceberg, Delta or similar), CDC and ingestion, data quality.
* Strong distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
* Security-first: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, tenant isolation, audit. Experience in a SOC 2, HIPAA or similarly regulated environment.
* Hands-on AI exposure: shipped LLM or agent features in production, and understand evals, tool-calling and MCP well enough to design platforms for them.
* Has made architecture decisions at scale and lived with the consequences.
* Leads through design and code review. People want your review.

**Nice to have**

* Query engine internals, catalog performance, query planning
* OpenTelemetry and LLM observability tooling
* Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS and GCP
* Enterprise system integration (ERP and other line-of-business systems)
* Healthcare, defense or financial compliance programs

**This role is not**

A people manager. A pure DevOps or SRE role.

**How we hire**

* Intro with the CTO
* Architecture deep dive: walk us through a platform you designed, including what you would change
* Live design: a governed data access layer for a multi-tenant AI platform
* Code review exercise
* Final with CEO

**What you get**

Ownership of the platform every product runs on, direct work with the CTO, real enterprise data problems, and meaningful equity.

title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
**About The Position**
**About Coralogix**
Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.
  
  
We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.
  
  
**The Role**
Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.
  
  
Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.
  
  
A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.
  
  
**What You Will Build**
**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

**Requirements**

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones

**Cultural Fit**
We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. description:
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer – Enterprise Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 9–12 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with proven technical leadership in large-scale ManageEngine and Microsoft Intune environments, ideally within an India-based global delivery model.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with seniority. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance (self, spouse, children, and parents), PF, gratuity, performance bonus, LTA, NPS, and professional certification reimbursement.
  
**Work Hours:** IST-aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking an experienced ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex ManageEngine/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Technical Leadership Architecture
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise ManageEngine/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with ManageEngine/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment Provisioning
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation Integration
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement Delivery Governance
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* ManageEngine Endpoint Management Tool (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

description:

Join us as a "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability" at Barclays, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behavior, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. You will need to take ownership of key initiatives to deliver results through an agile workflow.

  
  

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

To be successful as an "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability", you should have experience with:

**Essential Skills and Qualifications:**

* Manage change to data platforms.
* Perform incident triage for platform issues.
* Perform root cause analysis on platform performance issues.
* Manage cloud platform usage and costs.
* Educate on the data platforms that are used across the businesses.
* Support users in accessing the platforms and adhering to the required governance.
* Advocate best practice for data platform use to maximize business value delivered.
* Identify common themes in user platform use that is sub optimal and implement training and / or support where needed.
* Championing the features that the business need.
* Translating complex technology into consumable business language.
    
  Supporting corporate data modernisation program.
* Design, test and build complex forecast models and simulations to identify causal links between customer behavior and business opportunities and performance.

**Desirable skills/Preferred Qualifications:**

* Communication
* Problem solving
* SQL
* Database query optimization (and understanding of if and when optimization techniques can be used on different platforms)
* Willingness to learn new tools and platforms and then help educate others.
  

  

This role will be based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.

**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

**Principal Analyst, Business Intelligence Service Delivery:**

This role is responsible for leading development and support for the analytics solutions on SAP BW, Azure, Databricks, PBI and BPC. This individual is responsible for leading the business requirement gathering, design technical solutions, implementation, and optimization of solutions.

This role combines technical expertise with business acumen to ensure efficient and effective IT solutions delivery for analytics operations and automation.

This is an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgement in applying professional expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision. This Job requires an understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline, attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of information.

This role requires engaging and supporting global teams and business primarily in the US, good overlap hours required during working

**What you will do:**

* Design, build, test, and deliver scalable analytics and data solutions across SAP BW, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and BPC, ensuring reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Lead end-to-end analytics development and application support, ensuring successful delivery of solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, and enterprise data strategy.
* Partner with business, IT, global process governance, and project teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering security, scalability, stability, and long-term sustainability.
* Provide technical leadership to internal and vendor development teams, including solution design, hands-on development, code reviews, implementation, troubleshooting, and adherence to engineering best practices.
* Drive operational excellence by overseeing day-to-day application support and maintenance while identifying opportunities to improve system performance, process efficiency, and overall customer experience.
* Lead incident, problem, and root cause management, resolving complex technical issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve application stability and service reliability.
* Transform support operations through automation, AI, self-service, and shift-left approaches, reducing manual effort and continuously improving service effectiveness and user experience.

title: Vulnerability Management Security Sr. Analyst
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

**Vulnerability Assessment & Scanning**

* Plan, schedule, and execute vulnerability scans across network, endpoint, server, and cloud environments using tools such as Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Perform authenticated and unauthenticated scans, ensuring coverage across all in-scope assets.
* Conduct ad hoc scans following remediation activities to validate closure of identified vulnerabilities.
* Maintain and continuously improve scan coverage, ensuring no asset gaps in the vulnerability programme.

**Analysis & Risk Prioritisation**

* Analyse scan results and assess vulnerabilities based on CVSS scores, exploit availability, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Correlate vulnerability findings with threat intelligence feeds to identify actively exploited vulnerabilities that require expedited remediation.
* Differentiate and prioritise Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity vulnerabilities in line with client SLAs and organisational risk appetite.
* Provide contextual risk analysis beyond automated scoring, considering the environment and compensating controls in place.

**Remediation Management & Follow-up**

* Assign remediation tasks to relevant resolver teams and track progress through to closure.
* Conduct regular follow-up with resolver teams to ensure patch deployment, configuration changes, or compensating controls are applied within agreed timelines.
* Escalate overdue or high-risk items to management and client stakeholders as appropriate.
* Validate remediation completeness through rescan confirmation and update records accordingly.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare and deliver monthly, weekly, and ad hoc vulnerability management reports for client and internal stakeholders, including trend analysis, SLA performance, and risk posture summaries.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date vulnerability records across ticketing and vulnerability management platforms.
* Support governance meetings, monthly business reviews, and audit activities with relevant vulnerability data and evidence.
* Track and report on KPIs such as mean time to remediate (MTTR), vulnerability age, and scan coverage.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for client queries related to vulnerability findings, remediation status, and risk assessment.
* Provide guidance and recommendations to resolver teams and clients on remediation approaches, patch management, and risk acceptance.
* Participate in client calls and governance forums, presenting vulnerability posture and remediation progress clearly and concisely.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain and continuously improve vulnerability management SOPs, playbooks, and process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to automate or streamline scanning, reporting, and remediation tracking workflows.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, CVEs, threat actor activity, and vendor advisories, and communicate relevant intelligence to the team and stakeholders.
* Support tool evaluations, onboarding of new scan targets, and integration of new clients or entities into the vulnerability programme.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

* 4–6 years of experience in cybersecurity with at least 2–3 years focused on vulnerability management.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools — Nessus Professional, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, Defender or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of network protocols, operating systems (Windows, Linux), and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with ITSM and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow for remediation tracking.
* Strong analytical and report-writing skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in a managed security services or client-facing environment is preferred.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Threat Intelligence Analyst – Early Career**
==============================================

  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Threat Intelligence (TI) Analyst supports the collection, analysis, and dissemination of cyber threat intelligence to improve ADI’s ability to anticipate, detect, and respond to cyber threats. Working closely with the SOC, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, and Cyber Defence teams, this role helps identify emerging threats, track adversary activity, and translate intelligence into practical defensive actions. This is an early-career role intended for individuals looking to build expertise in cyber threat intelligence, adversary analysis, threat hunting, and intelligence-driven defence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Collect and analyse cyber threat intelligence from open-source, deep web, dark web, commercial, vendor, and industry sources.

* Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, malware campaigns, credential exposures, data leaks and threat actor activity relevant to ADI.

* Support the creation and distribution of threat intelligence briefings, reports, and summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.

* Maintain awareness of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

* Assist SOC and Incident Response teams by providing contextual intelligence during security investigations.

* Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs) and support operationalisation into security tools and detection platforms.

* Support proactive threat hunting activities by identifying relevant threats and hypotheses for investigation.

* Track industry and sector-specific threats affecting semiconductor, manufacturing, cloud, and enterprise environments.

* Assist with intelligence requirements gathering and mapping threats to business risks.

* Maintain threat intelligence documentation, repositories, watchlists, and reporting dashboards.

* Participate in tabletop exercises, purple-team activities, and lessons-learned reviews to improve defensive readiness.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of threat intelligence processes and intelligence sharing practices.

* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations

* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, intelligence analysis, SOC operations, or related technical field.

* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, ransomware, business email compromise, and common attack techniques.

* Experience conducting threat intelligence collection and monitoring across open-source, deep web, and dark web sources to identify emerging threats, threat actors, compromised credentials, and organizational risks.

* Basic understanding of threat intelligence concepts including IOCs, threat actors, TTPs, and intelligence lifecycle principles.

* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and research skills.

* Ability to identify patterns, connect information from multiple sources, and communicate findings clearly.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience leveraging AI, generative AI, and agentic security capabilities to enhance threat detection, investigation, response, and SOC operational efficiency.

* Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

* Experience with intelligence platforms, security monitoring tools, threat feeds, or OSINT research tools.

* Basic scripting or data analysis experience using Python, KQL, PowerShell, SQL, or similar technologies.

* CompTIA Security+, CySA+, SC-200, CTI-related certifications, or equivalent qualifications.

* Experience with threat hunting, CTFs, internships, malware analysis labs, or cyber research projects.

  
  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Timely delivery of threat intelligence briefings and reports.

* Quality and relevance of intelligence provided to SOC and Incident Response teams.

* Contribution to detection improvements through intelligence-driven recommendations.

* Identification and tracking of emerging threats relevant to ADI.

* Accurate maintenance of intelligence repositories, watchlists, and threat documentation.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

**Key Responsibilities**
