title: Chief Data Office - Records Retention & Destruction - Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

*Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast-paced, challenging area? This is a unique opportunity to partner with business and control functions, strengthen information lifecycle governance, and help deliver a comprehensive, auditable approach to records retention and destruction.*

Business / Team Overview

The Retention and Destruction function is responsible for enabling compliant information lifecycle management across physical and electronic records. The team partners with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and business stakeholders to ensure records are retained according to approved schedules, placed on hold when required, and destroyed in a controlled, auditable manner when eligible.

Job Summary

As Records Retention & Destruction Analyst (602) within the Retention and Destruction team, you will be responsible for supporting the execution and oversight of compliant records retention and destruction processes. You will coordinate retention schedule adherence, disposition reviews, legal holds, evidence collection, and operational reporting across physical and electronic records. You will partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, data stewards, and business stakeholders to resolve exceptions and maintain audit-ready documentation. You will also help strengthen controls, improve procedures, and advance automation for defensible information lifecycle management.

Job Responsibilities

* Execute day-to-day retention and destruction activities for in-scope records (electronic and/or physical), ensuring eligibility and approvals are met prior to disposition.
* Support adherence to approved retention schedules by coordinating with record owners, data stewards, and technology partners.
* Assist with **legal hold** processes: intake, implementation support, tracking, release coordination, and validation of hold effectiveness.
* Perform disposition reviews, sampling, and quality checks to confirm correct classification, retention calculations, and exception handling.
* Maintain auditable evidence for disposition decisions and completion of destruction activities, including chain-of-custody where applicable.
* Track and remediate exceptions (e.g., retention conflicts, unknown owners, incomplete metadata, hold impacts), escalating issues through defined governance channels.
* Produce operational reporting and metrics (e.g., backlog, eligible-for-destruction volumes, holds coverage, exception trends, cycle times).
* Contribute to process documentation: SOPs, runbooks, control narratives, and training materials.
* Participate in risk and control activities, including periodic attestations, internal reviews, and audit/exam support.
* Collaborate with technology teams to improve automation for disposition workflows, retention tagging, and defensible destruction.

Required Qualifications, Skills, and Capabilities

* Demonstrated experience in records management, information governance, compliance operations, risk and controls, or a related operational role.
* Working knowledge of records lifecycle principles, including retention schedules, disposition, legal holds, defensible destruction, and auditability.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow controlled processes while maintaining accurate, audit-ready evidence.
* Proven ability to analyze data and metadata, determine retention eligibility, and identify or resolve exceptions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and basic reporting, with the ability to work effectively with large datasets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across business, legal, compliance, risk, and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with electronic records and content management systems and/or eDiscovery and legal hold tooling.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory exams, or formal control testing activities.
* Exposure to data classification, data lineage/ownership, and metadata quality practices.
* Understanding of privacy and data protection considerations as they relate to retention and destruction.
* Experience improving operational processes (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent continuous improvement methods).

Competencies

* Control-minded execution and operational discipline
* Sound judgment and escalation when eligibility/approvals are unclear
* Stakeholder management and collaborative problem-solving
* Documentation rigor and continuous improvement orientation

description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Product Owner/ Business Analyst – Tax Reporting  
Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD

We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.

Product Ownership  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).

Agile & Scrum Delivery

Client Engagement  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.  

Domain Expertise  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.  
Qualifications  

Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.  

Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.  

Experience with back-office platforms (BPS, BETA preferred).  

Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.  

Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.  

Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.

title: Partner IAM - Security Platform Engineer
description:
Our Identity and Access Management platforms enable dealers, suppliers, and other external partners to securely access Ford applications and resources.
  
  
We are undertaking a critical modernization initiative to migrate B2B users from on-premises identity solutions to cloud-based identity services. This transformation is designed to improve the user and single sign-on experience, strengthen security and risk management, and enable greater automation of user onboarding and offboarding.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, deploy, and support scalable IAM capabilities using
**Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Entra External ID**
. You will work closely with globally distributed engineering, architecture, security, and application teams and contribute throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  

* Design, build, test, and maintain secure applications and services using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and relevant web technologies.
* Engineer identity solutions using Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Entra External ID, with a particular focus on external/B2B identities.
* Develop integrations with Microsoft Graph API and related Microsoft identity services.
* Design, develop, and maintain Spring Boot RESTful API microservices and web user interfaces.
* Collaborate with technical leads, architects, security teams, and application teams to deliver IAM platform capabilities aligned with enterprise security and architecture standards.
* Analyze, design, and implement tactical and strategic IAM solutions that improve the organization's security posture and user experience.
* Contribute to IAM platform strategy, technical architecture, and product roadmaps.
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, operational dashboards, and diagnostic capabilities using tools and query languages such as Kusto Query Language (KQL).
* Support production operations, including service requests, incidents, problems, and root-cause analysis.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, API documentation, coding standards, configuration guidance, operational procedures, and application onboarding documentation.
* Apply Agile software development practices to deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
* Build and use continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software build, testing, security validation, and deployment.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrate ownership across the end-to-end software engineering lifecycle, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Use AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools, to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and other software development lifecycle activities while maintaining appropriate security and quality controls.
* Participate in rotational on-call support as required.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of relevant software engineering, IAM, or IT experience.
* Hands-on experience designing or engineering identity solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, with experience supporting external/B2B identities.
* Strong experience developing RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience integrating applications with Microsoft Graph API.
* Experience with web application development using Angular or another modern JavaScript/TypeScript framework.
* Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building APIs, batch services, or web applications with automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience implementing automated build, test, security, and deployment processes using CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with development tools such as GitHub, Jira, and Postman.
* Familiarity with application-security and DevSecOps tooling such as 42Crunch, SonarQube, or Checkmarx.
* Experience with PowerShell or comparable scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience troubleshooting complex enterprise applications and identity integrations.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to engineering teams, application owners, business partners, and leadership.
* Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed teams.
* Ability to manage priorities and ambiguity while delivering against deadlines.
* Ability to participate in rotational on-call support.

**Preferred**

* Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra External ID for B2B/external customer or partner identity solutions.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly Cloud Run, container-based services, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure services.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipeline management and deployment.
* Experience with Kusto Query Language (KQL) for monitoring, diagnostics, and operational analysis.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to support software development, testing, documentation, and delivery.
* Experience designing, deploying, and supporting IAM capabilities within a large enterprise environment.

title: India - Senior System Analyst (Finance)
description:
**Who are Inchcape**  
At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.

**Job Location :** Chennai, Pune

**Job Purpose :**

The Senior Systems Analyst is responsible for analysing, impact assessing and implementing changes to ISS’s portfolio of finance applications (Unit4, Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara, Eyeshare and related integrations), supporting the business processes of:  

* Procure to Pay
* Record to Report
* Order to Cash
* Treasury and Cash Management
* Indirect Tax
* Financial Reporting

The role owns change end to end: from understanding the business requirement and assessing its impact on processes, integrations, controls and data, through configuration and testing, to controlled release into production. In doing so it keeps the finance application landscape stable, compliant and aligned with best practice.

**Duties and Responsibilities :**

  

**Analysis and Design**

* Work with Finance stakeholders, Product Owners and Business Analysts to understand requirements, pain points and process gaps, and translate them into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Conduct gap analysis against current configuration and standard product capability, recommending solutions that make full use of the platform before considering customisation.
* Produce solution designs and realistic effort estimates for changes and enhancements.

**Impact Assessment**

* Impact assess every proposed change, covering affected business processes, upstream and downstream integrations, reporting, data, security roles and financial controls. Document the risk, test scope and rollback approach before implementation.
* Review vendor release notes for Unit4, Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara and other SaaS platforms, assess the impact on ISS configuration and processes, and plan regression testing and any required changes ahead of each release.
* Maintain an end-to-end understanding of how data flows between the finance applications and connected operational systems, so that the knock-on effects of change are identified early

**Implementation**

* Configure and maintain Unit4, Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara, Eyeshare and related integration processes to a high and maintainable standard.
* Implement changes through the agreed change control process, including CAB approval where required, promoting configuration between environments in a controlled and documented way.
* Schedule changes around the financial calendar, avoiding month-end, year-end and other critical business windows.
* Roll out configurations globally across the product suite in line with the deployment plan.

**Testing and Quality**

* Plan and carry out system, integration and regression testing against documented acceptance criteria, and support business users through user acceptance testing.
* Validate data and reconcile outputs after go-live to confirm that changes have had no unintended financial impact.

**Controls and Compliance**

* Ensure changes maintain segregation of duties, audit trail and internal control requirements, and retain change evidence suitable for internal and external audit.

**Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide L3 support for complex issues, including root cause analysis and permanent resolution, and provide hypercare following deployments.
* Act as the technical point of contact with application vendors, raising and managing support cases through to resolution.
* Maintain functional and technical documentation, including configuration baselines, process flows and integration maps, in Confluence.
* Work within the Agile delivery model, keeping Jira up to date and participating fully in Scrum ceremonies.
* Deliver user training and knowledge transfer, and identify opportunities to improve processes and system efficiency.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, support teams and peer analysts, sharing knowledge and continuously improving how the team delivers value to the business.

  

**Knowledge :**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science or a related discipline. A professional accounting qualification (CA/ICWA/CIMA) is desirable.
* Strong understanding of core finance processes: Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, treasury and cash management, and indirect tax.
* Functional and configuration knowledge of SaaS finance applications, ideally Unit4 ERP.
* Knowledge of Kyriba, Sidetrade, Esker, Avalara or Eyeshare is highly desirable'

* Understanding of financial controls, including segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX-style compliance, and of change management.
* Technical knowledge: SQL; web services and APIs (REST, SOAP, XML, JSON); testing tools such as SoapUI or Postman.
* Agile tools: Jira and Confluence (or Azure DevOps/Rally).
* Knowledge of the maritime or shipping industry (desirable).

  

**Skills :**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to trace an issue across multiple systems to its root cause.
* Structured approach to impact assessment and risk identification.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Strong testing discipline, including test planning, regression testing and data reconciliation.
* Clear verbal and written communication; able to explain technical impacts to Finance users and finance

* requirements to technical teams.
* Collaborative, partner-focused approach with stakeholders and vendors.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple changes at once while meeting deadlines

  

**Experience :**

* 5+ years as a systems analyst or functional/techno-functional consultant on finance applications, ideally in a SaaS ERP environment (Unit4 preferred).
* Proven track record of impact assessing and implementing configuration changes in live finance systems.
* Managing SaaS vendor releases and the associated regression testing.
* Supporting finance integrations and middleware, including troubleshooting interface failures.
* Data migration, reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI).
* Working within formal change control and release management processes.
* L2/L3 production support and post-deployment hypercare.

  

**Other requirements :**

* Ability to travel (national and international) and work flexibility.
* Able to work from home.
* Out of hours or on call support as required

  

**Why Inchcape Shipping Services?**

  

We believe in building a diverse and high performing workforce, that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realise the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.

  

Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:  
  
Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture.

  

The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.

  

Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.

  

In return, we will offer you:  
  
A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally as a minimum you will receive:  
  

* A retirement savings plan
* Life assurance
* Healthcare
* Competitive salary
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Career development and progression opportunities
* Values Award celebration events
* Team building days
* Hybrid Working Model (Role Dependant)

Plus, much more!

  

If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!

  

#ISSthebiggerpicture

  

Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location.

  

Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society.We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

title: Specialist, Product Operations, Reference Data
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

The primary purpose of this position is to research, analyze, interpret, transform and present reference data for Equity and Funds securities across global markets, while supporting the Index team by providing reference data with precision. The focus of this position is to perform this work with documents written in English.

The incumbent must successfully complete a 8-to-12-week training program that centers on building enough subject matter expertise and the utilization of the database(s) of record such that the incumbent can independently analyze legal and financial documents associated with Equity and Fund securities. During training, the incumbent must master all of the subject matter and will be required to pass a series of quizzes and tests as well achieve the accuracy and timeliness metrics that were established for trainees.

The training curriculum for Data Analyst contains high level overviews of the complex structures worked on by more senior personnel as well as reference data client use cases so that the incumbent can differentiate between legal and financial language that is relevant to and required by our client base versus jargon describing information that is not required and, so that the incumbent can identify new financing techniques that come to market. The incumbent must then apply this foundation of knowledge via a logical sequence of decision-making events to determine relevancy of said information to our clients for any of their use cases and if deemed relevant, determine the appropriate next steps to ensure high client satisfaction levels.

The Equity and Funds asset class consists significantly large volumes of active securities and the reference data provided by ICE Data Services for said securities is used by our clients to make trading decisions, settle trades, make investment decisions, manage portfolios, analyze risk, create security master files, create client statements and conduct other back-office functions. Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within ICE and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze, interpret, collate, and transform reference data for multi structure/events/sub processes with high complexity in either the primary market or the secondary market (but not both) provided in a variety of legal and financial documents, third party reports and vendor information, while ensuring that the reference data provided in ICE’s products and services accurate, comprehensive and in a timely manner, namely best in class.
* Demonstrate familiarity with reference data products to support client challenges and resolve data problems.
* Build core competencies in the maintenance of reference data captured in alternate databases used to produce products.
* Independently perform all assigned business processes completely and accurately.
* Conduct user acceptance testing of new enhancements and bug fixes made to the database(s) of record
* Craft external facing responses for those clients that submitted customer inquiries containing a meaningful, well-thought out, well-constructed answer that includes a restatement of the challenge or question, the analysis completed to satisfy the request and where appropriate, the methodology used to determine the solution when researching and resolving client inquiries.
* Identifies trends and causation of inaccurate and/or incomplete data including but not limited to staying current with regulatory initiatives, new financing techniques used by the marketplace and organizations that impact coverage and completeness.
* Create simple excel and macro functions to organize, analyze, convert, and create reference data.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge and understanding of policies and procedures and work with training team to augment best practices as changes in the marketplace evolve.
* Applies problem-solving skills to identify and help to resolve data quality issues and/or work-flow inefficiencies and process improvements resulting in increased accuracy levels, time to market and productivity.
* Participate in root cause analysis efforts to identify system data issues and participate in creating process improvements. Resolve complex data challenges and time critical sensitive projects.
* Create charts, graphs, and presentations for leadership teams.
* Communicate with and influence market participants including underwriters, issuers, trust administrators and exchanges through phone and email correspondence to procure required reference data content, resolve data discrepancies and gain an understanding of undefined terms.
* Make sound, subjective decisions when interpreting legal and financial information by utilizing subject matter expertise to infer, deduce and ultimately draw the correct conclusions. Mentor junior employees provide guidance; serve as subject matter experts.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* 5+ years corporate level experience, or 2+ years direct experience.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressured, fluid environment
* Ability to distill large amounts of varied information into specific takeaways
* Excellent attention to detail and high degree of demonstrated decision-making and problem-solving skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Eagerness to learn and collaborate with others
* Strong excel skills required

title: Security Analyst, DR
description:
**About Us :**

  

CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.

  

**Position Summary:**

  

The BCDR Analyst delivers comprehensive business continuity and disaster recovery services across the organization. The analyst is responsible for operating the current resilience program, identifying opportunities to enhance strategies, and implementing improvements to strengthen organizational preparedness. This role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and other critical functions to ensure robust continuity planning, risk management, and recovery capabilities across the enterprise.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

Plan Development & Implementation:

* Design and maintain comprehensive BCDR plans.
* Identify critical business functions and establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs).
* Collaborate with IT, security, and business units to align recovery strategies.
* Develop standardized templates for BCDR plans, risk assessments, and recovery procedures to ensure consistency across business units.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather input and tailor templates and decks to specific business needs.  

  

Infrastructure Management:

* Administer backup and replication systems.
* Monitor and optimize cloud-based and on-premises recovery environments.
Conduct regular health checks and software upgrades.  

  

Testing & Validation:

* Coordinating with IT Infra teams & following up on performing regular failovers, failbacks, and recovery testing.
Analyze test results and update plans to address gaps.  

  

Incident Response:

* Lead response efforts during disruptions.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure swift recovery.  

  

Training & Awareness:

* Educate staff on BCDR protocols.
Promote a culture of preparedness.  

  

Compliance & Reporting:

* Ensure alignment with industry standards (e.g., ISO 22301).
* Create executive-level presentation decks to communicate BCDR strategies, testing outcomes, and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders and leadership.
Maintain and update documentation repositories, ensuring version control and accessibility for audits and compliance reviews  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in cybersecurity, IT, Computer Science, a related field, or an equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in BCDR, infrastructure, or equivalent.
* Relevant certifications such ISO 22301\CDRE\CBCP or similar and cloud certifications are highly desirable.
* Strong logical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Extensive knowledge of BCDR, cloud DR, and IT infrastructure.

CDK is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with fairness, dignity, and respect. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, caste, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, nationality, ethnic origin, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

title: Senior Security Consultant
description:
**Job Description – Senior Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist**

**Experience:** 8–10 Years  
  
**Function:** Cybersecurity – Incident Response / DFIR  
  
**Role Level:** Senior

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist with 8–10 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience to manage and investigate security incidents across enterprise environments.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents, including triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), malware analysis, and digital forensic analysis. The role also requires strong customer-facing skills to lead incident discussions, provide regular updates, explain technical findings, and present investigation outcomes and recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Response & Investigation**

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through closure.
* Lead investigation of Critical, High, and complex security incidents and coordinate response activities across relevant teams.
* Perform incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
* Investigate incidents involving ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise, credential theft, data exfiltration, insider threats, web attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and other advanced threats.
* Analyze security alerts and correlate information across EDR, SIEM, network, identity, cloud, email, and other security technologies.
* Develop incident timelines and determine the attack vector, affected assets, compromised accounts, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and overall impact.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and map findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Coordinate with SOC, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, IT, Cloud, Network, IAM, Application, Legal, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Perform detailed **Root Cause Analysis** for security incidents.
* Determine the initial attack vector, contributing factors, security/control gaps, and reasons existing preventive or detective controls did not stop or detect the activity earlier.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and lessons-learned sessions.
* Develop clear corrective and preventive actions based on investigation findings.
* Track remediation recommendations with relevant stakeholders through closure.
* Prepare comprehensive RCA reports suitable for technical teams, management, and customers.

**Malware Analysis**

* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand malicious file behavior and capabilities.
* Analyze suspicious executables, scripts, PowerShell commands, documents, URLs, and other artifacts.
* Identify malware persistence mechanisms, command-and-control activity, network indicators, file-system changes, registry modifications, and related behaviors.
* Extract IOCs and behavioral indicators for threat hunting and detection engineering.
* Perform malware sandboxing and behavioral analysis where required.
* Provide recommendations for detection, containment, and prevention based on malware-analysis findings.

**Digital Forensics**

* Perform digital forensic investigations on endpoints and other relevant systems.
* Analyze Windows/Linux artifacts, event logs, file systems, registry artifacts, browser artifacts, authentication logs, memory artifacts, and other forensic evidence.
* Perform disk and memory analysis where required.
* Collect and preserve digital evidence following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements.
* Build forensic timelines and reconstruct attacker activities.
* Determine the scope and impact of compromise using forensic evidence.
* Document forensic findings clearly and maintain investigation evidence appropriately.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key technical point of contact for customers during cybersecurity incidents.
* Lead incident calls and communicate investigation progress, impact, containment status, risks, and next steps.
* Provide timely and accurate incident updates to customers and internal leadership.
* Translate complex technical investigation findings into clear business-level communication.
* Manage customer expectations during high-severity and time-sensitive incidents.
* Present RCA and forensic investigation findings to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Handle technical questions and confidently explain investigation methodology, evidence, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with multiple internal and customer teams to drive incidents toward timely resolution.

**Incident Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare detailed incident investigation reports, including:
* Maintain accurate incident records, evidence, investigation notes, and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of Incident Response playbooks, SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation processes.
* Executive summary
* Incident timeline
* Scope and impact
* Root cause
* Attack vector
* IOCs and TTPs
* Investigation findings
* Containment and remediation actions
* Control gaps
* Corrective and preventive recommendations
* Lessons learned

**Required Technical Skills**

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in:

* Cybersecurity Incident Response / DFIR
* Security Incident Investigation
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Digital Forensics
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Endpoint and Network Investigation
* Windows and Linux Forensics
* Disk and Memory Analysis
* Log Analysis and Timeline Reconstruction
* IOC and TTP Analysis
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework
* SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
* EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, or similar
* Network security technologies including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Proxy, DNS, VPN, and WAF
* Cloud security investigation across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments
* Identity and authentication-related investigations
* Email and phishing investigations
* Forensic and malware-analysis tools such as Volatility, Autopsy, FTK, EnCase, Wireshark, Sysinternals, YARA, Ghidra, IDA, or equivalent tools
* Scripting/automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies would be an advantage.

**Required Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, DFIR, SOC, Threat Hunting, or related security domains.
* Demonstrated experience independently handling complex and high-severity cybersecurity incidents.
* Strong experience conducting RCA and presenting investigation findings.
* Hands-on experience with malware and forensic investigations.
* Experience handling customer-facing security incidents and leading technical/customer incident calls.
* Experience coordinating investigations involving multiple technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during Critical/High-severity incidents.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Communication & Leadership Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead incident bridges/calls during critical incidents.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to take ownership, make investigation decisions, and drive incidents to closure.
* Ability to mentor junior Incident Response/SOC analysts and provide technical guidance during investigations.

title: Associate PLM Support Analyst

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. Partnering with a diverse, global team, you will monitor production issues, troubleshoot business-critical issues, and drive enhancements that keep our digital operations running efficiently.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of supporting users, troubleshooting technology issues, and drive towards quick resolutions in the 3DEXPERIENCE Cloud platform. Collaboration with cross-functional and global teams is required to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.

* Provide L2/L3 support—investigating incidents, coordinating fixes, and ensuring effective root-cause analysis.

* Read and apply Quick Reference Guides (QRGs) and knowledge articles for effective troubleshooting.
* Document procedures, contribute to knowledge bases, and share best practices with global peers.
* Create and maintain accurate GXP documentation of configurations, processes, and changes
* Be the voice of the customer and be willing to go the extra mile to unblock their work.
* Proactively engage with product teams to understand the changes being introduced to the system, actively support during hypercare.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3 - 5 years of experience in Engineering, IT or related field

**Functional Skills:**

**Must-Have Skills:**

* Good understanding of 3DEXPERIENCE capabilities and ability to triage and troubleshoot issues.
* Experience in managing technology solutions involving one or more of the following - ENOVIA, DELMIA, CATIA Report Generator.
* Technical/Functional experience solutioning and supporting GxP applications across Engineering, Clinical, Commercial and Quality functions.
* Experience with configuring solutions using 3DEXPERIENCE platform.
* Experience and understanding of software configurations and propagation of configurations across tenants.
* Must be flexible and able to manage multiple activities and priorities with minimal direction in a rapidly changing and demanding environment.
* Good collaboration, communication and interpersonal skills to effectively manage stakeholder relationships and build new partnerships.
* Experience in applying technology best practice methodologies: Scaled Agile (SAFe).

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Experience in a support role within a pharmaceutical or technology organization
* Experience in software development lifecycle.
* Experience using and adoption of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
* Strong analytic/critical-thinking and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Broad working knowledge of key IS domains and layers

**Professional Certifications:**

* Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) for Teams (preferred)

* Good collaboration and communication skills.
* High degree of initiative and self-motivation.

* Team-oriented with a focus on achieving team goals.

title: Security Operations SME (L3)
description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix
*®*
Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix
*®*
Assessment 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a highly skilled Security Operations SME (L3) to serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex and high-severity cyber incidents. This role plays a critical part in leading advanced investigations, incident response, proactive threat hunting, and continuous improvement of detection and monitoring capabilities within the Security Operations Center (SOC). The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Infrastructure, Endpoint, Network, Cloud, and Application teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.
  
  

* Role: Security Operations SME (L3)
* Location: Mumbai
* Experience: 8 to 12 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Act as the Level 3 escalation point for complex, high-severity, and multi-domain security incidents.
* Lead deep-dive investigations to determine attack scope, root cause, affected assets, business impact, and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Drive incident containment, eradication, recovery, post-incident reviews, and corrective-action tracking with relevant technical teams.
* Conduct advanced analysis across SIEM events, endpoint telemetry, network traffic, identity activity, cloud logs, malware indicators, and threat intelligence sources.
* Perform proactive threat hunting and develop threat-hunting hypotheses aligned with MITRE ATT&CK and emerging threat patterns.
* Design, tune, validate, and maintain correlation rules, detection use cases, alerts, dashboards, and investigation content.
* Reduce false positives, identify detection gaps, and improve monitoring coverage using lessons learned from incidents and threat intelligence.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, SOPs, runbooks, escalation procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Optimize SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, and related security tools while troubleshooting integration, monitoring, performance, and data quality issues.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, case reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions for L1 and L2 analysts.
* Prepare incident reports, root-cause analyses, executive summaries, and technical recommendations.
* Support audits, tabletop exercises, service reviews, operational metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in shift rotations and on-call support for critical security incidents as required.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, incident response, security monitoring, and cyber investigations.
* Advanced hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk Enterprise Security, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, or equivalent solutions.
* Experience with EDR/XDR technologies including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike Falcon, Carbon Black, or similar platforms.
* Strong log analysis expertise across endpoint, network, server, application, identity, and cloud data sources.
* Deep knowledge of threat hunting, IOC analysis, attack-chain reconstruction, malware triage, and digital forensic fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, common cyberattack techniques, threat actor methodologies, and incident response lifecycle management.
* Experience developing, tuning, and optimizing SIEM correlation rules, threat detection content, searches, alerts, dashboards, and reports.
* Exposure to SOAR platforms, automated workflows, orchestration playbooks, and security automation initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication technologies, and cloud environments.
* Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience working within enterprise SOC or Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, Splunk, Microsoft Security, CrowdStrike, or equivalent security certifications.
* Experience presenting incident findings and security recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to manage high-severity incidents and drive effective incident response activities.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities for guiding junior analysts and improving SOC maturity.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong focus on continuous improvement, detection engineering, threat intelligence integration, and operational excellence.
* Commitment to staying current with evolving cybersecurity threats, technologies, and industry best practices.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

**Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent -**
**persistent.com/careers**
***“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”***

description: Job DescriptionThe Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes: Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams). Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet). Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit). Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.ResponsibilitiesIdentify and Prioritise Risk Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow. Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context. Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications. Coordinate Remediation Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams. Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels. Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry. Improve Security Practices Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance. Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling. Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications. Report and Govern Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance. Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams. Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance. Essential QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager. Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines. Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels. Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams. Desirable Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate. Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field. BGV: Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”. title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The Senior Security Engineer plays a key role in embedding security into the design and build phases of technology projects, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise security standards. Reporting to the Head of Information Security Transformation, this role provides hands-on technical expertise to uplift security capabilities and support the delivery of secure solutions across the organisation.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Actively contribute to technology projects during design and build phases, ensuring security is embedded early and effectively.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and delivery teams to review technical designs and provide security input into solution architecture.
* Translate security requirements into practical implementation guidance, ensuring alignment with business objectives and compliance standards.
* Participate in project planning, estimations, and workshops to represent security interests and influence outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of secure design patterns and delivery processes.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Design and implement security solutions across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.
* Support integration of security controls into CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and infrastructure-as-code environments.
* Deploy and manage tools such as DLP, WAF, DAM, endpoint protection, SIEM, and IAM solutions.
* Conduct technical risk assessments, threat modelling, and control validation during project execution.
* Serve as a point of escalation for complex technical security issues during project implementation.
* Contribute to the design and build of secure cloud-first environments, primarily in Microsoft Azure.
* Apply in-depth understanding of network, compute, and storage security across hybrid cloud environments.
* Support secure configuration, monitoring, and hardening of systems in collaboration with infrastructure and platform teams.
* Leverage hands-on experience with technologies including Microsoft Entra ID, Office 365, Zscaler, Citrix, CASB, and Active Directory.
* Prepare documentation including build guides, runbooks, and security implementation plans.

  
People Leadership 
  

* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior engineers within the team or project streams.
* Actively engage in team stand-ups, architecture reviews, and delivery retrospectives to share learnings and promote secure delivery practices.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams and promote shared accountability for secure outcomes.

  
Governance & Risk
  

* Review configuration changes and provide input into security policies and control baselines during build activities.
* Support audit readiness and evidence gathering for new solutions.
* Ensure all designs and implementations comply with internal policies and regulatory obligations, including privacy and data-protection requirements.
* Identify security gaps or control failures during project delivery and support timely remediation.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience 
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent, with a major in Information Security or Cybersecurity preferred.
* Minimum 7+ years in technical security roles, with a demonstrated record of delivering complex security initiatives across design, build, assurance, and operational transition.
* Hands-on experience with cloud, data, and Zero Trust security technologies such as Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Purview, Zscaler or Netskope, CASB, data loss prevention, secure access service edge, and web application firewalls.
* Experience with enterprise identity and access technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint, CyberArk, and Okta, including SSO and integration standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.
* Exposure to security operations and governance platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, vulnerability-management tooling, and ServiceNow Security Operations or GRC.
* Ability to apply enterprise security standards, regulatory obligations, and risk-management requirements within complex, product-centric delivery environments.
* Deep expertise in one or more priority domains—particularly identity, cloud, privileged access, or Zero Trust—is preferred; candidates are not expected to have experience with every listed technology.

  
Personal Attributes
  

* Strong technical problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Effective communicator who can translate security concepts into actionable guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary project teams while managing multiple concurrent priorities.
* Demonstrates a proactive, hands-on mindset with a focus on secure enablement and delivery excellence.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The Identity and Access Management Engineer (Junior) will supports the secure and reliable operation of identity services across the organisation. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role assists with user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication, single sign-on, privileged access and identity governance activities.
  
The position contributes to project delivery and operational support by following approved standards, documenting work, resolving routine issues and escalating risks or complex technical matters appropriately.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus
  

* Support the secure and reliable operation of identity and access management services across the organisation.
* Contribute to IAM, PAM and identity governance initiatives through project delivery and operational support activities.
* Assist in implementing identity standards, controls and automation aligned with the organisation’s security strategy.
* Support continuous improvement of identity lifecycle, authentication and privileged access capabilities.

  
Operational Management
  

* Manage approved joiner, mover and leaver activities, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes and routine IAM troubleshooting.
* Provision, modify and remove user, service and privileged accounts across supported on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Apply approved access models, including role-based and attribute-based access controls, group membership and entitlements.
* Support periodic access reviews and follow up outstanding certifications, exceptions and remediation actions.
* Assist with the administration, configuration, testing and support of hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
* Support application onboarding for single sign-on, multifactor authentication and automated provisioning using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Contribute to PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other scripts or workflows that automate repeatable IAM activities, with peer review before production use.
* Assist with identity services hosted across Azure and AWS and their supporting Windows, Linux and virtualised infrastructure.
* Maintain daily IAM platform stability and compliance through service monitoring, BAU engineering, incident troubleshooting, fulfilment of service requests and controlled changes.
* Troubleshoot access, authentication, federation, directory and provisioning issues using documented procedures, system logs and structured diagnostic techniques.
* Support Active Directory Domain Services and related technologies such as LDAP, Group Policy, DNS, certificate services, forest trusts and remote access services under appropriate guidance.
* Maintain accurate tickets, work notes, configuration records, operational procedures and handover information.

  
People Leadership
  

* Build effective working relationships with application owners, Service Desk, infrastructure, cloud, security and project teams.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Identity Architects to deliver IAM and PAM enhancements.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
* Share knowledge and contribute to team capability through structured learning and practical assignments.

  
Governance & Risk
  

* Support the discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
* Assist with implementation and uplift of privileged-access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, least privilege, account discovery and automated password rotation.
* Follow least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, privacy and privileged-access requirements when administering identity services.
* Support audit and assurance activities by maintaining complete access records, approvals, evidence and operational documentation.
* Identify control gaps, recurring incidents and opportunities for automation or service improvement and escalate recommendations through the appropriate process.
* Escalate risks, exceptions and complex technical matters through appropriate governance processes.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience
  

* Degree, diploma or equivalent practical training in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in IAM, directory services, systems administration, IT support or cybersecurity; graduates with relevant practical exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Foundational understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, conditional access, multifactor authentication, RBAC and ABAC.
* Practical exposure to Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in a hybrid environment; familiarity with Microsoft Identity Manager or Entra ID Connect is advantageous.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, federation and API concepts.
* Basic to intermediate PowerShell and scripting capability; exposure to Microsoft Graph is desirable.
* Awareness of Windows Server and Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, certificate services and forest trusts.
* Foundational cloud knowledge across Azure or AWS and basic familiarity with virtualisation; Linux exposure is desirable.
* Exposure to PAM or IGA platforms such as CyberArk and SailPoint is advantageous.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, IAM or security certifications are desirable but not essential.

Personal Attributes

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and seek guidance for complex or high-risk matters.
* Balanced interest in operational support, incident resolution, debugging and engineering delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to approvals, testing, evidence and record keeping.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build constructive relationships with technical teams and business partners.
* Able to prioritise assigned work, meet agreed deadlines, raise blockers early and contribute effectively in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.

description:

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Fund Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.

**Job Description – Financial Analyst, Transaction Opinions / Fund Opinions / CVAS**

**Overview**

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a global investment bank with expertise in mergers and acquisitions, capital markets, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Houlihan Lokey serves corporations, institutions, and governments worldwide with offices in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region. Independent advice and intellectual rigor are hallmarks of the firm’s commitment to client success across its advisory services. The firm is the No. 1 investment bank for all global M&A transactions for the past two consecutive years, the No. 1 M&A advisor for the past 10 consecutive years in the U.S., the No. 1 global restructuring advisor for the past 11 consecutive years, and the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years, all based on number of transactions and according to data provided by LSEG (formerly Refinitiv).

**Scope**

Our Board & Special Committee Advisory group provides advice to board of directors and special committees in valuing complex businesses and securities, understanding and structuring critical transaction issues, advising on alternatives, and rendering transaction opinions. The group primarily focuses on complex situations, related-party transactions, and other corporate governance issues for board of directors and special committees.

Our Fund Opinions group delivers fairness opinions and valuation advisory services to financial sponsors, including private equity funds, hedge funds, and credit funds. We provide advice to these sponsors across a variety of situations, including mergers, acquisitions, continuation fund and other portfolio company transactions.

The Corporate Valuation and Advisory Services group (CVAS) focuses on complex analytics, business valuations, financial models and other valuation services, frequently teaming with accounting and tax advisory, capital markets and M&A professionals.

As the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years, Houlihan Lokey enjoys industry-leading credibility in transaction opinions. Our dedicated Transaction Opinions group delivers fairness, solvency, and valuation advisory services across a variety of situations, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures/spin-offs, SPACs/PIPEs, recapitalizations, restructurings, and activist shareholder situations.

**Job Description**

We are looking for an Analyst to be part of an interdiscplinary team that focuses on complex analytics, financial models, and valuation – and works hand-in-hand with other teams within our firm (e.g., M&A, industry groups, etc.) to deliver investment banking services to clients. Our Analysts work on corporate fairness, fund fairness, solvency, and transaction-based valuation opinions, as well as a variety of business valuation and intangible asset valuation in connection with mergers and acquisitions, corporate restructurings and financial and tax reporting requirements. Analysts support engagements and new business development by:

* Analyzing and explaining historical and projected financial information
* Performing business and financial due diligence
* Conducting industry and sub-sector research
* Valuing companies, businesses, and securities
* Building complex financial models (e.g., to support negotiating/advocacy positions, assess cash flows of a company and/or value specific securities)
* Assisting in the preparation of board/special committee presentations supporting advice and opinions
* Helping pitch engagements and participating in business development initiatives

In addition, the current role will have the additional responsibility and opportunity to help build out regional capabilities via hiring an expanding team and being uniquely cross-functional within FVA across Transaction Opinions, Fund Opinions and CVAS.

**Qualifications**

* Prior investment banking, valuation, or related experience
* Advanced accounting, finance, financial modeling, and analytical abilities
* Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills (analyst)
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Experience managing analysts or other personnel (associate)
* Be an independent thinker and resourceful problem solver driven to succeed in a fast-paced environment
* Have a very strong work ethic, organizational skills, and ability to multi-task

Additional consideration will be given to candidates who possess:

* Chartered Accountant or MBA preferable, with CFA being an added advantage
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in investment banking or financial valuation
* A demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with all levels of staff

title: Senior Power Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Power Platform Engineer to design, build, secure, and support enterprise-grade solutions using Microsoft Power Platform. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, integrations, governance, and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

  

* **Role: Senior Power Platform Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent locations**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps using Microsoft Power Platform.
* Develop Power Automate Cloud Flows and approved Desktop Flows to streamline business processes.
* Build robust solutions utilizing Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL Server, enterprise APIs, and approved connectors.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable solution designs, data models, integrations, and deployment plans.
* Create reusable components, templates, accelerators, and development standards to improve delivery efficiency.
* Optimize application usability, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
* Implement Power Platform environment strategies and governance frameworks.
* Utilize managed solutions, solution layering, connection references, and environment variables effectively.
* Establish source control and version management practices for Power Platform assets.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines across development, testing, and production environments.
* Develop secure integrations using Custom Connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, and enterprise APIs.
* Assess and address non-functional requirements including performance, availability, recovery, maintainability, and operational supportability.
* Configure and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.
* Implement role-based access controls (RBAC), least-privilege access models, and environment governance policies.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, audit, and data governance requirements.
* Support platform inventory management, licensing optimization, environment governance, and Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives.
* Implement monitoring and governance controls to ensure sustainable platform growth and operational excellence.
* Develop and support unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, security testing, and user acceptance testing activities.
* Monitor application performance, platform health, and user adoption metrics.
* Investigate incidents, troubleshoot application issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Maintain operational documentation, support runbooks, deployment guides, and release records.
* Support production deployments and ongoing application maintenance activities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Security Teams, Architects, Data Teams, Risk Teams, and Operations Teams.
* Provide technical guidance and coaching to citizen developers, makers, and development teams.
* Conduct peer reviews and contribute to development standards and governance practices.
* Promote engineering best practices, supportability standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support organizational adoption of Power Platform capabilities and governance frameworks.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in application development, enterprise platforms, or low-code solution engineering.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse.
* Hands-on expertise in developing Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Strong experience designing and implementing Power Automate Cloud Flows.
* Expertise in data modelling, relational data structures, and Dataverse architecture.
* Experience working with SharePoint, SQL Server, REST APIs, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of Power Platform ALM concepts including managed solutions, solution deployment, and environment management.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of Custom Connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and API Management.
* Strong understanding of security, governance, DLP policies, RBAC, and compliance controls.
* Experience working with Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) frameworks and governance models.
* Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation abilities.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps delivery environments.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  

***"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."***
