title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

Research & Technology Group  

**Job Description:**

**Who we are**
--------------

  
  

**About bp/team**
=================

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.

  
  

**Role Purpose**
================

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.

  
  

Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Scope & Scale**
=================

**Platform focus**

Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.

**Testing coverage**

Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.

**Non-functional quality**

Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.

**Delivery lifecycle**

Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.

**Quality engineering**

Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis**
--------------------------------------

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.

* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.

* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.

* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.

* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

**Manual & Exploratory Testing**
--------------------------------

* Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services.

* Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios.

* Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards.

* Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes.

* Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases.

**Test Automation & Continuous Testing**
----------------------------------------

* Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios.

* Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback.

* Select appropriate candidates for automation, balancing business value, stability, maintenance effort and execution speed.

* Monitor automation reliability, investigate failures and continuously improve coverage, execution time and maintainability.

**Defect Management & Quality Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Log clear, reproducible defects with evidence, business impact, severity and appropriate diagnostic information.

* Work with engineers and suppliers to triage defects, investigate root causes, validate fixes and prevent recurrence.

* Maintain transparent defect status, highlight release risks and escalate unresolved quality concerns with options.

* Analyse defect patterns, escaped defects, automation results and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.

* Contribute to retrospectives and root-cause reviews, turning lessons into stronger requirements, engineering and test practices.

**Collaboration & Quality Culture**
-----------------------------------

* Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery.

* Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions.

* Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing.

* Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets.

* Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams.

  
  

**Skills & Experience**
=======================

* Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches.

* Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability.

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent.

* Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control.

* Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.

* Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing.

* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers.

* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations.

  
  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Clear test coverage and traceability across requirements, business journeys, risks and acceptance criteria.

* Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues.

* Reliable and maintainable automated regression coverage integrated into delivery pipelines.

* Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions.

* Improved platform quality across functionality, accessibility, usability, performance, security and operability.

* Effective defect resolution and measurable reduction in repeated or escaped defects.

Strong collaboration and shared quality ownership across business, product, engineering and supplier

  
  

**About bp**
------------

  
  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

description:
**T&T | Cyber: D&R | Analyst | Incident Response & Handling | Delhi**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 114743
  
• **Location**: Delhi
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

Deloitte helps organizations prevent cyberattacks and protect valuable assets. We believe in being secure, vigilant, and resilient—not only by looking at how to prevent and respond to attacks, but at how to manage cyber risk in a way that allows you to unleash new opportunities. Embed cyber risk at the start of strategy development for more effective management of information and technology risks. Learn more about Cybersecurity

  

**Your work profile**

As a Consultant in our Cyber team, you will support incident response, threat hunting, compromise assessment, malware triage, and digital forensics engagements. You will work under the guidance of experienced team members to collect and review evidence, analyse security events, document findings, and contribute to clear, evidence-based investigation outputs.The role requires foundational knowledge of incident response processes, including triage, scoping, evidence collection, containment support, eradication, recovery, root cause analysis, and lessons learned. The individual should be comfortable learning in time-sensitive situations and collaborating with SOC, engineering, identity, cloud, and infrastructure teams.

  

Key Skills Required

* Support incident response activities, including initial triage, evidence collection, event validation, scoping support, containment tracking, recovery support, and post-incident documentation.
* Review security events using evidence sources such as EDR telemetry, SIEM alerts, Windows event logs, Sysmon, identity logs, cloud audit logs, network telemetry, mailbox artefacts, and SaaS evidence under appropriate guidance.
* Assist in correlating available evidence to understand the source, impact, timeline, and potential scope of a security incident, and escalate findings to senior team members.
* Support investigations into phishing, credential compromise, suspicious authentication, malware execution, persistence, privilege abuse, lateral movement, and ransomware-related activity.
* Maintain accurate case notes, evidence trackers, investigation timelines, query records, and structured evidence trails to support technical analysis and reporting.
* Support incident bridge calls and technical discussions by maintaining action trackers, capturing key decisions, and preparing concise investigation updates.
* Collaborate with SOC, engineering, identity, cloud, and infrastructure teams to obtain evidence and support investigation activities.
* Support incident response assessments, simulations, playbook reviews, and after-action documentation.
* Contribute supporting evidence and analysis for root cause assessment, lessons learned, and resilience improvement recommendations.
* Actively participate in training, knowledge-sharing, lab exercises, and feedback sessions to develop technical investigation capability.
* Follow evidence-handling, confidentiality, documentation, and quality-review requirements throughout the engagement.
* Prepare clear investigation notes, evidence summaries, timelines, indicator lists, and draft technical findings for review by senior team members.
* Use investigation utilities such as CyberChef, Sysinternals, Wireshark, KAPE, Eric Zimmerman tools, Velociraptor, or comparable tools as appropriate to assigned tasks.
* Run approved SIEM, EDR, and threat-hunting queries and document results accurately; assist with query refinement under guidance.
* Support malware triage using file metadata, hashes, strings, sandbox results, process behaviour, persistence indicators, and identified network connections.
* Perform basic forensic triage of Windows and Linux systems, including review of event logs, registry artefacts, prefetch, scheduled tasks, services, PowerShell logs, browser artefacts, and process execution evidence under guidance
* Overall experience of 0 to 2 years in cybersecurity, including relevant internships, academic projects, lab work, SOC exposure, incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, malware analysis, or security monitoring.

* Practical exposure to security monitoring or investigation through employment, internships, projects, labs, simulations, or academic work is preferred.
* Foundational knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, networking, authentication, and common enterprise security concepts.
* Familiarity with SIEM or EDR platforms such as QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, or equivalent is desirable.
* Basic understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, cyber kill chain, common attacker techniques, and incident response lifecycle.
* Awareness of evidence sources beyond dashboards, including endpoint artefacts, authentication logs, cloud logs, network evidence, and mailbox artefacts.
* Awareness of SOAR technologies, incident response playbooks, case-management workflows, and ITSM tools is desirable.
* Ability to work in time-sensitive situations with professionalism, curiosity, structured thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to seek guidance when required.
* Ability to document observations objectively, distinguish confirmed findings from hypotheses, and maintain evidence traceability.
* Familiarity with scripting or query languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, KQL, SPL, SQL, or regular expressions is desirable.
* Basic knowledge of network concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP and HTTPS, common ports and protocols, proxies, firewalls, and packet capture analysis.
* Basic understanding of malware concepts such as hashes, strings, static and dynamic analysis, sandboxing, droppers, loaders, and command-and-control activity.
* Basic understanding of Windows event logs, PowerShell, Sysmon, processes, services, scheduled tasks, registry artefacts, and common persistence mechanisms.
* Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree
* Certifications like GCIH, GCFA, ECIH v2, CHFI, GCIA, SC-200, or equivalent are preferred.

title: Associate Analyst-RMS Personal Independence-GMS
description:
Location: Gurgaon

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: 23 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752103

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Career Family**

Risk Management Service

  

**Role Type**

Associate Analyst/ Analyst

  

**Competency**

Independence Risk Management Enablement Group - Global Monitoring System (GMS) Process

  

**Associate Analyst / Analyst - Independence - Risk Management Services**

This role requires the candidate to conduct research and execute global Independence processes aligned with EY Global (EYG) policies. These processes aim to safeguard EY's independence by assisting professionals in complying with the firm's personal Independence policies. The candidate will monitor professionals' financial relationships to identify and report potential conflicts of interest with audit clients. Additionally, this role involves providing coordinated support to EY professionals by answering their inquiries and questions on various country and personal Independence-related topics

  

**The opportunity**

Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.

  

This role will be part of the largest sub-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and mitigating any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditor's independence. This includes assessing employee financial and personal relationships, conducting investigations, providing guidance on resolving personal independence matters, and monitoring for new independence threats.

  

RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centers’: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.

  

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to EY's reputation as an independent auditor by supporting niche Independence profiles within a dynamic and growing environment. You'll work closely with EY professionals to mitigate their personal independence-related risks. This will involve collaborating with senior team members and stakeholders to resolve queries and gather information, ultimately positioning you as a subject matter expert in Independence processes.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

An Associate Analyst/ Analyst in the GMS team, will be responsible for developing a working knowledge of Personal Independence concepts, including financial interests, family relations, and business relationships. You will execute procedures as outlined in the EYG Independence policies, conduct research, and make updates to various EY tools and databases used to monitor their family and financial relationships (like securities, loans, insurance policies, etc). Through these activities, you will contribute to helping EY Professionals mitigate independence-related risks. In this role, you will communicate with EY professionals and senior team members to resolve queries and gather information, while learning from experienced professionals to become proficient in Independence processes.

  

**Technical expertise**

* Build good understanding of financial products and markets, such as equities, structured products, and funds, while executing work requests & projects from initiation to completion in line with established procedures.
* Perform research and analysis on EY professionals' financial interests and family relationships, including brokerage accounts, loans, and insurance policies, to determine the permissibility of their investments
* Participate in wide range of projects and collaborate with project managers for timely completion of assigned work
* Take part in team discussions/activities, service functions/ organization wide initiatives
* Understand and work towards meeting and exceeding the defined individual KPIs for the role.
* Build working knowledge of different internal Independence tools used to record EY professionals financial and family relation data such as details of securities owned and controlled, broker and deposit accounts, business relationships, loans, insurance policies etc.
* Candidate needs to be diligent and hardworking and be highly motivated, result oriented, with a strong willingness to learn quickly.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Possess strong communication and inter-personal skills.
* Fostering a diverse and inclusive team environment by actively participating in team events and engagements
* Must possess a client- centric and enablement mindset
* Prioritize tasks and manage time effectively to meet business expectations without compromising on quality or deadlines.
* Uphold the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and values.
* Be adaptable and agile in dynamic situations, facilitating change management.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Masters/post-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in research and analysis in a professional services firm
* Well-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Basic understanding of financial products like equities, mutual funds, pension plans, insurance policies etc.

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Experience in MS office suites like Outlook, MS excel, Word, SharePoint etc.

  

**What you can look for**

* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team that runs on foundational values of trust, respect, integrity and teaming.
* A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with Global teams and stakeholders
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**About the Role:**
This role helps reduce the cyber risk posed by third parties and protects S&P Global brands against possible attacks against our information assets by threat actors via backdoor created by our vendors. Primary responsibilities will include assessing Cybersecurity, Business Continuity controls for S&P third parties by conducting control risk assessments, risk recertifications, and continuously monitoring the vendors engaged by S&P.
  
  
**The Team**
As part of Vendor Risk Management, the Vendor Cyber Risk Management team manages the Supply Chain Cyber risks by performing risk assessments of third-party engagements to identify and reduce the risks posed by third parties. This is an extremely important role, considering the fact that large number of data breaches happen due to third parties. It involves working with internal stake holders as well as third parties to achieve the results.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**
Working in Vendor Risk Management offers the opportunity to continuously enhance processes to meet the evolving requirements of various regulators. This challenging environment provides ample opportunities to expand your knowledge and expertise.

+ Ability to build strategic partnerships with internal stakeholders.

title: Security Architect
description:
Within the context of Sodexo’s global digital transformation and as part of the Global Information and Cybersecurity Team, the Security Architect is responsible for ensuring that cloud solutions and digital initiatives are designed and review to ensure secure implementation.

The role provides security architecture expertise across cloud transformation programs, with a primary focus on the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with other cloud experience as added advantage skill. The Security Architect works closely with business, technology, architecture, and security teams to identify security risks, define appropriate security requirements, and ensure that both cloud-native and migrated workloads comply with Sodexo’s security principles, policies, and standards.

The role also contributes to strengthening Sodexo’s cloud security posture by defining security architecture patterns, supporting security governance, and enabling projects to adopt secure-by-design principles throughout their lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Security Architecture: Define technical and functional security requirements for strategic cloud and digital initiatives, covering areas such as identity and access management, network security, data protection, application security, API/integration security, data security and cloud infrastructure.
* Security-by-Design: Provide security architecture guidance to projects from early design through implementation, ensuring security requirements are incorporated before go-live and deployment.
* Cloud Security: Review Microsoft Azure services and other cloud, architectures, and implementation patterns and establish appropriate security requirements aligned with the Sodexo Security Framework and directives.
* Architecture & Risk Assessment: Assess solution architectures, identify security risks and design gaps, recommend mitigating controls, and support projects in making appropriate risk-based security decisions.
* Cloud Governance: Contribute to the definition and continuous improvement of cloud security architecture principles, policies, directives, standards, guidelines, and reusable security patterns.
* Digital Identity & Access Management: Define security requirements for digital identities, authentication, authorization, privileged access, workload identities, and service-to-service integrations.
* Cloud Integration Security: Review integrations between cloud, SaaS, on-premises, and external platforms and define appropriate security controls for APIs, data flows, connectivity, authentication, and authorization.
* Cloud Security Initiatives: Lead or contribute to cloud security projects, including requirements definition, technical evaluation, solution selection, testing, implementation, and transition into operational use.
* Business & Regional Support: Support regions, Business Units, CIO organizations, Solution Architects, and project teams in securely migrating or deploying applications and workloads into Sodexo’s public cloud environment.
* Security Advisory: Analyze business and IT requirements that may impact the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of Sodexo information and systems and recommend appropriate security measures.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business owners, IT teams, Enterprise and Solution Architects, Governance and risk team, Security operation team, Data protection team, legal, Internal Audit, external auditors, and technology partners to enable secure business transformation.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor emerging cloud technologies, security threats, architecture practices, and industry developments and use these insights to continuously improve Sodexo’s cloud security architecture

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or related discipline. A master’s degree is preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in Information Security, with at least 2 year relevant experience in security architecture, consulting, engineering, risk management, or security audit.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of public cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure, and experience securing cloud-native and migrated workloads.
* Strong technical understanding across cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, systems, databases, applications, APIs, and data security.
* Good understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, including authentication, authorization, privileged access, managed/workload identities, and least-privilege access.
* Experience performing security architecture reviews and risk assessments, with knowledge of methodologies and standards such as ISO 27005, EBIOS, ISO 27001, NIST, PCIDSS, GDPR or equivalent frameworks.
* Ability to translate business and technical requirements into practical and proportionate security controls and architecture requirements.
* Understanding of cloud security concepts including network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, secure integration, and Zero Trust principles.
* Relevant cloud certifications or training are preferred, such as Microsoft Azure security or architecture certifications and equivalent industry cloud security qualifications.
* Information Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001, or equivalent are considered an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance security, business requirements, architecture constraints, and operational needs.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security topics clearly and influence stakeholders across different levels of the organization.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural, and cross-functional environment.
* Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

description:
**Job Description**
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:
  
  

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Identify and Prioritise Risk
  
  

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
* Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.

Coordinate Remediation
  
  

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
* Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.

Improve Security Practices
  
  

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
* Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.

Report and Govern

**Microsoft 365 (M365) Specialist**
**Reports To: Director, Global IT Support & Collaboration Services**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Microsoft 365 Specialist to manage, optimize, and support our global Microsoft 365 environment. **Administration & Operations**

* Administer, configure, and maintain Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)

* Monitor service health, performance, and availability; troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests
* Perform tenant-level configuration, updates, and feature deployments

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, and data protection policies
* Support compliance initiatives (eDiscovery, retention policies, audit logs, DLP)
* Monitor and respond to security alerts and vulnerabilities within the M365 environment

* Lead or support migrations to/from Microsoft 365 (email, file shares, tenant consolidation)
* Implement governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive usage
* Integrate M365 with enterprise systems and third-party applications
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, automation, and platform efficiency

**Automation & Documentation**

* Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell or native M365 tools
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Develop and maintain reporting dashboards for usage, health, and compliance

* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft 365 administration and support experience

* Exchange Online
* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive for Business
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and identity/access management
* Proven experience implementing Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps)

**Key Competencies**

* Continuous learning mindset to stay current with M365 roadmap and emerging capabilities
* Focus on security, compliance, and operational excellence

title: Staff Security Engineer, API Security
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This role sits at the core of Product and AI Security engineering. This job leverages security expertise to resolve complex security issues, partners with teams to drive security initiatives, applies analytical skills to solve security challenges, contributes to security improvements, and influences security processes.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex security issues, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities
* Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
* Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company’s context.
* Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices.
* Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into security processes.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:**

* Build the end-state API security capability plane: Consolidate today's separate API security lint, gateway traffic visibility, shadow-API detection, and schema (GraphQL/AsyncAPI) security checks into a single, coherent capability that plugs into the org's shared policy-as-code enforcement architecture - the same engine already governing container, static-analysis, and software-composition findings. Design the end state first - this is not a request to bolt on another point tool.
* Take the pre-release API security gate from draft architecture decision to a shipped control, working with the Staff Engineer who owns enforcement architecture to get the gateway-level hard-block policy enforced end to end. This person unblocks stalled decisions - they do not wait for consensus to form on its own.
* Own the dynamic application security testing (DAST) tooling strategy end to end: complete the current tool evaluation into a production migration decision, and execute it.
* Extend API security capability into two domains identified as organizational blind spots - pipeline access & execution control, and systemic artifact consumption verification - treating API security as one instance of the broader supply-chain security problem, not a silo, and enabling them through the shared enforcement architecture rather than a parallel one.
* Be a force multiplier: mentor engineers across the merged team, unblock stuck initiatives, and drive delivery and innovation without waiting to be told what's next. Standard staff-engineer responsibilities and day-to-day routines apply in full - technical leadership, design review, on-call/escalation, sustaining engineering, and maintenance are shared responsibilities like any other staff engineer, not exceptions carved out for this role.
* Shape the Roadmap: Work with the engineering manager and tech leads to shape and prioritize the team's backlog, identify emerging business problems before they become fire drills, and think beyond the current scope of the role rather than just executing what's already been defined.

**What do you need to bring:**

* Software Engineering: 5+ years building production software with demonstrated staff-level ownership of a platform or system end-to-end, with hands-on coding experience in Python or Go - not just contributing features inside someone else's architecture.
* API Security Engineering: Deep, hands-on expertise in API architecture (REST, GraphQL, AsyncAPI), authZ/authN (OAuth2 scopes, token/session models), and API gateway or service-mesh internals (Envoy-class systems or equivalent).
* AI Knowledge: Working knowledge of how AI and agentic traffic is changing the API threat model - AI-driven API abuse patterns, agent-to-API authentication, and the security implications of agentic commerce - enough to reason about it directly, not just defer to the AI security team.
* Working fluency in policy-as-code approaches to security enforcement and CI/CD security gating - you can write enforcement policy, not just consume someone else's.
* Practical understanding of DAST/SAST tooling internals, deep enough to evaluate and replace an underperforming tool rather than just operate whatever is already in place.
* Security fundamentals across product, cloud, and vulnerability management that go a bit deeper than most - you know why a control exists, not just that it exists.
* Deep knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10 and common API abuse patterns (broken object-level authorization, excessive data exposure, resource/rate-limit abuse), and how to design controls that close them - not just cite the list.
* Hands-on experience with API traffic-protection mechanisms - rate limiting, bot/abuse mitigation, WAF/API gateway policy, and mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication.
* Working knowledge of API discovery and inventory practices, deep enough to stand up shadow-API detection rather than just consume a vendor's dashboard.

title: Principal Agentic Security Engineer
description:
**SECURITY ENGINEERING AT INVESTCLOUD**
At InvestCloud, we are building an intelligent security response capability that determines what to fix first based on the actual risk to our clients and business, not a scanner's native severity.
  
  
Traditional vulnerability management produces disconnected findings and long backlogs. It often misses whether vulnerable code is deployed, reachable by an attacker, connected to a critical service, capable of lateral movement, or already being exploited. We are solving that problem by combining threat intelligence, runtime and deployment evidence, configuration management data, attack path analysis, business criticality, and validation results.
  
  
The platform will ingest findings from infrastructure, cloud, application, software supply chain, secrets, containers, infrastructure as code, and adversarial testing. It will reconcile them to a canonical asset and service model, deduplicate them into unique exposures, and rank the remediation actions that remove the most risk.
  
  
The product is being built in Python on AWS with source-controlled connectors, deterministic policy code, an AI reasoning layer, human approval gates, complete audit evidence, and closed-loop validation. Large language models (LLMs) can correlate evidence, recommend remediation, and explain decisions. They do not calculate the authoritative priority score.
  
  
This is not another scanner or dashboard. It is a security decision and remediation platform that must answer one question reliably: what is the single next action that will remove the most material risk, why is it first, who owns it, and how will we verify the risk is gone? Every engineer on this team will build production software, operate what they build, and own the product after the initial consultant implementation.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As our Agentic Security Engineer, you will serve as the principal software architect for the harness and own the AI reasoning layer that turns prioritized exposures into evidence-grounded remediation options, residual risk analysis, and clear explanations.
  
  
You will ensure the product operates as a reliable system, not an AI demonstration. The deterministic policy engine owns the authoritative score. The LLM layer retrieves evidence, correlates likely root causes, evaluates mitigation choices, produces structured recommendations, and knows when to abstain or require a human. You will also set engineering standards across Python services, APIs, data contracts, the evaluation framework, observability, and the operator experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Product Technical Architecture: Own the end-to-end software architecture for the Python and AWS product, including service boundaries, FastAPI and client APIs, the React or TypeScript operator interface, data contracts, Aurora PostgreSQL integration, security controls, performance, resilience, testability, and technical debt. Review and approve material design changes.
* AI Reasoning & Tool Orchestration: Build reliable, stateful workflows that retrieve evidence, call deterministic tools, correlate findings, identify root causes, compare remediation options, and return schema-validated recommendations with citations and confidence.
* Grounding, Retrieval & Provenance: Ground every output in current CMDB, threat intelligence, scanner evidence, code and deployment context, policy, and remediation history. Preserve source, observation time, freshness, model version, prompts, tool calls, and output evidence without inventing facts.
* Evaluation, Safety & Confidence: Create representative test sets and automated evaluations for accuracy, completeness, unsafe actions, hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, model drift, and confidence calibration. Implement fallback, abstention, and deterministic validation when evidence is weak.
* Human Oversight & Controlled Autonomy: Implement approval workflows, policy gate integration, exceptions, kill switches, audit capture, and separation of duties. Support an initial recommendation mode, then controlled automation only after actions are proven safe, reversible, and approved.
* Technical Leadership & Product Ownership: Set coding, testing, observability, documentation, and secure development standards for the team. Mentor engineers, challenge vendor assumptions, maintain provider independence, manage cost and latency, and lead the full handover from the consultant.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 12+ years in software, AI, or security engineering, with principal-level evidence of architecture, delivery, and technical leadership. You must have shipped production AI or LLM systems and possess enough security depth to evaluate remediation safely.
* Expert production Python and backend engineering, including FastAPI, Pydantic or JSON Schema, asynchronous workflows, APIs, SQL or PostgreSQL, distributed systems, automated testing, CI/CD, and AWS.
* Production LLM and agentic workflow experience using Bedrock, Claude, OpenAI, LangGraph, or equivalent. You have built durable tools using systems with explicit state, retries, timeouts, validation, and failure recovery, not demos.
* Evaluation and AI security depth, including gold data sets, offline and online metrics, hallucination controls, prompt injection defenses, data isolation, model routing, observability, confidence calibration, and safe abstention.
* Retrieval and knowledge engineering across structured and unstructured data. You understand when relational queries, search, rules, or vector retrieval are appropriate and can preserve provenance and freshness.
* Security engineering depth across application, cloud, infrastructure, vulnerability intelligence, attack paths, remediation, and compensating controls. You can identify when an AI proposal is incomplete, unsafe, or simply wrong.
* A high ownership builder who maintains current expertise through self-directed work, uses AI to multiply output without lowering rigor, communicates complex designs concisely, mentors others, and collaborates without ego.

**CORE TOOLING & TECHNOLOGIES**
Python
  
  

* FastAPI
* Pydantic / JSON Schema
* LangGraph or equivalent
* AWS Bedrock
* Claude / OpenAI
* PostgreSQL / Aurora
* RAG and search
* REST / GraphQL
* React / TypeScript familiarity
* GitLab CI
* pytest
* OpenTelemetry / Datadog
* Jira / JSM
* AWS

**WHY JOIN THIS TEAM**
You will define whether this becomes a trustworthy security product or an impressive prototype. The role combines principal software architecture, applied AI, and security judgment at a level rarely available in one position.
  
  
Your work will make the platform explainable, testable, provider-independent, and safe enough to support controlled automation over time.

title: IR & Forensics - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join the Cyber Incident Response & Forensics team at Deloitte as a Senior Consultant supporting organizations through complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders while helping lead rapid-response incident management, forensic analysis, and threat hunting activities. This position requires sound judgment, immediate responsiveness during active incidents, and the ability to work independently in high-pressure situations.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Incident Response team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead incident response activities for malware, ransomware, data breach, and insider threat investigations across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Perform triage, containment, and forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and identity infrastructure, including Windows, Linux, and macOS systems
* Conduct threat hunting, log analysis, malware analysis, and investigation activities across security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, and network security platforms
* Document incident timelines, indicators of compromise, attack methodologies, findings, and remediation actions, and prepare post-incident reports and reviews
* Serve as a technical advisor to client stakeholders during active incidents, support tabletop exercises and incident response planning, and contribute to internal playbooks and knowledge assets

**The team**
Deloitte’s Cyber Incident Response team helps organizations investigate, contain, and recover from complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. The team supports clients through forensic analysis, threat hunting, incident management, and recovery planning during high-impact events. Professionals in this practice work across industries to strengthen incident response readiness, improve detection and response capabilities, and reduce the impact of future attacks.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**

**Qualifications**
Required:

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

description: Security Architect - AI-Powered Security EngineeringAbout The TeamThe security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this, with zero downtime! We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. By 2030, Meesho will be the world’s most trusted and secure digital ecosystem, operating on an AI-native, Zero-Trust, self-healing architecture. As we shift toward an era where autonomous agents generate and deploy code, we want to ensure our security scales seamlessly with engineering velocity. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member, fostering a strong 'Founder’s Mindset' that helps us move fast.About The RoleWe are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Security Architect (Individual Contributor) to guide and lead our AI-Powered Security Engineering charter. In this role, you will bridge the gap between conventional DevSecOps, infrastructure security, and the rapidly evolving landscape of AI. You will optimize our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by designing secure-by-default guardrails for both human developers and AI coding agents. Your mission is to ensure near-zero vulnerabilities from application and data security failures reach production. A significant portion of your focus will involve advanced Red Teaming, utilizing LLMs to improve Meesho's security posture, and architecting defenses for our autonomous AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, and jailbreaking attacks.What You Will DoLead AI Security Architecture: Drive the technical roadmap and high-level design to continuously prevent, detect, and autonomously contain threats across our systems and AI agents. Hands-on Prototyping & POCs: Build proof-of-concepts for autonomous agent harnesses that automatically detect, analyze, and mitigate security vulnerabilities in real-time. AI SDLC Optimization: Architect non-bypassable security guardrails across the SDLC for both developers and AI coding agents to ensure production systems are secured by default. Red Teaming & Adversarial Validation: Proactively execute adversarial testing by simulating real attack scenarios across APIs, AI systems, and infrastructure to validate defense mechanisms. Protect AI Systems: Design deep technical defenses to protect all AI agents and experimental features from prompt injection, system misuse, manipulation, and unauthorized actions. Zero-Trust Governance: Architect a Zero Trust Identity Control Plane that eliminates implicit trust, ensuring access for both humans and autonomous agents is time-bound, least-privileged, and continuously verified. Technical Leadership & Influence: Act as a security expert and IC leader. Mentor security engineers, provide architectural guidance across the organization, and partner closely with ML, DevOps, and Platform teams to evangelize secure coding practices without direct reporting lines. What You Will NeedExperience: 10+ years of hands-on technical experience across different areas of security, including infrastructure security, product security, system design, and DevSecOps. AI/ML Security Expertise: Proven track record of leveraging coding agents and LLMs for security workflows, Red Teaming GenAI models, and building defenses against jailbreaking, adversarial ML, and model hallucination risks. DevSecOps & Cloud Mastery: Deep technical proficiency with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, including their security tools, Docker, and containerization technologies. Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Node.js, and Python, combined with hands-on experience securing production code, developing security tooling, and performing manual source code reviews. Strategic Vision & Threat Modeling: Ability to architect secure-by-default platform capabilities so all services inherit baseline security automatically, paired with advanced threat modeling skills for AI-native and distributed architectures. Bonus PointsRelevant certifications such as GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) or OffSec’s Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (WEB-300). Strong understanding of emerging AI security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF). Experience participating in bug bounty programs or speaking at meetups/conferences. Developing Security products and frameworks.

title: Testing Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Quality Assurance Engineer**
Security Implementation & Integration Quality Assurance | Enterprise Security Program
  
  
**Experience**

* 5 – 9 yrs experience

**Employment type**
Full-time
  
  
**Working model**
Global collaboration; flexible hours as needed
  
  
Role overview
  
  
We are looking for a proactive and quality-focused QA Engineer to support information security implementation and integration projects. The ideal candidate brings strong IT fundamentals, a disciplined approach to delivery, and a genuine commitment to learning. Direct QA or security-testing experience is valuable, but transferable experience from any IT domain is welcome when supported by the right mindset, ownership, and attention to detail.
  
  
What matters most: ownership, reliability, learning agility, collaboration, and consistent follow-through.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Quality planning and delivery: Understand project requirements, risks, and acceptance criteria; translate them into practical test strategies, plans, scenarios, cases, and data.
* Test execution: Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing across project releases; maintain clear traceability to requirements.
* Defect management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through closure; provide concise evidence and work constructively with delivery teams on resolution.
* Security-focused validation: Support testing of security-related solutions and integrations, including negative scenarios, access controls, data handling, and agreed security requirements.
* Automation and efficiency: Contribute to reusable automated tests, test-data management, and integration of suitable tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Quality governance: Follow agreed QA standards, maintain audit-ready evidence, and contribute to quality metrics, status reporting, and release-readiness decisions.
* Collaboration: Partner with product, engineering, operations, information security, and vendor teams across locations and time zones.
* Continuous improvement: Actively identify gaps, suggest pragmatic improvements, share knowledge, and strengthen team practices.

**Mindset and behaviours**




+ Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through on commitments, and raises risks early.
+ Commitment and reliability: Demonstrates consistent effort, discipline, and dependability, especially during critical delivery periods.
+ Learning agility: Quickly understands unfamiliar technologies, business processes, and security concepts; actively seeks and applies feedback.
+ Quality mindset: Looks beyond happy-path validation, asks thoughtful questions, and focuses on preventing defects rather than only detecting them.
+ Collaboration and respect: Communicates clearly, works well with diverse stakeholders, and contributes to a supportive, high-performing team environment.
+ Pragmatic problem solving: Uses evidence and sound judgement to balance risk, speed, and quality.

**Required Qualifications And Capabilities**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 5 years of professional experience. Experience may come from software development, application support, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business analysis, operations, testing, or a comparable technology role.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand requirements, identify risk, and communicate findings clearly.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to organize work, manage priorities, meet commitments, and operate effectively with appropriate guidance.
* High attention to detail and a demonstrable commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience in software testing, test management, defect management, or quality engineering.
* Exposure to Agile or Scrum delivery and collaboration in cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with APIs, databases, web applications, integrations, or cloud-based solutions.
* Exposure to test automation frameworks, scripting, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Awareness of information security principles, security testing approaches, vulnerability management, or secure development practices.
* Experience working with distributed teams, vendor partners, or global stakeholders.

**Typical deliverables**

* Test strategy or test approach aligned to project risk and scope.
* Test plans, scenarios, cases, scripts, test data, and requirement traceability.
* Clear defect records with reproducible steps and supporting evidence.
* Test execution results, quality metrics, risk summaries, and release-readiness input.
* Automation assets and reusable QA documentation, where applicable.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Consistent delivery against agreed commitments and quality standards.
* Clear, accurate, and timely reporting of progress, defects, dependencies, and risks.
* Effective collaboration and constructive challenge within cross-functional teams.
* Growth in domain knowledge, QA capability, and ability to work with increasing independence.
* Meaningful improvement in test coverage, repeatability, and team efficiency.

Why join this team
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to build deeper quality-engineering and information-security expertise while contributing to business-critical initiatives. You will work with global stakeholders, learn across technologies and platforms, and help shape practical QA practices in a team that values accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Researcher - Security & AI
description: OverviewOverview Microsoft Research India (MSR India) is a leading research lab advancing innovation across research areas like Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Theory, Technology & Empowerment, and Systems. The lab was established two decades ago and has been at the forefront of computer science research in India, home to world-class talent and projects. AI is rapidly changing both the systems we need to secure and the way security itself is practiced. AI systems increasingly interact with sensitive data, execute code, invoke tools, and take actions across complex environments, creating new security challenges. At the same time, advances in AI create opportunities to fundamentally rethink how we detect vulnerabilities, understand attacks, and build defences.Our team is pursuing an Growth-orientedresearch agenda at the intersection of security and AI, spanning both securing AI systems and using AI to advance security. Our research includes protecting sensitive data throughout AI pipelines, securing agentic and autonomous systems against new classes of attacks, developing principled defences for AI-enabled systems, and using AI to discover vulnerabilities, understand complex attack surfaces, and develop new security defences.As a Sr Researcher – Security and AI, you will push the state of the art in security for emerging AI systems. You will pursue long-term research problems while also having opportunities to translate research advances into systems deployed at Microsoft scale. You will work with researchers and engineers across MSR India, Microsoft Research worldwide, and Microsoft product groups, enabling your work to have impact both in the research community and on systems used by millions of users.We Are Looking For Candidates WhoAre passionate about advancing the state of the art in security, privacy, cryptography, systems, and AI Have a strong research track record, demonstrated through publications at top venues such as IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS, or other leading security, systems, cryptography, or machine learning venues Are excited about tackling emerging security problems created by AI and agentic systems Combine scientific rigor with strong systems thinking and the ability to turn research ideas into working prototypes Thrive in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment Take end-to-end ownership of open-ended research problems ResponsibilitiesResponsibilitiesLead research at the intersection of security and AI, spanning both securing AI systems and applying AI to security problems. Develop new techniques to protect sensitive and proprietary data in AI systems and pipelines, including training, post-training, reinforcement learning, inference, and agentic workflows. Investigate the security of AI agents and autonomous systems, including attacks arising from tool use, code execution, memory, external data, multi-agent interaction, and long-running autonomous behavior, and develop principled defenses against them. Explore how AI can help address security problems, including discovering vulnerabilities and attack paths, understanding complex security environments, detecting attacks and anomalous behavior, and developing effective defenses. Investigate new attacks enabled or amplified by advances in AI and develop robust defenses against them. Design rigorous threat models, benchmarks, evaluations, and experimental methodologies for emerging AI security problems. Form hypotheses, build prototypes, design experiments, and evaluate new security mechanisms in realistic environments. Pursue long-term research while identifying opportunities to translate promising ideas into practical security mechanisms. Publish at top-tier security, systems, cryptography, and machine learning venues, release research artifacts where appropriate, and help shape the research agenda in security and AI. Collaborate with research and product teams across Microsoft to translate research advances into stronger security for real-world Microsoft systems. Mentor interns and entry level researchers and contribute to MSR India's broader academic and research engagement. Embody our culture and values. QualificationsRequired Qualifications PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 1+ years of software engineering or research experience. Strong background in one or more areas of computer security, privacy, cryptography, computer systems, or machine learning. Strong research track record in security, cryptography, systems, machine learning, or a closely related area. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and communicate results through publications, prototypes, open-source artifacts, or other impactful outcomes. Ability to identify and formulate important research problems, develop novel technical approaches, and evaluate them rigorously. Ability to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries and collaborate with diverse research and engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications Research experience in AI security, security of LLMs, or security of agentic systems. Experience with security and privacy techniques for AI training, post-training, inference, or data pipelines. Experience in areas such as systems security, applied cryptography, privacy-enhancing technologies, confidential computing, access control, or secure machine learning. Experience studying adversarial behavior, software vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, or security of large-scale systems. Experience applying LLMs or other AI techniques to security problems such as vulnerability discovery, security analysis, attack detection, or defense generation. Experience building and evaluating large-scale security or AI systems. Experience designing threat models, security benchmarks, adversarial evaluations, or red-team methodologies for emerging systems. **Position Summary**
