title: IND Red Team Engineer, Security
description:
IND Lead Engineer, Security - GCC041
  
  
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
  
  
**Job: Senior Red Team Engineer, Endpoint TTPs & Malware Development**
**Description**
We're hiring a senior offensive security engineer to join our growing Adversary Simulation (AdSim) team. We are looking for our first endpoint and malware development specialist: someone who can own initial access, persistence, payload development, evasion research, offensive tooling, and assist with hands-on execution during AdSim exercises.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You’re someone who is excited to reverse engineer security products, develop custom malware and endpoint tradecraft, and assist with operating those capabilities during exercises while evading live defenders. You’ll help provide insights into improved prevention and detection strategies for our defenders to consider.
  
  
**Specifically, You Will**

* Design, develop, and maintain custom offensive tooling, malware, loaders, implants, payloads, Beacon Object Files (BOFs), endpoint persistence mechanisms, and supporting operational infrastructure.
* Conduct malware development, malware analysis, reverse engineering, exploit development, and offensive security research inspired by Threat Intelligence, real-world adversary TTPs, and the candidate’s own research and development.
* Operate hands-on during AdSim exercises, including covert, purple team, and targeted exercises.
* Evaluate and challenge common EDR/AV platforms, log collection, behavioral analysis, network monitoring, identity protection, and other detective and preventative controls.
* Partner with SOC, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and Detection Engineering teams to improve prevention, detection, and response capabilities.
* Translate technical findings into business risk and deliver actionable detection and remediation guidance.
* Use and develop AI-assisted testing, automation, perform adversarial LLM research, and build offensive security workflows to accelerate capability development and operational effectiveness.
* Help shape the future direction of AI-enabled adversary simulation, endpoint tradecraft, malware development, and AdSim exercises.

**What You Bring**
Candidates will be evaluated based on their ability to perform the duties listed above while demonstrating the required skills and competencies necessary to be highly effective in the role. Preferred experience and certifications are nice to have, not required.
  
  
**Required Experience And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in red teaming, adversary simulation, offensive security engineering, malware development, exploit development, or advanced penetration testing.
* Demonstrated experience operating against mature enterprise environments protected by modern security controls.
* Strong software development skills in C, C++, C#, Rust, Go, Python, or similar languages, with demonstrated experience building offensive or security tooling.
* Proven experience developing or modifying custom malware, loaders, implants, payloads, BOFs, endpoint persistence techniques, evasions, ETW patching, AMSI bypass, and operational tooling.
* Strong reverse engineering, malware analysis, and exploit development capabilities, including analyzing malware, operating system components, and commercial security products.
* Deep understanding of Windows internals, Active Directory, authentication protocols, endpoint telemetry, and modern defensive technologies.
* Strong understanding of how EDR/AV, log collection, behavioral analysis, network monitoring, identity protections, and other detective and preventative controls identify adversary activity.
* Experience using AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate software development, research, automation, and offensive security activity, including interest in adversarial use of LLMs.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborate closely with defensive teams.

**Nice-to-have Experience**

* Broader red teaming knowledge in one or more additional areas such as cloud security across Azure, AWS, or GCP; application security; web application testing; phishing and social tradecraft; identity attack paths; Active Directory tradecraft; Linux or macOS endpoint internals and tradecraft, including macOS SIP, execution, persistence, telemetry, and security control behavior; wireless or physical security; exploit development; vulnerability research; custom C2 framework development; C2 extension, module, or profile development; or large-scale offensive infrastructure.
* Game hacking, game security, or anti-cheat bypass research against EAC, BattlEye, Vanguard, or similar platforms, with experience in internal/external tooling, Ring 3/Ring 0 tradecraft, manual mapping, injection, hooking/unhooking, kernel callbacks, memory scanning, overlays, driver-assisted tooling, and detection-surface reduction.
* Public research, conference presentations, blogs, tool releases, or open-source contributions.
* Experience with kernel development, kernel security research, advanced vulnerability research, or commercial security product research.
* Nice-to-have certifications include OSEP, OSED, OSCP, CRTO, GXPN, GREM, or equivalent hands-on offensive security certifications. No certifications are required.

**Why This Role**
The AdSim Team is building the team we know sets the bar: sharp enough to evade mature defenses, malleable enough to simulate a range of adversaries, and technical enough to build the capabilities other offensive teams dream about. You’ll build custom tooling, develop endpoint tradecraft, operate during realistic exercises, and chase the research that matters. If you want challenging work and the chance to help build one of the best AdSim teams in the space, help us build it at The Hartford

description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
  
  
This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
* Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
* Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
* Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
* Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
* Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CCSK, Cloud Vendor Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security — Specialty, AWS Certified Solution Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent credentials.

Are you passionate about building secure, scalable cloud infrastructure? Join our innovative team and lead the DevSecOps function that powers our cutting-edge facultative reinsurance platform. description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. **Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Technical Consultant: Threat Detection Response & Intelligence, you play a vital role in safeguarding an organization's digital infrastructure by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating cyber threats. This position involves using a variety of cybersecurity tools to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Conduct Event Investigations: Investigate security incidents using SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, and apply industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
* Manage Incident Reports: Prioritize and manage incident reports, providing actionable recommendations and responses to strengthen the client's security posture.
* Analyze Network and Endpoint Events: Interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
* Engage in Vulnerability Management: Participate in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
* Provide Actionable Recommendations: Deliver recommendations and responses to clients to enhance their security posture.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Cybersecurity Tools: Familiarity with a variety of cybersecurity tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
* Understanding of Industry Frameworks: Knowledge of industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
* Experience with Network and Endpoint Analysis: Ability to interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
* Exposure to Vulnerability Management: Participation in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
* Certification in Security Technologies: Familiarity with security technologies and certifications related to threat detection, response, and intelligence.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash is beneficial for automating tasks and interacting with various cybersecurity tools.
* Knowledge of Cloud Security: Understanding cloud security principles and experience working with cloud-based security solutions can be advantageous in identifying and mitigating cyber threats.
* Exposure to Threat Intelligence Platforms: Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and feeds can aid in staying up-to-date with emerging threats and improving incident response capabilities.

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
**Job Description**
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:
  
  

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Identify and Prioritise Risk
  
  

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
* Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.

Coordinate Remediation
  
  

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
* Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.

Improve Security Practices
  
  

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
* Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.

Report and Govern
  
  

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate.
* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

title: Network Automation Developer
description:
**Position Title:**
Network Automation Developer

**Experience:**
5 to 10 Years

**Work Locations:**
Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram

We are looking for development expertise on Nokia Service Platform (NSP) development and automation.

Looking for early joiners as this is urgent opportunity

**Summary**

The developer will design, modify, test, and maintain service templates and workflows within the Nokia NSP SDN Controller environment. The role supports network service lifecycle management and intent-based networking use cases across transport, IP, and SDN domains, applying AI-assisted development and intelligent automation techniques where they improve service modelling, workflow quality, operational insight, and engineering efficiency.

The individual will work closely with the Product Owner, network engineering teams, architects, and operations teams to translate service requirements into automated workflows and reusable service templates.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Template Development**

* Design and modify Nokia NSP service templates that support consistent service configuration and lifecycle management.
* Develop reusable service models and intent templates supporting customer and network services.
* Customize existing templates to accommodate new network products, services, and operational requirements.

**NSP Integration & Automation**

* Integrate service templates and workflows with relevant Nokia NSP components.
* Support northbound and southbound interfaces within the NSP ecosystem.
* Create automation workflows for provisioning, service modification, and decommissioning activities.

**Service Modeling**

* Translate business and network requirements into service models.
* Design service abstractions supporting IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN, L2VPN, L3VPN, transport, and SDN services.

**Model Driven Management (MDM) Enablement Objective**

Modernize Nokia NSP service templates and supporting workflows to align with Model Driven Management (MDM) architectures and reduce dependency on traditional CLI-based network configuration.

**Template Modernization**

* Analyze existing Nokia NSP service templates that rely on CLI configuration logic.
* Redesign service templates to utilize model-driven interfaces and data models.
* Replace device-specific CLI commands with standardized YANG model-based service definitions wherever supported.
* Develop reusable service abstractions supporting multi-vendor deployments.

**YANG and OpenConfig Integration**

* Support integration of:
* Native Nokia YANG models
* OpenConfig models
* Vendor-specific YANG extensions
* Ensure templates map service parameters directly to model-driven attributes.
* Validate model compliance and schema compatibility across network domains.

**AI-Enabled Network Automation**

* Apply AI and machine learning concepts to identify automation opportunities, analyze network and service data, and improve workflow efficiency.
* Use generative AI tools responsibly to support code development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and service-template optimization, with appropriate human review and validation.
* Support the development of AI-assisted use cases such as configuration validation, anomaly detection, intent interpretation, predictive assurance, and operational recommendations.
* Integrate AI-enabled components through secure APIs and ensure solutions meet requirements for data quality, explainability, governance, security, and responsible AI.

**Expected Deliverables**

The developer should be able to produce:

* Nokia NSP service templates
* Workflow automation scripts
* API integration components
* AI-assisted automation prototypes and validated use cases
* Test results, model evaluation outputs, and operational guardrails
* Documentation and design specifications

description:
Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.
  
  
  
  
With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘
**To Make Our Lives Easier**

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Networking Engineer to join our IT team and play an important role to design, build, operate secure, scalable, and highly available global AWS network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience with AWS networking services, strong traditional networking fundamentals, and the ability to collaborate effectively with security, DevOps, developers, and engineering teams.

**Duties and responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain AWS networking architectures, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, VPC endpoints, security groups, and network ACLs.
* Configure and support network services such as VPC peering, Transit Gateways, elastic load balancing, hybrid connectivity such as Direct Connect, and site-to-site VPN.
* Develop secure and scalable network infrastructure for multi-account and multi-region AWS environments, aligned with business, security, and operational requirements.
* Configure and support AWS WAF and third-party firewalls.
* Collaborate with DevOps, security and development teams on network related issues.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team offers the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive-scale, coordinated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant environment. OCI delivers cloud products that support customers tackling some of the world’s most complex and business-critical challenges.

OCI Infrastructure Delivery Engineering is a growing organization responsible for building services and tools that accelerate how OCI expands its compute and network capacity. Our platform supports the end-to-end lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. It enables OCI to scale efficiently in existing regions and launch new regions while meeting the high-capacity demands of large and hyperscale customers.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Software Development Engineer to help design, build, and operate this foundational platform. You will work on highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. This is a greenfield environment with significant autonomy to innovate, while integrating with OCI systems through established service contracts.

You will be a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging distributed-systems problems, values simplicity and customer impact, and takes ownership of quality in production. You will collaborate closely with engineers and partner teams to deliver reliable services that help OCI continue to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a cloud development engineer who has contributed to high-scale, high-impact solutions.
* You are customer-focused and consistently look for ways to exceed expectations.
* You communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with diverse partners.
* You hold yourself and your work to a high standard, continuously seeking better engineering outcomes.
* You are comfortable operating in an evolving environment and can bring structure to ambiguity.
* You are passionate about technology, able to advocate for your ideas constructively, and open to evidence-based alternatives.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS/Btech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 1+ year designing, delivering, or operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; working knowledge of scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Experience contributing to products from the ground up through the full software development lifecycle.
* Understanding of microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication protocols, and techniques for building highly reliable services.
* Familiarity with service observability, including dashboards, critical service metrics, alarms, and operational health indicators.
* Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and programming paradigms.
* Experience with production operations and practices for safely deploying quality code, participating in on-call rotations, and troubleshooting incidents.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing through design documents, proposals, architecture diagrams, and presentations.

Preferred Qualifications

* MTech or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Experience building control-plane or data-plane solutions for cloud-native platforms.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving performance, reliability, or scaling issues in complex distributed environments.
* Understanding of the physical asset lifecycle in a cloud-scale data center.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems or related tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Familiarity with modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.

Responsibilities

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Work with engineers and partner teams to define and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for the physical asset lifecycle.
* Investigate issues across the stack, resolve root causes, and improve service reliability, performance, and operational readiness.
* Apply sound distributed-systems and cloud-infrastructure principles to deliver resilient production services.
* Build and maintain meaningful service telemetry, dashboards, alarms, and runbooks to support operational excellence.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response; use operational learnings to drive durable improvements.
* Contribute to technical designs, architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering standards.
* Balance speed and quality through iterative, incremental delivery and thoughtful prioritization.
* Work independently on well-defined problems and provide technical mentorship and support to junior engineers.
* Communicate progress, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly, and help build consensus using data and sound engineering judgment.

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Acceptance Solutions Product Development team are the engineers responsible for a portfolio of products that drive diversification of Visa revenue, differentiate our network, and deliver value-added solutions across other rails. This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility.

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world’s most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale.

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale.

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

* Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.

* Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases.
* Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users.
* Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives.
* Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement.

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

title: Senior Manager - System Validation
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead System Validation for BIOS, Firmware and Driver validation activities across our embedded product portfolio. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership, drive validation coverage, strengthen test planning and execution discipline, and ensure timely visibility to critical issues, risks and customer-impacting defects. The leader will work closely with development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer-facing teams to ensure validation readiness, reduce test escapes and improve engineering effectiveness through scale and AI-driven initiatives.

**THE PERSON**

* A strong technical validation leader with deep understanding of system-level validation across BIOS, firmware, drivers and platform software stacks.
* Demonstrates ownership in defining validation coverage, test strategy, execution governance and defect triage for complex silicon and platform programs.
* Builds trusted networks across client and server ecosystems, development teams, silicon IP enablement teams and validation organizations to improve end-to-end product readiness.
* Balances technical depth with people leadership, helping the team grow in capability, execution maturity, collaboration and customer orientation.
* Brings a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive scale, automation, traceability and AI-enabled productivity across validation workflows.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide technical leadership for system validation activities covering BIOS, firmware and driver validation across assigned embedded programs.
* Define and drive the right validation coverage by partnering with architecture, development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer enablement teams.
* Own test management discipline including validation planning, test readiness, execution tracking, completion governance and timely reporting of progress, gaps and risks.
* Drive first-level triage for critical issues by ensuring structured debug data collection, clear ownership alignment, prioritization and timely handoff to the appropriate development teams.
* Establish strong collaboration forums with BIOS, firmware, driver, silicon IP, silicon validation and platform teams to close coverage gaps and improve defect discovery earlier in the lifecycle.
* Build and maintain technical connects in the client and server spaces from which the group leverages devices, ecosystems, validation methodologies and learnings.
* Reduce validation escapes through improved test strategy, coverage analysis, defect trend reviews, regression rigor and disciplined exit criteria.
* Support customer escalations and critical field issue triage as required, ensuring responsiveness, technical clarity and coordinated execution across engineering owners.
* Lead team development by coaching engineers and leads, improving technical depth, strengthening ownership behaviors and building succession for key validation areas.
* Drive scale initiatives across validation execution, including automation, reusable test assets, consistent dashboards, traceability from requirements to tests, and execution efficiency improvements.
* Champion AI initiatives that improve test planning, coverage mapping, traceability, execution tracking, defect analytics, reporting quality and validation productivity.
* Partner with program management and engineering leadership to provide accurate status, risk visibility, decision points and recovery plans for validation milestones.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* 20+ years of industry experience with 8+ years of exposure with people management roles
* Experience leading system validation, post-silicon validation, platform validation, BIOS validation, firmware validation or driver validation teams for complex silicon or platform products.
* Strong understanding of validation lifecycle, test plan development, coverage definition, test execution governance, defect management, regression strategy and exit criteria.
* Hands-on familiarity with BIOS, UEFI, firmware, drivers, platform initialization, silicon bring-up, debug flows and system-level validation environments.
* Experience collaborating with silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, platform, architecture and customer-facing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead issue triage, drive technical discussions, identify ownership, escalate risks and close critical defects with urgency.
* Experience with customer escalations, field issue debug, escape analysis and corrective action planning.
* Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices.
* Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights.
* Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership.

**Academic Credentials**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.

title: Environment Advocacy Communications Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

Join AECOM's Environment consulting practice and play a vital role in shaping some of the world's most significant infrastructure and development programmes.

Based in India, you will work directly with UK and international project teams, helping deliver engagement and consultation strategies for transformational projects across transportation, energy, water, urban development and major infrastructure. You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary experts and contribute to projects that improve communities, support sustainable development and influence how major investments are delivered.

This is a unique opportunity to develop specialist expertise in stakeholder engagement and public consultation within a global environment, gaining exposure to international best practices, complex infrastructure programmes, and high-profile clients while building a rewarding long-term career with AECOM.

At AECOM, you'll be empowered to work alongside industry-leading professionals, contribute ideas that make an impact, and help create better outcomes for people and communities around the world.

**Start Here. Grow Here.**

AECOM's Enterprise Capabilities team in India is expanding its Stakeholder Engagement practice to support a growing portfolio of UK and international infrastructure projects.

We are seeking a proactive and communication-driven professional who is passionate about helping organizations connect meaningfully with stakeholders, communities, clients and decision-makers. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex projects, influence engagement outcomes, and develop expertise in a highly valued and growing discipline within the global infrastructure sector.

**What You'll Gain**

* Direct exposure to major UK and international infrastructure programmes
* Opportunity to work alongside engagement, planning, environmental and technical specialists
* Structured career development within a globally recognized consultancy
* International project experience without relocation requirements
* A collaborative and inclusive working environment focused on professional growth
* Exposure to innovative digital engagement tools, consultation techniques and communication strategies

Here’s what you’ll do:

**Communications:**

* Support the development of communications strategy and delivery plans for major infrastructure projects, including Infrastructure Consent projects and DCOs primarily in the UK
* Developing themes, core messages and collateral for multiple audiences and stakeholders, including digital users, the media, local communities, statutory bodies, technical groups, and elected representatives
* Identifying creative ways to communicate complex ideas to a wide audience
* Managing communications channels and engaging directly with local communities

**Engagement and consultation:**

* Identifying and mapping key stakeholders for client projects, and establishing an engagement strategy and delivery plans
* Supporting consultation delivery, developing surveys, managing stakeholder feedback channels and analysing consultation responses
* Planning and delivery of events, both physical and virtual, ensuring the safety and wellbeing of all attendees, delivering logistics, developing tailored materials, developing Q&As and briefing colleagues

**Client relations:**

* Liaising with internal and external clients, ensuring a high level of customer service and ensuring accurate, timely reporting.

 **Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

You'll be successful in this role if you:

* Have experience in stakeholder engagement, communications, public affairs, consultation, community relations, corporate communications, public policy, social impact or related disciplines.
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex information for diverse audiences.
* Enjoy working in a collaborative, multidisciplinary and international environment.
* Have an interest in infrastructure, transportation, urban development, energy, environmental services or major capital projects.
* Are proactive, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret stakeholder feedback and identify key insights.
* Value inclusion, accessibility and meaningful community participation in project delivery.
* Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Communications, Public Policy, Political Science, Sociology, Social Sciences, Public Relations, Geography, Planning, Business, or a related discipline or an equivalent number of years of successful, relevant experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting infrastructure, transportation, energy, utilities, environmental or urban development projects.
* Exposure to UK, European or international projects.
* Experience with stakeholder mapping, consultation delivery, survey design, communications planning.

**Why Join AECOM?**

At AECOM, you'll be part of one of the world's leading infrastructure consulting firms, working on projects that shape cities, connect communities and support sustainable growth.

You'll gain global exposure, access to industry-leading expertise, career mobility across disciplines and regions, and opportunities to contribute to projects that leave a lasting positive impact on society.

Whether you're looking to deepen your stakeholder engagement expertise or build a long-term consulting career, AECOM provides the platform, scale and opportunities to help you grow.

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Detection Engineer – Early Career**
=====================================

  
  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

description:

organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 7 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 2 years of related experience.

* Experience building applications or services.

* Own resource planning, allocation, scheduling, and capacity management for Professional Services engagements across multiple customers and geographies.

* Coordinate the assignment of consultants, engineers, architects, and technical specialists based on project requirements, skill alignment, availability, and delivery priorities.
* Partner with resource managers, delivery leads, and technical practice leaders to forecast resource demand and identify capacity gaps, over-allocation, and potential delivery risks.

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Security Operations & Threat Hunter with exceptional troubleshooting abilities and a deep understanding of both endpoint and cloud threats. The ideal candidate will be a key player in our Security Operations Center (SOC), proactively hunting for threats, analyzing security incidents, and ensuring the protection of our infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments.

This role offers a distinct growth trajectory: beyond day-to-day triage and incident response, you will dedicate meaningful time to high-impact engineering projects, AI-driven security automation, and direct collaboration with senior engineering leadership.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Analyze security alerts from security tools to identify potential threats.
* Conduct forensic investigations and deep-dive analysis of security events to identify trends, attack techniques, and areas for improvement.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, and cloud environments to identify sophisticated cyber threats.
* Analyze security logs, behavioral patterns, and anomalies to detect indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Investigate security incidents, perform forensic analysis, and provide actionable recommendations for mitigation and remediation.
* Develop and refine threat hunting methodologies, leveraging frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
* Automate threat detection and analysis using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Continuously monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack trends to improve detection and response strategies.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of experience in security operations, threat hunting, or a similar cybersecurity role.
* Experience working with log data for detection and response across Cloud, EDR, Network, and related telemetry.
* Experience developing and deploying effective detection rules (e.g., YARA, Sigma, SQL-based rules, Network signatures).
* Strong understanding of network security monitoring, packet analysis, and log correlation.
* Deep understanding of advanced threat detection methodologies and threat intelligence.
* Proficiency in analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) based on frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation for security operations (Python, PowerShell, or Bash).
* Solid understanding of endpoint security, identity management, cloud security, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response, and threat intelligence.
* Strong communication skills, an inquisitive mindset, and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and collaborate across teams.

**Working Model & Schedule**
----------------------------

* **Global Exposure & Quarterly Rotations:** To foster close alignment with our distributed engineering teams and US leadership, this role follows a structured quarterly time-zone rotation (rotating through San Francisco/PST, New York/EST, and local daytime business hours). This cadence provides direct access to senior leadership, high-visibility global projects, and cross-functional teams across the organization.
* **Rotational On-Call Coverage:** Shared participation in rotational weekend on-call pager duty to triage critical incidents alongside team members and leadership.
* **Location & Hybrid Flexibility:** Based in Bangalore. During local daytime business cycles, work on-site from our Bangalore office to build strong peer relationships and cross-functional connections; flexible remote arrangements apply during global and US-aligned cycles.

title: Security Consultant
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 23, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752299

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Security Consultant**

**Job Summary:**

As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.

  

The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.

  

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity:**

The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.

The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**

This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

  

**Skills and attributes for success:**

The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.

  

A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.
* Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

  

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

  

**What working at EY offers:**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Technical System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

  Bengaluru
