Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a senior, hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Senior Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: Design and implement secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
* Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
* Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
* IoT & smart buildings: Architect and integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
* DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
* Technical leadership: Define standards, review code and designs, mentor engineers and work closely with architects, vendors and business stakeholders.

Key responsibilities (text) We believe you bring:
  

* 7+ years (recommended) in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
* Data platform – Expert level: Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
* Programming - Expert level: Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
* Back-end / full-stack - Advanced: REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
* IoT & smart buildings - Advanced: MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
* DevOps - Advanced: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Security & governance - Advanced: IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Senior, hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: Strong background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with a strong back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Advanced Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
* Data background: Solid data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, data modelling, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
* IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

  
Nice to have:
  

* Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
* Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Hands-on technical leader who still writes code and builds solutions.
* Strong architectural thinking, balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Drives large initiatives with ownership, structure and focus on outcomes.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
* Mentors and raises the technical level of the team.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  
Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
* Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

**Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.**

**Principal DevOps / Software Engineer (Cloud Orchestration & Platform Engineering)**

The Software Engineering team delivers next-generation application enhancements and new products for a changing world. Working at the cutting edge, we design and develop software for platforms, peripherals, applications and diagnostics — all with the most advanced technologies, tools, software engineering methodologies and the collaboration of internal and external partners.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Software Principal Engineer on our Software Engineering Team in **Bangalore, India**.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal DevOps / Software Engineer, you will architect, build, and evolve the cloud automation, orchestration, and platform capabilities that power our global development ecosystem. You will work deeply within our VMware‑based infrastructure stack, spanning Aria Automation, Aria Operations, VCF, ESXi, and vCenter, while driving modernization toward next‑generation VCF Operations and AI‑enabled orchestration frameworks.

You will partner closely with our software engineering Scrum teams to deliver resilient, intelligent, and scalable automation services that enhance developer productivity, streamline reservation and deployment workflows, and maintain the reliability of critical DevOps tool chains. Your leadership will influence both technology strategy and hands‑on implementation across complex hybrid‑cloud environments.

**You will:**

* Design, implement, and evolve cloud automation and orchestration workflows for VMware‑based platforms, including Aria Automation/Operations and emerging VCF Operations
* Architect and maintain integrations with ServiceNow, reservation systems, deployment services, and asset management platforms supporting global engineering teams
* Develop, enhance, and maintain automation pipelines and services supporting virtual and physical asset provisioning
* Lead modernization initiatives as Aria is modernized, transitioning orchestration capabilities into new VCF‑based platforms and intelligent automation ecosystems
* Create automation frameworks, APIs, and services enabling self‑service provisioning, developer tooling, and global platform operations
* Collaborate closely within Agile/SCRUM teams to design high‑quality automation, observability, and platform capabilities aligned with product engineering needs
* Drive architectural discussions, document solutions, and mentor engineering peers in DevOps engineering, platform automation, and VMware‑centered cloud technologies

title: Engineer, CAE Application
description:
**Your Job**

Molex is seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer / Technical Lead** to join our Multiphysics Simulation Group in Bengaluru. In this role, you will combine deep structural FEA expertise with surrogate modeling to help transform complex simulation data into fast, reliable predictions that support product-design decisions. You will lead structural simulation programs, develop and validate surrogate models, and help advance Virtual Product Qualification through credible physics-based prediction.

**Our Team**

You will join the Multiphysics Simulation Group within Global Engineering Services and Predictive Engineering at Molex's Global Technical Center in Bengaluru. The team is advancing simulation, digital twins, and AI-assisted surrogate models to reduce prototype-heavy development cycles and enable faster engineering decisions.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead structural FEA programs involving quasi-static loading, impact and drop testing, pressure-induced deformation, vibration, fatigue, and creep.
* Develop and validate surrogate models that predict stress, strain, displacement, and deformation from FEA training data, reducing dependence on full simulation runs during design iteration.
* Apply approaches including regression, response-surface methods, design of experiments, neural networks, and Bayesian correction techniques where appropriate.
* Establish confidence in simulation and surrogate predictions through convergence studies, sensitivity analysis, error quantification, cross-validation, and correlation with physical test data.
* Define the design-space boundaries and limitations within which surrogate models can be reliably used.
* Partner with product engineering teams across Molex businesses to translate simulation insights into product-design decisions.
* Mentor engineers and strengthen structural simulation methods, review practices, and technical standards across the team.
* Contribute validated structural prediction models to broader multiphysics and digital-twin architectures, supporting progress toward Virtual Product Qualification.

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Civil, Computational Mechanics, or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrated structural simulation experience with strong knowledge of solid mechanics, finite-element methods, nonlinear analysis, and contact mechanics.
* Hands-on experience with at least one commercial FEA solver such as Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Nastran, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience personally building and validating surrogate or reduced-order models from simulation data to predict structural responses.
* Programming experience using Python or MATLAB for model development or automation, with experience using regression, response-surface, Gaussian-process, or neural-network modeling approaches.

  
**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Solid Mechanics, or a related discipline.
* Experience with commercial surrogate or AI simulation platforms such as Physics AI, DEP MeshWorks, Ansys SimAI, Altair HyperStudy, Siemens HEEDS, Rescale, or Isight.
* Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, Physics-Informed Neural Networks, or physics-constrained machine learning.
* Experience with impact, drop-test, or crash simulation in high-reliability product applications.
* Understanding of digital-twin architectures and integration of surrogate models into multiphysics environments.
* Experience with coupled thermo-structural or electro-thermal-structural simulation.

  
**Who We Are**

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

**Job Summary**
===============

ABOUT FIRST AMERICAN INDIA First American (India) Private Limited (“FAI”) is a Global  
Capability Centre (GCC) of the First American Financial Corporation (FAF: NYSE) a leading provider  
of title insurance, settlement services and risk solutions for real estate transactions since 1889.  
FAI delivers Software Development, IT Infrastructure, Data & Analytics, back-office, and  
knowledge-processing operations to support First American's global operations across the US, UK,  
Australia & Canada. We build technology that powers millions of real-estate transactions, with a  
people-first culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and solving real-world problems at  
scale.  
Job Title: AWS/Azure Staff Engineer (Remote India)  
About the Role  
You will be the technical lead for First American’s enterprise AWS platform powering application  
modernization, with strong multi-cloud exposure across AWS and Azure. You will define strategy  
and reference architectures with a strong product mindset, lead complex designs (networking,  
security, identity, observability, centralized root account management, and org-wide Config and  
GuardDuty on AWS; Management Groups, Azure Policy and Entra ID RBAC/PIM on Azure), and  
guide multiple squads building a secure, compliant, self-service platform. You will take end-to-end  
ownership, hold yourself accountable for outcomes, communicate clearly across stakeholders,  
mentor engineers, and collaborate with AWS, Azure, and GCP Platform Engineering teams and our  
centralized point of presence to align guardrails and shared patterns across clouds.  
Key Responsibilities  

* Own the end-to-end AWS platform architecture (Organizations/OU model, Control Tower

and AVM account vending, identity, network, security, observability, cost) and its roadmap.  

* Partner with Azure Platform Engineering to align landing-zone design: Azure Management

Groups, subscription vending/Enterprise Scale, identity, network, security, observability,  
and cost governance.  

* Set and enforce platform principles across AWS and Azure: security-by-default, IaC-only

(Terraform with CloudFormation/Bicep/ARM where appropriate), least privilege, and  
defense-in-depth for workloads.  

* Lead AWS hub-and-spoke networking: Direct Connect/Partner connectivity, centralized

DNS, policy-based routes, Palo Alto security inspection, and centralized VPC interface  
endpoints.  

* Align Azure hub-and-spoke networking patterns: ExpressRoute/Partner connectivity, Azure

Virtual WAN, centralized DNS, policy-based routing, Palo Alto inspection, and centralized  
Private Link/Private Endpoints.  

* Define and govern AWS SCPs, IAM policies, and permission boundaries; drive policy-ascode,

exception processes, and AWS Well-Architected reviews.  

* Align Azure governance: Azure Policy, deny assignments, RBAC least-privilege design,

policy-as-code, exception processes, and Azure Well-Architected reviews.  

* Own centralized AWS root account management strategy: no routine root access, secured

credentials, activity monitoring, and audited break-glass aligned with InfoSec and  
compliance requirements.  

* Support Azure tenant/subscription break-glass controls: secured privileged access, PIM/JIT

governance, activity monitoring, and audited emergency access aligned with InfoSec.  

* Define org-wide AWS Config and GuardDuty architecture (delegated admin, aggregators,

conformance packs, auto-remediation, threat detection baselines) integrated with Security  
Hub and operational response.  

* Align Azure security posture: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy compliance, autoremediation,

threat detection baselines, and integration with Security Hub-equivalent  
operational response.  

* Direct AWS identity architecture: IAM Identity Center with Entra ID (SAML), workload roles

and OIDC for keyless auth across CI/CD and services; break-glass model with hardware  
MFA.  

* Align Azure identity architecture: Entra ID (Azure AD) federation, group-based RBAC,

PIM/JIT access, managed identities, workload OIDC for keyless CI/CD, and AKS workload  
identity.  

* Own AWS observability architecture: org-level CloudTrail and log aggregation streaming
* Splunk/Elastic; ensure coverage for management, data, VPC flow, DNS, firewall, Config,

GuardDuty, and Security Hub findings.  

* Align Azure observability: Activity Log, Diagnostic Settings, Azure Monitor, VNet flow logs,

DNS/firewall logs streaming Splunk/Elastic; ensure Defender for Cloud and policy  
compliance coverage.  

* Partner with InfoSec on unified posture management across AWS (Security Hub, Config,

GuardDuty) and Azure (Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy), plus Prisma Cloud and Qualys;  
define controls, SLAs, and drift remediation.  

* Drive multi-cloud patterns and guardrails consistent across AWS, Azure, and GCP;

harmonize landing-zone, identity, networking, and security models and shared  
Blueprint/Modules standards.  

* Define modernization paths for AWS (EKS, ECS, RDS, data services) and Azure (AKS,

Container Apps, Azure SQL, data services) with consistent platform patterns.  

* Champion AI-assisted engineering (Claude, Cursor) and agentic automations for platform

delivery, documentation, and operational excellence across AWS and Azure.  

* Lead Terraform IaC migration strategy, module standards, and pipeline governance

(GitHub; Spacelift where adopted) for AWS and Azure workloads.  

* Apply a strong product mindset: prioritize platform capabilities that deliver measurable

value to application teams, balance roadmap trade-offs, and translate technical work into  
clear outcomes and adoption.  

* Mentor and develop senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and

career guidance; model accountability, ownership, and high-quality delivery.  

* Collaborate across Platform Engineering teams (AWS, Azure, GCP, Blueprint and Modules,

DNA Enablement) to align standards, shared patterns, and multi-cloud guardrails.  

* Design and manage AWS multi-account strategy using AWS Organizations with OU

hierarchy aligned to environment, business unit, and workload classification  

* Implement and maintain AWS Control Tower or a custom landing zone for account vending

and baseline configuration  

* Define and execute strategic roadmaps for AWS and Azure cloud platforms, aligning cloud

adoption with business objectives, optimizing cost and performance, and ensuring  
scalability, security, and compliance across environments.  

* Communicate effectively with engineering, InfoSec, operations, and leadership; represent

the AWS platform and multi-cloud alignment in architecture councils, CAB, and executive  
updates.  
Key Requirements  

* 12+ years in platform/cloud engineering with 6+ on AWS at enterprise scale; proven multicloud

exposure with hands-on Azure platform engineering in regulated environments.  

* Expert in Terraform (modules, workspaces), IaC governance (policy-as-code/OPA), and

CI/CD (GitHub; Spacelift OIDC federation, policies, and stacks preferred) across AWS and  
Azure.  

* Deep AWS networking: VPC design, Transit Gateway, centralized VPC endpoints, routing,

load balancing; hub/spoke with centralized inspection.  

* Solid Azure networking: VNet design, Azure Virtual WAN, Private Link/Private Endpoints,

routing, load balancing; hub/spoke with centralized inspection.  

* Strong AWS security engineering: SCPs, IAM least-privilege/deny patterns, centralized root

account management, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS/CMEK strategy, Secrets  
Manager and enterprise secrets integrations.  

* Strong Azure security engineering: Azure Policy, deny assignments, RBAC least-privilege

design, Defender for Cloud, Key Vault/CMEK strategy, and enterprise secrets integrations.  

* AWS identity: Entra ID federation via IAM Identity Center, group-based RBAC, JIT/PIM

concepts; OIDC for CI/CD and Kubernetes (IRSA).  

* Azure identity: Entra ID (Azure AD) federation, group-based RBAC, PIM/JIT access,

managed identities, OIDC for CI/CD and AKS workload identity.  

* AWS observability: CloudTrail, CloudWatch, log streaming pipelines, Splunk/Elastic design

and cost optimization.  

* Azure observability: Activity Log, Diagnostic Settings, Azure Monitor, log streaming

pipelines, Splunk/Elastic design and cost optimization.  

* Hands-on with AWS Control Tower, AVM, Organizations, and the AWS Well-Architected

Framework.  

* Hands-on with Azure Management Groups, subscription vending/Enterprise Scale landing

zones, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework.  

* Strong product mindset with a track record of shaping platform roadmaps around customer

(application team) needs, adoption, and measurable outcomes.  

* Excellent communication skills; demonstrated accountability and ownership of complex

initiatives end to end.  

* Proven ability to mentor and grow engineers and to collaborate effectively across Platform

Engineering and partner teams.  

* Excellent leadership: roadmaps, cross-BU influence, vendor management, risk trade-offs,

and executive communication.  
Nice to Have  

* Spacelift knowledge or hands-on experience.
* Cloudflare Zero Trust/Tunnels, WAF/DDoS; Palo Alto VM-Series design at scale.
* CloudFormation and Bicep/ARM expertise; GitHub Actions federation at scale.
* GCP platform familiarity for multi-cloud architecture alignment.

title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior QA Manager** to own end-to-end quality for **SonicOS**, the core operating system powering SonicWall's next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust.

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle — from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Strategy & Release Ownership**

* Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
* Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
* Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
* Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpoint

**Firewall Domain & Technical Leadership**

* Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as:
* + Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
  + Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering
* Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
* Define comprehensive test strategies covering:
* + Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
  + Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
  + HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability
* Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenarios

**Automation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure**

* Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
* Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
* Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
* Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
* Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environments

**Execution Excellence & Metrics**

* Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
* Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
* Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
* Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvements

**People Leadership & Stakeholder Influence**

* Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
* Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
* Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
* Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviews

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
* Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
* Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
* Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
* Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
* Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
* Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
* Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
* Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCA

**What Success Looks Like**

* Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
* Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
* Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
* Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
* Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations

**Summary**
The Linux Desktop Engineer will own the design, deployment, configuration, and structural maintenance of Celestica's high-performance Linux computing platform. This role directly supports the Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) engineering group by managing a fleet of approximately 50 HP ZBook Mobile Workstations preinstalled with Ubuntu and optimized for advanced AI-based software development.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of enterprise endpoint compliance and agile engineering infrastructure , the successful candidate will use HCL BigFix as the primary Endpoint Management framework. Responsibilities include developing deployment packages for core endpoint security software , managing monthly patching cycles , and troubleshooting highly specialized developer toolchains to maximize engineering velocity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Fleet Configuration & Baseline Optimization: Own the baseline golden imaging, mass deployment, and configuration maintenance of the HP ZBook workstation fleet utilizing HCL BigFix.
* Silent Software Packaging: Architect and deploy automated, silent installation packages for all enterprise and custom engineering endpoint software via BigFix fixlets.
* Endpoint Security Management: Install and administer Celestica’s standard security applications, including CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker, and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Persona Customization: Configure application controls specifically for the engineering developer workspace. This involves deploying ThreatLocker in a persistent Learning Mode with dedicated sandbox path exceptions (such as ~/Workspace) to prevent process blocks during source compilation.
* Exclusion Path Auditing: Implement and maintain required anti-malware scan exclusions across engineering build paths (e.g., /home/\*/src/, make, gcc, cargo) to ensure frictionless local compilation.
* Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Support and execute monthly operating system and application patching cycles. Ensure critical security patches are vetted and pushed to engineering systems within a mandatory 24-hour window when required.
* Privileged Access Governance: Administer scoped sudo access on developer workstations using secure alternative authentication models (such as SSH agent-based PAM) and manage compliance audits via session recording tools like tlog.
* Engineering Toolchain Support: Act as the primary technical interface for HPS Software Engineers, ensuring local access to build essentials, containerization software, and integrated development environments.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  
**Preferred Technical Qualifications**

* Operating Systems: Expert-level administration of native Ubuntu Linux (specifically 22.04 LTS and 24.04 LTS Desktop environments).
* Endpoint Management: Deep technical expertise using HCL BigFix for software asset tracking, package packaging, enterprise scripting, and automated deployment.
* Endpoint Security: Direct experience administering patches and Fixlets for enterprise security suites: CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker (including allowlisting/ringfencing policy adjustments), and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Environments: Familiarity supporting low-level compilation workflows and toolchains: build essentials (GCC, Clang, CMake, Rust/cargo), Python 3.10+, Docker CE, MicroK8s/Kind, and VS Code.
* Scripting & Automation: Advanced proficiency in Bash or Python scripting to automate workstation configuration, environment provisioning, and repetitive IT administrative tasks.
* Workstation Hardware: Experience configuring high-density workstations (such as the HP ZBook Fury series), including managing system BIOS updates and optimizing dedicated NVIDIA hardware driver profiles.

**Core Competencies**

* Developer Velocity Orientation: Possesses an intense focus on minimizing developer friction, reducing environment downtime, and protecting the engineer's flow state.
* Matrix Collaboration: Exceptional diplomatic and relationship-building skills to successfully co-develop frameworks with Global Information Security and remote site infrastructure divisions.
* Advanced Technical Problem Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot unique, non-standard software-hardware boundary failures that fall outside typical corporate enterprise IT ticketing scripts.

Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Systems, with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience supporting specialized R&D or engineering IT environments.

title: NOC Tier 2 Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
Role Summary
  
  
The Tier-2 NOC Engineer takes escalations from Tier-1 and restores service across our customer contracts, which span on-premises, Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, each with its own SLA. You will troubleshoot across network, compute, operating system, database, application and cloud layers, engage vendors and internal teams, and keep customers informed during major incidents.
  
  
You will also make the NOC better over time: tuning noisy alerts, writing and automating runbooks, and raising problem records so recurring issues are fixed for good. You will work closely with the SOC, providing infrastructure data during security investigations.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Key Responsibilities**
Diagnose and Restore
  
  

* Take escalated tickets from Tier-1 and troubleshoot across network, compute, OS, database, application and cloud layers.
* Restore service through fixes, failover, scaling, or rolling back a bad change, within contract SLAs.
* Identify the likely root cause and record it, with resolution notes, in the ticket.

Change Management
  
  

* Raise and implement emergency changes needed to restore service.
* Roll back changes that cause incidents, and check whether a recent change caused an incident.
* Execute critical out-of-band patches when requested by the SOC and validate service health after patching.

Coordination and Communication
  
  

* Engage vendors (Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, ISPs and others) and internal infrastructure and application teams.
* Send status updates to customers and stakeholders on each contract's schedule during P1/P2 incidents.
* Collect and provide data (logs, configurations, flow data) to the SOC on request during security investigations.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Raise problem records for recurring or unexplained issues.
* Tune alerts: remove noisy ones, adjust thresholds, and action false-positive tuning requests from Tier-1.
* Write and improve runbooks and automate common fixes so Tier-1 can resolve more issues at first contact.
* Coach Tier-1 analysts on troubleshooting and runbook use.

**Scope and Escalation Boundaries**
Inputs this role works from
  
  

* Escalated tickets from Tier-1 with triage evidence
* Monitoring data across all tools, CMDB/service maps per contract, change records and vendor contacts
* Requests from SOC Tier-2 for infrastructure data

Escalate to NOC Tier-3 / engineering when
  
  

* The root cause is outside standard operations (code defect, architecture limit, product/IoT firmware, capacity design).
* A fix needs a significant change or design decision.
* The issue is not resolved within the P1/P2 time limit (e.g., 1 hour of active work on a P1).

Escalate to the Incident Commander (war room) when
  
  

* There is a major incident: several contracts affected, a full customer outage, a likely SLA breach with penalties, or a possible security cause.

**Required Skills**
Technical Depth
  
  

* Hands-on depth in at least two of the following, with working knowledge of the rest:
* Network: TCP/IP, OSI model, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP, load balancers, network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Systems: Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux administration.
* Databases: Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server (performance, blocking, storage, job failures).
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure and AWS (compute, networking, identity, monitoring).
* Applications: Java-based applications, web and application servers, application logs.
* Working knowledge of the products and IoT devices for the contracts supported.
* Log analysis across firewalls, routers, switches, servers and applications.

Monitoring and Observability Tools
  
  

* SolarWinds: NPM, NetFlow analysis, node and interface health.
* AppDynamics: transaction tracing and application performance analysis.
* Oracle Enterprise Manager: database and middleware performance analysis.
* Site24x7: synthetic monitoring and availability checks.
* Azure Monitor and AWS CloudWatch: metrics, alarms and log queries.
* PRTG Network Monitor and Nagios
* Ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira or similar) and Microsoft 365.

**Scripting standards this role follows:**

* All scripts kept in Git in an approved, peer-reviewed library.
* Read-only by default: diagnostic scripts never change anything; scripts that make changes need a change or ticket reference.
* No hard-coded credentials: credentials are pulled from a vault.
* Parameterized by contract and CI, safe to run twice, and logging what they did into the ticket.

Process Skills
  
  

* ITIL incident, problem and change management, including emergency changes and rollbacks.
* Vendor escalation and management.
* Shift handover and incident documentation.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Structured, analytical troubleshooting under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal technical updates for both technical and customer audiences.
* Attention to detail, and the ability to manage several incidents at once.

**Preferred Skills**

* Python for automation that spans several systems (e.g., one script that checks a service across Azure, AWS and on-premises).
* Splunk SPL basics.
* Network device CLI for reading switch, router and firewall state.
* Experience in a multi-customer or managed services NOC with contract-specific SLAs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* CCNA or CompTIA Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
* CompTIA Security+

title: IT&D Technical Project Manager, Lab Resilience
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
Reporting to the IT&D Senior Program Manager – Lab Resilience, this role is responsible for end to end delivery of technical remediation projects across Category and QC laboratories as part of the Lab Resilience Programme. The role focuses on execution of assessment driven remediation, including network segmentation, end of life (EOL) infrastructure replacement, backup deployment, observability tooling rollout, and stabilisation of post implementation operations. The role leads day to day technical delivery, coordinates vendors and site teams, and ensures solutions are implemented securely, compliantly, and sustainably within GxP laboratory environments.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Deliver multiple concurrent technical remediation projects across laboratory environments, aligned to the Lab Resilience roadmap and governance model.
  
  

* Own delivery of remediation activities, adoption of: Network segmentation controls, Backup and recovery processes, Armis asset visibility and alert workflows.
* Maintain detailed project plans, milestone tracking, and dependency management for all assigned labs and workstreams.
* Ensure technical implementations align with IT&D architecture standards, cyber controls, and program design authority decisions.
* Translate high‑level resilience and cyber requirements into clear site‑level implementation plans.
* Coordinate configuration, cutover, and validation activities in lab environments with minimal disruption to operations.
* Ensure remediation solutions consider lab constraints, equipment lifecycles, vendor dependencies, and validation requirements.
* Support site readiness for audits by ensuring remediation evidence, artefacts, and configuration records are complete and accurate.
* Own post implementation stabilisation, ensuring solutions transition smoothly into BAU support.
* Work with ITSM, cyber operations, and site IT to embed monitoring, alerting, and incident response procedures.
* Identify and remediate early operational issues to prevent regression of resilience improvements.
* Act as the primary delivery interface for lab sites, local IT, cyber teams, and external delivery partners.
* Coordinate third party vendors delivering network, endpoint, backup, or observability solutions.
* Escalate risks, delays, or implementation barriers with clear options and impact assessments.
* Support senior programme governance by providing accurate delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans.

Relationship Management:
  
  

* Work closely with lab SMEs, site leadership, and IT&D platform teams to align delivery activities with operational and regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with cyber security, Architecture, platform teams to ensure remediation activities effectively reduce risk exposure.
* Build effective working relationships with external partners to ensure quality, timely delivery, and controlled handover.

The experience we're looking for
  
  
**Essential**

* 8–12+ years of experience delivering infrastructure, network, or cyber remediation projects in complex environments.
* Proven delivery experience across network segmentation, infrastructure refresh, and endpoint modernisation.
* Practical understanding of cyber resilient network designs and secure lab / OT adjacent environments.
* Experience delivering technical change within GxP regulated or highly governed environments.
* Strong project delivery capability across waterfall and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors and site stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong issue resolution, dependency management, and execution focus.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience delivering remediation following cyber or resilience assessments.
* Exposure to laboratory environments, manufacturing, or OT adjacent estates.
* Familiarity with Armis, network visibility, or asset discovery platforms.
* Experience with backup and recovery solutions in industrial or lab contexts.
* Working knowledge of Zero Trust or network segmentation concepts.

**Essential**

* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and project reporting tools.
* Networking, infrastructure, or cyber security certifications (vendor neutral or vendor specific) like CCNA, CISM.
* Project management certification or equivalent delivery experience (PRINCE2, PMP, Agile).

Desired
  
  

* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management qualification.
* Understanding of NIST Cybersecurity Framework or similar security frameworks.

The skills for success
  
  
OT Cyber Security, Cyber remediation, network segmentation, Ability to manage multiple vendors, site stakeholders, understanding of cyber resilient network designs, experience across network segmentation, infrastructure refresh, and endpoint modernisation.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Cloud Operations Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious Cloud Operations(SRE) Intern to join our CloudOps team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in day-to-day cloud operations, monitoring and incident triage, infrastructure automation and CI/CD, cloud cost management (FinOps), security and compliance, and AI-assisted operations while collaborating with experienced cloud engineers, and application development teams.  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the platform end to end, connect application and business needs to reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud operations, evaluate state-of-the-art automation approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and agentic operations solutions.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the platform architecture (mainly AWS, with some Azure), the multi-account setup across production and non-production environments, service dependencies, deployment workflows, and the main reliability, security, and cost risks.
* Assist with day-to-day cloud operations, including environment health checks, configuration reviews, access requests, backups, and resource inventory, starting in non-production environments under guidance.
* Build and maintain monitoring for cloud services, including CloudWatch metrics, log-based metric filters, alarms, and dashboards, and help tune thresholds to reduce alert noise.
* Participate in incident investigation and log triage; query logs and metrics with tools such as CloudWatch Logs Insights, reproduce issues, support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and turn findings into runbooks and triage playbooks.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation, Terraform) and Python or Typescript automation for repeatable operational tasks, following peer review and change-management practices.
* Support Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure; analyze pipeline results, build logs, and agent failures, and help keep controllers and agents healthy and current.
* Contribute to FinOps work across AWS and Azure, such as cost reporting and dashboards, tagging hygiene, finding idle or unused resources, rightsizing, and Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage reviews.
* Support security and compliance work, including IAM least-privilege reviews, key and secret hygiene, audit evidence collection, and control mapping for SOC 2 and FedRAMP.
* Prototype AI-assisted operations using LLMs, Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as alarm and ticket triage, log summarization, incident analysis, cost anomaly explanation, and runbook maintenance.
* Contribute to the team’s Amazon Bedrock CloudOps prototype, an agentic AI assistant that plans read-only investigations, queries logs, metrics, and platform data through approved tools, uses the team’s playbooks as a knowledge base, and reports findings, with PII masking, guardrails, and human review built in.
* Measure monitoring and automation effectiveness by tracking alert noise, time to detect and resolve incidents, automation coverage, and cost savings, and recommend practical improvements.
* Learn and apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework, SRE principles such as toil reduction, the FinOps lifecycle, and secure operations practices.

Required Qualifications  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, identity and access management, and virtual networks, along with Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing).
* Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, TypeScript.
* Foundational understanding of source control (Git), CI/CD concepts, APIs, JSON and YAML, SQL, and ticketing tools such as Jira.
* Essential exposure to and conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI, including their practical use in software engineering or IT operations.
* Ability to understand a system end to end, troubleshoot methodically from symptom to cause, learn unfamiliar technologies, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment and learn, with care and discipline around production systems.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills :**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, identity and access management, and virtual networks, along with Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing).

* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment and learn, with care and discipline around production systems.

Nice to have skills :

* Hands-on exposure to AWS, and ideally Azure, through coursework, labs, or personal projects; entry-level certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) are a plus.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK, and to observability tools such as Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

* Interest in FinOps and cloud cost management, with exposure to AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Report (CUR 2.0) data, Microsoft Cost Management, or SQL and BI tools such as Amazon Athena, Snowflake, or Tableau.
* Exposure to prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks such as Strands Agents or LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock (Guardrails, Knowledge Bases, AgentCore), or model evaluation techniques.

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  
A day in the life  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.  
  
About the team  
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: IT Technical Intern
description:

* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base articles, process guides, diagrams, or user training materials.

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. title: AV and Microsoft Teams Rooms Support Engineer
description:
Location: Powai, Mumbai (Work from Office)

Experience: 3–6 years

Employment: Full-time employment with Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd

Recruitment Partner: Vallaham

Working Week: Five days, with planned event coverage

Joining: Immediate to 30 days preferred

**Hiring and Employment Arrangement**

Vallaham is the recruitment partner for this position and will manage candidate sourcing, screening and interview coordination. The successful candidate will be employed by Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd.

The offer letter, payroll, statutory benefits, employment terms and HR records will be managed by Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd.

**Role Overview**

Bay of Bangalore is seeking a technically proficient and customer-focused L2 AV and Collaboration Support Engineer to support enterprise meeting-room technology and collaboration systems at its Powai, Mumbai, workplace.

The role involves maintaining the operational readiness of Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms and associated Audio-Visual (AV) systems; troubleshooting technical incidents; supporting executive meetings, town halls and hybrid events; and coordinating with specialist vendors for complex issues, hardware repairs and system-level escalations.

The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise with structured troubleshooting, clear communication, professional stakeholder management and strong incident ownership. The candidate should be capable of working independently, diagnosing faults systematically and ensuring a reliable meeting experience for business users.

Expertise in every AV manufacturer or platform is not expected. However, practical experience with enterprise collaboration systems and the ability to troubleshoot across multiple technology layers are essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AV and Collaboration Technology Support**

* Perform daily room health checks and provide L2 operational support for conference rooms, boardrooms, town halls and other collaboration spaces.
* Configure, operate and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms and Zoom Rooms in a live enterprise environment.
* Support enterprise AV equipment and peripherals from manufacturers such as Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Neat, DTEN, Shure, Biamp and QSC.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels, cabling, USB/HDMI connectivity, content sharing and conferencing peripherals.
* Trace AV signal flow and isolate faults across compute devices, conferencing applications, audio/video equipment, network connectivity and peripheral interfaces.
* Conduct room readiness checks before scheduled meetings and ensure that critical collaboration spaces remain operational.

**2. Technical Troubleshooting and Incident Resolution**

* Apply a structured troubleshooting methodology to identify the root cause of AV and collaboration incidents.
* Differentiate between hardware, software, configuration, connectivity and network-related issues before implementing corrective action.
* Perform basic network diagnostics relevant to AV endpoints, including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS reachability, VLAN awareness and switch port identification.
* Resolve incidents independently within the scope of L2 support and escalate complex programming, infrastructure or hardware issues with detailed diagnostic findings.
* Document symptoms, troubleshooting steps, root causes, workarounds and resolutions to support knowledge sharing and prevent recurrence.
* Identify recurring faults and recommend preventive measures to improve system reliability and reduce downtime.

**3. Executive Meetings and Live Event Support**

* Provide planned technical support for executive meetings, boardroom sessions, town halls, webinars and hybrid events.
* Conduct pre-event testing, technical rehearsals and dry runs to validate audio, video, presentation sharing and conferencing functionality.
* Monitor live sessions, respond promptly to technical issues and minimise disruption to business-critical meetings.
* Coordinate with meeting organisers, presenters, event teams and relevant technical stakeholders to confirm requirements and ensure operational readiness.
* Maintain composure and communicate clearly when resolving issues under time pressure, particularly during senior leadership meetings and live events.
* Support event-specific requirements such as microphone management, camera positioning, audio mixing and digital signage, where applicable.

**4. Communication and Stakeholder Management**

* Communicate professionally with business users, meeting organisers, senior stakeholders and external service providers.
* Ask relevant diagnostic questions, understand the impact of incidents and explain technical issues in clear, non-technical language.
* Provide timely updates on incident status, expected resolution, workarounds and escalation requirements.
* Manage user expectations appropriately while maintaining a calm, service-oriented approach during high-pressure situations.
* Provide simple operating instructions and guidance to users on meeting-room equipment and collaboration platforms.
* Coordinate effectively with internal IT teams, network teams, AV integrators, OEMs and specialist vendors to resolve incidents.

**5. Service Management and Operational Governance**

* Log, categorise, prioritise, track and close incidents and service requests using an IT service management or ticketing platform.
* Take ownership of assigned incidents and service requests, ensuring timely follow-ups and compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain accurate records of room configurations, equipment inventories, spare devices, maintenance activities and vendor service actions.
* Perform preventive maintenance and coordinate approved firmware updates, system checks and routine equipment servicing.
* Support room upgrades and new deployments through site surveys, equipment testing, punch-list closure, acceptance checks and handover documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors for warranty claims, equipment replacement, repairs and specialist technical support.

**Essential Skills and Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in enterprise AV support, video conferencing operations, meeting-room technology or AV systems integration.
* Practical experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms or Zoom Rooms in a live business environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across audio, video, display, camera, microphone, touch panel, USB/HDMI and conferencing systems.
* Ability to understand AV signal flow and systematically isolate faults across hardware, software, peripherals and network connectivity.
* Hands-on experience with at least two enterprise AV ecosystems or equipment platforms, such as Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Neat, DTEN, Shure, Biamp or QSC.
* Working knowledge of networking concepts relevant to AV systems, including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs and switch ports.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems, incident management, SLA-based support and technical documentation.
* Strong spoken and written English, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly and communicate professionally with senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise incidents based on urgency and business impact.
* Ability to work independently onsite while collaborating effectively with remote IT teams, event organisers and external vendors.
* Willingness to work from the Powai, Mumbai, office and provide planned early-morning or late-evening event coverage when scheduled.

**Desirable Experience and Certifications**

* Dante Level 1 or Level 2, AVIXA CTS, or relevant manufacturer training from Microsoft, Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Shure, Biamp or QSC.
* Experience with Teams Rooms Pro Management, Crestron XiO Cloud, Logitech Sync or comparable device monitoring and management platforms.
* Experience supporting town halls, webinars and live events involving audio mixing, camera tracking, digital signage or hybrid event technology.
* Basic CCNA-level networking knowledge or experience supporting enterprise environments such as banking, financial services or other business-critical workplaces.
* Experience assisting with AV room deployments, upgrades, commissioning, acceptance testing and technical handovers.

**Measures of Success**

* Meeting rooms and collaboration spaces are checked and ready before scheduled business use.
* Priority incidents are diagnosed and restored within agreed service targets, with minimal disruption to meetings.
* Executive meetings, town halls and hybrid events are supported through documented checks, rehearsals and appropriate technical monitoring.
* Incidents, recurring faults, asset movements and vendor actions are accurately documented and tracked to closure.
* Repeat incidents are reduced through preventive maintenance, structured troubleshooting and root-cause follow-up.
* Users receive clear, timely and professional communication throughout the incident lifecycle.
* AV systems remain reliable, well maintained and aligned with operational requirements.

**Growth Opportunity**

The role offers exposure to enterprise collaboration platforms, AV systems management, structured IT service operations, executive events and meeting-room modernisation projects.

High-performing engineers may progress towards senior AV and Unified Communications engineering, AV systems integration or site lead responsibilities.

**Application Information**

Interested candidates should submit their CV along with the following details:

* Current location
* Total years of AV and video conferencing experience
* Hands-on Microsoft Teams Rooms and/or Zoom Rooms experience
* Experience with enterprise AV equipment and collaboration platforms
* Current notice period and earliest joining date
* Two examples of meeting-room or live-event issues personally diagnosed and resolved, including the troubleshooting approach and outcome

Vallaham will coordinate the recruitment process on behalf of Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd.
