**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Support Engineer**

**Position**

Customer Success & Support Engineer

**Business Unit**

EdgeSense (IIoT Monitoring Platform)

**Department**

Customer Success / AMC

**Reports To**

Business Head / Project Manager

**No. of Positions**

1

**Experience**

2–5 years, IoT / automation support

**ABOUT EDGESENSE**

EdgeSense is the Industrial IoT monitoring platform of Rhosigma Engineering and Automations Pvt Ltd. We help utilities and manufacturers monitor energy, power quality, machine health and environmental parameters by connecting field sensors and meters through gateways to the EdgeSense cloud platform, with live dashboards, alerts and reports. We are building a lean, capable team that owns the complete customer journey: Lead → Solution Design → Proposal → POC → Order → Implementation → Customer Success → AMC / Upsell.

**JOB PURPOSE**

To ensure EdgeSense systems remain healthy, usable and valuable after commissioning, while creating AMC, renewal and upselling opportunities.

**This role is central to our strategy: EdgeSense should generate recurring revenue, not just one-time project revenue.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIESSystem Health Monitoring**

Monitor:

* Device connectivity
* Gateway status
* Data availability
* Missing data
* Sensor status
* Communication failures
* Dashboard issues

**Customer Support**

* Receive customer issues.
* Classify severity.
* Troubleshoot remotely.
* Coordinate field engineers when required.
* Track every issue until closure.

**Customer Engagement**

Communicate regularly with customers about:

* System health
* Usage
* Alerts
* Reports
* Improvements
* New features

**Monthly / Quarterly Reviews**

Prepare customer reports showing:

* Monitoring uptime
* Data availability
* Alerts generated
* Important events
* Energy / operational trends
* Issues identified
* Recommendations

**AMC Management**

Manage:

* AMC renewals
* Preventive maintenance
* Support contracts
* SLA compliance

**Upselling**

Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts, for example:

**Energy Monitoring → Power Quality → Machine Monitoring → Environmental Monitoring → Water / Gas / Steam Monitoring → Advanced Analytics**

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Performance in this role will be measured on:

■ System uptime

■ Data availability %

■ Support response time

■ Resolution time

■ Open ticket ageing

■ AMC renewal %

■ AMC revenue

■ Upsell revenue

■ Customer retention

■ Customer satisfaction

**IDEAL CANDIDATEEducation**

Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, E&TC or Computer Engineering.

**Experience**

2–5 years of experience in:

* Technical support for IoT, SCADA or automation systems
* Remote diagnostics of devices and networks
* Customer-facing service or AMC management

**Skills & Attributes**

* Comfortable reading dashboards, data trends and device logs.
* Understands gateways, Modbus and basic networking.
* Clear written and spoken communication; good report-making in Excel / PowerPoint.
* Customer-first attitude with an eye for upsell opportunities.
* Organised ticket tracking and follow-up until closure.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

title: Technical Support Engineer 3D Rendering Software
description:
Job Description: IT Support Engineer – Design Software & IT Infrastructure

**Company:** Studio 5 Design  
**Location:** Matunga, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Department:** IT  
**Job Type:** Full-time, On-site

About Studio 5 Design

Studio 5 Design is an interior design firm looking for a technically skilled and solution-oriented IT Support Engineer to manage day-to-day IT operations, troubleshoot interior design software, and maintain the company's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience supporting design professionals and resolving hardware, software, networking, and system-related issues.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced IT Support Engineer who can independently troubleshoot interior design and 3D visualization software while managing the organization's IT infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of workstations, design applications, networks, servers, and other IT systems used by our design team.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Interior Design Software Support**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit, V-Ray, Lumion, and Enscape.
* Diagnose and resolve software crashes, installation errors, rendering issues, plugin conflicts, and performance problems.
* Troubleshoot software compatibility issues, licensing errors, and activation problems through authorized vendor support.
* Assist designers in resolving technical issues that affect their daily workflow.
* Coordinate with software vendors and service providers to resolve complex technical problems.

**2. IT Infrastructure Management**

* Maintain and troubleshoot desktop computers, workstations, laptops, printers, scanners, and other office IT equipment.
* Manage LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, IP configurations, and network connectivity.
* Maintain shared folders, file servers, user accounts, access permissions, and data backup systems.
* Monitor system performance and ensure that computers meet the requirements of design and rendering applications.
* Troubleshoot hardware issues involving RAM, SSDs, processors, graphics cards, and other workstation components.
* Manage Windows operating systems, software updates, antivirus, and endpoint security.

**3. Technical Support & Maintenance**

* Provide timely technical support to employees and resolve hardware, software, and network issues.
* Diagnose recurring issues and implement long-term solutions to minimize downtime.
* Maintain IT asset inventories, software records, warranty details, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Perform routine system maintenance, preventive checks, and data backup verification.
* Ensure the secure handling of company data and maintain appropriate access controls.

**4. IT Operations & Coordination**

* Coordinate with management, design teams, vendors, and external IT service providers.
* Maintain records of reported issues, resolutions, and pending technical requests.
* Recommend hardware upgrades and IT improvements to enhance performance and productivity.
* Ensure all IT systems operate reliably and support the company's day-to-day design activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in IT support, infrastructure management, and technical troubleshooting.
* Practical knowledge of interior design, CAD, BIM, and 3D rendering applications.
* Strong understanding of computer hardware, Windows operating systems, networking, and IT infrastructure.
* Experience with workstation performance optimization and graphics-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of user access management, data backups, antivirus, and basic IT security.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to independently diagnose issues and provide timely solutions.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working in an interior design firm, architecture studio, engineering consultancy, or 3D visualization company.
* Familiarity with high-performance design workstations and rendering requirements.
* Experience managing shared storage, NAS or file servers, and network-based workflows.
* Knowledge of software deployment, license management, and IT asset management.

Key Performance Expectations

* Minimize downtime caused by software, hardware, and network issues.
* Resolve technical issues efficiently and maintain proper records.
* Ensure reliable access to design applications, shared files, and IT resources.
* Maintain workstation performance, system security, and data backup practices.
* Provide responsive technical support to the design team.

Work Location

**Studio 5 Design, Matunga, Mumbai, Maharashtra.**

**Work Mode:** Full-time, on-site.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume, highlighting their experience in IT infrastructure management and troubleshooting interior design software.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description: Network Automation & Orchestration: Develop low-level automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, and Puppet to configure routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto), and enforce policy-driven changes across hybrid environments. 2) Core Network Engineering: Hands-on expertise in Layer 2/3 protocols (MPLS, BGP, OSPF, VRRP, STP, VLANs) and physical/logical infrastructure design for large-scale, multi-region enterprise networks. 3) Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement version-controlled, repeatable network provisioning using Terraform modules, YAML-based configs, and Git workflows to manage complete network lifecycles. 4) Cloud Network Provisioning: Automate and manage cloud-native networking (VPCs, subnets, route tables, VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, firewalls, NACLs, Security Groups) in AWS, Azure, and GCP. 5) CI/CD for Network Ops: Integrate network changes into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for test-driven deployments with linting, validation, rollback, and minimal operational downtime. 6) Internet & Perimeter Security: Configure and manage internet-edge security layers (firewall policies, DDoS protection, IPS/IDS, web proxies) and ensure secure ingress/egress traffic flows. 7) Monitoring, Telemetry & Auto-Remediation: Deploy NMS/telemetry tools (SolarWinds, Prometheus, InfluxDB) and write custom scripts for real-time alerting, anomaly detection, and event-driven remediation. 8) Troubleshooting & Packet Analysis: Perform low-level debugging using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump), flow telemetry, syslog, and routing table state analysis to resolve incidents in multi-vendor networks. 9) Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation: Collaborate with CloudOps, DevOps, Security, and platform teams to align network architecture with application needs. description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.

  

Identify and Prioritise Risk

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.  

Coordinate Remediation

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.  

Improve Security Practices

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.  

Report and Govern

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

  

Essential

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.  

Desirable

* Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate.
* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

FIELD OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – FIELD OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE (CIVIL SURVEY & DGPS OPERATIONS)**

**Company:** BetterDrones (Knifedge Lab Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)  
**Location:** Noida, Sector 62, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirement:** Extensive travel across India, including remote and difficult terrain

**About BetterDrones**

BetterDrones is a drone intelligence and geospatial technology company specializing in drone inspections, GIS, LiDAR, mapping, surveying, and AI-powered infrastructure inspection solutions.

We work with power utilities, renewable energy companies, EPC contractors, railways, and government organizations to inspect, map, and manage critical infrastructure using advanced drone and geospatial technologies.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on **Field Operations Executive with a Civil Engineering or Surveying background** to manage and execute field survey and infrastructure inspection projects across India.

The role involves managing Surveyor and DGPS (Differential Global Positioning System) teams, coordinating field activities, monitoring survey quality, handling client communication, and ensuring timely project execution.

**This is a demanding, field-intensive position — not a desk-based operations or coordination job.** Project locations may include difficult terrain, uneven ground, remote areas, long walking routes, and sites with limited accessibility. Candidates must be prepared to work in challenging field conditions and stay at project locations for extended periods.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked as Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, or Civil Site Engineers and are ready to take ownership of teams, clients, and end-to-end field execution.

Key Responsibilities1. Field Survey & Project Execution

* Plan, coordinate, and execute field surveying, DGPS, mapping, and infrastructure inspection projects.
* Understand project requirements, survey methodology, site conditions, manpower needs, and equipment requirements before deployment.
* Monitor field progress and ensure survey activities are completed as per project specifications and timelines.
* Visit project sites and actively supervise field execution whenever required.
* Ensure teams are prepared to work in challenging terrain, remote locations, and physically demanding field conditions.

2. Surveyor & DGPS Team Management

* Lead and manage Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, field engineers, and other deployed personnel.
* Allocate work, plan daily routes, monitor productivity, and ensure adequate field coverage.
* Verify that teams understand survey instructions, coordinates, benchmarks, data collection requirements, and project deliverables.
* Resolve field-level challenges related to manpower, equipment, access, productivity, and survey execution.
* Maintain team discipline, accountability, attendance, and adherence to company policies.

3. Client Coordination & Site Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during field execution.
* Coordinate site access, survey requirements, permissions, daily progress, and project schedules.
* Communicate technical and operational issues clearly and professionally.
* Handle client queries, field-level escalations, and execution-related concerns.
* Provide regular progress updates and ensure client expectations are aligned with actual site conditions and project timelines.

4. Survey Quality & Technical Coordination

* Review survey records, field measurements, DGPS observations, coordinates, and daily field reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, survey procedures, and required accuracy standards.
* Coordinate with GIS, data processing, and project teams for data transfer, validation, and final deliverables.
* Identify gaps, errors, and incomplete field data and arrange corrective action.
* Maintain proper documentation and ensure data completeness before project closure.

5. Planning, Logistics & Equipment Management

* Plan manpower deployment, travel, accommodation, local transportation, and field logistics.
* Coordinate the movement and availability of DGPS equipment, GNSS receivers, survey instruments, drones, batteries, and accessories as applicable.
* Ensure equipment is maintained, handled, and used correctly.
* Anticipate operational risks and arrange resources to minimize downtime and project delays.

6. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

* Prepare daily progress reports, project trackers, manpower reports, and field status updates.
* Monitor project timelines, team productivity, survey coverage, data quality, and pending activities.
* Escalate resource shortages, technical issues, and schedule risks promptly.
* Coordinate with management and internal departments to ensure timely project completion.

Required Experience & QualificationsEssential Requirements

* 3–6 years of experience in civil surveying, DGPS/GNSS surveying, land surveying, infrastructure projects, or field operations.
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Surveying, Geomatics, or a related technical discipline.
* Practical understanding of field survey execution, survey instruments, site measurements, and survey documentation.
* Experience managing or coordinating field teams, preferably Surveyor and DGPS teams.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage client interactions professionally.
* Ability to plan field activities, resolve on-site problems, and manage project deadlines.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, reporting, and project documentation.
* Willingness and physical readiness to work in demanding field conditions and travel extensively across India.

Preferred Experience

* Power transmission line and distribution network surveys.
* Transmission line route surveys and corridor mapping.
* DGPS, GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or similar surveying workflows.
* Railway, highway, solar, industrial, and other infrastructure surveys.
* LiDAR surveys, drone mapping, and geospatial data collection.
* Experience coordinating with government departments, power utilities, EPC contractors, and infrastructure clients.
* Hands-on experience as a Surveyor or Survey Engineer with subsequent team-management responsibilities.

Field Conditions — Please Read Before Applying

Candidates must understand the practical demands of this role:

* Projects may be located in remote, hilly, uneven, forested, rural, or otherwise difficult-to-access areas, depending on the assignment.
* Fieldwork may involve extensive walking, long outdoor working hours, changing weather, and physically demanding site conditions.
* Some projects require extended stays away from Noida, with travel schedules determined by operational requirements.
* The role requires active supervision of Surveyor and DGPS teams, not merely assigning tasks from the office.
* Candidates must be comfortable handling field personnel, resolving site-level issues, and communicating with clients under pressure.
* Work conditions vary by project, and candidates should be prepared for both relatively accessible sites and challenging terrain.

**Please apply only if you are genuinely comfortable with the field requirements and nationwide travel.**

Why Join BetterDrones?

* Work on large-scale power and infrastructure surveying and inspection projects.
* Gain exposure to DGPS, GIS, LiDAR, drone mapping, and advanced geospatial technologies.
* Work with experienced professionals and enterprise infrastructure clients.
* Develop leadership experience in field operations and project execution.
* Build a career in the growing drone and geospatial technology industry.

Who Should Apply?

Civil Engineers, Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, and field professionals who combine **practical surveying knowledge, team-management ability, strong client communication, and a willingness to work in challenging field conditions**.

Candidates with only office-based coordination experience and no relevant field or surveying exposure may not be suitable for this position.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have in Civil Surveying, DGPS/GNSS Surveying, Land Surveying, or Infrastructure Field Operations? Briefly describe your experience.
* Which surveying instruments have you personally operated or used in field projects? Mention your practical experience with DGPS/GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or other survey equipment.
* Describe your experience managing Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, or field survey teams. How many people have you managed, and what were your responsibilities?
* This role involves extensive walking, uneven terrain, remote locations, long outdoor working hours, and physically demanding field conditions. Are you comfortable performing these duties as required? Please explain any relevant field experience.
* Are you willing to travel extensively across India and stay at remote project locations for extended periods according to project requirements? Please confirm clearly.
* Describe a situation where you directly coordinated with a client or site representative during a survey or infrastructure project. What issue arose, and how did you resolve it?
* Our budget for this position is ₹3 LPA to ₹4.2 LPA, depending on experience and suitability. Are you comfortable with this salary range? Please mention your current CTC and expected CTC.
* We are looking for immediate joiners. If selected, how soon can you join? Please mention your current notice period and the earliest confirmed joining date.

title: Engineer II / Senior Civil and Pipeline Engineer
description:

------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Civil & Pipeline Engineer to join our Water Infrastructure team and lead the delivery of major pipeline and utility projects across water and wastewater networks. This role is ideal for a technical leader with extensive experience in the planning, design, and delivery of large-diameter transmission pipelines, trunk mains, rising mains, utility diversions, and associated civil infrastructure. The successful candidate will play a key role in developing resilient water networks, improving asset performance, and delivering sustainable engineering solutions for utility clients. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will be responsible for driving technically challenging projects from feasibility and concept development through detailed design, procurement support, and construction.

**Your Role**
-------------

  

* Lead the design and delivery of strategic water transmission pipelines, trunk mains, rising mains, gravity sewers, and utility infrastructure projects.

* Design and review large-diameter buried pipelines, valve chambers, flow control structures, utility crossings, and associated civil infrastructure.
* Lead design activities required for utility surveys, clash assessments, diversion designs, easement requirements.
* Support or lead hydraulic modelling of water, wastewater, and stormwater networks using tools such as WaterGEMS, SewerGEMS, or similar software.
* Support network planning, capacity assessments, flood risk studies, resilience improvements, and infrastructure investment decisions.

* Provide technical governance through design reviews, risk assessments, quality assurance, and value engineering initiatives.
* Support project delivery during procurement and construction by resolving technical issues and providing engineering guidance.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and client relationship management.
* Mentor engineers and support the development of pipeline and utility design capability across the business.

**About You**
-------------

*Qualifications & Skills*

* Mandatory bachelor's degree in civil engineering.
* Work experience of 8 years or more
* Significant experience in water and wastewater pipeline engineering and utility infrastructure design.

*Strong expertise in*

* Large-diameter water transmission mains
* Trunk sewers and rising mains
* Utility diversion and coordination projects
* Buried infrastructure and pipeline corridor design
* Utility protection and asset management requirements
* Pumping stations and associated network infrastructure
* Pipeline hydraulics and route optimization studies
* Design management and multidisciplinary coordination
* Construction support and buildability reviews

*You will also demonstrate*

* Experience delivering projects through feasibility, concept, detailed design, and construction support stages.
* Experience in hydraulic modelling for water, wastewater, or stormwater networks.
* Proficiency in GIS software and geospatial data analysis.
* Understanding of UK water industry standards and project delivery practices.
* Experience with trenchless technologies such as HDD, pipe jacking, or micro-tunnelling would be advantageous.
* Excellent stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage complex technical interfaces.
* Experience working on major water utility frameworks and infrastructure programmes.
* Chartered Engineer status, or a commitment to achieving chartership, would be advantageous.

**Rewards & Benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

title: Lead Verification & Validation Engineer
description:
Lead Verification & Validation Engineer will be responsible for the delivery of the of HVDC Controls & Protection Verification and Validation team’s activities on time / as per Project Scheduled through proper coordination between Project and department. The role involves technical leadership on the various work packages within the department ensuring that they meet the requirements, and the relevant processes are followed

**Job Description**
===================

Essential responsibilities:

o Prepare and maintain Validation & Verification team’s activity plans as per the Project scheduled.

o Design, create Factory System Test (FST) cases and review results against design requirements including leading Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) with clients.

o Developing HVDC System and plant modelling in electromagnetic transient tools like PSCAD, RSCAD, EMTP-RV etc including undertaking Dynamic Performance Studies and Protection co-ordination.

o Preparing control system requirements for the RTDS Lab setup including AC DC interface requirement, Plant Emulator Interface requirement and RSCAD Power system network conversion, modelling, and verification.

o Support New Product Introduction (NPI) to develop existing and new products and tools.

o Provide support to Commissioning Engineers during Dynamic commissioning at Site.

o Support continual improvement, raising the effectiveness and efficiency of the team through the introduction of tools, methods and process improvements and coordinating with the Continuous Improvement leaders.

o Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Uses prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.

o In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.

o Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.

o Maintain rigorous end-to-end requirement traceability, ensuring that every design change is verified against system architecture and validated via documented test evidence.

o Drive continuous improvement initiatives in the V&V lifecycle, implementing changes where necessary that increase test coverage and decrease the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).

o Serve as the primary technical point of contact for V&V engineers.

o Investigate complex technical anomalies by correlating event-logs, signal traces, and control states to identify and implement corrective actions under high-pressure delivery timelines.

o Provide technical guidance to junior V&V engineers, fostering a culture of "Quality First" and promoting best practices in test plan preparation and documentation.

o Orchestrate communication between cross-functional teams (Controls, Software, Hardware, and Commissioning) to resolve integration bottlenecks and maintain project velocity.

**Qualifications and requirements:**

* + Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business.
  + Significant experience in the position of Verification Engineer in High Voltage field, with experience as a Control & Protection design Engineer. Good knowledge of overall 400kV substation, HVDC system (LCC/VSC/SVC) including control and protection system is essential.
  + Experience of developing and working with PSCAD and RSCAD models is essential including knowledge of Overall HVDC System Operational Behaviour.
  + Experience in defining Test Strategy, Root-Cause Analysis (RCA), Cross-functional Stakeholder Management and Mentorship.
  + Experience in technical leadership with ability to manage team of validation engineers
  + Strong communication skills with a fluency in English language.
  + Willingness to travel to support projects globally and readiness for flexible with working hours
  + Knowledge of applicable electrical standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 62351, IEC 12207, IEEE 15288, IEC 25010, IEC 27032, NERC/CIP.

**Desired characteristics**

* + Process improvement or RCA experience or certification
  + Experience on MATCAD, PSS/E and MATLAB SIMULINK, EMTP-RV, Digsilent etc will added advantage.
  + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

title: Project Lead-App Development
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As Observability Engineer / SME, you will be the technical authority for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise monitoring and observability solutions across hybrid IT environments. Working hands-on with platforms such as HPE OpsRamp and SolarWinds (and similar ITOM/observability tools), you will deliver end-to-end monitoring — onboarding, discovery, service mapping, alert correlation, and ITSM-integrated event management — to improve reliability, reduce noise, and accelerate MTTD/MTTR for our clients. You will also mentor L1/L2 teams and serve as the central point of expertise for monitoring delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Design & Implementation**

* Design, deploy, configure, customize, and integrate observability solutions using HPE OpsRamp, SolarWinds, and similar platforms (Nagios, Zabbix, ManageEngine OpManager, etc.) across on-prem, cloud, and edge infrastructure.
* Analyze client infrastructure design, architecture, and security standards to define fit-for-purpose monitoring solutions.
* Develop and maintain architecture blueprints, design documents, SOPs, and operational runbooks for monitoring and event-management systems.
* Lead onboarding, discovery, service mapping, alert correlation, and runbook automation for green-field and brown-field engagements.

**Operations & Event Management**

* Own day-to-day operations of observability platforms — ensuring high availability, performance, capacity, data accuracy, and timely upgrades/patching.
* Manage event-management processes: event ingestion, correlation, noise reduction, deduplication, and routing to the appropriate resolver groups.
* Troubleshoot complex incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams; lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and turn telemetry into actionable reliability insights.
* Establish and continuously improve standards, thresholds, and SLA-based response models; maintain telemetry data hygiene (retention, indexing, access controls).
* Integrate monitoring tools with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, BMC, Ivanti) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) — including alert/ticketing workflows via MID server/connectors.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Monitoring & Observability (mandatory)**

* 6–8 years of hands-on experience in IT monitoring tool deployment, implementation, operational support, and report building.
* Strong hands-on expertise with HPE OpsRamp and SolarWinds and their modules; experience with similar tools (ManageEngine OpManager, Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG) is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of broader observability/APM platforms — Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk — and OpenTelemetry concepts.
* Proven experience in Managed Services / NOC delivery and ITSM-integrated event management.

**Infrastructure, Cloud & Automation**

* Strong understanding of servers, networks, virtualization, storage, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Hands-on integration experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow preferred, BMC, Ivanti) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Scripting for automation and integration — Python, Bash, or PowerShell; familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.

Sound understanding of ITIL processes — Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management

**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Microsoft 365 Specialist to manage, optimize, and support our global Microsoft 365 environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of core collaboration and productivity platforms, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and related services across a geographically distributed organization.
  
  
The M365 Specialist will serve as a technical subject matter expert, supporting end users across multiple regions, driving platform governance, and implementing best practices to enhance collaboration, security, and operational efficiency at a global scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Administration & Operations**

* Administer, configure, and maintain Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Manage user accounts, licenses, roles, and permissions through Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Admin Center
* Monitor service health, performance, and availability; troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests
* Perform tenant-level configuration, updates, and feature deployments

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, and data protection policies
* Support compliance initiatives (eDiscovery, retention policies, audit logs, DLP)
* Monitor and respond to security alerts and vulnerabilities within the M365 environment
* Ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory security standards

* Implement governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive usage
* Integrate M365 with enterprise systems and third-party applications
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, automation, and platform efficiency

* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Develop and maintain reporting dashboards for usage, health, and compliance

* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be joining the Digital Risk Consulting Team.

We’re looking for Senior Consultant with expertise in Cloud Security and Risk Assessment’ to lead the audit/review of security architecture and controls across hybrid cloud environments. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Evaluate key cloud security solutions such as Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Cloud encryption and key management services, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and security automation tools with respect to hybrid cloud security posture (AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises).

* Evaluate security hardening standards and secure cloud configuration best practices across all environments.
* Assess AWS, Azure, and GCP environments against industry standards, regulatory requirements, and cloud security best practices.
* Review and design cloud security architectures, landing zones, network segmentation, identity and access management, privileged access management, encryption, and key management controls.
* Conduct cloud security strategy, maturity, governance, and target-state assessments to support cloud adoption and transformation initiatives.
* Perform technical security configuration reviews across cloud infrastructure, platforms, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, and cloud-native security controls.
* Assess cloud security posture using CSPM and CNAPP solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Prisma Cloud, or equivalent tools.
* Conduct cloud security audits, risk and compliance reviews, maturity assessments, and third-party or vendor security assessments.
* Develop actionable security improvement recommendations and prioritised roadmap strategies based on identified cloud risks, control gaps, and target-state objectives
* Evaluate DevSecOps implementation to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
* Evaluate the current practice followed of cloud security monitoring and incident management
* Conducting risk assessments and vulnerability analyses in cloud environments and propose mitigation strategies

**About the Role**

Position Title : KYC QA Analyst

Corporate Title: Senior Analyst

Reporting to : Assistant Vice President

Location : Bengaluru

  

**Job Profile**

**Roles and Responsibilities**

· Review and adherence of KYC Policy, Operating Manual, QA Workbooks, and any other Process documentation.

· Discuss with the KYC MO and identify a representative sample of customers for review.

· Review the sampled customers for the characteristics outlined in the KYC QA workbook.

· KYC QA workbook needs to be completed for KYC review.

· QA reviewer needs to opine on the Accuracy, Completeness, and Timeliness aspect of each review criteria for the sampled customers.

· Any variances observed should be documented and shared with the KYC MO.

· A summary of the variances along with recommendations should be shared with the KYC MO.

· QA reviewer to discuss the variances with the process owner.

· Any variances remediated by the Bank should be revalidated by the QA reviewer and closed if it is addressed satisfactorily. Variances that require significant time to remediate will be included in the next quarterly review.

· Summarize the QA results and work with the Bank to develop a plan to address the Exceptions/Errors/Recommendations

· Assign each of the variances into different themes by customer type.

· For each of the QA themes document the recommendations to address the variances

· Classify the impact of each recommendation as “Improving the quality” or “Improving the efficiency”.

· Compare the current quarter results with the previous quarter to assess the impact of the recommendations

· Prepare and deliver QA Toolkit workbooks.

Work experience:

· Experience designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining KYC programs

· Experience in performing QA reviews on KYC profiles.

· Experience working with technical, customer, and functional teams

title: Business Acceptance Analyst
description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

#### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Bangalore (On-site)  
**Contract type:** Permanent
  
**Target start date:** January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time (40h/week), aligned with the GMT timezone (**starting** at **1:00 PM IST**)  
**Compensation:** INR 10,00,000 – 22,00,000 per year

#### **What You'll Architect**

As a **Business Acceptance Analyst / Digital Solution Validation**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making.

This role is both analytical and consultative, ideal for someone who can bridge business requirements and delivered digital solutions while ensuring production readiness. We are looking for professionals who can connect business needs with technology delivery, ensuring that solutions meet expectations before moving into production. Professionals who think like architects and act like builders.

You will support a global team responsible for the **processes, tools, and data governance associated with customer installed-base management**, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and digital delivery teams.

##### **Responsibilities**

* Review business and functional requirements to understand expected outcomes and acceptance conditions.
* Translate requirements and specifications into **structured validation scenarios and acceptance criteria**.
* Validate delivered functionality against agreed business requirements and solution specifications.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and deviations between requirements and delivered solutions.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and digital delivery teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain traceability between **requirements, acceptance criteria, validation outcomes, and production readiness**.
* Support business acceptance and pre-production validation activities.
* Provide clear evidence-based reporting of validation results and outstanding issues.
* Challenge unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria before solutions progress toward production.
* Apply **AI-enabled techniques** to improve validation efficiency, requirements analysis, documentation quality, scenario generation, and solution analysis.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI-assisted tools.
* Collaborate effectively with international colleagues while maintaining a strong on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges.
* You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action.
* You balance technical thinking with business understanding.
* You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments.
* You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.
* You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* You have strong attention to detail and enjoy validating whether solutions truly meet business expectations.
* You embrace innovation and are interested in leveraging AI to improve quality and efficiency.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in **business acceptance, solution validation, functional testing, QA analysis, UAT, or a similar role** within digital or technology delivery environments.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and software delivery teams.
* Experience operating within agile or iterative delivery environments.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Availability to work on-site in Bangalore.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Strong understanding of business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to transform functional requirements into effective validation scenarios and acceptance approaches.
* Experience validating delivered functionality against agreed business requirements.
* Proven ability to identify discrepancies between specifications and delivered solutions.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills.
* Experience with requirements traceability and acceptance management processes.
* Experience supporting production-readiness assessments and go-live decisions.
* AI-aware mindset with the ability to apply AI-assisted techniques to validation and analysis activities.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience validating **data-driven applications, platforms, or digital products**.
* Knowledge of **data quality, data governance, or master data management** concepts.
* Familiarity with validation management, defect tracking, or requirements management tools.
* Familiarity with CRM, enterprise applications, or Salesforce ecosystems and the business processes they support.
* Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot or other Generative AI tools to support business analysis, validation, documentation, or testing activities.
* Exposure to industrial, manufacturing, energy or service environments
* Experience in consulting or client-facing projects.
* Exposure to large-scale international transformation or digitalisation programmes.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Testing, Quality Assurance, Agile, Scrum, or related disciplines.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism.
* You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions.
* You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* You combine autonomy with collaboration.
* You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus India**

* **Hybrid work** model (3 days/week in office)
* **18 paid leaves** + 9 public holidays
* **₹5L** medical insurance + **₹10L** accident insurance
* Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
* International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
* Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Referral Bonus Scheme
* Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

️ **Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.**

#### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic..

title: Quality Assurance Test Engineer
description:
QA / Test Engineer for Wualt and Nexus

Wualt is a personal-safety platform: a smart ring and app, a live response centre, and a real-time emergency flow. Nexus is our enterprise platform for apparel manufacturing operations. This role owns quality across both.

About the role

We are hiring a hands-on QA / Test Engineer to own quality across both products. You will do both manual and automated testing, from writing and running test plans by hand to building the automation and CI checks that catch regressions before they reach users. Because Wualt is a safety product, correctness and reliability are not negotiable.

What you will own

Test strategy and coverage across both products: mobile apps, web consoles, back-end APIs, and real-time flows.

The real-time, safety-critical flows: live location and audio, and the alerts that ride on them.

Clear test plans and cases from product requirements, plus exploratory, functional and regression testing by hand.

Automated tests you build and maintain: API and end-to-end suites, mobile and web automation, wired into CI.

Device integration flows: Bluetooth ring pairing and on-device behaviour.

The bug lifecycle end to end: reproduce, isolate, report with evidence, prioritise, and verify the fix.

Release QA: build sign-off, regression cycles, and quality tracking across releases.

Data-privacy and security checks, including that personal data is handled in line with the DPDPA.

What we are looking for

Solid QA experience across manual and automated testing of real, shipped software.

Mobile app testing, ideally React Native, and web application testing.

API testing (Postman or a REST client) and an understanding of how the back end fits together.

Hands-on with at least one automation stack (Appium or Detox for mobile; Playwright, Cypress or Selenium for web; pytest or similar).

Comfort with CI/CD such as GitHub Actions, and bug tracking tools such as Jira or Linear.

Strong attention to detail and the discipline to test methodically and document clearly.

Nice to have

Testing real-time or streaming systems; performance or load testing (JMeter or k6).

Security or privacy testing, and familiarity with the DPDPA.

Testing IoT, BLE or wearable-connected products, or enterprise or ERP systems.

Scripting in Python or JavaScript beyond test frameworks.

How we work

Full-time, based in Chennai, on-site, with some inter-site travel between the Wualt and CF sites.

How to apply

Apply through this LinkedIn posting and email your resume to sunil@armortrixtech.com. A short note on a tricky bug you caught, how you found it, and how you would have automated the catch is welcome.

* Define and implement overall testing strategies including functional, regression, performance, security, and automation testing.

Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.This is a high-visibility role where we establish the production-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent-a-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations AI-Specific & Non-Deterministic Testing Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable Performance, Reliability & NFR Verification Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs Process, Evidence & Collaboration Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy Requirements 8+ years of test automation title: Test Validation Engineer
description:
**Hiring Validation Test Engineer**

**Job Title:**
Validation Test Engineer

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Kokapet, Hyderabad (Work from Office only)

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a
**detail-oriented Validation Test Engineer**
with hands-on experience in end-to-end product testing and Computer System Validation (CSV).
**The candidate will be responsible for testing product modules, validating functionality against requirements, identifying and reporting defects, coordinating with Development teams for resolution, and performing retesting and regression testing**
. The role also involves preparing and executing validation documentation to ensure compliance with applicable GxP regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Perform end-to-end product testing across individual modules, features, workflows, and integrated functionalities.
* Understand product requirements and design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test data covering positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Verify application functionality, data integrity, workflow transitions, user roles and permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and other relevant system features.
* Identify, document, and report defects with clear steps to reproduce, expected versus actual results, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
* Log, prioritize, assign, and track defects in Jira; follow up with Development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Perform defect retesting after fixes are deployed and conduct regression testing to ensure existing functionalities remain unaffected.
* Maintain test execution records, defect status, test evidence, and testing progress reports.
* Review URS and FRS documents to develop and execute OQ, PQ, and UAT test cases, ensuring appropriate requirement coverage and traceability.
* Author and maintain validation deliverables, including Validation Plan, URS, FRS, Functional Risk Assessment, 21 CFR Part 11 Assessment, Traceability Matrix, and Validation Summary Report.
* Ensure compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), GAMP 5 guidelines, GxP requirements, and applicable regulatory standards throughout the system lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, and Validation teams to investigate issues, clarify requirements, improve product quality, and support release readiness.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **3–7 years of relevant experience in software/product testing and/or Computer System Validation.**
* Hands-on experience in end-to-end application
  **testing, test case design, execution, defect reporting, retesting, and regression testing.**
* Practical experience using
  **Jira for defect logging, tracking, and closure.**
* Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, and validate complex workflows across multiple modules.
* Experience in
  **drafting and executing OQ/PQ protocols and validation test cases.**
* Good understanding of
  **the CSV lifecycle, risk-based validation, and requirement traceability.**
* Knowledge of
  **GAMP 5, GxP best practices, Good Documentation Practices, and 21 CFR Part 11.**
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or a related discipline is required.
