title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

**Installed base (all markets)**

* Execute the corrections arising from the installed base accuracy programme coordinated by the Data Coordinator; maintain the underlying data for the country accuracy score

**Support and enablement**

* Handle hands-on support requests from non-designated markets — price-file validation, IB corrections, de-duplication — logged and reported, with the Steering Committee managing the balance against verification work
* Maintain the single current repository of data SOPs using existing global platforms (GetBasic, GetLibrary, GetQMS, the Finance Manual) rather than local copies
* Produce one-page filter, currency and refresh-cycle guides for the global dashboards and support market training

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated)**

* Zone and region performance reporting for India, building on work already under way with the Service Director
* Account-history and customer summary requests for sales and service teams, once scoped by the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have:**

* 4–8 years in data operations, master data maintenance, finance operations, order management or service administration
* Hands-on SAP experience in at least two of: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and service-contract records — including creating and maintaining records, not only reporting on them
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); Power BI a strong advantage
* Meticulous attention to detail and the persistence to work through large record sets methodically
* The habit of asking why an error occurred — able to recognise when a data problem is really a process or ownership problem, and to say so
* Good written and spoken English; able to explain an exception clearly to a colleague in another country
* Comfortable working across cultures and time zones with people who do not report to you

**Good To Have**

* An analytics background or interest — the role has a Phase 2 pathway into reporting and analytics work
* Medical-device, pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience
* Exposure to service-contract or installed-base administration
* Experience with distributor or channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

NA

15 years full time education

As a Performance Engineer, a typical day involves investigating and resolving complex performance challenges that have not been addressed by the internal performance testing team. description:
**Company Description**
EZ Informatics Solutions Pvt Ltd is a technology-focused company that specializes in delivering high-quality software solutions and IT services to global clients. **Role Description**
The K6 Load Testing Engineer role is a full-time remote position focused on designing, implementing, and executing performance and load tests using K6. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating test plans and test cases, scripting and maintaining K6 test suites, and running test executions to validate system performance, scalability, and reliability. * Proficiency in K6 scripting (JavaScript), familiarity with HTTP APIs, microservices architectures, and common performance metrics (latency, throughput, error rates).
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, or similar) to interpret load test results and diagnose performance issues.
* Understanding of software development and deployment practices, including version control (Git) and continuous integration workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, effective written and verbal communication skills, and capacity to work independently in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; prior experience in performance testing or QA engineering is highly beneficial.

description:

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software QA Engineer to join our Engineering Intelligence team and help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of cloud-delivered engineering applications used by global manufacturers.

**Job Description**
**Who we are**
**About Bp/team**
bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.
  
  
Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.
  
  
Scope & Scale
  
  
**Platform focus**
Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.
  
  
**Testing coverage**
Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.
  
  
**Non-functional quality**
Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.
  
  
**Delivery lifecycle**
Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.
  
  
**Quality engineering**
Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis
  
  

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.
* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.
* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.
* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.
* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

Manual & Exploratory Testing
  
  

* Implement manual functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, exploratory and end-to-end testing across digital products and services.
* Validate user journeys, content workflows, business rules, integrations, permissions, data handling and error scenarios.
* Test responsive behaviour, usability, cross-browser compatibility and accessibility against agreed standards.
* Work with business users and Business Analysts to support UAT, capture evidence and confirm acceptance outcomes.
* Perform production verification and support early-life testing following releases.

Test Automation & Continuous Testing
  
  

* Design, build and maintain reliable automated tests for UI, API, integration, regression and end-to-end scenarios.

and system design documentation.
  
  

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently execute testing activities and coordinate with multiple

engineering disciplines.
  
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively based on business requirements and on short

notice.
  
  

* Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, airport baggage handling, material handling, or

distribution systems is an advantage.

customers’ doors.

matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

www.vanderlande.com

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

description:

* Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues.
* Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

* Strong experience in developing and reviewing test strategies, test plans, test cases, integration plans, system designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Proven ability to lead testing activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in leading defect investigations and technical issue resolution.
* Strong ownership, leadership, and mentoring capabilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support customer projects based on business requirements.

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to
  
  
customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

**The Opportunity**
The Sr.QA Engineer role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each Sr. QA Engineer will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
  
  
We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a proven track record of developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have extensive experience successfully implementing test automation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Develop an automation-first testing strategy for functional, performance, and regression testing.
* Architect and develop reusable and scalable multi-layer automation frameworks for UI, API, and database automated test scripts that cover the functional areas of our application suite.
* Guide other test automators embedded in cross-functional development teams, to create scripts and provide faster, scalable, and more comprehensive test coverage.
* Organize and direct team meetings to ensure automation efforts are on track.
* Always be the advocate for automation and quality best practices.
* Review requirements stated in product backlog and assign to each sprint as needed.
* Partner with product, engineering, and IT personnel to align long term solution roadmap with quality assurance efforts.
* Analyze root cause of failing test automation test scripts and fix.
* Lead the collaboration with software developers as needed to identify root cause of product defects and resolve problems.
* Align strategies with organizational goals and report progress to the product owner.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* You must always be curious about the business and customers you support. The more you know and understand your customers and how they work on a daily basis, the better equipped you will be to deliver high quality technology solutions.
* Motivated to deliver the best possible software solutions in a fast-paced collaborative environment.
* Ability to quickly identify and communicate risks.
* Proactively learn and experiment with new technologies and cloud development strategies, staying ahead of the curve.
* Ability to self-manage multiple priorities and understand when to ‘switch gears’ to unblock others.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
* Diplomatic with strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* Self-motivator with a strong work ethic, able to perform job duties without significant supervision.
* Comfortable with leveraging approved AI toolsets to help you be more efficient and productive.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 7 to 9 years of overall test automation experience, at least 3 years using Playwright and Typescript (or Javascript).
* Development experience with C#, Java, or any other Object Oriented Programming language.
* Experience with keyword and data driven test automation.
* Experience implementing APIs (OData, REST, SOAP) and database automated tests.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins / TeamCity, LambdaTest, etc.
* Experience with development tools, such as Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Junit, and Eclipse.
* Working knowledge of code coverage tools, defect-tracking systems, test case management systems, and performance tools.
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN.

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM
* Experience with Agile Scrum and ATDD methodologies.
* Experience automating mobile platforms, a plus.
* Experience in writing SQL queries and database automation.
* Experience in scripting languages, such as Python or Ruby, are a plus.

**What We Look For**
We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you.
  
  
**What Working At ACA Offers**
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  
  
  
  
**Plus, we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Why join our team?**
We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
  
  
Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**More About ACA**
ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
  
  
Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.

title: Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer
description:
**# Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer**

* Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
* Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office (WFO)(890)
* Experience:\*\* 8–11 Years
* Salary Budget:\*\* ₹8,00,000–₹18,00,000 per annum (₹8–18 LPA)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 45 Days
* Preferred Candidates:\*\* Local candidates based in Pune

**## Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Agent Evaluation & Operations Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
  
  
This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality.
  
  
**## Key Responsibilities**
### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration
  
  

* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies.
* Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic.
* Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable.
* Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations.

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations.
* Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation.
* Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles.
* Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs.

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing
  
  

* Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications.
* Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
* Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
* Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

### 4. Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.
* Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
* Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions.

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations
  
  

* Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows.
* Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management.
* Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses.
* Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations.

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control
  
  

* Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab.
* Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks.
* Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues.

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability
  
  

* Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms.
* Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements.
* Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security
  
  

* Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads.
* Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep.
* Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls.

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate technical issues, evaluation outcomes, incident updates, and resolutions clearly.
* Participate in technical discussions and troubleshooting sessions.
* Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams.

**## Mandatory Skills / Must-Haves**
**The Following Skills Are Explicitly Mandatory For This Position**

* Python
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* OpenAI
* Azure Databricks

Candidates must also demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities appropriate for a client-facing engineering role.
  
  
##
**Nice-to-Have Skills**
### Programming & APIs
  
  

* FastAPI
* REST APIs
* Pydantic
* pytest

### Agent Orchestration
  
  

* OpenAI Agents SDK
* Google ADK
* Pydantic-AI

### Agent Observability
  
  

* OpenTelemetry
* OpenInference
* Langfuse
* LangSmith

### LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle
  
  

* MLflow Evaluation
* DeepEval
* Ragas
* promptfoo
* Custom pytest evaluations

### Azure AI Stack
  
  

* Azure OpenAI
* Microsoft Foundry
* Azure Monitor
* Application Insights

### Databricks
  
  

* Unity Catalog
* Databricks Workflows/Jobs
* SQL Warehouses

### CI/CD & Version Control
  
  

* Git
* GitLab
* Automated testing pipelines

### Production Monitoring
  
  

* Grafana
* Prometheus
* Azure Monitor
* Kibana
* Alerting platforms

### Cloud & Containers
  
  

* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Terraform
* Bicep

### Security & Identity
  
  

* Microsoft Entra ID
* Managed identities
* OAuth2
* Key Vault
* Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

## Candidate Screening Criteria
  
  

* \*\*Experience:\*\* 8–11 years.
* \*\*Employment stability:\*\* Minimum 2 years in an organization.
* \*\*Notice period:\*\* Immediate to 45 days.
* \*\*Communication:\*\* Excellent verbal and written communication is mandatory; no compromise.
* \*\*Location:\*\* Local Pune candidates are preferred.
* \*\*Work arrangement:\*\* Work From Office is mandatory.
* \*\*Shift flexibility:\*\* Candidates must be comfortable with the specified weekday, weekend, public holiday, and rotational standby schedule.
* \*\*Compensation:\*\* ₹8–18 LPA salary budget.

## Shift Schedule
  
  
All timings below are in Singapore Time (SGT).

Candidates must be willing to participate in rotational shifts, weekend and public holiday coverage, and the 1:00 AM–9:00 AM standby rotation.
  
  
## Interview Process

description:

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) strives to provide the company with transparent, proactive insights into process and control effectiveness that are used for managing risk, policy adherence, and driving operational excellence. EIT tests processes and controls throughout the year on behalf of Frontline Units (FLUs), Control Functions (CFs), and Global Risk Management to enable them to manage their processes and controls more effectively. EIT also participates in regular reviews, examinations, and routines with regulators, as well as Corporate Audit.
  
  
**Job Description\***
**TEST DEVELOPMENT AND TEST AUTOMATION (TD) IC**
The Test Development and automation role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive test procedures to evaluate control effectiveness, and looking for test automation feasibility and execution.
  
  
The role requires collaboration with stakeholders to translate business, regulatory, and process requirements into structured, repeatable test scripts, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of testing outcomes, as well as checking for usable automated workflows . The role operates within a structured framework, ensuring all development activities are executed, tracked, and governed through a centralized system of record, including milestone tracking, documentation, and status reporting.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in test development, test execution, QA/QC, and test automation, with strong analytical, data, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Design and develop test scripts aligned to EIT standards
* Assess test steps and data sources to identify repeatable, rules-based automation opportunities
* Design, build, test, and maintain automated test scripts or workflows aligned to EIT standards
* Define input data, business rules, expected results, exception handling, and reconciliation checks for automated tests
* Validate automated outputs against approved test procedures before deployment and after material changes
* Translate business and control requirements into structured, repeatable test scenarios
* Execute activities across the end-to-end Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC)
* Ensure all development activities are accurately tracked in the system of record, with timely status updates and progression
* Prepare and maintain attestation evidence and deliverables, ensuring alignment to defined acceptance criteria prior to closure
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Test Execution, QA, and Risk teams to ensure seamless workflow progression
* Identify, document, and escalate defects, control gaps, and process issues
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing standards, and quality benchmarks
* Adhere to defined SLAs, timelines, and quality benchmarks
* Monitor automation performance, investigate failures, and maintain documentation, evidence, and change history
* Contribute to continuous improvement and testing transformation initiatives

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Graduate / Postgraduate in
  
  

* Business / Commerce / Banking
* Finance / Risk / Operations
* Technology or related disciplines

**Experience Range\***
4–6 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet defined SLAs
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop integrated solutions
* Strong data-analysis capability using Excel and query tools to profile, reconcile, and validate test populations
* Ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive test requirements and scenarios
* Strong understanding of test design, test lifecycle management, automation feasibility, and control validation
* Hands-on ability to develop and troubleshoot automated tests using SQL, Python, or equivalent approved automation tools
* Ability to convert manual test logic into reusable automation with defined inputs, rules, expected outputs, and exceptions
* Understanding of automation controls, including validation, access management, version control, change management, and audit evidence
* Ability to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency in testing outputs
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
* Understanding of structured test lifecycle frameworks (e.g., TDLC or equivalent)
* Minimum 2+ years of experience in testing, risk management, process improvement, compliance, or front-line control roles demonstrating strong analytical capability
* Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Test Development, Test Execution, QA/QC, or test automation
* Understanding and awareness of AI/other emerging technologies

**Desired Skills**

* Working knowledge of data warehousing and data mining concepts, with basic understanding of SAS/SQL query languages
* Experience in writing queries to extract and analyze data from multiple data sources (e.g., DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop, Hive)

**Work Timings\***
12:30 PM to 9:30 PM (IST); As per business requirement (flexibility to support global stakeholders)
  
  
**Job Location\***
GIFT/HYD City

title: Principal Engineer, S/W QA Cyber Security
description:
**Additional Locations:**
N/A
  
  
**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**
At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Principal Cybersecurity Quality Engineer is a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert responsible for providing independent Quality oversight and technical leadership for product cybersecurity activities across the medical-device product lifecycle. This position partners with Quality, R&D, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Global Product Cybersecurity, Regulatory Affairs, Design Assurance, Post-Market Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity risks and deliverables are appropriately identified, assessed, controlled, verified, documented, and maintained.
  
  
The role supports new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, third-party software and component assessments, vulnerability management, and post-market cybersecurity activities. The individual will also strengthen organizational cybersecurity capability by developing consistent approaches, reusable knowledge assets, and technical expertise within the Quality organization.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Serve as the Quality subject matter expert for product cybersecurity activities across new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, remediation, and integration programs.
* Provide independent Quality review and approval of cybersecurity plans, assessments, reports, and other lifecycle deliverables in accordance with applicable Quality System requirements.
* Review cybersecurity risk analyses, threat models, security architectures, attack-surface assessments, and risk-control strategies for completeness, consistency, technical adequacy, and traceability.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks, requirements, controls, and verification evidence are appropriately connected across design controls, software lifecycle documentation, system requirements, and product risk-management files.
* Review Software Bills of Materials, MDS2 documentation, cybersecurity reports, penetration-test results, static and dynamic analysis results, vulnerability assessments, and security verification evidence.
* Assess the cybersecurity quality impact of design changes, software changes, third-party software updates, operating-system changes, supplier changes, and other product lifecycle changes.
* Provide Quality oversight for cybersecurity verification and validation strategies, including acceptance criteria, test coverage, traceability, anomaly handling, and objective evidence.
* Support product vulnerability assessments and Post-Market Vulnerability Reviews, including evaluation of potential safety, quality, compliance, and product-security impacts.
* Support post-market cybersecurity investigations, remediation plans, corrective actions, and escalation activities, as applicable.
* Partner with Global Product Cybersecurity and project teams to interpret and consistently apply internal cybersecurity procedures, work instructions, standards, and regulatory expectations.
* Support cybersecurity content needed for regulatory submissions, notified-body reviews, internal audits, external inspections, and responses to regulatory questions.
* Identify Quality and compliance gaps, communicate risks clearly, and influence appropriate mitigation and escalation decisions.
* Lead complex cybersecurity quality initiatives that may span multiple projects, product families, divisions, or geographic locations.
* Develop and improve cybersecurity quality review methods, templates, checklists, playbooks, metrics, and reusable knowledge assets.
* Monitor cybersecurity quality trends and recommend process, training, governance, or capability improvements.
* Mentor engineers and cross-functional team members in cybersecurity risk management, design controls, documentation quality, and lifecycle expectations.
* Support development of independent cybersecurity subject matter experts and help establish a sustainable cybersecurity Quality capability.
* Represent Cybersecurity Quality in technical reviews, governance forums, communities of practice, and cross-functional decision-making bodies.
* Maintain current knowledge of evolving medical-device cybersecurity regulations, standards, guidance, technologies, threats, and industry practices.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant professional experience in cybersecurity, software quality, design assurance, product security, systems engineering, software engineering, or another relevant technical field.
* Experience working with software-enabled products in a regulated product-development environment.
* Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity risk assessment, threat modelling, vulnerability evaluation, security requirements, or secure product-development practices.
* Working knowledge of software development lifecycle and design-control principles.
* Experience reviewing complex technical documentation and determining whether evidence is complete, traceable, technically sound, and compliant.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical work independently and make risk-based recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions across functions and organizational levels without direct reporting authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex cybersecurity risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively within a global, cross-functional, and matrixed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience in the medical-device, healthcare technology, pharmaceutical, aerospace, automotive, or another safety-critical regulated industry.
* Experience with medical-device cybersecurity, software quality assurance, design assurance, or product-security quality oversight.
* Knowledge of medical-device design controls, software lifecycle processes, and product risk management.
* Experience with threat modelling, security architecture review, vulnerability assessment, penetration-testing review, static application security testing, or dynamic application security testing.
* Experience reviewing SBOMs, third-party software components, open-source software, commercial software, and software supply-chain risks.
* Experience supporting post-market vulnerability reviews, cybersecurity investigations, vulnerability remediation, CAPA, or other corrective-action processes.
* Experience supporting regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, or regulatory inquiries involving cybersecurity or device software.
* Experience developing organizational processes, templates, metrics, training, or reusable cybersecurity knowledge assets.
* Experience mentoring engineers or developing technical subject matter experts.
* Professional certification such as CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, GIAC, or an equivalent cybersecurity or quality credential.

**Leadership And Expectations**

* Acts as a recognized technical authority in cybersecurity quality.
* Operates with substantial independence in defining approaches and resolving complex or ambiguous problems.
* Provides technical direction for complex, high-risk, or highly visible cybersecurity quality matters.
* Influences cybersecurity quality decisions across multiple functions, projects, product families, or business units.
* Develops scalable methods, frameworks, and practices rather than limiting contributions to individual project execution.
* Anticipates emerging cybersecurity risks and recommends appropriate organizational responses.
* Coaches and mentors engineers while building sustainable technical capability.
* Communicates cybersecurity quality risks and recommendations clearly to technical and business leadership.
* Balances technical rigor, patient safety, regulatory compliance, product quality, and business needs.

636429

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
**Job Description**
As part of the Financial Reporting Quality Assurance (FRQA) organization within Corporate Controllership, this role is accountable for overseeing critical Level 1 production support processes for financial systems, including data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, validation, operational calendar management, end-to-end process coordination, and incident management.
  
  
The team maintains deep knowledge of data sources, processing workflows, and regulatory reporting requirements, and is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across a broad range of finance technology platforms. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, disciplined operational execution, proactive monitoring, and timely incident resolution.
  
  
The Service Management Financial System Analyst is expected to be collaborative, highly organized, and results oriented, with responsibility for end-to-end operational monitoring, incident tracking, triage, problem management, and support of financial system reliability, stability, and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role is responsible for ensuring financial systems operations are effectively governed, executed, monitored, controlled, and continuously improved. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage operational processes to ensure financial systems function as intended, processes run efficiently, and required controls and auditability are maintained.
* Ensure successful completion of daily operational activities in alignment with established processing calendars, controls, and service expectations.
* Collaborate with business, finance, and technology stakeholders to triage incidents, manage resolution activities, and support timely root cause analysis.
* Identify recurring incident themes and partner with technology and business teams to drive sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, and automation.
* Assess the operational impact of production changes and ensure runbooks, procedures, and related documentation are updated accurately and on time.
* Develop, operationalize, and monitor dashboards that provide transparency into process health, operational performance, and service management trends.
* Document business and technical requirements for enhancements, standard operating procedures, and process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and control management requirements.
* Identify, document, implement, and periodically test operational controls in accordance with RCSA/PRSA guidelines to confirm control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technology-related field, preferably Computer Science.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial systems implementation, production support, and incident management for financial systems.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database and data management concepts, with strong proficiency in SQL and exposure to both traditional and modern data technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial, business, and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Ability to perform effectively in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in challenging situations.
* Proven transformational mindset, with a focus on improving process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Self-starter and proactive team player with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality service and meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Experience with accounting and reporting processes, including financial and regulatory reporting, is preferred.
* Flexibility is essential for this production support role, including the ability to work in shifts and provide weekend support on a rotational basis.

Technical Skills & Knowledge of Platforms
  
  

* Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and production incident troubleshooting, including the ability to write complex queries and perform multi-table joins.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, MemSQL, and Putty for incident triage, reporting, and operational support.
* Advanced knowledge of job scheduling tools such as Airflow and Automic is required.
* Experience in Generative AI frameworks would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, monitoring, logging, IAM, production support, maintenance, and troubleshooting, is preferred.
* Experience with AxiomSL is preferred.
* Knowledge of Flink and Beam server is preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira is preferred.

The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

**Job Description**
Job Opportunity
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled, technical
**Survey Programming Consultant**
to join our growing Global Programming & Hosting (P&H) team. In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for translating our clients' complex research requirements into highly functional, error-free online surveys.
  
  
As a consultant-level scripter, you will own the technical execution of the survey lifecycle, from initial scripting and logic testing to quality assurance, hosting, and final data delivery. You will work closely with Project Managers and client stakeholders to ensure our surveys are engaging, accessible, and optimized for maximum data quality.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 6+ years of hands-on survey programming experience within a market research, panel, or data collection environment.

* Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize survey interfaces and design. Experience with Python or XML is a strong plus.

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics

title: Principal Software Test Engineer
description:
**Description**
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:
  
  

* Automation & Engineering (Core IC Work – 50%)

+ Help Develop and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks for Web, API, and Thick Client applications.
+ Build and enhance automation solutions to improve test coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.
+ Ensure CI/CD readiness, enabling seamless integration of automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
+ Contribute to code reviews and continuous improvement of automation assets.

* Manual Testing (Core IC Work – 50%)

+ Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual test plans, test cases, and test suites for Web, API, and Thick Client applications.
+ Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure product quality and coverage.
+ Collaborate with development and product teams on acceptance criteria, edge cases, and defect validation.
+ Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps and expected versus actual results.

* Driving Automation Excellence

+ Help drive adoption of automation frameworks and best practices across teams within the Business Unit.
+ Collaborate with teams to identify automation opportunities and improve overall test strategy.
+ Advocate for shift-left testing and early quality validation.

* Performance & Quality Engineering

+ Design and execute performance and load testing using JMeter.
+ Analyse system performance, identify bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for optimization.

* Mentorship & Collaboration

+ Mentor and support QA engineers in test automation concepts, tools, scripting, and best practices — serving as a senior technical resource and go-to person for automation guidance within the team.
+ Provide technical guidance without direct people management responsibilities.
+ Collaborate with product, development, and DevOps teams to ensure alignment on quality goals.
+ Contribute to knowledge sharing and capability building within the team.

* Operational Excellence

+ Participate in planning, estimation, and requirement analysis.
+ Define and contribute to quality metrics and automation effectiveness tracking.
+ Troubleshoot complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers.

**Minimum Qualifications (knowledge, Skills, And Abilities)**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 8-12 years of experience in software testing with balanced expertise across both manual and automation testing.
* Proven experience as a senior individual contributor in quality engineering/automation.
* Solid hands-on experience in test automation with the ability to guide and mentor team members on automation practices, tool usage, and best practices — framework design expertise is not required.
* Hands-on expertise in:

+ Web automation (Selenium / Playwright / Cypress)
+ API automation (REST Assured / Postman / similar tools)
+ Thick client / desktop automation (Test Complete)

* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience in performance testing using JMeter.
* Proficiency in Java, Python, JS or similar programming languages.
* Experience with JIRA or similar test/defect management tools.
* Solid understanding of databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and SQL queries.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to debug and troubleshoot complex systems.
* Experience working in enterprise-scale applications/products.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive adoption of best practices.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across teams.
* Passion for mentoring team members, particularly in test automation, and enabling others to grow their technical skills.
* Ability to balance hands-on execution with broader quality impact.

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Lead Verification & Validation Engineer
description: Job Description SummaryLead Verification & Validation Engineer will be responsible for the delivery of the of HVDC Controls & Protection Verification and Validation team’s activities on time / as per Project Scheduled through proper coordination between Project and department. The role involves technical leadership on the various work packages within the department ensuring that they meet the requirements, and the relevant processes are followedJob DescriptionEssential responsibilities: Prepare and maintain Validation & Verification team’s activity plans as per the Project scheduled. Design, create Factory System Test (FST) cases and review results against design requirements including leading Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) with clients. Developing HVDC System and plant modelling in electromagnetic transient tools like PSCAD, RSCAD, EMTP-RV etc including undertaking Dynamic Performance Studies and Protection co-ordination. Preparing control system requirements for the RTDS Lab setup including AC DC interface requirement, Plant Emulator Interface requirement and RSCAD Power system network conversion, modelling, and verification. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) to develop existing and new products and tools. Provide support to Commissioning Engineers during Dynamic commissioning at Site. Support continual improvement, raising the effectiveness and efficiency of the team through the introduction of tools, methods and process improvements and coordinating with the Continuous Improvement leaders. Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Uses prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy. In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area. Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions. Maintain rigorous end-to-end requirement traceability, ensuring that every design change is verified against system architecture and validated via documented test evidence. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in the V&V lifecycle, implementing changes where necessary that increase test coverage and decrease the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). Serve as the primary technical point of contact for V&V engineers. Investigate complex technical anomalies by correlating event-logs, signal traces, and control states to identify and implement corrective actions under high-pressure delivery timelines. Provide technical guidance to junior V&V engineers, fostering a culture of "Quality First" and promoting best practices in test plan preparation and documentation. Orchestrate communication between cross-functional teams (Controls, Software, Hardware, and Commissioning) to resolve integration bottlenecks and maintain project velocity.Qualifications And RequirementsEngineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business.Significant experience in the position of Verification Engineer in High Voltage field, with experience as a Control & Protection design Engineer. Good knowledge of overall 400kV substation, HVDC system (LCC/VSC/SVC) including control and protection system is essential.Experience of developing and working with PSCAD and RSCAD models is essential including knowledge of Overall HVDC System Operational Behaviour.Experience in defining Test Strategy, Root-Cause Analysis (RCA), Cross-functional Stakeholder Management and Mentorship.Experience in technical leadership with ability to manage team of validation engineersStrong communication skills with a fluency in English language.Willingness to travel to support projects globally and readiness for flexible with working hoursKnowledge of applicable electrical standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 62351, IEC 12207, IEEE 15288, IEC 25010, IEC 27032, NERC/CIP.Desired characteristicsProcess improvement or RCA experience or certificationExperience on MATCAD, PSS/E and MATLAB SIMULINK, EMTP-RV, Digsilent etc will added advantage.Excellent communication and interpersonal skillsAdditional InformationRelocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: QA Automation Test Analyst
description:
**Overview**
Make an Impact!
  
  
Do you enjoy building the frameworks that keep quality at the heart of every release? At McGraw Hill, our QA Automation Test Analyst drives progress and helps build the future of learning. If you have the technical expertise and passion for quality to thrive in an innovative, fast-paced environment, we want to learn more about you.
  
  
How can you make an Impact?
  
  
This critical role within the Global Technology Services (GTS) Business Systems department is responsible for developing and maintaining automation frameworks using JMeter, Selenium, or Playwright with TypeScript. As the single point of contact from Offshore for the Quality Assurance and test team, this role provides technical guidance to QA/QC teams both onshore and offshore, supports process innovation, and drives SDLC process improvement and automation across the department. This role is focused on back-office software applications, providing feedback and recommendations on technical quality across SOA, Oracle SaaS, and other cloud/SaaS-based applications.
  
  
What can you expect from the position?
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using JMeter, Selenium with Java/Cucumber, Playwright with TypeScript, GitHub Actions, and AI prompt-writing capabilities, automating and maintaining test scripts with reusability in mind across SOA, Oracle SaaS, and other cloud-based applications.
* Provide technical assistance to the Performance Testing Team, QA/QC team, developers, and project managers to ensure software delivery is completed efficiently and to QA standards.
* Evolve Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment processes by helping implement new workflows and tools that move testing closer to the point of code change.
* Document test results, create and track bugs for the software development team, isolate and resolve issues throughout testing, and review user interfaces for consistency.
* Test and respond to software quality assurance issues, communicating effectively on findings and status.
* Improve efficiencies by introducing innovation and effective strategies across the QA cycle, leveraging the latest automation tools available in the market.

**Experience & Education Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of IT software quality assurance experience in ERP and web-based application testing.
* Minimum of 3-4 years of demonstrated experience with automation testing tools such as Selenium Java and Cucumber, or Playwright with TypeScript.
* Exposure to ERP Oracle Apps EBS, SOA, SQL databases, JMeter, and UFT.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycles (Agile, Waterfall, iterative, etc.) and quality assurance processes.
* Experience in Enterprise QA, functional and performance testing and automation techniques and tools (JMeter, Selenium/Java Cucumber).
* Experience supporting SDLC tools and processes (ServiceNow, JIRA, Jenkins, Confluence, GitHub, PVCS, or similar).
* Multiple years of testing and automating tests for large-scale ERP systems (Oracle, SAP, SOA).
* Exposure to multiple test automation tools.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to analyze software gaps and recommend improvements to overall software quality.
* Ability to communicate quality metrics clearly to the product team.

Why work with us?
  
  
There has never been a better time to join McGraw Hill. In our culture of curiosity and innovation, you will be able to own your growth and develop as we do.
  
  
As an education innovation company, we're proud to play our part by inspiring learners around the world. If you bring your curiosity, we'll help you grow in a collaborative environment where everyone shares a passion for success.
  
  
Are you ready for a new challenge? Apply for a career at McGraw Hill and together, we'll impact the world.

description:

**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
