* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Our Commitment
  
  
**As a commitment,**
we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

+ Trade processing engines
+ Static and reference data frameworks
+ Interfaces, messaging standards (ISO15022/20022, FIX), and APIs

+ Workflow creation & orchestration

* Database skills – Able to write SQL queries of moderate complexity,

description:

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Define or review system architecture for each project, ensuring scalability, performance, and security.
* Choose appropriate tech stacks, tools, and frameworks for projects.
* Establish coding standards, best practices, and code review guidelines; perform regular code reviews.
* Ensure proper use of version control, including branching strategy and pull requests.
* Act as the go-to person for debugging and resolving complex technical issues, guiding developers rather than solving issues on their behalf.
* Maintain high-level technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, deployment documentation, and integration notes.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Break down requirements into technical tasks and provide realistic timeline estimates.
* Track project progress and adjust priorities as needed.
* Balance workload across developers, assigning tasks based on skill and development needs.
* Ensure deployments are smooth and aligned with release cycles.
* Oversee quality assurance, testing strategy, and release notes.

**People Leadership**

* Mentor and coach developers to support technical and professional growth.
* Encourage knowledge-sharing sessions and recognize good performance.
* Provide constructive feedback without micromanaging.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training or upskilling.

**Stakeholder & Communication**

* Communicate project status (progress, risks, blockers) clearly to clients and management.
* Translate technical details into business terms for non-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate with QA, DevOps, Product Managers, and Business Analysts; track cross-project dependencies.
* Anticipate risks early and escalate to management along with proposed solutions.

**Process & Improvement**

* Run daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives; keep project boards up to date.
* Drive adoption of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and monitoring tools.
* Conduct post-release analysis to identify improvement opportunities and adapt processes accordingly.

**Daily Operating Cadence**

* Conduct daily stand-up meetings covering pending backlog items, in-progress tasks, and recently completed items.
* Review at least 1-2 pull requests per day to ensure standards and consistency.
* Update project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) with task progress, status changes, and effort estimates.
* Proactively inform the Technical Manager of technical delays, exceptions, or blockers.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, and system scalability.
* Proven experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Proficiency with version control systems and CI/CD tools.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

8+ years

title: Senior Software Test Engineer (SDET)
description:
**About the Company**

Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3,000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security. This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

**Location:**
Bangalore (Electronic City)

**Work Model:**
4 Days Work from Office

**Interview Process:**
Face-to-Face Interviews at our Bangalore Office

**Note**
: Apply only if you match the requirement.

**About the Role**

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‑quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‑based applications. It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. By collaborating with cross‑functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles.

As per company policy, this role requires presence in the office 4 days per week.

**Responsibilities:**

**Duties:**

* Test Case Development & Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test cases that align with project requirements, ensuring thorough testing of software functionality, performance, and security.
* Automation Support: Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts and frameworks. Assist in enhancing test automation coverage for both system-level and front-end applications.
* Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify, track, and document software defects, functionality issues, and performance problems, working closely with developers to reproduce, debug, and resolve issues.
* Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and senior testers, to ensure alignment on testing goals and priorities. Communicate findings and progress effectively.
* Test Reporting & Metrics: Contribute to the preparation of test reports and track key testing metrics to assess test coverage, defect resolution, and overall testing progress.
* Support in Test Planning: Participate in test planning activities, contributing to discussions about scope, approach, and strategy for different types of testing, such as functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Version Control & Configuration Management: Utilize version control systems (e.g., Git, Subversion) for maintaining test scripts, test cases, and related artifacts.
* CI/CD Integration: Assist in integrating test scripts into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure that automated tests are executed as part of the development process.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

**Required Skills**

* 4–7 years of hands‑on experience testing distributed, microservices‑based applications, including test strategy definition, design, execution, and maintenance.
* Strong expertise in automated testing frameworks such as Robot Framework and Python for service‑level and end‑to‑end testing across backend and consumer‑facing applications.
* Proficiency in API testing (RESTful services), including contract validation, payload verification, error handling, and service dependency checks.
* Hands‑on experience with containerisation technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes), including deployment validation and scalability testing.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms and their deployment models.
* Experience supporting applications deployed via CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Bitbucket) with understanding of microservices promotion across environments.
* Proficiency with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), test management tools (TestRail), and version control systems (Git).
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, microservices concepts, and test methodologies with ability to collaborate across development, DevOps, and testing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear test cases, maintain accurate documentation, and track quality metrics in fast‑moving environments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Broader exposure to advanced automation strategies or scripting for test environments.
* Certifications in testing frameworks, cloud technologies, or DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with security testing or compliance validation in microservices architectures.
* Self-starter with excellent time management, attention to detail, and initiative.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

title: Application Lead Test Engineer
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can both build and break software. You’ll develop features across our full stack, lead quality for the team, and own the test strategy. Roughly [50%] of your time will be spent on application development and [50%] on testing and QA activities. You’ll work in Java, PHP, Jmix, JavaScript and TypeScript, use AI to work faster while keeping human judgment in the loop, and lead a small team of QA engineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Application Development

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack features using Java, PHP, and the Jmix framework on the back end, and JavaScript/TypeScript on the front end
* Build and consume REST APIs and integrate third-party services
* Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions
* Contribute to architecture and design decisions, including code structure, patterns, and technical standards
* Write clean, well-tested code with strong unit and integration test coverage
* Participate in and lead code reviews across both application and test code
* Debug and resolve production issues, and optimize application performance
* Mentor developers and QA engineers on code quality and testability

Testing & Quality Leadership

* Lead and mentor QA engineers, balancing leadership with hands-on technical work
* Architect, build, and maintain test automation frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
* Plan, design, and run performance, load, and stress tests, then analyze results and recommend improvements
* Promote shift-left testing by working with the team on testability, early defect detection, and test coverage
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines so builds, tests, and deployments run automatically
* Set up test tooling, including mocks, stubs, and test environments
* Track quality metrics, run defect triage, and report risks and status to stakeholders
* Estimate effort and continuously improve processes in an [Agile/Scrum] environment

AI in Engineering

* Use AI tools to generate test cases and test data, draft and refactor code, review changes, and summarize failures and logs
* Define team guidelines for responsible AI use, including prompt practices, review of AI-generated code, and protection of sensitive data
Evaluate and introduce AI-powered development and testing tools, and measure their real impact on quality and speed  

#LI-SS1

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

BA/BS degree and 7-10years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience

**Required Qualifications**

Development

* 7-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including full stack development
* Strong proficiency in Java, with Spring Boot or similar frameworks
* Hands-on experience with the Jmix framework (or its predecessor, CUBA Platform)
* Working experience with PHP (Laravel, Symfony, or similar)
* Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, plus a modern front-end framework [React / Angular / Vue]
* Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development
* Experience designing and building REST APIs, including authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT)
* Good grasp of design patterns, clean code, SOLID principles, and application architecture
* Experience with Git workflows, pull request reviews, and build tools (Maven/Gradle, npm)

Testing

* SDET or test automation engineering experience and previous experience leading QA teams
* Proven experience writing Test Plans and Test Strategies for complex projects
* Experience building automation frameworks from scratch (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, TestNG/JUnit, or similar)
* Hands-on performance testing experience (JMeter, k6, Gatling, or similar), including load modeling and bottleneck analysis
* Strong API testing experience (REST Assured, Postman, or similar)
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with Jira and test management tools (TestRail, Xray, or similar)

AI & Soft Skills

* Practical experience using AI assistants and coding tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) in daily development and testing, with the judgment to validate and correct their output
* Prompt engineering skills for producing reliable code, test cases, and test data
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to switch between building and testing, and to lead by example

Nice to Have

* Experience building AI-assisted tooling, such as agents, scripts that call LLM APIs, or MCP integrations
* Microservices architecture and event-driven design
* Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Application performance monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic, Datadog)
ISTQB or AI certifications

description:

**Location:**
Chennai, India |

18+ Years |

Full-time |

Quality Assurance & Test Engineering |
**Reports To:**
Head – Quality Engineering

**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE**

Ramco Systems is part of the
**$1 billion+ diversified Ramco Group**
, a legacy enterprise with deep roots in industries such as cement, textiles, engineering, software, energy, and biotech. With over 75 years of heritage and innovation, the Ramco Group is a global powerhouse that blends traditional business values with modern technologies.

**Ramco Systems**
is the Group’s technology arm, delivering
**next-gen enterprise software**
across
**Global Payroll**
,
**HR**
,
**Aviation MRO**
,
**ERP**
, and
**Logistics**
. Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35+ countries and is recognized for its
**AI/ML-based**
,
**bot-enabled**
, and
**cloud-native**
solutions.

Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high-growth enterprises alike.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications—
**Ramco is the place to be.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Testing AI & Agentic Software (core focus)**

* Own test strategy for copilots, assistants, LLM workflows, RAG pipelines, and multi-step agents across Ramco products.
* Build evaluation-driven quality:
  **golden datasets, eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge with human calibration**
  , and pass thresholds agreed with Product before release.
* Run regression for models and prompts — version pinning, drift detection, re-baselining on model upgrades, and A/B release comparison.
* Test RAG quality (retrieval precision and recall, groundedness, citation correctness, hallucination rate) and agents (tool selection, trajectories, memory, retries, loops, handoffs, MCP and tool contracts).
* Validate blast radius of autonomous action — permission scoping, approval gates, human-in-the-loop, idempotency, and rollback.
* Lead AI red teaming (prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, PII and tenant leakage) and AI non-functional quality (latency, token cost, concurrency, fallback).
* Extend quality into production through tracing, online evals, and drift monitoring, feeding failures back into regression.
* Ensure responsible-AI readiness — bias, explainability, and audit evidence against EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001.

**AI-Led Testing Transformation**

* Define the AI-in-QA strategy across test design, automation, test data, triage, RCA, and release readiness — including where AI is deliberately not used.
* Personally build testing accelerators with
  **Claude Code**
  or comparable agentic tools, and establish agent engineering practices (prompts, context files, skills, sub-agents, MCP integrations to ALM and CI, shared workflow repositories).
* Drive AI-assisted test design with mandatory human review, NL-to-script automation (Playwright, Selenium), self-healing locators, risk-based test selection, synthetic and masked test data, and AI defect intelligence.
* Govern AI-generated artefacts — review gates, traceability, IP hygiene, secure data handling, and human ownership of every released test asset.
* Measure AI impact (adoption, cycle time, coverage, escaped defects, cost per release), retire what shows no value, and reskill 40–50 engineers in prompt, context, and agent engineering.

**Quality Strategy & Organisational Leadership**

* Set the quality vision and multi-year roadmap with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Delivery.
* Run Quality Maturity Assessments with the Quality CoE and ensure QMS adherence.
* Balance Dev and QA capacity, and re-baseline QA sizing as AI gains land.
* Own the operating budget, including AI tooling and token spend, with ROI tracking.

**Test Engineering, Automation & Non-Functional Quality**

* Manage strategies across functional automation, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing.
* Drive testability and observability, including the instrumentation AI features need to be evaluable.
* Build simulation environments with mocked model endpoints for deterministic CI.
* Run proofs of concept comparing AI testing platforms against internal builds, and plan end-to-end testing across products and partners.

**Delivery, Metrics & People Leadership**

* Track productivity, defect leakage, automation coverage, AI adoption and, for AI features, eval pass rates and hallucination trends.
* Report licensing, financials, delivery, and quality to executives, and resolve production issues with global stakeholders.
* Lead managers, leads, and engineers across performance, automation, accessibility, security, and AI quality.
* Define career paths for AI quality and test tooling engineers, and build a culture of experimentation and psychological safety.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* AI features released against defensible, pre-agreed evidence rather than subjective confidence.
* Non-deterministic behaviour caught in evals before it reaches a customer workflow.
* AI used in QA where it demonstrably earns its place, and retired where it does not.
* Escaped defects trending down across products while release cadence goes up.
* A test organisation whose engineers can build their own tooling with coding agents.
* Responsible-AI evidence available when a customer, auditor, or regulator asks for it.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head of Quality Engineering and reviewed on the cadence noted.*

* **AI release confidence**
  — eval pass rates against agreed thresholds, hallucination rate, and groundedness and citation correctness on RAG features at release.
  *(Per release)*
* **AI safety and blast-radius assurance**
  — red-team findings (prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage) closed before release, and permission scoping, approval gates, and rollback validated for autonomous actions.
  *(Per release)*
* **AI-in-QA impact**
  — adoption of AI testing accelerators, cycle-time reduction, coverage gain, and cost per release against baseline.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Escaped defects and production quality**
  — defect leakage to production across products, and production issues resolved within agreed timelines.
  *(Monthly)*
* **Automation and non-functional coverage**
  — functional automation, API, performance, accessibility, and security test coverage against plan.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Quality maturity and governance**
  — Quality Maturity Assessment outcomes, QMS adherence, and responsible-AI evidence maintained and audit-ready.
  *(Half-yearly)*
* **Capability and budget stewardship**
  — engineers reskilled in prompt, context, and agent engineering against plan; QA sizing re-baselined; and operating budget including AI tooling and token spend managed to plan with ROI tracked.
  *(Half-yearly)*

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
* 18+ years in test engineering, including 10+ years as a QA manager on complex products.
* 5+ years leading 50+ engineers including managers, in a matrixed global MNC, with a proven shift from QA to test engineering to AI-augmented testing.

**AI & Agentic Testing — essential**

* Hands-on tools built with
  **Claude Code**
  or equivalent, with concrete examples of users and savings; agent engineering across context files, skills, sub-agents, and MCP.
* Production experience testing LLM and agentic software — copilots, RAG, multi-step workflows — not lab-only.
* Eval frameworks for non-deterministic systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, and defensible release criteria; RAG quality measurement.
* AI safety testing — prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool data leakage, and agent permission scoping.
* Tooling: LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, and agent-run tracing; judgement on AI economics and when deterministic tests are the better answer.

**Core Test Engineering**

* Functional and non-functional testing, Agile and Scrum, SQL validation, and quality standards and metrics for strategic programmes.
* Automation and performance tooling: Playwright, Selenium, Cucumber, Postman, JMeter, LoadRunner; REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and event-driven APIs.
* Languages and DevOps: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java or C#; Git, Jenkins, containers, Terraform or Ansible; LLM APIs and orchestration patterns.
* ALM: Jira/Xray, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, with APIs for agent-driven integration.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Manager certification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* AI quality gates embedded in CI/CD.
* Exposure to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001.
* Human-in-the-loop models for agents operating on enterprise data.
* AI enablement contributions — training, guilds, hackathons.
* AI certification such as CT-AI; PMP or PRINCE2 an advantage.

**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS**

* Lead quality for AI assistants, copilots, and autonomous agents embedded in enterprise workflows used across 35+ countries.
* A genuine dual mandate — testing AI, and rebuilding testing itself around AI.
* Budget and authority to build tooling rather than only buy it.
* Be part of a fast-evolving, innovation-led enterprise software company.

-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

You will own delivery accountability, team health, technical quality, and the cross-team coordination that keeps two scrum teams moving in the same direction. You will be the primary technical counterpart to the US-based Product leadership, the direct interface to platform teams, and the person who sets the engineering culture for the entire team.

* Lead the full Chennai engineering organization (~20 engineers): two Scrum teams, two Engineering Managers, Staff/Senior engineers, Applied ML, and Staff SDET.

* Own delivery accountability: sprint cadence, cross-team dependency management, risk tracking, and executive reporting on engineering progress.

* Set and enforce technical standards: hexagonal architecture discipline, AI-native integration patterns, code quality gates, and observability standards across both teams.

* Act as the primary technical counterpart to US-based Product leadership — translate business requirements into engineering execution plans, surface trade-offs early, and maintain shared understanding of what is being built and why.

* Own the cross-team coordination interface to platform teams (Agentic Engine, Core Platform, ARC backend, Design) — ensuring product dependencies are tracked, escalated, and resolved on schedule.

* Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent: own the full hiring pipeline, define career ladders, conduct performance reviews, and make compensation decisions.

* Drive the technical roadmap for Phase 2 in partnership with the ML Architect, Applied Scientist, and Product leadership — shaping the next wave of AI capabilities.

* Maintain technical depth: actively participate in architecture reviews, challenge design decisions, and unblock engineers on complex distributed systems and AI integration challenges.

* Build and sustain a high-trust, high-accountability engineering culture where engineers feel ownership, psychological safety, and pride in their craft.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering leadership — managing managers and leading teams of 15+ engineers.

* Deep technical background in Java backend systems, distributed microservices, and event-driven architecture — able to engage credibly in architecture reviews and design decisions.

* Proven track record building and operating SaaS platforms on AWS with multi-database stacks (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis/Aerospike).

* Demonstrated experience with hexagonal architecture at scale — enforcing domain isolation as teams and services grow.

* Strong cross-functional leadership: experience working closely with Product Management, Design, and executive stakeholders across geographies (US-India distributed teams).

* Track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent — building teams from the ground up in competitive markets.

* Experience delivering in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with evolving platform dependencies and shifting priorities.

Good to Have

* Experience leading engineering teams building AI-native products (LLM integration, agentic systems, scoring pipelines, MCP tool design).

* Background in martech, customer data platforms, or dealer/automotive technology.

* Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines within the same org.

Exposure Temporal for durable workflow orchestration at the team level.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options.

* Medical insurance coverage.

* Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies.

**About RTX**
At RTX, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 people come together with a shared purpose: to solve the world’s most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference. Through our three industry-leading businesses, advanced engineering capabilities, and significant investments in research and development, we are pushing the boundaries of science and technology to connect and protect our world.
  
  
**Join Collins Aerospace and help shape the future of flight.**
Collins Aerospace delivers technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of aerospace technologies, we help customers navigate the evolving demands of global aviation.
  
  
Be part of a team that is advancing aviation safety, reliability, and innovation through world-class engineering.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Avionics Software Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer / Technical Lead**
to drive the verification, testing, debugging, and certification of safety-critical avionics software.
  
  
In this role, you will work on requirement-based testing, structural coverage analysis, host- and target-based verification, and compliance with DO-178B/C certification objectives. You will collaborate with global engineering teams, contribute to certification reviews and audits, and help develop innovative tools and processes that improve software quality and engineering efficiency.
  
  
This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with technical leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement while contributing to avionics systems that support safe and reliable flight operations.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Avionics Software Verification & Certification
  
  

* Design, develop, review, and execute requirement-based test cases, test procedures, and unit tests for safety-critical avionics software.
* Perform software verification and validation across host and target environments, including unit, integration, and system-level testing.
* Conduct Structural Coverage Analysis (SCA) and support the achievement of applicable software coverage objectives.
* Ensure compliance with DO-178B/C processes and objectives for applicable software assurance levels, including Levels A, B, and C.
* Support certification activities, including Stages of Involvement (SOI), technical reviews, compliance submissions, and internal and external audits.
* Maintain adherence to established software development, verification, quality, and documentation standards.

**Technical Problem-Solving & Tool Development**

* Debug and troubleshoot software issues across host and target platforms, including software-software and hardware-software integration environments.
* Analyze system capabilities, software behavior, and reported issues to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Develop and maintain Python-based automation and common engineering tools to improve development and verification efficiency.
* Apply engineering principles to design, develop, and implement technologies, components, subsystems, and systems that meet defined requirements and specifications.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in test automation, verification methodologies, and engineering workflows.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams to deliver project milestones and engineering commitments.
* Lead or coordinate moderately sized engineering teams, as applicable, ensuring quality, timely execution, and alignment with project objectives.
* Coach and mentor junior engineers, review technical deliverables, and promote engineering best practices.
* Lead or contribute to innovation initiatives, quality improvement activities, and CORE workshops to deliver measurable product and process improvements.
* Identify novel technical solutions and ensure innovations are appropriately captured and protected through applicable intellectual property processes.

**What You’ll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* Understanding of avionics systems and software architecture, particularly in areas such as Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), and cockpit displays.
* Strong proficiency in Python for scripting, test automation, and engineering tool development.
* Sound knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and DO-178B/C processes for safety-critical avionics software.
* Hands-on experience in software Verification & Validation, Structural Coverage Analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and requirement-based testing.
* Experience in unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and software verification activities.
* Experience with software-software and hardware-software integration and debugging.
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
* Working knowledge of version control and project tracking tools such as Git or Subversion and Jira.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6-9 years of avionics engineering experience, particularly in safety-critical software verification and certification.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as PyATE, Rapita, Coverity, and Jama.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and tools or environments such as Docker, Visual Studio Code, and Artifactory.
* Sound programming knowledge of C/C++.
* Knowledge of avionics data link applications and protocols, including: Controller–Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC).Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Contract (ADS-C).ATN Context Management (CM).FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN).Airline Operational Control (AOC) and Flight Management System (FMS) flight-planning applications.
* Familiarity with data link industry standards such as DO-258A, ED-110B, and DO-351.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and engineering review experience.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in Lean principles, innovation, and engineering excellence.

**Why Join Collins Aerospace?**

* Make a real-world impact: Contribute to safety-critical avionics software that supports the future of aviation.
* Solve complex engineering challenges: Work with advanced technologies, rigorous certification processes, and sophisticated verification environments.
* Collaborate globally: Partner with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams across international locations.
* Grow your technical leadership: Mentor engineers, influence engineering practices, and contribute to innovation.
* Drive engineering excellence: Help improve product quality, verification efficiency, and software reliability.

The recruiting team will provide further details regarding the role type and current site arrangements during the hiring process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned location is the employee’s responsibility.

title: AI Test Engineer
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
  
  
We are looking for an AI Test Engineer who combines strong software quality assurance and test automation experience with hands-on expertise in AI-assisted testing. The role involves using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and Figma designs to generate test scenarios and executable automated tests using AI tools.
  
  
The ideal candidate can effectively provide the right context to AI tools, validate AI-generated outputs, and continuously improve test development workflows to accelerate automation while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, traceability, and maintainability.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions to translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX specifications such as Figma designs into test scenarios and executable automated tests.
* Build and improve AI-assisted testing workflows where requirements and design artifacts can be provided as context and used to generate, update, and expand automated tests with minimal manual scripting.
* Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to provide AI tools with requirements, application context, coding standards, existing automation frameworks, and relevant design information so that generated tests are accurate and maintainable.
* Review, validate, debug, and refine AI-generated test scenarios and automation code rather than accepting generated output without verification.
* Identify opportunities to automate the test-development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, test generation, test-data creation, regression maintenance, failure analysis, and coverage expansion.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in software QA
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding or engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for software testing and test automation.

title: Test Validation Engineer
description:
**Hiring Validation Test Engineer**

**Job Title:**
Validation Test Engineer

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Kokapet, Hyderabad (Work from Office only)

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a
**detail-oriented Validation Test Engineer**
with hands-on experience in end-to-end product testing and Computer System Validation (CSV).
**The candidate will be responsible for testing product modules, validating functionality against requirements, identifying and reporting defects, coordinating with Development teams for resolution, and performing retesting and regression testing**
. The role also involves preparing and executing validation documentation to ensure compliance with applicable GxP regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Perform end-to-end product testing across individual modules, features, workflows, and integrated functionalities.
* Understand product requirements and design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test data covering positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Verify application functionality, data integrity, workflow transitions, user roles and permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and other relevant system features.
* Identify, document, and report defects with clear steps to reproduce, expected versus actual results, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
* Log, prioritize, assign, and track defects in Jira; follow up with Development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Perform defect retesting after fixes are deployed and conduct regression testing to ensure existing functionalities remain unaffected.
* Maintain test execution records, defect status, test evidence, and testing progress reports.
* Review URS and FRS documents to develop and execute OQ, PQ, and UAT test cases, ensuring appropriate requirement coverage and traceability.
* Author and maintain validation deliverables, including Validation Plan, URS, FRS, Functional Risk Assessment, 21 CFR Part 11 Assessment, Traceability Matrix, and Validation Summary Report.
* Ensure compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), GAMP 5 guidelines, GxP requirements, and applicable regulatory standards throughout the system lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, and Validation teams to investigate issues, clarify requirements, improve product quality, and support release readiness.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **3–7 years of relevant experience in software/product testing and/or Computer System Validation.**
* Hands-on experience in end-to-end application
  **testing, test case design, execution, defect reporting, retesting, and regression testing.**
* Practical experience using
  **Jira for defect logging, tracking, and closure.**
* Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, and validate complex workflows across multiple modules.
* Experience in
  **drafting and executing OQ/PQ protocols and validation test cases.**
* Good understanding of
  **the CSV lifecycle, risk-based validation, and requirement traceability.**
* Knowledge of
  **GAMP 5, GxP best practices, Good Documentation Practices, and 21 CFR Part 11.**
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or a related discipline is required.

Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the product and project end to end, translate customer and system requirements into reliable software solutions, evaluate modern development approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and AI-assisted engineering solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the product architecture, application workflows, customer use cases, technical requirements, dependencies, and engineering challenges across the complete software development lifecycle.
* Assist in designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining software applications and components based on business and technical requirements.
* Write clean, readable, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code following established coding standards and software engineering best practices.
* Develop and integrate application features across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and supporting services, as applicable to the assigned project.
* Participate in requirements analysis, technical discussions, solution design, code reviews, debugging, and implementation activities.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and work with databases, data models, queries, and application integrations.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and unexpected application behavior.
* Develop unit tests and integration tests to validate software functionality, reliability, and maintainability.
* Use Git-based version control workflows to manage code changes, collaborate with team members, and contribute to shared repositories.
* Work with Jenkins or other CI/CD tools to understand build processes, automated checks, deployment workflows, and software delivery practices.
* Explore modern development tools, frameworks, libraries, and architectural approaches to improve development efficiency and software quality.
* Prototype AI-assisted software development solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as code generation, code review, documentation, debugging, refactoring, and test creation.
* Contribute to AI-enabled engineering workflows where software agents can analyze requirements, use development tools, generate or modify code, and validate outcomes with appropriate human review.
* Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and adherence to established engineering standards.
* Apply secure coding practices, investigate technical challenges, and recommend improvements to application performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, APIs, and development workflows to support knowledge sharing and long-term product maintenance.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills :**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of software development principles, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, debugging, and software development lifecycle (SDLC) concepts.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Foundational understanding of application development, REST APIs, databases, SQL, source control, and software integration concepts.
* Essential exposure to and conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI, including their practical applications in software engineering.
* Ability to understand a system end to end, learn unfamiliar technologies, analyze problems logically, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment, learn, and accept feedback.

**Preferred/Nice To Have Skills**

* Hands-on exposure to frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with backend development using Python, Java, Node.js, Spring Boot, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar systems.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, API integration, authentication, and application security fundamentals.
* Exposure to Git-based workflows and development platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Jenkins or another CI/CD platform, including build pipelines, automated checks, and deployment processes.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, or development tools such as AWS, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Experience with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, AI-agent frameworks, or model evaluation techniques.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, hallucination risks, code validation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Academic, personal, internship, or open-source projects involving application development, full-stack engineering, AI-assisted coding, or intelligent software solutions.

**Who We Are**
Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.
  
  
Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
  
  
Join Shure and
**Amplify Your Impact.**
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer
description: Summary Position Summary Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte’s engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. Key Responsibilities: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production—holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. The successful candidate will possess: Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. Required Qualifications: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems—defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging—e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); title: Software Development Engineer II, Fintech TAX - RoW Compliance
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Financial Technology team is seeking passionate, results-driven, and inventive software developers who thrive in working on massively scalable and distributed systems. The ideal candidate excels in a fast-paced environment, understands how to handle large data sets and transactions, and will contribute to delivering a new generation of software leveraging Amazon Web Services. With a passion for technology and a desire to tackle real-world business challenges, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in our platform, which serves Amazon's finance, tax, and accounting functions globally. As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document, and support massively scalable, distributed real-time systems. Utilizing C++, Python, Java, object-oriented design patterns, distributed databases, and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements. We seek individuals with a range of experience, from brilliant and motivated new college graduates to seasoned technical leaders with battle-tested wisdom and scars. If you can think big, aspire to join a fast-moving team breaking new ground at Amazon, and meet the qualifications, we would be delighted to engage with you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned software engineer to take on a pivotal role in the architecture, design, implementation, and deployment of large-scale, critical, and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture skills to the limit by owning all aspects of end-to-end solutions through full-stack software development. Leveraging agile methodologies, you will iteratively build and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. With strong verbal and written communication abilities, self-motivation, and a collaborative mindset, you will work across Amazon engineering teams and business teams globally to plan, design, execute, and implement this new platform across multiple geographies. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will review requirements, design services that lay the foundation for the new technology platform, build new interfaces, integrate with existing architectures, develop and test code, and deliver seamless implementations for Global Tax customers. In a hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day activities, participate in designs, design reviews, and code reviews with the engineering team. Utilizing AWS technologies such as EC2, RDS/DynamoDB/RedShift, SWF, S3, and QuickSight, you will build backend services and customer-facing APIs. You will design and code technical solutions using tools such as Angular JS, React, Node.js, JQuery, and SQL Server to deliver value to tax customers. Additionally, you will contribute to a suite of tools hosted on the AWS infrastructure, working with a variety of tools across the spectrum of the software development lifecycle.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Tax teams to gain a deep understanding of their business challenges, adapt swiftly to evolving needs, and align your efforts with customer priorities. You should possess the ability to act with agility, rapidly develop solutions, create proofs of concept (POCs), and provide customers with the right recommendations. A key aspect of your responsibilities will involve working closely with peer engineers, actively contributing to the design of solutions, conducting thorough deep dives, and participating in quality code reviews. Additionally, you will share the responsibility of owning and resolving operational tickets alongside your peers, ensuring efficient and effective issue resolution. This position demands a proactive mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions tailored to the specific requirements of Tax teams and their customers.

description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET)

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**The job**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and modern quality engineering solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in C#, hands-on experience with MSTest/FlaUI, expertise in Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and practical experience leveraging GitHub Copilot to accelerate test automation development, improve code quality, and enhance engineering productivity.

**Key responsibilities**

* 6–10 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or quality engineering, with substantial hands-on development experience.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks using C# and FlaUI for Desktop Based application which is also enabled in Browser based.
* Integrate automated tests with Microsoft Test Platform and compatible test runners.
* Troubleshoot test failures, debug application behavior, and resolve automation framework issues.
* Use GitHub Copilot to accelerate the development of test scripts, reusable automation utilities, and test framework components.
* Leverage AI-assisted coding to generate test scenarios, test data variations, assertions, and negative test cases.
* Use GitHub Copilot to assist with code refactoring, debugging, documentation, and unit test development.
* Design, implement, and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for automated test execution.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD workflows to enable continuous validation. Experience with Git

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Test Platform, VSTest, and automated test execution tools.
* Knowledge of REST API automation using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or other UI automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of SQL and database validation.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation setup, execution, and reporting.
* Experience with Azure DevOps REST APIs, pipeline artifacts, and test reporting.
* Familiarity with parallel execution, distributed test environments, and regression optimization.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development, prompt engineering, and AI-generated code validation.
* Experience measuring engineering productivity and automation effectiveness. *.*

  

**Measurable Performance Outcomes**

Performance will be assessed against agreed project baselines and delivery objectives.

* **Automation coverage:** Increase automated coverage of prioritized regression scenarios.
* **Execution efficiency:** Reduce regression execution time through optimization and parallelization where feasible.
* **Test reliability:** Reduce flaky tests, false failures, and recurring automation issues.
* **CI/CD integration:** Ensure agreed test suites execute reliably through Azure DevOps pipelines with published results.
* **AI-assisted productivity:** Demonstrate measurable improvements in test development or maintenance efficiency using GitHub Copilot.
* **Code quality:** Maintain reusable, reviewable, secure, and maintainable automation code.
* **Defect detection:** Improve early identification of critical defects and regressions.
* **Knowledge sharing:** Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant software testing, automation, or Microsoft technology certifications are desirable but not mandatory.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior SDET with strong C# and MSTest expertise, proven Azure DevOps CI/CD experience, and the ability to apply GitHub Copilot effectively in test automation engineering. They can independently develop automation solutions, improve framework reliability, optimize test execution, and mentor other engineers while maintaining high standards of software quality.

**R&D at AVEVA**

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

title: Software Development Project Lead
description:
**Be a Part of the Technology Revolution**
There has never been a more exciting time to be part of an automotive technology company like Visteon. No industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity than today’s automotive industry. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place. Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider solely focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.
  
  
**Key objectives of this Role:**

* Experience leading large design & architecture of automotive embedded products is preferred.
* Knowledgeable in different products (Cluster, Display, ADAS).
* Knowledgeable in large project management and delivery.
* Work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams.
* Communication with rationale and build consensus with stakeholders.
* Prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.
* Develop new approaches to complex design problems.
* High level of domain expertise.
* Lead overall project delivery and coordination across projects / multiple internal teams.
* Leverage project management skills and understanding of multiple domains/technology to balance projects with varying schedules and priorities.
* Sustain and lead efforts in High Level Design (HLD) through complete ownership and commitment to quality standards. Act as the single point of contact for all aspects relating to HLD.
* Understand and review business requirements with the software delivery team, leveraging their knowledge of multiple domains.
* Work on assigning the requirements between different tech teams internally, identifying the interfaces and dependencies. Work to ensure there is a clear channel of communication between teams to meet deliveries.
* Work with the architects to define project-specific architectures. Understand and contribute to the technical solution from design through to code level. Analyze technical issues and guide the teams to find solutions.
* Lead project-focused technical discussions between the domains and internal teams. Work with the integration and testing teams on triaging of defects with accurate assignment of defects and analysis of complex defects that would overlap multiple domains.
* Work with external vendors/suppliers on tools and other software. Support supplier quality and assessments with other internal teams.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* On-Time Delivery: Achieve 85% or higher on-time delivery of customer milestones. Tracked on a sprint level.
* Code Coverage Metric: Percentage of Code Covered by Testing, Maintain code coverage at 85% or higher. Regularly monitored during each development cycle.
* Static Analysis KPI assessed at the end of each development iteration.
* Global Team Collaboration: Frequency and Effectiveness of Collaboration with Global Teams

**Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Computer engineering, Electronics Communication Engineering or mechatronics or equivalent.
* 10+ years of software experience.

**Desired Competencies:**

* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well.
* Dedicated: Devoted to a task or purpose with loyalty or integrity.
* Organized: Eye for detail and can put across ideas in a tangible form.
* Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks.
* Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Join NetApp's Data Protection and Business Continuity team as a Staff Product Manager where you'll drive innovation in solutions that help organizations safeguard their most valuable asset their data. We're looking for strategic thinkers who are passionate about solving customer challenges and shaping the future of data resilience. At NetApp, we believe diverse perspectives fuel innovation. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experience paths who share our commitment to customer success and continuous growth.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* As a Staff Product Manager, you'll own the product vision and strategy for our data protection portfolio:
* Define and execute product roadmaps that align with customer needs and market opportunities in data protection and business continuity
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, sales, marketing, and support teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes
* Engage directly with customers and partners to understand pain points, validate solutions, and drive product adoption
* Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to identify strategic opportunities
* Champion customer-centric innovation by translating complex requirements into actionable product features
* Drive business results through data-driven decision making, measuring product performance and customer satisfaction
* Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of ownership, belonging, and high performance
* Communicate product vision and progress to stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to executive leadership

**What We're Looking For**

* We value skills and potential over specific backgrounds. You'll thrive in this role if you bring:
* Product management experience with enterprise technology solutions, demonstrating ownership of product outcomes
* Strong customer empathy and ability to translate customer needs into product strategy
* Analytical mindset with experience making data-informed decisions and measuring success
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and business audiences
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and drive results in dynamic environments
* Growth mindset with curiosity about emerging technologies and market trends
* Experience or interest in data protection, backup, disaster recovery, or or related infrastructure domains

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in technology, business, or related field.
* Product management, technical, or customer-facing experience in enterprise software or infrastructure.
* Understanding of data management, cloud technologies, or storage concepts.
* Requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
  
  
**Our culture**
We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
  
  
**Submitting an Application**
To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
  
  
**AI Disclosure**
For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.
