title: Senior Digital Product Manager - Platform Product Management
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of platform capabilities that enable scalable, innovative digital experiences across the enterprise. This role requires a highly collaborative product leader with strong technical acumen, capable of partnering closely with engineering, design, and architecture teams to build reusable platform services and foundational capabilities that drive meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Define and execute the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise platform capabilities and services.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, design, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions.
* Translate complex business and technical requirements into product capabilities, features, and prioritized backlogs.
* Drive product discovery, customer research, and data-driven decision-making to identify opportunities and increase platform adoption.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate technical trade-offs, scalability requirements, integration patterns, and platform architecture decisions.
* Define product requirements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria while balancing customer value, business impact, and technical considerations.
* Establish platform standards, API design principles, developer experience best practices, and governance frameworks.
* Monitor platform performance, adoption, and customer feedback to continuously enhance the product experience.
* Champion AI-enabled capabilities and automation opportunities that improve customer experiences and business outcomes.
* Influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations to align priorities, drive execution, and deliver measurable results.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Digital Product Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education.
* 2+ years of platform product management experience supporting platform, API, developer, infrastructure, or enterprise technology products.
* Strong technical background with experience defining product strategies and roadmaps, leading platform product initiatives, and partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable technology solutions.
* Experience integrating AI-driven capabilities into digital products and customer experiences.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while effectively managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proven success managing the full product lifecycle, from discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and optimization.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams to assess technical trade-offs, scalability requirements, and solution design considerations.
* Ability to build strong partnerships and collaborate effectively across business, product, engineering, architecture, and operations teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and facilitate discussions that drive clarity, alignment, and decision-making.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Agile software delivery methodologies, information architecture, digital platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Proactive, innovative, and customer-centric mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Job Expectations**

* Strong technical and product management expertise, with experience defining product strategies and roadmaps while partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities, modernization initiatives, and enterprise technology solutions.

**Posting End Date**
25 Oct 2026
  
  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

**We Value Equal Opportunity**
Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
  
  
Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management
  
  
**General Summary**
Directs a comprehensive product strategy from product conception and definition through end of life. Functions as a central resource with design, process, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing, and distribution as the product(s) and/or product line(s) move through their lifecycle. Formulates and executes long-term roadmaps for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends. Directs those involved in the design, modification, and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance of the product or product line.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or technical related field.
* 2+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
* 1+ year of working in a large matrixed organization.
* 1+ year of working with operating budgets and/or project financials.
* 1+ year of negotiating 3rd party business agreements.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conducts analyses to assess marketability of products based on market, customer, technology, and other ecosystem demands.
* Serves as a market and business advisor in the formation of a business case for the development of a new product or product features (i.e., time to market, cost, market share).
* Drives the launch efforts of products and technologies for own area of responsibility by staying up to date on technological developments and customer needs through direct customer contact.
* Seeks out market information and displays an understanding of the marketplace to contribute to the product roadmap.
* Directs the development of moderately complex products and services under some supervision and communicates with individuals across functional teams.
* Completes product development and definition activities including determination of cost and impact, and interacts with sales team to generate forecasts.
* Stays up to date on competitors, technological advances, and product ecosystem and supports the development and design of new products.
* Maintains effective communication within own team and cross-functional team(s) on the management of a single product.
* Ensures successful cross-functional collaboration by ensuring that agreed upon KPIs and specifications are met for a single product, upon delivery by engineering team.
* Supports the establishment of product goals (e.g., performance, cost, timeline) and collaborates with others to execute tasks based on established goals.

**Level Of Responsibility**

* Working under some supervision.
* Making decisions that are low to moderate in impact; errors may have relatively minor financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.
* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey information that may be somewhat complex to others who may have limited knowledge of the subject in question. May require basic negotiation and influence, cooperation, tact, and diplomacy, etc.
* Completing tasks with multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; some planning and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively; mistakes may result in some rework.
* Exercising creativity to draft original documents, imagery, or work products within established guidelines.
* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or incomplete; intermediate data analysis/interpretation skills may be required.

**The Responsibilities Of This Role Do Not Include**

* Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).
* Influence over key organizational decisions.
* Role in strategic planning.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Level Up Your Career!**
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile and the indie PC and Console space.
  
  
As well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.
  
  
**Join the team!**
Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.
  
  
You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.
  
  
We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.
  
  
This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

**What You’ll Own**
Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.
  
  
You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.
  
  
**How We’ll Celebrate Your Success**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

**Essential**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

**Why Kwalee?**

* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food & Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch & Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
  
  
Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
  
  
We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Associate, Product Manager-Clinical Intelligence
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organization, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

The
**Senior Associate, Product Manager-Clinical Intelligence**
at Amplify Health plays a critical role in shaping the future of digital health solutions across Asia. This position operates at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation, driving transformative initiatives that improve patient outcomes and redefine healthcare delivery models.

The Product Manager is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of products—from ideation and concept validation to development, launch, and continuous optimization. This includes defining the product vision, setting strategic priorities, and ensuring that every product aligns with Amplify Health’s mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and effective.

The role requires a strategic thinker and hands-on executor who can translate high-level business objectives into actionable product roadmaps. The Product Manager leverages emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architectures to deliver innovative solutions that meet evolving customer needs and regulatory requirements.

As a key leader, the Product Manager collaborates cross-functionally with business, technology, and external partners to ensure seamless delivery. They champion customer-centric design principles, integrating behavioral insights and advanced analytics to personalize health experiences and improve engagement.

This position is ideal for a visionary product leader who thrives in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, embraces complexity, and is passionate about leveraging data and technology to transform healthcare across Asia.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Clinical Product Strategy & Vision**

* Own 1 clinical‑backed product strategy and multi‑year roadmap aligned to customer outcomes and business objectives.
* Drive the clinical, insurance and technology roadmap and vision of the product will intersect clinical and insurance
* Define target problems, personas, JTBDs, and success metrics for payers, providers, employers, and members.
* Drive data‑informed prioritization using frameworks such as WSJF, RICE, or equivalent value models.
* Make explicit trade‑offs balancing customer value, technical complexity, regulatory risk, and commercial impact.

**2) Discovery, Design & Outcomes**

* Run structured discovery (customer interviews, prototype tests, betas, VOC programs), and instrument products with dashboards/analytics to measure adoption, engagement, and outcomes.
* Champion API-First design for B2B scalability and enhanced Integration experience adoption through use-cases based interfaces, SDKs, Implementation guide.

**3) Interoperability & Data Architecture**

* Partner with architecture/engineering to deliver API first, cloud agnostic services and integrations, leveraging HL7 FHIR/SMART on FHIR for data models, auth and scopes, and secure EHR/payer connections.
* Ensure solutions can ingest/serve longitudinal health data and payer data, and support bulk data and near real-time workflows where appropriate.

**4) Privacy, Security & Compliance**

* Embed privacy by design; for example, align to PDPA in Singapore (and analogous regimes in other markets), and incorporate NEHR/HIB data sharing requirements in Singapore.
* Collaborate with InfoSec to implement ISO/IEC 27001 controls and pursue standard like HITRUST aligned assurance for healthcare customers, as appropriate to product scope.

**5) Delivery & Quality**

* Run Agile delivery with crisp backlog management, well-formed PRDs/Epics/Stories, and definition of done that includes security, privacy, performance, and observability.
* Drive experimentation and A/B testing; ensure robust post launch monitoring and incident response playbooks are in place for mission-critical B2B Integrations.

**6) Go-To-Market & Commercialisation**

* Partner with Sales, CS, Clinical and Operations on packaging, pricing, launch readiness, and product enablement playbooks, with minimum adjustments to different customer segment and country.
* Own success metrics: time to value, logo/market expansion, renewal/retention, measured clinical/financial outcomes per solution.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline required.
* Medical degree (MD/MBBS), health sciences background, MBA, or other advanced degree is highly advantageous.
* Minimum of 5+ years of experience in either:
* B2B product management with end‑to‑end lifecycle ownership and a demonstrated track record of delivering impactful features,
  **or**
* A healthcare insurer environment, with strong understanding of end‑to‑end processes, operational workflows, and key pain points.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, cross‑functional products within agile development environments.
* Strong interoperability awareness, including understanding of OpenAPI concepts, FHIR resources, and how SMART on FHIR enables secure, scoped access to health data (OAuth 2.0/OIDC and app launch patterns).
* Working knowledge of data privacy and security requirements, including PDPA obligations (consent, purpose limitation, protection, and breach notification), with experience collaborating with Information Security teams toward ISO 27001 controls.
* Demonstrated proficiency in prioritization and value‑based decision‑making, leveraging frameworks such as WSJF and RICE, defining KPIs and OKRs, and applying product analytics to measure outcomes.

**Preferred:**

* Possess understanding in insurance and healthcare ecosystems and products would be advantageous.
* Experience with AI/ML in healthcare (e.g., risk scores, triage, personalization) and familiarity with governance and policy framework would be preferred.
* Experience integrating with payer/provider systems using FHIR APIs (R4/R5), and familiarity with SMART App Launch and Backend Services patterns.

**Competencies & Core Characteristics:**

We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale-up environment:

* **Health InsurTech Domain Expertise:**
  Knowledge and understanding of how insurers, providers, regulators in the healthcare industry work end to end from payments, integrations, operations, product, member, claims and clinical journeys. Possess either deep knowledge in 1 or 2 APAC markets with additional context on what is best in class and deep understanding of client pain points in the end to end lifecycle and which pain points customers are willing to pay for to solve.
* **Clinical Domain Knowledge:**
  Knowledge of clinical coding terminology for providers and insurers (such as CPT, ICD10CM, ICD11, etc.) Knowledge of clinical tools including coders, groupers, and classifications. Understanding of clinical measurements and outcome frameworks such as AHQR, HEDIS, etc. Knowledge of WHO frameworks for member program pathways, clinical guidelines and other clinical interventions. Knowledge and understanding of how clinical variation impacts insurers and providers. Knowledge of CMS based guidelines for clinical payment arrangements, quality programs, screening and prevention and other clinical payment applications.
* **Technical Expertise Domain:**
  Demonstrates strong technical acumen to bridge business and technology effectively, ensuring scalable and secure product delivery. Possesses proficiency in agile methodologies, data analytics, cloud platforms, and API-driven architectures, while maintaining awareness of emerging technologies such as AI/ML and IoT. Applies privacy-by-design principles and collaborates seamlessly with UX/UI teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.
* **Customer Obsessed & Outcome-driven:**
  Act as a relentless advocate for customers, prioritizing user needs, integration experiences, and real‑world outcomes in every decision. Practice continuous discovery, including customer interviews, structured betas, and VOC loops, to validate problems and solutions. Champion user‑centric and API‑consumer‑centric design, collaborating closely with UX/UI and engineering to maximize adoption and engagement. Define and track clear north‑star metrics (adoption, engagement, clinical and financial impact) using real‑time dashboards and analytics.
* **Strategic Architect:**
  Ability to translate business vision into scalable product architecture and long-term roadmap. Demonstrates foresight in anticipating market trends and aligning product strategy with organizational goals.
* **Data-Driven Decisiveness:**
  Leverage data, experimentation, and evidence‑based insights to inform prioritization, validate hypotheses, and optimize product outcomes. Apply structured prioritization frameworks (e.g., WSJF, RICE) and OKRs to balance customer value, risk, and business impact. Comfortable running experiments (including A/B tests where appropriate) and learning quickly from results—both successes and failures.
* **Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer:**
  Builds strong relationships across diverse teams, fostering collaboration and alignment between business, technology, and external partners. Skilled at influencing without authority and driving consensus in complex environments.
* **Coach & Talent Multiplier:**
  Empowers team members through mentorship and guidance, creating an environment that encourages learning and growth. Recognises and nurtures talent to maximize team performance.
* **Resilient Operator:**
  Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments, maintaining composure under pressure. Demonstrates adaptability and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges and deliver results.
* **Insatiable Curiosity:**
  Continuously explores emerging technologies and industry trends. Brings creativity and a willingness to experiment with new ideas to drive innovation and differentiation.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
**Company Overview**
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
  
  
**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:

+ Analog and custom IC design
+ Standard cell design and optimization
+ Physical implementation
+ Design migration and design reuse
+ Semiconductor design automation
+ Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows

* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.
  
  
**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
  
  
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

description: BlueOptima is a company built on transparency, collaboration, and accountability. A total number of 110+ employees (and increasing every day) from different nationalities and with over 25 languages spoken.Location: BangaloreDepartment: EngineeringJob DescriptionCode Insights is BlueOptima's application security product — helping engineering and security teams ship secure code faster by catching exposed secrets, static analysis (SAST) vulnerabilities, and risky open-source dependencies (SCA) before they reach production. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own this product end to end: its roadmap, its narrative, and its commercial outcome.This is a high-agency role. You will set the AppSec point of view for Code Insights, defend it under pressure from CISOs and security architects in customer meetings, and hold your own presenting strategy, trade-offs, and results to BlueOptima's exec and C-suite team. This isn't a seat where someone else makes the calls and you execute tickets — you're expected to have a point of view, in the room, internally and externally, and defend it.Alongside the core mandate, you'll have room to shape how Code Insights grows through product-led channels — using its shift-left, developer-first design (CLI, pre-commit hooks, CI/CD scanning) as a wedge for organic adoption. This is a growth opportunity for the right person to build.What Impact Looks Like:We want whoever takes this role to know, concretely, what “doing this job well” means — outcomes we'll hold you to, not just activities:Roadmap & delivery — Code Insights ships against a roadmap you've defined with key stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data and Revenue teams, and can defend, grounded in AppSec domain reality (SAST/SCA, secrets detection, OWASP alignment), not just inbound requests. Customer-facing conversion — You're a credible voice in front of CISOs, SecOps leads, and security architects; customer pilots you own convert to paid, renewed, and expanded accounts. Retention & commercial outcome — Success is tied directly to retention goals, so you're accountable for customers staying and growing, alongside deals closing. Organic growth — if you lean into the PLG opportunity, you'll have room to build and own a self-serve growth motion — upside on top of the core mandate. QualificationsKey Responsibilities Own Direction and Roadmap (Core Mandate)Set and defend the product roadmap for Code Insights — secrets detection, SAST, SCA/dependency risk — rooted in real AppSec domain expertise, not secondhand requirements. Partner with engineering to ship high-quality, well-scoped releases; own the trade-off calls when scope, timeline, and security depth conflict. Report product health, risk, and roadmap progress directly to senior leadership — including exec/C-suite settings — with the judgment to say what leadership needs to hear, not just what's easy to report. Be the External and Internal Face of the ProductPitch Code Insights directly to CISOs, SecOps leads, and security architects; be comfortable being challenged on technical depth and defending the product's position against competing SAST, SCA, and secrets-detection tools. Own customer pilots end to end, from technical validation through commercial conversion — you carry the pilot, not just support it. Close the loop from field to roadmap: translate customer and prospect input into product decisions, and be willing to say no to requests that don't fit the strategy. Represent the product internally to sales, marketing, and execs as the person who can explain not just what Code Insights does, but why it wins and where it's still catching up. Grow the Product-Led Opportunity (Growth Track)Use Code Insights' shift-left, developer-first design (CLI, pre-commit hooks, CI/CD integration) as a foundation to build organic, self-serve adoption. Partner with Design and Marketing to test and refine the self-serve journey — from first scan to habitual use to internal champion. Treated as a strategic opportunity to grow into, not a prerequisite — we'll support you in building this muscle if it's new to you. What We're Looking For:We're looking for technical judgment and business fluency in the same person:Seniority — 6–7+ years in product management or a customer-facing technical role, with real ownership of roadmap decisions, not just execution. Security domain grounding — working knowledge of application security concepts (SAST, SCA, secrets detection, or software supply chain security) sufficient to hold your own with security practitioners. Deep AppSec expertise is a strong plus; a fast learner with adjacent technical credibility can also thrive here. Business and interpersonal range — we're actively looking for candidates with an MBA or equivalent business training who pair that with technical depth — people who can move fluently between an engineering standup, a CISO pitch, and an exec update in the same week. Strong written and verbal communication, executive presence, and the judgment to know when to push back matter as much as domain knowledge. Commercial instinct — comfortable owning outcomes tied to revenue and retention, not just shipped features; you think in terms of business impact, not just backlog throughput. PM fundamentals — track record managing roadmaps, backlog hygiene (Jira or equivalent), and clear stakeholder reporting. Nice to have, not required — prior exposure to PLG or self-serve growth motions. We see this as an opportunity for you to grow into, not a filter we're screening for. This role has a direct line of visibility to the exec/C-suite team on Code Insights strategy and results — you'll be expected to present, and defend, your own work in that setting.Additional InformationBenefits:33 days of holidays (this includes public and religious holidays)Contributions to your Provident Fund which can be matched by the company above the statutory minimum as agreedGratuity paymentsPrivate Medical Insurance provided by the company (Employee + Spouse + 2 Children + 2 Parents)Personal Accident Insurance (Employee Only)12 Weeks Paid Paternity Leave, 6 months Maternity leaveSupport with childcare costs (50%)Work from Home Equipment allowanceFlexible Work from Home policy - 2 days home p/wFlexible Work from Long Distance - 4 weeks a yearSponsored Learning OpportunitiesTeam SocialsStay connected with us on LinkedIn or keep an eye on our career page for future opportunities!

title: Digital Product Professional
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced digital product professional to lead the strategy, development, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of customer-facing mobile applications. The role requires strong product ownership, technical understanding, stakeholder management, and experience managing complex digital platforms throughout their lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will combine customer experience expertise with technical product knowledge to drive product adoption, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Product Strategy and Ownership**

* Define and manage product vision, roadmaps, feature priorities, and business outcomes for mobile applications.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable deliverables.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, release schedules, dependencies, and delivery priorities.
* Lead product discovery, refinement, demonstrations, reviews, and stakeholder alignment.
* Oversee user acceptance testing, business readiness, release approvals, and post-launch improvements.

**Mobile Application Delivery and Technology**

* Guide the development and enhancement of iOS and Android applications.
* Work closely with UX/UI designers, developers, architects, QA, DevOps, and backend engineering teams.
* Coordinate integrations involving APIs, CRM, ERP, payment gateways, authentication, content platforms, and analytics systems.
* Ensure product requirements address performance, scalability, security, privacy, accessibility, and device compatibility.
* Monitor application performance, crash reports, availability, and technical quality using relevant monitoring tools.
* Coordinate application releases, app-store submissions, deployment readiness, and rollback planning.

**Customer Experience and Product Optimisation**

* Improve digital customer journeys, including discovery, enquiries, onboarding, documentation, payments, service requests, and ongoing engagement.
* Use customer research, behavioural analytics, feedback, and experimentation to identify product improvements.
* Define and monitor KPIs such as adoption, retention, conversion, feature usage, task completion, application reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive product launches, user education, adoption initiatives, and continuous improvement.

**Operations and Partner Management**

* Manage external delivery partners and coordinate internal teams to ensure delivery quality and accountability.
* Monitor service levels, incident resolution, support performance, recurring defects, and root-cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident response, escalations, stakeholder communications, and permanent corrective actions.
* Conduct regular product and service reviews, track risks, and drive resolution of delivery and operational issues.
* Manage technical debt, platform upgrades, security remediation, and ongoing product sustainability.

**Stakeholder and Performance Management**

* Collaborate with business, technology, operations, customer service, and leadership teams.
* Maintain transparent reporting on roadmap progress, delivery milestones, risks, adoption, and realised business value.
* Balance business priorities with customer needs, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational stability.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in digital products, business technology, or customer experience, including at least 5 years in a Product Owner, Product Manager, or equivalent mobile product leadership role.
* Mandatory experience in real estate, property development, property portals, community management, or PropTech.
* Proven experience owning large-scale mobile applications from strategy and discovery through development, launch, optimisation, and live operations.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management, roadmap planning, release governance, and product analytics.
* Working knowledge of React Native, iOS and Android delivery, APIs, backend services, cloud platforms, and enterprise integrations.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Photos
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. description:
The Role

INSYS Digital Systems is a Bengaluru-based deeptech company with over a decade of experience designing and manufacturing safety-critical power electronics and embedded systems for Indian Railways — including SMPS-based Integrated Power Supply (IPS) systems and Digital Axle Counters. We are now entering the telecom power, data centre power, and solar energy markets, leveraging our proven expertise in high-efficiency power conversion, battery management, surge protection, ruggedised enclosures, and remote monitoring — all directly applicable to solar inverters, BESS, and balance-of-system power electronics. We are looking for a seasoned Sales Manager to own all three verticals end-to-end: build the pipeline from scratch, establish relationships with telecom operators, tower companies, data centre builders, colocation providers, and solar EPC/C&I buyers, and drive our first commercial wins across these verticals.

Key Responsibilities

* **Market Development:** Identify, map, and penetrate the Indian telecom power and data centre power infrastructure markets —tower companies (Indus Towers, ATC India, Summit Digitel), system integrators, fibre network providers, hyperscale data centre builders (NTT, STT, Yotta, CtrlS), colocation providers, edge/enterprise DC operators, solar EPC companies, C&I rooftop buyers, and DISCOM/SECI channel partners.
* **Sales Pipeline:** Build and manage a structured sales pipeline from lead generation through vendor empanelment, RFQ response, technical presentation, field trial, and purchase order closure across both verticals.
* **Key Account Management:** Develop and own relationships with procurement, engineering, and energy/infrastructure teams at target accounts. Become the go-to contact for INSYS in the power infrastructure ecosystem.
* **Channel & Partnerships:** Identify and onboard channel partners, telecom EPC contractors, DC MEP contractors, solar EPC firms, and OEM/white-label opportunities to extend market reach beyond direct sales.
* **Techno-Commercial Proposals:** Work closely with the INSYS engineering team to prepare technical proposals, compliance matrices, and competitive pricing for -48V DC rectifier systems, modular UPS/power shelves, outdoor power cabinets, battery backup solutions, small cell power units, solar inverters, and battery energy storage systems (BESS).
* **Vendor Empanelment:** Drive INSYS through the vendor qualification and empanelment process at major operators, tower companies, and DC operators, including TEC certification coordination.
* **Market Intelligence:** Track competitor activity , pricing trends, technology shifts (lithium-ion adoption, solar-hybrid, 5G power demands, 48V DC distribution, ALMM-listed modules, net metering policies), and feed insights into product roadmap decisions.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own quarterly and annual revenue targets for telecom, data centre, and solar verticals. Report on pipeline health, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy.
* **Field Trials & Pilot Deployments:** Coordinate pilot installations at customer sites, manage trial documentation, and convert successful pilots into commercial rollouts.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work with R&D on product-market fit, with operations on delivery timelines, and with management on pricing strategy and investment decisions for all three verticals.

Candidate ProfileRequired

* 8–12 years of sales/business development experience in telecom power, data centre power infrastructure, solar energy, or power electronics
* Existing relationships with procurement or energy/infrastructure teams at Indian telecom operators, tower companies, DC builders/operators, solar EPC companies, or telecom/DC/solar EPC firms
* Track record of closing B2B deals worth ₹1–10 Cr+ in the telecom, data centre, or power infrastructure space
* Experience with the full vendor lifecycle: empanelment, RFQ, technical evaluation, commercial negotiation, and PO closure
* Working knowledge of power systems: -48V DC rectifiers, modular UPS, battery backup, outdoor power cabinets, SPDs, BMS, PDUs, solar inverters, and/or BESS
* Willingness to travel across India (30–40% travel)
* BE/B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, or Telecommunications Engineering

Preferred

* Experience selling into Indus Towers, ATC India, Summit Digitel, Jio, Airtel energy/infra divisions, or data centre operators (NTT, STT, Yotta, CtrlS, Nxtra, Colt), or solar EPC/C&I channels
* Familiarity with TEC certification, GR-487-CORE, ETSI EN 300 132, and Uptime Institute tier standards
* Prior experience in a company entering a new market vertical — comfort with ambiguity, building from zero, and wearing multiple hats
* Knowledge of solar-hybrid systems, lithium-ion BESS, 48V DC power distribution, ALMM compliance, and net metering/open access regulations
* MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required

What We Offer

* **Ground-floor ownership:** You are building this vertical, not inheriting it. Direct reporting to the CEO with full autonomy over the telecom go-to-market.
* **Competitive compensation:** Fixed salary commensurate with experience + performance-linked incentive tied to pipeline milestones and closed revenue.
* **Bengaluru base:** Office in Bengaluru with flexibility for remote working between customer visits.

* **Build practical business models. Develop Excel-based financial, market, and operational models that support scenario planning, opportunity assessment, prioritization, and executive decision making.**

* **Set the standard for data quality and insight generation. Ensure analytical rigor, data integrity, validation, and transparency of assumptions in all work products.**

title: Associate Performance Marketing Manager
description:
*1 Line JD: A hands-on growth and performance marketing role for someone who can connect media, creative, consumer behaviour, and the full funnel to find and scale the next growth lever for As-It-Is Nutrition.*

<aside>

**Our Mission**

As-It-Is Nutrition exists to make honest, effective sports nutrition accessible to every Indian household, not only serious gym-goers. We are building a trusted, mainstream nutrition brand by putting real ingredients, transparency, and results above hype.

</aside>

About As-It-Is Nutrition

As-It-Is Nutrition is a digital-first sports nutrition business with approximately ₹250 crore in revenue. We are already one of the largest brands in the category, but there is a much bigger opportunity ahead: becoming a household name for a broader set of Indian consumers.

The marketing function is evolving from a founder-led setup into a structured, high-performing team. This is an opportunity to join that journey early and help build a sharper, more repeatable growth engine.

The Role

We are looking for an **Assistant Manager, Growth and Performance Marketing** who is curious about why performance changes, not only what the dashboard reports.

You will work closely with the Head of Marketing and cross-functional creative, content, design, analytics, and commerce partners. You will manage campaigns, diagnose the full funnel, turn data into testable hypotheses, and help the team make better decisions about audiences, creatives, offers, landing pages, and budgets.

This is a hands-on role for someone with 2 to 3 years of experience who is ready to move beyond platform operations and become a strong growth problem-solver.

**You will report to:** Head of Marketing

What You Will Own1. Performance Marketing

* Manage and optimise campaigns across Meta, Google, and other relevant paid channels.
* Track performance against revenue, CAC or CPR, ROAS, conversion, and scale potential.
* Make clear recommendations on when to scale, hold, iterate, or stop a campaign or creative.
* Monitor budget allocation and identify where spend can work harder.

2. Full-Funnel Growth Diagnosis

* Read the journey from spend to audience, creative, click, landing-page view, conversion, AOV, and ROAS.
* Identify where performance is leaking and determine whether the issue sits in targeting, creative, landing page, offer, product, pricing, or checkout.
* Look beyond top-line efficiency metrics to understand what is actually driving or limiting growth.

3. Growth Opportunity Discovery

* Find under-funded audiences, inefficient segments, regional opportunities, and hidden signals in campaign and customer data.
* Investigate anomalies before changing budgets or targeting.
* Turn observations into prioritised opportunities with a clear business case.

4. Creative Performance

* Develop consumer hypotheses, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative briefs.
* Work closely with designers, copywriters, editors, and creators to improve ad performance.
* Connect creative learnings with audience and funnel data so each test produces a useful next step.
* Build a clear view of creative fatigue, winning angles, and refresh requirements.

5. Experimentation

* Use a disciplined process: **Observation → Hypothesis → Experiment → Metric → Decision**.
* Define what each test is expected to teach, not only what it is expected to improve.
* Maintain a learning log so successful insights can be reused across products, audiences, and channels.
* Balance testing velocity with sufficient signal and commercial relevance.

6. CRO and Funnel Improvement

* Partner with relevant teams to improve landing pages, offers, product pages, and checkout journeys.
* Diagnose gaps between clicks and landing-page views, traffic and conversion, or ROAS and AOV.
* Recommend practical changes based on evidence, then measure the impact.

Your First 90 DaysFirst 30 Days: Learn and Diagnose

* Understand the product portfolio, customer segments, growth targets, current channel mix, and performance baselines.
* Audit campaign structure, audience allocation, creative performance, landing pages, and existing reporting.
* Build a clear view of the most important funnel leaks and unanswered questions.

Days 31 to 60: Test and Improve

* Launch prioritised experiments across audience, creative, offer, and landing-page variables.
* Create a simple, reliable cadence for campaign reviews and learning documentation.
* Work with the creative team to translate data into sharper hooks, briefs, and variants.

Days 61 to 90: Scale the Learning System

* Identify repeatable growth opportunities and recommend where to scale, hold, iterate, or stop.
* Improve budget allocation using channel, audience, creative, and funnel evidence.
* Establish a working growth scorecard and a backlog of high-quality experiments.

What We Are Looking For

* 2 to 3 years of hands-on performance or growth marketing experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of Meta Ads and experience managing real budgets.
* Working knowledge of Google Ads and other relevant acquisition channels.
* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC or CPR, AOV, CTR, CPC, CPM, landing-page view rate, CVR, frequency, and creative fatigue.
* Ability to turn numbers into questions, hypotheses, and decisions, not only dashboards.
* Creative thinking and the ability to identify multiple consumer and messaging angles for the same product.
* Comfort writing or shaping ad concepts, hooks, and briefs.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets and analytics skills. GA4 experience is preferred.
* D2C or e-commerce experience is preferred.

The Mindset That Will Help You Succeed

You see a number and ask a useful question:

* Why is a high-performing segment receiving so little spend?
* Why are clicks strong but landing-page views weak?
* Why is ROAS improving while AOV is falling?
* Is the audience weak, or are we communicating the wrong reason to buy?

The goal is not to run more experiments. The goal is to learn faster and make performance work harder.

This Role May Not Be for You If

* You only report spend, CTR, and ROAS without diagnosing what changed.
* You know Ads Manager but are not curious about consumers, creative, and the funnel.
* You default to standard audience structures without a hypothesis.
* You wait for the creative team to decide what should be tested.
* You cannot explain whether a result is scalable.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Quality of campaign decisions and budget allocation.
* Ability to identify meaningful growth signals and funnel leaks.
* Improvement in acquisition efficiency, conversion, and scalable revenue.
* Quality and pace of creative, audience, and funnel experiments.

---------------

Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of Sales Manager for its Amazon Shipping / Ship with Amazon (SWA) team. The goal is to develop easy-to-use, reliable and transparent transportation services that beat all existing shipping alternatives for our customers. In doing this, Amazon Shipping is deeply studying customer shipping needs and building innovative, market-leading solutions that will organically attract customers towards our services. To help us succeed in this large endeavor, we are looking for dynamic, self-starting and entrepreneurial individual who will organize, execute and deliver key features to the Amazon Shipping portfolio.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Define, design, launch and manage new products and programs for improving experience and reducing churn within the Amazon Shipping shipper cohort and thereby enabling scale.  
2. Gather requirements and conceptualize solutions to solve a business and shipper problems and work with key stake holders across various functions to define and launch the product/program.  
3. Monitor key metrics on the program and work with all involved stakeholder teams to drive necessary action with field teams, business ops, finance, product and leadership teams, to achieve goals. Manage Daily/weekly performance, build mechanisms to detect and drive down defects and work on continuous improvements for all processes.  
4. Launch and expand the program as per the business requirements and build/own all the long term planning, program and product roadmap for Amazon Shipping. Work extensively on industry bench marking, do shipper studies and work with Commercial team to understand the requirements of our prospective Shippers and work on building these capabilities.  
5. Use customer and market feedback, competitive analysis and bench marking, and business metrics to make informed decisions.  
6. Setup and manage end-to-end operational, performance measurement and customer satisfaction related processes for all shippers with whom Ship with amazon is tied up.  
  
A day in the life  
This role will require exceptional communication and influencing skills, and will work to influence stakeholders across shippers, Program, Operations and Tech teams. This role will require the ability to work effectively in a fast paced, startup environment, partnering with others as needed, and the ability to exercise sound judgment solving novel problems without clear direction from leadership. The successful candidate has demonstrated the ability to solve complex logistics challenges and possesses bias for action and deliver results in the role.

Amazon Shipping is the externalization arm for generating revenue by serving external shippers. We are leveraging our existing transportation network which serves A.in customers and use its infrastructure and capacity to serve external shippers.

* 6+ years of sales experience

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

This role of Marketing Executive will support the Senior Marketing Manager of our Specialty business within the Financial Lines and Crisis Management teams. Additionally, they will provide support to the newly created Private Equity and M&A P&L. They should be a high-performing, self-motivated individual who can manage multiple projects successfully to achieve exceptional commercial results.

Our marketing activities focus on three core objectives:  
Distinguishing the Gallagher brand from our peers;  
Thought-leadership and insight-led campaigns that drive organic sales leads and revenue opportunities;  
Contributing to a differentiated client experience that deepens retention and advocacy.

The Marketing Executive will play an integral role in creating value for clients through the delivery of integrated sales & marketing plans and campaigns that align to each business’s specific objectives and deliver on Gallagher’s near-term and longer-term growth aspirations. This includes effective collaboration within the broader marketing and communications team.

In addition to supporting the Specialty business, the Marketing Executive will also contribute to Gallagher’s European marketing efforts, ensuring content and activity is aligned with regional strategies.

The Marketing Executive will contribute to the delivery of our digital and social marketing plans to reach and engage target audiences. The aim is to increase conversion, improve customer journeys, and enhance the user experience throughout. This includes a focus on web metrics and ROI reporting.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Support senior marketing colleagues in delivering marketing plans to support our corporate, divisional, and business aims.
* Ensure all marketing activity is grounded in a strong understanding of business goals, products, industry, customer needs, and competitive opportunities.
* Ensure all marketing activity follows the processes and best practices required to deliver excellent results.
* Collaborate with internal marketing colleagues to ensure that marketing plans are agreed upon, delivered to deadline, and achieve the desired results. Frequently evaluate activity against the plan and review post-completion for areas to improve.
* Understand campaign KPIs and communicate clearly back to the marketing team as required, particularly analytics.
* Proactively identify new marketing opportunities as well as respond to requests from marketing colleagues.
* Be creative in the approach to marketing and be willing to test and trial new activities.  
  Challenge the boundaries of marketing, ensuring all forms of media and channels are deployed when delivering campaigns.
* Ensure necessary compliance sign-off for marketing activities, including FinProms approval.  
  Monitor industry and wider marketing best practices, as well as the activities of competitors, to ensure we stay one step ahead.
* Write compelling and effective copy for marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and tone of voice.
* Brief relevant teams, including creative and digital teams, to ensure the successful execution of marketing activities.

**Stakeholder accountabilities**

  

* Develop key relationships within the wider marketing community and across the Gallagher group.
* Work with Sales, Marketing & Communication colleagues to ensure marketing activity is joined up to deliver customer-centric and best in class marketing.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of our core customer groups.

**Operational excellence**

* Apply project and campaign management tools and best practice to ensure projects are delivered effectively, efficiently and to budget.
* Always look for efficiencies in respect of how the team is working; identify issues and challenges early on and work with Senior Marketing Managers to develop tangible ways to improve performance.
* Understand the changing regulatory and legal environment around marketing activities, ensure risks are factored in to all strategies and activities, flagging potential risks as required to senior management and putting in place all measures to suitable mitigate risk.
* Adhere to brand guidelines and become an active champion of the brand.
    
  Ensure necessary FinProms/compliance sign off is obtained in a timely fashion and in full adherence with corporate policies.
* Carry out duties following internal policies and procedures in accordance with applicable laws, rules, regulation, good governance and Gallagher’s shared values, in particular, putting customers at the heart of our business.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* Educated to degree standard or higher (desirable) or equivalent experience.

**Experience:**

* 3+ years of marketing experience in either a commercial sector or agency setting, ideally financial services.
* Execution of social media and email marketing campaigns.
* Execution of marketing projects adhering to best practice marketing principles.
* Experience of delivery of End-to-End marketing campaigns.
* Experience of managing internal stakeholders, and working as part of a wider marketing function.

**Skills/other**

* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively.
* Results-driven mindset.
* Exceptional project management skills.
* Acute attention to detail.
* Builds rapport easily with colleagues and gains trust.
* Working within structured project methodology and reporting.
* Excellent planning skills and ability to anticipate future outcomes and manage risks to projects.
* Ability to meet consistently high quality standards whilst managing a variety of projects and deadlines.
* Experience of using email client software, Linkedin, website CMS, Google analytics, Adobe creative software desirable.
* MS Office expertise.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:

Edsmart is looking for a **Performance Marketing professional** who can drive measurable and profitable growth across our e-commerce and digital channels.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing **Meta Ads, Google Ads and e-commerce campaigns**, analysing data, testing creatives and audiences, and continuously improving conversion and profitability.

* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

title: GridBeats APM Growth Leader
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The GridBeats APM (Asset Performance Management) Growth Leader deﬁnes and implements the business development strategy for the Power Transmission, Distribution and Industry business segment, with a speciﬁc focus on digital transformation and predictive maintenance services. You will drive the adoption of our Asset Performance Management (APM) portfolio by analyzing the installed base and market trends to define high-impact commercial campaigns, digital asset monitoring strategies, and strategic partnerships that optimize grid reliability and asset health.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Pillars of the Role**

* Commercial Growth: Develop and scale digital asset monitoring packages and value-based sales campaigns that drive commercial growth and long-term customer digital engagement.
* Strategic Market Development: Conduct deep-dive market studies and forge strategic partnerships to accelerate the GridBeats APM roadmap.
* Operational Excellence: Lead cross-functional alignment between engineering, sales, and digital product teams to ensure APM solutions meet evolving grid requirements and customer pain points.

**Operational Activities**

* Growth Strategy: Deﬁne the growth strategy for each product line using historical performance, installed base analytics, and regional requirements. Propose, structure, and deploy external growth strategies, including partnerships and inorganic growth opportunities, to expand our digital footprint.
* Asset Health & Lifecycle Management:

○ Design and deploy service oﬀerings for high-voltage assets (transformers, breakers, cables, disconnectors) that transition customers from reactive to predictive maintenance.
  
  
○ Leverage APM data (e.g., DGA for transformers, Partial Discharge for cables/ GIS, contact wear for breakers) to build compelling, data-driven value propositions.
  
  

* Campaign Deployment: Steer multi-channel commercial campaigns specifically tailored for digital adoption, measuring success through KPIs like number of opportunities generated and converted into orders. Implement and maintain dashboards and KPIs to measure the success of commercial campaigns and growth initiatives.
* Solution Bundling: Create integrated packages combining hardware, ﬁeld services, and software (GridBeats APM) to provide end-to-end lifecycle support. Collaborate with technical and commercial teams to bundle GridBeats software with hardware renewals and life-extension projects.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate with Sales, Key Account Managers, Engineering, and Finance to ensure alignment on solutions and commercial governance.
* Innovation & Knowledge Sharing: Foster a culture of technical innovation, promote feedback loops for lessons learned, and support cross-functional skill development.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a primary point of contact for clients, delivering technical brieﬁngs.

**Technical Domain Knowledge**
The successful candidate must possess a deep understanding of the following asset health parameters:
  
  

* HV Asset Health: Ability to interpret Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA), bushing power factor, and thermal data of transformers. Understanding of mechanical timing, SF6 pressure, and contact wear as key indicators for maintenance intervention for Circuit Breakers. Expertise in partial discharge monitoring and thermal imaging to prevent catastrophic failures and unplanned outages of Cables. Proﬁciency in identifying how external environment, load cycling, and grid transients impact the degradation of electrical infrastructure.
* Digital Ecosystems: Demonstrated experience in software-based asset monitoring, cloud/data lake architectures, OT networking, and complex software licensing models.

**Essential Requirements**

* Professional Background: Demonstrated experience as a Project Manager or

Business Development Leader in the industrial or power sector.
  
  

* Technical Proﬁciency:

○ Familiarity with high-voltage products: circuit breakers, GIS/AIS, power transformers, and cabling.
  
  
○ Solid understanding of IEC standards and industrial asset maintenance best practices.
  
  

* Strategy & Analysis: Proven track record in identifying business opportunities through market analysis and managing cross-functional projects.
* Communication: Proficiency in English
* Operational Tools: Proﬁciency with Salesforce and Microsoft Oﬃce suite.
* Qualification: Formal degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical ﬁeld.
* Preferable to have direct experience with digital APM (Asset Performance Management) platforms or remote monitoring systems.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:
