description: About Amplify Health Who We Are Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.As an ISO27001 certified organization, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.Our Vision and Ambition To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.The PositionSummaryThe Senior Associate, Product Manager, Clinical Intelligence at Amplify Health plays a critical role in shaping the future of digital health solutions across Asia. This position operates at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation, driving transformative initiatives that improve patient outcomes and redefine healthcare delivery models.The Product Manager is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of products—from ideation and concept validation to development, launch, and continuous optimization. This includes defining the product vision, setting strategic priorities, and ensuring that every product aligns with Amplify Health’s mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and effective.The role requires a strategic thinker and hands-on executor who can translate high-level business objectives into actionable product roadmaps. The Product Manager leverages emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architectures to deliver innovative solutions that meet evolving customer needs and regulatory requirements.As a key leader, the Product Manager collaborates cross-functionally with business, technology, and external partners to ensure seamless delivery. They champion customer-centric design principles, integrating behavioral insights and advanced analytics to personalize health experiences and improve engagement.This position is ideal for a visionary product leader who thrives in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, embraces complexity, and is passionate about leveraging data and technology to transform healthcare across Asia.Responsibilities1) Clinical Product Strategy & VisionOwn 1 clinical‑backed product strategy and multi‑year roadmap aligned to customer outcomes and business objectives.Drive the clinical, insurance and technology roadmap and vision of the product will intersect clinical and insurance Define target problems, personas, JTBDs, and success metrics for payers, providers, employers, and members.Drive data‑informed prioritization using frameworks such as WSJF, RICE, or equivalent value models.Make explicit trade‑offs balancing customer value, technical complexity, regulatory risk, and commercial impact.2) Discovery, Design & OutcomesRun structured discovery (customer interviews, prototype tests, betas, VOC programs), and instrument products with dashboards/analytics to measure adoption, engagement, and outcomes.Champion API-First design for B2B scalability and enhanced Integration experience adoption through use-cases based interfaces, SDKs, Implementation guide.3) Interoperability & Data ArchitecturePartner with architecture/engineering to deliver API first, cloud agnostic services and integrations, leveraging HL7 FHIR/SMART on FHIR for data models, auth and scopes, and secure EHR/payer connections. Ensure solutions can ingest/serve longitudinal health data and payer data, and support bulk data and near real-time workflows where appropriate. 4) Privacy, Security & ComplianceEmbed privacy by design; for example, align to PDPA in Singapore (and analogous regimes in other markets), and incorporate NEHR/HIB data sharing requirements in Singapore. Collaborate with InfoSec to implement ISO/IEC 27001 controls and pursue standard like HITRUST aligned assurance for healthcare customers, as appropriate to product scope. 5) Delivery & QualityRun Agile delivery with crisp backlog management, well-formed PRDs/Epics/Stories, and definition of done that includes security, privacy, performance, and observability.Drive experimentation and A/B testing; ensure robust post launch monitoring and incident response playbooks are in place for mission-critical B2B Integrations.6) Go-To-Market & CommercialisationPartner with Sales, CS, Clinical and Operations on packaging, pricing, launch readiness, and product enablement playbooks, with minimum adjustments to different customer segment and country.Own success metrics: time to value, logo/market expansion, renewal/retention, measured clinical/financial outcomes per solution.Candidate ProfileExperience and QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline required. Medical degree (MD/MBBS), health sciences background, MBA, or other advanced degree is highly advantageous. Minimum of 5+ years of experience in either: B2B product management with end‑to‑end lifecycle ownership and a demonstrated track record of delivering impactful features, orA healthcare insurer environment, with strong understanding of end‑to‑end processes, operational workflows, and key pain points.Proven ability to deliver complex, cross‑functional products within agile development environments. Strong interoperability awareness, including understanding of OpenAPI concepts, FHIR resources, and how SMART on FHIR enables secure, scoped access to health data (OAuth 2.0/OIDC and app launch patterns). Working knowledge of data privacy and security requirements, including PDPA obligations (consent, purpose limitation, protection, and breach notification), with experience collaborating with Information Security teams toward ISO 27001 controls. Demonstrated proficiency in prioritization and value‑based decision‑making, leveraging frameworks such as WSJF and RICE, defining KPIs and OKRs, and applying product analytics to measure outcomes.Preferred:Possess understanding in insurance and healthcare ecosystems and products would be advantageous.Experience with AI/ML in healthcare (e.g., risk scores, triage, personalization) and familiarity with governance and policy framework would be preferred.Experience integrating with payer/provider systems using FHIR APIs (R4/R5), and familiarity with SMART App Launch and Backend Services patterns.Competencies & Core Characteristics:We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale-up environment:Health InsurTech Domain Expertise: Knowledge and understanding of how insurers, providers, regulators in the healthcare industry work end to end from payments, integrations, operations, product, member, claims and clinical journeys. Possess either deep knowledge in 1 or 2 APAC markets with additional context on what is best in class and deep understanding of client pain points in the end to end lifecycle and which pain points customers are willing to pay for to solve. Clinical Domain Knowledge: Knowledge of clinical coding terminology for providers and insurers (such as CPT, ICD10CM, ICD11, etc.) Knowledge of clinical tools including coders, groupers, and classifications. Understanding of clinical measurements and outcome frameworks such as AHQR, HEDIS, etc. Knowledge of WHO frameworks for member program pathways, clinical guidelines and other clinical interventions. Knowledge and understanding of how clinical variation impacts insurers and providers. Knowledge of CMS based guidelines for clinical payment arrangements, quality programs, screening and prevention and other clinical payment applications. Technical Expertise Domain: Demonstrates strong technical acumen to bridge business and technology effectively, ensuring scalable and secure product delivery. Possesses proficiency in agile methodologies, data analytics, cloud platforms, and API-driven architectures, while maintaining awareness of emerging technologies such as AI/ML and IoT. Applies privacy-by-design principles and collaborates seamlessly with UX/UI teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.Customer Obsessed & Outcome-driven: Act as a relentless advocate for customers, prioritizing user needs, integration experiences, and real‑world outcomes in every decision. Practice continuous discovery, including customer interviews, structured betas, and VOC loops, to validate problems and solutions. Champion user‑centric and API‑consumer‑centric design, collaborating closely with UX/UI and engineering to maximize adoption and engagement. Define and track clear north‑star metrics (adoption, engagement, clinical and financial impact) using real‑time dashboards and analytics.Strategic Architect: Ability to translate business vision into scalable product architecture and long-term roadmap. Demonstrates foresight in anticipating market trends and aligning product strategy with organizational goals.Data-Driven Decisiveness: Leverage data, experimentation, and evidence‑based insights to inform prioritization, validate hypotheses, and optimize product outcomes. Apply structured prioritization frameworks (e.g., WSJF, RICE) and OKRs to balance customer value, risk, and business impact. Comfortable running experiments (including A/B tests where appropriate) and learning quickly from results—both successes and failures.Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer: Builds strong relationships across diverse teams, fostering collaboration and alignment between business, technology, and external partners. Skilled at influencing without authority and driving consensus in complex environments.Coach & Talent Multiplier: Empowers team members through mentorship and guidance, creating an environment that encourages learning and growth. Recognises and nurtures talent to maximize team performance.Resilient Operator: Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments, maintaining composure under pressure. Demonstrates adaptability and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges and deliver results.Insatiable Curiosity: Continuously explores emerging technologies and industry trends. Brings creativity and a willingness to experiment with new ideas to drive innovation and differentiation.Join UsIf you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Management
  
  
Manager (Commercialization), Global Product Management, Operational Intelligence Program
  
  
**Job Title**
Manager (Commercialization), Global Product Management
  
  
**Overview**
Masterard Data & Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.
  
  

* We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise
* We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behavior beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data
* We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and more

We are looking for a seasoned product manager within the Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team to play a key role in the commercialization/go-to-market strategy for its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers and drive key activities including development of the go-to-market strategy, defining the product value proposition and pricing, create sales and delivery materials and play a key role in sales and delivery enablement.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management technical team to ensure product strategy, roadmap and vision is aligned with the go-to-market strategy and product business priorities.
  
  
Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard
  
  

* Build revolutionary products that advance how businesses all over the world derive the most value from their data assets
* Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value
* Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products
* Act as connectors to ensure the commercial success of our products by working with Sales and Marketing while ensuring technical success through close partnership with Technology teams
* Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and tradeoffs, and build scalable products that serve an array of customer segments
* Set product direction with coordination, not isolation—considering how our products all work together to serve customer needs

Role
  
  

* Act as an expert, advocate, and champion for OI program products
* Lead global product management team efforts with analytically driven input into strategic business plans and product roadmaps
* Coordinate across cross-functional teams for product sales, usage, and continuous product enhancement
* Lead developing the product business strategy including customer segmentation, pricing, sales, and marketing strategy
* Play a key role in rolling out new solutions focused on new segments (e.g., Fintechs), use cases (e.g., real time alerts, crypto payments), networks (e.g., open banking, Blockchain)
* Manage the product P&L and lead the forecasting/budgeting discussions for the products
* Effectively communicate strategy and vision up and down the organization
* Prioritize development efforts as they align against business strategy

**All About You**

* Agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Strong experience with analytical solutions designed for payments or a related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Strategic mind set to solve complex and ambiguous problems
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the self-service analytics space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities
* Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)
* Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience
* Experience in strategy consulting or developing go-to-market strategies for products
* Experience of developing and driving end to end execution of initiatives – particularly in a cross-functional environment, managing and prioritizing competing initiatives
* Strong communication & influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders, with ability to clearly articulate problem statements and opportunity areas
* Strong understanding of the Mastercard products & services and key revenue drivers

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager/Director - Product, Survey CoE, PEG Alpha
description:
**About us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

 

**Who you will work with**

BCN Private Equity Group CoE at Bain & Company provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching >250 members today from ~10 members in 2013. We operate from 3 locations – 2 in India and 1 in Poland, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought-partner with daily deliverables.

**What you’ll do**

**Set product vision & strategy**

 — Define and evolve a clear product vision grounded in user needs and Survey CoE priorities; identify where AI, automation, and new technology can most meaningfully improve the survey workflow; ensure products evolve as a coherent portfolio with defined success measures.

* **Own the roadmap & priorities**
  — Continuously prioritize initiatives across products balancing user value, strategic fit, technical feasibility, and capacity; make clear trade-offs and communicate rationale to stakeholders; partner with the Engineering Lead on constraints and dependencies.
* **Lead product discovery**
  — Build strong feedback loops with Survey CoE leadership and practitioners; structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and validate ideas through user research, product data, and prototypes before committing engineering capacity.
* **Turn strategy into execution**
  — Translate roadmap priorities into clear direction for Product Owners; review requirements for major initiatives; maintain delivery visibility and proactively address risks; ensure released capabilities solve the intended problem.
* **Drive adoption & performance**
  — Own overall portfolio success; define meaningful adoption and impact metrics; identify and address barriers to adoption; establish a continuous improvement cycle fed by user insights.
* **Shape AI-enabled experiences**
  — Identify where GenAI, agentic workflows, and automation create genuine value in the survey workflow; partner with Data/AI specialists to translate capabilities into reliable product experiences; define expected behaviors, success measures, and evaluation mechanisms for AI-powered features.
* **Lead across the product team**
  — Act as primary product counterpart to Survey CoE stakeholders; coach and develop Product Owners; establish consistent PM practices across squads; communicate direction and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.

**About You**

An experienced product manager with strong user orientation, structured problem-solving, and sound commercial and technical judgment. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems, setting team direction, and operating at both the strategic and execution level simultaneously. Credible working with engineers and technical specialists on feasibility and trade-offs.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field
* 8–10+ years of relevant experience with significant time in product management or digital product delivery
* Demonstrated ownership of software/digital product roadmaps from problem identification through launch and iteration
* Experience managing multiple products or complex multi-module products strongly preferred
* Background in consulting, enterprise tech, SaaS, or fast-paced environments; experience with analytics, research, or survey products a plus

**Key Skills**

* Full product lifecycle ownership — discovery, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Strong Agile/Scrum and Lean product-development practices; experience with Jira/Azure DevOps, Confluence
* Data-driven PM skills — KPI definition, usage/adoption analysis, experiment design; SQL or BI tool familiarity a plus
* Technical fluency across web applications, APIs, databases, cloud architectures, and SDLCs
* Strong understanding of AI/LLM product patterns — RAG, copilots, agentic workflows, human-in-the-loop design, responsible AI
* Familiarity with AI-powered development tools (Synthetic Users, V0, Lovable or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar prototyping tools
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint proficiency for senior stakeholder communication

**Leadership**

* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional influence skills
* Strong written and verbal English communication with senior and non-technical audiences
* Experience coaching Product Owners or APMs; high ownership and comfort with ambiguity
* Ability to collaborate across functions, seniority levels, and geographies in a fast-paced environment

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
Join us as a an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Product owner, Analytical Skills, Business Acumen, and Stakeholder Management as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
You will work closely with business, operations and cross-functional partners to solve complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and ensure efficient delivery. Acting as the key interface between business and functional stakeholders, you will support the development of product propositions, and/or service strategies—from concept and release.
  
  
To be successful as an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Critical / Essential Skills**

* Define clear business requirements, manage prioritised backlogs and support feature teams through delivery using Agile ways of working and JIRA.
* Extract and analyse data from Barclays Information Warehouse using Structured Query Language, translating complex datasets into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify fraud loss trends, performance drivers, root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Use management information, dashboards, funnel data, complaints, contact drivers and customer feedback to support evidence-based decision-making.
* Own and assess customer journeys end to end, map pain points and conduct journey health checks to improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Establish, monitor and interpret journey and customer-outcome measures, including Net Promoter Score, complaints, customer effort, fraud losses and operational performance.
* Investigate complex customer and fraud-related issues and translate findings into strategic and operational change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of risk, control and governance practices, including Operational Risk and Control Assessments, issue management, Consumer Duty, control monitoring, evidence gathering and escalation.
* Exercise sound judgement on when to act, align or escalate, particularly where customer harm or regulatory risk may arise.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the United Kingdom and India, including Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Controls and Customer Experience teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional and cross-skilled teams to deliver sustainable journey, fraud strategy and customer-outcome improvements.
* Produce high-quality governance materials, management information, presentations and written recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Apply structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, attention to detail and ownership to resolve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrate commercial acumen and knowledge of market trends and the competitor landscape to benchmark performance and inform priorities.
* Use artificial intelligence-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, insight generation, backlog quality and documentation, while retaining accountability for outcomes.
* Use Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to at least an intermediate level.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Fraud and scam domain knowledge.
* SQL skills
* Experience supporting AI-enabled processes or transformation.
* Fraud and scam loss management.
* Ability to monitor and interpret loss performance, emerging fraud trends and portfolio risk indicators.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to identify key drivers of fraud and scam losses and define improvement actions.
* Experience supporting loss management, portfolio reviews or performance governance forums.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Sr Business Systems Analyst
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 5 to 10 years of hands-on SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting experience, including Classic and Optimized Contract Management
* Strong solution design expertise across revenue recognition, contract management, performance obligations, SSP allocation, contract modifications, posting, reconciliation, and month-end close
* Knowledge of IFRS 15, ASC 606, SOX controls, audit support, deferred revenue, and accrued revenue accounting. Ability to shape requirements, manage multiple priorities, and deliver scalable finance solutions using tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, SharePoint, Teams, and Visio

* Strong understanding of integrations across revenue accounting, sales and distribution, financial accounting, general ledger, billing, CRM, and middleware platforms
* Experience using AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve documentation, testing, reporting, and finance process efficiency

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* SAP S/4HANA or SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting certification is preferred

**Responsibilities**

* This role is the trusted advisor and Product Owner for Revenue Accounting, owning the SAP S/4HANA RAR workstream from requirements and design through testing, decisions, and deployment
* Lead global Revenue Accounting solutions that strengthen compliance and support Moody’s finance transformation priorities
* Deliver SAP S/4HANA RAR implementations, enhancements, and production support across global business processes
* Own the Revenue Accounting workstream, drive solution decisions, and ensure progress from discovery through deployment
* Lead workshops to shape requirements, challenge assumptions, raise risks and decisions, and align Finance, Technology, Operations, Sales, and delivery partners
* Translate business needs into clear requirements, functional designs, and scalable CCM and OCM solutions
* Design and configure revenue recognition processes, including performance obligations, SSP allocation, contract changes, event-based processing, posting, reconciliation, and close activities
* Lead testing, defects, cutover, hypercare, and support; drive accountability for priorities, risks, dependencies, decisions, and stakeholder follow-through

Our Business Systems Team acts as Product Owner for finance process areas, partnering with Finance, Technology, and delivery teams to own solution changes from requirements through deployment and post-go-live support.
  
  

* Own the product backlog, turning strategic priorities into requirements, functional designs, and Jira epics
* Drive solution changes by speaking up, raising risks and decisions early, maintaining traceability, and confirming deployment readiness
* Partner with Finance, Tax, Treasury, Technology, and delivery stakeholders while managing priorities, risks, dependencies, and decisions

By joining our team as part of Business Services Team, you will drive business analysis and functional design across global finance transformation initiatives — collaborating with finance stakeholders and TSG to deliver technology-enabled change that matters.

title: Product Manager – Advance NDT Systems
description:

**Position: NDT Sales Engineer, Product Manager – Advance NDT Systems**

Noida

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

**3. Additional Requirements:**

* Willingness to travel as needed to client sites and other iNETest locations.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Product Manager – DEX & Automations
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
  
  
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the DEX Monitoring and Automations area within TeamViewer ONE. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the centre of TeamViewer's Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) strategy — the journey from reactive IT to fully autonomous endpoint operations.
  
  
You will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for two equally strategic pillars: proactive digital employee experience monitoring (real-time telemetry, DEX scoring, AI-driven insights) and IT workflow automation (the DEX Hub automation library, Tia Scripting, SCALE instructions, and remediation workflows). Working closely with Engineering, UX, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and GTM teams, you will define clear requirements, deliver iterative value, and create measurable outcomes for both IT administrators and the employees they support.
  
  
DEX Monitoring & Insights
  
  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for real-time DEX telemetry, endpoint health monitoring, and experience scoring, evolving the DEX Score to reflect true user-centric performance during live usage.
* Drive the development of AI-powered insights that transform raw telemetry into normalized, actionable intelligence — enabling IT teams to detect, investigate, and remediate issues before employees are impacted.
* Own the Tia Reporting capability, enabling self-service conversational reporting and dynamic dashboards that replace static analytics with real-time, natural-language-driven insights.
* Expand DEX visibility beyond the desktop by leading the strategy for DEX for Mobile (Android and iOS), Exoprise integration for network and SaaS performance monitoring, and future endpoint architecture investments.
* Define and track key experience metrics (DEX Score, MTTR, proactive issue resolution rate) and use these to continuously improve platform effectiveness and customer outcomes.

**Automations & Workflow Orchestration**

* Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.
* Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.
* Define the end-to-end automation lifecycle: from discovery and creation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — ensuring automation is both powerful and safe for enterprise-scale operations.
* Collaborate with Engineering and UX to design automation creation workflows that are accessible to IT generalists while remaining expressive enough for advanced users and MSPs.
* Identify and prioritize automation use cases with the highest customer impact, grounded in field data, customer interviews, and win/loss analysis.

**Cross-Functional & Strategic**

* Act as the product domain authority for DEX & Automations — representing roadmap priorities to senior stakeholders, customers, and field teams, and translating strategic goals into actionable, well-scoped requirements.
* Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Sales to develop positioning, enablement materials, and go-to-market strategies that communicate the business value of DEX and automation capabilities to economic buyers (CIOs, DEX Program Owners).
* Drive customer discovery through interviews, advisory councils, and field feedback loops — continuously synthesizing market signals into roadmap decisions.
* Ensure that all roadmap items ladder to TeamViewer's AEM strategic narrative: the journey from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and ultimately autonomous endpoint management.

**Requirements**
**Must Have**

* 4+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in endpoint management, ITSM, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise software.
* Demonstrated experience owning complex, data-intensive product areas with strong analytical ability — comfort with telemetry, metrics-driven roadmapping, and outcome-based KPIs.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into well-defined product requirements and ship iterative value in an agile environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to influence without authority and align cross-functional stakeholders from Engineering to Executive leadership.
* Experience working in or alongside GTM, Sales, or Customer Success functions, with the ability to create compelling product positioning and enablement content.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Hands-on familiarity with DEX platforms (e.g. 1E, Nexthink, Riverbed Aternity) or IT automation tools (e.g. Ansible, PowerShell DSC, ServiceNow Orchestration).
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to IT operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, GenAI for scripting or remediation.
* Experience in or exposure to the Gartner DEX Management Tools, UEM, or AEM market categories.
* Scripting literacy in PowerShell, Bash, or Python — not a hard requirement, but enables faster domain depth and more productive engineering partnerships.
* Fluency in German is a plus given the Munich location and regional customer base.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
  
  
If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring

**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1

Who You'll Work With

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
