title: Senior Manager - Industrial Engineering
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a
**Senior Manager – Industrial Engineering**
located in
**Sriperumbudur, Chennai.**
What a typical day looks like:
  
  

* Manages a team of engineers and technicians to establish work measurement programs and analyzes work samples to develop standards for labor utilization.
* Analyzes work force utilization, facility layout, and operational data, such as production costs, process flow charts, and production schedules, to determine efficient utilization of workers and equipment.
* Recommends methods for improving worker efficiency and reducing waste of materials and utilities, such as restructuring job duties, reorganizing work flow, relocation work stations and equipment, and purchase of equipment.
* May develop management systems for cost analysis, financial planning, wage and salary administration, and job evaluation.
* Demonstrates functional, technical and people and/or process management skills as well as customer (external and internal) relationship skills. Demonstrates expertise in multiple areas and industry. Demonstrates proficient knowledge of the function and a thorough understanding of Flex and related business.
* Demonstrates knowledge of multiple functional technologies/processes, industries or functions and understanding of interdependencies of such processes at the site. Use of the following tools may be required: Office Skills: typing, telephones, data entry, HR related and office software to include; word processing, spread sheets, and presentation packages.
* Must have a good knowledge of employment law and company practices, with excellent interpersonal

The experience we’re looking to add to our team:
  
  

* Typically requires 15+ years of Industrial Engineering experience, including supervision.
* Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is preferred.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the most complex documents.
* Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or complaints.
* Ability to write speeches and articles using original or innovative techniques or style.
* Ability to make effective and persuasive speeches and presentations on controversial or complex topics to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.
* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference to practical situations.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

What you’ll receive for the great work you provide
  
  

* Medical insurance
* PTO

PV14
  
  
Flex is an Equal Opportunity Employer and employment selection decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. We do not discriminate based on: age, race, religion, color, sex, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, pregnancy status, or any other status protected by law. We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations to those with a disability for assistance in the application process. Please email accessibility@flex.com and we'll discuss your specific situation and next steps (NOTE: this email does not accept or consider resumes or applications. This is only for disability assistance. To be considered for a position at Flex, you must complete the application process first).

title: Workday Extend Integration Lead
description:
**Role Description**
UST Title: Architect II - Enterprise Solutions
  
  
**About UST**
UST is a global digital transformation solutions company partnering with leading organizations worldwide to build innovative solutions, enhance business outcomes, and create meaningful impact through technology and human-centered innovation.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
UST is seeking an experienced Workday Extend Integration Lead to drive the design, development, implementation, and management of Workday integrations and Workday Extend solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Workday Integrations, Workday Extend, Studio, EIB, web services, and enterprise integration technologies, with the ability to lead complex integration initiatives across Human Capital Management (HCM) and Financial Management domains.
  
  
This role requires strong technical leadership, client-facing communication skills, and experience delivering scalable integration solutions aligned with business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the design and architecture of Workday integrations between Workday and external enterprise applications.
* Design, build, test, and deploy Workday Extend applications and integration solutions.
* Develop and manage integrations using:

+ Workday Studio
+ Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
+ Core Connectors
+ Web Services
+ Third-party integration platforms

* Conduct discovery sessions with stakeholders to gather business and technical requirements.
* Define integration scope, architecture, and implementation strategy.
* Collaborate with clients, business users, and third-party vendors to deliver end-to-end integration solutions.
* Ensure high-quality data exchange, system reliability, and process alignment across HCM, Payroll, Finance, and other business functions.
* Lead integration development lifecycle activities including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Identify and resolve complex integration challenges while ensuring adherence to best practices.
* Proactively identify project risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Drive process improvements and establish integration standards and methodologies.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to integration developers and project teams.
* Work effectively with global and cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives.

Required Qualifications
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

**Experience**

* 6+ years of overall IT experience.
* 3+ years of consulting experience, preferably in a Senior Consultant or Lead role.
* Strong hands-on experience in Workday Integrations.
* Experience in at least one full lifecycle Workday implementation.
* Experience leading integration development and delivery activities.

Required Technical Skills
  
  
Workday Technologies
  
  

* Workday Extend
* Workday Studio
* Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
* Workday Web Services
* Core Connectors
* Workday Integration Framework

Integration Technologies
  
  

* XML
* XSLT
* SOAP & REST APIs
* Web Services
* EDI
* Middleware Platforms
* Java and/or .NET

Functional Knowledge
  
  

* Workday Human Capital Management (HCM)
* Payroll Integrations
* Benefits Integrations
* Financial Management Integrations
* Third-party Vendor Integrations

Certifications (Mandatory)
  
  

* Workday Integrations Certification
* Workday Extend Certification

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with global Workday deployments.
* Experience integrating Workday with ERP, payroll, talent management, and finance applications.
* Exposure to cloud integration platforms and modern API frameworks.
* Experience working in multinational and distributed team environments.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to influence and guide technical discussions.
* Client-facing consulting experience.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Skills**
Requirements Gathering, Workday, XSLT

title: Manager_OneStream Implementation_Finance Solutions
description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. As a Manager, you will guide and develop teams, manage client accounts, and drive strategic planning. You will be responsible for mentoring junior staff, confirming project success, and maintaining standards. title: RC FS -BTI INS -Life and Annuity -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life & Annuity Senior position:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

* Candidate Expectations

* Prepare and maintain detailed project schedules, work plans and timelines.

* Coordinate with project managers, site teams, engineering, procurement and other stakeholders.
* Identify project delays, planning gaps and potential risks, and recommend corrective actions.

Job Title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation
  
  
GCL:D2
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn rigorous process design into enterprise outcomes that unlock time for discovery and better serve patients? As a Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation based in Chennai, you will report to the Process Optimisation Director and support the end-to-end management and evolution of our BPM platform. This permanent role blends deep analytical thinking with clear, impactful communication across a diverse global collaborator community.
  
  
You will help shape our strategy and standards, strengthen governance, and build a thriving BPM community of practice that delivers consistent, high-quality models ready for automation and insight. Your work will enable faster, smarter decision-making across the business by connecting process clarity to measurable efficiency and effectiveness. How will you translate complex operations into simple, reusable assets that scale across the enterprise?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* BPM Strategy and Framework: Co-develop the direction of our BPM approach; maintain methodologies, modeling standards, governance and guidelines so process assets are consistent, trusted and reusable.
* Platform Governance and Administration: Act as tool administrator; manage configurations, metadata and access; ensure data integrity; and communicate directly with software providers and internal technology teams to prioritize enhancements and resolve issues at pace.
* Process Modelling Excellence: Model and document end-to-end business processes using BPMN 2.0; guide strategic projects with high-quality process maps that drive efficiency, quality and compliance outcomes.
* Community Enablement and Training: Lead onboarding of new users to the BPM platform; deliver training and certification; run clinics and office hours to build capability and foster a collaborative, supportive community.
* Insight-Driven Optimisation: Analyse and redesign business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness; identify daily work optimisation opportunities using AI and link process insights to automation, mining and continuous improvement.
* Agile Delivery and Ways of Working: Operate within Agile methodology; manage backlogs and status analyses; work virtually across time zones with strong time management, balancing multiple initiatives without losing momentum.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Solid understanding of process modelling techniques, tools, frameworks and standards
* Strong experience in at least one BPM platform (e.g. BIC, Bizagi, Aris, Signavio etc.)
* Ability to model and document end to end business processes using BPMN 2.0
* Capable of acting as tool administrator and performing requirement gatherings and status analyses
* Ability to communicate/articulate requests directly to software providers, alongside other internal technological teams
* Analysing and designing business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness
* Ability to seek daily work activities optimisation with AI utilization
* Energetic and self-motivated
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple initiatives at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Proficiency in English
* Experience of working in Agile methodology

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience of various related BPM capabilities such Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
* Experience of working in Agile methodology
* Six Sigma or Lean Management Green Belt certified
* Experience in change management projects and process optimization initiatives

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Job Description – Technical Lead**
**Company:**
MAKO IT
  
  
**Experience:**
3–6 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai – Work from Office
  
  
**Shift:**
2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Career Path:**
Technical Lead → Senior Technical Lead → Solution Architect
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Technical Lead to join our SaaS Integration & Solutions team.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in API integrations, backend development, and solution design, along with the ability to lead projects and develop a high-performing engineering team.
  
  
This position offers a clear growth opportunity toward a
**Solution Architect role**
, where the individual will progressively take responsibility for designing scalable integration solutions, making architectural decisions, and driving technical excellence.
  
  
A key expectation is to
**build and develop a team of engineers, including fresh graduates**
, through structured training, mentorship, technical guidance, and hands-on project exposure.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Leadership & Integration Development
* Design, develop, and maintain integrations between enterprise SaaS applications.
* Work extensively with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication protocols, and data synchronization.
* Develop backend services and custom integration solutions using Python and/or Node.js.
* Lead technical discovery, requirement analysis, estimation, development, testing, and deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex integration issues and provide sustainable technical solutions.
* Maintain high coding standards, conduct code reviews, and implement engineering best practices.
* Develop reusable integration components, connectors, and frameworks.
* Solution Architecture & Technical Growth
* Gradually take ownership of end-to-end integration solution architecture.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical designs.
* Prepare solution architecture documents, API specifications, integration workflows, and technical diagrams.
* Evaluate alternative integration approaches based on scalability, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate integration development.
* Collaborate with senior leadership on architectural decisions and technical improvements.
* Develop the technical and business understanding required to progress into a Solution Architect role.
* Team Building & Fresher Development
* Build and develop a capable team of integration engineers.
* Actively participate in technical interviews, fresher hiring, and candidate evaluations.
* Design structured onboarding and technical training programs for fresh graduates.
* Mentor junior engineers in Python, APIs, integration concepts, coding standards, and debugging.
* Create practical assignments, learning milestones, and technical assessments.
* Gradually transition trained freshers into independent project contributors.
* Conduct regular technical reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and performance feedback discussions.
* Identify future technical leaders within the team and support their professional growth.
* Build a team culture focused on ownership, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
* Project Delivery & Ownership
* Independently manage multiple integration projects from initiation to successful delivery.
* Prepare accurate technical estimates, implementation plans, and delivery timelines.
* Allocate technical tasks based on team capabilities and project priorities.
* Monitor project execution, identify risks, and resolve technical dependencies.
* Ensure quality deliverables, appropriate documentation, and timely project closure.
* Take complete ownership of technical escalations and issue resolution.
* Establish repeatable delivery practices to improve consistency and productivity.
* Customer Communication & Solution Consulting
* Participate in technical discovery sessions and discussions with international customers.
* Understand customer business processes and recommend suitable integration solutions.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, technical demonstrations, and implementation discussions.
* Communicate technical dependencies, challenges, and project progress proactively.
* Collaborate with implementation managers, project managers, and customer success teams.
* Build customer confidence through technical expertise, accountability, and effective communication.

**Required Technical Skills**
**Must-Have**

* 5–8 years of software development experience with strong exposure to enterprise SaaS integrations.
* Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or Node.js.
* Excellent knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and authentication mechanisms.
* Experience with third-party system integrations, data mapping, and synchronization.
* Strong understanding of backend architecture, databases, and integration design patterns.
* Experience independently designing and delivering technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
* Experience guiding junior engineers or mentoring developers.
* Good English communication skills and confidence in customer-facing technical discussions.
* Ability to manage multiple parallel technical projects.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, Make, or similar iPaaS platforms.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, or ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of AWS/Azure, Docker, and CI/CD.
* Experience developing reusable connectors, SDKs, and integration frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and workflow automation.
* Experience designing training programs or mentoring fresh graduates.
* Exposure to SaaS implementation, professional services, or customer onboarding projects.

Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Strong hands-on technical contributor with a leadership mindset.
* Willingness and ability to recruit, train, and develop freshers.
* Ability to build a self-sufficient integration engineering team.
* Strong ownership of customer commitments and technical delivery.
* Proactive approach to solving problems and improving processes.
* Interest in learning system architecture and growing into a Solution Architect position.
* Ability to balance coding, mentoring, customer communication, and project responsibilities.

Growth Opportunities
  
  
This role provides a structured progression toward Solution Architect responsibilities.
  
  
**Initial Phase – Technical Leadership**

* Own integration development and technical project delivery.
* Establish development standards and reusable integration practices.
* Mentor freshers and develop their technical capabilities.

**Growth Phase – Team & Solution Ownership**

* Build a capable team that can independently execute integration projects.
* Lead increasingly complex solution designs.
* Improve technical estimation, scalability, and integration architecture.

**Future Phase – Solution Architect**

* Own end-to-end technical architecture across integration projects.
* Define reusable solution patterns, technical standards, and frameworks.
* Guide multiple engineering teams on architecture and technical decisions.
* Collaborate with business and delivery leadership on complex customer solutions.

**Required Skills**
Solution Design Python REST API SaaS Integrations Customer-Facing API Integration Technical Lead Technical Project Delivery

title: Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM
description: Role Title: Senior Consultant - SAP PaPMLocation: ChennaiWe are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.What You’ll DoThis role supports the technical solution design for Operational Transfer Pricing and other Tax capabilities or part of a cross functional component. The role is a key position on the Axial Programme IT design team taking a central role in defining the global design template for AstraZeneca in line with our ambition of Fit to Standard using SAP best practice as far as possible. You will be a member of a wider Axial IT Design Team that will lead on defining the IT solution that will support our global standardised business processes. Ensuring integration between business process definition, SAP solution definition and SAP data objects definition.In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that the global standard solution is fully and accurately documented and tested according to project standards and will guide the core design through the required governance forums. You will work closely with IT Enterprise Business Partners, others IT Product Managers and SMEs across the design team to ensure that solutions are efficiently integrated into a wider AstraZeneca global standard design. This will also include working with SMEs from our external partners to ensure that the AZ solution adopts standard and groundbreaking technology in fulfilling business capabilities and outcomes.As the project moves to the deployment phase you will continue to play a pivotal role in ensuring that the localisation requirements of individual operating units are properly represented in the solution, whilst retaining the integrity of a fit to standard best practice template. title: Social Operations - Marketing
description:
**Agency Operations Manager – Creative & Client Delivery | CubicDesignz Agency**

**Now Hiring: Agency Operations Manager**

**💼 Experience: Minimum 3-7 years of work experience**

**📍 Location: Chennai (Work From Office)**

**Role Overview:**

We are a creative marketing agency working with restaurants, FMCG brands, doctors, and multispecialty hospitals. You will oversee a team of 20+ members across design, video editing, development, and content. As the central point for daily task allocation, you will turn client requirements into clear assignments, organize schedules, monitor progress, and ensure timely delivery.

This role requires strong operational leadership alongside social media strategy knowledge and creative judgment. You should be comfortable reviewing creative work, addressing performance issues, and keeping clients and internal teams aligned.

**What You’ll Do:**

- Own daily agency operations and maintain visibility across ongoing projects and client commitments.

- Plan and allocate daily tasks across design, video editing, development, and content teams.

- Set clear briefs, priorities, responsibilities, and deadlines based on team capacity.

- Schedule and lead internal meetings, daily check-ins, client calls, and project reviews.

- Serve as the main coordination point between clients and internal teams.

- Clarify client requirements, document feedback, and translate requests into actionable tasks.

- Monitor progress, attendance, availability, and delivery commitments through transparent work processes.

- Address missed deadlines, quality issues, and recurring performance concerns with clear feedback and follow-up.

- Review social media creatives, videos, captions, and carousels for brand consistency, clarity, and campaign relevance.

- Apply social media strategy knowledge to identify weak ideas and guide improvements.

- Coordinate client approvals, including medical review where required for healthcare content.

- Manage revisions, changing priorities, and dependencies while keeping delivery schedules realistic.

- Resolve operational blockers and escalate issues requiring leadership decisions.

- Maintain project trackers, meeting notes, approval records, and performance reports.

- Improve workflows to reduce avoidable delays, repeated revisions, and communication gaps.

**What We’re Looking For:**

- Experience managing multidisciplinary teams within a creative or digital marketing agency.

- Strong knowledge of social media strategy, content formats, and campaign planning.

- Ability to evaluate design, video editing, and copy against a creative brief.

- Strong task allocation, resource planning, and project coordination skills.

- Confidence leading client conversations and communicating expectations clearly.

- An assertive and fair leadership style, with the ability to handle conflict and hold teams accountable.

- Strong organizational skills, consistent follow-through, and sound judgment.

- Ability to balance productivity, creative quality, and realistic workloads.

- Familiarity with project management tools, reporting dashboards, and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

- Ability to review Tamil, English, and Tanglish content.

- Integrity and discretion when handling client information, employee matters, and company resources.

**What Success Looks Like:**

- Every team member has clear daily priorities and deadlines.

- Client requirements reach the right team with complete briefs.

- Meetings result in documented decisions and assigned actions.

- Work meets agreed quality standards and delivery timelines.

- Clients receive timely updates, and issues are addressed early.

- Daily operations run smoothly with fewer avoidable escalations.

**About Company:**

CubicDesignz is a creative marketing agency that helps brands connect with their audiences through design, content, and digital marketing. We work across food, FMCG, healthcare, and other industries to create campaigns that reflect each brand and support its marketing goals.

**How to Apply:**

Apply through this LinkedIn job posting with your resume. Include a brief overview of the teams you have managed, your client coordination experience, and examples of how you have improved agency workflows or project delivery.

title: Engineering Manager – Permitting & Regulatory Compliance
description:
**Job Description**
Remarkable people, trusted by clients to design and advance the world.
  
  
Wood is currently recruiting for an Engineering Manager – Permitting & Regulatory Compliance to be based in our Chennai, India Office.
  
  
This position will be for a permanent role supporting our major clients.
  
  
**The Role**
The Engineering Manager – Permitting & Regulatory Compliance is a core member within the Wood India Project Management group. This role has a remit across all project phases relating to securing applicable regulatory permits and statutory approvals applied by the Owner, which are essential to design, engineer, construct, store hazardous materials, and safely start up the plant in full compliance with the applicable with all legal and statutory requirements within the industry.
  
  
**What We Can Offer**

* Meaningful and interesting projects delivered to high profile clients across the Energy Sector
* Flexible working arrangements that balance client, team and individual needs offering hybrid and remote working where relevant
* Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business
* Competitive renumeration package with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
* Commitment to continued professional development; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests
* Global connections: join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession
* Energy Transition Academy; join a community of experts sharing your knowledge and gaining more exposure to a variety of existing and emerging energy systems – delivered by experts in their field

**Responsibilities**

* FEED, Detailed Engineering and PMC Support phases:

**Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) Phase**
During the FEED phase, this role provides strategic regulatory foresight to ensure early-stage designs are fundamentally compliant.
  
  

* Support Engineering & Design Teams: Review preliminary layouts, process flow diagrams (PFDs), and plot plans to ensure early-stage designs incorporate correct safety distances and environmental zone restrictions.
* Provide Client Advisory Support: Advise the Client on the comprehensive list of applicable Indian statutory approvals, estimated timelines, and documentation requirements needed for their upcoming project lifecycle.
* Participate in Model reviews to ascertain that the design is compliant with all statutory norms.

**Detailed Engineering (DE) Phase**
During the DE phase, the focus shifts to vetting technical data and verifying that the final, granular designs strictly adhere to Indian statutory codes
  
  

* Support Engineering & Design Teams: Conduct rigorous reviews of detailed engineering drawings, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), equipment datasheets, and layouts to verify full alignment with Indian standards
* Provide Client Advisory Support: Package and hand over thoroughly vetted technical documentation to the Client, providing clear technical explanations to assist them in preparing their formal applications.
* Regulatory Alignment Vetting: Review contractor and vendor designs for specialized units (like ETP, STP, and hazardous chemical storage) to ensure they meet the technical criteria mandated by regulatory bodies like the SPCB and PESO.

**Project Management Consultancy (PMC) Phase**
In the PMC phase, the role acts as the Owners Engineer, monitoring contractor compliance and provide technical support to the Client
  
  

* Support Engineering & Design Teams: Cross-functional coordination between the EPC contractors and the design team to ensure field modifications or site queries (RFIs) do not breach statutory guidelines.
* Provide Client Advisory Support: Provide ongoing guidance to the Client on the health and progress of the Permit Master Schedule, highlighting potential milestone risks, bottlenecks, or regulatory changes.
* Advisory Monitoring: Track and review the documentation prepared by EPC contractors for construction-stage consents (like Consent to Establish), ensuring it is technically sound before the Client submits and expedites it with the respective authorities.

**General**

* Guide the Owner and EPC contractors systematically through the entire government approval lifecycle from initial engineering design to final plant commissioning.
* Establish, maintain, and dynamically update a comprehensive Permit Master Schedule to strictly track timelines, avoiding project milestone delays or regulatory fines.
* Review and vet technical engineering drawings, layouts, and technical data sheets from contractors to verify full alignment with Indian statutory standards prior to official submission.
* Awareness of State Factory Inspectorate (DISSH) and Labor Department compliance
* Acts as a SME and provide technical advisory support.
* Pollution Control & Environmental Compliance (PCB & MoEFCC)
* Lead the processing and tracking to secure formal Environmental Clearance (EC) from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) for greenfield layouts or brownfield expansions.
* Obtain mandatory Consent to Establish (CTE) before construction mobilization and Consent to Operate (CTO) prior to plant commissioning from the respective State Pollution Control Board (PCB).
* Secure the required Hazardous Waste Authorization from the PCB under the provisions of the Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules.
* Evaluate plant designs for Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) to confirm engineering alignment with Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) or specified state treated discharge standards.
* Storage, Safety & Explosives (PESO & OISD)
* Obtain crucial statutory approvals and operating licenses from the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) for layout, construction, and bulk storage of petroleum, gases, and hazardous chemicals under the Petroleum Rules and Gas Cylinder Rules.
* Ensure overall plant safety layout designs, separation distances, and mitigation frameworks strictly adhere to Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD) standards and guidelines.
* Secure Factory Plan Approvals and operational factory licenses from the State Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) or Inspectorate of Factories.
* Mechanical & Electrical Utilities (Boiler Act & Electrical Inspectorate)
* Coordinate registrations, drawings approval, and stage-wise physical inspections for all high-pressure boilers and steam piping networks under the provisions of The Indian Boilers Act, 1923.
* Secure mandatory statutory clearances from the Chief Electrical Inspector to Government (CEIG) for the installation and energization of electrical substations, transformers, switchyards, and plant lightning protection infrastructure under Central Electricity Authority (CEA) norms.
* Radiation & Nuclear Safety (AERB)
* Secure necessary procurement permissions and operating licenses from the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) for industrial radiography equipment, nuclear level gauges, and radiation-emitting equipment utilized in non-destructive testing (NDT) or plant instrumentation systems.

**Qualifications**
**What makes you remarkable?**
At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.
  
  
**Expected**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or mechanical engineering or Petroleum Engineering
  
  
**Experience:**
Minimum of 20+ years of demonstrated professional experience managing statutory permitting, regulatory clearances, and utility compliance for mega industrial projects (Chemical plants, Refineries, Petrochemical complexes, or oil and gas facilities).
  
  
**Role Exposure:**
Prior experience working within a Plant Owner/ EPC Contractor /Engineering Consultant companies is essential.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications & Additional Qualifications**

* ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems (EMS) Lead Auditor / Implementation Certification.
* ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems Certification.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Comprehensive Regulatory Fluency: Thorough operational understanding of Indian statutory laws and acts governing industrial production, environmental protection (PCB rules), utility infrastructure safety (Boiler Act, CEIG norms), hazardous chemical management (PESO, OISD standards), and specialized nuclear/radiation instrumentation guidelines (AERB regulations) and any other Indian regulatory laws as applicable.
* Stakeholder Liaison & Communication: Excellent inter-personal, negotiation, and verbal/written communication capabilities to clearly articulate complex engineering plant parameters to regulatory officers and coordinate seamlessly across cross-functional multi-disciplinary project teams.

**About Us**
Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com
  
  
**Diversity Statement**
We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

description:
Job title : Manager — HR Information Systems, HR

Skill : HRIS

Experience Required : 10 to 12 Years

Location : Chennai

Role purpose

To own the Workday platform end to end — configuration, data integrity, security, release governance and continual improvement — and to lead the HRIS team as the senior functional and technical authority partnering HRBPs globally, Group Rewards, HR Shared Services and Payroll. The Manager sets platform direction, owns the release and change agenda, and is accountable for system integrity and the standards and templates the enterprise runs on.

Key responsibilities

• Own the HRIS strategy and roadmap across the Absence, Benefits and Talent modules; prioritise the

enhancement pipeline by value, risk and effort and keep it aligned to the enterprise technology strategy.

• Own release governance for the half-yearly Workday releases (R1 and R2): make feature-enablement

decisions aligned to policy and risk, set regression strategy, and hold go/no-go authority.

• Own system integrity and the data governance framework across all modules, including the security model

and the segregation-of-duties controls.

• Own the demand and change governance forum (intake, prioritisation, change advisory board), and the

standards, naming conventions and configuration templates the team builds to.

• Act as programme owner for new business unit onboarding — from requirements discovery through

configuration, data migration, cutover and hypercare.

• Own major incident governance, root cause analysis sign-off, and the HRIS response to internal audit,

external audit and control reviews.

• Manage the relationships with Workday and implementation partners, including support contracts,

escalations and roadmap engagement.

• Lead, develop and resource the HRIS team (team leads and specialists); own capability build, cross-skilling,

succession and the coverage model for the Singapore shift.

• Own the advisory partnership with HRBPs, Group Rewards, HR Shared Services and Payroll, translating

policy and ways of working into system direction.

• Own the HRIS budget, licence position and productivity commitments.

Must-have skills and experience

• 12 - 15+ years in HR information systems, including deep hands-on Workday experience and at least 3

years leading an HRIS team or platform.

• Proven ownership of multiple Workday modules — Absence, Benefits and Talent — across configuration,

security and reporting.

• Demonstrated ownership of global release governance (R1/R2), including feature-enablement decisions,

regression strategy and go/no-go.

• Strong command of the business process framework, calculated fields, EIB, reporting and the security and

segregation-of-duties model.

• Track record leading new entity or business unit onboarding end to end, including data migration, cutover

and hypercare.

• Strong functional HR knowledge — able to translate HR policy and ways of working into system design.

• Multi-country governance experience and confident senior stakeholder management across regions.

Good-to-have skills and experience

• Workday certification(s) across one or more supported modules.

• PeopleSoft or other legacy HCM background.

• Integration architecture experience (EIB, Workday Studio, middleware).

• M&A, divestiture or large-scale business unit onboarding experience.

• Exposure to RPA or workflow automation strategy.

• ITIL or equivalent service management qualification.

title: Associate Project Manager RTSM - Operations
description:
About Signant Health
  
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Associate Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, and completion of projects considering budget, timelines, resources, and task management. The Associate Project Manager will communicate in a transparent and timely manner with the assigned Signant Health clients and internal stakeholders. He/she will identify project risks and ensure timely resolution while reporting out on project status with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
This role requires problem-solving skills, the ability to motivate within a result-oriented team, and the ability to build trust-based relationships with stakeholders.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function
  
  

* Works across all phases of each assigned project, including project plan and client deliverables.
* Can be assigned multiple projects concurrently, maintaining project schedule and quality deliverables in a dynamic environment.
* Coordinate with other Global Project Management personnel as well as Global Technical Delivery resources to ensure the timely and quality preparation of project deliverables based on assigned scope-of-services.
* Oversee development and approval of study materials.
* Ensure all project deliverables are of high quality and exceed client’s expectations in compliance with Quality Management governance procedures.
* Coordinates study status and risks with project sponsors.
* Reviews assigned resources and tasks to ensure all logistics, materials, and technologies necessary as defined by scope-of-services.
* Coordinate with project sponsors to ensure all project expectations are met.
* Produce internal and external project status reports (e.g., weekly, interim, final, etc.).
* Facilitate new Change Order creation and socialization for assigned projects in cooperation with Business Development Operations.
* Facilitate positive relationships within assigned client accounts including routine written, telephone, and face-to-face communication.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Role
  
  

* As a member of staff, the employee is expected to embrace and contribute to our culture of process improvement with a focus on streamlining our processes, adding value to our business, and meeting client needs.
* Responsible for compliance with Company Procedures in support of client deliverables.
* Recognize, exemplify, and adhere to the company values, which centre around our commitment to People, Clients, and Performance.

Decision Making and Influence
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to lead projects through influence.
* Capable of weighing risks and making decisions that align with Signant values and strategy.
* Facilitate customer escalations effectively, with follow-up and closure.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* Three to five years of professional experience.
* Experience with work plans, project budgets, invoicing, resource allocation, and deliverable management.
* College degree (B.S., B.A.) / University degree for EU candidates, or equivalent years of experience.
* Demonstrated analytical, organizational, creative problem-solving, and structured communication skills.
* Strong client and vendor relationship skills.
* Demonstrated experience in career development and team management.
* Ability to travel for business (overnight trips each month are expected).
* Demonstrated proficiency with computers, especially Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Access).
* Fluency in English (will be required to write, speak, and understand English to conduct day-to-day business).
* Ability to manage own time, proactively identifying prioritized tasks.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, drive, and work ethic.
* Focus on attention to detail.

**Desirable:**  

* One to two years of project management experience.
* Background in Pharmaceutical, Medical Education, and/or CRO.
* Experience of clinical trials / pharmaceutical industry / life sciences.
* Ability to travel for business trips (overnight business trips could be expected quarterly).
* Experience/understanding of the clinical research environment and GCP principles is preferred.

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

Project Intake Coordinator - D&C Project Controls Program
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Project Intake Coordinator serves as the central point of contact for all incoming project requests within the Design & Construction (D&C) Project Controls Program. This role ensures efficient project initiation by evaluating requests, verifying completeness of information, routing to appropriate resource groups, and coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams. The position combines operational coordination with analytical capabilities to optimize intake processes and provide performance insights.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Request Management & Coordination
  

* Serve as primary contact for all D&C Project Controls Program intake requests, assessing scope, urgency, complexity, and resource requirements.
* Determine appropriate resource groups and team assignments based on project characteristics, expertise requirements, and capacity.
* Facilitate smooth handoffs between intake and project execution teams, ensuring continuity of information and stakeholder expectations.
* Route and prioritize requests using defined criteria to balance workload distribution and delivery timelines.

Information Verification & Quality Control
  

* Evaluate completeness and quality of initial project information including scope definitions, budgets, timelines, and stakeholder documentation.
* Identify gaps in project requirements and engage requestors to gather missing details before assignment.
* Maintain standardized intake templates and checklists to ensure consistent information capture across all requests.
* Enforce documentation standards that enable accurate project scoping and reduce downstream rework.

Stakeholder Coordination & Communication
  

* Lead intake calls and kickoff meetings with internal clients, project sponsors, and D&C Project Controls teams.
* Coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups including operations, finance, real estate, facilities, and business units.
* Communicate project status, routing decisions, and next steps to all relevant parties throughout the intake lifecycle.
* Serve as a trusted liaison between requestors and delivery teams, ensuring alignment on expectations and priorities.

Reporting & Analytics
  

* Monitor dashboards tracking intake volume, request types, assignment patterns, and processing timelines.
* Analyze performance metrics including time-to-assignment, request completion rates, and resource utilization.
* Identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement within the intake workflow.
* Prepare regular reports on intake productivity, team performance, and operational efficiency for D&C Project Controls leadership.

Process Optimization
  

* Continuously evaluate and refine intake procedures to improve efficiency and stakeholder experience.
* Recommend and implement improvements to intake forms, routing criteria, and coordination protocols.
* Collaborate with D&C Project Controls leadership to establish service level agreements and performance standards.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of intake processes, routing guidelines, and best practices.

Required Qualifications
  
  
Experience
  

* 3–5 years of experience in project coordination, operations, or related roles within corporate real estate, facilities management, design and construction, or professional services environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing workflows across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Background in process improvement and operational efficiency initiatives.

Skills & Competencies
  

* Strong organizational abilities with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent requests.
* Exceptional communication skills with confidence leading meetings and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups at all organizational levels.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Proficiency in project management principles and understanding of design and construction project lifecycles and project controls methodologies.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools for reporting and analytics.
* Experience with project management systems, intake platforms, or workflow management software

Personal Attributes
  

* Customer service orientation with commitment to stakeholder satisfaction.
* Proactive problem-solver who can work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Adaptable and comfortable managing ambiguity in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Strong business acumen with ability to understand organizational priorities and make sound routing decisions.

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Senior Project Manager - Project Controls**

Milestone is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Controls Business Analyst / Project Manager to support the financial, operational, and governance activities across a portfolio of Information Systems (IS) projects and programs. This role serves as a critical liaison between Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Technology Leadership, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to ensure accurate financial forecasting, project reporting, budget management, and portfolio governance.

The ideal candidate combines strong project controls expertise with business analysis, financial management, and PMO support capabilities. The role requires hands-on ownership of project financials, purchase order management, forecasting, vendor tracking, status reporting, and project governance activities while helping ensure alignment between project execution and broader organizational financial objectives.

This is a tactical execution-focused position that works directly with project and program teams to maintain financial discipline, reporting accuracy, and operational excellence across a diverse technology portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Financial Management & Controls**

* Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost estimates for IS initiatives.
* Build and manage quarterly and ad hoc project financial forecasts.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure spend aligns with approved budgets and forecasts.
* Track and manage Capital Expenditures (CapEx) and Operational Expenditures (OpEx).
* Maintain project balance sheets and assist with financial reconciliation activities.
* Support monthly and quarterly financial close processes.
* Create and maintain cost tracking models and financial dashboards.
* Analyze project financial performance and identify budget variances, risks, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare and present financial reports for project teams, leadership, and portfolio stakeholders.
* Support Long-Range Estimates (LEs) and financial planning activities.

title: Assistant Project Manager – US Commercial Real Estate (Night Shift)
description:
**Assistant Project Manager (Civil) Fluent English is Must**

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Timings:** Night shift, 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST, Monday to Friday  
You must be available during U.S. business hours (mainly CST) and adjust your schedule when needed to support site activity, project milestones and deadlines.

**About Us**  
The Prime Developer is a US commercial real estate firm based in Austin, Texas. We develop, lease and manage retail and flex properties across Texas, working with franchise brands, local businesses and investors. We are building our team in India to support US operations during US business hours.

**The Role**  
We’re looking for a detail-oriented civil professional to support our US architects and construction teams remotely from India. You’ll keep projects on track behind the scenes. That means checking estimates, BOQs and bills, tracking materials, handling invoices and managing customer communication. This role suits someone who understands construction, reads drawings with confidence, and is organized enough to keep several projects moving at once.

**Responsibilities**

**Project and Site Support**

* Support onsite architects, project managers and construction teams with documentation, coordination and follow-ups
* Review drawings, specifications and scope documents, and flag discrepancies or missing information
* Track project schedules, milestones and progress updates, and highlight delays or risks early
* Maintain RFIs, submittals, change orders, meeting notes and daily or weekly progress reports
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, vendors and consultants on pending items

**Estimates, BOQs and Materials**

* Prepare, review and check cost estimates and BOQs (Bills of Quantities) for accuracy and completeness
* Do quantity take-offs from drawings and compare contractor quotes against BOQs and scope
* Track material requirements, orders, deliveries and usage against the project plan
* Compare vendor and contractor bids, and summarize differences for the US team

**Billing and Invoices**

* Review contractor and vendor bills against work completed, BOQ rates and contract terms
* Process and track invoices, pay applications and draw requests, and flag overbilling or errors
* Maintain budget-vs-actual tracking for each project and report variances
* Coordinate with the accounting team on approvals, payments and retainage

**CRM and Customer Management**

* Manage customer and tenant records in the CRM, including inquiries, project status, communication logs and follow-ups
* Keep customers updated on timelines, build-out progress and handover
* Make sure customer requests and issues are tracked and resolved on time

**Documentation**

* Organize project files, contracts, drawings, invoices and reports in shared drives (Google Drive, Dropbox) and project management tools

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering (M.Tech in Construction Management or a similar degree is a plus)
* 3+ years of experience in construction project coordination, estimation, QS or billing
* Strong knowledge of BOQs, quantity take-offs, rate analysis and contractor billing
* Able to read and interpret civil and architectural drawings; working knowledge of AutoCAD
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for estimates, trackers and reconciliations
* Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Procore, Primavera or similar) and CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho or similar)
* Good written and spoken English, and comfortable working with US teams
* Organized and careful with detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once
* Experience with US construction projects or commercial/retail build-outs is a plus
* Ability to speak Telugu is a plus

**Location:** Gachibowli, Hyderabad, India

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided

Work Location: In person

What You’ll Do

* Track project progress, manage risks, and proactively address bottlenecks
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality of insights and deliverables

* Support resource allocation and prioritize workload across multiple concurrent projects
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with stakeholders on timelines and outcomes

What You Have
**:**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university (e.g., Business, Economics, Life Sciences, or related field)
* +4 years of experience in project management, consulting, research, or insights roles
* Experience managing multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Strong team management, organizational, problem-solving, and prioritization skills
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Monday.com) and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a team atmosphere with minimal supervision

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive compensation
* Employee medical coverage
* Central office location
* Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions
* Casual work environment

**About Guidepoint:**
Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams.
  
  
Backed by a global network of more than

title: Project Engineer - HVAC
description:
**Company Description-**

Raw Aircon is an HVAC company and leading provider of comprehensive air conditioning and ventilation solutions for commercial and industrial environments. The company designs and installs advanced VRF systems from brands such as Samsung, LG, and Mitsubishi Electric, with a focus on seamless integration and reliable performance. Raw Aircon also delivers specialized ventilation solutions for basements, staircases, and lifts to support safe and healthy indoor conditions. Services include system design, installation, maintenance, repair, and HVAC consulting, giving clients end-to-end project support. The team is committed to prompt, professional service tailored to each customer’s technical and operational needs.

**Role Description-**

The Project Engineer role at RAW AIRCON is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division. The Project Engineer will oversee HVAC project execution from design review through installation, commissioning, and handover, ensuring adherence to technical specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with clients, contractors, and internal teams, preparing and updating project plans, tracking progress, and resolving technical and scheduling issues. The role involves reviewing engineering drawings, supporting site inspections, monitoring resource utilization, and assisting with cost and material estimates. The Project Engineer will also contribute to continuous improvement of project processes and support documentation for project reports and compliance.

**Qualifications-**

* Candidates should possess strong Project Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills to manage HVAC system design, installation, and technical troubleshooting.
* Candidates should possess Project Management and Project Planning skills to handle timelines, resources, risk mitigation, and coordination across multiple sites.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to interact with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
* Beneficial qualifications include a degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or related Engineering, experience in HVAC or building services, and familiarity with industry standards and safety regulations.
* Additional beneficial skills include proficiency with project scheduling tools, ability to read and interpret technical drawings, strong problem-solving abilities, and readiness to work on-site at project locations.

title: Application Delivery Lead
description:
The Application Development Lead (ADL) is responsible for overseeing delivery of high-profile software development initiatives under the defined jurisdiction. Responsibilities may include managing large projects or small project portfolios, leading architecture and design initiatives, and leading quality management processes aimed at ensuring incidents and other customer-impacting issues are handled efficiently and thoroughly.
  
  
When assigned to a large program, the ADL works directly with the program’s PMO team to deliver on program-specific goals while keeping development teams on track per Agile guidelines (including traditional Agile Scrum Master duties). The ADL also ensures technical continuity between the program and other areas of the business unit. This includes Salesforce teams, corporate technology support teams, and vendor resources that contribute to business-critical projects and significant technical initiatives.
  
  
Examples of the types of initiatives that might be led by the ADL include major technology migration or transformation, application and infrastructure security initiatives, and application performance governance including system availability and the management of incidents and problems. Given the diverse set of technical disciplines that the ADL may manage, the ideal candidate must have an equally diverse background including robust experience with application development as well as some exposure to other topics such as operations, infrastructure and DevOps.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead development resources across multiple disciplines
* Run all relevant Agile ceremonies

* Develop and maintain relationships with support and customer organizations
* Ensure in-scope incidents are tracked and resolved within SLA guidelines
* Establish and enforce sound development practices

**Technical Proficiency Required**

* Familiar with application architecture concepts
* Continuous Integration & Delivery and DevOps philosophy
* Technical strategy and planning

**Other Skills Preferred**

* 10+ years in information technology

* Experience leading remote/offshore teams
* Experience establishing and managing vendor relationships
* Experience in complex, high-visibility programs
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Experience with Salesforce-integrated applications
* Ability to travel up to 30%
* People management Experience (minimum 3 years).
* Experience in creating Delivery plans.
* Good understanding of release management and risk management

* DSDM: Practitioner, Advanced Practitioner, trainer/Coach, Consultant
