title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
  
  
The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
  
  
The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities

**Working Conditions**

* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

**Summary:**

Provides consultation to the business unit and IT Project management and strategies.

Undertakes complex projects requiring additional specialized technical knowledge.

Responsible for all aspects of the development and implementation of assigned projects and provides a single point of contact for those projects. Takes projects from original concept through final implementation. Helps defines project scope and objectives.

Develops detailed work plans, schedules, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports.

Responsible for project meetings and is responsible for project tracking and analysis.

Ensures adherence to quality standards and reviews project deliverables. Provides specialized knowledge and analytical guidance to project team.

Reporting to the Modernization / EOL Director you will play a vital role to help the firm ensure that NT’s technology continues to run on supported technology.

Northern Trust has a commitment to ensure that all technology is secure, reliable and resilient.

As part of that Northern Trust has deep commitment to ensuring that all Platform and Vended Applications are supported and secure.

A dedicated Sr Lead Project Manager is required to lead our largest infrastructure lifecycle upgrade projects.

These projects encompass upgrading a major infrastructure technology (e.g. Operating System, Middleware, Database) and all of the associated applications running on that technology. This includes financial management, resource management, dependency management, multi-year planning, reporting, stakeholder management, and audit compliance.

The ideal candidate has experience being part of large projects, helping identify and resolve key program risks and program blockers, and as well as providing critical data and business analysis to help drive program decisions. This candidate will also work directly with business unit service delivery managers ensuring that the vendor lifecycle management programs initiatives are being met against key timelines, budgets, and against competing business priorities.

This role is more than a project management position - a resource in this role will be expected to work with Architects and Senior leaders to design an implementation pattern; applications to plan the project required based on that implementation pattern, and drive the project to closure.

The project manager should be expected to understand technical concepts included in those patterns.

**Major Duties**

* Provides comprehensive consultation to business unit and IT Project management and strategies.
* Undertakes complex projects requiring additional specialized technical knowledge.
* Advances planning and project execution for end of life / end of support software.

**Global Talent Impact Partner**
**About The Role**
In this role, you will join an agile team of highly skilled HR professionals responsible for shaping and advancing Bayer’s enterprise talent strategy. You will work across a broad and evolving portfolio of talent priorities, partnering with leaders, HR colleagues, and key stakeholders to design and deliver scalable solutions that strengthen organizational capability, leadership effectiveness, and business performance. The role offers the opportunity to build a strong global network, deepen an end-to-end enterprise mindset, and create sustainable impact on Bayer’s talent agenda.
  
  
**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**

* Listen to and identify talent and business needs across the organization, translating them into scalable solutions that drive enterprise outcomes.
* Lead global projects, workstreams, and design teams, ensuring successful delivery of strategic talent initiatives from concept through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted talent expert and consultant across the HR community, providing thought partnership and guidance on talent, leadership, and organizational priorities.
* Build strong partnerships with senior leaders, HR colleagues, and key stakeholders to influence talent decisions, connect perspectives, and align on enterprise priorities.
* Design, pilot, launch, scale, and continuously improve talent management products, processes, and experiences that support Bayer’s talent strategy.
* Contribute to the evolution of enterprise talent frameworks, leadership capabilities, skills-based approaches, and workforce-readiness strategies in response to changing business needs.
* Use talent insights, data, research, external trends, and stakeholder feedback to develop recommendations, assess impact, and improve talent outcomes.
* Lead change, communication, and adoption efforts to enable sustainable implementation of talent solutions across countries, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Build Talent Management and broader HR capability by sharing expertise, coaching and supporting colleagues, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.
* Collaborate across HR and the business to connect talent priorities, manage interdependencies, and deliver integrated solutions that support key business outcomes.
* Apply digital and AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to improve the relevance, scalability, and employee experience of talent solutions.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, adapting focus as enterprise talent priorities evolve.

**Who You Are**
**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Significant experience developing, executing, and driving change for global initiatives, including consulting with and influencing senior business and HR leaders and other stakeholders.
* Demonstrated talent management, organizational development, leadership development, HR consulting, or related expertise, with the ability to connect talent solutions to business needs.
* Proven track record of leading complex projects, programs, or cross-functional teams from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze complex issues, develop hypotheses, synthesize diverse perspectives, and translate insights into practical recommendations.
* Ability to prioritize based on enterprise value, expected impact, feasibility, and return on investment.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, adapt to evolving priorities, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and productive relationships across cultures, functions, and organizational levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
* Broad professional experience in Human Resources, Talent Management, organizational development, leadership development, or internal or external consulting.
* Experience managing large-scale, complex, or enterprise-wide initiatives in a global and matrixed organization.
* Experience using talent analytics, digital platforms, or AI-enabled tools to inform or improve talent solutions.

This position is not assigned to one specific project, product, or talent discipline. Priorities and assignments may evolve in line with Bayer’s enterprise talent strategy and business needs. title: Program Manager (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Program Manager (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location and Work Authorization: New Delhi, India preferred. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Application Deadline: 10 November 2026, 6 PM IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a Program Manager to lead the delivery and scale-up of PxD's heat initiative in India — bringing AI-based heat forecasts and actionable heat advisories to agriculture and livestock farmers, with a particular focus on government partnerships and coordination across delivery channels.
  
  
You will build and maintain strong relationships with relevant government institutions — including agriculture, animal husbandry, meteorological, dairy cooperatives and disaster management agencies — and coordinate closely with PxD's research, technology, program, and country teams. You will play a central role in moving the heat use case from formative research and pilot to delivery at scale, aligning partners, content, timelines, and channels so that farmers receive timely, consistent heat guidance.
  
  
This is a chance to help farmers protect their crops, animals, and livelihoods from increasingly frequent and severe heatwaves, at a moment when advances in AI forecasting make earlier and more localized heat warnings possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are below.
  
  
Government Relations & Partnerships
  
  

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with central and state government institutions involved in heat early warning, weather and climate services, agriculture extension, and animal husbandry, serving as a key point of contact for PxD's heat initiative
* Coordinate with government stakeholders to secure approvals and support for the implementation, alignment, and scale-up of heat advisory activities, and identify opportunities to integrate heat advisories into government systems such as heat action plans, extension platforms, and existing advisory services
* Engage with forecasting and technical partners to align on the use of AI-based heat forecast products
* Represent PxD in government meetings, technical working groups, workshops, conferences, and other external forums

Use Case, Pilot & Channel Coordination
  
  

* Work with the research team to translate formative research findings into a heat advisory use case for crop and livestock farmers, and support the planning and execution of pilots
* Coordinate across the channels used to deliver heat forecasts and advisories (e.g. voice calls, IVR, SMS, WhatsApp, extension workers), working closely with program, research, technology, and content teams on channel-specific activities and deliverables
* Support the development, testing, and rollout of heat advisory content with agronomists and livestock experts, ensuring advisories are timely, actionable, and suited to local contexts
* Maintain clear implementation plans, timelines, and responsibilities, plan around the seasonal heatwave window, monitor progress, and proactively address challenges and risks

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
  
  

* Coordinate meetings, workshops, trainings, demonstrations, and other stakeholder engagement activities with government and implementation partners
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, updates, and reports for government and external stakeholders, and support knowledge-sharing between the India and global PxD teams
* Work closely with PxD’s senior leadership and relevant colleagues to ensure government engagement aligns with country priorities and organizational objectives

Program Learning, Monitoring & Adaptation
  
  

* Support strategies to increase the reach, use, and effectiveness of heat advisory services, incorporating farmer feedback, evidence, and pilot learning into program improvements
* Track program and channel performance indicators, support teams in using data to inform implementation decisions, and document stakeholder engagement, decisions, and lessons learned

Reporting & Organizational Contribution
  
  

* Contribute to project reports, donor updates, funding proposals, and other documentation
* Support other program activities related to PxD's weather and climate portfolio as required

What You'll Bring
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

* A Master's degree in development studies, economics, agricultural economics, public policy, environmental or climate science, communications, or a related field
* Significant professional experience in program management, government relations, or stakeholder/partnership management, including demonstrated experience working directly with central and/or state government institutions in India
* Strong understanding of government structures, processes, and stakeholder engagement in India; familiarity with heat action plans, disaster management, agriculture extension, or animal husbandry systems is an advantage
* Experience coordinating programs involving multiple stakeholders, partners, and delivery channels; experience in agriculture, livestock, weather, climate, or digital development is an advantage
* Interest in how AI and new forecasting technologies can be applied to climate adaptation for farmers
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to work effectively with government officials and institutional partners
* Strong project coordination skills, including work planning, tracking deliverables, and managing timelines across multiple workstreams
* Ability to communicate complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, in both English and Hindi (fluency in Hindi required; another Indian language is a plus)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary, international teams
* Ability and willingness to travel within India as required, including to project sites during the summer months

How To Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and complete the online application form, including your CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 6 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Urban Transport Specialist - req38813
description: Urban Transport Specialist Job #: req38813Organization: World BankSector: TransportationGrade: GFTerm Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)Recruitment Type: Local RecruitmentLocation: New Delhi,IndiaRequired Language(s): EnglishPreferred Language(s)Closing Date: 11/9/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTCDescriptionAt the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrdSouth Asia Region ContextThe South Asia Region, comprising Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, is at a pivotal stage of development. Rapid economic growth, driven by urbanization and demographic trends, has reduced poverty, but significant disparities persist. The region also faces growing climate risks, environmental pollution, informality, and low female labor force participation.Sustained, private sector-led growth, anchored in investments in infrastructure, logistics, energy, and connectivity, is critical to creating jobs for South Asia’s sizeable youth population. At the same time, continued investment in human capital is needed to equip people for the jobs of the future.The South Asia Infrastructure program supports countries in building sustainable, resilient, and inclusive infrastructure systems through an integrated, cross-sectoral approach to growth, job creation, connectivity, resilience, and service delivery. Infrastructure engagements increasingly combine public and private sector solutions, including collaboration across the World Bank Group, to maximize development impact.India, the largest economy in South Asia, is undergoing a profound urban and economic transformation. Meeting the country’s growing demand for sustainable mobility, efficient logistics systems, and climate-resilient infrastructure will be important for improving access to jobs and services, enhancing competitiveness, supporting decarbonization, and attracting private investment. The World Bank Group’s engagement in India increasingly calls for integrated solutions that combine public and private financing, policy reform, institutional strengthening, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA.Transport And Logistics PracticeThe Transport and Logistics Practice supports efficient, safe, resilient, and low-carbon connectivity across road, rail, urban transport, maritime transport, inland waterways, and aviation. Working with public and private sector partners, it combines investment and policy support to improve access, trade, economic integration, and the performance of transport services and supply chains.In India, the Practice’s urban transport program promotes compact, connected, inclusive, and low-carbon development through better public transport, multimodal integration, transit-oriented development, electric mobility, safer streets, stronger institutions, and sustainable financing. The program brings together lending, analytics, technical assistance, policy dialogue, and partnerships with national, state, and city governments.About The PositionISAT1 seeks to recruit an Urban Transport Specialist (GF), based in New Delhi, to support the preparation and implementation of urban mobility operations and analytical and advisory work in India and, as needed, elsewhere in South Asia. The position requires a strong combination of urban transport expertise, operational capability, client engagement, analytical judgment, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines and institutions.The selected candidate will be expected to contribute materially to the design and delivery of complex programs, including public transport and institutional reform, urban rail and bus systems, integrated mobility, electric mobility, accessibility and inclusion, climate resilience, road safety, digitalization, infrastructure financing, and private sector participation. The Specialist will work closely with government counterparts, World Bank Group teams, development partners, consultants, and other stakeholders, and will report to the Practice Manager for Transport and Logistics in South Asia.Duties And ResponsibilitiesThe Urban Transport Specialist will perform a full range of technical, operational, analytical, and coordination functions, including but not limited to the following: Urban Transport Operations Support and, as appropriate, lead or co-lead the identification, preparation, appraisal, and implementation of lending and non-lending activities in urban transport. Contribute to project design, results frameworks, implementation arrangements, cost and economic analysis, risk assessment, procurement planning, and implementation support. Help resolve implementation bottlenecks and provide practical, timely advice to clients on institutional, technical, contractual, and operational issues. Work with environmental, social, procurement, financial management, legal, and other specialists to ensure integrated and high-quality project delivery. Monitor progress, results, risks, disbursements, and agreed actions, and prepare concise, decision-useful reporting for task teams and management. Technical and Policy Support Provide technical advice on urban mobility planning, public transport networks and operations, urban rail and bus systems, multimodal integration, first- and last-mile connectivity, walking and cycling, transit-oriented development, and demand management. Support reforms related to public transport institutions, governance, service contracting, fare policy, funding and financing, data systems, performance management, and service quality. Contribute to electric mobility programs, including public transport electrification, enabling infrastructure, institutional arrangements, and coordination with energy and private sector stakeholders. Integrate climate mitigation and resilience, road safety, gender, universal accessibility, social inclusion, and environmental considerations into transport strategies and investments. Assess opportunities for private capital mobilization and innovative financing, including PPPs, blended finance, guarantees, land value capture, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA, where appropriate. Analytics, Knowledge, and Innovation Lead or contribute to analytical and advisory work, policy notes, investment frameworks, sector diagnostics, and city-level mobility studies. Collect, assess, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; use evidence to diagnose mobility constraints, compare options, and formulate implementable recommendations. Promote the use of digital tools, geospatial analysis, transport modeling, open data, and other technologies where they improve planning, operations, monitoring, or user outcomes. Prepare clear technical reports, briefing notes, presentations, talking points, and other knowledge products for varied technical and senior audiences. Share lessons across projects, cities, countries, and Global Practice networks, and contribute to knowledge events and professional communities. Client Engagement and Partnerships Build and maintain effective working relationships with national ministries, state governments, urban local bodies, transport authorities, operators, development partners, private sector participants, academia, and civil society. Participate in policy dialogue and technical discussions, providing evidence-based and practical advice that is responsive to client priorities and implementation capacity. Plan and support missions, workshops, consultations, training activities, and high-level visits, including timely documentation and follow-up. Coordinate effectively across World Bank Group practices and institutions to develop integrated solutions relevant to India’s urban transformation. Team Contribution Work collaboratively in diverse, multidisciplinary, and geographically dispersed teams, contributing constructively to shared outcomes. Guide consultants and junior colleagues, review technical outputs, and contribute to quality assurance and capacity development. Support country and regional strategy work and other Transport and Logistics Practice priorities, including assignments outside the immediate urban transport portfolio when required. Undertake other related responsibilities assigned by the Practice Manager.Selection Criteria Master’s degree or higher in transport planning, transport or civil engineering, urban planning, economics, public policy, finance, or a closely related field. At least 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in urban transport, with demonstrated experience in project preparation, implementation, and/or advisory work. Substantial experience in at least three of the following areas: public transport planning and reform; urban rail or bus systems; integrated and multimodal mobility; electric mobility; active mobility and road safety; transport institutions and policy; infrastructure financing or private sector participation. Experience working with national, state, or city governments on complex transport programs. Experience in India or comparable federal and rapidly urbanizing settings is highly desirable.Technical And Operational Capabilities Strong understanding of urban mobility systems, including the interactions among land use, accessibility, public transport, non-motorized transport, road networks, technology, institutions, financing, and user needs. Demonstrated ability to translate technical analysis into practical project design, policy advice, and implementable actions. Experience managing or supporting complex infrastructure or service-delivery projects, including coordination across technical, fiduciary, environmental, social, and institutional dimensions. Familiarity with economic and financial analysis, procurement and contract management, results monitoring, and risk management in infrastructure projects. Experience with World Bank or other MDB operations is desirable. Familiarity with IPF, PforR, or other development finance instruments would be an advantage.Client, Communication, And Team Skills Excellent client orientation and the ability to build trust, work through differing perspectives, and provide candid, evidence-based advice in complex institutional settings. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, including the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely to technical and senior audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines. Strong judgment, initiative, attention to detail, resourcefulness, and results orientation. Ability to mentor colleagues, manage consultants, and contribute to an inclusive and collaborative working environment.Critical Success Factors Sound understanding of India’s urban transport challenges, institutions, and political economy, with the ability to identify feasible pathways for reform and investment. Capacity to connect technical quality with implementation realities, financing constraints, institutional incentives, and user outcomes. Ability to move comfortably between detailed operational work and higher-level strategic and policy dialogue. Credibility with clients and colleagues, combined with humility, collaboration, and a strong focus on results. Commitment to sustainable, safe, resilient, inclusive, and low-carbon urban mobility.WBG and Transport GP CompetenciesThe position requires strong alignment with World Bank Group Core Competencies, including Deliver Results for Clients, Collaborate Within Teams and Across Boundaries, Lead and Innovate, Create, Apply and Share Knowledge, and Make Smart Decisions. Relevant Transport GP competencies include transport policy and institutions, general transport planning, transport systems and technologies, operational project management, project design for impact and sustainability, client orientation, and knowledge and communication.As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.WBG Culture Attributes Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.World Bank Group Core CompetenciesThe World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.Learn more about working at the World Bank and IFC including our values and inspiring stories.

title: Lead, User-Led Growth (Referrals & Affiliates)
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**User-Led Growth Lead**
to turn our 1M+ travellers into one of Atlys’s most powerful growth channels.
  
  
You’ll own the referral & affiliate program end to end, from how it is constructed and how it shows up in the product to the data and operations that make it run, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Data.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role for someone who has built something from scratch and can own both the strategy and the execution.
  
  
**The Job**

* Own the referral program construct, the incentives, reward economics and placement in the traveller journey, rebuilt from first principles and extended with new levers like an affiliate program.
* Reimagine the referral experience with Product and Engineering, from discovery and sharing to reward redemption across the app and website, shipping experiments that move the numbers.
* Understand who refers and why, digging into data on non-referrers, new referrers and power referrers and running motivation studies that turn into targeted interventions.
* Build the processes behind the program, from reward fulfilment to reporting, so it runs reliably at scale.
* Run a tight ship on delivery, executing referral and UGC campaigns relentlessly, paying every reward on time and catching fraud before it scales.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 3–4 years of experience in growth, product or strategy roles at a startup.
* Have built something from 0 to 1, ideally a referral, loyalty or user-led growth program, and taken it from idea to scale.
* Are a first-principle thinker who is deeply data-driven and lets numbers, not opinions, guide decisions.
* Have a strong grasp of consumer psychology and product, and understand how incentives, timing and UX shape user behaviour.
* Are execution-heavy with strong ops diligence: you sweat the details, close loops and ship fast.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Software Portfolio Specialist - Delhi NCR (Hybrid)
description:

The Software Portfolio Specialist supports the end-to-end management of the organization’s software application portfolio, from initial business need and sourcing through provisioning, ongoing administration, renewal, optimization, and retirement. This role partners with business stakeholders, Purchasing, Cybersecurity, software vendors, and other IT teams to ensure applications are effectively managed and aligned with business needs.

**Software Application Management**

* Support the full lifecycle of software applications, including evaluation, onboarding, administration, optimization, renewal, and retirement.
* Administer software applications as assigned, including user access, license allocation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine configuration.
* Coordinate with other Technology teams on application-related security, identity/access, endpoint, infrastructure, architecture, and support requirements.
* Maintain accurate application records, including licensing information, business ownership, renewal dates, contracts, entitlements, and other portfolio data.
* Execute established policies, procedures, and controls.
* Support software license optimization and reclamation activities.

* Help develop an increasingly autonomous operating model, where routine activities are proactively identified and automated.
* Maintain application documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and administration guides.

* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.

* Hands on experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management Professional (SAM Pro) and IT Service Management (ITSM), including incident and request management.

* Experience supporting application implementations or technology projects preferred.

description:
**Job Title:** Project Director – MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing)

**Department:** Projects  
**Industry:** Construction / MEP Services  
**Experience:** 15–20+ Years  
**Location:** As per Project Requirement  
**Reports To:** Managing Director / CEO

Job Summary

The Project Director – MEP is responsible for overseeing and managing all MEP projects from planning and execution to completion and handover. The role involves strategic project management, coordination with clients and consultants, budget control, resource planning, quality assurance, safety compliance, and ensuring timely project delivery within the approved budget.

Key Responsibilities

* **Project Planning & Execution**
* Lead and oversee all MEP project activities from initiation to final handover.
* Develop project execution strategies, schedules, and resource plans.
* Ensure projects are completed within the approved timeline and budget.
* Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions when required.
* **MEP Technical Management**
* Oversee mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, firefighting, and related building services.
* Review and approve technical drawings, shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements.
* Ensure proper coordination between MEP, civil, structural, and architectural teams.
* Resolve major technical issues and site execution challenges.
* **Budget & Cost Control**
* Manage project budgets, cash flow, procurement costs, and resource allocation.
* Monitor project profitability and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Review project variations, claims, and additional work requirements.
* Ensure effective utilization of manpower, materials, and equipment.
* **Client & Stakeholder Coordination**
* Maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and project management teams.
* Attend project review meetings and provide progress reports to senior management.
* Resolve escalated issues and ensure client satisfaction.
* Coordinate approvals, inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
* **Team Leadership & Resource Management**
* Lead Project Managers, Project Engineers, Construction Managers, and other MEP teams.
* Allocate manpower and resources across projects based on priorities.
* Set performance targets and monitor team productivity.
* Mentor and develop project leadership teams.
* **Quality, Safety & Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, specifications, and statutory requirements.
* Implement quality assurance and quality control procedures.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Monitor inspections, testing, commissioning, and snag rectification.
* **Procurement & Contract Management**
* Oversee procurement planning, vendor selection, and material delivery schedules.
* Review major purchase orders, subcontract agreements, and commercial terms.
* Monitor subcontractor performance and contractual obligations.
* Ensure materials and equipment meet approved specifications.
* **Reporting & Project Handover**
* Prepare and review project progress, financial, and risk reports.
* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure proper documentation, as-built drawings, operation manuals, and warranties.
* Lead final commissioning, client handover, and project closeout.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
* A postgraduate qualification in Project Management or Construction Management is an advantage.
* PMP or other recognized project management certification is preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and strategic decision-making abilities.
* Excellent knowledge of MEP systems and construction project management.
* Strong financial management, budgeting, and contract administration skills.
* Excellent client communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple large-scale projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Project, Primavera P6, AutoCAD, and MS Office.

Preferred Experience

* 15–20+ years of experience in MEP construction and project management.
* Proven experience managing large-scale commercial, hospitality, residential, or industrial projects.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing project budgets.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical systems, plumbing, firefighting, testing, and commissioning.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of projects.
* Project budget adherence and profitability.
* Quality standards and reduction in rework.
* Safety compliance and incident reduction.
* Client satisfaction and successful project handover.
* Effective manpower and resource utilization.

Work Location: In person

title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

Opensity is committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and the work we do for our clients.

Opensity provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, family status, marital status, source of income, record of offences, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal or provincial human rights legislation.

We are committed to fair and barrier free recruitment, selection, and employment practices, and to providing reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process and employment lifecycle, in accordance with applicable human rights legislation.

Candidates who require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process are encouraged to advise our Talent team so appropriate support can be provided.

title: Associate Project Manager - Quantitative Research
description:
**Inizio Ignite, Research Partnership**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Our Research Partnership healthcare market research team provides research and insights to inform and power healthcare decisions. Serving a variety of clients across the lifecycle, our expertise includes data, research & insights (proprietary syndicated and custom research) and brand tracking (ATU). Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The role of the Project Manager is to cost and oversee the set up and management of fieldwork and data collection to ensure successful completion within best practices. You will also be expected to contribute to company operations processes; providing proactive ideas and plans about improving the efficiency of the project management function and projects. Core, but not exclusive, responsibilities will include:
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Responsibility for sourcing, obtaining and negotiating commercially advantageous costs from external suppliers and panel providers for Research Partnership project proposals
* Updating suppliers on the status of their quotes
* Overseeing the smooth running of fieldwork management
* Successful handover of project deliverables to research team:
* Coordination of Data Processing (DP) work and deliverables, based on specs and templates provided by the project team (Quant-only)
* Own, coordinate and update project timelines with internal research and external client and supplier stakeholders
* Take ownership for coordinating project team meetings,
* Opportunity to develop line management responsibilities for junior members of the team
* Responsibility for Pharmacovigilance and Adverse Event reporting
* Coordination of client and supplier Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Client and supplier invoice management (PO numbers, invoicing and liaison with Finance team)
* You will own specific sub-topics as a member of one of the department’s Pillars (Clients, Suppliers, People, Innovation, Operational Excellence)

**What You'll Need**

* More than 5 years of experience in market research project management (quantitative research)
* Experience managing healthcare market research projects
* Knowledge of the fieldwork agency landscape
* Strong project management skills (adhering to agreed timelines, troubleshooting and communication with internal and external stakeholders)
* Ability to multitask
* Collaboration and working as part of a team
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Excellent numerical skills

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

***Artificial Intelligence***

title: Manager/Senior Manager – Middle Office (Project Management) – Financial Operations
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group seeks a motivated and detail-oriented professional to join its growing Middle Office function in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India. This team supports the lifecycle of the firm's global trading strategies and serves as a key link between the front office and operational teams. This project-focused role offers the opportunity to lead middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies, while retaining hands-on operational ownership. This position will initially be an individual contributor role, with the potential to assume people management responsibilities in the future based on business needs and the candidate's interest.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will lead and deliver middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies. You will act as a project manager across internal and external teams—scoping requirements, driving solutioning, coordinating testing, and owning sign-off on product roadmaps. You will partner with trading desks, technology, operations, and vendors to convert operational pain points into durable solutions that reduce risk and manual effort. You will manually handle exceptions and edge cases that fall outside automated workflows, resolving them accurately and feeding insights back into process improvements. You will work across the full trade lifecycle and a range of hedge fund asset classes, designing corner cases and defining exception handling for post-automation workflows. You will also build workflows, dashboards, and tooling that give the desk and management clear visibility into trading activity, operational health, and risk.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* A postgraduate degree and 5+ years of relevant experience across the trade lifecycle, including time in or alongside middle office functions
* A robust understanding of trade lifecycle operations—trade capture, P&L, security master, settlements, and corporate actions—and of how various hedge fund asset classes behave across their lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience managing projects end-to-end as a project manager across internal and external teams, including scoping, testing, sign-off, and stakeholder coordination
* A risk-first mindset, with the judgment to anticipate corner cases and design exception handling for post-automation workflows
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to senior management, stakeholders, front office, and vendors
* The ability to design or contribute to dashboards, workflows, and analytics that surface operational insight

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with automation and hands-on familiarity with emerging GenAI and LLM tooling, with the ability to identify and apply these pragmatically within middle office workflows
* Program management–related academic qualifications (e.g., MBA, PMP)

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/MngrMOPMJul2026
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Noida. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  
  

IT Project Manager is responsible for ensuring that projects are completed successfully, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while managing risks, stakeholders, and resources effectively.

  

**We will count on you to:**

  

* Project Planning: Develop a comprehensive project plan that outlines the project scope, objectives, timelines, budget, and resources required to complete the project successfully.

* Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain relationships with stakeholders, core team members, extended project team to ensure that project goals are met.
* Communication: Communicate project progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, including senior management, project sponsors, and team members.
* Resource Management: Manage project resources, including personnel, equipment, and materials, to ensure that they are used effectively and efficiently.
* Quality Management: Ensure that project deliverables meet the required quality standards and that project processes are followed consistently.
* Change Management: Manage changes to the project scope, schedule, or budget, ensuring that they are properly documented and approved.
* Project Closure: Ensure that all project deliverables are completed, and that the project is closed out in a timely and efficient manner.
  

  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline
* 10 years of Project Management experience
* Experience of managing Finance system projects
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) to convey information clearly and concisely to stakeholders of all levels.
* Advanced skills in MS Project, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Strong leadership skills, ability to motivate and inspire team members to achieve project goals.
* Good time management skills to be able to manage your own time and time of project team members to ensure project deadlines are met.
* Problem solving skills to be able to effectively identify and solve problems that arise during the project, including thinking creatively, identify potential solutions and make informed decisions
  

**What makes you stand out:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently
  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services –**
**Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. You will work across tax, process, and technology teams to support scalable, compliant, and efficient tax functions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals
* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
How you’ll grow At Deloitte - We’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
  
  
Deloitte supports your progression through a well-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent postgraduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
  
  
Deloitte’s culture
  
  
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centred, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
  
  
Corporate citizenship
  
  
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience
* 5+ years of implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S/4HANA with a focus on Tax integration across SAP FICO/MM/SD, including Direct or Indirect Tax experience
* Experience with tax technology applications such as ONESOURCE/Global Next Integration, Vertex Accelerator and Chainflow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, and Sovos
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations, and reporting
* Experience resolving high-priority L1 tickets and supporting L2/L3 tickets, with deep root-cause analysis for recurring system failures
* Experience with SLA compliance, monitoring performance metrics to ensure target resolution times are consistently met
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, and providing user training and documentation
* Expert in cross-functional integration of modules - SD-FI and MM-FI
* Strong project management and leadership abilities, with the ability to independently drive project cycles and deliverables
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time
* Effective communication and strong presentation and team-building skills; proactive, participates in firm-based activities, and owns his/her career
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation
* Chartered Accountant, MBA, Master of Commerce (M.Com), or comparable/equivalent postgraduate qualification, with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Audit

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S/4HANA) Certified
* Experience with third-party tax engines such as Vertex, ONESOURCE, or Avalara, and knowledge of SAP DRC
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, and Asset Accounting implementation
* Experience with ITSM/incident management tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA, including SLA dashboards and incident/problem management reporting

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. title: Senior Manager, Global Coverage/Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
  
  
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager of Global Coverage will work with a technology leader in the market research industry, specialising in online and digital methodologies. This role is responsible for managing a team of Project Managers while developing and growing strong relationships with customers, the sales team, and key internal stakeholders.
  
  
This position plays a critical role within the organisation, serving as the primary line of communication between the Global Coverage team and the Director and leadership team. As part of a global organisation, the Senior Manager is accountable for ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction by enabling their team to successfully deliver on client project goals, supporting client growth strategies, and proactively troubleshooting and resolving client concerns.
  
  
In addition, the role involves coaching and developing team members, leading strategic projects, and collaborating cross-functionally with multiple departments to improve operational efficiency and continue diversifying the coverage portfolio.
  
  
To support our commitment to 24×7 customer coverage, flexibility with shift timings is essential, including participation in rotational shifts. This is a remote position.
  
  
Candidates with high initiative and a hands-on, can-do approach will thrive in this fast-paced environment. Successful individuals will encounter daily opportunities to contribute to the company’s growth in a demanding yet rewarding setting where creativity, ownership, and strong results are recognised and rewarded.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage a team of Project Managers at various skill levels
* Utilize Cint’s proprietary software to create and manage research surveys related to advertising effectiveness or professional services
* Act as the first point of escalation for your team members including (but not limited to) incidents involving platform issues, client's communicated concerns, or impactful changes to project scope
* Develop a robust understanding of the Market Research and Digital Advertising industries, comprehending how Cint can solve challenges using technology
* Support your team to successfully work on a multitude of projects concurrently while ensuring a high level of quality across all studies with little to no supervision
* Compile and extract data from various sources (proprietary software, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Salesforce, Qualtrics, etc.) to present data to internal and external clients
* Coordinate with Sales Directors, Account Management, Product, and Finance to ensure seamless project execution and continued product development
* Ability to work independently and be self-motivated with effective time management
* Develop strong working relationships with external client personnel, anticipating client needs and ensuring high levels of customer service while adhering to client budget
* Work with customers to understand project needs, recommend optimal solutions, and coordinate with internal teams and external partners to successfully deliver projects on time and in budget

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* BA/BS Degree
* Minimum 8 years of customer-facing experience with proven ability to manage multiple complex projects under tight deadlines
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing, growing, and scaling teams.
* Proficient in Google Suite, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Strong work ethic with a self-motivated mindset and drive to achieve goals
* Detail-oriented, self-starter who is eager to learn new skills and concepts
* An innate sense of accountability, ability to provide proactive and thoughtful feedback
* Top quality ability in written and oral communication in English, additional languages are highly beneficial

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the online market research ecosystem
* Knowledge of programmatic sampling
* Survey design experience in Qualtrics, Survey Monkey, etc.
* Market Research coursework or experience
* Microsoft Excel certification
* Statistical knowledge or working knowledge or SPSS, STATA, SAS

**Benefits**
**Additional Information**

* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience
* Comprehensive training and opportunities for professional growth and promotion
* Worldwide exposure to the biggest companies in the market research industry
* Company-provided laptop and other facilities to enable work from home

**Our Values**
**Collaboration is our superpower**

* We uncover rich perspectives across the world
* Success happens together
* We deliver across borders.

**Innovation is in our blood**

* We’re pioneers in our industry
* Our curiosity is insatiable
* We bring the best ideas to life.

**We Do What We Say**

* We’re accountable for our work and actions
* Excellence comes as standard
* We’re open, honest and kind, always.

**We are caring**

* We learn from each other’s experiences
* Stop and listen; every opinion matters
* We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

**More About Cint**
We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
  
  
In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.
  
  
Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)
  
  
Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

title: Senior Programme Manager
description: Role purposeThe Senior Manager – Finance Systems will provide permanent, enterprise-level leadership for the Finance Systems & Transformation portfolio.
