Controlled programme financial and resource view covering budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and capacity. Business readiness, transition and BAU handover plans for each material initiative. Portfolio-level benefits tracking and post-implementation review.EssentialSkills and experience Significant experience leading complex, multi-workstream Finance Systems or enterprise transformation programmes. Strong programme and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, governance, RAID, dependencies, change control and benefits realisation. Experience preparing executive and Steering Committee reporting and converting complex information into clear decisions and recommendations. Proven ability to coordinate Finance, Technology, Operations and external delivery partners in a matrix environment. Experience challenging delivery plans, driving recovery activity and holding senior workstream owners accountable. Understanding of Finance processes, systems implementation, controls, testing, readiness and BAU transition. Commercial and financial discipline covering budgets, forecasts, resource plans and supplier commitments. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills. Ability to operate hands-on, manage competing priorities and deliver through ambiguity.Preferred Experience in Financial Services or another regulated, control-focused environment. Experience with Finance ERP, EPM, reporting, data, controls or operating-model transformation. Exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Anaplan, Power BI, Qlik or Azure DevOps. Experience establishing or maturing a transformation office, portfolio office or enterprise PMO. Experience working across global teams and delivery partners, including India-based delivery models. Recognised programme or project management qualification, such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent. Finance, accounting, technology or transformation-related professional qualification.Personal attributes Outcome-oriented, structured and able to combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery. Calm and credible with senior stakeholders, while willing to challenge constructively. Highly organised, analytical and rigorous about ownership, evidence and follow-through. Commercially aware, pragmatic and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information. Collaborative across cultures, functions and locations, with a strong commitment to building internal capability.Success measures Transformation initiatives delivered to agreed outcomes, quality, cost and key milestones. Leadership has a reliable, single view of programme status, decisions, risks, resources and dependencies. Material risks and slippage are identified early, with timely recovery action and escalation. Governance forums result in clear decisions, accountable actions and measurable follow-through. Improved consistency and maturity of programme planning, reporting and delivery controls. Successful business adoption, BAU transition and measurable benefits realisation. Reduced reliance on external programme leadership through sustainable permanent capability in India.Role positioningThis is not a reporting-only PMO role. It is a senior, hands-on programme leadership position accountable for joining up the Finance Transformation portfolio, driving execution and maintaining the governance discipline required to deliver sustainable business outcomes. Individual workstream leads remain accountable for their solutions and deliverables; this role provides the integration, challenge, visibility and leadership that connect them into one controlled programme.About FNZFNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back. We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution. We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle

We aim to make meaningful spiritual knowledge accessible to audiences around the world. We value teamwork, mutual respect, continuous learning and a friendly, collaborative working environment.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About The E2M**
E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.
  
  
**About The Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Discovery and Assessment
* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.
* AI Blueprint and Proposal
* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.
* Delivery and Account Management
* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.
* Adoption and Training
* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.
* Team Leadership
* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements**

* Experience
* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.
* Technical Skills
* AI: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* Build: Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* Integration: APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* Agency stack: GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* Judgment: Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.
* Consulting Skills
* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.
* Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.
* Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.
* Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.
* Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.

Who you are

* **Mandatory: real, hands-on ground experience.**
   8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have stood on sites, managed crews and contractors, and know how a PNG connection is built, from survey to gas-on. Desk-only or consulting backgrounds will not be considered.
* **Deep relationships across PSUs, government and utilities.**
   You have strong, active links with decision-makers in gas, power and other utility companies, PSUs and the government departments that oversee them, and you know how they evaluate, approve and buy.
* **Commercial instinct.**
   You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. You can open a door, run a meeting and follow through to a decision.
* **Equally at home on a site and in a boardroom.**
   You can win over a plumbing supervisor, and you can present calmly and crisply to an MD.
* **Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi,**
   with clear spoken and written English for leadership meetings and proposals.
* **A natural trainer and explainer.**
   You can take a non-technical crew through a new app and get them using it the same day.
* **A sharp observer.**
   You notice how work really gets done, and you can describe it clearly enough for a product team to act on.
* **Firm and fair with contractors.**
   You hold people to commitments without breaking the relationship.
* **Comfortable with data.**
   You live in dashboards and Excel, and you act on what the numbers show.
* **A builder.**
   You want to create something new, are comfortable with ambiguity, and own outcomes rather than tasks.
* **Graduate engineer**
   (mechanical, civil, chemical or petroleum preferred), or equivalent field experience.

Good to have

* Experience at a Gujarat city gas company, or with contractors who work for one.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement: tenders, empanelment and approval processes.
* Exposure to SAP in a utility (service orders, contractor billing or customer service).
* Experience rolling out a field app or digital process to a distributed, non-office workforce.
* Experience in a startup, or in a new-business role inside a larger company.
* A network of contractors, plumbers and site supervisors in Gujarat.

Location, pay and how to apply

* **Base:**
   Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
* **Travel:**
   frequent day trips to pilot sites and service centres in Gujarat (for example Surat and Bharuch), plus travel to other states for client meetings.
* **Ownership:**
   [ESOPs or equity, to be discussed].
* **Growth:**
   as the product scales, you build and lead the field and client team across utilities.

**To apply,**
 send your CV to Vivek.slaria@originbluy.com with a short note on one field rollout you led and one client you helped win: what was stuck, what you did, and what changed.

title: Civil Engineer (Renewable) - US
description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates solar, wind, green hydrogen, battery storage, and EV infrastructure projects across the United States, India, and EMEA markets. The company provides turnkey "Development as a Service," powered by 100% internal systems engineering and a world-class team that comes out of some of the most reputed organizations in the renewables industry. This team operates within a sophisticated software and AI environment to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

* Ahmedabad/ Noida/ Chennai

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Civil Engineer with 4–6 years of project design experience to lead civil engineering efforts for utility‑scale solar projects in the U.S. market. The role involves directing civil design activities, including site planning, grading, drainage, stormwater engineering, and road layout development, while ensuring compliance with AHJ, DOT, DEP, and U.S. code requirements.

This position requires strong proficiency in Civil 3D for surface modelling, corridor creation, earthwork analysis, and preparation of grading and drainage deliverables. The Civil Engineer will work closely with civil, structural, electrical, environmental, and permitting teams to produce coordinated IFC packages and support client discussions and technical reviews. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong engineering judgment, leadership ability, and the capability to deliver accurate, constructible, and code‑compliant civil design packages from concept through IFC.

**Core Responsibilities**

***Site Planning, Site Feasibility Study***

* Lead and own civil engineering design for C&I, DER, and utility-scale solar projects in the U.S.
* Define design strategy, establish criteria, and guide technical direction based on AHJ, geotechnical, permitting, and client requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to the civil design team, resolving engineering issues and ensuring high-quality deliverables.
* Plan and optimize overall site layout, access roads, entrances, parking, laydown yards, PV blocks, and infrastructure in accordance with AHJ and DOT requirements.
* Lead Civil 3D expertise for site development workflows, including corridor modeling, assemblies, subassemblies, profiles, plan-view alignment creation, sight-distance triangles, roundabout geometry, and county road upgrade requirements.

***Grading Design***

* Lead grading design for inverter pads, tracker rows, PV solar fields, BESS pads, substation yards, O&M buildings, equipment foundations, and overall site platforms.
* Oversee Civil 3D-based grading for roads, slopes, berms, retention/detention ponds, laydown yards, and drainage corridors.
* Perform earthwork optimization, cut/fill balancing, grading tie-ins, slope stabilization design, and constructability reviews.
* Develop detailed road alignment layouts, vertical profiles, cross-sections, super-elevation design, and horizontal control in accordance with DOT and county standards.
* Support trench design, underground routing, ductbank alignments, trench cross-sections, and Civil 3D modeling of utilities.

***Drainage & Stormwater Management***

* Lead hydrology and stormwater engineering including runoff modeling, hydraulic sizing, stormwater routing, and channel/ditch design.
* Design retention ponds, detention ponds, sediment basins, drainage traps, and basin outlet structures following state and county stormwater regulations.
* Review and validate hydraulic calculations for culverts, swales, energy dissipation, spillways, and peak-flow control per AHJ requirements.
* Oversee preparation of permitting-compliant SWPPP, SPCC, SPPP, E&S Plans, BMP strategies, and stormwater technical packages.
* Provide technical guidance for Highway Occupancy Permits (HOP), driveway access permits, county stormwater permits, environmental approvals, and right-of-way applications.

***Coordination, BOQ & Technical Support***

* Coordinate with civil, structural, electrical, environmental, and geotechnical teams to deliver fully integrated design packages.
* Review and approve BOQs, engineering estimates, scope matrices, material specifications, and procurement documentation.
* Provide engineering oversight for IFC deliverables, design bases, technical notes, and permitting documents.
* Act as the lead civil engineering representative in client discussions, multi-disciplinary design reviews, technical meetings, and bid/proposal cycles.

***Quality Assurance & Site Support***

* Lead QA/QC processes including checking grading models, corridor models, hydrology reports, drainage maps, and civil-site deliverables.
* Conduct risk assessments, design validation, constructability reviews, and peer checks in alignment with U.S. codes and project standards.
* Provide engineering support during permitting, pre-construction, and construction, including responding to RFIs, design clarifications, and field condition changes.

***Design Review & Code Compliance***

* Review and validate all civil engineering analyses including grading models, corridor modelling outputs, hydrologic calculations, and pond sizing.
* Ensure compliance with U.S. federal, state, and county standards including DOT roadway criteria, AHJ stormwater requirements, erosion control rules, and permitting frameworks.
* Guide the design team in applying ASCE, ASTM, EPA, state DEP stormwater rules, and local jurisdictional standards based on project location.

**Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (required).
* Master’s degree in Structural Engineering (preferred).

**Technical Skills and Experience**

*Software Proficiency*

* AutoCAD
* Civil 3D
* AutoTurn, Vehicle Tracking
* HECRAS, HECHMS, HydroCAD, StormCAD
* QGIS, ArcGIS
* Storm Sewer Analysis
* CulvertMaster, StormCAD

*Project Management:*

* Design experience in projects from conception to implementation
* Ability to coordinate with other engineers and stakeholders

*Renewable Energy Systems:*

* Understanding of solar PV, BESS, and renewable energy infrastructure design and integration.

*Experience*

* 4–6 years of civil engineering experience, preferably on U.S. solar, BESS, substation, or other renewable energy projects.
* Strong experience in analysis and design for power and renewable energy systems.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Project Management experience a plus.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
* Excellence in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

title: Senior Executive, Application Development
description:
**Job Description**

* Analyse functional and business integration requirements and translate them into detailed technical interface designs.

* Work hands-on with technologies and protocols such as:

+ SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration

+ OData APIs
+ REST APIs
+ SOAP Web Services
+ EDI

* Support SAP S/4HANA integration with applications such as:

+ Manufacturing and shop-floor systems
+ Laboratory/LIMS systems
+ Warehouse and logistics applications
+ Quality systems
+ Banking and treasury applications
+ Master data systems
+ CRM and commercial applications
+ Regulatory and serialization solutions
+ Identity/access management applications

* Understand SAP business objects and interface structures across relevant SAP functional modules.

* Analyse IDoc failures, API errors, message failures, connectivity issues, data mapping errors, and application-level exceptions.
* Design appropriate:

+ Error handling
+ Retry mechanisms
+ Reprocessing
+ Alerting
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation
+ Audit trail mechanisms

* Participate in technical design reviews and ensure interfaces meet enterprise integration architecture standards.
* Prepare and maintain technical/interface specification documents covering end-to-end integration from source system through middleware to target system.
* Ensure specifications clearly document:

+ Source and target systems
+ Interface direction
+ Business triggers
+ Data structures and mappings
+ Transformation rules
+ Frequency and volumes
+ Authentication/security
+ Error handling
+ Reprocessing
+ Monitoring
+ Reconciliation
+ Dependencies
+ Batch scheduling
+ Performance requirements

* Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, cutover, and production deployment.
* Prepare test data and technically support defect investigation and resolution.
* Participate in interface migration and deployment activities across SAP development, quality, validation, and production environments.
* Support cutover planning, interface activation/deactivation, data synchronization, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Provide Level 2/Level 3 technical support for production integration issues.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective solutions for recurring interface failures.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors for API specifications, connectivity, certificates, endpoints, firewall requirements, and technical issue resolution.

**SAP Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP interface/integration development.
* Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA integration architecture.
* Strong knowledge of at least one major SAP middleware/integration platform, preferably SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration.

* Strong knowledge of IDoc/ALE, RFC, BAPI, OData, REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, and API technologies.

* Working knowledge of ABAP sufficient for interface troubleshooting, debugging, enhancements, user exits/BAdIs, and technical coordination with ABAP teams.
* Knowledge of SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF) is desirable.
* Experience with integration monitoring and error-handling frameworks.
* Understanding of certificate management, OAuth, Basic Authentication, SAML, API keys, encryption, and secure communication protocols.

* Understanding of event-driven integration, Event Mesh, or similar technologies is an advantage.

* Minimum 8+ years of overall SAP technical/integration experience.

* Experience working in SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, transformation, or support programs.
* Greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation experience is preferred.
* Experience integrating SAP with multiple enterprise and third-party applications.
* Experience working with geographically distributed functional, technical, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
* Pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical device, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Associate – Integration Developer / SAP Integration Suite certification.
* SAP BTP-related certification.
* SAP S/4HANA-related certification.
* Other relevant SAP technical/integration certifications.

* Delivery of stable, secure, scalable, and maintainable SAP interfaces.

* Compliance with SAP Clean Core and enterprise architecture principles.

title: Revenue Operations Hubspot Specialist
description:
**RevOps HubSpot Specialist**

**Department & Reporting Line**

Department: Revenue Operations / GTM Team

Location: Ahmedabad, India — Onsite

Reports to: RevOps Lead

Works with: Business CRM Analyst (Driver on delivery) and the RevOps Strategist / Client Owner (Approver) on every ticket, per the DACI model in the RevOps Delivery Process. Escalates directly and ad hoc to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief.

Role Summary

We are hiring a RevOps HubSpot Specialist to execute hands-on CRM configuration and GTM process builds for York IE's client engagements. This role is the core technical Contributor in the RevOps Delivery Process — building against well-defined Jira stories across HubSpot's core hubs, self-certifying QA, and growing into ownership of increasingly complex, multi-hub builds under the guidance of a RevOps Lead.

Key Responsibilities

HubSpot CRM Configuration & Build

1. Configure and administer core HubSpot modules — Sales Hub and Marketing Hub as the primary scope, with growing, guided exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, and CMS Hub.
2. Build workflows, sequences, lead scoring, list segmentation, pipelines, and property/field configuration against documented acceptance criteria.
3. Set up lead routing rules, lifecycle-stage automation, and standard Marketing → Sales → Customer Success handoff logic.
4. Support HubSpot-to-Salesforce (or another adjacent tool) field mapping and sync troubleshooting under guidance from the Lead or a senior Specialist.

GTM Execution Support

1. Execute campaign tracking (UTMs), nurture flow builds, and sequence design per Marketing/Sales requirements.
2. Assist with waterfall enrichment logic and match-rate troubleshooting in coordination with data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
3. Support first-touch/last-touch attribution reporting and funnel conversion tracking.

Reporting & Analytics

1. Build standard HubSpot reports and dashboards tracking pipeline, campaign performance, and activity metrics.
2. Flag data-quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, broken syncs) to the Business CRM Analyst or RevOps Lead promptly.

Delivery Process (Contributor per DACI)

1. Configure/build each assigned story in HubSpot against acceptance criteria set by the Business CRM Analyst.
2. Complete the Self-QA Checklist — functional test, data validation, regression check, access/permissions check, evidence attached — before moving a story to Ready for UAT.
3. Give the standing Delivery & Build Update on weekly client calls: what was configured, what passed Self-QA, what's blocked.
4. Escalate directly and promptly to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief or needing core technical guidance — an ad hoc coaching step, not a formal workflow stage.

Data Governance & Quality

1. Follow the deduplication, normalization, and data hygiene standards set for the account.
2. Maintain clean documentation and evidence trails on every ticket per the Self-QA standard.

Required Qualifications

1. 4+ years of hands-on RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, or CRM Admin experience, with solid working expertise in HubSpot (Sales Hub and Marketing Hub required; exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, or CMS Hub is a strong plus).
2. Comfortable independently building workflows, sequences, lead scoring, and reporting on well-scoped tickets.
3. Basic familiarity with Salesforce or another secondary CRM (Zoho) is a plus.
4. Exposure to GTM data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit) is helpful but not required.
5. Comfort working in a Jira/DACI-based delivery model — clear on when to build independently versus when to escalate.
6. Solid communication skills; comfortable giving a live build update on client calls.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

1. HubSpot certifications (Sales Hub Implementation, Marketing Hub Implementation, or RevOps).
2. Experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
3. Exposure to Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, or Segment.
4. Basic reporting/BI tool familiarity (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

The role requires strong expertise in soft textile products, cushion and cover manufacturing, stitching operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and large-scale shop-floor operations. The candidate will work closely with PPC, Quality, SCM, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure efficient and timely execution of customer orders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Production Operations Management


+ Lead day-to-day production operations for cushion, covers, soft furnishings, and customized textile products.
+ Manage end-to-end manufacturing processes including fabric cutting, printing/customization, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, finishing, packing, and dispatch.
+ Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
+ Optimize manpower and machine utilization to achieve planned production volumes.
+ Ensure production schedules are executed as per customer requirements and committed delivery timelines.
+ Monitor shop-floor operations and proactively address bottlenecks affecting production output.

* Production Planning & Execution


+ Coordinate closely with PPC and SCM teams to ensure availability of fabrics, trims, fillers, accessories, packaging materials, and other required raw materials.
+ Plan production capacity based on order volumes, product complexity, manpower availability, and machine capacity.
+ Monitor WIP, production flow, line balancing, machine loading, and bottlenecks.
+ Ensure effective production sequencing for multiple SKUs, customized orders, and varying product specifications.
+ Establish effective shift planning, production allocation, and handover mechanisms.
+ Ensure smooth execution of urgent and priority orders without compromising quality.

* Cutting, Stitching & Sewing Operations


+ Drive operational efficiency across cutting, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, and finishing processes.
+ Optimize cutting layouts and fabric utilization to minimize wastage.
+ Improve stitching productivity through appropriate machine allocation, line balancing, and operator skill mapping.
+ Monitor sewing machine efficiency, operator productivity, cycle times, and line output.
+ Identify process constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
+ Standardize processes and SOPs across different product categories and production lines.

* Quality Management


+ Ensure adherence to defined product specifications, workmanship standards, and customer requirements.
+ Minimize defects, rejection, rework, fabric wastage, stitching defects, dimensional deviations, and finishing issues.
+ Work closely with QA/QC teams to establish process quality checkpoints.
+ Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
+ Ensure consistency in dimensions, stitching quality, filling density, finishing, appearance, and overall product quality.
+ Monitor quality metrics and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

* Manpower & Shop-Floor Management


+ Lead supervisors, line leaders, operators, tailors, cutters, helpers, and other shop-floor personnel.
+ Plan manpower deployment based on production requirements and skill availability.
+ Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and workforce utilization.
+ Develop skill matrices and identify training requirements for operators and supervisors.
+ Drive multi-skilling and cross-training initiatives to improve workforce flexibility.
+ Build a performance-oriented, disciplined, and safety-focused production culture.

* Machine & Equipment Management


+ Ensure optimum utilization of stitching, sewing, cutting, printing, filling, and finishing equipment.
+ Coordinate with Maintenance teams to minimize machine breakdowns and production downtime.
+ Monitor machine efficiency and support preventive maintenance initiatives.
+ Identify requirements for new machines, tooling, automation, and process improvements.
+ Support machine installation, trials, commissioning, and production stabilization.
+ Evaluate opportunities for automation in repetitive and high-volume production processes.

* Productivity & Process Improvement


+ Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, line balancing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
+ Improve productivity through optimization of manpower, machine utilization, process flow, and cycle times.
+ Identify opportunities to reduce material wastage, rework, overtime, and production costs.
+ Analyze production MIS and KPI dashboards to identify performance gaps.
+ Establish and monitor KPIs for productivity, efficiency, quality, wastage, downtime, and on-time production.
+ Drive standardization and process improvement across the cushion and cover manufacturing operations.

* Cross-Functional Coordination


+ Work closely with PPC, SCM, Quality, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, Product Development, and Warehouse teams.
+ Coordinate with Design/Product teams to understand new product specifications and manufacturing requirements.
+ Support new product introduction (NPI), sampling, trials, and production scale-up.
+ Ensure smooth transition of new products from sampling to mass production.
+ Resolve production-related issues impacting order fulfillment and customer commitments.

* Safety & Compliance


+ Ensure adherence to EHS and statutory requirements across the production floor.
+ Maintain safe working practices across cutting, stitching, filling, printing, and finishing operations.
+ Conduct regular shop-floor audits and ensure timely closure of safety observations.
+ Promote 5S, workplace discipline, housekeeping, and safe equipment handling.

**Key Deliverables**




+ Achievement of daily/monthly production targets.
+ Improved production efficiency and machine utilization.
+ Reduction in rejection, rework, wastage, and production losses.
+ Improved stitching, cutting, filling, and finishing productivity.
+ Improved fabric utilization and reduction in material wastage.
+ Timely completion of customized customer orders.
+ Effective manpower utilization and productivity improvement.
+ Reduction in machine downtime and process bottlenecks.
+ Successful execution of new product introductions and production scale-ups.
+ Controlled manufacturing cost and continuous process improvement.
+ Safe, disciplined, and compliant production operations.

**Qualification & Experience**




+ Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Textile Engineering, Production, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
+ 8–12 years of experience in textile, home furnishing, soft furnishing, cushion, cover, upholstery, garmenting, or related manufacturing operations.
+ Strong experience in cutting, stitching/sewing, filling, finishing, and soft textile product manufacturing.
+ Experience managing large shop-floor manpower and multiple production lines/shifts.
+ Strong understanding of production planning, line balancing, productivity improvement, quality management, and manufacturing KPIs.
+ Exposure to Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, and process improvement will be preferred.
+ Experience in customized/high-SKU or e-commerce manufacturing environments will be an added advantage.
+ Strong analytical, problem-solving, people-management, and cross-functional coordination skills.

**Job title:**
Production Manager – Compression Molded Rubber Products

**Company:**
Manna Rubber Products (Manna Group of Companies)

Airapuram Rubber Park, Ernakulam, Kerala, India

Full-time

Description (paste into the “Description” box)

**About Us**

Manna Rubber Products is part of the Manna Group of Companies, a Kerala-based rubber group working in rubber reclaiming, tread rubber and retreading materials, and tires, with operations in India and the UAE. We’re growing our range of compression-molded rubber products, including rubber mats.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced production manager to lead our compression-molded rubber goods production. You’ll run day-to-day production, including planning, people, machines, quality, and reporting, and you’ll be responsible for improving machine and manpower efficiency in ways we can measure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and run daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules against sales orders so orders ship on time at the target quality and cost.
* Manage the full compression molding process: compound issue, preform preparation, press loading, curing (time, temperature, and pressure), deflashing, trimming, inspection, and packing.
* Lead, train, and motivate shift supervisors, operators, and contract workers. This includes manpower allocation, shift planning, discipline, and multi-skilling.
* Measure and report machine efficiency (press utilization, OEE, cycle time, downtime, and changeover losses) and act to improve it.
* Measure and report manpower efficiency (output per man-hour or man-shift, labour cost per piece or kg, overtime and absenteeism).
* Prepare daily production reports and a monthly MIS covering plan vs. actual, OEE, rejection and scrap, material consumption vs. standard, and yield.
* Reduce rejection and rework by finding the root cause of molding defects (under-cure, air traps, short fill, blisters, excess flash) and putting corrective actions in place, working closely with the QC lab.
* Control material consumption, flash and scrap losses, and energy use.
* Make sure production transactions in SAP are accurate: production orders, material issues, receipts and stock.
* Work with maintenance on preventive maintenance of presses, molds and utilities, and with stores, QC and dispatch.
* Enforce safety, 5S and housekeeping standards, including safe operation of hydraulic presses.
* Support new product development, mold trials, SOPs and process sheets.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in compression-molded rubber goods manufacturing, as a production manager or in a related role (Production In-charge, Assistant Production Manager or Plant Manager).
* Strong hands-on knowledge of compression molding presses, curing parameters, mold handling and common molding defects.
* A record of leading and managing large shopfloor teams across shifts.
* Strong skills in calculating machine efficiency (OEE) and manpower efficiency, with experience reporting regularly from data.
* Good working knowledge of ERP systems, preferably SAP (SAP Business One is a plus), and MS Excel.
* A degree or diploma in polymer/rubber technology, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in rubber mat production (e.g., flooring, anti-fatigue, cow/animal mats, automotive mats).
* Experience working with reclaimed rubber compounds.
* Exposure to Lean, 5S, Kaizen, or ISO 9001 systems.
* Experience setting up or scaling a molding line.
* Ability to speak Malayalam and Hindi with shopfloor teams.

**What We Offer**

* A competitive salary based on experience.
* A leadership role in a growing business, with room to shape processes from the ground up.
* A hands-on management team that is investing in automation and digital production tools.

title: SME-Learning & Development
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in learning and development focuses on creating and delivering training solutions for claims adjudication and health care compliance within provider and payer environments. The position supports night shift operations enabling global coverage while ensuring accurate claims handling regulatory alignment and continuous capability building across multiple functional teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive training programs that build strong capability in claims adjudication processes for provider and payer operations while aligning with current business objectives and quality standards.
* Develop detailed learning content that simplifies complex health care claim rules and workflows so that new and existing team members can perform adjudication tasks with high accuracy and consistency.
* Deliver engaging virtual and classroom training sessions during night shift hours to support hybrid team members and ensure consistent knowledge transfer across locations.
* Conduct targeted training needs analysis by collaborating with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps in claims adjudication and prioritize high impact learning interventions.
* Monitor learner performance data and quality audit outcomes to refine course materials and ensure that training directly improves claim resolution accuracy and turnaround time.
* Ensure that all learning content reflects current health care regulations and privacy requirements related to HIPAA so that team members handle sensitive information responsibly.
* Create practical simulations and case based exercises that mirror real life provider and payer claim scenarios to help learners build confidence and decision making skills.
* Provide ongoing floor support during production hours by answering process queries and clarifying adjudication rules so that associates can resolve complex claims efficiently.
* Collaborate with process experts and compliance teams to update training materials whenever there are changes in benefit designs coding standards or regulatory guidance.
* Track training effectiveness through feedback surveys assessments and quality metrics and present insights that show how learning programs support business performance and member satisfaction.
* Maintain detailed training records and documentation that support internal audits and demonstrate adherence to organizational learning standards and regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with workforce management and team supervisors to schedule training sessions that minimize business disruption while meeting the needs of night shift hybrid associates.
* Support the adoption of digital learning tools and knowledge repositories so that team members can access updated claims adjudication and HIPAA guidance on demand.

**Qualifications**

* Apply strong knowledge of health care claims adjudication rules benefit structures and payment policies to design technically accurate learning content for provider and payer processes.
* Use hands on experience with provider and payer workflows to explain real world scenarios and guide learners in applying policy rules to complex claim situations.
* Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and data privacy expectations to embed compliance guidelines into every stage of the learning and support process.
* Utilize prior operations or quality experience within claims environments to connect training topics with performance outcomes such as first pass resolution and reduced rework.
* Demonstrate proficiency with common office productivity tools and learning platforms to create clear presentations job aids and reference guides for hybrid teams.
* Communicate clearly and inclusively with diverse audiences across global locations while adapting explanations to suit different experience levels and learning styles.
* Show readiness to work permanent night shifts in a hybrid work model while maintaining high levels of responsiveness reliability and collaboration with onshore and offshore partners.

title: Naval Architect
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Naval Architect to join our Naval Architecture team at S&O Maritime Services Pvt. is seeking a skilled Naval Architect to support Naval Architecture projects, including basic and production design, engineering calculations, and project coordination. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, project management skills, and the ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver quality engineering solutions within project timelines.

**POSITION**

Naval Architect

**COMPANY**

S&O Maritime Services Pvt. Ltd.

**LOCATION**

Aluva, Kerala

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE**

Full-Time | Permanent

(Preference will be given to candidates who are flexible and willing to undertake on-site deployments at shipyards, client locations, and marine or offshore project sites as required).

**EXPERIENCE**

2 - 4 Years of Relevant Experience

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*A. Project Management, Basic Design and Production Design*

1. **Basic Design Coordination**
   : Coordinate and manage basic design activities, including preparation and review of general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary vessel layouts, design specifications, and other relevant naval architecture deliverables in accordance with project requirements.
2. **Production Design Coordination**
   : Coordinate production design activities, including detailed engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, structural details, and production documentation, ensuring alignment with approved basic designs and shipyard requirements.
3. **Project Planning and Progress Monitoring**
   : Plan and monitor engineering activities, track project schedules and deliverables, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and ensure timely completion of assigned work packages while maintaining effective communication with project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
4. **Technical Review and Project Execution**
   : Review design deliverables for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications. Identify technical issues, coordinate corrective actions, support material take-offs and engineering documentation, and contribute to quality control throughout project execution.

*B. Basic Design Calculations, Stability and Ship Structure Analysis*

1. **Basic Design Calculations:**
   Perform preliminary naval architecture calculations, including hydrostatics, displacement, weight estimation, centre of gravity, trim, draft, and other relevant calculations required to support vessel design and development.
2. **Vessel Stability Analysis**
   : Perform preliminary intact stability calculations and assessments, evaluate relevant stability parameters, and support verification against applicable design criteria, classification requirements, and project specifications.
3. **Ship Structure Analysis**
   : Assist in ship structural analysis and strength assessments, including evaluation of structural arrangements, loads, scantlings, and structural integrity in coordination with structural engineers and in accordance with applicable design requirements.
4. **Engineering Calculations and Technical Documentation**
   : Prepare, review, and maintain calculation sheets, analysis reports, design assumptions, and supporting technical documentation. Coordinate with design and structural teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure consistency between engineering calculations, drawings, and project requirements.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Naval Architecture.

**Experience**

* 2 - 4 years of relevant experience in naval architecture, ship design, shipbuilding, marine engineering, vessel conversion, or offshore engineering.
* Experience in coordinating engineering activities, managing project deliverables, and working with multidisciplinary technical teams is preferred.

**Skills**

*Technical and Professional Skills*

* **Naval Architecture Fundamentals**
  : Good understanding of vessel design principles, hydrostatics, displacement, weight estimation, centre of gravity, trim, draft, and basic vessel stability calculations.
* **Design, Analysis and Engineering Software**
  : Candidates are expected to demonstrate proficiency in relevant software tools from the following list, depending on their area of expertise and project requirements:

Autodesk AutoCAD

Autodesk Inventor

SOLIDWORKS

Rhinoceros (Rhino 3D)

AVEVA

ShipConstructor

CADMATIC

Tekla Structures

MOSES

AutoShip

AutoHydro

AutoPower

OpenFOAM

SESAM

ANSYS

Bentley STAAD.Pro

PV Elite

* **Engineering Drawings and Documentation**
  : Ability to prepare, interpret, and review general arrangement (GA) drawings, lines plans, vessel layouts, hull forms, technical specifications, and engineering calculation reports.
* **Marine Engineering and Construction:**
  Basic understanding of hull structures, ship construction methods, marine materials, welding, fabrication processes, and interfaces between naval architecture and structural engineering.
* **Classification and Regulatory Requirements**
  : Familiarity with classification society rules, including DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, and Bureau Veritas, as well as applicable IMO regulations and client-specific requirements.
* **Project Planning and Coordination:**
  Ability to organize engineering activities, track project schedules, monitor deliverables, coordinate resources, and manage multiple assignments within agreed timelines.
* **Technical Problem-Solving and Quality**
  : Ability to identify engineering discrepancies, assess technical challenges, review design outputs, and recommend practical, safe, and cost-effective solutions.

·        
**Professional Skills**
: Effective communication, teamwork, task ownership, technical documentation, and proficiency in MS Office and project tracking tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Opportunity to work on marine and offshore engineering projects.
* Exposure to vessel design, shipbuilding, marine systems, and engineering project execution.
* Opportunities to develop technical expertise, project management capabilities, and leadership skills.
* Opportunity to work with experienced engineers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance, technical expertise, and leadership capabilities.
* Competitive salary in accordance with industry standards, qualifications, experience, and technical expertise.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/Resume with the subject:

**“Application – Naval Architect”**
Email: admin@sandomaritime.com

**WORK TYPE**

* Work Type: In-Person
* Employment: Full-Time | Permanent (Preference will be given to candidates willing to undertake on-site deployments at shipyards, client locations, and marine/offshore project sites).
* Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

**PAY**

Salary will be offered in accordance with industry standards and based on qualifications, relevant experience, technical expertise, and project management capabilities.

**WORK LOCATION**

S&O Maritime Services Pvt. Ltd.

Aluva, Kerala, India

description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

#### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Bangalore (On-site)  
**Contract type:** Permanent
  
**Target start date:** January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time (40h/week), aligned with the GMT timezone (**starting** at **1:00 PM IST**)  
**Compensation:** INR 10,00,000 – 22,00,000 per year

#### **What You'll Architect**

As a **Business Acceptance Analyst / Digital Solution Validation**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making.

This role is both analytical and consultative, ideal for someone who can bridge business requirements and delivered digital solutions while ensuring production readiness. We are looking for professionals who can connect business needs with technology delivery, ensuring that solutions meet expectations before moving into production. Professionals who think like architects and act like builders.

You will support a global team responsible for the **processes, tools, and data governance associated with customer installed-base management**, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and digital delivery teams.

##### **Responsibilities**

* Review business and functional requirements to understand expected outcomes and acceptance conditions.
* Translate requirements and specifications into **structured validation scenarios and acceptance criteria**.
* Validate delivered functionality against agreed business requirements and solution specifications.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and deviations between requirements and delivered solutions.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and digital delivery teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain traceability between **requirements, acceptance criteria, validation outcomes, and production readiness**.
* Support business acceptance and pre-production validation activities.
* Provide clear evidence-based reporting of validation results and outstanding issues.
* Challenge unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria before solutions progress toward production.
* Apply **AI-enabled techniques** to improve validation efficiency, requirements analysis, documentation quality, scenario generation, and solution analysis.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI-assisted tools.
* Collaborate effectively with international colleagues while maintaining a strong on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges.
* You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action.
* You balance technical thinking with business understanding.
* You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments.
* You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.
* You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* You have strong attention to detail and enjoy validating whether solutions truly meet business expectations.
* You embrace innovation and are interested in leveraging AI to improve quality and efficiency.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in **business acceptance, solution validation, functional testing, QA analysis, UAT, or a similar role** within digital or technology delivery environments.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and software delivery teams.
* Experience operating within agile or iterative delivery environments.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Availability to work on-site in Bangalore.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Strong understanding of business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to transform functional requirements into effective validation scenarios and acceptance approaches.
* Experience validating delivered functionality against agreed business requirements.
* Proven ability to identify discrepancies between specifications and delivered solutions.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills.
* Experience with requirements traceability and acceptance management processes.
* Experience supporting production-readiness assessments and go-live decisions.
* AI-aware mindset with the ability to apply AI-assisted techniques to validation and analysis activities.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience validating **data-driven applications, platforms, or digital products**.
* Knowledge of **data quality, data governance, or master data management** concepts.
* Familiarity with validation management, defect tracking, or requirements management tools.
* Familiarity with CRM, enterprise applications, or Salesforce ecosystems and the business processes they support.
* Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot or other Generative AI tools to support business analysis, validation, documentation, or testing activities.
* Exposure to industrial, manufacturing, energy or service environments
* Experience in consulting or client-facing projects.
* Exposure to large-scale international transformation or digitalisation programmes.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Testing, Quality Assurance, Agile, Scrum, or related disciplines.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism.
* You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions.
* You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* You combine autonomy with collaboration.
* You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus India**

* **Hybrid work** model (3 days/week in office)
* **18 paid leaves** + 9 public holidays
* **₹5L** medical insurance + **₹10L** accident insurance
* Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
* International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
* Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Referral Bonus Scheme
* Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.
